m: Amendement van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Çörüz ter vervanging van nr. 10 over een beperkte loslating van de indeling in sectoren

Removes the conditions allowing administrative refusal or withdrawal of subsidies and permits only for designated sectors, widening executive discretion and dropping the parliamentary pre-consultation requirement.
As a result, the pre-consultation requirement attached to Article 7, second paragraph, will also lapse.
Ten gevolge hiervan komt uiteraard ook de voorhangbepaling te vervallen die is verbonden aan artikel 7, tweede lid.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Çörüz c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 11 over een evaluatie van de wet herziening gerechtelijke kaart
Requires the Minister of Security and Justice to report to parliament on the effectiveness of the court map reform law within five years, and within three years for the Oost-Nederland district.
Our Minister of Security and Justice shall send to the States General within five years of the entry into force of this law a report on the effectiveness and effects of this law in practice.

Onze Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie zendt binnen vijf jaar na inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk.
Motie Çörüz c.s. over een evenwichtige zaakverdeling over zittingsplaatsen
Asks the government to ensure, when approving court case-allocation rules, a balanced distribution of cases across court sitting locations.
requests the government, when reviewing approval decisions on case allocation regulations, to safeguard
verzoekt de regering bij de toetsing van instemmingsbesluiten over zaaksverdelingsreglementen te bewaken
Motie Helder c.s. over kantonrechtspraak in iedere zittingsplaats
Asks the government to ensure cantonal court sessions are offered at every court location even after the judicial map is revised.
requests the government to ensure that cantonal court proceedings are offered at every court location
verzoekt de regering om ervoor te zorgen dat kantonrechtspraak in iedere zittingsplaats zal worden aangeboden
Amendement van het lid Çörüz c.s. over een evaluatie van de wet herziening gerechtelijke kaart
Requires the minister to report to the States General within five years on the effectiveness and effects of the judicial map reform law, and within three years for the Eastern Netherlands region.
Within five years of this law entering into force, the Minister sends the States General a report on the effectiveness and effects of this law in practice.
Onze Minister zendt binnen vijf jaar na inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk.
Motie Van der Steur en Çörüz over eigen verantwoordelijkheid directmarketingbedrijven
Asks the government to ensure direct marketing firms take responsibility for easy objection options and to report on this at evaluation.
requests the government to ensure that the direct marketing companies concerned take their responsibility and to report on this at evaluation
verzoekt de regering erop toe te zien dat de bedoelde direct marketing bedrijven hun verantwoordelijkheid nemen
Amendement van het lid Çörüz over het laten vervallen van de verplichting tot het jaarlijks opstellen van een verslag van werkzaamheden en bevindingen door de functionaris
Amendment deleting the statutory obligation for the data protection officer to publish an annual report of activities and findings.
to abolish the legally mandatory annual report of the data protection officer
het wettelijk verplichte jaarverslag van de functionaris gegevensbescherming af te schaffen
Motie Van der Steur c.s. over kostenvergoedingen aan ISP's
Asks the government to take into account the interests of small, large and business internet service providers when setting cost compensation for data requests.
to take into account the justified interests of small, large and business ISPs within the existing financial frameworks
de gerechtvaardigde belangen van de kleine, grote en zakelijke ISP's te betrekken binnen de geldende financiële kaders
Motie Çörüz en Van der Steur over geluiddempers bij wildbeheer
Asks the government to investigate and report on whether silencers and other wildlife management tools should be permitted.
requests the government to investigate whether it is desirable to permit silencers and other wildlife management tools
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken of het wenselijk is dat geluiddempers en andere middelen voor het wildbeheer worden toegestaan
Motie Çörüz c.s. over een veteranenbeleid voor uitgezonden politieambtenaren
Asks the government to consult the police field on creating a veterans policy for police officers deployed abroad, modelled on Defence's policy.
requests the government to consult the field to gauge the need for developing a veterans policy for deployed police officers
verzoekt de regering in gesprek te gaan met het veld om de behoefte te peilen aan de ontwikkeling van een veteranenbeleid voor uitgezonden politieambtenaren
Motie Dibi c.s. over een landelijke wapeninleveractie
Asks the government to organise a nationwide weapons amnesty collection action soon.
requests the government to organise a nationwide weapons collection action in the short term
verzoekt de regering om op korte termijn een landelijke wapeninleveractie te organiseren
Motie Brinkman c.s. over uniformiteit van competenties, taken, bevoegdheden en zichtbaarheid van de bestuurlijke toezichthouders
Asks the government to counter fragmentation of municipal enforcement by making competences, tasks, powers and uniform clothing of municipal supervisors uniform.
requests the government to counter this fragmentation of enforcement in the public domain
verzoekt de regering deze versnippering van de handhaving in het publieke domein tegen te gaan
Motie Çörüz en Omtzigt over een ruimere "margin of appreciation"
Asks the government to seek a wider margin of appreciation for states vis-a-vis the European Court of Human Rights and to plead for it in Council of Europe reform.
also requests the government to clearly advocate for a wider margin of appreciation in the Council of Europe reform process
verzoekt de regering tevens om in het hervormingsproces van de Raad van Europa duidelijk te pleiten voor een ruimere «margin of appreciation»
Motie Hennis-Plasschaert c.s. over regionalisering van de brandweer
Asks the government to move towards regionalisation of the fire service within the Veiligheidsregio's law.
requests the government to proceed to regionalisation of the fire service within the Veiligheidsregio's law
verzoekt de regering over te gaan tot regionalisering van de brandweer binnen de wet Veiligheidsregio's
Motie Vd Staaij c.s. over een actieprogramma bestrijding antisemitisme
Asks the government to draw up a concrete action programme against antisemitism.
requests the government to draw up a concrete action programme to combat antisemitism
verzoekt de regering een concreet actieprogramma bestrijding antisemitisme op te stellen
Motie Kuiken c.s. over de bevoegdheden van de burgemeester op het gebied van het veiligheidsdomein
Asks the government to research and propose a legal framework to harmonise and clarify mayors' fragmented powers in the broad social safety domain in the Gemeentewet.
Requests the government to submit the results of its research to the House by 1 June 2010 and to make proposals to amend the Municipalities Act.
verzoekt de regering het resultaat van haar onderzoek uiterlijk op 1 juni 2010 aan de Kamer voor te leggen en daarbij tevens voorstellen te doen voor een aanpassing van de Gemeentewet
Motie Çörüz over terugdringen aantal ongegronde klachten
Asks the government to propose ways to reduce the number of unfounded complaints against police, for example through a filing fee as gatekeeper.
requests the government to make proposals to reduce the number of unfounded complaints
verzoekt de regering voorstellen te doen om het aantal ongegronde klachten terug te dringen
Motie Çörüz over strafbaar stellen van gedrag dat gezagsuitoefening frustreert
Asks the government to propose criminalising non-violent behaviour that frustrates the exercise of public authority.
requests the government to make proposals to criminalise behaviour that frustrates the exercise of authority without being violent
verzoekt de regering voorstellen te doen om gedrag dat gezagsuitoefening frustreert zonder gewelddadig te zijn, strafbaar te stellen
Motie Çörüz over wijziging van de Wob
Asks the government to propose amending the Wob so that freedom of information does not apply to information held in police registers.
requests the government to propose amendments to the Wob to limit its application to information contained in police registers
verzoekt de regering voorstellen te doen tot wijziging van de Wob om toepassing op informatie die is opgenomen in politieregisters te beperken
Motie van het lid Çörüz over onderzoek naar een thuisblijfplicht
Asks the government to study the possibility of a limited stay-at-home obligation under the mayor's powers and report to the House.
requests the government to investigate the possibility of imposing a stay-at-home obligation under article 172a of the Municipal Act
verzoekt de regering onderzoek te doen naar de mogelijkheid om in het kader van artikel 172a Gemeentewet een thuisblijfplicht op te leggen
Amendement van het lid Çörüz om het woord "ernstig" te schrappen in artikel 509hh, eerste lid, onder a, Sv
Amendment deletes the word 'ernstig' from the criminal procedure provision on mayoral and prosecutorial measures against football violence and nuisance.
in article 509hh, first paragraph, under a, the word 'ernstig' lapses
vervalt in artikel 509hh, eerste lid, onder a, het woord «ernstig»
Amendement van het lid Çörüz over de mogelijkheid om zonder dat er sprake is van herhaaldelijk gedrag op te kunnen treden
Removes the word 'herhaaldelijk' (repeatedly) from the proposed mayoral power, so the mayor could act against nuisance without repeated conduct.
Through the amendment the mayor can also act without there being 'repeated' conduct.
Door het amendement kan de burgemeester ook zonder dat er van «herhaaldelijk» sprake is, optreden.
Amendement van het lid Çörüz over toevoegen mogelijkheid om de gedragsaanwijzing drie keer te verlengen
Allows the public prosecutor to extend a behaviour instruction three times instead of twice under the football-violence and nuisance law.
In article II, part B, in article 509hh, fourth paragraph, 'twice' is replaced by 'three times'.
In artikel II, onderdeel B, wordt in artikel 509hh, vierde lid, «twee keer» vervangen door: drie keer.
Amendement van het lid Çörüz over toevoegen mogelijkheid om de gedragsaanwijzing drie keer te verlengen
Would allow the mayor's behavioural order (gedragsaanwijzing) to be extended three times instead of two, up to twelve months.
In article I, part A, in article 172a, fourth paragraph, 'tweemaal' is replaced by 'driemaal'.
In artikel I, onderdeel A, wordt in artikel 172a, vierde lid, «tweemaal» vervangen door: driemaal.
Motie Van der Staaij c.s. over het niet ontmoedigen van het gebruik van Mosquito's
Asks the government not to discourage municipalities from using Mosquito devices until the Chamber has been consulted on their constitutionality and desirability.
requests the government not to advise against or discourage municipalities from using these Mosquitos until the Chamber has been consulted on the constitutionality and desirability of these devices

verzoekt de regering de gemeenten niet te ontraden of te ontmoedigen, deze Mosquito's te gebruiken, alvorens met de Kamer is overlegd over de (grond)wettelijkheid en wenselijkheid van deze voorzieningen
Motie van het lid Çörüz c.s. over de effectiviteit van het instrumentarium voor bestrijding van overlast
Asks the government to study the effectiveness of municipal tools against nuisance in light of court rulings and propose adjustments, reporting to the House by 1 May 2009.
requests the government to carry out a study into the effectiveness of municipal instruments to combat nuisance and neglect
verzoekt de regering een onderzoek in te stellen naar de effectiviteit van het instrumentarium van gemeentebesturen om overlast en verloedering te bestrijden
Motie van het lid Çörüz c.s. over het terugbrengen van de overhead bij de politiekorpsen
Asks the government, based on a standard to be developed, to systematically reduce overhead at regional police forces.
requests the government, based on a standard to be developed, to systematically and purposefully reduce overhead at the police forces
verzoekt de regering op basis van een te ontwikkelen standaard, systematisch en gericht de «overhead» bij de politiekorpsen terug te brengen
Motie van het lid Van der Staaij c.s. over onderzoek naar de feitelijke beschikbaarheid van politieagenten
Asks the government to research the actual availability of police officers in rural areas and promote a more even distribution.
requests the government to investigate the actual availability of officers in rural areas
verzoekt de regering onderzoek te doen naar de feitelijke beschikbaarheid van agenten in landelijke gebieden
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Uitslag en Çörüz over het bericht ‘In de zorg is fraude oké’

MPs Uitslag and Çörüz asked the government about a report that two care agencies allegedly defrauded 1 million euro, whether the Public Prosecution Service deprioritises care fraud, and how fraud detection and pgb fraud will be strengthened. The minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service decides on prosecution of the reported cases, denied that care fraud lacks priority, listed the many detection bodies and the 2011 fraud figures, and promised a proposal on the extra pgb anti-fraud funding this autumn.
It is up to the Public Prosecution Service to assess whether criminal prosecution is indicated in this case.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te beoordelen of in dit geval strafrechtelijk optreden geïndiceerd is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çörüz en Gesthuizen over het bericht ‘Drugsinfiltrant VS actief in Nederland’

MPs Çörüz and Gesthuizen asked whether a newspaper report about a US drug informant operating in the Netherlands was accurate and what rules apply to foreign and criminal civilian informants. The minister said the US denied any DEA undercover operation in the Netherlands, that foreign police may not act independently on Dutch soil, and that criminal civilian informants are in principle not permitted except in exceptional terrorism cases with safeguards.
Investigation in the Netherlands on behalf of another state always takes place under the supervision and direction of the Dutch public prosecution service and the police.
Onderzoek in Nederland ten behoeve van een andere staat vindt altijd plaats onder toezicht en leiding van het Nederlandse openbaar ministerie en de politie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Çörüz over het bericht `Politie `laks' bij grote wietzaak Nederhorst'

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police in Gooi en Vechtstreek give too little priority to cannabis grow operations, given the national drugs policy, and about one reported case in Nederhorst. The minister denied neglect, describing a regional cannabis covenant, specialised investigators, cooperation with neighbouring regions, and 63 raids in 2011 and 26 in 2012 so far, and said the main suspect has been arrested in another case.

No. The Gooi en Vechtstreek police force concluded a cannabis covenant in December 2011 with municipalities, the Public Prosecution Service, housing corporations, the Tax Authority, UWV, SVB and grid operators.
Nee. Het korps Gooi en Vechtstreek heeft in december 2011 een hennepconvenant afgesloten met gemeenten, Openbaar Ministerie, woningcorporaties, Belastingdienst, UWV, SVB en netbeheerders.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Joldersma en Çörüz over minderjarigen die zich na alcoholgebruik schuldig maken aan misdrijven en (uitgaans)geweld

Two MPs from the CDA asked the ministers of Health and of Justice about under-16s committing offences and violence after drinking, including how incidents are recorded, whether police should register alcohol use, whether public drunkenness by minors should be punished more harshly, and how higher sentence demands for alcohol-related offences are implemented. Minister Opstelten answered that police registration of alcohol use is being prepared with a bill on testing powers, that public drunkenness by youths is mostly fined already and an objective promille norm is undesirable, and that prosecutors will seek higher sentences once the testing powers take effect.
Before this registration process can be implemented, the police must be given the power to use substance tests.
Alvorens dit registratietraject te implementeren dient de politie de bevoegdheid te krijgen om middelentesten in te zetten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Çörüz over het arrest van de Hoge Raad met betrekking tot het uitmaken van een agent voor “mierenneuker”

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the Supreme Court ruling on calling a police officer a "mierenneuker" and its impact on zero-tolerance policy toward insults against police. The minister answered that the case was remanded because context was insufficiently reasoned, and that zero-tolerance policy continues unchanged.
The zero-tolerance policy toward insult, intimidation and assault of police officers continues unchanged.
Het «zero-tolerance»-beleid ten aanzien van belediging, intimidatie en mishandeling van politiemedewerkers wordt onverkort voortgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Çörüz over de honderdprocentscontrole op Schiphol

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether an Advocate-General's opinion that there is no statutory power to question travellers at Schiphol without further cause means the 100% checks must stop. The minister answered that refusing to cooperate remains punishable under the Customs Act, that the Supreme Court's ruling is awaited, and that the checks involve more than questioning, so they continue.
Moreover, the 100% checks consist of more activities than asking questions, and other control instruments and powers are also deployed.
Overigens bestaan de honderprocentscontroles uit meer activiteiten dan het stellen van vragen en worden ook andere controlemiddelen en -bevoegdheden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brinkman en Çörüz over het artikel “Gemeente Haren verscheurde parkeerboetes van gezagsdragers”

MPs Brinkman and Çörüz asked the Minister of Interior about Haren municipality tearing up parking fines issued to public officials and councillors, asking how many cases there were, whether those responsible should pay, and whether the minister would start an integrity investigation. The minister answered that records only show plate numbers, time and place, so the number of official cases cannot be stated; that enforcement is a municipal responsibility; and that integrity is a local matter, with a municipal audit committee investigation already under way.
The parking ticket booklets record only the license plates of the cars and the time and place of the violation.
In die bonnenboekjes zijn uitsluitend de kentekens van de auto’s en het tijdstip en de plaats van de overtreding genoteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çörüz en Joldersma over het bericht ‘Verkopers schoonmaakmiddel verdienen fors aan partydrug GHB’

MPs Çörüz and Joldersma (CDA) asked ministers about reports that GBL sellers profit from GHB, including hospital admissions, Netherlands as distribution country, RIVM/CAM purity findings, licensing, denaturation and the FIOD reporting point. Minister Schippers answered that GHB is being moved to list I, GBL purity bans are not desired, prevention will be analysed, and the FIOD reporting point is adequately publicised.
Very soon GHB will be moved from list II to list I of the Opium Act.
Zeer binnenkort zal GHB van lijst II naar lijst I van de Opiumwet worden verplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Çörüz over het bericht dat mensen die lid worden van een coffeeshop twee familieleden mogen meenemen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether coffeeshop members may bring two relatives, as reported in the press. The minister said the report was incorrect: Breda only discussed a request for visitor passes for a coffeeshop owner's relatives, which would conflict with the closed-club criterion, and he considers no measures necessary now.
Issuing visitor passes to relatives of club members is contrary to the (tightened) coffeeshop policy.
Het verstrekken van bezoekerspassen aan familieleden van clubleden is in strijd met het (aangescherpte) coffeeshopbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Bommel, Çörüz, Van der Staaij en Ouwehand over vrouwenrechten in Marokko

Five MPs asked the foreign minister about Morocco's Article 475, which lets a rapist avoid prosecution by marrying the victim, following the suicide of Amina Filali, and whether the Netherlands would condemn it, press for repeal via the EU, and what Dutch Matra programme work addresses women's legal inequality. The minister confirmed the article conflicts with Morocco's international obligations, said the matter is for Morocco to reform through its own national debate, and noted the EU human rights dialogue and Dutch-funded women's rights projects in Rabat.
It is not known how often such cases occur.
Het is niet bekend hoe vaak dergelijke zaken voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ormel en Çörüz over de recente aankondiging van executie van Balwant Singh Rajoana in India

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister about the announced execution of Balwant Singh Rajoana in India, the legal process, India's refusal to support a UN moratorium on the death penalty, pending clemency petitions, and EU steps. The minister said the case has had little criticism, that a de facto moratorium exists but India opposes UN resolutions, and that the EU will make a demarche in Delhi calling for the moratorium to be kept.
The EU will carry out a demarche with the Indian authorities in Delhi in the short term and raise its principled objections to the death penalty.
De EU voert op korte termijn bij de Indiase autoriteiten in Delhi een demarche uit en stelt de principiële bezwaren tegen de doodstraf aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çörüz en Omtzigt over de Magnitsky zaak

MPs Çörüz and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the Magnitsky case, including whether Russian documents are authentic, whether a US-style visa ban exists, and when the Netherlands will impose a visa ban as the House requested. The minister answered that the Russian criminal case is ongoing, that there is no categorical US visa ban but visas can be refused for human rights abuses, that the list of persons refused entry is confidential, and that further EU steps will be considered after the Russian proceedings.
Information on who is or is not registered in the Schengen Information System for refusal is confidential.
De informatie met betrekking tot wie al dan niet in het Schengen Informatie Systeem ter weigering staan geregistreerd, is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Çörüz over de uitzending “Undercover in Nederland”

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice how easy it is to order hard drugs online, whether action has been taken before, and whether steps will follow after a television broadcast. The minister found this undesirable, announced a police quickscan to gauge the scale of online drug trade, and said the Public Prosecution Service acts where possible against online drug sales and the websites involved.
To this end, I will have a quickscan carried out by the police.
Ik laat daartoe een quickscan uitvoeren door de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brinkman en Çörüz over het artikel ‘Gemeente Haren verscheurde parkeerboetes van gezagsdragers’

MPs Brinkman and Çörüz asked whether the municipality of Haren wrongly cancelled parking fines for officials and politicians, how many cases there were, and whether integrity investigations, repayment or punishment would follow. The minister answered that the cases were incidental, the practice was improper and has ended, but that the matter is local, so the municipality decides on integrity and sanctions.
This is a local matter. It is for the municipality to decide on this.
Het gaat hier om een lokale aangelegenheid. Het is aan de gemeente hierover te beslissen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Çörüz over het bericht ‘Londen boos op Europese Hof na uitspraak over radicale Aboe Katada’

An MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Foreign Affairs about the European Court of Human Rights ruling blocking the deportation of Abu Qatada to Jordan, including how many similar suspects are in the Netherlands and how Europe can avoid becoming a safe haven for extremists. The minister answered that only a very small number of such persons are in the Netherlands, explained the Court's reasoning (diplomatic assurances sufficient on Article 3, but a flagrant denial of justice risk under Article 6), and said the government will keep exploring options such as removal to third countries.
An exact number is not given in cases like these because of the nature of the files.
Een exact aantal wordt in gevallen als deze niet gegeven in verband met de aard van de dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çörüz en Omtzigt over de Magnitsky-zaak

MPs Çörüz and Omtzigt asked the foreign minister about the Magnitsky case, including what was raised with Lavrov, the posthumous prosecution, a visa ban on 60 officials, and further pressure on Russia. The minister answered that he pressed for a swift, objective investigation, questioned the posthumous proceedings, and noted the US and UK had no visa ban, deferring any EU steps until the Russian investigation concludes.
I pressed for the swift completion of an objective and comprehensive investigation into the death of Sergei Magnitsky.
Ik heb aangedrongen op een spoedige afronding van een objectief en alomvattend onderzoek naar de dood van Sergei Magnitsky.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Çörüz over de Wet Bibob

An MP asks the minister why a Bibob integrity screening of a coffeeshop operator did not lead to withdrawal of permits while police suspect illegal gambling, cannabis trade and money laundering, and whether Bibob screening and monitoring always apply. The state secretary declines to discuss the specific case citing the strict confidentiality of the Bibob Act, says screening is discretionary for municipalities, and promises to ask the Bibob quality commission to review the advice in its annual quality analysis.
To address any concerns arising from this case, I will ask the Bibob quality commission to examine the Bibob advice issued in this case.
Om tegemoet te komen aan eventuele zorgen naar aanleiding van deze casus zal ik de kwaliteitscommissie Bibob verzoeken om het Bibob-advies dat in deze casus is afgegeven te onderzoeken
Vragen van de leden Çörüz en Van Hijum (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over beelden van inbrekers gemaakt door RTV Oost (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

MPs Çörüz and Van Hijum asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether broadcasting images of burglars by RTV Oost, and public posting of identifiable footage generally, is permitted under privacy law and whether the legal framework should be clarified. The minister answered that the journalistic exemption makes such broadcasting generally permissible, that citizens should first offer footage to police and prosecutors, and that a bill amending the Wbp is in consultation to set conditions for private camera footage.
The bill contains, among other things, a further regulation on the use of surveillance camera images made by private individuals.
Dit wetsvoorstel bevat onder andere een nadere regeling voor het gebruik van beelden van bewakingscamera's die door particulieren zijn vervaardigd.
Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over Sharia4Belgium (ingezonden 16 december 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about disruption of debates by Sharia4Belgium/Sharia4Holland activists, past similar incidents, and whether the football-violence law, unwelcome declaration, and firearms-licence rules could prevent recurrence. The state secretary answered that the law could be applied to known disturbers facing serious fear of future disruption, that unwelcome declaration of EU citizens is a very far-reaching measure requiring proportionality, and that firearms licences would be refused where signals of misuse exist, but he had no direct contact with Belgian authorities on this incident.
Declaring an EU citizen unwelcome is a very far-reaching measure that must be proportionate and may be based solely on the foreigner's conduct.

Het ongewenst verklaren van een EU-burger is een zeer vergaande maatregel, die in overeenstemming moet zijn met het evenredigheidsbeginsel en uitsluitend gebaseerd mag zijn op het gedrag van de vreemdeling.

Vragen van de leden Çörüz en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het rapport «The Torture and Murder of Sergei Magnitsky and The Cover Up by The Russian Government» (ingezonden 7 december 201

MPs Çörüz and Omtzigt asked the foreign minister about the Magnitsky case, including repeated postponements of the Russian investigation, the lack of follow-up to a Russian human rights council report, and EU steps. The minister answered that the case has been raised with Russian authorities and EU officials, noting the investigation is ongoing and that the EU Parliament has condemned Russia's handling.

As long as the criminal investigation into Magnitsky's death is ongoing, it is too early to indicate the extent to which the Russian authorities have followed up on the findings of the Russian president's human rights council.

Zolang het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar de dood van Magnitsky loopt is het te vroeg om aan te geven in welke mate de Russische autoriteiten gevolg hebben gegeven aan de bevindingen van de mensenrechtencommissie van de Russische president
Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het artikel «Belangrijke criminele politie-infiltrant runt coffeeshops» (ingezonden 2 november 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice why a former police informant who allegedly ran criminal drug proceeds was able to invest in coffeeshops, and why the Bibob Act did not prevent it. The Minister replies that the criminal cases from the IRT period ended in acquittal so no confiscation was possible, that Bibob screening is the responsibility of the municipality of Haarlem, and declines to say whether a Bibob advice was issued because of confidentiality rules.
In view of Article 28 of the Bibob Act, I cannot address whether a advice was issued by the National Bibob Bureau in this case and what its outcome would have been.
Met het oog op artikel 28 van de Wet Bibob kan ik niet ingaan op de vraag of er in deze casus een advies is uitgebracht door het Landelijke Bureau Bibob

Vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Çörüz (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de veiligheid tijdens de Olympische Spelen in 2012 in Londen (ingezonden 25

The MPs asked whether the government shares US concerns about security at the 2012 London Olympics, how contact with responsible bodies is maintained, and whether the Netherlands would send its own security staff with the Dutch team. The minister answered that the UK is responsible, a Dutch liaison is stationed in London, Dutch security is considered adequate, and no Dutch security personnel will be sent unless the UK requests support.
The Netherlands has stationed a liaison from the KLPD and the Royal Marechaussee in London for this purpose.
Nederland heeft daarvoor een liaison van de KLPD en de Koninklijke Marechaussee in Londen gestationeerd.
Vragen van de leden Recourt (PvdA) en Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over Ierse klusjesmannen in Nederland (ingezonden 3 november 2011).

MPs Recourt and Çörüz asked the Minister of Security and Justice about itinerant Irish handymen suspected of fraud and coercion in the Netherlands, including whether a central registry or coordinated approach is needed. The minister said the practices are undesirable and may be criminal in some cases, pointed to police warnings, consumer information and labour and tax enforcement, and declined a central registry or coordination because no such signals had been received.
I do not have data on the number of groups that are active or their size.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens over het aantal groepen dat actief is of hun omvang.
Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het Zwitsers saldo van Bruinsma (ingezonden 2 september 2011).

An MP asked the Justice Minister how the phrase that the prosecution cannot gain sight of any Swiss balance of Bruinsma fits with reports that the FIOD investigated a bank account, and what the basis was for Swiss seizure in 1995. The minister referred to earlier answers, said the Dutch prosecution is not informed of the Swiss results or reasons, and cited tax secrecy for not disclosing the fiscal outcome.
Given the secrecy obligation of article 67 of the General State Taxes Act, the Tax Authority cannot make statements about the tax treatment of individual taxpayers.

Gelet op de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan de Belastingdienst geen mededelingen doen over de fiscale behandeling van individuele belastingplichtigen.
Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de anonieme website Silk Road (ingezonden 22 september 2011).

An MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Health whether they knew that drugs and psychiatric medicines could be bought anonymously via the Silk Road website and posted by ordinary mail, whether this was shocking, and how they would act. The government confirmed the facts, called it undesirable but a marginal phenomenon, and said the Public Prosecution Service acts where possible but cannot comment on specific investigations.
No statements can be made about concrete criminal investigations.
Over concrete strafrechtelijke onderzoeken kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan.

Vragen van de leden Çörüz en Omtzigt (beiden CDA), Timmermans (PvdA), De Roon (PVV), Van Bommel (SP), Schouw (D66), Voordewind (CU), Thieme (PvdD) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het a

MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that the UK had secretly banned Russian officials linked to the death of lawyer Magnitsky from entering, whether Russian investigations could still be trusted, and whether the Netherlands would ban the same officials. The minister replied that no visa ban was introduced by the UK or US, that Russia has continued prosecuting doctors, and that the Netherlands would raise the matter as it has before, without committing to a new measure.
The government has repeatedly expressed its concern about the death of Mr Magnitsky and the circumstances under which he died.
De regering heeft herhaaldelijk haar zorg uitgesproken over de dood van de heer Magnitsky en over de omstandigheden waaronder hij is overleden
Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de cannabisexperimenten binnen de gemeente Utrecht (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice why Utrecht continues preparing cannabis experiments despite the minister's opposition, whether the minister has contacted the mayor and public prosecutor, and what concrete action will be taken. The minister confirms the radio interview, says planning is not prohibited but the closed-club model may not be implemented under the Opium Act, and says the Public Prosecution Service will state this position locally and enforce if needed.
The experiment with the closed club model for the cultivation and use of cannabis by adults who use cannabis recreationally is in violation of the Opium Act and therefore may not be carried out.

Het experiment met het gesloten clubmodel voor de teelt en het gebruik van cannabis door volwassenen die recreatief cannabis gebruiken is in strijd met de Opiumwet en mag daarom niet ten uitvoer worden gebracht.

Vragen van de leden Çörüz en Uitslag (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat 9% van de coffeeshops zich binnen een straal van 350 meter van ee

CDA MPs asked why 9% of coffeeshops reportedly sit within 350 metres of a school, given the coalition agreement's national 350-metre rule, and what the government will do. The minister disputes the 9% figure, says the rule will be implemented via OM policy criteria from 1 January 2014, and promises a letter to parliament on implementation.
I will send your House a letter in the short term on the state of affairs and the concrete implementation of the various measures the cabinet is preparing.
Ik zal uw Kamer op korte termijn een brief sturen over de stand van zaken en concretisering van de invoering van de diverse maatregelen die het kabinet in voorbereiding heeft.
Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Succes Wallenaanpak onmogelijk te meten» (ingezonden 3 oktober 2011).

CDA MP Çörüz asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Amsterdam Coalitieproject 1012 uses methods of unknown effectiveness, how it relates to the Emergo project, and what the government will do. The minister answered that the 1012 project is purely municipal policy, that Emergo is a separate, intensively monitored project whose cooperation will continue within the RIEC Noord-Holland, and that he sees no reason to intervene.
Because this is entirely municipal policy, I have not been involved in the Coalitieproject 1012.
Omdat het hier volledig om gemeentelijk beleid gaat, heb ik geen betrokkenheid bij het Coalitieproject 1012 gehad.

Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over meerdere Nederlanders die in het buitenland actief deelnemen aan de jihad (ingezonden 15 se

An MP asks the Interior and Justice ministers about several Dutch nationals fighting in jihad abroad, including how many there are, criminal options, handling on return, and stripping nationality. The minister answers that AIVD has identified dozens of attempted travellers, that prosecution tools exist but no information on specific investigations can be given, and that nationality can be withdrawn only after a terrorism conviction for offences committed after 1 October 2010 without causing statelessness.
Insofar as the question concerns whether a criminal investigation is taking place, no statement can be made on this, because it may jeopardise investigative interests.

Voor zover de vraag betrekking heeft op het al dan niet plaatsvinden van strafrechtelijk onderzoek, kan hierover, vanwege het mogelijk doorkruisen van opsporingsbelangen, geen mededeling worden gedaan.
Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over beloningen van korpschefs (ingezonden 31 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the rewards of police chiefs would be reduced and simplified, and whether the new chiefs would live in their regions as required by a 2009 motion. The minister confirmed the goal of reducing allowances and said a residence requirement will apply to chiefs of the new units, with possible exemptions.
In my employer's proposal, which will be sent to you shortly, proposals are included for a residence requirement for the current police chiefs.
In mijn werkgeversinzet, die binnenkort aan u zal worden toegezonden, zijn voorstellen opgenomen voor een woonplaatsvereiste voor de huidige korpschefs.

Vragen van de leden Knops en Çörüz (beiden CDA) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat de Turkse moslimextremist E. in Nederland asiel heeft aangevraagd (ingezonden 26 au

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about reports that a Turkish Islamist extremist linked to Turkish Hezbollah applied for asylum in the Netherlands, including whether he was convicted in Turkey, whether extradition was requested, and how many Turkish asylum claims are made and granted. Minister Leers answered that the IND screens for exclusion under Article 1F of the Refugee Convention, that no Hezbollah-activist figure can be given because it is not registered in IND systems, and that no extradition request had been made by Turkey.
Your question how many Hezbollah activists have applied for asylum in the Netherlands in recent years, I cannot answer concretely at this moment.
Uw vraag hoeveel Hezbollah-activisten in de afgelopen jaren in Nederland om asiel hebben gevraagd kan ik op dit moment niet concreet beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over qathandel in Uithoorn (ingezonden 9 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about qat trade in Uithoorn: whether police may stop vehicles of Somali qat buyers and dealers, whether APV rules like those in Tilburg can address the nuisance and what tools the municipality has, and whether foreign intelligence services are active and what was done about it. The minister said stopping vehicles for non-discriminatory traffic reasons is permitted, the APV gives the mayor broad powers under local authority, international qat trade is not criminal under Dutch law, and the government would respond to the expert committee's advice; on foreign services he neither confirmed nor denied activity, citing the need for discretion.
The work of the security services naturally requires a great degree of discretion, including regarding the question of whether any investigation is taking place.
Het werk van de veiligheidsdiensten vereist uiteraard een grote mate van discretie, ook met betrekking tot de vraag of er onderzoek plaatsvindt.

Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het weigeren of intrekken van een wapenvergunning bij signalen van radicalisering (ingezond

An MP asked the ministers whether, since the Çörüz motion, AIVD and NCTb watch-lists of radicalisation signals were compared with weapon-permit holders, and whether this led to refusals or withdrawals. The government answered that AIVD information is not meant for weapon-permit assessments, that NCTb holds no such lists, and that the OvV investigation into the Alphen shooting will inform policy on legal firearm possession.
For the National Coordinator for Counterterrorism, under its current mandate it does not conduct investigations itself and therefore does not hold such lists of persons.

Voor de Nationaal Coördinator Terrorismebestrijding geldt dat deze, op grond van zijn huidige taakopvatting, zelf geen onderzoek doet en daarom ook niet over dergelijke «lijsten» van personen beschikt.
Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de kwaliteit van bewakingsbeelden (ingezonden 5 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why poor-quality surveillance camera footage supplied by businesses to police was not noticed earlier, whether quality has declined, and whether suppliers can be held liable. The minister answered that the problem was known and raised with businesses, that image quality is not declining, that replacing cameras is the responsibility of individual entrepreneurs, and that supplier liability depends on contractual terms.
Ultimately it is the responsibility of the entrepreneur whether he purchases a camera and, if so, of what quality.
Het is uiteindelijk de verantwoordelijkheid van de ondernemer of hij een camera aanschaft en zo ja van welke kwaliteit.

Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over karatelessen voor Marokkaanse probleemjongeren in Gouda (ingezonden 5 augustus 2011).

An MP asked whether karate lessons subsidised by Gouda for Moroccan problem youths were submitted to the Erkenningscommissie Gedragsinterventies, whether they are funded from riot-related security money, and whether projects without proven effect on nuisance and crime are still being funded. The minister answered that the project was not submitted because it is not imposed in a criminal framework, that it is funded from one-off Rijk security funds mainly to train sports club coaches, and that no new funds for at-risk youth groups are being allocated.
The project has not been submitted to the Erkenningscommissie Gedragsinterventies Justitie.
Het project is niet aangemeld bij de Erkenningscommissie Gedragsinterventies Justitie.
Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over schietincidenten op snelwegen (ingezonden 17 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Infrastructure and Environment about shootings on motorways, including what highway cameras can technically record and whether footage may be stored, and whether the law should allow storage. The government answered that a criminal investigation is ongoing, explained the limits on camera recording and ANPR retention, and said a bill allowing retention of ANPR data would be sent to the Council of State around November 2011.
I aim to submit a bill to the Council of State in November 2011.
Ik streef er naar om een wetsvoorstel in november 2011 aan te bieden aan de Raad van State.

Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat de politie geen uitvoering wil geven aan een vonnis dat is geveld door de rechterlijke macht (ingezonden 29 juni 2011).

An MP asked the Justice Minister how the police could refuse to implement a court judgment and whether the penalty payments would be paid from public funds. The minister answered that the police must comply with court rulings, that a mediated settlement ended the dispute with the two officers, and that the payments fall under the force's responsibility as employer.
I state at the outset that the police force management is obliged to implement court rulings.
Ik stel voorop dat de korpsleiding gehouden is uitvoering te geven aan rechterlijke uitspraken.
Vragen van de leden Ferrier en Çörüz (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over milities in Rio de Janeiro (ingezonden 16 juni 2011).

MPs Ferrier and Çörüz asked the Foreign Minister how militia control in Rio de Janeiro has developed since 2009, how Brazil has responded to the Freixo report and Amnesty's findings, what the Netherlands and EU have done to raise these recommendations, and how the Dutch government views and supports human rights defenders in Brazil. The minister answered that progress is slow, that implementation of the Freixo recommendations proceeds gradually according to local authorities, that the EU raised human rights defender protection at the May 2011 dialogue and will do so again, and that Dutch support for defenders is general in nature through policy, embassy engagement and EU meetings of heads of mission.
The EU has indicated that it will again put the protection of human rights defenders on the agenda at the next dialogue with Brazil.
De EU heeft aangegeven ook in de eerstvolgende dialoog met Brazilië het onderwerp van de bescherming van mensenrechtenverdedigers weer te zullen agenderen.
Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het vrijkomen van geld van de heer Bruinsma (ingezonden 26 mei 2011).

MP Çörüz asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether a Swiss-blocked account of Mr. Bruinsma was blocked at Dutch request in 1995, what happened afterwards, whether Swiss action undid Dutch seizure, and what the government will do under Plukze legislation to recover the money. The minister refers to answers given to earlier written questions from MP Gesthuizen, without repeating substance here.
I refer to my answer to the written questions from MP Gesthuizen of your House.
Ik verwijs naar mijn antwoord op de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Gesthuizen van uw Kamer
Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over qat (ingezonden 23 juni 2011).

An MP asked the Justice minister about qat: whether it should be banned, whether foreign security services operate among traders, and what municipalities like Uithoorn can do about nuisance. The state secretary said the cabinet will decide on listing qat this autumn, knows no concrete evidence of terrorist financing, cannot comment on foreign operations in ongoing investigations, and pointed to municipal bylaws (APV) as a tool.
In the interest of ongoing investigations, I cannot make statements on whether foreign authorities are active in a specific case.
In het belang van lopende onderzoeken kan ik geen mededelingen doen over de vraag of in een concreet geval buitenlandse autoriteiten actief zijn.

Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het voornemen van de Vereniging Eigen Huis om beelden van inbrekers op een website te publiceren (ingezonden 9 juni 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the Vereniging Eigen Huis plan to publish images of burglars online, including conflicting burglary statistics and whether citizens may contribute to investigations. The minister said he is in principle positive about victim initiatives within the legal framework, referred to earlier answers on statistics, and noted that the Data Protection Act governs such publication, with the CBP supervising.
In principle I am positive about initiatives by crime victims to support the police and Justice in their work.
Ik sta in beginsel positief tegenover initiatieven van slachtoffers van criminaliteit om politie en Justitie te ondersteunen in hun werk.
Vragen van de leden Cörüz en Uitslag (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Utrecht zet plan voor legale wietteelt toch door» (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

CDA MPs Cörüz and Uitslag asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he was aware of reports that Utrecht was pressing ahead with a legal cannabis cultivation plan despite his stated opposition, and what concrete action he would take. The state secretary confirmed awareness, restated his opposition, said he had already informed the Utrecht mayor and chief prosecutor, and assumed the local tripartite would act in line with his position without committing to a specific step.
I also earlier informed the mayor of Utrecht and the chief public prosecutor of this position, as announced during the oral question hour of 15 March.
Ook stelde ik eerder, zoals aangekondigd tijdens het mondeling vragenuur van 15 maart jl., de burgemeester van Utrecht en de hoofdofficier van justitie van dit standpunt op de hoogte.
Vragen van de leden Cörüz en Van Toorenburg (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over «foute» hulpofficieren (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

The MPs asked whether it is desirable that criminal cases against police officers acting as unauthorised hulpofficieren were settled by a Public Prosecution Service transaction rather than a court, whether they should be reinstated, and how many cases were affected. The minister answered that reinstatement is for the police forces to decide, that the investigation was lawfully handled by the Maastricht prosecutor, and that no national overview of affected cases exists.
The Public Prosecution Service does not have a national overview of all criminal cases in which the lack of authority of the hulpofficieren did or did not have consequences.
Het Openbaar Ministerie beschikt niet over een landelijk overzicht van alle strafzaken waarin de onbevoegdheid van de hulpofficieren al dan niet consequenties heeft gehad.
Vragen van de leden Brinkman (PVV), Hennis Plasschaert (VVD) en Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Moord Hillis gefilmd» (ingezonden 27 april 2011).

MPs Brinkman, Hennis Plasschaert and Çörüz asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that the murder of a criminal figure was filmed by police, including whether evidence was lost, whether police had prior knowledge, and whether the case compares to the IRT affair. The minister confirmed a police helicopter filmed the attack during an unrelated wiretap operation, declined to discuss the footage or the ongoing investigation, denied friction between the national and Amsterdam police, and rejected any comparison with the IRT affair.
I will not go into the content of the footage or conclusions that may or may not be drawn from it while the investigation is ongoing.
Op de inhoud van de beelden en conclusies die daaraan al dan niet kunnen worden verbonden, ga ik lopende het onderzoek niet in.
Vragen van de leden De Rouwe en Çörüz (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de blaastest (ingezonden 12 mei 2011).

The MPs ask the Justice Minister about a newspaper report casting serious doubt on breathalyser tests, whether earlier signals of doubt existed, how breathalyser devices are calibrated and certified, the relevance of a US study, whether the ongoing NFI research affects alcohol checks and counter-testing rights, and whether the NFI findings will be shared with parliament. The minister declines substantive comment on the pending case, points to earlier court and NMi findings and certification rules affirming reliability, notes counter-testing rights at the suspect's expense, and promises to share the NFI results after final judgment.
Since the case is still before the judge, I will refrain from a substantive response.
Nu de zaak nog onder de rechter is, zal ik me onthouden van een inhoudelijke reactie.
Vragen van de leden Ferrier en Çörüz (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over mishandeling van vrouwen in Irak (ingezonden 7 april 2011).

MPs Ferrier and Çörüz asked the foreign minister about violence against women in Iraq, including Article 41 of the Iraqi penal code, the arrest of youth activists, and reported pressure on the Organisation for Women's Freedom Iraq, which receives Dutch MDG3 Fund support. The minister answered that these issues are raised bilaterally and in the EU, that two detained activists were released while two remained unlocated, and that he was unaware of the raid on the OWFI office but would keep raising civil society and human rights concerns.

The Netherlands will continue to raise with the Iraqi authorities, both bilaterally and within the EU, the importance of an independently operating civil society and improving the human rights situation in general.

Nederland zal de Iraakse autoriteiten zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband blijven aanspreken op het belang van een onafhankelijk opererend maatschappelijk middenveld en het verbeteren van de mensenrechtensituatie in het algemeen.
Vragen van de leden Koopmans en Çörüz (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over wietteelt in woningen (ingezonden 15 maart 2011).

MPs Koopmans and Çörüz asked whether article 13b of the Opiumwet can be used to close homes used for cannabis cultivation, and whether a legal change is needed. The minister answered that article 13b is limited to selling, supplying and providing drugs, that cultivation is better tackled via articles 3 and 11 plus the mayor's powers under the Woningwet, and saw no reason to amend article 13b.
Against this background I see no reason to change the scope of article 13b of the Opiumwet.
Tegen deze achtergrond zie ik geen aanleiding de reikwijdte van artikel 13b van de Opiumwet te wijzigen.
Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over vastgoed (ingezonden 24 maart 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether prosecutorial settlements (transacties) in large real-estate fraud cases leave market actors uncertain about the reliability of former suspects, and whether settlements should require public admissions of guilt, be published in full, or exclude settlers from public tenders. The minister replies that market parties can ask for a VOG and details of the settlement, that no admission of guilt is required, that press releases already name suspects and offences, and that exclusion from public tenders is not possible under current European procurement law.
The Public Prosecution Service offers a settlement when it considers the suspect guilty of the offence and believes the case is provable.
Het Openbaar Ministerie gaat over tot een transactieaanbod als het de verdachte schuldig acht aan het strafbare feit en meent dat de zaak bewijsbaar is.
Vragen van de leden Uitslag en Çörüz (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de partijdrug GHB (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

MPs Uitslag and Çörüz asked the health and justice ministers about GHB, its links to school dropout and youth care, addiction treatment waiting lists, and whether it should be rescheduled. Minister Schippers answered that no causal link to dropout or youth care is known, acknowledged detox waiting lists in some regions with a protocol project underway, and committed to a new risk assessment of GHB by 1 July 2011 that could lead to rescheduling.
I have asked the CAM to complete this risk assessment by 1 July 2011.
Ik heb het CAM gevraagd deze risicobeoordeling voor 1 juli 2011 af te ronden.
Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de veiligheidsmonitor van het CBS (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice about large discrepancies between the Safety Monitor (VM) and the Integrated Safety Monitor (IVM), including car theft figures, and whether internet survey methods explain them. The Minister answered that the 2009 method change makes the surveys not directly comparable, that the IVM is usable for measuring the dark number, that the car theft gap is under consultation with CBS and industry, and that methodological quality will be kept under review.
The differences therefore do not point to a quality deficiency of the IVM.
De verschillen duiden zodoende niet op een kwaliteitsgebrek van de IVM.

Vragen van de leden Recourt (PvdA), Gesthuizen (SP) en Çörüz (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de zaak C (ingezonden 31 januari 2011).

MPs Recourt, Gesthuizen and Çörüz asked about the case of C., a convicted arms dealer whom Italy wanted detained, and about a Dutch consular official's private contact with him. The Minister of Foreign Affairs answered that the sentence transfer request is under review by the Openbaar Ministerie, that the earlier answers will be made public, and that the consular official's private visit was not recorded in the file.
I am willing to make public the answers to the earlier parliamentary questions (submitted 27 April 2010 and answered 28 June 2010) on this subject and attach them as an annex to the present answer.

Ik ben bereid de beantwoording van de eerdere Kamervragen (ingezonden op 27 april 2010 en beantwoord op 28 juni 2010) over dit onderwerp openbaar te maken en voeg deze als bijlage toe bij de huidige beantwoording.
Vragen van de leden Çörüz en Koopmans (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Met camerabeelden betrapte dieven niet vervolgd» (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Justice whether camera footage from shops and petrol stations is not being used as evidence, so that caught thieves go unprosecuted, and whether the law should change. The minister replied the report is incorrect: camera footage can be used as evidence under current law, and in the four cases footage failed to identify suspects in one (dismissed for insufficient evidence), while the others produced a conviction, a dismissal for minor prosecutorial interest, and an ongoing case.
This report is incorrect. Under current legislation, camera footage can indeed be used as evidence in criminal cases.
Dit bericht is onjuist. Camerabeelden kunnen op grond van de huidige wetgeving wel degelijk gebruikt worden als bewijs in strafzaken.
Vragen het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over bevoegdheden van particuliere beveiligers (ingezonden 14 december 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the private security industry association is in talks with the ministry about expanded powers, including access to the vehicle register, and whether the state monopoly on force should remain with the police. The minister confirmed ongoing contact on information sharing and oversight but said no concrete request for vehicle-register access was made, and that private guards lack handcuff permission, with a discussion with police on a less restrictive application of the policy planned.
The police will discuss whether there is room for this without detracting from the principle that the state monopoly on force lies with the government.
Met de politie zal worden besproken of daarvoor ruimte bestaat zonder afbreuk te doen aan het uitgangspunt dat het geweldsmonopolie bij de overheid ligt.
Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de schietincidenten en het aanzwellend geweld in Amsterdam Zuidoost (ingezonden 18 november 2010).

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about shootings and rising violence in Amsterdam Zuidoost, including the causes, police knowledge of the groups involved, whether the security risk area and intensified patrols remain in force, and why the mayor or police head has not declared a state of emergency. The minister answered that the causes are mainly drug trade and an inability to resolve conflicts without violence, that the security risk area has been extended and police measures intensified, that a state of emergency is not a suitable tool for fragmented shootings, and that the promised neighbourhood officers are on schedule.
That extension is still in force.
Die uitbreiding is nog steeds van kracht.
Vragen van de leden Çörüz en Van Toorenburg (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over autobranden (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

MPs Çörüz and Van Toorenburg asked the Justice minister about a series of car arsons, whether they deserve special police attention, whether expertise is shared between police forces, and whether a national approach is warranted. The state secretary answered that a district investigation team and extra night patrols were set up in Vught, that contact was made with other forces, that nationwide information exchange on offender profiles already occurs, and that current measures are considered sufficient.
For now, I consider these measures sufficient.
Vooralsnog acht ik deze maatregelen voldoende.
Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over doorgifte van serienummers van navigatiesystemen na diefstal (ingezonden 2 november 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Dutch Police Data Act prevents police from passing on serial numbers of stolen navigation systems to manufacturers, and whether the law should change as in Germany. The Minister answered that the Act does not prohibit such passing on, no legal change is needed, and that car manufacturers bear major responsibility for preventing reuse of stolen systems.
No, the Police Data Act does not oppose passing on serial numbers of navigation systems to the manufacturer.
Nee, de Wet Politiegegevens verzet zich niet tegen doorgifte van serienummers van navigatiesystemen aan de fabrikant.

Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over bedrijven die in 2001 een politieagent omkochten met als doel een pepperspraycontract binnen te halen (ingezonden 28 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether a former Defense Technology director confessed to bribing a Dutch police officer for a pepperspray contract, what Dutch justice is doing, whether contracts can be annulled, and what safeguards exist in procurement. The minister confirms investigation by the Rijksrecherche under the Landelijk Parket with mutual legal assistance requests, declines details for investigative reasons, says public safety was never at risk, and points to European procurement law and a court ruling.
Because of the importance of the investigation, no statements can be made about the content of the requests and the investigation.
Over de inhoud van de verzoeken en het onderzoek kunnen vanwege het belang van het onderzoek geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Vragen van de leden Ormel en Çörüz (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de ten doodveroordeling van ten Sri Lankaanse huishoudster in Saoedi-Arabië (ingezonden 1 november 2010).

MPs Ormel and Çörüz asked the Foreign Minister about the upheld death sentence of a Sri Lankan domestic worker in Saudi Arabia, including doubts over interpreting, her possible minority, and possible EU or UN steps. The minister confirmed the sentence, said there are serious doubts about the trial's fairness due to interpreter translation, noted uncertain birth date, and described EU action urging non-execution and a moratorium.
There are serious doubts about the accuracy of the translation given by an interpreter during the questioning of the suspect and the statements she made.
Er bestaat ernstige twijfel over de juistheid van de door een tolk gegeven vertaling bij het ondervragen van de verdachte en de door haar afgelegde verklaringen.

Vragen van de leden De Rouwe (CDA), Jacobi (PvdA), Berndsen (D66) en Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over problematiek rondom de aansluiting van de Meldkamer Noord-Nederland (MkN

MPs De Rouwe, Jacobi, Berndsen and Çörüz asked the minister why the regional control rooms MkNN and OCSB must use the closed NAFIN network for C-2000, causing high connection costs, and whether a cheaper public fibre link could be allowed. The minister defended NAFIN as essential for reliable, secure emergency communication, refused any revision, and said regional budgets should cover these costs, which could be offset by merging control rooms.
Given the importance of C-2000 for the safety of both citizens and emergency workers and the strict requirements this imposes on the network, I see no room to reconsider.
Gezien het belang van C-2000 voor de veiligheid van zowel burgers als hulpverleners en de strenge eisen die hierdoor worden gesteld aan het netwerk, zie ik geen ruimte om tot een herziening te komen.
Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de beloningen bij de Amsterdamse politietop (ingezonden 23 juni 2010).

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether reported pay in the Amsterdam police leadership exceeds the agreed Balkenende norm, why the former head did not report this, and whether a directive will follow. The minister confirmed the figures reflect mandatory WOPT reports, clarified the two norms, identified two officials above the norm, and said new arrangements will be reviewed and the audit findings shared, without issuing a binding directive.

I have asked the chair of the board of police chiefs to convey that police board chiefs should, in future appointments, act as far as possible in the spirit of the first draft proposal on police leadership conditions of employment.

Ik heb de voorzitter van het korpsbeheerdersberaad verzocht uit te dragen dat korpsbeheerders bij toekomstige benoemingen zoveel mogelijk handelen in de geest van het eerste conceptvoorstel arbeidsvoorwaarden politietop

Vragen van de leden Çörüz en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Justitie over uitspraken tijdens de jaarlijkse parlementaire vergadering van de Organisatie voor Veiligheid en Samenwerking

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers whether they had noted remarks by a US congressman at the OSCE parliamentary assembly claiming the Netherlands is a major source and destination of human trafficking and a top-six country for sex-trafficked women, and what action would follow. The government replied that the US TiP report classes the Netherlands as primarily origin and destination country without comparing it to others, that the cited ranking reflects CoMensha victim-origin data rather than a world ranking, and that the report gives the Netherlands a top tier ranking while listing the national taskforce and international cooperation measures already taken.
The Netherlands is described as primarily an origin and destination country and to a lesser extent a transit country (p. 248).
Nederland wordt aangeduid als primair een herkomst- en bestemmingsland en in mindere mate een doorvoerland (p. 248).
Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het veroordelen van een advocaat door een Syrische militaire rechtbank (ingezonden 8 juli 2010).

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister how the Netherlands could act internationally against Syria's arrest and conviction of critics, including lawyer Haitham al-Maleh, and what would be done about his health and detention conditions. The minister answered that Nether­lands raised the issue bilaterally and in the EU, pushed for an EU clause allowing suspension of the Association Agreement, and called for al-Maleh's release.

I have already urged EU High Representative Ashton to issue a statement on behalf of the EU condemning the arrests and convictions of the Syrian human rights defenders and calling for their immediate release.
Ik heb reeds bij EUHV Ashton aangedrongen op een verklaring namens de EU, waarin de arrestaties en veroordelingen van de voornoemde Syrische mensenrechtenverdedigers worden veroordeeld
Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Justitie over het niet vervolgen van zeker zestien in Nederland wonende misdadigers uit Rwanda (ingezonden 27 april 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Justice why the Public Prosecution Service reportedly does not prosecute sixteen Rwandan genocide suspects living in the Netherlands, and whether a Rwandan verdict in one case should trigger prosecution. The minister answered that such reports are assessed case by case, that several cases have led to investigations and one conviction under appeal, and that a Rwanda extradition arrangement is being pursued while dossiers remain under review.
Whenever new information is obtained, the situation of a case is reassessed, and an investigation may still be opened.
Steeds wanneer nieuwe informatie wordt verkregen wordt de situatie van een zaak opnieuw beoordeeld, en kan alsnog tot het starten van een opsporingsonderzoek worden besloten.

Vragen van de leden Çörüz en Ten Hoopen (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat winkeliers veel minder aangifte doen van winkeldiefstallen omdat de politie niet of

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether falling willingness of shopkeepers to report shoplifting, due to slow or inadequate police response, reflects police understaffing and how this fits with pledges that budget cuts would not harm police work. The minister denied staffing as the cause, cited police strength above agreed levels and rising case disposals, and said an expert group would advise on improving reporting intake, including a national form and online reporting.
The reduced willingness to report is not explained by insufficient manpower, since police strength has increased in recent years and stood at 53,348 full-time equivalents on 31 December last.
De verminderde aangiftebereidheid is niet te verklaren door onvoldoende mankracht, immers de politiesterkte is de afgelopen jaren toegenomen en bedroeg op 31 december jongsleden 53.348 fte.

For privacy reasons I cannot go into individual cases.
Omwille van privacyredenen kan ik niet ingaan op individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de arrestatie van Pakistaanse oud-premier Imran Khan

Rep. Kuzu asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of former Pakistani PM Imran Khan, the alleged mistreatment of his lawyers, the Section 144 assembly ban, and whether the Netherlands would speak out internationally. The minister answered that the government cannot judge proportionality of the measures, regrets any mistreatment of lawyers, supports the EU statement, and discussed the matter with his Pakistani counterpart.
The cabinet cannot give a judgement on whether the measures taken are proportionate to the threat to public order and security.
Het kabinet kan geen oordeel geven over de vraag of de genomen maatregelen in verhouding staan tot de dreiging voor de openbare orde en veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het programma op de Duitse publieke zender ZDF op 17 februari jl. over het functioneren van de Hoge Vertegenwoordiger in Bosnië Christian Schmidt

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a ZDF documentary alleging that High Representative Christian Schmidt in Bosnia is biased toward Croat nationalists, weakens democracy, and imposed a retroactive electoral law change. The minister answered that the HV acts autonomously within the Dayton mandate, the government shares concern about ethnic divisions and has raised them with the Office of the HV, but it rejects condemning Schmidt and will keep working through diplomatic channels.
The cabinet considers it important that the HV fulfils that task in an independent manner.
Het kabinet acht het van belang dat de HV die taak op onafhankelijke wijze invult.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu (DENK) over het van overheidswege uitschakelen van internet terwijl de autoriteiten jagen op een Sikh-prediker

DENK MP Kuzu asked the Foreign Minister about the Indian Punjab state's internet shutdown during the hunt for a Sikh preacher, and whether this collectively punishes about 30 million Punjabis and violates their rights. The minister said the government sees internet access as part of free expression, that such shutdowns should be used only in extreme emergencies, cannot judge the threat from available information, and that Netherlands raises minority and free-expression rights with India through human rights dialogue.
The cabinet is of the view that access to online media and services is an essential part of media freedom and freedom of expression, and can therefore be counted among human rights.
Het kabinet is van mening dat toegang tot online media en diensten een essentieel onderdeel van mediavrijheid en vrijheid van meningsuiting vormt, en daarmee tot de mensenrechten gerekend kan worden.

Antwoord op vragenvan de leden Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, Ephraim, Gündoğan, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons, Eppink, Ceder, Van der Plas, Teunissen, Kuzu, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Den Haan,

MPs from across the parliament asked why Jan Zwartendijk, who saved thousands of Jews in WWII, was reprimanded and why he should not receive the highest honour posthumously, and whether a memorial and rule changes are possible. The minister apologised for any reprimand, agreed to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on a posthumous Erepenning in gold, made a one-time exception to the 1951 policy, and said a memorial at the Foreign Ministry is being prepared.
I am therefore wholeheartedly willing to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on whether Mr Zwartendijk can be posthumously nominated for the Erepenning for Humanitarian Aid, in gold.

Ik ben dan ook van harte bereid om het Kapittel voor de Civiele Orden om advies te vragen of de heer Zwartendijk postuum kan worden voorgedragen voor de Erepenning voor Menslievend Hulpbetoon, in goud.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Nispen, Van der Lee, Ceder, Teunissen, Piri, Kuzu en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat de overdracht van Singh aan Nederland gebaseerd is op politieke onwil

MPs from several parties asked the Justice and Foreign Ministers whether the government has done enough to bring detained Dutch national Jaitsen Singh from the United States to the Netherlands, and why a transfer (WOTS procedure) was not pursued after a parole denial. The government answers that a WOTS transfer does not meet the policy criteria because of insufficient ties to the Netherlands, that a pardon route on humanitarian grounds remains open, and that the family's willingness to take him in does not change the assessment.
The cabinet continues to make efforts to bring Mr Singh to the Netherlands on humanitarian grounds because of his advanced age and fragile health, provided he poses no danger to society.
Het kabinet blijft zich inspannen om de heer Singh op humanitaire gronden vanwege zijn hoge leeftijd en fragiele gezondheid naar Nederland te brengen, mits hij geen gevaar voor de samenleving vormt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de doofpotoperatie rondom Srebrenica en de rol van Dutchbat III hierin.

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that Dutchbat III saw far more of the Srebrenica executions than it disclosed, the handover of 350 men, the alleged cover-up by generals Couzy and Van Baal, and lessons learned. The minister mostly referred to the NIOD report and parliamentary enquiry findings, acknowledged the handover was wrong under the Supreme Court ruling, and described post-Srebrenica rules on deployment decisions and Afghanistan evacuation reviews.
Good information provision is essential for the functioning of Defence, and this also applies to information provision to political office holders.
Een goede informatievoorziening is essentieel voor het functioneren van Defensie, dit geldt ook voor de informatievoorziening richting de bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het feit dat babysterftecijfers bij asielzoekers zeven keer hoger liggen dan het landelijk gemiddelde

Kuzu (DENK) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that infant mortality among asylum seekers is seven times the national average, and whether discrimination in care or the reception system explains it. The State Secretary acknowledged the concern, noted several possible causes including late pregnancy care, relocations and reception conditions, and pointed to existing care arrangements and planned discrimination research without committing to new specific measures.
The starting point is that asylum seekers are moved as little as possible, especially vulnerable groups such as children and pregnant women.
Het uitgangspunt is dat asielzoekers zo min mogelijk verhuizen, zeker waar het gaat om kwetsbare groepen, zoals kinderen en zwangere vrouw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sahla, Belhaj en Kuzu over het artikel 'Racisme duwt medewerkers uit de ouderenzorg'
