MPs Sahla, Belhaj and Kuzu asked ministers about a NRC article saying racism pushes care workers out of elderly care, and about the scale of discrimination, its effect on health and sickness absence, and what government and care providers are doing. The ministers answered that discrimination is recognised but insufficiently addressed by employers, cited survey data, described existing Arbo duties and support tools, and announced a national study in 2023 and a progress letter in autumn 2023.
The Ministry of VWS intends to start a nationwide study in 2023 into discrimination and equal opportunities in care, welfare and sport.
Het Ministerie van VWS wil in 2023 een landelijk onderzoek starten naar discriminatie en gelijk kansen in de zorg, welzijn en sport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder en Kuzu over de modernisering van de Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap

MPs from D66, VVD, CDA and DENK asked about the coalition agreement's plans for a private register of unwanted nationality and for revising the automatic loss of Dutch nationality after thirteen years abroad. The government answered that the register is a societal initiative the state would only support if taken up, and that it will draft a bill in the first quarter of 2023 amending the Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap to revise the loss rule and add a recovery option.
I am preparing a bill that amends the Netherlands Nationality Act on these two points.
Ik bereid een wetsvoorstel voor dat de Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap op deze twee onderdelen wijzigt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Kuzu, Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Brekelmans, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons en Piri over het bericht dat waarnemers van de Organisatie voor Veiligheid en Samenwerkin

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about two Ukrainian OSCE staff members sentenced to over ten years by courts in the unrecognised Luhansk region, asking about their detention conditions, pressure on Russia, evacuation of local staff, and whether Turkey could help secure their release. The minister confirmed the sentences, said detention location is unknown, listed joint EU and OSCE calls for release, and said the OSCE Secretary General is working on their release.
At this time it is not known where the detainees are being held.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend waar de gevangenen worden vastgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de werking van de technische regeling tussen de EU en Israël

MP Kuzu asked whether products from Israeli settlements in occupied territories are excluded from EU preferential tariffs, how Dutch customs checks origin claims, and what enforcement data exist for 2017-2021. The Staatssecretaris confirmed exclusion, described risk-based and sample-based checks (0.4% physical, 2.8% document checks), reported no refusals or verification requests, and stated no Commission monitoring information was given.
The customs declaration for free circulation does not contain information on the postcode of the place where a product underwent its origin-conferring processing.
In de aangifte voor het vrije verkeer (de invoeraangifte) wordt geen informatie opgenomen over de postcode van de plek waar een product zijn oorsprongsverlenende be- of verwerking heeft ondergaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, De Roon, Kuzu, Van der Lee en Piri over het feit dat Taiwan graag waarnemend lid wil worden van de Internationale Burgerluchtvaartorganisatie

MPs from seven parties asked the government about Taiwan's wish to become an observer at the ICAO, including whether it could be invited under the Council's rules, its safety relevance for flights, and whether the Netherlands would support its participation at the 41st Assembly. The minister answered that Taiwan could in principle be invited as an 'other body' observer to the Council only if China agreed, is excluded from the Assembly under Taiwan's non-state status, and that the Netherlands supports meaningful Taiwan participation in coordination with like-minded countries while respecting its one-China policy.
Taiwan is not considered a state by the Netherlands and most other states in the world and therefore cannot in principle participate as an observer in these meetings.
Taiwan wordt door Nederland en de meeste andere staten in de wereld niet als staat beschouwd en kan daarom in principe niet als waarnemer aan deze vergaderingen deelnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het Nederlandse stemgedrag in de World Health Assembly

An MP asks why the Netherlands voted against the annual WHA resolution on health conditions in the occupied Palestinian territory and Syrian Golan in 2021 and 2022, while supporting the resolution on Ukraine, and whether this double standard undermines credibility. The minister answers that each resolution is judged on its merits, that the Palestinian/Golan resolution diverges from its underlying report and is handled separately from other emergencies, and that the government recommended folding it into the general emergency agenda item, without committing to change its vote.
The government assesses every resolution on its content and merits.
Het kabinet beoordeelt iedere resolutie op inhoud en merites.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht Moeder van mishandelde jongen (5) uit azc Katwijk: 'Hij reageert anders'

An MP asked the State Secretary about a report that a five-year-old boy was beaten at the Katwijk asylum centre, the slow police investigation, safety and mental health measures, and the mother's criticism of the COA. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, pointed to the ongoing investigation and to 24-hour security and COA supervision, and said COA can refer residents and transfer them if needed.
It is important that this investigation is carried out carefully. In the interest of proper procedure, I am awaiting the outcome.
Het is van belang dat dit onderzoek zorgvuldig plaatsvindt. In het belang van een goede procesorde wacht ik de uitkomst af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht 'Onrust in azc Katwijk na mishandeling Adam (5)'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the reported assault on a five-year-old boy at the Katwijk asylum centre, including oversight, registration of incidents, and whether the centre's safety policy is adequate. The State Secretary declined to comment on the case because a criminal investigation is ongoing, pointed to a WODC report with incident statistics, and said no additional safety measures were needed for now.
In the interest of a careful legal process I cannot make statements about what happened, partly because the investigation has not yet been completed.
In het belang van een zorgvuldige procesgang kan ik geen mededelingen doen over wat er is gebeurd, mede omdat het onderzoek nog niet is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het afschaffen van vitamine D uit de basisverzekering

An MP asked the minister about removing vitamin D from the basic health insurance package, its health effects for risk groups and the burden on people with darker skin. The minister answered in detail, acknowledging the health role of vitamin D but refusing to reinstate coverage, following the Zorginstituut's advice and committing to monitor effects.
The Zorginstituut will therefore monitor in practice the effects of no longer reimbursing vitamin D.
Het Zorginstituut zal daarom de effecten van het niet meer vergoeden van vitamine D in de praktijk monitoren

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Piri, Kuzu, Teunissen, Stoffer, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Lee, Brekelmans en Dassen over het gebrek aan humanitaire toegang in de Tigray-regio in Ethiopië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the lack of humanitarian access to Tigray, Ethiopia, including calls for UN investigations, sanctions, safe zones and press freedom. The minister answered that Nederland supports independent investigation and humanitarian access, has pressed for sanctions and an arms embargo within the EU without sufficient support, and will raise press access with the EU Special Envoy.
The Netherlands will continue to press, in EU and international contexts, on the three priorities mentioned above.
Nederland zal zich in blijven zetten, in EU- en internationaal verband, op de hierboven genoemde drie prioriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Kuzu , Sylvana Simons en Sjoerdsma over straffeloosheid voor oorlogsmisdaden in Jemen

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about rising Saudi-led coalition airstrikes in Yemen after the UN Human Rights Council ended its war-crimes investigation, and whether Netherlands would push to resume an UN-mandated inquiry. The minister said the April ceasefire is holding, that Netherlands supports UN envoy efforts, but will not launch an initiative at the Council because the chance of success is very small, instead funding local accountability efforts.
The Netherlands will continue to emphasise the importance of combating impunity in international fora and in bilateral talks.
Ook zal Nederland het belang van het tegengaan van straffeloosheid in internationale fora en in bilaterale gesprekken blijven benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de doodgeschoten journalist van Al Jazeera op de Westelijke Jordaanoever

An MP from DENK asks the Foreign Minister about the killing of Al Jazeera journalist Shireen Abu Akleh in the West Bank, including who fired, whether international law was breached, and whether the Israeli ambassador should be summoned. The minister answers that the facts are unclear, calls for a transparent and thorough investigation, says he raised this with Israeli and Palestinian counterparts, and declines to make judgements on international law violations.
The cabinet does not agree with your characterisation that Israel is an apartheid state.
Het kabinet gaat niet mee met uw bewoordingen dat er sprake is van een apartheidsstaat in Israël.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Westerveld, Van Esch, Agema, Sylvana Simons, Koekkoek, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Eerdmans en Den Haan over de gewiste opnames van de OMT-vergaderingen

MPs asked whether recordings of OMT (Outbreak Management Team) meetings fall under the Archiefwet, whether the 14 April 2020 recording was destroyed and by whom, and about COVID-19 hotspot archiving lists. The minister answered that audio recordings are used only to draft minutes, that the minutes are archived while recordings are deleted as standard practice, and that some answers (selection lists, hotspot lists) would follow later.
An audio recording of an OMT meeting is deleted by the secretariat after the minutes are finalised. There is no registration of this.
Een geluidsopname van een OMT-vergadering wordt door het secretariaat verwijderd na het definitief vaststellen van het verslag. Hier is geen registratie van.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de sancties van het Verenigd Koninkrijk aan Bosnisch Servische politici Milorad Dodik en Zeljka Cvijanovic

An MP asked whether the Netherlands would impose sanctions like the UK's on Bosnian Serb politicians Dodik and Cvijanovic and why the EU had not acted; the minister said the Netherlands had pushed for targeted EU sanctions without success, Hungary opposes them, and the government keeps the option open via EU and bilateral channels. The answers acknowledge the UK acted bilaterally but do not commit the Netherlands to comparable national measures, since no legal basis exists.
In the Netherlands there is currently no legal basis for imposing bilateral sanctions such as trade measures or an entry ban.
In Nederland bestaat er op dit moment geen juridische basis voor het instellen van bilaterale sancties als handelsmaatregelen of een inreisverbod.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Piri over de Russische 'sigarettenkoning' die onder Europese sancties uitkomt, omdat Nederland er niet in slaagt om zijn vermogen te bevriezen

MPs Kuzu and Piri asked whether Russian oligarch Kesajev's assets can be frozen under EU sanctions, given his resignation from a supervisory board, and how control, ownership, UBO identification and supervision by DNB work. The government answered that resignation alone does not avoid sanctions, that control can be decisive, that DNB confidentiality limits disclosure of individual cases, and that Netherlands will keep pressing for lowering the ownership threshold from 50% to 25%.
Furthermore, no funds, economic resources or other benefits may be made available, directly or indirectly, to sanctioned persons, such as shareholders.
Daarnaast mogen er (direct en indirect) geen tegoeden en economische middelen of andere voordelen ter beschikking worden gesteld aan gesanctioneerde (rechts)personen zoals aandeelhouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht 'Migranten door kou gestorven aan de Turks-Griekse grens'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about reports that twelve (later nineteen) migrants died of cold after alleged pushbacks at the Greek-Turkish border, and about Greek denials, UNHCR warnings, Frontex's role and EU funding. The government condemned alleged pushbacks, said it lacks independent information, pointed to the Commission's responsibility as guardian of the treaties and to an independent monitoring mechanism, and promised no concrete new step.
The cabinet refers gladly to the answers to questions 4 and 5.
Het kabinet verwijst graag naar de beantwoording van vragen 4 en 5.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Haan en Kuzu over het bericht dat de zorg nog niet klaar is om de groeiende groep oudere migranten met dementie op passende wijze zorg te verlenen

MPs Den Haan and Kuzu asked whether healthcare is adequately prepared for older migrants with dementia, citing missed diagnoses, language barriers and lack of culturally adapted tests. The minister answered that GP guidelines already address this, that a study on interpreters is underway with results expected around summer, that culture-specific care guidance exists, and that a letter on culturally sensitive care will follow in autumn 2022.
Given the growing number of people with a migration background who depend on good care, I will send your House a letter on culturally sensitive care in autumn 2022.
Gegeven het toenemend aantal mensen met een migratie-achtergrond dat op goede zorg is aangewezen, zal ik uw Kamer in het najaar 2022 een brief doen toekomen over cultuursensitieve zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het kabinetsbesluit UAWC niet langer te financieren en Israëls criminalisering van Palestijnse maatschappelijke organisaties

An MP from DENK asks the government about its decision to end funding for the Union of Agricultural Work Committees (UAWC) over alleged links to the PFLP and about the consequences for Palestinian civil society, including UN rapporteurs' objections. The ministers answer that the government found individual ties to the PFLP, sees no basis to classify UAWC as terrorist, has consulted the Palestinian side, and will coordinate with other donors and the EU without giving a timeline.
Based on the external investigation, the cabinet has no reason to classify UAWC as a terrorist organisation.
Het kabinet heeft op basis van het externe onderzoek geen reden om UAWC te kwalificeren als een terroristische organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Teunissen, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Simons en Dassen over het lot van de Afghaanse ambassadebewakers

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister why the Afghan guards employed by an external contractor at the Dutch embassy in Kabul were not evacuated, when the Belhaj motion called for evacuating those who assisted the Dutch government, and whether the contractor was informed of the decision. The minister answered that the guards were not embassy employees and guarded other states' diplomatic missions, so they fell outside the evacuation criteria; he acknowledged the contractor received no timely written reply and that the lists and correspondence are shared only confidentially.
The request of 15 August and both reminders are shared with you on a confidential basis.
Het verzoek van 15 augustus en beide rappels worden op vertrouwelijke basis met u gedeeld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Ellemeet, Van der Graaf, Piri, Jasper van Dijk, Dassen, Kuzu en Teunissen over het bericht 'Polish coalition dynamics complicate rule-of-law talks, says EU’s justi

MPs asked the government whether the EU rule-of-law conditionality mechanism would be activated before Hungary's April 2022 elections and why it had not yet been used, and urged the Netherlands to press the Commission. The minister replied that the Commission had delayed the mechanism pending guidelines and a Court of Justice ruling (issued 16 February 2022), that the procedure takes at least three months so cannot be finished before the Hungarian vote, and that the Netherlands continues to urge swift guidelines and activation.

The government continues to urge the Commission to fully use the MFK rule-of-law regulation by establishing guidelines as soon as possible and starting the procedure to suspend or stop payments of EU funds.

Het kabinet blijft er bij de Commissie op aandringen om de MFK-rechtsstaatverordening volledig te benutten, door nu zo snel mogelijk richtsnoeren vast te stellen, en de procedure om tot de opschorting of stopzetting van uitkering van EU-middelen te komen, te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Ceder, Koekkoek, Jasper van Dijk, Simons, Piri  en Kuzu over afwijzingen kort verblijf familieleden Syrische Nederlanders

MPs asked why Syrian visitors for family visits, even when they appear to meet the Visa Code conditions, are refused at a high rate (55% for Syrians overall, about 75% for family visits), and whether the Syrian war is treated as breaking ties to the home country. The Minister of Foreign Affairs answered that each application is assessed on its merits under the Visa Code, that refusals mostly reflect insufficient ties to the country of origin and doubts about timely return, and that Syrian nationals can only obtain a family visit visa if these concerns are resolved.
Every visa application is assessed on its own merits in accordance with the provisions of the Visa Code.
Alle visumaanvragen worden echter op hun eigen merites beoordeeld overeenkomstig de bepalingen van de Visumcode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Agema over aerosole transmissie en het belang van ventilatie

Opposition MPs Kuzu and Agema asked the health minister about aerosol transmission of SARS-CoV-2, the role of ventilation, and why COVID policy did not focus more on it. The minister answered that transmission is mainly droplet-based at short range, that aerogenic transmission is addressed through ventilation advice and measures, and that existing ventilation rules and funding for schools remain the policy.
We have adjusted the government website for this specific passage, because it is not in line with current insights.
Wij hebben de website rijksoverheid.nl aangepast voor deze specifieke zinsnede, want dat is niet conform de huidige inzichten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Dassen, Kuzu, Teunissen, Simons, Van der Plas en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Buitenlandse Zaken weigert Afghaanse bewakers ambassade Kabul te evacueren’

MPs asked why Dutch embassy security guards employed via a subcontractor in Kabul were not evacuated while Hungarian guards were, and whether a new direct-employment criterion was introduced without informing parliament. The government answered that the criteria for evacuation (Belhaj motion) were unchanged, that embassy guards fall under host-state responsibility and their employer is responsible, and gave figures on remaining interpreters and Afghans awaiting transfer.
There is no question of a new criterion.
Er is geen sprake van een nieuw criterium.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Simons en Kuzu over de administratieve detentie van Palestijnen

MPs Simons and Kuzu asked the Foreign Minister about over 500 Palestinians held in administrative detention by Israel without charge or trial, including a hunger strike by six detainees, and whether the government would condemn it, press for release, and reconsider the EU-Israel Association Agreement. The minister acknowledged the concern, said five of six hunger strikers had ended their strike via agreements, and said the Netherlands and EU press for strict compliance with safeguards and support NGOs, while declining to commit to sanctions or suspension of the Association Agreement, instead favouring resuming the Association Council.

The Netherlands and the EU consider the specific situation, and more broadly the frequent use of administrative detention, worrying, and regularly stress to the Israeli authorities the importance of a fair legal process.

Nederland en de EU achten de specifieke situatie, en in bredere zin het veelvuldig gebruik van administratieve detentie, zorgelijk en onderstrepen in gesprekken met de Israëlische autoriteiten met regelmaat het belang van een eerlijke rechtsgang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Bikker, Kuzu, Pouw-Verweij en Van der Plas over eiwit-vaccins

MPs asked the health minister about people who want a protein-based COVID-19 vaccine, the cancellation or reduction of Sanofi and Novavax orders, and vaccine efficacy data. The minister said the government has no data on the size of this group, chose Novavax over Sanofi and bought fewer Novavax doses because mRNA vaccines were already sufficient, and gave efficacy figures while noting approval and procurement decisions rest with EMA and the Gezondheidsraad.
I therefore see no need to investigate this in further detail, but will ask the RIVM to keep paying attention to this in its monitoring.
Ik zie daarom geen noodzaak om dit in verder detail uit te zoeken, maar zal het RIVM vragen ook hier in de monitoring aandacht voor te blijven houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat Israël zes Palestijnse mensenrechtenorganisaties als terroristisch heeft bestempeld

An MP asked the foreign minister about Israel's designation of six Palestinian human rights organisations as terrorist, and about the broader record of Israeli rights violations and the Dutch response. The government said it had requested the underlying evidence from Israel without receiving it yet, that it raises the issue bilaterally and in the EU, and that it continues to press Israel on international law and accountability.
The information underlying the six listings is not public.
De informatie die ten grondslag ligt aan de zes listings is niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de herpublicatie van het boek ‘Allerlei Ontucht’

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the republication of the book 'Allerlei Ontucht', which may glorify or normalise child sexual abuse, should be banned or withdrawn, and what approach is needed on paedophilia and child abuse awareness. The minister answered that such texts are not per se criminal unless they incite a crime, that a planned offence on preparatory instructive material is coming to parliament, that literary works should not be censored, and listed prevention, public-private cooperation and enforcement measures.
It must be prevented that censorship is unintentionally imposed on books and other literary works, even when these works must be considered absolutely indecent and contrary to current moral views.

Voorkomen moet worden dat onbedoeld censuur wordt opgelegd op boeken en andere literaire werken, ook wanneer deze werken absoluut ontuchtig en in strijd met de huidige morele opvattingen moeten worden geacht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Wijngaarden, Piri, Bromet, Belhaj , Teunissen, Kuzu, Dassen, Van der Plas, Leijten , Jasper van Dijk, Simons, Boswijk, Stoffer en Ceder over de evacuatie in Afghanistan

MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether the Netherlands would send soldiers to collect evacuees in Kabul and bring them past Taliban checkpoints to the airport, and how the Dutch evacuation would be carried out given the rising number of Dutch nationals in Afghanistan. The ministers replied that the government is doing everything to evacuate the priority groups, that extra special forces have arrived, and that operational details cannot be disclosed for security reasons.
In the interest of the safety of our soldiers, diplomats and evacuees, and so as not to endanger the operation, the cabinet cannot make further detailed statements about this.
In het belang van de veiligheid van onze militairen, diplomaten en de evacués en om de operatie niet in gevaar te brengen kan het kabinet hier verder geen gedetailleerde uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Boswijk, Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Bromet, Ceder, Kuzu en Dassen over Afghaanse tolken

MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs how the government would support Afghan interpreters and their families to evacuate as security collapsed, including whether passport requirements would be waived and a charter flight arranged. The government said it is doing everything possible to bring the group to safety, explained that Afghan authorities and airlines required passports and that airport access depends on verifiable identity, and promised a further letter on the consequences of recent developments.
The cabinet will shortly send a further letter to address the consequences of the recent developments.
Het kabinet zal op korte termijn een nadere brief sturen om in te gaan op de consequenties van de recente ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Bromet, Ceder en Kuzu over het beschermen van Afghanen die werkzaam waren voor Nederland tijdens de Afghanistanmissies

MPs from six parties asked the cabinet why it is not doing more to quickly bring Afghan interpreters and other former local staff who worked for Dutch missions to safety, including questions on the asylum process, document problems, non-interpreter staff, and a deportation moratorium. The ministers answered that additional staff were deployed, interpreters' remaining requirements were dropped, about 43 interpreters had arrived since June, non-interpreters are assessed individually and generously, and the moratorium's extension will be decided later.
The cabinet is taking all steps within its own power to bring the interpreters and their families to the Netherlands as quickly as possible.
Het kabinet onderneemt alle stappen die binnen het eigen vermogen liggen om de tolken en hun gezinnen op een zo kort mogelijke termijn naar Nederland over te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Ceder en Kuzu over ‘De Nederlandse militairen zijn weg uit Afghanistan, maar hun tolken lopen gevaar’

MPs asked the Defence and Justice ministers about Afghan interpreters and guards who worked for the Dutch mission still awaiting admission, including passport delays, EUPOL interpreters and exclusion of guards. The government gave detailed figures, explained passport and identity-verification obstacles, said it will consider guards case by case, and answered that each question would be addressed separately.
The cabinet makes maximum efforts to do what is possible if an applicant does not have a passport.
Het kabinet zet zich maximaal in om te doen wat mogelijk is indien een aanvrager niet over een paspoort beschikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Kuzu en Ceder over de noodsituatie van de Afghaanse tolken

MPs from five parties asked the Defence Minister how many Afghan interpreters and their families had arrived in the Netherlands in June 2021, how many remain in Afghanistan, and what is being done to speed up their transfer and protect them. The government answered with case counts (90 families arrived since 2014, 84 active applications in Afghanistan, 113 rejected), listed measures to accelerate processing, and said the embassy in Kabul will remain open if security allows.
For security reasons I cannot go into these measures.
Omwille van veiligheidsoverwegingen kan ik niet ingaan op deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de operationalisering en instrumentalisering van de IHRA-definitie van antisemitisme

An MP from DENK asks the Minister of Justice and Security about the European Commission's handbook on the IHRA antisemitism definition, its authors, use in funding and the appointment of the national antisemitism coordinator Eddo Verdoner, including his former board role at CIDI. The Minister answers that the Commission decides its own publications, that the IHRA definition is a non-legally binding working definition, that funding conditions require a statutory basis, and that Verdoner has resigned his prior functions and is suitable for the post.
The European Commission itself decides on the texts it publishes.
De Europese Commissie beslist zelf over de teksten die zij publiceert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over marktkooplieden in de non-food sector, die nog steeds niet open mogen

An MP asked the Justice, Social Affairs and Economic Affairs ministers why non-food market traders may still not reopen, why they are excluded from click & collect, NOW and TVL support, and whether the Tozo partner-income test and market fees can be relaxed. The minister answered that epidemiological conditions do not yet allow reopening, that the partner-income test will be kept for capacity and equality reasons, and that municipalities decide on market fees without a separate compensation scheme.
The cabinet does not intend to abolish the partner income test in the Tozo.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens de partnerinkomenstoets in de Tozo af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de massaprotesten tegen nieuwe landbouwwetten van de Indiase premier Narendra Modi

An MP from DENK asked the government about mass protests in India against new agricultural laws, including internet shutdowns, the use of force, concerns about farmers' incomes and human rights, and calls for Dutch diplomatic action. The ministers answered that the laws are an internal Indian matter, that the government welcomes dialogue and the suspension of the laws, and that it will raise civil society and responsible business conduct through existing channels.
Parliamentary approval of the laws is an internal Indian matter.
Daarbij is de parlementaire goedkeuring van de wetten een interne Indiase aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over honderden bewoners van de Rotterdamse wijken Bloemhof en de Afrikaanderwijk die niet kunnen stemmen vanwege ontbrekende stempassen

MP Kuzu asked the Interior Minister about hundreds of residents in Rotterdam's Bloemhof and Afrikaanderwijk who could not vote because their polling cards were not delivered, and whether the municipality acted adequately. The minister answered that a PostNL courier withheld 195 polling cards, that 68 voters requested replacements and the remaining 127 cards were delivered, that the prosecutor dropped the case, and that the municipality has ordered an external investigation.

Following signals from politicians, residents and the Bloemhof neighbourhood council, the Rotterdam mayor instructed that people in the area where polling cards were reportedly not delivered be actively informed of the option to request a replacement polling card.

Naar aanleiding van signalen vanuit de politiek, bewoners en de wijkraad Bloemhof heeft de burgemeester van Rotterdam opdracht gegeven om in de wijk waar volgens genoemde signalen geen stempassen zijn bezorgd, mensen actief te wijzen op de mogelijkheid om een vervangende stempas aan te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de IHRA-definitie van antisemitisme

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the non-binding IHRA definition of antisemitism plays a role in prosecution and whether it is used by the Public Prosecution Service, and how the government monitors its use. The Minister answered that the definition is not legally binding, that the OM uses it only as a signalling aid within the existing legal framework, and that he shares ECRI's concern about misuse to stigmatise criticism of Israel.
The Public Prosecution Service takes the view that the definition and its indicators can be helpful in staying alert to facts and circumstances that may indicate discriminatory expressions.

Het OM stelt zich op het standpunt dat de definitie zelf en de indicatoren behorende bij de IHRA-definitie behulpzaam kunnen zijn om alert te zijn op feiten en omstandigheden die een indicatie zouden kunnen vormen van discriminerende uitingen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Van Kooten-Arissen over het beleid rondom maskergebruik ter preventie van SARS-CoV-2 infecties in de ziekenhuiszorg

Two MPs asked the Minister of Health whether the RIVM guidance on masks for healthcare staff treating COVID-19 patients is adequate, given aerosol transmission concerns and calls for FFP2 masks. The minister replied that the expert advice (OMT and RIVM) still considers type IIR surgical masks sufficient outside aerosol-generating procedures, while employers may deviate on risk assessment and must support staff requests, and that the guidance is for professional bodies rather than politicians to set.
It is not for me to determine when which type of PPE/face mask must be prescribed for use by healthcare workers.
Het is niet aan mij om te bepalen wanneer welke type PBM/mondneusmasker voorgeschreven dient te worden voor gebruik door zorgmedewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over schade die de Palestijnse NGO UAWC lijdt door opschorting van Nederlandse financiering

An MP asked the ministers about harm suffered by the Palestinian NGO UAWC after Dutch funding was suspended pending an investigation into alleged PFLP links. The government confirmed about USD 1.08 million in payments were withheld, said it will take no steps to ensure UAWC's continuity until the external investigation concludes, and answered the remaining questions largely by restating policy on Area C and Israeli settlement activity.
Pending the external investigation into UAWC, the cabinet will not take any steps to guarantee UAWC's continuity.
Het kabinet zal hangende het externe onderzoek naar UAWC geen stappen zetten om de continuïteit van UAWC te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over een veroordeelde terrorist die werkzaam is bij de Israëlische organisatie Shurat Hadin

An MP asked the ministers whether the government was concerned about a convicted terrorist working at Shurat Hadin, a conference appearance by its director, and whether NGO Monitor's conference framing was acceptable. The minister said the government had noted the reports, that freedom of expression applies to organisations like NGO Monitor within legal limits, and that the questions would be answered separately.
Freedom of expression applies in full, to everyone and without regard to persons, within the limits of the law.
De vrijheid van meningsuiting geldt onverkort, voor iedereen en zonder aanzien des persoons binnen de grenzen van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht 'Eerst Assads strijder, nu asiel in Nederland'

MP Kuzu asked the Foreign and Justice ministers whether they knew of Assad-regime sympathisers and alleged war criminals in the Netherlands who received asylum, and what would be done about it, including the disappearance of a Syrian whistleblower. The State Secretary replied that 1F exclusion is applied through individual assessment, that criminal investigations depend on concrete suspicion and realistic prospects, that Syrian refugees are protected like any other resident, and declined to discuss individual cases.
I cannot go into these individual cases or persons.
Ik kan niet ingaan op deze individuele zaken of personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht ‘Brandbom bij Syrisch gezin in Heerlen: burenruzie of racisme’

The MP Kuzu asks the ministers about a Syrian family in Heerlen subjected to months of threats, intimidation and violence, including a reported firebomb, and about the roles of the municipality, police, housing corporation Vincio Wonen and its past discrimination record. The minister answers that investigations are ongoing and declines to discuss the specific incidents, states that local authorities are primarily responsible for safety and housing, and says the corporation's discrimination matter was previously prosecuted and dismissed while a new review of social media is underway.
While this investigation is ongoing, I do not wish to go into the substance of this specific case and the possible incidents.
Lopende dit onderzoek wil ik niet inhoudelijk ingaan op deze specifieke casus en de eventuele incidenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de groei van illegale Israëlische nederzettingen op Palestijns gebied

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the government condemns Israeli settlement expansion in occupied Palestinian territory, whether it will pursue sanctions, and whether it will recognise Palestine. The minister confirmed the approval of 5,000 new settlement homes, called settlements contrary to international law, said the Netherlands joined a demarche urging Israel to halt construction, rejected sanctions, and said recognition depends on a peace agreement.

On 13 October 2020, the Netherlands, together with France, Germany, the United Kingdom, Spain, Italy, Sweden, Ireland, Finland and Belgium, urged Israel during a demarche to refrain from building new homes in the occupied territories.

Nederland heeft samen met Frankrijk, Duitsland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, Spanje, Italië, Zweden, Ierland, Finland en België op 13 oktober 2020 tijdens een demarche bij Israël aangedrongen op afzien van de bouw van nieuwe woningen in de bezette gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat er vreselijke dingen zijn gebeurd met het testen van vaccins in Afrika

MP Kuzu asked the ministers whether clinical vaccine trials in developing countries, including Africa, are supervised to protect participants' rights, whether abuses are known, and whether pharmaceutical firms exploit weaker rules there. Minister De Jonge answered that all trials supporting EU registration must meet EU Good Clinical Practice standards wherever they are conducted, that EMA verifies compliance through inspections, that no current abuses are known, and that compensation rules and capacity-building efforts exist.
Clinical studies supporting EU drug registration, wherever in the world they are conducted, must comply with all Good Clinical Practice (GCP) regulations.
Klinische onderzoeken ten behoeve van de registratie van geneesmiddelen in de EU, waar ook ter wereld uitgevoerd, moeten voldoen aan alle regelgeving op het gebied van Good Clinical Practice (GCP)
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de status en rol van de IHRA-definitie bij de strafrechtelijke beoordeling of uitlatingen discriminatoir zijn

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Interior about the legal status of the IHRA antisemitism working definition in criminal assessment of discriminatory speech, and whether it is used by prosecutors and judges. The Minister answered that the definition is non-binding, that the government does not treat its illustrative examples as part of the definition, that it only helps police and prosecutors be alert to indicators, and that criminal assessment remains governed by the Criminal Code and case law.
Agreement with the list of expressions and conduct will never automatically lead to the conclusion that a punishable discriminatory/antisemitic expression or conduct exists.
Overeenkomst met de lijst met uitingen en gedragingen zal nimmer automatisch leiden tot de conclusie dat sprake is van een strafbare discriminatoire/antisemitische uiting of gedraging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat minister Kaag op 9 juli jl. heeft besloten om verdere betalingen aan UAWC aan te houden

An MP from DENK asked the minister why the government suspended payments to UAWC, whether UAWC is linked to a terrorist group, and whether NGO Monitor and UK Lawyers for Israel are undermining civil society. The minister replied that an external investigation into UAWC will be commissioned, that UAWC is not listed as a terrorist organisation, and that the government is concerned about shrinking civil space but will not comment on the pending Israeli case.
The cabinet does not wish to speculate on this and cannot anticipate the Israeli ruling in this case, which is not expected before next year.
Het kabinet wil hierover niet speculeren en kan niet vooruitlopen op de Israelische uitspraak in deze zaak, die niet voor volgend jaar wordt verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht 'Afghaanse migranten op de Iraanse grens gemarteld en in rivier gegooid'

Kuzu (DENK) asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Iranian border guards tortured and drowned Afghan migrants, and whether the government would raise this with Iran in the EU and the UN Human Rights Council. Minister Blok said the government awaits the outcome of a joint Iran-Afghanistan investigation, offered Dutch-funded IOM return and reintegration support and COVID care access for migrants, and said Iran's human rights abuses will remain on the agenda in multilateral fora.
The cabinet is awaiting the outcome of this investigation.
Het kabinet wacht het resultaat van dit onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht ‘Suriname vraagt Nederland om coronahulp’

An MP from DENK asked the Foreign Minister about Suriname's request for Dutch COVID-19 aid, including ICU capacity, ventilators, and support for a Surinamese foundation. The minister answered that Dutch medical supplies had arrived, further deliveries and ten ventilators were planned, and aid is coordinated with the health ministry, though many answers refer back to a single general reply.
Currently the possibilities are being examined to temporarily deploy Dutch medical personnel to assist in Suriname.
Momenteel worden de mogelijkheden onderzocht om tijdelijk Nederlands medisch personeel in Suriname assistentie te laten verlenen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, De Roon, Van Ojik, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Raan, Krol, Van der Staaij, Kuzu, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de repatriëring van Nederlander

MPs asked how many Dutch nationals remain stranded abroad, why repatriation costs are charged, and whether a 300-euro rate should extend to more countries and hardship cases. The minister replied that about 8,000 registered Dutch nationals still wished assistance, that the registration closed on 8 April, that costs are charged after the fact, that Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories will be considered favourably, and that a coulance regime is not appropriate given personal responsibility and budget impact.
I am willing to look favourably at the request to add Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories to the list for which the 300-euro rate applies.
Ik ben bereid welwillend te kijken naar het verzoek om Jordanië, Israël, Libanon en de Palestijnse Gebieden toe te voegen aan de lijst waarvoor het tarief van 300 euro geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de situatie dat Oeigoeren in China het slachtoffer zijn geworden van dwangarbeid en andere mensenrechtenschendingen

MP Kuzu asked the foreign minister about reports that around 80,000 Uyghurs were forced to work in factories supplying well-known brands, asking which brands, whether products reached the Dutch market, what sanctions were possible, and what action was planned. The government said it cannot confirm the ASPI report's findings independently, that no EU sanctions basis exists, that it will raise the issue in EU and UN fora, and that it will hold a business information session on human rights and supply-chain risks once the coronavirus situation allows.
The cabinet cannot confirm the conclusions of the ASPI report on the basis of independent information but sees sufficient reason to raise this in EU and UN contexts.
Het kabinet kan de conclusies van het ASPI-rapport niet op basis van eigenstandige informatie bevestigen maar ziet voldoende aanleiding om dit in EU- en VN-verband aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Azarkan over schooladviezen die jongeren kansen ontnemen

MPs Kuzu and Azarkan asked about reports that school recommendations underestimate children from low-educated families, and about measures against under-advising. Minister Slob acknowledges the concern, cites monitoring and a second opinion via the final test, and says a guidance handbook will be piloted and distributed, but denies being able to rule out under-advising.
I find it worrying that for some pupils there is under-advising.
Ik vind het zorgelijk dat er bij een deel van de leerlingen sprake is van onderadvisering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over een VN-database met bedrijven actief in Israëlische nederzettingen

An MP asks the Dutch government about the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights' database of companies active in Israeli settlements, including whether the government supports its publication and related criticism. The government answers that it opposed creating the database but must implement the Human Rights Council's mandate, that companies themselves decide their activities under IMVO/OECD standards, and that it declines to comment on the statements of Israeli ministers and the AJC.
The cabinet sees no reason to assume that the High Commissioner did not act carefully.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om aan te nemen dat de Hoge Commissaris niet zorgvuldig te werk is gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over achterstandsscholen die zich bevinden in fijnstofgebieden

An MP asks whether schools in air-pollution zones, many of them disadvantaged schools in Amsterdam, were left unprotected and whether parents and school boards are informed, and asks for national funding of filters and green playgrounds. The minister replies that air quality is a shared responsibility of municipalities and schools, that the GGD advises on health effects, that the Schone Lucht Akkoord sets targets, and that national funding for filters and playgrounds does not fit the current system.
It is up to municipalities to inform school boards about air quality and health effects, and to take measures to reduce exposure to local sources.
Het is aan gemeenten om schoolbesturen te informeren over de luchtkwaliteit en gezondheidseffecten, en maatregelen te treffen om blootstelling aan lokale bronnen te verminderen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van Dam, Bosman, Diertens, Van der Graaf, Van Raak, Kuiken, Krol, Kuzu en Bisschop over de aanleg van wegen op Sint Eustatius

MPs asked why road works on Sint Eustatius (Cherry Tree Road) have barely progressed since 2018, whether tendering rules and European-style technical requirements excluded local contractors, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledges the delay, explains the tender chose a simplified international approach open to local bidders, and says the island's public works department will finish Cherry Tree itself, backed by about 9.5 million euro in funding.
For the Cherry Tree project, after the contract with the contractor was terminated, the public body chose to complete it itself.
In het geval van het project Cherry Tree heeft het openbaar lichaam er na beëindiging van het contract met de aannemer voor gekozen dit nu in eigen beheer af te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over een gepland optreden van de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Israël op een conferentie van NGO Monitor

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the planned participation of the Dutch ambassador to Israel in an NGO Monitor conference, and about the government's stance on NGO Monitor, the Israeli Ministry of Strategic Affairs, BDS and the IHRA antisemitism definition. The minister confirmed the participation, said the government monitors but does not track contacts between the Israeli ministry and Dutch actors, and defended the decision as a way to present Dutch policy to Israeli audiences while distinguishing criticism of Israeli policy from antisemitism.
The cabinet does not monitor possible contacts between the Israeli Ministry of Strategic Affairs and persons or organisations in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet monitort niet eventuele contacten tussen het Israëlische Ministerie van Strategische Zaken en personen of organisaties in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat de Indiase regering de speciale status van het gebied Kashmir schrapt

MP Kuzu asks the Foreign Minister about India's revocation of Kashmir's special status, including repression, detentions, communications blockades, Hindu settlement rights, human rights and Muharram processions, and whether the Netherlands will act at the UN. The minister answers that the government follows the situation closely, has raised concerns bilaterally and within the EU, sees no evidence of ethnic cleansing, considers itself insufficiently informed to judge legality under international law, and says the questions were answered as well as possible.
The cabinet has insufficient insight into this complex situation to judge whether the Indian government's decision violates international law.
Het kabinet heeft onvoldoende inzicht in deze complexe situatie om een oordeel te kunnen vellen over de vraag of het besluit van de Indiase regering in strijd met het internationaal recht is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de 500 banen die verloren raken bij drie ziekenhuizen

An MP asked the health minister about the loss of roughly 500 jobs at three Treant hospitals in Drenthe and Groningen, including whether forced dismissals are excluded and whether the sector's finances are to blame. The minister said forced dismissals are off the table, pointed to workforce and demand challenges beyond finance, declined state financial support for now, and described transition pools and voluntary departure schemes.
Treant has since spoken with the trade unions and forced dismissals are off the table.
Inmiddels heeft Treant met de vakbonden gesproken en zijn de gedwongen ontslagen van tafel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de situatie dat Oeigoeren in Chinese concentratiekampen worden vermoord en hun organen worden verkocht

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Uyghurs in Chinese camps are killed for their organs and whether this amounts to concentration camps and genocide, and what the government is doing. The minister said the government cannot verify the organ-harvesting allegations, does not consider genocide criteria met, and listed diplomatic efforts such as joint statements at the UN and EU, while withholding some embassy details for confidentiality.
The cabinet is not able to verify these allegations on the basis of its own information nor to refute them.
Het kabinet is niet in staat om deze aanklachten op basis van eigen informatie te verifiëren noch te ontkrachten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over de kilometerslange files bij de grensovergangen van Turkije, Bulgarije, Servië, Hongarije, Griekenland en Kroatië, en de intimidatie die reizigers ervaren

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked about long queues at EU external border crossings, systematic checks of EU citizens, mandatory paid vehicle disinfection in Bulgaria and intimidation of travellers. The minister said the government has no indications that countries withhold capacity, explained the EU framework for checks and disinfection, and noted the embassy raised complaints with Bulgarian authorities.
The Cabinet has no indications that the countries concerned do not deploy the available capacity.
Het Kabinet heeft geen aanwijzingen dat betrokken landen de beschikbare capaciteit niet inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht ‘VN wil sancties tegen bedrijven uit Myanmar, ook Shell betrokken’

MP Kuzu (DENK) asks the Foreign Minister whether the government will back targeted financial sanctions against Myanmar military-linked conglomerates (MEHL, MEC) and their business partners, including Shell, following a UN fact-finding report, and what Dutch businesses and the government are doing about indirect ties. The ministers answer that the Netherlands supports targeted measures and EU-level review of listings and an arms embargo, but declines broad sanctions, has no overview of Dutch companies' dealings, and only engages Shell in contact.
The cabinet does not keep an overview of the activities or forms of cooperation of Dutch companies with enterprises established in Myanmar.
Het kabinet houdt geen overzicht bij van activiteiten of samenwerkingsvormen van Nederlandse bedrijven met in Myanmar gevestigde ondernemingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht ‘Justitie blundert met persoonlijke brief aan vermoorde Hümeyra’

MP Kuzu asked the Minister of Justice about the OM sending a personal victim letter to the murdered Hümeyra, and about protection and handling of stalking reports. The Minister acknowledged a serious error, apologised via letter and a conversation with the family, and said the Inspectorate's investigation is ongoing with results to follow.
The Minister for Legal Protection and I will inform your House as soon as possible after delivery about the outcomes of this Inspectorate investigation.
De Minister voor Rechtsbescherming en ik zullen uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk na oplevering berichten over de uitkomsten van dit Inspectieonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de bestorming van de al-Aqsa compound door honderden kolonisten gesteund door Israëlische militairen

Dutch MP Kuzu (DENK) asked the ministers about the storming of the al-Aqsa compound by settlers escorted by Israeli forces, and whether the government condemns it, will act, and supports a UN mission. Minister Blok answered that the Temple Mount status quo is important, that the Netherlands and the EU have repeatedly urged its preservation, but that the Netherlands plays no mediating role and does not support an independent UN monitoring mission.

No. In recent years Israel, the Palestinian Authority and Jordan have shown they are able, sometimes with difficulty and sometimes with external help, to make arrangements about the holy sites in Jerusalem.

Nee. De afgelopen jaren hebben Israël, de Palestijnse Autoriteit en Jordanië aangetoond dat zij in staat zijn, soms met moeite en soms met externe hulp, om afspraken te maken over de heilige plaatsen in Jeruzalem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de eenzijdige beëindiging van Temporary International Presence in Hebron (TIPH) door de Israëlische overheid

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Israel's decision not to renew the TIPH observer mission in Hebron, including its impact on Palestinians, whether the government condemns it, and the prospects for resumption. The minister said the government regrets the decision, shares EU concern, calls for the mission's resumption, but notes it lacks the confidential TIPH reports and that resumption depends on Israel, the Palestinian Authority and contributing states.
The Netherlands was not one of the countries that supplied observers to TIPH, and therefore did not receive the confidential TIPH reports the media refer to.
Nederland was niet een van de landen die waarnemers leverden voor TIPH, en kreeg daarom ook niet de vertrouwelijke rapporten van TIPH, waarnaar de media verwijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Ploumen over het bericht dat er nieuw bewijs is van China's missie om de moskeeën in Xinjiang te verwoesten

MPs Kuzu and Ploumen asked the government about reports that China is demolishing mosques and shrines in Xinjiang, whether this violates universal human rights, and what the Netherlands and the EU have done to press China. The ministers answer that the demolitions fit a broader pattern of restricted freedoms in Xinjiang that they consider contrary to international human rights norms, list bilateral, EU and UN initiatives, and say they will keep pressing for meaningful access for UN experts to Xinjiang.
The cabinet continues to call for meaningful access to Xinjiang for UN (human rights) experts, including the High Commissioner for Human Rights.
Het kabinet blijft pleiten voor betekenisvolle toegang tot Xinjiang voor (mensenrechten)experts van de VN, waaronder de Hoge Commissaris voor de Mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat het leger van Myanmar opnieuw mensenrechten schendt

An MP asked the Foreign and Development Ministers about Amnesty International's report on new Myanmar army abuses in Rakhine State, including demands for sanctions, an ICC referral and a arms embargo. The ministers condemned the violence, said Netherlands keeps pressing for ICC referral, sanctions and an investigation mechanism, but noted UN Security Council deadlock blocks action.
On 17 June, Minister Blok again called in the Foreign Affairs Council for additional sanctions against those responsible for the human rights violations.
Minister Blok heeft op 17 juni in de RBZ nogmaals opgeroepen tot aanvullende sancties tegen de verantwoordelijken voor de mensenrechtenschendingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het beschikbare lesmateriaal over het conflict tussen Israël en de Palestijnen

An MP asks whether CIDI's Israel-Palestine teaching materials and university course are biased and whether the government should stop their influence in education. The minister answers that education freedom is constitutionally protected, the ministry does not judge the content, schools and parents can raise concerns via participation councils, and CIDI and other organisations may freely offer materials.
Education freedom is enshrined in the Constitution, so it is not the ministry's task to judge the content of the available teaching materials.
In de Grondwet is de vrijheid van onderwijs verankerd en het is dan ook niet de taak van het ministerie om een oordeel te vormen over de inhoud van het beschikbare lesmateriaal
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de situatie in Amsterdam na het faillissement van het MC Slotervaart

MP Kuzu (DENK) asked the Minister for Medical Care fifteen questions on the Amsterdam healthcare situation after the bankruptcy of MC Slotervaart, including why ministry signals on finances were not shared earlier, whether specialist care stays available, and whether laws must change for patient transfers. The minister answered that sufficient specialist capacity remains in the Amsterdam region, that an independent investigation into the bankruptcies will be launched, and that he will not anticipate its outcome on legislative changes.
For that reason I have promised your House that I will launch an external and independent investigation into the course of events leading up to the bankruptcies and afterwards.
Om die reden heb ik uw Kamer toegezegd dat ik een extern en onafhankelijk onderzoek zal starten naar de gang van zaken in aanloop naar de faillissementen en daarna.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over samenwerking van Israël met antisemitische regeringen en leiders

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he was concerned that Israel increasingly cooperates with governments and leaders who have made antisemitic statements or tolerate antisemitism, and why pro-Israel organisations like CIDI do not object. The minister denies that Netanyahu enthusiastically supports antisemitic leaders, says the Dutch government distinguishes criticism of Israeli policy from antisemitism, and restates that the IHRA definition does not change the legal assessment of statements about Israeli government policy.
The cabinet does not keep an overview of the number of occasions on which this has been raised.
Het kabinet houdt geen overzicht bij van het aantal gelegenheden waarbij dit ter sprake is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Van Helvert, Koopmans, Voordewind en Kuzu over kerksluitingen in China

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the closure of the Sion church in Beijing, China's repression of religious minorities, and the legal basis of new restrictions on religious groups. The minister confirmed the closure as part of a broader pattern of restrictions, described the legal measures and Article 36 of the Chinese constitution, said past Dutch interventions cannot be shown to have had direct effect, and committed to keep raising the issue within the EU and at the UN General Assembly.
Raising human rights violations remains necessary according to this cabinet, if only to discourage China from continuing those violations.
Het aan de orde stellen van mensenrechtenschendingen blijft volgens dit kabinet noodzakelijk, al is het enkel om China te ontmoedigen met die schendingen door te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de aanval van het Israëlische leger op Palestijnse betogers langs de grens tussen Gaza en Israël

MP Kuzu asked the Foreign Minister about the Israeli military's killing of seven Palestinian protesters at the Gaza-Israel border, including two children, and whether the Netherlands would condemn it, revisit arms exports, and raise it at the UN Human Rights Council. The minister answered that the Netherlands is concerned, urges Israel to respect proportionality and necessity, notes that investigations are not finished, states that export licences are assessed case-by-case against EU criteria, and says concerns are raised in regular talks with Israeli and Palestinian representatives.
The Israeli investigation into the events has not yet been completed.
Het Israëlisch onderzoek naar de gebeurtenissen is nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat het strafhof in Caïro doodstraffen en zware gevangenisstraffen aan demonstranten heeft opgelegd

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a Cairo court's death sentences and heavy prison terms for protesters, including doubts about the fairness of the trial and whether the Netherlands would press for reversal. The minister answered that the Netherlands opposes the death penalty, monitored the trial with partners, raised concerns bilaterally and via the EU, and supported an EU statement, while declining to judge the legal process before appeals are exhausted.
As long as appeal options remain, I do not consider it appropriate to make definitive statements about the legal process.
Zolang er nog beroepsmogelijkheden zijn, acht ik het niet opportuun om definitieve uitspraken te doen over de rechtsgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat een Nederlandse docente “door Israël is gearresteerd en gedeporteerd”

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether a Dutch lecturer was arrested and deported by Israel, whether she was denied consular help, and whether the government would act, plus whether this links to Israel's BDS entry-ban law. The minister said the government knows of the case only from the person's blog, does not recognise the term deportation, and that the woman never requested consular assistance; the government raised concerns about the earlier entry denials with Israel but said entry policy is Israel's prerogative.
The cabinet knows of this matter only through the blog of the person concerned.
Het kabinet is uitsluitend via het blog van betrokkene bekend met deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van Rooijen, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Kuzu over de uitvoering van de motie inzake Magnitsky-sancties

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he had formally proposed an EU human rights sanctions regime, how other member states reacted, and why he doubts a national Magnitsky-style regime would be effective, as well as whether he will implement the Omtzigt motion. The minister answered that he proposed an EU global human rights sanctions regime at the Gymnich meeting, that some states were positive and none openly negative, that a formal proposal is deferred until support exists, that a national regime would be ineffective given Schengen, and that he will pursue the EU route and report after a November meeting.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is organising a senior-official meeting in November for EU member states and like-minded countries to further develop the concept of a human rights sanctions regime.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken organiseert in november een hoogambtelijke bijeenkomst voor EU-lidstaten en enkele gelijkgezinde landen om het concept van een mensenrechtensanctieregime verder te ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over een lasterlijk rapport van het Israëlische Ministerie van Strategische Zaken

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about an Israeli ministry report accusing EU-funded NGOs of ties to terrorism, and about related Israeli activities against BDS campaigners and activists. The government answered that the EU does not fund terrorism, that the Netherlands opposes BDS but protects its expression, and that it has no independent information on the alleged surveillance or intelligence activities.
The cabinet has no independent information indicating that such activities are being carried out against Dutch citizens and therefore sees no reason to inquire with the Israeli authorities.

Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie die er op wijst dat er dergelijke activiteiten tegen Nederlandse burgers worden ontplooid en ziet daarom geen aanleiding hier bij de Israëlische autoriteiten over te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat de Chinese overheid ambtenaren inzet om de Oeigoeren in Xinjiang te controleren en te indoctrineren

Dutch MP Kuzu asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade about reports that Chinese officials are staying with Uyghur families in Xinjiang to monitor and indoctrinate them, and about detention of a footballer and re-education camps, asking what the government will do and whether it will support an independent international inquiry. The government says it is seriously concerned about restrictions on religious and cultural freedoms, has raised the issue in the human rights dialogue, EU and UN channels, but declines to pursue an international investigation.
The cabinet does not consider it opportune to push for an international investigation and believes the current course is most appropriate.
Het kabinet acht het niet opportuun om op een internationaal onderzoek aan te sturen en is van mening dat de huidige koers
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over een vorm van slavernij bij PostNL

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked whether working conditions for agency sorters at PostNL amount to a form of slavery, including pace of work, heavy lifting, breaks, standby pay, underpayment and bypassing the collective agreement. The ministers answered that employers bear primary responsibility under the Working Conditions Act and that the Labour Inspectorate enforces the rules, that the underpayment matter is before the civil court, and that they saw no reason to meet PostNL's management.
Following the findings of the investigation, the FNV summoned PostNL and agency InPerson before the civil court on 22 February 2018.
Naar aanleiding van de uitkomsten uit het onderzoek heeft de FNV op 22 februari 2018 PostNL en uitzendbureau InPerson voor de civiele rechter gedaagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de handelsmissie naar China

The MP Kuzu asks why the government organised a trade mission to China, how it squares with criticism of human rights and religious freedom, and what is being done on Uyghurs and Tibetans. The Minister answers that the mission aims to strengthen economic ties and that human rights concerns, including Xinjiang and Tibet, were raised bilaterally and will be discussed in a human rights dialogue, but gives little operational detail on the Mensenrechtenfonds projects.
For the safety of project partners, further details cannot be provided.
Omwille van de veiligheid van projectpartners kan niet op nadere details worden ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Azarkan over de situatie van Nederlandse kinderen in Syrië en Irak

MPs Kuzu and Azarkan asked the government about the situation of Dutch children in Syria and Iraq, whether it will actively help them return, and whether consular assistance and child protection cooperation are possible. The minister answered that at least 175 minors with a Dutch link are there, that consular help is only given when families present themselves in person at a Dutch post, that Syria and crisis areas are largely beyond reach, and that the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming is ready to support returnees.
The Dutch government does not provide consular assistance to Dutch travellers and families who are in unsafe areas in Syria and Iraq and wish to leave.
De Nederlandse regering verleent geen consulaire bijstand aan Nederlandse uitreizigers en families die zich in onveilige gebieden in Syrië en Irak bevinden en deze willen verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie door uitzendbureaus

An MP from DENK asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about discrimination by temp agencies, how it persists, whether the Labour Inspectorate can investigate more intensively and use unconventional methods such as test calls, and when an action plan will be sent. The government answers by referring to a letter sent in response to a motion from another MP, so the substantive questions are not answered in this document.

The written questions from MP Kuzu (DENK), question number 2018Z01649, have been answered by means of the letter 'Response to the request from MP Özütok, made during the Regeling van werkzaamheden of 30 January 2018, on discrimination at temp agencies'.

Mededeling De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Kuzu (DENK), vraagnummer 2018Z01649 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op het verzoek van het lid Özütok, gedaan tijdens de Regeling van werkzaamheden van 30 januari 2018, over discriminatie bij uitzendbureaus» (Kamerstuk 29 544, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over demonstrerende Palestijnen die zijn doodgeschoten door het Israëlische leger in Gaza

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about Israeli security forces killing Palestinian protesters in Gaza, including whether the government will call for an independent investigation, condemn Israel's refusal to cooperate, and press Israel on its treatment of Palestinians and recognition of a Palestinian state. The minister says the government is concerned about the deaths, supports a transparent independent investigation and urges restraint from all parties, but does not condemn Israel and rejects recognising a Palestinian state now, pointing to a negotiated two-state solution first.
The cabinet endorses the EU statement that this raises questions about the proportionality of the use of force.
Het kabinet onderschrijft de verklaring van de EU, dat dit vragen oproept over de proportionaliteit van het gebruik van geweld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu, Azarkan en Öztürk over het bericht dat een Turks-Nederlandse vereniging in Rotterdam is besmeurd met PKK-leuzen door sympathisanten van de terroristische beweging PKK

MPs Kuzu, Azarkan and Öztürk asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of the Interior about the graffiti of PKK slogans on a Turkish-Dutch association building in Rotterdam, measures to protect members, and PKK demonstrations with flags. Minister Grapperhaus replied that local authorities and police are handling protection, a criminal investigation has no suspects yet, the PKK is monitored and on the terrorism sanctions list, and flag displays are regulated under the right to demonstrate.
I have viewed the defacement with abhorrence.
Ik heb met afkeer kennisgenomen van de bekladding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azarkan en Kuzu over het bericht dat vier Marokkaanse Nederlanders onderwerp van een arrestatiebevel zijn van het Marokkaanse openbaar ministerie

DENK MPs asked whether four Dutch-Moroccans are subject to arrest warrants from Morocco's prosecutor over Rif protests, what contact the Netherlands had with Moroccan authorities, and how the Netherlands would refuse unjustified extradition or legal-assistance requests. The government replied that Morocco said these were witness summonses rather than arrest warrants, that it cannot say more than it knows, that each request is assessed case by case under Dutch law and the ECHR including free expression, and that it raised the treatment of detained demonstrators with Moroccan ministers.
Legal assistance and extradition requests are always assessed case by case and in compliance with Dutch law and international treaties.
Rechtshulp- en uitleveringsverzoeken worden altijd per geval en met inachtneming van de Nederlandse wet en internationale verdragen beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat er een einde dreigt te komen aan döner kebab

An MP asked whether EU phosphate rules could effectively ban döner kebab in the Netherlands, and whether the government would lobby for an exemption and assess job and revenue losses. The minister replied that the EU parliament had approved phosphate use in döner kebab, that no ban is at issue, that additives are EU-regulated and no exemption or loss study is needed, and that the government will communicate with the sector.
Yes, I can understand that. Meanwhile it has become clear that phosphates in döner kebab will not be banned.
Ja, dat kan ik begrijpen. Intussen is duidelijk geworden dat fosfaten in döner kebab niet worden verboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het bericht dat de gemeenten Turkse Nederlanders discrimineren bij controles op uitkeringen

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the minister whether municipalities discriminate against Turkish Dutch people in benefit checks, whether outsourcing foreign asset investigations to private firms is lawful, and whether rules should be tightened. The state secretary acknowledged the Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling that Almelo and Eindhoven's practices breached the non-discrimination ban, said outsourcing to private parties is permissible within legal limits, and promised to bring the ruling to municipalities' attention via a circular letter while declining to draft a ban on outsourcing.

I will bring the ruling of the Centrale Raad van Beroep and its consequences, as well as the options offered by the IBF for cross-border fraud, to the attention of municipalities via the circular letter.

Ik zal de uitspraak van de Centrale Raad van Beroep (CRvB) en de gevolgen hiervan alsmede de mogelijkheden die het IBF biedt bij grensoverschrijdende fraude, onder de aandacht brengen bij gemeenten via de verzamelbrief

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Thieme, Baudet, Kuzu, Van de Hul en Knops over het bericht dat de Nederlandse overheid grote steken heeft laten vallen in het verle

MPs from many parties asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the Dutch government failed to assist Mr Singh, a Dutch national imprisoned in the US for 33 years, including over consular visits, a transfer request and the handling of his case. The government rejects the picture of failure, says it cannot intervene in foreign justice, explains that transfer was refused on legal grounds and pledges continued support for parole and review requests.
The ministries of Foreign Affairs and Justice and Security do not recognise that picture.
De ministeries van Buitenlandse Zaken en Justitie en Veiligheid herkennen zich niet in dat beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over een lastercampagne van pro-Israël activisten tegen de Minister voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking

Member Kuzu asked the government about a smear campaign by pro-Israel groups against Minister Kaag, including attacks on her family, a misquoted article, and reported Israeli surveillance of pro-Palestinian activists in Europe. The government condemned personal attacks, said the quoted remark was incorrect and regretted the resulting confusion, and declined to say anything publicly about foreign intelligence activity while noting the Dutch services operate under the Wiv 2002 and ECHR standards.
No public statements can be made about knowledge of or investigations into the activities of foreign intelligence services.
Over kennis van en onderzoek naar activiteiten van buitenlandse inlichtingendiensten kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Azarkan over het bericht dat PSV-spelers racistisch zijn bejegend in Venlo

MPs Kuzu and Azarkan asked the government about racist chanting directed at PSV players in Venlo, including what clubs, referees and the KNVB did, whether criminal prosecution is underway, and whether penalties for discriminatory football-related offences should be raised. The Minister said the KNVB disciplinary process is pending, a criminal investigation by the Public Prosecution Service is ongoing and he will not comment on it, and that prosecutors may raise sentence demands by 50% for football-related discrimination offences.
As is customary, while the criminal investigation is ongoing, I make no statements on the progress of this criminal investigation and the prosecution.
Zoals te doen gebruikelijk doe ik, gaande het strafrechtelijk onderzoek, geen uitspraken over het verloop van dit strafrechtelijk onderzoek en de vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over Chinese moslims die hun korans moeten inleveren

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about Chinese measures restricting Muslims in Xinjiang, including confiscating Qurans, banning beards and Islamic names, and mandatory spy apps, and asks what the government will do. The minister says the government shares concerns and has raised them bilaterally, in the EU and at the UN, but declines to seek an international fact-finding mission and gives no new concrete action.

The cabinet does not consider it opportune to push for an international investigation and believes the current course, raising China's own international and constitutional human rights obligations bilaterally and in EU and UN fora, is the most appropriate.

Het kabinet acht het niet opportuun om op een internationaal onderzoek aan te sturen en is van mening dat de huidige koers, om zowel bilateraal als in EU- en VN-verband China aan te spreken op de eigen internationale en constitutionele mensenrechtenverplichtingen, de meest gepaste is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat er kilometerslange files hebben gestaan bij de grensovergangen tussen Turkije - Bulgarije, Bulgarije - Servië, Servië - Hongarije en Servië – Kroatië, en het beric

Kuzu (DENK) asked about long border queues at Turkey-Bulgaria and other Balkan crossings, reports of intimidation and disinfection fees imposed on Turkish-Dutch travellers in Bulgaria, and Bulgarian corruption. The minister attributed queues to systematic EU border checks and to Bulgaria's general rules, offered complaint channels, and said the government supports keeping the CVM in place while noting EU funds are used for border management.
