Following these parliamentary questions, the Dutch embassy in Sofia added to its website contact details of the Bulgarian Ministry of Interior where travellers can lodge complaints.
Naar aanleiding van deze Kamervragen heeft de Nederlandse ambassade in Sofia haar website aangevuld met contactgegevens van het Bulgaarse Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over ernstige bedreigingen en onrechtmatig geweld door het Israëlische leger tegen Palestijnse burgers

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about threats and lethal force by the Israeli army against Palestinian civilians, including a reported commander known as 'Captain Nidal', and whether the government would seek an official response and take firmer action. The minister said the government lacks information to verify the commander's existence or the allegations, will press Israel on international law and proportionality through bilateral and EU channels, but declined to change Israel's friendly-nation status.
The cabinet has insufficient information to verify the existence of 'Captain Nidal' or to judge the allegations.
Het kabinet beschikt over onvoldoende informatie om het bestaan van «Captain Nidal» te kunnen verifiëren of om een oordeel te kunnen geven over de beschuldigingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de situatie van de Rohingya in Myanmar

An MP from DENK asked the Dutch foreign minister, in 18 questions, about the Rohingya crisis in Myanmar, including the humanitarian toll, army conduct, blocked aid, possible genocide, refugee intake and trade with Myanmar. The minister condemned the violence, called on Myanmar's authorities to protect civilians and allow aid, pledged extra humanitarian funding and backed a UN Fact Finding Mission, but declined to halt trade or commit to large-scale resettlement.
The cabinet has, in recent weeks, taken note with horror of the reports of violence in Rakhine State.
Het kabinet heeft de afgelopen weken met afschuw kennisgenomen van de berichten over het geweld in Rakhine State

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Özturk over de uitspraak van de Reclame Code Commissie over de informatievoorziening van het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over orgaandonatie

Two MPs asked the health minister how the ministry responded to a Reclame Code Commissie ruling that its organ donation information failed to explain the legal meaning of brain death and death, and why similar shortcomings persisted after an earlier ruling and a parliamentary motion. The minister answered that website, brochure and letter texts were supplemented with explanations of brain and heart death, that information is continuously updated, and that all texts will be externally reviewed and the Chamber informed of the outcome.
I will inform the Chamber of the outcomes.
Ik zal de Kamer van de uitkomsten op de hoogte te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het bericht dat orkaan Irma de zwaarste orkaan is die de Bovenwindse Eilanden ooit heeft getroffen

DENK MPs asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about the damage from hurricane Irma on Sint Maarten, Saba and Sint Eustatius, Dutch support for reconstruction, and whether authorities were prepared. The minister answered that damage is still being assessed, reconstruction funding is not yet determined, and military assistance was prepositioned before the storm.
It is still too early to say how the Dutch government will support the reconstruction of buildings and infrastructure on the islands and how much funding the government will allocate.

Het is nu nog te vroeg om aan te geven op welke wijze de Nederlandse overheid de wederopbouw van de gebouwen en de infrastructuur op de eilanden gaat ondersteunen en hoeveel middelen de regering hiervoor vrijmaakt.
Vragen van de leden Kuzu en Azarkan (beiden DENK) aan de Ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de demonstraties in Marokko (ingezonden 1 juni 2017).

DENK MPs asked the foreign and social affairs ministers about protests in northern Morocco, the government's stance, the response of Moroccan authorities, arrests, tensions in the Netherlands, contact with Morocco, risks to Dutch nationals and possible de-escalation. The minister answered that peaceful protest is a right, that incidents should be investigated, that exact arrest numbers cannot be verified, that Dutch nationals face no generally increased danger, and that Dutch projects in the region contribute, while the resolution lies with Moroccan actors.
The exact number of arrests cannot currently be verified.
Het exacte aantal arrestaties is op dit moment niet te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de resolutie van het Europees parlement over de bestrijding van antisemitisme

The MP Kuzu asks the ministers about the European Parliament's resolution on combating antisemitism and the IHRA working definition, including whether the definition is legally unclear and risks restricting free speech on Israel. Minister Asscher answers that definitions work differently across legal systems, that Dutch criminal law is leading, that expressions about Israel remain protected by free speech, and that existing anti-discrimination instruments are effective.
Statements about Israel are protected by freedom of expression.
Uitlatingen over Israël worden beschermd door de vrijheid van meningsuiting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Öztürk, Azarkan en Kuzu over hoe de vrijheid van meningsuiting, de vrijheid van demonstratie en de vrijheid van vereniging zich verhouden tot de openbare orde

MPs Öztürk, Azarkan and Kuzu asked how freedom of expression, assembly and association relate to public order, including the bans on Eritrean and Turkish-minister-linked events, the Rotterdam police handling, and the expulsion of a Turkish minister. The government defended the mayors' powers under the Wet openbare manifestaties, declined to assess the mayors' conduct against human rights treaties (leaving that to courts), and said it could not judge mayoral decisions that fall to municipal councils.
It is for the court to form a judgement on that, if and insofar as such legal questions are submitted to a court in any procedure.
Het is aan de rechter om zich daarover een oordeel te vormen indien en voor zover aan de rechter in enigerlei procedure dergelijke rechtsvragen worden voorgelegd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu, Azarkan en Öztürk over het bericht dat er voor de zoveelste keer wordt gediscrimineerd tijdens de sollicitatieprocedure

MPs Kuzu, Azarkan and Öztürk asked ministers about reported job-application discrimination, the College voor de Rechten van de Mens's ruling against Yacht B.V., how such rulings relate to prosecution, whether the College and OM have enough capacity, and whether government contracts and staffing agency oversight should be tightened. The government calls discrimination unacceptable, says the College's equal-treatment track is separate from criminal law, rejects expanding OM capacity and a licensing system for agencies, and points to a study on procurement exclusion and an added Inspectie SZW budget.
On the question of a licensing system for the temporary staffing sector, I am focusing on improving public-private cooperation within the Stichting Normering Arbeid quality mark.
Ten aanzien van de vraag over een vergunningstelsel voor de uitzendbranche zet ik in op verbetering van de publiekprivate samenwerking in het kader van het keurmerk van de Stichting Normering Arbeid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het evenement 'VOC-Dag' van Bataviawerf

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the Bataviawerf 'VOC-Dag' event, whether colonial crimes such as slavery are sufficiently addressed by government-funded initiatives and school curricula, and whether the VOC period should be treated as a black chapter. The Minister answered that Bataviawerf is an independent foundation responsible for its own programme, that government-funded institutions cover the negative sides of the VOC, and that slavery is already part of the formal curriculum.
I intend to support a coordination point, to be housed at NiNsee, so that attention to the history of slavery and its effects can be better aligned, made accessible and made durably visible.

Ik ben voornemens een coördinatiepunt te ondersteunen, bij het NiNsee onder te brengen, waarmee de aandacht voor het slavernijverleden en de doorwerking ervan beter kunnen worden afgestemd, ontsloten, en duurzaam zichtbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Azarkan over de rellen in Rotterdam van 7 mei 2017

MPs Kuzu and Azarkan asked the Justice Minister about the 7 May 2017 Rotterdam riots after Feyenoord's loss, including prosecution, the mayor's enforcement choices compared with other demonstrations, and integration. The minister condemned the rioters, said prosecution is ongoing, and stated that public order enforcement is a matter for the local mayor and council.
Policy on this and its implementation is tailored and a matter for local authorities.
Het beleid ten aanzien hiervan en de uitvoering daarvan is maatwerk en aan het lokale gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het feit dat voor de zoveelste keer een zelfmoord wordt gepleegd ten gevolge van sexting

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the ministers about a suicide linked to sexting and bullying, asking about school responsibility, investigation, victim support, internet providers, the Dutch Data Protection Authority budget, the Kindertelefoon, and legal action. The state secretary answered that school anti-bullying duties and sexting education exist, that a police investigation is ongoing, and that IP-address identification is increasingly unreliable, while stating that bullying itself is not a crime.
The police are currently investigating this case both online and offline.
De politie is op dit moment zowel online als offline bezig met een onderzoek naar deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het bericht '15-jarige scholier pleegt zelfmoord na pesterijen'

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked ministers how the government will act on bullying after a 15-year-old pupil took her life, including whether an independent investigation will be launched and what is done to prevent bullying. The state secretary answers that school-safety law, inspection oversight and an ongoing joint inspectorate review are in place, that an independent review into the authorities' conduct is underway, and that specific national suicide-by-bullying figures are not available.
Under the banner of the Social Domain Supervision/Joint Youth Supervision (TSD/STJ), a preliminary investigation is currently taking place.
Onder de vlag van het Toezicht Sociaal Domein/Samenwerkend Toezicht Jeugd (TSD/STJ) vindt momenteel een vooronderzoek plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat er grote verontwaardiging heerst over de aanhouding van een 12-jarige jongen

Kuzu asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the arrest of a 12-year-old boy in Amsterdam Zuidoost, including racism, disproportionate force, identity-document requests, boa legal knowledge, aftercare, fine remission and apologies. The Minister answered that the matter is a local case for the municipality to respond to, referred to an earlier letter on ethnic profiling and violence, described the youth-suspect working procedure and police training, and said psychological help is assessed case by case.
This concerns an individual local matter on which council questions have also been asked. It is for the local competent authority to respond or act.
Het betreft hier een individuele lokale aangelegenheid waarover ook Raadsvragen zijn gesteld. Het is aan het lokale bevoegd gezag om hierop te reageren c.q. te acteren.

Vragen van het lid Kuzu (Groep Kuzu/Öztürk) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de berichten «Asielzoeker overlijdt na aanhouding in Maastricht» en «Getuigen fatale arrestatie Maastricht moesten beelden wisse

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a death after a police arrest in Maastricht, including whether officers forced witnesses to delete footage, whether a neck hold was proportionate, and whether officers should have been suspended and how many arrestees suffered lasting injury. The minister answered that a Rijksrecherche investigation is ongoing and declined to comment on findings, said disciplinary measures are the chief of police's responsibility, and said the police do not keep a record of arrestee injuries.
The Rijksrecherche (national criminal investigation service) is investigating this incident.
De Rijksrecherche doet onderzoek naar dit incident.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de uitzending van 'Waarom Srebrenica moest vallen'

MP Kuzu asked the Defence Minister whether a 2015 documentary revealed new information about the Dutch role in the fall of Srebrenica, alleged betrayal by allied states, and related accountability and victim-support measures. The government answered that a NIOD exploratory study found no evidence of secret allied deals or betrayal, declined to request further US documents, and rejected new external investigations and claims reconsideration.
NIOD states that it has not been shown that the allies France, the United Kingdom and the United States made secret agreements not to use air power anymore.
Het NIOD stelt dat niet is gebleken dat de bondgenoten Frankrijk, het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de Verenigde Staten geheime afspraken hebben gemaakt om het luchtwapen niet meer in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht ‘Politie biedt 84-jarige man excuses aan voor hardhandige arrestatie’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police apologised for the handcuffed arrest of an 84-year-old man for cycling on the wrong side of the road, questioning proportionality, language contact, possible ethnic profiling and police training. The Minister answered that questions about this specific incident fall under the local mayor's responsibility, that police acted out of concern for a confused man, that police apologised, and that ethnic discrimination is not tolerated.
Answering specific questions about the incident falls under the responsibility of the mayor as the local competent authority.
Het beantwoorden van specifieke vragen over het genoemde voorval valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de burgemeester als lokaal bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over etnisch profileren in Nederland

MP Kuzu asked the Minister of Security and Justice about ethnic profiling by police in traffic checks following a Supreme Court ruling, and whether police discrimination harms public trust. The minister replied that selecting vehicles solely or predominantly on ethnic or religious grounds is not permitted, pointed to internal guidance on risk indicators, diversity and anti-discrimination policy, and said the questions on recherche misuse did not warrant further investigation.
However, it is not permitted to select for a traffic check on the basis of solely or predominantly ethnic or religious characteristics of the driver or other occupants of the vehicle.

Het is echter niet toegestaan om daarbij op grond van uitsluitend of overwegend etnische of religieuze kenmerken van de bestuurder of andere inzittenden van het voertuig te selecteren voor een verkeerscontrole.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht ‘Meldingen kinderporno dit jaar verdubbeld’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that child pornography notifications had doubled, the reasons for the rise, prevention, prosecution figures, trauma expertise and police digital capacity. The minister attributed the rise mainly to Dutch internet infrastructure and reporting volume rather than a confirmed increase in material, gave prosecution statistics and described prevention, care and prioritisation measures without announcing new measures.
At this moment I have received no signals from this reporting that would require additional measures.
Op dit moment hebben mij geen signalen bereikt naar aanleiding van deze berichtgeving extra maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat 200 mensen aangehouden zijn bij de intocht van Sinterklaas

MP Kuzu asked the Justice and Interior ministers about the arrest of about 200 anti-Zwarte Piet demonstrators, the Rotterdam city-centre demonstration ban, the emergency order, police conduct and the broader Zwarte Piet debate. The minister answered that the police offered to escort the group to Maassluis but they chose to go to central Rotterdam, that the mayor's ban was justified for public order, and that complaints about police force can be filed with the police or courts, while the Zwarte Piet tradition is a matter for society and broadcasters.
The mayor of Rotterdam committed in the council debate of 17 November 2016 to evaluate the events surrounding the arrests for the council.
De burgemeester van Rotterdam heeft in het raadsdebat van 17 november 2016 toegezegd aan de raad de gebeurtenissen omtrent de aanhoudingen te evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de campagne ‘zet een streep door discriminatie’

An MP asks the Interior Minister whether he will remove Giel Beelen from the government anti-discrimination campaign spot after Beelen's racist remarks, and whether the government's refusal condones discrimination. The minister answers that discrimination is unacceptable, the spot is no longer broadcast, Beelen has apologised, and the matter is not for the cabinet to decide.
The matter is not for the cabinet to decide.
De zaak is niet ter beslissing voor het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat moslims steeds vaker slachtoffer zijn van discriminatie vanwege hun geloof

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the ministers about reports that Muslims are increasingly victims of religious discrimination, including the rise in reported incidents, the effects of terrorism and rhetoric by politicians, possible measures, and a registry of cases and sentences. The government answered that discrimination is unacceptable, pointed to the 2015 discrimination report and the Nationaal Actieprogramma, and gave incident counts for 2013-2015 while declining a separate racism police force and taking no firm new measures beyond awaiting a study on triggers.
On the basis of this report, I want to examine, after consulting relevant partners, where efforts to combat Muslim discrimination can be further strengthened.
Op basis van deze rapportage wil ik, na overleg met betrokken partners, nagaan waar de inzet op het bestrijden van moslimdiscriminatie verder versterkt kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat slechts een kwart van de aangiften van discriminatie in behandeling wordt genomen door het openbaar ministerie

An MP asked the ministers about reports that only a quarter of discrimination complaints reach the public prosecution service, and what is being done to raise reporting and improve handling, including online discrimination. The government denies the figures as stated, says it shares concern about reporting and is reviewing the Discrimination Directive with police and OM, but refuses a racism register, a racism police unit, and dedicated extra budget, pointing to existing action programmes.
For an explanation of this, I refer to the answer to questions 2 and 3 from Member Marcouch.
Voor een verklaring hiervoor verwijs ik naar het antwoord op de vragen 2 en 3 van het lid Marcouch
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat de Verenigde Naties verzaken om de Rohingya in Myanmar te beschermen

An MP asks the Dutch government about leaked UN documents and a documentary suggesting the UN failed to protect the Rohingya in Myanmar, and about reports of intimidation and restricted aid access. The minister answers that the government is concerned, supports UN and NGO work in Rakhine, raised the issues during a visit, and rejects the claim of institutional complicity, while declining to share an internal UN report.
The Netherlands does not have the report. It is an internal report commissioned by the UN.
Nederland beschikt niet over het rapport. Het betreft hier een intern rapport dat in opdracht van de VN is opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het bericht dat dat de Kinderombudsman wordt bedreigd vanwege haar mening over Zwarte Piet

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the government about reports that the Children's Ombudsman was threatened over her views on Zwarte Piet, and about discrimination children experience and whether the tradition breaches the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child. The government condemned the threats, said security measures are taken when needed without detailing them, declined to take a cabinet position on Zwarte Piet, and offered facilitation of dialogue plus a planned new research study.
However, I cannot provide information about the content of any security measures.
Ik kan echter geen informatie verstrekken over inhoud van eventuele beveiligingsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het omstreden referendum dat onrust stookt in Servisch Bosnië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the referendum in Republika Srpska held despite a Constitutional Court suspension, its risk of unrest, and whether the Dayton Agreement and EU stance are at stake. The minister called the holding of the referendum regrettable, said Dayton is not likely under pressure, backed de-escalation calls, and noted EU and Dutch efforts in Bosnia.
It is regrettable that the referendum was nevertheless held despite this ruling.
Het is spijtig dat het referendum in weerwil van deze uitspraak toch is gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat een mensenrechtenjurist in Nederland ernstig bedreigd wordt

MP Kuzu asked whether a human rights lawyer working for al-Haq on ICC preliminary examinations of Israel and Palestine was threatened, why police initially did not take threats seriously, whether NGOs were obstructed, whether a state actor was behind the threats, and whether the Kamer would be informed of the investigation. The ministers confirmed the threats and an ongoing criminal investigation, described a consultation mechanism with the ICC and NGOs, but declined to comment on state involvement and said it is not customary to inform parliament about ongoing investigations.
It is not customary to inform the Kamer about ongoing investigations or their conclusion.
Het is niet gebruikelijk de Kamer te informeren over lopende onderzoeken of de afronding hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over de racistische en discriminatoire gebeurtenissen in de weken 22 en 23

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the government about racist incidents in Geesteren and elsewhere, victim support, police reporting practices, specialisation in discrimination cases, rising racist violence, and non-implementation of ECRI recommendations. The Minister said victim support follows standard procedure, the motorcop case is under investigation so no comment is possible, police reporting uses a multichannel approach, discrimination training is being strengthened, and the ECRI recommendations are partly addressed through the National Action Programme with a progress report due January 2017.
This case is currently being investigated. While the investigation is ongoing, I cannot make any statements about it.
Deze zaak wordt momenteel onderzocht. Lopende het onderzoek kan ik hier geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over een racistische aanval in Zwolle

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the government about a racist attack in Zwolle, victim support, rising racist violence, stronger penalties such as an educational sentence for discrimination, police specialisation in discrimination complaints, and budgets for combating discrimination and radicalisation. The government replied that victim support follows the regular procedure, existing sentencing options suffice, police already have discrimination contact persons, and gave the budget figures, but declined to answer the questions before the plenary debate.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu inzake het bericht dat bij het inroosteren van examens in Groot-Brittannië rekening wordt gehouden met de Ramadan

An MP asked the state secretary about accommodating Ramadan in exam scheduling, citing UK and Flemish developments and a VU study showing lower exam results during Ramadan. The state secretary replied that the Dutch central exams did not overlap with Ramadan in the first session, that students may reschedule fasting or retake in the second session, and that no additional measures are needed.
In view of the answers to questions 4, 5 and 6, I do not consider additional measures necessary.
Gelet op de antwoorden bij de vragen 4, 5 en 6 acht ik geen aanvullende maatregelen noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu inzake de stigmatiserende video van Powned over inwoners van de Bijlmer

An MP asked the government whether a PowNed video portraying Bijlmer residents as stigmatised was acceptable, and whether public funding should be reconsidered. The state secretary answered that public broadcasters have editorial autonomy under the Mediawet, the government does not judge individual programmes, and complaints can go to anti-discrimination bodies or the courts, while an NPO-wide ombudsman is being pursued.
It is not for the government to pass judgement on the media offering of public media institutions.
Het is niet aan de overheid om een oordeel uit te spreken over het media-aanbod van de publieke media-instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de ontmanteling van een Nederlands ontwikkelingsproject door het Israëlische leger

MP Kuzu asked whether Israeli forces dismantled a Dutch-funded agricultural development project, the consequences for Dutch aid and bilateral ties, and whether the ambassador should be summoned. The ministers say the report is inaccurate (a stop-work order on one site of a larger project), describe protests and legal avenues, and say the Israeli side is being pressed on damage while bilateral dialogue continues.

This is not correct. It concerns a so-called stop-work order for one of the locations where Palestinian farmers, with support from a Palestinian NGO funded by the Netherlands, had further developed their land to achieve a better harvest.

Dit is niet correct. Het betreft een zgn. stop-work order voor één van de locaties waar Palestijnse boeren, met steun van een door Nederland gefinancierde Palestijnse NGO, hun land verder ontwikkeld hebben om een betere oogst te kunnen realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over extreem hoog percentage afwijzingen islamitische middelbare scholen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education why only two of thirty applications for Islamic secondary schools were approved, and whether the criteria allow discretion. The State Secretary replied that applications are assessed only against the objective statutory founding norm with no discretion, and announced a bill (Meer ruimte voor nieuwe scholen) to change the start procedure, with housing decisions left to municipalities.
I aim to submit the bill to the House of Representatives in early 2017, after completing all formal steps including advice from the Education Council and Council of State.
Ik streef ernaar om het wetsvoorstel, na het doorlopen van alle formele stappen, waaronder advisering door de Onderwijsraad en Raad van State, begin 2017 aan de Tweede Kamer te kunnen aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over 117 medewerkers bij het Openbaar Ministerie die berispt of ontslagen zijn na fouten

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why figures on 117 Public Prosecution Service staff reprimanded or dismissed for misconduct only emerged after FOIA requests, and whether reporting, screening and disciplinary standards would be improved. The Minister answered that the OM reports integrity cases annually, that it will now publish the anonymised half-yearly overviews each year, and that screening and whistleblowing channels exist, while declining to break down cases by sex, ethnicity, function or pay scale to protect privacy.
The OM will in future annually and actively publish the BI-OM overviews in addition to the annual report.
Het OM zal in het vervolg jaarlijks in aanvulling op het jaarbericht de BI-OM-overzichten actief publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu inzake het bericht dat de pabo "steeds witter wordt"

An MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that teacher-training (pabo) intake is becoming whiter, given sharp drops in intake and in students of non-Western origin after stricter admission requirements. The minister acknowledged the drop, attributed it largely to the new entry requirements, and outlined support tracks, diversity measures and funding compensation without committing to a formal oversight change.
I will follow developments around a 'teach-nasium' with interest and, when it takes shape, inform the House in the annual progress report on the Teacher Agenda.
Ik zal de ontwikkelingen rondom een «teach-nasium» met belangstelling volgen en wanneer dit vorm krijgt uw Kamer hierover informeren in de jaarlijkse voortgangsrapportage Lerarenagenda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over racistische uitingen van de supporters van ADO Den Haag tijdens de wedstrijd tegen Ajax

MPs Kuzu and others asked ministers about racist chants by ADO Den Haag supporters against Ajax players and whether the government would act, including on investigation, prosecution and the KNVB's handling of such incidents. The government replied that clubs, KNVB and Eredivisie CV agreed to act faster against offensive chants, that prosecution is considered in provable cases, and that existing monitoring and action plans are sufficient, declining new investigations.
Professional football clubs, the KNVB and Eredivisie CV have agreed to act faster and more firmly against offensive chants in football.
Betaald voetbalclubs, KNVB en Eredivisie CV hebben afgesproken sneller en kordater op te treden tegen scheldkoren in het voetbal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over dat de politie te weinig leert van klachten die worden ingediend door burgers

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the Justice Minister why nearly 3,000 of 10,898 citizen complaints against police in 2014 were not handled and why the police learn too little from complaints. The minister explains many unhandled complaints were misdirected or registered as received, points to measures already taken, and declines further investigation or an apology.
There can be various reasons why a complaint was not taken up in the complaints procedure or is still open at year-end.
Er kunnen diverse redenen zijn waarom een klacht niet in de klachtenprocedure in behandeling is genomen of aan het eind van het jaar nog open staat voor behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol, Pieter Heerma, Verhoeven, Jasper van Dijk, Thieme en Kuzu over de behandeling van de Mediawet in de Eerste Kamer

MPs asked the State Secretary about appointments to the supervisory boards of the NOS and NTR and the NPO, including alleged political favouritism and whether a board chair's position at UWV made the appointment incompatible with the Mediawet. The State Secretary denied any legal incompatibility, said the NPO appointment followed an independent advisory committee, and refused to reverse it.
I regret the impression that has arisen and do not consider it consistent with the actual course of events.
Ik betreur het beeld dat is ontstaan en vind dat ook niet in overeenstemming met de feitelijke gang van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de illegale annexatie van Palestijns land door de Israëlische regering

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about Israel's reported annexation of about 154 hectares of Palestinian land, whether it is illegal, what steps the government will take, and about efforts to restart peace talks and recognition of a Palestinian state. The minister condemns the designation of 234 hectares near Jericho as state land as unlawful appropriation contrary to international law, describes EU and Dutch diplomatic efforts to revive talks, and says recognition of Palestine will be used at a strategic moment and is a national decision.
The cabinet regrets this decision, which constitutes an unlawful appropriation in violation of international law.
Het kabinet betreurt dit besluit, dat een onrechtmatige toe-eigening vormt in strijd met internationaal recht
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de 39 aanhoudingen tijdens een PEGIDA demonstratie

An MP asks the Justice Minister about 39 arrests at a PEGIDA demonstration in Rotterdam, including the alleged violent arrest and denial of medical help and delayed lawyer access of a journalist, and about press freedom. The minister declines to comment on the individual case while a police complaints investigation (BVIK) is ongoing, describes the standard procedure for lawyer access, and says other journalist cases are not known to him.
During this investigation I cannot make a statement on the content of this case.
Gedurende dit onderzoek kan ik geen uitspraak doen over de inhoud van deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over Russische bombardementen op Turkmeense minderheden in Syrië

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkmen in Syria fled after Russian bombings, and about condemnation, EU/NATO/UN action, aid, casualty figures, and the Geneva talks. The minister answered that the government has repeatedly condemned Russian attacks on the moderate opposition, supports UN resolution 2254, provides humanitarian aid regardless of ethnicity, and cannot independently verify casualty figures, while withholding details on supported groups for security reasons.
For security reasons, the specific fate of the groups supported by the Netherlands cannot be addressed.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen kan niet worden ingegaan op de specifieke lotgevallen van de groeperingen die door Nederland worden gesteund.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk inzake het bericht dat een presentatrice is gediscrimineerd bij RTL Nieuws

Deputies Kuzu and Öztürk asked about reports that a RTL Nieuws presenter was discriminated against, and about diversity and representativeness in Dutch media and the public broadcaster NPO. The Secretary of State said RTL denies discrimination, that media diversity is ultimately the responsibility of broadcasters, that data limits exist due to privacy rules, and that he will urge media organisations and the NPO to improve diversity without committing to binding action.
It is unacceptable if someone is treated differently on the basis of their skin colour than another person.
Het is onacceptabel als iemand op basis van zijn/haar huidskleur op een andere manier wordt behandeld dan een ander persoon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het bericht ‘In Nederland dreigt nieuwe onderklasse van vluchtelingen te ontstaan’

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the government how it will prevent a new underclass of refugees, including waiting times, early language and labour-market preparation, and allowing work or study during the asylum procedure. The minister replies by pointing to existing letters on integration, early language courses, and an expanded pre-integration programme, without committing to new measures such as working during the procedure.
Are you willing, for the integration of newcomers, to let asylum migrants work and study already during their procedure?
Bent u bereid, ten behoeve van de integratie van de nieuwkomers, asielmigranten al tijdens hun procedure te laten werken en studeren?

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops, De Roon, Voordewind, Grashoff, Van der Staaij, Thieme, Bontes, Kuzu, Van Vliet, Krol, Klein en Houwers over de levensbedreigende situatie

MPs asked the ministers about the humanitarian siege of Madaya in Syria, where about 40,000 people face starvation, and whether the Netherlands would press for a ceasefire, humanitarian access and airdrops. The ministers confirmed the severity of the situation, described Dutch funding and diplomatic efforts through the UN and ICRC, and explained why airdrops are not considered feasible.
The Netherlands has for some time been pressing within the UN for a ceasefire so that humanitarian aid can be provided to the population.
Nederland dringt in VN-verband al geruime tijd aan op een staakt-het-vuren zodat humanitaire hulp geboden kan worden aan de bevolking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu inzake docent die niet mag bidden op school

An MP asks the state secretary for Education about a teacher reportedly barred from praying during breaks at a Rijswijk school, and whether this breaches religious freedom and equal treatment law. The state secretary declines to judge the facts or the legal question, saying the College voor de Rechten van de Mens or a court should decide, and announces no new measures.
Giving a legal judgment on this matter is reserved for the College voor de Rechten van de Mens or the court, not for the cabinet or the House of Representatives.
Het geven van een juridisch oordeel over deze zaak is voorbehouden aan het College voor de Rechten van de Mens of de rechter, niet aan het kabinet of de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat de aanpak van radicalisering is gedoemd te mislukken

Rep. Kuzu asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Dutch approach to radicalisation, which an expert called doomed to fail, polarises society, is based on a wrong equation of counter-terrorism with Islamic culture, and should be replaced by a more effective approach with concrete measures. The minister replies that the approach targets all forms of violent extremism, that the integrated evaluation of the National CT strategy is underway with results to be sent to the House in spring 2016, and that psychosocial factors are taken into account while research continues.
The results of the evaluation will be sent to the House of Representatives in spring 2016.
De resultaten van de evaluatie zullen in het voorjaar van 2016 naar de Tweede Kamer worden verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat de politie de nekklem mag blijven gebruiken van de rechter

MP Kuzu asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police use of the neck hold after a court ruling allowed it to continue, including its training, deaths and injuries, whether it should be banned pending an Inspectorate investigation, and prosecution of officers. The Minister replied that force is assessed case by case, the court found no general ban was warranted, the Inspectorate is investigating neck-hold use with results expected in December, and the Rijksrecherche investigates deaths and serious injuries with prosecution decided by the Openbaar Ministerie.
As I informed your House on 10 July, I asked the Inspectorate of Security and Justice to launch an investigation into police use of the neck hold.
Zoals ik uw Kamer op 10 juli jl. liet weten heb ik de Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie verzocht een onderzoek in te stellen naar het gebruik van de nekklem door de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over de schokkende uitspraken op Twitter van een persoon die werkzaam is bij een onderwijsinstelling

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked ministers about a discriminatory tweet by a school employee, rising internet discrimination reports, and whether a racism register, educational measure, and stronger reporting channel would be introduced. The government answered that online speech is protected within legal limits, cited rising MiND reports, announced an expert meeting with platforms and promised to report results in the budget debate, but rejected a racism register and a new educational measure.
I am not in favour of a separate racism register as advocated by MPs Kuzu and Öztürk.
Ik ben geen voorstander van een apart racismeregister zoals dat wordt voorgestaan door de leden Kuzu en Öztürk
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat een man op social media dreigt met massamoord op Turkse Nederlanders

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a social media video in which a man threatens mass murder of Turkish Dutch people, and whether the person's identity and PKK links would be investigated. The minister said all instruments are used against threats, declined to comment on individual cases for investigative reasons, and reported no current indications of physical threat from the PKK in the Netherlands.
For the sake of investigation and prosecution interests, I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Omwille van de belangen van opsporing en vervolging kan ik over individuele gevallen geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de situatie van de Rohingya uit Birma/Myanmar

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the treatment of Rohingya in Myanmar, Thai trafficking and refugee camps, Myanmar's dealings with MSF, and the link between economic ties and human rights. The minister answers that the government is concerned, supports humanitarian funding, raises rights issues with Myanmar and Thailand through the EU, and says no concrete new commitments are made.
Of course, the cabinet will continue to monitor the situation of the Rohingya and raise it in future talks.
Vanzelfsprekend zal het kabinet de situatie van de Rohingya blijven monitoren en ook in toekomstige gesprekken aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over privacyschending door middel van nieuwe vormen van telefoonfraude

MP Kuzu asked whether spoofing apps that let callers fake their number, which enabled fraud causing about 300,000 euro in losses to companies, should be regulated, and whether a public awareness campaign or research into such apps is planned. The State Secretary replied that spoofing has legitimate uses, that prosecution is possible under article 231b for misuse, that fraud is to be tackled via police priorities and existing advice channels, and that no separate campaign or study is planned.
I do not intend to set up a separate awareness campaign.
Ik ben niet voornemens een aparte bewustwordingscampagne op te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de situatie van Oeigoeren in de Chinese provincie Xinjiang

MP Kuzu asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Uyghurs in Xinjiang were prevented from observing Ramadan, strict mosque controls, assimilation and population policy, and the deportation of Uyghur asylum seekers. The minister answered that the government raises religious freedom and minority rights with China bilaterally and through the EU, that information from the region is hard to verify, and that the asylum question is referred to the State Secretary of Security and Justice.
The cabinet makes a consistent and joint effort regarding the human rights situation in China.
Het kabinet levert een consistente en gezamenlijke inspanning wat betreft de mensenrechtensituatie in China.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat een festivalbezoeker is overleden na hardhandig optreden van de Haagse politie

MP Kuzu asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the death of Mitch Henriquez after police restraint in The Hague, including the number of custody deaths, the handling of officers, racism within the police, and independent complaint mechanisms. The Minister answered that the Rijksrecherche investigation is ongoing, that officers were placed off duty, that no evidence of systemic discrimination was found, and that complaints can go to independent commissions and the Nationale ombudsman, while withholding detailed ten-year data and declining several structural measures.
When an arrestee dies, the Rijksrecherche investigates all events from the first report up to and including the death.
De Rijksrecherche onderzoekt bij het overlijden van een arrestant alle gebeurtenissen vanaf de eerste melding tot en met het overlijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de bescherming van persoonsgegevens

MP Kuzu asks about privacy and data protection issues involving Google privacy terms, NPO tracking cookies, the education tablet provider Snappet, and apps directed at children. The government answers that the data protection regulator CBP and consumer authority ACM are responsible, that Snappet ended its violations without enforcement, and that cookie consent and parental consent rules apply under the Telecommunicatiewet and Wbp.
It is up to the Dutch Data Protection Authority (CBP) to assess whether in individual cases there is a violation of the Personal Data Protection Act (Wbp).
Het staat ter beoordeling van het College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP) of in individuele gevallen sprake is van overtreding van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (Wbp).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over sociale uitkeringen voor Nederlanders woonachtig in illegale nederzettingen in bezet Palestijns gebied

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked whether the government will apply the Wet BEU consistently to Dutch residents of Israeli settlements in occupied Palestinian territory, in line with 2002 policy, and whether the SVB's position on the territories is correct. The government answered that the new AOW policy is consistent with the 2002 position: current recipients keep the single-person AOW up to 70% of the minimum wage, while from 1 January 2016 new single recipients in occupied areas receive the married-person norm of 50%.
This decision will be published and communicated as soon as possible.
Dit besluit zal zo spoedig mogelijk worden bekendgemaakt en gecommuniceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het doodvonnis voor de Egyptische oud-president Mohammed Morsi

An MP asked the government about the death sentence against former Egyptian president Morsi, whether it was political, why the Netherlands had not spoken out more firmly, what diplomatic, legal and political steps it would take, and about the scale of death sentences in Egypt. The government answered that it opposes the death penalty, has raised concerns bilaterally and through the EU and UN, but declined to send a special envoy or to pursue the steps asked, and gave no firm new commitments.
The cabinet does not consider it opportune to separately appoint a Dutch special envoy to raise the death sentences in Egypt.
Om die reden acht het kabinet het niet opportuun om separaat een Nederlandse speciale gezant aan te wijzen om de doodvonnissen in Egypte aan te kaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het alsnog straffen van een ambtenaar om een IS-tweet

MP Kuzu asks the Minister of Security and Justice why a civil servant was given a conditional dismissal over an IS-related tweet despite the AGFA advisory committee's findings that ministers' public statements contributed to the unrest, how the advice leaked to the press, and why other officials making racist posts faced no discipline. The minister replies that he informed parliament by letter, that he knows of no leak from his officials, that it is improper for officials to learn of their own cases via media, and that discipline is decided case by case.
I conclude that the NRC has the advice. How the NRC obtained the advice is not known to me.
Ik concludeer dat de NRC over het advies beschikt. Op welke wijze de NRC de beschikking over het advies heeft gekregen, is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de arrestatie van de Palestijnse parlementariër Khalida Jarrar

MP Kuzu asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of Palestinian legislator Khalida Jarrar, the reported administrative detention of Palestinian MPs, the travel ban, Israel's compliance with international law, and recognition of Palestine. The minister answered that Israeli measures lack transparency and due process, that the Netherlands raises this in the EU and bilateral dialogue, that recognition will be used at a strategic moment, and that no summoning of the Israeli ambassador is planned.
Basing a travel ban solely on secret evidence is therefore problematic.
Het baseren van een reisverbod op alleen geheim bewijsmateriaal is dan ook problematisch.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over herhaaldelijke censuur bij de Vrije Universiteit (VU) in Amsterdam

An MP asks the minister about the VU university refusing a room for a lecture on the Armenian genocide, which it judged one-sided, and whether this threatens academic freedom. The minister answers that the VU acted under its neutral room-booking rules, not censorship, and declines to intervene or raise the matter with the university board.
I therefore see no reason to consult with the VU on this matter.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om hierover met de VU in overleg te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over de discriminerende uitspraak van de burgemeester van Gilze-Rijen

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked whether the mayor of Gilze-Rijen, who made discriminatory remarks about the Turkish-Dutch community, should be sanctioned or should step down. The minister defended the mayor's crime-fighting role, noted the mayor apologised and that the dialogue was resumed, and saw no reason for intervention, saying the mayor is accountable to the municipal council.
I see no reason for further intervention regarding the mayor's position.
Ik zie geen reden tot een nadere interventie met betrekking tot de positie van de burgemeester.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over censuur bij de Vrije Universiteit

An MP asks the Minister of Education whether the Vrije Universiteit's refusal to provide a room for a critical debate on Palestine amounts to censorship and an infringement of academic freedom, and whether the minister will act. The minister answers that the university withheld the room over concerns about a sense of exclusion, not as censorship, that external parties had no influence, and that the minister considers the matter a matter between the university and the student group.
I consider this a matter between the VU and the SRP.
Ik vind dit een zaak tussen de VU en de SRP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat de inspectie niet in actie kwam na de dood van een psychiatrisch patiënt

An MP asked whether the health inspectorate (IGZ) failed to act after a psychiatric patient died during coercive care, and why it let the care provider investigate first. The minister confirmed the IGZ initially delegated the investigation under its guidelines, later decided to investigate itself, said the probe is ongoing with results expected mid-year, and declined to support the family's legal action beyond pointing to legal aid options.
The IGZ investigation is still ongoing at this time.
Het onderzoek van de IGZ loopt op dit moment nog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over een boete voor racistische uitspraken onder voetbalselfie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why only three people received fines for racist remarks under a football selfie, whether penalties and prevention measures against racism online and in government posts should be strengthened, and whether a racism reporting point for government roles should be created. The minister answered that three suspects received transaction offers, that criminal law is a last resort within a broader anti-discrimination policy, that discriminatory remarks are incompatible with civil service conduct and may be disciplined, and that no separate reporting point is needed.
I am not aware whether any of the perpetrators holds a government position.
Het is mij niet bekend of een van de daders een functie bij de overheid heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het onderzoek ‘Nederland en de islam: onbegrepen en moeizaam’

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the minister about an EO survey finding widespread lack of contact with Muslims, perceived threat and negative views, and what government will do about Islamophobia and integration. The minister answered that the EO poll's robustness is unclear, pointed to the SCP and SIM research and to anti-discrimination initiatives, and gave Eurobarometer comparisons while denying integration policy has failed.
There is no insight into the robustness of the results of the survey conducted by the EO.
Er is geen zicht op de robuustheid van de resultaten van de peiling die is uitgevoerd door de EO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over allochtone daders die een grotere kans op een zware straf hebben

Kuzu asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that non-Western-looking or minority-origin defendants receive harsher sentences, and whether this breaches equal treatment and ECHR principles. The Minister said the Raad voor de rechtspraak takes the signals seriously, that differences largely disappear after controlling for criminal record and employment, and that a follow-up study is being carried out by the judiciary itself.
Impartiality is one of the core values of the judiciary.
Onpartijdigheid is één van de kernwaarden van de rechtspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het dreigende ontslag van een militair wegens haar relatie met een Turk

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the Defence and Social Affairs ministers about a female soldier facing dismissal because of her relationship with a Turkish partner, whom the MIVD cannot screen. The Defence minister answered that a tailored solution can prevent dismissal, that the MIVD has done what is required, that the commander's view is weighed, and that personnel will receive more information on partner policy.

As I explained in my letter of 21 May, no list can be released of the countries with which the intelligence and security services have a cooperation relationship on the basis of which personal data are exchanged.

Zoals ik heb toegelicht in mijn brief van 21 mei jl., kan geen lijst worden vrijgegeven van landen met wie de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten een samenwerkingsrelatie hebben op basis waarvan persoonsgegevens worden uitgewisseld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de inkoop van goedkopere bloedglucosemeters door zorgverzekeraars

An MP asked the Minister of Health about insurers steering diabetes patients to cheaper blood glucose meters of uncertain quality, and about the lack of mandatory independent physical quality checks. The Minister answered that insurers may control costs as long as quality is assured, that existing CE and ISO 15197 standards apply, and that the Inspectorate has asked RIVM to investigate reported measurement deviations.
The inspectorate has asked the RIVM to start an investigation.
De inspectie heeft het RIVM gevraagd een onderzoek te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat de gemeente Amsterdam onwettige eisen heeft gesteld bij een huisvestingsaanvraag door een school voor bijzonder onderwijs

MP Kuzu asked the minister about reports that Amsterdam demanded board control over an Islamic school (SIO) as a condition for housing, contrary to law and the Onderwijsraad advice, and whether the municipality ignores a court ruling. The state secretary answered that the municipality dropped those conditions, a new decision is in preparation, the government sees no need for new measures against municipalities, and an inspectorate investigation of the SIO board will follow when funding is decided.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over de golf van incidenten jegens moskeeën

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the government about a wave of incidents against mosques, including threats, vandalism and arson, and about police registration of anti-Muslim discrimination, protection of mosques and prosecution. Minister Opstelten answered that the government condemns such attacks, will improve registration of Muslim discrimination and report on it separately, will take protective measures where threat warrants, and will apply prosecution policy with aggravated sentencing for discriminatory offences.
No public statement is made about information received from the intelligence and security services.
Over ontvangen informatie van inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten wordt in het openbaar geen uitspraak gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over Etnisch profileren in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about ethnic profiling by police, including the handling of a complaint about alleged mistreatment and an unlawful stop in The Hague's Schilderswijk, and the findings of a Leiden University study. The Minister answered that the complaint procedures were carefully conducted, that the Leiden study found no structural ethnic profiling, and that the police use of identity checks is legally bounded, while withholding some detail on disciplinary cases citing anonymised data.
Mr Sealiti can avail himself of various legal remedies if he believes this outcome does him an injustice.
De heer Sealiti kan zich van verschillende rechtsmiddelen bedienen indien hij meent dat met deze uitkomst hem onrecht wordt aangedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het bericht dat de rechter opnieuw heeft bepaald dat het korten van kinderbijslag onwettig is

Two MPs asked the ministers whether the government will keep litigating over the export-residence principle (woonlandbeginsel) after courts repeatedly ruled that cutting child benefit for children in Morocco is unlawful, and asked about legal costs, Moroccan project funding, and diplomatic fallout from terminating the social security treaty with Morocco. The minister answered that the law was passed by parliament, that the government respects rulings and continues litigation where needed for clarity, that legal costs are budgeted within structural implementation costs, that a Moroccan funding freeze is Morocco's own decision, and that the government will seek to revise the treaty and submit a termination approval bill to parliament.
Where it turns out that the export-residence principle cannot be applied, the cabinet has of course respected those rulings.
Waar blijkt dat woonlandbeginsel niet kan worden toegepast, heeft het kabinet deze uitspraken uiteraard gerespecteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuzu over artsen die laks zijn bij het voorschrijven van medicijnen

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about GPs who fail to record the reason for prescribing medicines, the risks this poses for patients and pharmacists, and what the government will do. The minister acknowledged the non-compliance as unacceptable, said pharmacists' advisory role suffers, stated that providers are responsible for record quality, and committed to monitoring and enforcement by the Inspectorate from 1 January 2015.
I find the reasons given in the study in no way do justice to the responsibility that prescribers have for their patients.
Ik vind de in het onderzoek opgegeven redenen op geen enkele manier recht doen aan de verantwoordelijkheid die voorschrijvers voor hun patiënten hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over thuiswonende dementerenden die te vaak onvrijwillige zorg ontvangen

MP Kuzu asked the State Secretary about coercive care for home-living people with dementia, including what the government is doing to reduce it and the roles of municipalities, other actors and the Inspectorate. The State Secretary answered that the Zorg en Dwang bill, pending in the Senate, will set conditions for coercion at home, that an action programme is underway, and that the Inspectorate acts on reports from care providers but cannot act against coercion by family carers.
In contrast to coerced restriction of liberty in institutional care, there is no duty to report involuntary care in the home situation to the IGZ.
In tegenstelling tot gedwongen vrijheidsbeperking in de intramurale zorg, bestaat er voor onvrijwillige zorg in de thuissituatie geen meldplicht bij de IGZ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de vergoeding van een geneesmiddel zonder de meerwaarde ervan te beoordelen

An MP asked the health minister why the Zorginstituut clustered Tecfidera without comparing its price to a cheaper compounded DMF product, and why its price rise leaves patients paying about €875 per month. The minister answered that the price of Tecfidera is not part of the clustering assessment under the GVS, that no price negotiation was started because the drug fell in an existing cluster, and that drug-rediscovery pricing will be examined further.
For all these individual arrangements, the agreed price reductions are not made public.
Voor al deze individuele arrangementen geldt dat de overeengekomen prijsverlagingen niet openbaar gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het Euripid-netwerk

MP Kuzu asked the minister about the state and usefulness of the Euripid network of drug price databases, Dutch participation, its use for the Wet geneesmiddelenprijzen, and whether meeting reports can be published. The minister answered that 22 EU states now contribute, that Nederland mainly joins for price indication, that the database may be used for comparisons, and that the reports cannot be made public because the network agreed that price information is shared only among government bodies.
This means that the reports cannot be made public.
Dit wil zeggen dat de verslagen niet openbaar gemaakt kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht ‘Separeercel nog te vaak gebruikt’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports of frequent and prolonged use of isolation cells in psychiatric care, and what is being done to reduce it, including consultation of the Centre for Consultation and Expertise and inspection oversight. The Minister answered that isolation is a last resort, that the inspectorate enforces a review framework on consultation and isolation, that the number of patients isolated over three months is lower than reported, and that the Wvggz bill is intended to limit coercion further.
Where the IGZ finds that (long-term) isolation is not applied in line with the norms, it takes enforcement action and will hold the institution to its responsibilities.
Daar waar de IGZ constateert dat de (langdurige) separatie niet conform de normen wordt toegepast, treedt zij handhavend op en zal zij de instelling aanspreken op haar verantwoordelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over over het bericht dat allochtonen vaker een burn-out hebben

MP Kuzu asked the minister about reports that non-Western immigrants suffer burn-out more often, and what the government is doing about it. The minister acknowledges the higher rates, attributes them mainly to labour-market position and other factors, and points to existing campaigns, guidelines and tools without committing to a new investigation.
But every burn-out is one too many.
Maar elke burn-out is er één te veel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Kuzu over de berichten dat het rijk schulden erger maakt door het inhouden van toeslagen en de stijging van het aantal mensen dat onder beschermingsbewind is geplaatst

MPs Schouten and Kuzu asked whether the state worsens household debts by clawing back excess childcare and other benefit advances, and about the rise in people placed under protective administration (beschermingsbewind). The state secretary acknowledged the repayment problem, described repayment arrangements and the protection of the subsistence allowance, said the Rijksincassovisie would address it, and referred to a separate letter for the protective administration questions.
If the benefit applicant cannot pay the amount under the standard payment arrangement, he can ask for a tailored payment arrangement.
Wanneer de toeslagaanvrager het bedrag van de standaard betalingsregeling niet kan opbrengen, kan hij om een betalingsregeling op maat vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over mogelijke leveringsproblemen van preferente geneesmiddelen

An MP asked the health minister whether shortages of preferred medicines persist, whether the preference policy lowers costs, and whether wholesalers and the IGZ should be made to ensure adequate stock. The minister answered that shortages are mostly due to manufacturers, that wholesalers have no obligation to be fully assorted, and that the IGZ already checks stock levels without a new instruction.
I will not instruct the IGZ to audit wholesalers on sufficient stock, because the IGZ already routinely includes this point in its supervision of wholesalers.
Ik zal de IGZ geen opdracht geven groothandels te toetsen op het punt van voldoende voorraad omdat de IGZ in haar toezicht op groothandels dit punt al sinds enige tijd standaard meeneemt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Van Laar over het bericht “Nepdokteren in Kenia wordt beloond met ridderorde in Nederland”

MPs Van Laar and Kuzu asked ministers about a Dutch homeopath whose non-profit distributes the homeopathic remedy Iquilai as a substitute for antiretrovirals in Kenya, and about his knighthood. The minister says such substitution is harmful, will ask the Dutch embassy to inform Kenyan authorities and asks the Inspectorate for Healthcare to examine options, but states she has no power to revoke the honour and no action is possible abroad.
I have therefore asked the Inspectorate for Healthcare to examine what options there are to investigate this matter further.
Ik heb daarom de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg gevraagd om na te gaan wat de mogelijkheden zijn om deze zaak nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Bouwmeester over patiënten die lange wachttijden melden voor tweedelijns geestelijke gezondheidszorg

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about long waiting times in second-line mental health care reported on TV, including the number of patients waiting, whether zorgverzekeraars are failing their zorgplicht, and what the NZa is doing. The minister said no current national waiting-list data exist, promised an NZa waiting-time measurement and a monitor, said insurers have a duty to refer patients, and committed to pressing insurers and providers on information and to reviewing the NZa information policy rule.
Currently no up-to-date national data are known about waiting lists in mental health care (GGZ).
Momenteel zijn geen actuele landelijke gegevens bekend over wachtlijsten in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (GGZ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de bijwerkingen van antidepressiva (SSRI’s)

An MP asks the Health Minister about reported aggression, suicide and violence linked to SSRI antidepressants, including the regulator's studies, label warnings, PSUR reporting, DNA testing and treatment guidelines. The minister answers that adverse effects are monitored, label warnings exist, aggression was added for under-18s and is under review for adults, and that DNA testing and mandatory changes to guidelines are not currently warranted.
The CBG is currently assessing Lareb's latest recommendation to include this side effect in the package leaflet, in the context of earlier measures and European discussions.
Het CBG beoordeelt op dit moment de laatste aanbeveling van Lareb over het opnemen van deze bijwerking in de bijsluiter in de context van eerder genomen maatregelen en Europese discussies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Van Laar over het bericht ‘Nibud bevestigt dat Bonaire ver onder de armoedegrens leeft’

MPs Kuzu and Van Laar asked about a report by the Nibud finding that Bonaire lives well below the poverty line, and whether the government has the report and how it compares to the CBS study and the social minimum in the European Netherlands. The State Secretary answered that Bonaire commissioned the report for its own poverty policy, that the Nibud figures are reference amounts not norms, that the CBS study is a separate economic study, and that the government will engage with the island's executive but will not base national minimum wage or benefit levels on the Nibud report.
The Nibud study cannot be the basis for national policy on the levels of the statutory minimum wage and benefits.
Het Nibud-onderzoek kan niet de basis zijn voor het rijksbeleid ten aanzien van de niveaus van het wettelijk minimumloon en de uitkeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kuzu over de falende controle op medicijngebruik van ouderen

MPs Wolbert and Kuzu asked the Minister of Health about insufficient checks on medication use by elderly people, including the low uptake of annual medication reviews and whether the Dutch Health Care Insurance (eigen risico) should exclude them. The minister acknowledged medication safety gaps, said implementation of the polypharmacy guideline is shared among GPs, pharmacists and patients, and said the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate will tighten supervision from 2015, while declining to exclude reviews from the deductible for now.
The IGZ will in any case tighten supervision from 1 January 2015.
De IGZ zal in ieder geval vanaf 1 januari 2015 het toezicht verscherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het Mirro-screeningsinstrument van Achmea

An MP asks the Health Minister about insurer Achmea's Mirro screening tool, including an 8% tariff difference for providers who do not use it and doubts about its validation. The minister replies that the tool was developed by care providers, that use is not mandatory and the clinician decides, that no fully validated tool yet exists, and that insurers do not determine treatment.
It is always up to the care professional, based on their own clinical judgement, to decide whether or not to follow the advice of the screening tool.
Het is altijd aan de zorgprofessional om, op basis van de eigen klinische blik, te besluiten het advies van het screeningsinstrument wel of niet op te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Yücel en Kuzu over het niet toelaten van kinderen tot sportverenigingen van op basis van achternamen

MPs asked whether children were refused membership of a Rotterdam football club based on their surname or origin and whether the government would investigate such refusals. The minister confirmed awareness, declined to commission a study of refusal numbers, and said the KNVB had contacted the club and requested a written statement before any further action.
A study into the number of times children are refused on improper grounds is something I will not commission.
Een onderzoek naar het aantal keren dat kinderen op basis van oneigenlijke gronden worden geweigerd, ga ik niet laten uitvoeren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de betaalbaarheid van kankermedicijnen

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Health about the affordability of cancer medicines, including whether secret price negotiations are the right tool and whether price ceilings, the Norwegian model or NICE-style cost-effectiveness assessment should be used. The Minister answered that Dutch mechanisms (CVZ assessment, price arrangements, hospital budget transfer, registration) are adequate, rejected generic price ceilings, and promised only to await a CVZ report on cost-effectiveness.
Introducing new generic price ceilings or budgets is, in my view, not an alternative for this.
Het instellen van nieuwe, generieke prijsplafonds of budgetten is hiervoor mijn inziens geen alternatief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuzu over wanbetalers in de zorg

MPs Bouwmeester and Kuzu asked the Minister of Health about rising numbers of people who do not pay their health insurance premiums, including whether unpaid premiums are growing and what causes and measures apply. The minister confirmed about 320,000 defaulters with roughly 887 million euro outstanding, explained the debt-collection and bronheffing process, and committed to a further package of measures in summer.
I have no data on that.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Recourt over malafide incassobureaus

Two PvdA MPs asked the government about allegedly fraudulent debt collection agencies, including over-charging of consumers and a possible fraud case, and whether a legal quality mark is needed. The State Secretary answered that the sector's voluntary membership suffices for now, that a dialogue with the sector and a letter on enforcement of the Wet incassokosten would follow before Christmas, that legal aid is available only where gedupeerden fall under the Wet op de rechtsbijstand, and that no specific government body supervises compliance, with the Autoriteit Consument en Markt possibly acting in some cases.
No government body is specifically charged with supervising compliance with this law.
Er is geen overheidsinstantie specifiek met het toezicht op de naleving van deze wet belast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de consequenties van de voorgenomen opzet basis-GGZ /specialistische GGZ voor met name de behandeling van angst- en stemmingsstoornissen

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the planned basic and specialist mental health care structure would undermine treatment of moderate to severe anxiety and mood disorders, citing concerns from NEDKAD about session reductions, assignment criteria, and referral limits. The Minister largely rejects the concerns, relies on expert input and a planned monitor, and declines to commit to revising the criteria beyond monitoring.
I am setting up a monitor to evaluate the generalist basic mental health care.
Ik zet de monitor op om generalistische basis GGZ te evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de invloed van het Apollo netwerk op het beleid

An MP asked the health minister about the Apollo network, its purpose, members' interests and funding, whether it produced reports, and whether it influenced pricing agreements for medicines. The minister answered that the network aims at shared knowledge, that ministry funding since 2010 totals modest sums, that it produced two publications, and that policy is not influenced by industry, though contacts are carefully managed.
I do not have an overview of side positions and of the research and/or advice for which they received contributions from the pharmaceutical industry.
Ik heb geen overzicht van nevenfuncties en de onderzoeken en/of adviezen waarvoor zij een bijdrage hebben ontvangen van de farmaceutische industrie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kuzu over een dronken huisarts

MPs Wolbert and Kuzu asked whether the Inspectorate should immediately investigate and suspend a doctor who came to work drunk, and about related reporting and disciplinary steps. Minister Schippers said the IGZ investigated in 2012 and found no patient-safety risk while the doctor was sober, has now reopened an inquiry after new complaints, plans a legal power for immediate interim suspension, and will work with the sector on alcohol norms and refer to the College van Medisch Toezicht where unfitness is proven.
Within disciplinary law I want to create the possibility to immediately suspend a practitioner by way of interim measure
In het kader van het tuchtrecht wil ik de mogelijkheid creëren om een beroepsbeoefenaar bij wijze van voorlopige voorziening direct te schorsen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over becherming van persoonsgegevens in digitale patientendossiers

MPs Oosenbrug and Kuzu asked the health and justice ministers about privacy protection in digital patient records after the Dutch data protection authority (CBP) found that none of the examined care institutions complied with the Wbp. The minister answered that institutions must improve access controls, that CBP will enforce if breaches continue, that NEN security norms will be made binding via an AMvB, and that IGZ is considering intensifying its supervision.
If the CBP finds that the institutions do not end the violations, the CBP will take enforcement action.
Als het CBP constateert dat de instellingen de overtredingen niet beëindigen, zal het CBP handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het risico op bloedingen bij het gebruik van nieuwe bloedverdunners

An MP asked the health minister about the bleeding risk of new anticoagulants (dabigatran, rivaroxaban) highlighted in an Erasmus MC study, international concerns, the secret price agreement and follow-up research. The minister answered that the risks were weighed at registration and are monitored, the price agreements run until 2016, and first follow-up results are not expected before 2016.
The agreements with the manufacturers concerned run until 1 January 2016.
De afspraken met de betrokken fabrikanten lopen tot 1 januari 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Kuzu over de beschikbaarheid van het Q-koorts medicijn doxycycline

MPs Van Dekken and Kuzu asked the health minister about the nationwide shortage of the antibiotic doxycycline, which chronic Q-fever patients depend on, and whether supply is restored. The minister confirmed the shortage, explained supply chain causes, reported partial availability from some suppliers, and pointed to a general plan on medicine shortages without a specific patient-level commitment.
My ambition is therefore, where possible, to address medicine shortages through joint efforts of all parties involved.
Mijn ambitie is dan ook daar waar mogelijk geneesmiddelentekorten aan te pakken door een gezamenlijke inspanning van alle betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden vr Van Dekken en Kuzu over het duurder worden van sportbeoefening

Two PvdA MPs asked whether rising sports fees threaten children's and low-income participation in sport and what the government will do. The minister says local authorities are primarily responsible, points to the Sport en Bewegen in de Buurt programme, Sportimpuls, Jeugdsportfonds funding and poverty-policy funds, and commits to discussions with VNG and the Jeugdsportfonds.
Encouraging sport and exercise is primarily a local responsibility.
Het stimuleren van sporten en bewegen is primair een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Kuzu over het artikel ‘screen op resistente bacteriën’

MPs Van Dekken and Kuzu asked the health minister whether the Netherlands is sufficiently prepared against emerging resistant bacteria, including ESBL-like ones such as Oxa-48, NDM-1 and KPC, and about periodic screening and new antibiotic development. The minister replied that antibiotic resistance is a government priority, referred to a letter of 2 July 2013 on the policy, and announced expanded surveillance including nationwide ISIS-AR and a molecular monitoring system.
Antwoord vragen Kerstens en Kuzu over stijgende bewindvoerderskosten ten laste van de bijzondere bijstand

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary about rising court-appointed administrator costs (beschermingsbewind) consuming municipal special assistance budgets. The government confirmed the rise is mostly driven by more people placed under administration, said it is analysing the signals with VNG, Divosa and NVVK, and pointed to a pending bill giving municipalities power to request administration orders.
We are currently analysing the various signals received. On that basis it will be examined whether and what actions or research are needed.
Momenteel analyseren we de verschillende ontvangen signalen. Aan de hand daarvan zal bekeken worden of en zo ja welke acties of onderzoek nodig zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuzu over de toename van betalingsachterstanden bij zorgverzekeraars
