MPs Bouwmeester and Kuzu asked about rising payment arrears at health insurers, the stable number of around 300,000 registered defaulters, timely removal from the defaulter scheme, and whether insurers should be obliged to offer instalment plans and prevention. Minister Schippers answered that payment plans are a positive result of the defaulter law, committed to a bill tightening the scheme, but declined to disclose insurer-level figures on commercial-sensitivity grounds and rejected mandatory proactive instalment offers.
A breakdown of these figures by health insurer cannot be provided, as it concerns business information sensitive to the health insurers.
Een uitsplitsing van deze aantallen naar zorgverzekeraar kan ik u niet verstrekken, aangezien het hier gaat om voor de zorgverzekeraars gevoelige bedrijfsinformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Van Dekken over stijgend aantal kinderen dat in armoede opgroeit

Two MPs (PvdA) asked the state secretary about the rising number of children growing up in poverty and what measures the government takes, including ring-fencing poverty funds, regional differences and the municipal participation ordinance. The state secretary answered that poverty policy is mainly a municipal task, listed existing measures, declined to earmark funds, and said the ordinance will be evaluated after two years.
Poverty reduction is primarily a task for municipalities.
Armoedebestrijding is primair een taak voor gemeenten.
Antwoord vragen Kuzu over een tekort aan opvangplekken voor dakloze gezinnen

MPs Kuzu and Ypma asked about a shortage of shelter places for homeless families, families being turned away, mixing with psychiatric or addicted people, daytime access, and whether a plan of action is needed. Secretary of State Van Rijn said the situation is undesirable in places, that data is lacking and monitoring is commissioned, that preventive measures are preferred over a separate plan of action, and that he will inform parliament before summer.
Neither the VNG nor the Federatie Opvang, the umbrella organisation of shelter institutions, knows how many families have become homeless over the past five years or how many are on a waiting list.

Bij de VNG en bij de Federatie Opvang, de koepelorganisatie van de instellingen voor maatschappelijke opvang, is niet bekend hoeveel gezinnen de afgelopen vijf jaar dakloos zijn geraakt en hoeveel er op een wachtlijst staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over ontspoorde verslavingszorg

The MP asks whether the minister is aware of reports that addiction care is out of control: new providers billing high-intensity categories, a lack of volume caps, admissions not medically necessary, and unqualified therapists. The minister answers that insurers must check billing, that the 2012 agreements and a bed reduction target apply, and promises a risk analysis on fraud in mental health care including addiction care, with results later that year.
It is up to health insurers to check whether these claims are justified and whether the care provided is efficient.
Het is aan zorgverzekeraars om na te gaan of deze declaraties terecht zijn en of de geleverde zorg doelmatig is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuzu over de werkwijze van de IGZ

MPs Bouwmeester and Kuzu asked the state secretary about the Health Inspectorate's (IGZ) supervision of nursing homes after a broadcast in which staff said their complaints were ignored, including whether unannounced visits and transparency of reports could be improved. The state secretary defended the IGZ's risk-based approach, stated that a third of general inspection visits are unannounced, noted that all general and thematic reports are published, and said a policy response to two external reports will follow.
The inspectorate publishes all reports from its general and thematic supervision in elderly care on its website.
De inspectie maakt alle rapporten van haar algemene toezicht en thematisch toezicht in de ouderenzorg openbaar op haar website.
Antwoord vragen Kuzu over het geen doorgang vinden van het Landelijk Informatiesysteem Schulden (LIS)

Kuzu (PvdA) asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether the withdrawal of the Dutch Banking Association from the national debt registration project (LIS/ViP) means the initiative is dead, and what steps were taken since the July 2012 letter, including a pilot said to be approved by the Data Protection Authority. The State Secretary regretted the banks' decision, described the pilot intentions and the January 2013 meeting where the LIS partners ended their initiative, and said she intends to explore other options for early warning of problem debts.
I intend to talk with the parties involved to explore whether there are other options for arriving at a system of early warning.
Ik ben voornemens om met betrokken partijen in gesprek te gaan om te verkennen of er andere mogelijkheden zijn om tot een systeem van vroegsignalering te komen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuzu en Jadnanansing over de aandacht van scholen voor het omgaan met geld door jongeren

MPs Kuzu and Jadnanansing asked whether young people lack financial self-reliance and how schools and government address responsible money management. The State Secretary answered that core objectives in primary and secondary education cover consumer self-reliance and budgeting, leaving school-level implementation to schools and declining to direct schools to use specific Nibud lesson packages.
It is not for the government to encourage schools to use certain lesson packages.
Het is niet aan de overheid scholen te stimuleren bepaalde lespakketten te gebruiken.
Antwoord vragen Kuzu en Bouwmeester over het vooraf betalen van het eigen risico in de bijstand

MPs Kuzu and Bouwmeester asked whether it is acceptable that Agis collects the compulsory deductible monthly in advance from welfare recipients in Amersfoort, whether the minister will intervene, and whether the refund timing is fair. Minister Schippers replied that the collective scheme is voluntary, that municipalities and insurers may agree such arrangements, that refunds come by end 2014 because care billing lags, and that she sees no reason to intervene.
I see no reason for further consultation with ZN and the VNG, because the arrangement is voluntary.
Ik zie geen reden tot nader overleg met ZN en de VNG, omdat de regeling op vrijwillige basis is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Voortman over de acties in de verpleeghuiszorg van 3 november jl

MPs Kuzu, Leijten and Voortman asked whether care provider Amsta received intensification funds for extra staff yet did not hire them, and questioned executive pay and strike-related measures. The state secretary answered that Amsta received about 4.1 million euros, reported on its use via a progress report, and that the government does not intend to request an overview from each institution; he also stated the right to strike is not in question.
Beyond the oversight of the care office, I monitor the progress of the realisation of the extra funds at macro level.
Naast het toezicht van het zorgkantoor monitor ik op macroniveau de voortgang van de realisatie van de extra middelen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kuzu en Bouwmeester over tekort aan allochtone medisch specialisten

MPs Kuzu and Bouwmeester asked the health minister about the underrepresentation of doctors with non-Western backgrounds among medical specialists, and whether selection for specialist training is biased, including by age. Minister Schippers answered that ethnicity is not registered by law so the claims cannot be verified, that selection is the responsibility of the medical specialty societies, and that age limits are legally restricted unless objectively justified.
Because registering ethnicity is not legally permitted, it is unknown whether the cited percentages are correct.
Daar registratie van etniciteit wettelijk niet is toegestaan, is onbekend of genoemde percentages correct zijn.

requests the government to remove the existing exception in Article 45d, second paragraph, of the Copyright Act on a proportionate and fair remuneration for video on demand

requests the government to ensure that working young disabled persons may keep extras of at least 1,200 euro per year

requests the government to amend the law so that employees with a work disability obtain the same financial benefit

requests the government to come with concrete improvements and adjustments in the future budget, annual report and VWS monitor

to involve the safeguarding of privacy in the evaluation and also to involve the Dutch Data Protection Authority in the evaluation
om de borging van privacy te betrekken bij de evaluatie en tevens de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens te betrekken bij de evaluatie

Asks the government to propose structural compensation to municipalities for the new duty to act on every signal of payment arrears, in the 2021 budget.
to make a proposal in the 2021 budget to structurally compensate municipalities for this
om bij de begroting voor 2021 een voorstel te doen om gemeenten hiervoor structureel te compenseren

requests the government, if the present initiative law is adopted, to evaluate the law's effectiveness and feasibility after two years
verzoekt de regering, indien onderhavige initiatiefwet wordt aangenomen, om de effectiviteit en uitvoerbaarheid van de wet na twee jaar te evalueren
Amendement van het lid Bruins c.s. t.v.v. nr. 8 over budget voor het creëren van baankansen voor kwetsbare jongeren uit het VSO en PrO

MPs Smeulders and Renkema asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that non-home workers feel unsafe at work and fear COVID-19 infection, and what the government will do to ensure safe work, including inspection capacity and enforcement. An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Social Affairs how many Wajong beneficiaries have lost income despite the guaranteed amount, why this was not examined earlier, and whether beneficiaries can choose their reference period and when they will learn their guaranteed amount. The minister acknowledges the signals, commits to an urgent UWV analysis and to informing parliament, rejects a self-chosen reference period as unworkable, and gives a timeline that delays guaranteed-amount decisions for self-employed beneficiaries until at least 2022.
I take the signals we receive about deterioration seriously. That is why I am now conducting an urgent analysis with UWV into the reasons why Wajongers are losing income.
Ik neem de signalen die we ontvangen over achteruitgang serieus. Daarom voer ik nu met UWV met urgentie een analyse uit naar de redenen waarom Wajongers er op achteruitgaan.

In spring 2021 I will receive a progress letter from the Zorginstituut on the transition trajectory for the system advice on physiotherapy and exercise therapy.

De redenen voor de uitval worden niet onderzocht.

Ik zie op basis van het voorgaande geen noodzaak in het wettelijk verplicht stellen van een vertrouwenspersoon.

One of the first concrete results of the Special Envoy's efforts is that the company Roche has made the recipe available to the government.
Eén van de eerste concrete resultaten van de inzet van de Speciaal Gezant is dat de firma Roche het recept ter beschikking heeft gesteld aan de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over ontwikkelingen op het dossier BUIG, bekostiging bijstandsuitkeringen en uitspraak Centrale Raad van Beroep

MP Renkema (GroenLinks) asked why Utrecht and The Hague are returning to court over 2015 social assistance budget allocations, why arbitration was not pursued, and how the BUIG budget model and surpluses/deficits for municipalities are handled. The State Secretary answered that SZW recalculated 2015 budgets for four municipalities using the 2017 model as basis, that the model is objective and rewards effective municipalities, and that structural solutions for the wider social domain are being pursued via further talks.
It is therefore up to the CRvB to give the final judgment in these cases.
Het is daarmee aan de CRvB om het uiteindelijke oordeel te geven in deze zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge en Renkema over maatregelen tegen het Coronavirus in mbo-instellingen

MPs Van den Berge and Renkema asked why mbo vocational schools were not advised to move all non-essential activities online or cancel them, given student work in care settings and the approach taken for higher education. The minister replied that from 15 March until 6 April no on-site teaching occurs in mbo and other schools, that online teaching is used where possible, and that schools were asked to prioritise final-year students and the Cabinet is assessing consequences for individual students.
Currently the cabinet is inventorying the further consequences of COVID-19, including the consequences for individual students.
Momenteel inventariseert het kabinet de verdere gevolgen van COVID-19, waaronder de gevolgen voor individuele studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over de televisie-uitzending van Rambam ‘Heel Holland coacht’

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Health and Social Affairs about a rise in self-described coaches, the lack of self-regulation and a possible national quality register for coaches, citing professional concern about a 'wildgroei'. The government replied that coaching is not a protected profession or part of mental health care, so it declines to judge the sector or take on a regulatory role, pointing responsibility to the profession and clients.
Coach is not a protected profession and not a function within (mental) health care.
Coach is geen beschermd beroep en geen functie binnen de (geestelijke) gezondheidszorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema, Smeulders, Westerveld en Özütok over het coronavirus (COVID-19)

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about its whole-of-government approach to COVID-19, equipment and ICU capacity, school decisions, Caribbean Netherlands coordination, economic measures like part-time unemployment benefit, accessibility of public communication, and intensified publicity. The minister answered that broad measures are in place, outlined capacity expansions and procurement steps, and committed to letters on decision-making and a school decision framework.
During the debate of Thursday 5 March I committed to inform you about this by letter.
Ik heb tijdens het debat van donderdag 5 maart toegezegd u hierover per brief te informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Buitenweg over het interview ‘Politiechef Anja Schouten: Er moet een eerste hulp bij onbegrepen gedrag komen’ en het opinieartikel ‘Laat de politiegeen zorgtaken uitvoeren’

GroenLinks MPs Renkema and Buitenweg asked the state secretary for Health and the Justice minister about police chief Schouten's call for a first-aid response to 'confused behaviour' (E33 reports) and an op-ed against police doing care tasks. The government answered that the problem is multi-faceted and needs regional, personalised solutions, reported E33 incident counts for 2011–2019, and declined to adopt a national model or a mandatory crisis-point in every region.
A single national approach would also not do justice to the complexity of the problem and would leave insufficient room for local customisation.
Eén landelijke aanpak zou ook geen recht doen aan de complexiteit van de problematiek en onvoldoende ruimte bieden voor lokaal maatwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden de leden Westerveld, Renkema en Futselaar over het rapport van WOinActie ‘Inventarisatie omvang en gevolgen van structureel overwerk aan de Nederlandse universiteiten’

Three opposition MPs asked the government about a WOinActie report on structural unpaid overtime at Dutch universities, including whether it is lawful, the government's responsibility, job insecurity and workload causes. The minister answered that the Inspectie SZW will examine the complaints in its planned inspections of the 14 universities, that the Wml, Atw and Arbowet set the legal limits, and that she will press institutions and VSNU on permanent contracts and workload reduction.
It is up to the Inspectie SZW to investigate whether this is indeed the case.
Het is aan de Inspectie SZW om te onderzoeken of dit inderdaad het geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over het bericht 'Altrecht schrapt therapie voor zware psychiatrische aandoening: Charlotte (26) moet nu wéér wachten'

MP Renkema asks the State Secretary about Altrecht closing its trauma centre and dissociative disorder therapy due to staff shortages, leaving patients on waiting lists, and about accessibility of specialist mental health care and market effects. The State Secretary answers that Altrecht lacks expertise to continue the therapy, that patients received continuity plans, that a shortage of mental health staff exists, and that insurers and providers must submit a plan within four weeks to secure high-specialist capacity.
I have agreed with the health insurers and care providers that they will deliver their plan within four weeks.
Ik heb met de zorgverzekeraars en de zorgaanbieders afgesproken dat zij binnen vier weken hun plan opleveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Regterschot en Renkema over het manifest van Lijm de Zorg

MPs Regterschot and Renkema asked the state secretary about the Lijm de Zorg manifesto on mental health care gaps, number of stranded patients, the Arkin deregulation experiment, a central reporting number and the evaluation of the Wvggz. The state secretary answered that a plan for complex-care capacity is due by 4 March, outlined steps including national rollout of simplified activity codes, a central number by 1 July 2020, and an evaluation of the Wvggz within two years, while admitting no precise count of stranded persons is kept.
I have asked health insurers and care providers to come up with a plan to secure care provision for the highly complex target group.
Ik heb zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders gevraagd met een plan te komen om het zorgaanbod voor de hoogcomplexe doelgroep te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Renkema over het AO 'Vliegen over Conflictgebieden'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked who decides on suspending flights to China, whether it is right that airlines make that call commercially, what information airlines use, the roles of the UK and German governments, when the Dutch state could suspend flights, whether KLM cut mainly unsold flights, and whether arriving passengers can be medically screened. The Minister answered that airlines decide under advice from RIVM, WHO, EU and ICAO and the foreign ministry travel advice, that the Minister of Medical Care could impose targeted emergency measures under the Public Health Act but no flight-ban is warranted now, and that entry screening is not effective.
Transport permits that airlines hold under aviation treaties can only be withdrawn when operators do not comply with national rules on the admission, stay and departure of passengers and cargo.

Vervoerstoestemmingen die luchtvaartmaatschappijen op grond van de luchtvaartverdragen hebben, kunnen alleen worden ingetrokken wanneer exploitanten de nationale voorschriften voor de toelating, verblijf en vertrek van passagiers en vracht niet opvolgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Renkema over berichten dat kwetsbare ouderen en mensen met een beperking verstoken zijn van huisartsenzorg

MPs Slootweg and Renkema asked about reports that frail elderly people and people with disabilities lack GP care, including the role of specialist elderly care physicians and physicians for people with intellectual disabilities and the cost-sharing rules. The minister answered that consultation with parties is ongoing toward a convenant, that the NZa is conducting a quickscan of contracting problems, and that GP care is not subject to the insurance deductible by design, while committing to further follow-up.
I have now asked the NZa to map, with a quickscan, the experiences with contracting SOs and AVGs in primary care.
Ik heb inmiddels de NZa gevraagd om met een quickscan de ervaringen met de contractering van de SO en de AVG in de eerste lijn in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Renkema over het rapport ‘Beleidsscan VN-Verdrag handicap’ van de NVRR?

MPs Özütok and Renkema asked ministers about the NVRR report on municipal implementation of the UN Disability Convention, including why most municipalities lag, the lack of attention to women with disabilities, national implementation steps, and the convention's status in the Caribbean and Kingdom countries. The minister answered that municipalities face challenges, that the VNG project 'Iedereen doet mee' and the 'Onbeperkt Meedoen!' programme are underway, that the NVRR did not investigate the cause regarding women, and that the convention awaits implementing legislation in Caribbean Netherlands and has not been ratified by the other Kingdom countries.
The NVRR did not investigate the cause of why municipalities pay no particular attention to the position of women with disabilities.
De NVRR heeft niet onderzocht wat de oorzaak is waarom gemeenten geen bijzondere aandacht besteden aan de positie van vrouwen met een beperking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Renkema over "de bureaucratie rondom het aanvragen van de dubbele kinderbijslag"

GroenLinks MPs asked the state secretary about bureaucracy in applying for double child benefit for intensive care, including repeat applications and possible simplification. The secretary reported application and appeal figures, said a follow-up study is underway with results due before summer 2020, and committed to simplifying the process if feasible.
I am in favour of simplifying processes, especially when this relieves citizens of burdens.
Ik ben een voorstander van vereenvoudiging van processen, zeker als burgers hiermee ontlast worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Westerveld over het bericht dat sommige jongeren niet kunnen studeren omdat zij dakloos zijn

GroenLinks MPs asked whether homeless young people are excluded from education, how many cannot study or lack a startkwalificatie, where they can get help, and about schuldsanering and student loan barriers. The government replied that lack of a registered address is no bar to enrolment, that no national figures exist on homeless youth without qualifications, that municipalities coordinate support, and pointed to existing action programmes and schuldhulp measures.
DUO does not register who has no fixed residential or residence address.
DUO registreert niet wie er geen vaste woon- of verblijfsplaats heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Ellemeet over de ingezonden brandbrief in het NRC van 67 zorgprofessionals ‘Laten we de duurste ziekte aanpakken – dementie’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister about a open letter from 67 care professionals urging greater focus on preventing dementia, including claims about lifestyle-related risk and possible savings. The minister acknowledged the letter, said prevention is part of existing programmes and the Nationaal Preventieakkoord, and declined to make a sugar tax a priority while offering to talk with the initiators.
We are, however, willing to enter into discussion with the initiators.
Wel zijn wij bereid met de initiatiefnemers het gesprek aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over het bericht ‘Familiedrama in Winschoten: 'Ze belde 113, maar dat nummer bestaat helemaal niet'

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretary whether the confusing 113 suicide-prevention number, which cannot be reached by dialling 1-1-3, contributed to a family tragedy in Winschoten and why 0900-0113 was chosen. The state secretary answered that the organisation is in talks with the ministry on a short-term fix such as redirecting callers, explained the historical reasons for the number, and promised a further letter to parliament.
I am now in discussion with the Ministry of EZK to take action on this and to adjust the message for now into a clear referral or redirection to the correct number.
Ik ben inmiddels met het Ministerie van EZK in gesprek om hier actie op te ondernemen en de melding vooralsnog aan te passen in een duidelijke verwijzing of doorschakeling naar het juiste nummer
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over het bericht 'Rotterdamse rechter passeert Participatiewet'

An MP asked the State Secretary whether a court's binding debt arrangement (dwangakkoord) overriding a municipality's refusal to participate in a voluntary debt settlement is undesirable, and whether the Participatiewet should be changed. The State Secretary answered that such cases are not tracked, that the court appropriately weighs interests case by case, that the Participatiewet requires full repayment of fraudulent benefits, and that no law change is needed.
It is not tracked how often situations like this occur.
Het wordt niet bijgehouden hoe vaak situaties als deze voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over het bericht 'Daklozenopvang in nood: opnamestop bij Leger des Heils'

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about a reported reception stop at Leger des Heils in Amsterdam, rising homelessness, and whether shelter capacity and ambulant care are adequate. The state secretary confirmed the stop was temporary and lifted by the Amsterdam council, cited existing reports, and described ongoing work with municipalities and national programmes without committing to a new national intervention.
I consider this an adequate solution to the situation that had arisen.
Ik vind dit een adequate oplossing voor de situatie die was ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over het Vertrouwensexperiment bijstand Tilburg

An MP asked whether the Tilburg welfare trust experiment's early positive results are known, whether they will be shared, and whether experiments will be extended and expanded to other municipalities. The State Secretary replied that interim results will not be published to protect the scientific evaluation, that the experiments run until 1 October 2019 with a proposed three-month extension, and that a final report with conclusions will be sent to Parliament by 1 May 2020.
For this reason it is desirable not to publish provisional, interim results.
Hiertoe is het wenselijk om geen voorlopige, tussentijdse resultaten naar buiten te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over een aangenomen resolutie door de VN-Mensenrechtenraad

The MP asks whether the government will act on a UN Human Rights Council resolution calling for full implementation of the UN Children's Rights Convention and whether it will lift its reservation on article 26. The minister says the resolution is non-binding, the government awaits a UN treaty-body evaluation before deciding on optional protocols, and it sees no reason to lift the reservation because the child's social security right is derivative of parents' entitlements.
I therefore see no reason to lift the reservation.
Ik zie derhalve geen reden om het voorbehoud op te heffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over het rapport ‘Psychiaters in GGZ-instellingen: Arbeidsmarktonderzoek NVvP-LAD’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Health about a labour market report on psychiatrists in mental health institutions, concerning the attractiveness of employment versus self-employment, rising workload for employed psychiatrists, and government action. The State Secretary answered that employee and self-employed numbers are both rising, that self-employment is not inherently undesirable, that the government will work through the Hoofdlijnenakkoord ggz with partners and include the report's recommendations.
I will include the recommendations from this report in the elaboration of these agreements.
Ik zal de aanbevelingen uit dit rapport meenemen in de uitwerking van deze afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Kröger en Renkema over het rapport ‘Last Gasp: The coal companies making Europe sick’

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about a report attributing 231 premature deaths in Europe to emissions from Dutch coal plants, and asked whether the two oldest plants should close by 2020, whether the Clean Air Accord covers this, whether Germany's RWE should be pressed, and whether RIVM should study health effects further. The minister acknowledged the findings, pointed to a planned legal ban on coal for electricity by 2029 (2024 for the oldest plants), said the Clean Air Accord considers power-sector emissions, reported intensified dialogue with Germany, and declined extra RIVM research.
The cabinet aims for a permanent improvement of air quality, so as to reduce health risks from air pollution.
Het kabinet streeft naar een permanente verbetering van de luchtkwaliteit, om zo te komen tot een vermindering van gezondheidsrisico's door luchtverontreiniging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent, Smeulders, Renkema en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat de distributiecentra van Picnic niet veilig zijn

MPs from SP, GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports of high workload, unsafe equipment and poor pay at online supermarket Picnic, including whether the Inspectorate SZW would investigate, whether its risk assessment was in order, and whether it should fall under the supermarket collective agreement. The Minister answered that employers are responsible for safe work and workload, that the Inspectorate acts on complaints and risk-based priorities without commenting on specific investigations, that no company collective agreement is registered for Picnic and interpreting the scope of sector agreements is for the social partners, and that the government is taking measures against competition on labour conditions.
No statements are made about whether the Inspectorate SZW is conducting an investigation or not.
Er worden geen uitlatingen gedaan of de Inspectie SZW al dan niet onderzoek doet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Smeulders over het bericht dat jonge gehandicapten geregeld geen uitkering krijgen terwijl ze er wel recht op hebben

MPs Renkema and Smeulders asked about a report that young disabled people are often denied a Wajong benefit they are entitled to, and about a UWV internal study finding wrong conclusions in 21% of files. The State Secretary answered that the study could not confirm incorrect outcomes with certainty, that UWV introduced retraining and quality controls, that the 2018 risk fell to 7%, and that the internal report was not shared with the ministry.
The internal study report in question was not provided to me for information at the time.
Het bewuste interne onderzoeksrapport is destijds niet ter informatie aan mij aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet, Özütok en Renkema over #metoo in de culturele sector

MPs from GroenLinks asked the minister about a survey showing that 45% of respondents in the cultural sector experienced sexual misconduct, low reporting rates, and dissatisfaction with complaint handling, and what the government would do. The minister shared concern, said the sector is primarily responsible, pointed to employer duties under the Arbowet and Inspectie SZW enforcement, and committed to a meeting with stakeholders on 20 December before deciding on any measures.
I will meet with stakeholders on 20 December. Depending on this conversation and any follow-up conversations, I will look into whether I will take measures.
Ik ga op 20 december met betrokkenen in gesprek. Afhankelijk van dit gesprek en eventuele vervolggesprekken zal ik kijken of ik maatregelen ga treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Ellemeet over de problematiek rondom (chronische) Lyme

MPs Renkema and Ellemeet asked the minister about Lyme disease: patient concerns, prevention, recognition and diagnosis, co-infections, treatment of chronic patients, and whether the Health Council should be asked for new advice. The minister answers that research and patient involvement are ongoing, that prevention and GP training exist, and that a new Health Council advice will await results of the NLe research expected in a few years.
On the basis of the outcomes I want to formulate a new request for advice.
Op basis van de uitkomsten wil ik een nieuwe adviesvraag formuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Westerveld over de uitzending van Radar over online kindermarketing

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about online child marketing of unhealthy food shown on Radar, including influencer reach, YouTube disclosure rules and the Jongeren Op Gezond Gewicht programme. The government acknowledged the concern, said it will annually monitor compliance with the food advertising code including social media, and will discuss the results with industry and the Alliantie Stop Kindermarketing.
I will conduct annual research into compliance with these agreements and will explicitly include the influence of social media in it.
Ik zal jaarlijks onderzoek doen naar de naleving van deze afspraken en zal de invloed van sociale media hierin nadrukkelijk meenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Jasper van Dijk over "vingerscan-affaire in Spijkenisse"

MPs Renkema and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the illegal collection of welfare recipients' fingerprints in Spijkenisse, the reversal of sanctions, and the treatment of claimants as criminals were acceptable. The State Secretary called fingerprint scanning undesirable and contrary to privacy law, said the practice had ended and the AP was responsible for enforcement, and left sanction disputes to the courts.
Scanning and collecting fingerprints of welfare recipients to check their attendance at a work company is, in my view, undesirable and moreover contrary to the applicable privacy legislation.

Het scannen en verzamelen van vingerafdrukken van bijstandsgerechtigden ter controle van hun aanwezigheid bij een werkbedrijf acht ik onwenselijk en bovendien in strijd met de geldende privacywetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over het Health Behaviour in School-aged Children-onderzoek; het rapport over het welzijn en de gezondheid van Nederlandse jongeren (11-16 jaar)

An MP asked the state secretary about the decline in condom use among young people and the HBSC report on youth health, including falling sexual health knowledge and the end of the Vrij Veilig campaigns. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, pointed to schools, a seven-point plan and a planned campaign on contraceptive use, but did not commit to reinstating the Vrij Veilig campaign.
Furthermore, I want to inform various target groups through a campaign about conscious contraceptive use.
Daarnaast wil ik door middel van een campagne diverse doelgroepen gaan informeren over bewust anticonceptiegebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over "uitkeringsfraude"

An MP from GroenLinks asks the state secretary for Social Affairs about a university study finding that a hard enforcement approach to benefit fraud may increase fraud, and about the harm to trust between benefit recipients, social services and government. The state secretary answers that she supports effective enforcement, is studying the 'slimmer handhaven' research, stresses respectful treatment and personal contact, and says the rules are regularly reviewed with stakeholders while pointing to a 2017 change in the Fraudewet allowing more tailored sanctions.

To gain more insight into what does and does not work in enforcement with the ultimate aim of promoting compliance, the Rijksuniversiteit Groningen research on 'smarter enforcement' is also being taken under consideration and studied further by SZW.

Om meer zicht te krijgen op wat wel en niet werkt in de handhaving met als uiteindelijke doel naleving te bevorderen, wordt ook het onderzoek van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen over «slimmer handhaven» 5 door SZW in beraad genomen en verder bestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Renkema over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraar Menzis de behandeling van depressies voortaan vergoedt op basis van de resultaten

MPs Ellemeet and Renkema asked whether Menzis paying for depression treatment partly on outcomes risks undertreatment, patient selection and administrative burden, and whether the government would discourage it. The state secretary supports outcome-based payment in principle, says the patient group is limited to milder cases with no 'no cure, no pay', and rejects discouraging the contracts, while noting ROM measurement debates and promising monitoring with patient organisations.
I therefore do not intend to discourage this type of agreement.
Ik ben daarom niet van plan om dit type afspraken te ontmoedigen.

m: Motie van de leden Kerstens en Çegerek over optimaal benutten van mensen met afstand tot de arbeidsmarkt en regionale werkgelegenheid
Asks the government to ensure that within the national circular economy programme, opportunities for people far from the labour market and regional employment are optimally used.
requests the government to ensure that within the nationwide circular economy programme the opportunities for people at a distance from the labour market
verzoekt de regering, er zorg voor te dragen dat binnen het rijksbrede programma circulaire economie de kansen voor mensen met afstand tot de arbeidsmarkt
Motie van het lid Çegerek c.s. over het ondersteunen van het project Smart Delta Resources
Asks the government to explore how to support the Smart Delta Resources circular economy project through the national circular economy programme.
requests the government to explore the possibilities to support the Smart Delta Resources project
verzoekt de regering, te verkennen wat de mogelijkheden zijn om het project Smart Delta Resources te ondersteunen
Motie van het lid Çegerek c.s. over het Actieplan Luchtkwaliteit breder inzetten dan alleen in Rotterdam en Amsterdam
Asks government to extend the air quality action plan beyond Rotterdam and Amsterdam, aiming at WHO guideline values.
requests the government to deploy the Air Quality Action Plan more broadly than only in Rotterdam and Amsterdam
verzoekt de regering om, het Actieplan Luchtkwaliteit breder in te zetten dan alleen in de steden Rotterdam en Amsterdam
Motie van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Çegerek over het wegnemen van belemmeringen voor ondernemers in het mkb en voor start-ups
Asks the government to support SMEs and start-ups by removing barriers and informing the House about this.
requests the government to support SMEs and start-ups by removing barriers, and to inform the House about this
verzoekt de regering, ondernemers in het midden- en kleinbedrijf en start-ups te ondersteunen door belemmeringen weg te nemen, en de Kamer daarover te informeren
Motie van het lid Van Veldhoven c.s. over een nationaal luchtplan
Asks the government, with provinces and municipalities, to prepare a national air plan aimed at health-based clean air standards by 2018.
requests the government, together with provinces and municipalities, to consult in 2017 with the aim of presenting a national air plan in 2018
verzoekt de regering, samen met provincies en gemeenten in 2017 overleg te voeren met als doel in 2018 te komen met een nationaal luchtplan

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Çegerek ter vervanging van nr. 6 dat regelt dat het bevoegd gezag door middel van een beschrijving van de werkprocessen en procedures vastlegt hoe het zorg draagt voor
Requires the competent authority to document in work processes how it ensures proper separation of functions when it is also the project initiator under environmental impact assessment rules.
The competent authority records in a description of work processes and procedures how it ensures proper separation as referred to in the first paragraph
Het bevoegd gezag legt de wijze waarop het zorg draagt voor een passende scheiding als bedoeld in het eerste lid vast in een beschrijving van de werkprocessen en procedures
Amendement van het lid Çegerek dat de commissie m.e.r. in de gelegenheid stelt om advies uit te brengen over het milieueffectrapport indien het bevoegd gezag zelf de activiteit wil ondernemen

Requires that the Commissie m.e.r. be given the chance to advise on the environmental impact report whenever the competent authority is itself the initiator of the activity, to ensure independent oversight.
gives the commission the opportunity to advise on the environmental impact report if the competent authority itself wishes to undertake the activity
stelt de commissie in de gelegenheid advies uit te brengen over het milieueffectrapport, indien het bevoegd gezag zelf de activiteit wil ondernemen

Amendement van het lid Monasch c.s. dat regelt dat een centrale aanbestedende dienst niet alleen ingeval wordt gegund op grond van de laagste prijs, maar ook in het geval dat wordt gegund op grond van

Amends the public procurement law so contracting authorities may award on lowest cost based on cost-effectiveness with justification, and must give greater weight to social, environmental and innovation criteria in best price-quality awards.
the contracting authority that determines the most economically advantageous tender on best price-quality ratio always sets social, environmental and innovation criteria

de centrale aanbestedende dienst die de economisch meest voordelige inschrijving vaststelt op basis van de beste prijs-kwaliteitverhouding, altijd het nadere criterium sociale, milieu- en innovatieve kenmerken stelt
Motie van de leden Çegerek en Remco Dijkstra over onderzoek naar een kennisbank voor grondstoffen
Asks the government to investigate whether a central raw-materials knowledge bank could help the circular economy by advising and assisting businesses.
requests the government to investigate whether a raw-materials knowledge bank can serve to promote the circular economy
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken of een kennisbank voor grondstoffen kan dienen om de circulaire economie te bevorderen
Motie van de leden Çegerek en Van Veldhoven over 10% circulair inkopen door de overheid
Asks the government to aim for 10% of public procurement to be circular.
requests the government to aim to procure 10% circularly
verzoekt de regering, ernaar te streven om 10% circulair in te kopen
Motie van de leden Çegerek en Van Tongeren over stapsgewijs toewerken naar een steeds gezondere luchtkwaliteit
Asks the government to draw up a plan for stepwise improvement of air quality after the NSL ends in 2017, with sufficient RIVM budget for monitoring.
requests the government to draw up a plan aimed at stepwise progress towards ever better air quality
verzoekt de regering, een plan op te stellen waarbij stapsgewijs toegewerkt wordt naar een steeds betere luchtkwaliteit
Motie van de leden Çegerek en Remco Dijkstra over een overkoepelend programma voor de circulaire economie
Asks the government to create one overarching programme for the circular economy before the committee debate.
requests the government, before the committee debate on the circular economy, to arrive at one overarching programme for the circular economy
verzoekt de regering, voor het algemeen overleg Circulaire economie te komen tot één overkoepelend programma voor de circulaire economie
Motie van de leden Van Veldhoven en Çegerek over een geïntegreerd grondstoffenakkoord
Asks the government to explore with stakeholders an integrated raw materials agreement on the circular economy and to inform the House.
requests the government to explore, with the named parties, concluding an integrated Raw Materials Agreement
verzoekt de regering, met genoemde partijen het sluiten van een geïntegreerd Grondstoffenakkoord te verkennen
Motie van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Cegerek over evaluatie van de Wet algemene bepalingen omgevingsrecht

Motion asking the government to evaluate the Wet algemene bepalingen omgevingsrecht before entry into force and feed recommendations into the Omgevingswet bill, then start a five-yearly evaluation cycle.
requests the government to evaluate the new Wet algemene bepalingen omgevingsrecht before entry into force
verzoekt de regering, de nieuwe Wet algemene bepalingen omgevingsrecht voor inwerkingtreding te evalueren
Amendement van de leden Çegerek en Remco Dijkstra dat regelt dat de evaluatie eenmaal in de twee jaar plaatsvindt
Amendment shortening the interval between evaluations of quality criteria for regional enforcement services from every three years to every two years.
in Article 5.6, first paragraph, 'every three years' is replaced by 'every two years'
wordt in artikel 5.6, eerste lid, «iedere drie jaar» vervangen door: iedere twee jaar
Motie van het lid Çegerek c.s. over inruilen van tweetaktscooters voor elektrische scooters
Asks the government to use existing schemes to encourage entrepreneurs to switch to electric scooters and to find ways to stimuli private owners to trade in two-stroke scooters.
also requests the government to look for ways to encourage private individuals to trade in two-stroke scooters for electric scooters
verzoekt de regering tevens om, te zoeken naar mogelijkheden om particulieren te stimuleren tweetaktscooters in te laten ruilen voor elektrische scooters
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Çegerek en Remco Dijkstra ter vervanging van nr. 17 waarmee een bedrag wordt gereserveerd voor de cofinanciering van het opruimen van drugsdumpingen
Amendment moving a sum within the budget from external safety to sustainability to co-finance clean-up of drug waste dumping by municipalities.
With this amendment an amount is reserved under article 21 Sustainability for co-financing the clean-up of drug dumpings.
Met dit amendement wordt in artikel 21 Duurzaamheid een bedrag gereserveerd voor «cofinanciering opruiming drugsdumpingen».
Motie van het lid Çegerek c.s. over een loket circulaire economie
Asks the government to inform the Chamber within six months on circular economy policy and to set up a helpdesk for entrepreneurs.
requests the government to inform the Chamber within half a year about circular economy policy
verzoekt de regering om, binnen een half jaar de Kamer te informeren over het beleid omtrent circulaire economie
Motie van de leden Çegerek en van Veldhoven over mensen met luchtwegaandoeningen
Asks the government to redesign the smog alarm so people with respiratory conditions are warned in time, aligning thresholds with neighbouring countries.
requests the government to shape the smog alarm so that people with respiratory conditions are really warned in time
verzoekt de regering, het smogalarm zodanig vorm te geven dat mensen met luchtwegaandoeningen echt tijdig gewaarschuwd worden
Motie van het lid Ouwehand c.s. over duurzaamheid in het onderwijs
Motion asking the government to study how sustainable development can be integrally facilitated in Dutch education and report back.
requests the government to investigate how sustainable development could be facilitated integrally in Dutch education
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken hoe duurzame ontwikkeling op integrale wijze in het Nederlandse onderwijs gefaciliteerd zou kunnen worden
Motie van de leden Agnes Mulder en Çegerek over gebruik van microplastics in cosmetica
Asks the government to make binding agreements with the cosmetics industry to reduce microplastics to zero, aiming for 2017.
requests the government to make clear binding agreements with the cosmetics sector for the whole sector to reduce microplastic use in cosmetics to zero
verzoekt de regering om, met de cosmeticabranche voor de hele branche duidelijke bindende afspraken te maken om het gebruik van microplastics in cosmetica tot nul te reduceren
Amendement van de leden Çegerek en Remco Dijkstra waarmee 1 miljoen euro wordt vrijgemaakt voor het opruimen van dumpingen van drugsafval
Adds 1 million euro in the budget for co-financing municipal clean-up of illegal drug-waste dumping, with forensic investigation of polluters.
with which dumping of drug waste can be cleaned up
waarmee dumpingen van drugsafval kunnen worden opgeruimd
Motie van de leden Öztürk en Çegerek over een Actieplan Maakindustrie
Asks the government to produce an Action Plan for the manufacturing industry including circular economy opportunities, and to examine using innovation, SME and SZW funds for it.
to come up with an Action Plan for the manufacturing industry and to use the opportunities for the circular economy in this
te komen met een Actieplan Maakindustrie en hierbij ook de kansen voor de circulaire economie te benutten
Motie van het lid Çegerek over afspraken met de NAVO over het structureel maken van de 35% geluidsreductie
Asks the government to agree with NATO that the 35% noise reduction is made structural.
requests the government to make agreements with NATO so that the 35% noise reduction is and remains structural
verzoekt de regering, afspraken te maken met de NAVO zodat de 35% geluidsreductie structureel is en blijft
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Kerstens over de recycling van afgedankte smartphones

MPs Cegerek and Kerstens asked about recycling of discarded smartphones, Greenpeace's call on manufacturers, collection volumes, repair incentives, collection actions and the role of shops, recycling targets, and jobs. The state secretary answered that roughly half of about 900,000 discarded phones yearly are estimated to be recycled through certified channels, that existing producer collection and WEEE targets apply, and that circular-economy measures are under development, with a KPMG jobs study due in 2017.
No recent figures are known for this.
Hier zijn geen recente cijfers van bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het bericht 'Europa dumpt nog steeds schepen op Aziatische sloopstranden'

An MP asked the ministers whether EU-flagged ships are still dumped on Asian beaches, about Dutch participation, the IMVO covenant with the shipping association, and ratification of the Hong Kong Convention. The government rejects the practice, reports a covenant aimed for this year, and says ratification will follow parliamentary approval of the treaty.
Het kabinet keurt deze praktijk af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çegerek, Leenders en Jacobi over de onkostenvergoeding voor de plaatsing van hoogspanningsmasten

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether compensation for high-voltage pylons on farmland differs by period, whether some owners were bought out permanently for small sums, and whether TenneT could harmonise payments nationally. The minister answered that full compensation applies everywhere, that older buy-outs were legally permissible and that the current TenneT system is already applied nationally.
This principle is always and everywhere applied, regardless of the period in which the compensation was agreed.
Dit principe wordt altijd en overal toegepast, onafhankelijk van de periode waarin de schadevergoeding is afgesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over de tekortkomingen bij Brzo-bedrijven (bedrijven die vallen onder het Besluit risico's zware ongevallen)

An MP asked the state secretary about shortcomings at Brzo major-hazard companies following an Onderzoeksraad report on the Odfjell case, including fragmented supervision, uptake of audit tools, supply-chain checks, and publication of inspection reports. The state secretary welcomed the report, pointed to improvements in coordination and voluntary safety-culture measures, and promised to consult all parties and inform the House before summer.
I will therefore consult with all the parties involved about the conclusions of this investigation and the follow-up to this (follow-up) investigation.
Ik ga daarom met alle betrokken partijen in overleg over de conclusies van dit onderzoek en de opvolging van dit (vervolg) onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Dik-Faber, Remco Dijkstra, Ouwehand, Cegerek, Van Veldhoven, Van Tongeren en Geurts over het bericht dat chemiebedrijven de veiligheidsregels schenden

MPs asked the state secretary how to respond to reports that more than half of Dutch major-risk chemical firms repeatedly violated safety rules, including risks to workers and residents in Zaltbommel and how inspections and enforcement work. The state secretary replied that violations fell from 850 to 615 in 2015, that most are light offences, that inspectors act immediately on serious ones, that Zaltbommel is being handled through a planning and permit process, and that repeat offenders face escalated sanctions.
As previously promised, I will send the State of Safety of Major Risk Companies report for 2016 to your House before the summer, including an analysis of regional differences in compliance rates.
Zoals eerder toegezegd, zal ik de Staat van de Veiligheid Majeure Risicobedrijven over 2016 voor de zomer naar uw Kamer sturen inclusief een analyse van regionale verschillen in naleefpercentages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over actie tegen afvalcriminaliteit

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment and the Minister of Security and Justice how waste crime by illegal dumpers is being tackled, including reinstating financial security deposits and escrow accounts. The government says it supports the polluter-pays principle, points to existing enforcement and prosecution tools, is willing to consult provinces and waste sector, but sees no reason yet to reintroduce financial security for these firms and considers escrow measures unsuitable.
Naturally I am willing to take measures if that helps to tackle the problem better, but for now I see no reason to reintroduce financial security for this type of company.

Vanzelfsprekend ben ik bereid om maatregelen te treffen als dat helpt om de problematiek nog beter aan te kunnen pakken, maar vooralsnog zie ik geen reden om financiële zekerheid voor dit type bedrijven opnieuw in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Albert de Vries over de inventarisatie van asbestdaken

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about gaps in municipal inventories of asbestos roofs and what this means for the 2024 removal deadline. The state secretary answered that removal is primarily the owner's responsibility, that municipalities decide whether an inventory is needed, and outlined a programmatic approach with communication tools and financing exploration.
It is not expected that all municipalities will have an asbestos inventory carried out.
Het is niet de verwachting dat alle gemeenten een asbestinventarisatie laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Van Dekken over een ZEMBLA-uitzending over de gezondheidseffecten van rubbergranulaat

MPs Cegerek and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Health and the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment whether a ZEMBLA broadcast on health effects of rubber granulate on sports pitches warranted new measures or a different RIVM advice, and how the tyre industry's norm compares to EU and RIVM norms. The minister answered that the broadcast does not change RIVM's advice that safe use of the pitches is possible, that RIVM will consider the unpublished study once published, and that the industry norm is stricter than the existing EU limits while the government aims to lower it further.
As long as it is not known which substances in which concentrations were found by the VU, RIVM cannot make a statement
Zolang niet bekend is welke stoffen in welke concentraties door de VU zijn aangetroffen, kan het RIVM geen uitspraak doen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Van Dekken over het bericht 'Hoe de lobby het rubber in het gras hield'

MPs Cegerek and Van Dekken asked about press reports on industry lobbying over rubber granulate in artificial turf and whether the Netherlands shifted from treating it as an article to a mixture under REACH. The government answered that it reversed its position to align with the European Commission and most member states, that the health risk to sports users was judged low, and that it did not commit to a new national action beyond pursuing a lower EU norm.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çegerek, Albert de Vries en Vermue over een plan voor een recreatieproject in het Veerse Meer

MPs Çegerek, Albert de Vries and Vermue asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about a large recreational development at the Veerse Dam in a Natura 2000 area, its tension with the Coastal Pact, the land lease agreement signed by the state property agency, and related permit and nitrogen questions. The minister answered that the project falls under the Nature Conservation Act permit regime, that the Coastal Pact will set zones and manage pending initiatives, that the state's role is only assessed at permit stage, and that the municipality council declined an anterior agreement with the initiator.
Ahead of the definitive signing of the Coastal Pact and permit applications, I cannot yet give insight into that.
Vooruitlopend op de definitieve ondertekening van het Kustpact en aanvragen voor vergunningen, kan ik daar nog geen inzage in geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çegerek, Albert de Vries en Jan Vos over het project Brouwerseiland

MPs Cegerek, De Vries and Vos asked the minister whether the Brouwerseiland coastal project fits her earlier stance against building up the coast, and whether she would refuse a derogation under the Barro that would block it. The minister said the Kustpact will set zoning, that the derogation decision will be made carefully under the legal test without pre-judging outcomes, and that local procedures and the municipal council will weigh local views.
I will take a decision on the derogation request as soon as possible, carefully weighing the presence of special circumstances and the national interests to be served.
Ik zal zo spoedig mogelijk een besluit nemen over het ontheffingsverzoek, waarbij ik de aanwezigheid van bijzondere omstandigheden en de te dienen nationale belangen zorgvuldig zal wegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Cegerek over het bericht 'Drie Chinezen blijven over in strijd om Attero'

MPs Nijboer and Cegerek asked about the 2013 sale of waste processor Attero to private equity firm Waterland, including dividends, environmental aftercare obligations and whether the sale price was too low. The state secretary answered that competition supervision applies as for any concentration, environmental aftercare is handled by the provinces, the sale was a decentralised decision, and a Zuidelijke Rekenkamer inquiry is due in May 2017.
The agreements form part of the confidential sale agreement.
De afspraken zijn onderdeel van de vertrouwelijke verkoopovereenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Cegerek over het bericht ‘Maak nieuwe regels voor kunstgraskorrels’

Two MPs asked the State Secretary whether artificial turf rubber granules should fall under stricter consumer PAH limits, and whether a special norm closer to the consumer standard should be set after consulting industry and RIVM. The government answered that EU REACH treats granules as a mixture with a looser limit, that it will push at EU level to lower the limit toward the consumer standard, and that it will continue talks with industry.
The cabinet aims for a source-based approach, in this case the cleanest possible car tyres.
Het kabinet streeft naar een aanpak aan de bron, in dit geval naar zo schoon mogelijke autobanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over de uitspraken van het Europees Milieu Agentschap (EMA) over de luchtkwaliteit in Nederland

An MP asked the state secretary about a European Environment Agency report ranking Dutch air quality poorly and what action would prevent a similar result next year. The state secretary argued the ranking is distorted by monitoring locations, pointed to a declining NO2 trend and the Clean Air Action Plan, and said current projections show the Netherlands meeting the new emission ceilings without extra measures.
With the Clean Air Action Plan a broad package of measures is being deployed to further improve air quality.
Met het Actieplan Luchtkwaliteit wordt een breed maatregelenpakket ingezet om de luchtkwaliteit verder te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Cegerek en Leenders naar aanleiding van berichtgeving over de toename van fijn stof in Zuidoost Brabant

Three PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about press reports that fine particulate matter in south-east Brabant would exceed norms in 2020, asking about health effects, prevention measures and causes. The state secretary acknowledged the forecast exceedance of the daily fine-dust norm in five Brabant municipalities near livestock farms, cited RIVM estimates of about nine months of life-years lost, and described an existing package of measures and an upcoming update on poultry-sector air quality.
You will be informed about this shortly.
U wordt hier binnenkort over geïnformeerd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek, Albert de Vries en Jan Vos over het project Brouwerseiland

MPs Cegerek, Albert de Vries and Jan Vos asked the minister about the Brouwerseiland recreation project, covering Natura 2000 protection, nitrogen limits, the Kustpact, recreation oversupply, noise barriers, displaced recreation and participation. The minister replied that the Barro exemption and Nb-wet permit are handled by the competent authorities, with the Kustpact still pending and remaining decisions left to the province and municipality.

Beyond the national interests named in the Structuurvisie Infrastructuur en Ruimte and the Barro, it is the responsibility of decentralised governments, for good spatial planning, to determine the need for space and weigh it.

Buiten de in de Structuurvisie Infrastructuur en Ruimte en in het Barro benoemde rijksbelangen is het ten behoeve van de goede ruimtelijke ordening de verantwoordelijkheid van de decentrale overheden om de ruimtebehoefte te bepalen en hiervoor een afweging te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Van Dekken over de giftige stoffen in rubbertegels

MPs Cegerek and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Health whether rubber playground tiles containing carcinogenic substances pose a health risk, why no research was done at introduction, which alternatives exist, and when EU limits apply. The minister answered that NVWA considered risks negligible, a RIVM risk assessment is expected early 2017, the current 1 mg/kg PAK limit is precautionary, and further measures will follow if risks are found.
The RIVM is currently working on a risk assessment of the rubber tiles. If it turns out the tiles pose a risk to public health, I will take additional measures.
Het RIVM werkt op dit moment aan een risicobeoordeling van de rubbertegels. Als daar uitkomt dat de tegels een risico vormen voor de volksgezondheid zal ik aanvullende maatregelen treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het bericht dat internationale brandstofbedrijven op grote schaal giftige brandstof via Nederlandse havens naar Afrika exporteren

An MP asked the government about reports that international fuel companies export toxic fuel via Dutch ports to Africa, including exported volumes, air pollution, and whether Dutch and international law is violated. The minister answers that no violation of current rules is known, promises an NCP review of the oil and gas sector due in spring 2017, and describes multilateral efforts through UNEP and partnerships on cleaner fuel standards.
At this moment the cabinet has no indications that current legal and regulatory frameworks are being violated.
Op dit moment heeft het kabinet geen aanwijzingen dat in strijd met het huidige kader van wet- en regelgeving wordt gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Cegerek over luchtvervuiling op het platteland door de veehouderij

MPs Cegerek and Van Dekken asked about a study linking living near livestock farms to reduced lung function, about low public awareness of air pollution, and about why EU air quality limits are looser than WHO guidelines. The government said it will inform parliament on measures and follow-up research, points to existing public information channels, and says a push for stricter EU norms is not currently realistic while it keeps working toward WHO levels.
The cabinet intends to inform parliament shortly by letter about the measures to be taken and the follow-up research.
Het kabinet is voornemens uw Kamer binnenkort per brief te informeren over de te nemen maatregelen en het vervolgonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Jacobi over het gebruik van Dimethylaceetamide (DMAc) door DuPont

MPs Cegerek and Jacobi asked about DMAc exposure at DuPont Kerkrade, including past occupational health monitoring, inspection follow-up, urine test results withheld from workers, and possible risks to residents. The minister answered that the Dordrecht fact-finding study will cover lessons learned, that employers are primarily responsible for worker protection with inspection oversight, that urine results cannot be shared for privacy reasons, that RIVM found resident risk very unlikely, and that prosecutorial matters cannot be discussed.
Answering the questions about the situation at DuPont Kerkrade in the past would require in-depth research.
Het beantwoorden van de vragen over de situatie bij Dupont Kerkrade in het verleden zou diepgaand onderzoek vergen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over de jaarlijkse vernietiging van meer dan een miljoen kledingstukken

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the yearly destruction of over a million unsold garments and what measures reduce overproduction, support small retailers, cut direct-from-store destruction, and find alternative outlets. The State Secretary pointed to the Circular Economy programme, the textile covenant, a roadmap with industry, and a workshop, while stating that resale and market outlets are the responsibility of market parties.
Selling unsold products on the market is the responsibility of market parties.
Het verkopen van onverkochte producten op de markt is de verantwoordelijkheid van de marktpartijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Cegerek over de verdieping van de Nieuwe Waterweg en de Botlek in relatie tot oude milieumisdrijven

MPs Jacobi and Cegerek asked whether soil contamination in the Nieuwe Waterweg and Botlek had been systematically investigated before deepening, given past environmental scandals, and where dredged sludge would go. The minister answered that extensive soil research (TAUW 2015, MER documents) gave sufficient insight, that most material is clean enough for reuse, and that contaminated sludge goes to the Slufter depot.
With the research carried out, sufficient insight has been gained into the state of the soil.
Met de uitgevoerde onderzoeken is voldoende inzicht gekregen in de staat van de bodem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het gebruik van plastic trays in de sierteelt

An MP asks the State Secretary about the sustainability of single-use plastic trays in the ornamental horticulture sector, including their recyclability, health effects of polystyrene, and whether reusable trays or a ban could be pursued. The State Secretary says the sector will be brought into the plastics chain agreement, an LCA study by Royal FloraHolland is awaited before discussing options with the sector, and no health study is deemed necessary.
I will therefore bring the ornamental horticulture sector into contact with various chain partners under the plastics chain agreement.
Ik zal dan ook de sierteeltsector in verbinding brengen met diverse ketenpartners onder het kunststof ketenakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het opruimen van oorlogsmunitie in Apeldoorn

An MP asked the ministers whether the ordnance clearance around Apeldoorn is underfunded and whether the remaining explosives pose an unacceptable fire and safety risk. The minister answered that the municipality is responsible for risk assessment and clearance, that the fire service works only on cleared paths, and that clearance of phase 2 is expected to take 8 to 8.5 years.
Responsibility for public order and safety is a local responsibility.
De zorg voor openbare orde en veiligheid is een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het bericht ‘Bospaden bij Apeldoorn vol asbest’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that several forest paths near Apeldoorn contain asbestos, and how widespread, dangerous and in need of closure the problem is. The state secretary said the municipality is inventorying the asbestos, that the bound asbestos is not considered to spread and that closure is not needed for now, while noting that unknown numbers of asbestos roads remain nationally.
It is nationally unknown how many asbestos roads still exist and where they are located.
Het is landelijk onbekend hoeveel asbestwegen er nog zijn en waar deze zich bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çegerek en Leenders over berichten inzake de Zuid-West 380 kV Oost-hoogspanningsverbinding

MPs Cegerek and Leenders asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that alternative routes for the ZW380 Oost high-voltage line were not taken seriously, that the route document was biased, and that TenneT ignored environmental guidelines and altered routes. The minister denied these claims, saying alternatives were incorporated through an interactive process, the route document follows the guidelines, and the environmental impact report will determine the preferred alternative with an independent monitoring commission.
I do not agree with this claim. The route document substantiates, based on the policy starting points of SEV III and the EIA principles, why the distinct realistic alternatives were considered.

Ik ben het niet met deze stelling eens. In het tracédocument is op basis van de beleidsuitgangspunten van SEV III- en m.e.r.-principes onderbouwd waarom de onderscheidende realistische alternatieven in beschouwing zijn genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over de uitstoot van het kankerverwekkende GenX door Chemours

An MP asks whether GenX emitted by the Chemours plant in Dordrecht is adequately controlled, given RIVM findings that it is likely toxic and persistent, and whether it will be placed on the EU list of very high concern substances. The government answers that the regional authority set strict emission limits, that the permit is publicly available and emissions stayed within it, that RIVM was asked for a further assessment, and that it will pursue an EU evaluation with Germany rather than an immediate ban.
The permit, including the maximum permitted emissions, is available for anyone to view on the Omgevingsdienst website.
De vergunning, met daarin de maximaal toegestane uitstoot, is voor iedereen in te zien op de website van de Omgevingsdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het gevaar van plastic deeltjes in de lucht

An MP asked the state secretary whether plastic particles airborne in the air are harmful, whether research is lacking, and what policy addresses them. The state secretary answered that fine-particle health research exists but does not separate plastic components, that emissions reduction measures are being pursued, and that RIVM is studying options with a cost-effectiveness report promised for December.
In December I will inform you further on this.
In december zal ik u hierover nader berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çegerek en Volp over de dumpingen van drugs en ander (gevaarlijk) afval in Gelderland

MPs Cegerek and Volp asked about illegal dumping of drug-lab and other hazardous waste in Gelderland, including prosecution rates and cost-sharing. The minister answered that enforcement focuses on production and prosecution, that the 50% state funding applies only to drug waste, and that a provincial cooperation like those in Brabant and Limburg would be joined if Gelderland wants it.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over ‘het hoge aantal treinen met gevaarlijke stoffen op het spoor Amersfoort – Deventer’

An MP asked the state secretary why hazardous-goods trains on the Amersfoort–Deventer line far exceeded Basisnet risk ceilings, whether residents remain safe, and why municipalities are only informed afterwards. The secretary answered that Basisnet sets no binding norms for individual carriers, that risk contours keep homes outside the danger zone, and that consultations with carriers are underway, while reporting quarterly to municipalities.
It is precisely because of Basisnet that I am now consulting with carriers on measures to prevent exceedances in the future.
Het is juist vanwege Basisnet dat ik nu met vervoerders in overleg ben over maatregelen om overschrijdingen in de toekomst te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Fokke over het bericht ‘gesjoemel met gevaarlijke stoffen tussen Eindhoven en Venlo’

MPs Cegerek and Fokke asked whether hazardous goods were transported on the Eindhoven–Venlo route in breach of Basisnet rules, and what the consequences are for residents and the government's measures. The State Secretary denied that any category is banned, acknowledged risk-ceiling exceedances without homes being within the contour, said causes are being analysed with results expected in early July, and affirmed the Basisnet commitments still apply.
Before further concrete measures are taken, it is important that the causes are properly identified. I expect the outcome of this analysis at the beginning of July.
Voordat verdere concrete maatregelen worden genomen is het van belang dat de oorzaken goed in beeld zijn gebracht. Ik verwacht de uitkomsten van deze analyse begin juli.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çegerek en Van Dekken over de hoogspanningsverbinding van 380 kV in Groningen van Eemshaven naar Vierverlaten

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the promised further study into undergrounding part of the 380 kV line in Groningen, the status of that study, and whether all area partners are involved in the upcoming administrative consultation. The minister confirmed TenneT's study is ongoing with a decision after summer 2016, and said provincial and municipal officials and residents' groups are consulted at set moments, though not always at the same table.
Based on this study and consultation with the region, I will take a decision after the summer of 2016.
Mede op basis van dit onderzoek en overleg met de regio zal ik na de zomer van 2016 een besluit nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over de bouw van een outletcentrum in Zevenaar

An MP asked the Economics and Infrastructure ministers whether the approved Zevenaar outlet centre conflicts with the Ladder for sustainable urbanisation, regional retail deals and provincial steering, and what further action is possible to stop it. The minister answered that the Ladder is only a duty to motivate, that the decision belongs to local and provincial authorities and the courts, and that no further appeal is possible against the Council of State ruling.
No appeal is possible against the Council of State's decision.
Tegen het besluit van de Raad van State is geen beroep mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Wolbert over het gebruik van hormoonverstorende stoffen in ziekenhuizen

MPs Çegerek and Wolbert asked the Minister of Health about specialists' warnings on endocrine-disrupting substances leaking from medical devices in hospitals, WHO and Gezondheidsraad signals, and whether hospitals should phase out plastics. The Minister says the government is acting on BPA and DEHP, convening hospital associations and professional groups on a stepwise plan, and pursuing EU criteria and new medical device rules, but does not commit to a specific ban.

In the short term I have therefore invited the hospital associations and the professional groups relevant to the most vulnerable patients to jointly consider how reducing exposure can best be done, for example through a targeted step-by-step plan.

Op korte termijn heb ik daarom de koepels van ziekenhuizen en de voor de meest kwetsbare patiënten relevante beroepsgroepen uitgenodigd om gezamenlijk na te denken over de manier waarop terugdringing van de blootstelling het beste gedaan kan worden, bijvoorbeeld via een gericht stappenplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Cegerek over particuliere speeltoestellen in de openbare ruimte

MPs Van Dekken and Çegerek asked the Minister of Health about a possible three-year pilot letting municipalities set safety rules for privately placed play equipment, its design, safety, parent information, and whether it leads to legislation. The minister answered that the pilot is still under study, municipal views vary, consultation with the ROW has taken place, and any evaluation would be independent and could lead to a single national solution.
An evaluation will then be carried out by an independent research bureau.
Een evaluatie zal dan door een onafhankelijk onderzoeksbureau worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het feit dat Milieudefensie de Staat voor de rechter heeft gedaagd om gezonde lucht

An MP asked the State Secretary about Milieudefensie's lawsuit against the State over air quality, a report showing NO2 norm exceedances in at least 11 places, the timeline for resolving them, and whether the air quality action plan would be accelerated and funded for areas beyond Amsterdam and Rotterdam. The State Secretary replied that the RIVM expects no NO2 knelpunten by 2020, that the 2015 monitoring report due at year-end will guide any adjustments to the action plan, and that existing NSL funds for local authorities remain the instrument, with additional measures to be decided after that report.
I have asked the RIVM to include the findings of Milieudefensie's research in the monitoring.
Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van Milieudefensie te betrekken in de monitoring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Hoogland over het bericht dat milieuzones in steden worden tegengewerkt

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister whether the central government is undermining municipal discretion to set up environmental zones (milieuzones) for cleaner air, and how drivers can more easily know which zones apply. The minister denied any obstruction, said the government will drop the proposal to extend zone signage to passenger cars following the Visser motion, and said municipalities remain responsible and that communication on access rules is a local task.
The municipality is and remains responsible for taking local measures to improve air quality and can thereby proceed to establish an environmental zone.
De gemeente is en blijft verantwoordelijk voor het treffen van lokale maatregelen om de luchtkwaliteit te verbeteren en kan daarbij overgaan tot het instellen van een milieuzone.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek, Vermue en Albert de Vries over de alternatieven voor het nieuwe hoogspanningstraject in Zeeland

MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about alternative routings for a new high-voltage line in Zeeland proposed by D-Cision, including whether the existing 150 kV line will fail by 2020 and whether the minister will consult the province and municipalities. The minister confirmed awareness, argued the existing line need not be upgraded for 10 to 15 years, said the preferred route remains best, and promised to assess the proposal's effects and inform the House before summer 2016.
