As I indicated during the General Consultation on 20 April 2016, I am currently working to map the effects of this.
Zoals ik tijdens het Algemeen Overleg op 20 april 2016 heb aangeven ben ik momenteel bezig om de effecten hiervan in beeld te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Volp over de verschuiving van drugsdumpingen van Noord-Brabant naar Gelderland

PvdA MPs Cegerek and Volp asked about the shift of illegal drug-waste dumping from Noord-Brabant to Gelderland, including enforcement capacity and the role of environmental services. The Minister largely referred to earlier answers, said he lacks an overview of enforcement capacity per province, attributed dumping patterns to the location of synthetic drug labs and offenders' choice of distant dumping sites, and described existing cross-agency cooperation in Brabant and Limburg.
I do not have an overview of the requested ratios in enforcement capacity.
Ik heb geen overzicht van de gevraagde verhoudingen in handhavingscapaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Jacobi over de vervanging van een dorpswindmolen

MPs Cegerek and Jacobi asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether a village windmill replacement in Reduzum, and the Friesland wind-energy targets, are consistent with the national wind action plan and what role the Rijk should play in local energy initiatives. The minister replied that the provinces are responsible for local projects, that his role is to set frameworks and subsidies, and that Friesland's 2020 wind target is at risk but the Kop van Afsluitdijk project may now be realised on time.
It is the responsibility of the provinces, in consultation with municipalities and the local population, to decide on concrete initiatives such as this project.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincies om in overleg met gemeenten en de lokale bevolking te beslissen over concrete initiatieven zoals dit project.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Cegerek over de financiering van de restauratie van de Eusebiuskerk in Arnhem

MPs Monasch and Cegerek asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about funding for restoring the Eusebius church in Arnhem, including past state subsidies, Brim maintenance subsidy eligibility, and the provincial role. The minister answered that the church is important, outlined subsidy history, explained that Brim covers only maintenance and that provinces manage restoration funds, and said a joint approach will be discussed after an inventory due before summer.
It is important to get an overall picture of cases that may pose a bottleneck for provinces, as is currently the case with the Eusebius.
Het is van belang om een totaalbeeld te krijgen van gevallen die mogelijk een knelpunt kunnen zijn voor provincies, zoals dat nu het geval is met de Eusebius.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over de brand bij een transportbedrijf in Duiven

MP Cegerek asked whether the fire at a Duiven transport company was a known risk business, whether supervision was adequate, what the health risks were, and what lessons follow. The government answered that the municipality, not the regional environmental service, was responsible for supervision, the cause could no longer be determined, and a multidisciplinary evaluation would identify lessons learned.
The company falls under the general rules of the Activities Decree.
Het bedrijf valt onder de algemene regels van het Activiteitenbesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Jacobi over de gifuitstoot van de afvaloven in Harlingen

MPs Cegerek and Jacobi asked the State Secretary about a technical fault at the Harlingen waste incinerator that raised dioxin emissions for two days in October 2015, and about health risks, causes, measures and monitoring. The government answered that the province and municipality found no clear effect on local dioxin levels, that the province imposed penalty-backed orders on the operator, and that monitoring is carried out under accredited, independent measurement rules.
The province of Fryslân has instructed REC Harlingen to make additional efforts within two months to further reduce dioxin emissions during malfunctions and the chance of malfunctions.
De provincie Fryslân heeft REC Harlingen opgedragen binnen twee maanden extra inspanningen te verrichten om de dioxine-emissie tijdens storingen en de kans op storingen verder omlaag te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek, Hoogland en Jan Vos over het bericht ‘Luchtkwaliteit in gevaar door 130 kilometer per uur’.

MPs Cegerek, Hoogland and Jan Vos asked the minister whether RIVM and TNO criticism of raising motorway speed limits to 130 km/h, and of the air-quality modelling, was taken into account and whether the forecasts were sound. The minister replied that the methodology follows the legal framework and Raad van State practice, that monitoring will track NO2 and PM10 annually, and that some route boundaries were adjusted after objections.
In the annual NSL monitor it is checked whether the air quality limit values are exceeded.
In de jaarlijkse NSL-monitor wordt getoetst of de grenswaarden voor luchtkwaliteit worden overschreden.
Antwoord op vagen van de leden Cegerek en Jacobi over de gevolgen van jarenlang gebruik van PFOA bij Dupont in Dordrecht

MPs Cegerek and Jacobi asked about long-term PFOA use at DuPont (now Chemours) in Dordrecht, including undisclosed blood test results, unpermitted emissions, drinking water contamination, and calls for a population health study. The state secretary answered that the company is responsible for sharing blood results, that a RIVM exposure study and an Inspectie SZW investigation are underway, that polluter-pays rules apply, and that a stricter drinking water guideline is being prepared.

For privacy reasons and because of the medical confidentiality of the company doctor, results traceable to individual employees may not simply be shared with the Labour Inspectorate (or any other government body).

Uit privacyoverwegingen en vanwege het medisch beroepsgeheim van de betrokken bedrijfsarts mogen naar individuele werknemers herleidbare uitslagen niet zonder meer met de Inspectie SZW (of enig ander overheidsorgaan) worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het onderzoeksrapport naar statiegeld van het Wageningen University and Researchcentre (WUR)

An MP asked the state secretary about press reports that ministry officials intensively shaped a WUR study on deposit schemes, whether the study was biased, and what follows from the research integrity committee's judgment on it. The state secretary replied that the ministry asked WUR to add a societal-cost perspective and speed up the study, that the committee's assessment of WUR's quality is for the committee alone, and that the Framework Agreement on packaging remains in place with its evaluation planned for 2017.
Apart from WUR's publication on its website, the ministry has no further knowledge of this matter.
Het ministerie heeft, naast de publicatie van de WUR op haar website, geen verdere kennis van deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Çegerek over het feit dat de geloofwaardigheid van keurmerken onder druk staat

MPs Dikkers and Çegerek asked the State Secretary about the ACM finding that eco-label credibility is undermined by proliferation and unclear meaning, and whether government should define criteria and coordinate a framework. The State Secretary referred to his earlier letter, declined to set criteria himself but invited parties to act on ACM and Milieu Centraal recommendations, and noted an agreement to achieve an ordering of robust sustainability labels by end 2016.
I therefore do not consider it reasonable for the government to formulate the requirements itself.
Ik vind het dan ook niet in de rede liggen om vanuit de overheid de eisen te formuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çegerek en Dikkers over het gebruik van hormoonverstorende stoffen in voedingsverpakkingen

MPs Cegerek and Dikkers asked the ministers about hormone-disrupting substances such as BPA in food packaging, the protective measures, alternatives, and Dutch EU presidency efforts. The government answered that BPA exposure should be reduced through tighter EU limits rather than a ban, as substitutes are not yet proven safe, and committed to raising the issue at the Environment Council.
The Cabinet therefore adopts the RIVM advice to promote tightening of the current European standards and to reduce exposure to BPA as far as possible at national level.

Het Kabinet neemt daarom de adviezen van het RIVM over om aanscherping van de huidige Europese normen te bevorderen en om op nationaal niveau de blootstelling aan BPA zo ver mogelijk terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Cegerek over waterveiligheid in het kustgebied

MPs Jacobi and Cegerek asked the minister about the proposal to allow more building along the Dutch coast, the adequacy of coastal defences, changes to the Barro rules, decentralisation of coastal quality policy and related stakeholder demands. The minister answered that the current coastal rules stay unchanged for now, that a renewed consultation with stakeholders will follow, and that coastal safety is currently well in order, though many answers restate policy without detailing specific safeguards.
In addition, I have indicated that I will again consult the relevant societal and administrative parties on coastal policy.
Daarnaast heb ik aangegeven dat ik opnieuw in overleg zal treden met de betrokken maatschappelijke en bestuurlijke partijen over het kustbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Albert de Vries over het gevaar van betonblokken

MPs Cegerek and Albert de Vries asked whether concrete blocks containing waste (including lead-containing cathode-ray tube glass and fluorescent tubes) pose risks to people and the environment, how many accidents occurred, and whether stricter controls are needed. The State Secretary answered that cathode-ray tube glass processing is a permitted practice, that the RIVM advises against it, that existing permits are not criminal, that new insights will be shared with the regional authorities and the third national waste plan, and that the only reported accident is with the public prosecutor, so no conclusion on stricter controls can be drawn.

I will present the new insights to the environmental services that are the competent authorities for the producers of concrete blocks and will also include these insights in the upcoming third National Waste Management Plan (LAP3).

Ik zal de nieuwe inzichten voorleggen aan de omgevingsdiensten die bevoegd gezag zijn voor de producenten van betonblokken en deze inzichten tevens opnemen in het komende derde Landelijk Afvalbeheerplan (LAP3).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over bouwen in de duinen

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether the ban on building in the coastal zone has been abolished, why, and what the consequences are for nature and the openness of the coast. The government confirmed it intends to replace the building ban with conditions for initiatives, leaving nature protection law in force and placing more responsibility on provinces and municipalities, while committing to talks with stakeholders.
The cabinet intends to replace the building ban in the coastal zone, outside urban areas, with new conditions for initiatives in the coastal zone.
Het kabinet heeft het voornemen om het bouwverbod in de kustzone – in gebieden buiten stedelijk gebied – te vervangen door nieuwe randvoorwaarden voor initiatieven in de kustzone
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Monasch over het faillissement van onder andere V&D en Macintosh

MPs Cegerek and Monasch asked about the bankruptcies of V&D and Macintosh, the risk of retail vacancy, and why the ministers suspended parts of Zuid-Holland's retail ordinance without informing parliament. The government answered that restructuring is underway, pointed to the Retailagenda and Retaildeals, and explained that suspension was justified by doubts about compliance with national and EU law, with the provincial dispute still pending.
When there is genuine doubt that this is being complied with, intervention is necessary.
Wanneer er gerede twijfel is dat hier niet aan wordt voldaan, is ingrijpen noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over de brand op Chemiepark Chemelot

An MP asked the state secretary about a fire at Chemelot chemical park, its cause, health effects, whether safety rules were met and enforced, and whether incidents there are above average. The answer says no casualties occurred, the cause is not yet known pending the operator's and external reports, RIVM found no health concern though local nuisance occurred, the permits were in order and the site was inspected, and inspection frequency will be raised in 2016.
I am awaiting the results of the ongoing investigations. Your House will be informed of the outcomes of those investigations as promised.
Ik wacht de resultaten van de lopende onderzoeken af. Uw Kamer wordt zoals toegezegd over de uitkomsten van die onderzoeken geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het feit dat sommige Europese landen niet voldoen aan de in 2010 aangenomen Europese Richtlijn die import van illegaal gekapt hout verbiedt

An MP asked whether four EU member states still failing to implement the 2010 EU timber regulation are letting illegally logged timber into the Netherlands, what pressure exists to make them comply, and why the EU forest action plan has yielded poor results. The State Secretary answered that Dutch imports from those countries are small (0.21% of sawn wood), that the Commission has started infringement proceedings against three of them, and referred to a separate letter for the broader question.
It is for the European Commission to deploy pressure instruments when member states do not comply with EU law and regulations.
Het is aan de Europese Commissie om drukmiddelen in te zetten wanneer lidstaten zich niet houden aan EU wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Jan Vos over de invloed van grote bedrijven op het duurzaamheidsbeleid

MPs Cegerek and Jan Vos asked whether large companies unduly influence sustainability policy, citing a PhD study on business lobbying, and whether small players are disadvantaged in schemes such as SDE+, the postcode rose scheme and the energy savings fund. The minister answers that government policy is now shaped jointly with stakeholders, that the cabinet weighs interests itself, that most innovation funds go to SMEs, and that the postcode rose and energy savings fund rules have been simplified, with a further review promised.
In doing so, the cabinet is responsible for a balanced weighing of the various interests.
Daarbij is het kabinet verantwoordelijk voor een evenwichtige afweging van de verschillende belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Remco Dijkstra over de milieuvervuiling van bandengruis

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about tyre-wear particles (bandengruis) and microplastic pollution, including the reliability of a 1,000-tonne estimate, other brake and road wear, follow-up research, remedies, and foreign measures. The State Secretary answered that the data are uncertain, gave emission estimates for brake and road wear, and said a RIVM study on microplastic sources was due in February 2016.
It is important, given the uncertainties in the data, that emissions from tyre wear and other road-vehicle wear (and road surface wear) are better mapped, including the share of microplastics.

Het is van belang – gezien de onzekerheden in de data – dat de emissies van bandenslijtage en andere slijtstof van wegvoertuigen (en van het wegdek) beter in beeld worden gebracht, inclusief het aandeel van microplastics hierin.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Cegerek over het bericht dat gemeenten de geuroverlast van veehouderijen niet terug mogen dringen

MPs Van Dekken and Cegerek asked whether municipalities can tighten odour rules in overburdened areas, citing a reported Council of State ruling, and whether cumulative odour nuisance and resident perception should be reflected in the Wet geurhinder en veehouderij evaluation. The state secretary corrected the press report, said the evaluation working group will advise before any response, noted the Crisis- en herstelwet has not yet been used coercively, and confirmed the RIVM comparison and that these matters will be part of the evaluation.
Yes. At my request the RIVM carried out a comparative analysis in which the research methods and results of the Utrecht University and GGD study were compared with the 2001 PRA study.
Ja. Het RIVM heeft op mijn verzoek een duidingsonderzoek uitgevoerd waarin de onderzoeksmethodiek en resultaten van het onderzoek van de Universiteit Utrecht en de GGD
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over de rookoverlast van houtkachels, haarden en vuurkorven

An MP asked the government about health warnings from the GGD on wood-smoke pollution, how advice on stove use is disseminated, and its response to a 2006 RUG report criticising municipalities for under-enforcing smoke nuisance. The Staatssecretaris pointed to a handbook, MilieuCentraal information, a new Platform Houtstook, the principle that municipalities decide how to use their powers, and an EU Ecodesign tightening of stove standards.
It is further up to municipalities to determine how they give substance to their powers in combating smoke nuisance.
Het is verder aan gemeenten om te bepalen op welke wijze zij invulling geven aan hun bevoegdheden bij het bestrijden van rookoverlast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Cegerek en Wolbert over het gebruik van de kankerverwekkende stof perfluoroctaanzuur (ook wel PFOA of C8) bij DuPont in Dordrecht

MPs Jacobi, Cegerek and Wolbert asked the government about PFOA (C8) use at DuPont in Dordrecht, including health risks, the company's blood-monitoring data not being shared with the inspectorate, and whether specific environmental health research was ever done. The government answered that the inspectorate lacks the data, that the environmental permits followed national guidelines, and that it will ask RIVM to prepare a study on possible health effects.
The company concerned has not shared the research data with the Inspectorate SZW.
Het betreffende bedrijf heeft de onderzoeksgegevens niet met Inspectie SZW gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over een smogplan voor hete zomers

An MP asked the state secretary whether a smog plan for hot summers should be drawn up to warn people with respiratory conditions in time, and how it compares with neighbouring countries' alarms. The state secretary answered that RIVM advised improving the smog warning (adding fine particulate matter, aligning with Belgium) and that the revised information service would be presented in September 2015.
In September 2015 the renewed information provision on air quality will be presented.
In september 2015 zal de vernieuwde informatievoorziening over de luchtkwaliteit worden gepresenteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Jacobi inzake het vrijgekomen asbest bij een grote brand in Harlingen

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about asbestos released in a large fire in a Harlingen warehouse, including health risks, whether residents were warned via NL-Alert, and fire prevention. The secretary said the fire was probably arson, a certified firm found no asbestos spread by smoke, residents were advised to close windows, and existing building rules are considered sufficient, with no new measures promised.
Er is geen landelijk overzicht beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Cegerek over dubieuze transacties van investeringsfonds Waterland

MPs Nijboer and Cegerek asked whether private equity fund Waterland extracted more cash from Attero than it invested, whether this weakened the firm's landfill aftercare provisions and ability to pay future remediation costs, and what it means for staff. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that excess distributions are not per se improper, pointed to existing private equity asset-stripping rules and corporate law, said aftercare reserves and financial guarantees remain legally required, and said Waterland describes Attero as financially healthy while the staff impact cannot be assessed.
Dutch company law provides that the profit of a private or public limited company belongs to the shareholders, and sets limits on distributability.
Het Nederlandse vennootschapsrecht bepaalt dat de winst van een besloten of naamloze vennootschap toekomt aan de aandeelhouders, en stelt grenzen aan uitkeerbaarheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het afschaffen van statiegeld en het opnieuw niet nakomen van gemaakte afspraken over het gebruik van PVC in verpakkingsmateriaal door de supermarktketens

An MP asked whether supermarket chains again failed to meet agreed conditions for abolishing deposit (statiegeld) and PVC packaging phase-out, and how that affects abolition. The state secretary replied that the ILT found the PVC performance guarantee was not met, the report is sent to parliament, and the research cited by Radar was commissioned by industry, with the decision based on the ILT findings.
The ILT's review showed that the performance guarantee for PVC was not met.
Uit de toetsing door de ILT bleek dat aan de prestatiegarantie voor PVC niet voldaan is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over de ernstige last die mensen ondervinden van verkeerslawaai

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that traffic noise causes serious health harm and why decades of policy have not reduced it. The State Secretary answered that the health figures came from a CROW web compilation rather than a new study, that existing measures have reduced noise exposure relative to growth, and that noise production ceilings and a remediation scheme will be introduced through the Environment Act.
I provide a framework and instruments within which this is possible or can be enforced where necessary.
Ik voorzie in een raamwerk en instrumentarium waarbinnen dat mogelijk is of dat zo nodig kan worden afgedwongen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over de incidenten met gevaarlijke stoffen

An MP asked the State Secretary whether companies fail to report hazardous-substance transport incidents out of fear of fines, whether carriers are unaware of the reporting duty, and whether the Inspectorate (ILT) actively enforces reporting. The State Secretary answered that non-reporting often stems from unfamiliarity with the duty, that the ILT informs firms and enforces where needed, and that seven official reports were drawn up in 2014.
If it turns out that companies do not report incidents with hazardous substances, the ILT takes enforcement action under criminal or administrative law.
Als blijkt dat bedrijven incidenten met gevaarlijke stoffen niet melden, treedt de ILT strafrechtelijk of bestuursrechtelijk handhavend op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Albert de Vries en Çegerek over het verlies van banen bij het gerechtshof in Arnhem

MPs asked whether the Arnhem-Leeuwarden court of appeal may relocate from Arnhem to Zwolle, with possible job losses, and how this fits the goal of spreading government jobs. The Minister said the court board is only exploring housing scenarios with no decision taken, that some scenarios move posts out of Arnhem, and that a decision on locations would be made after the Rvdr's review rather than waiting for the 2018 evaluation.
The board of the Arnhem-Leeuwarden court of appeal is currently exploring the future housing needs of the court's organisational units.
Het bestuur van het gerechtshof Arnhem-Leeuwarden voert op dit moment verkenningen uit naar de toekomstige huisvestingsbehoefte van de organisatieonderdelen van het gerechtshof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Çegerek naar aanleiding van een nieuwsbericht  van Deltares over een onderzoek naar microplastics

An MP asked the State Secretary about a Deltares study on microplastics and their additives, litter control, washing-machine filters and further research. The government answered that measured concentrations are below risk limits, lists existing and planned measures, and commits to a research programme on microplastic effects.
I am following this research and will use its outcomes when developing measures to reduce microplastic emissions from land-based sources.
Ik volg dit onderzoek en zal de uitkomsten hiervan gebruiken bij het ontwikkelen van maatregelen om de emissies van microplastics vanuit landbronnen te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het bericht “Gekke Gerrit mikt op 30 supermarkten”

An MP asked whether a supermarket chain selling Polish Coca-Cola without deposit would be stopped, and whether the deposit obligation on PET bottles stays in place after the Afvalfonds takes over. The Secretary of State said the chain ended its no-deposit promotion, and that StAV now charges members selling large bottles without deposit a much higher fee (about 0.25 euro per bottle), giving a strong incentive to join the deposit system.
No. As before, a situation can still arise in which a producer or importer, for example from Poland, imports soft drinks in 1.5 litre PET bottles and places them on the market without deposit.

Nee. Zoals voorheen, kan ook nu zich een situatie voordoen dat een producent of importeur uit bijvoorbeeld Polen frisdrank in PET-flessen van 1.5 liter importeert en deze zonder statiegeld op de markt brengt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het bericht "Noodverordening in Roermond om asbest na grote brand"

An MP asked the state secretary about a fire in Roermond that released asbestos, its cause, the health consequences, and whether locations with asbestos were inventoried. The state secretary said the police investigation is ongoing, the amount of released asbestos and health effects are not yet known, no complete national inventory of asbestos locations exists, and he intends to ban asbestos roofs from 2024 and points to regional and sector initiatives.
The police investigation into the fire is still ongoing and no statements can currently be made about it.
Het politieonderzoek naar de brand loopt nog en hierover kunnen op dit moment geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over een statiegeldproject op een school in Apeldoorn

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that a school project in Apeldoorn on waste and recycling was obstructed by the Afvalfonds, which allegedly pressured the school into supporting a deposit scheme. The State Secretary answered that the initial application was rejected for lack of clarity on side effects, was approved after revision, that the Afvalfonds plays no substantive role in assessment, and listed the assessment criteria.
The Afvalfonds foundation plays no substantive role in assessing an application.
Stichting Afvalfonds speelt geen inhoudelijke rol bij de beoordeling van een aanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Cegerek over louche asbestverwijderaars.

MPs Kerstens and Cegerek asked whether the government can stop asbestos removal firms that re-apply for certification through new legal entities after losing a certificate, and whether certification rules and oversight should change. Minister Asscher acknowledged about five firms tried to circumvent the rules, committed to tightening the certification scheme and intensifying Inspectorate enforcement, while rejecting a shift to a different oversight system for now.
I find it unacceptable that companies or persons, after a certificate has been withdrawn, continue their work in the same way under another certificate.
Ik vind het onaanvaardbaar dat bedrijven of personen na het intrekken van een certificaat onder een ander certificaat hun werkzaamheden op dezelfde manier voortzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Cegerek over het bericht “Duurzaam betekent niets meer”

MPs de Vries and Cegerek asked about a report claiming that 'sustainable' no longer means anything in construction, questioning builders' attitude to environmental rules, innovation, the National Environmental Database, and the reliability of certificates. The minister rejected the claim that builders reject environmental rules, defended the Nationale Milieudatabase and Green Deals, and said the government will study how consumers use certification labels and report to parliament.
The Tweede Kamer will be informed further about the results.
Over de resultaten wordt de Tweede Kamer nader ingelicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Cegerek over de afvalstoffenbelasting

MPs Dijkstra and Cegerek asked about the waste tax taking effect in 2015, including export leakage, the effect on storage tonnages, the competitive position of the sector, and whether other EU countries have comparable export levies. The state secretary answered that export effects are expected to be limited but will be monitored, that the level playing field in the EU is not currently ensured, and that measures will be considered if leakage appears.
Should this monitoring show that undesirable leakage abroad does occur, it will be considered which measures are appropriate.
Mocht uit deze monitoring blijken dat er toch sprake is van een ongewenste ontwikkeling met weglek naar het buitenland dan zal worden bezien welke maatregelen passend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Cegerek over het bericht ‘Akzonobel overweegt chloortransport’

MPs Hoogland and Cegerek asked about risks of a possible chlorine transport by Akzo Nobel, who responsibility if something goes wrong, the criteria for incidental transports, and the necessity given a strike-related shortage. The State Secretary replied that strict rules and ILT supervision apply, that the company is primarily responsible, that a 2002 covenant allows limited incidental transports, and that the labour conflict is a matter between employer and employees.
For incidental chlorine transports there is 100% control, meaning all chlorine transports are checked against the applicable regulations.
Bij incidentele chloortransporten is er sprake van 100% controle wat inhoudt dat alle chloortransporten op de van toepassing zijnde regelgeving worden gecontroleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het bericht dat Lidl en Aldi afgekocht zijn

An MP asked whether the CBL offered Aldi and Lidl compensation to drop their own deposit systems, and whether taxpayer money is involved. The Secretary of State said the offer comes from StAV's own funds financed by industry contributions, not taxpayers, and that such private arrangements are not a government matter.
Making arrangements about offering compensation for possible financial disadvantages Aldi and Lidl may suffer, I regard as a private matter in which the government has no role.

Afspraken maken over het aanbieden van een compensatie voor de mogelijke financiële nadelen die Aldi en Lidl kunnen ondervinden, zie ik als een private aangelegenheid, waar de overheid geen rol in heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het bericht met betrekking tot de mogelijke risico’s van loombandjes

An MP asked the state secretary about media reports that loom rubber bands may contain harmful substances and could end up as waste, and whether toy recycling receives attention. The government answered that the bands meet EU toy-safety chemical rules, are not harmful, that toy waste is not measured, and that toy recycling will be examined within the 'From Waste to Raw Material' programme.
From the 'From Waste to Raw Material' programme I will look into whether toys are a waste stream with potential for closing loops.
Ik zal vanuit het programma «Van Afval naar Grondstof» bekijken of speelgoed een stroom is die potentie heeft voor het sluiten van ketens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het bericht invallen en arrestaties in afvalfraude

An MP asked the government about reports of raids and arrests in a waste-fraud case, including why the illegal activity was not stopped earlier, to whom illegal waste was sold, and whether public health was endangered. The Minister of Justice declined to answer the questions on who was involved and why action came late, citing the ongoing criminal investigation, and said only that waste fraud can pose risks, which the investigation must establish.
The criminal investigation being conducted under the direction of the Public Prosecution Service has not yet been concluded.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek dat plaatsvindt onder leiding van het Openbaar Ministerie is op dit moment nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Van Dekken over het bericht dat milieuvergunningen voor veehouderijen al jaren op verkeerde geurberekeningen zijn gebaseerd

MPs Cegerek and Van Dekken asked the state secretary about reports that livestock environmental permits were based on flawed odour calculations using the V-Stacks model, and whether this harms residents and the transition to sustainable farming. The state secretary acknowledged the Noord-Brabant study, said discrepancies appear only in specific situations, promised further testing, a model adjustment within months and guidance to municipalities, but disputed the call for a full evaluation of the odour system.
I expect to have an answer within a few weeks on the exact situations in which deviations in the model affect a permit decision and how often those situations occur.

Ik verwacht binnen enkele weken antwoord op de vraag in welke exacte situaties afwijkingen binnen het model gevolgen heeft voor een besluit tot vergunningverlening en hoe vaak die situaties voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek, Nijboer en van Dekken Milieu over overlast vanwege laagfrequent geluid

MPs Cegerek, Nijboer and van Dekken asked the State Secretary about residents' complaints of low-frequency noise near the NAM gas storage site at Grijpskerk, Zuidhorn. The government answered that studies found no clear cause for the complaints, so no basis remains for targeting a specific source, and it informed the Zuidhorn mayor accordingly.
In this specific case, research has not identified a clear cause for the complaints.
In dit specifieke geval is uit onderzoek geen duidelijke oorzaak voor de klachten naar voren gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het rapport van CE Delft «Kosten statiegeldsystemen voor grote PET-flessen»

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the government accepts CE Delft's review finding that the WUR cost basis for lifting the deposit (statiegeld) on large PET bottles was wrong and that the decision rested on incorrect data. The State Secretary declined to judge which of the two conflicting cost analyses is correct, stating the framework agreement rests on target-steering rather than the cost analysis, and that the deposit lift is a matter of producer responsibility.
It is not my role to give a judgement on the correctness of the two reports.
Het is niet mijn rol een oordeel te geven over de juistheid van de twee rapporten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden de Kamerleden Cegerek en Dikkers over het bericht dat er teveel dioxine gevonden is in eieren nabij de afvalverbrandingsoven Harlingen

MPs Cegerek and Dikkers asked about reports of excessive dioxin in eggs from backyard hens near the Harlingen waste incinerator, whether eggs and milk should be removed, and whether the incinerator and its enforcement by a regional agency posing a conflict of interest are adequately checked. The minister replied that the eggs were not marketed, that existing consumption advice still applies, that a re-evaluation of the EU tolerable weekly intake will be pushed in Europe, that incinerator emissions are continuously monitored and tested twice yearly, that no extra research is needed, and that the regional agency only advises municipalities and enforcement is not delegated.
The province is the competent authority for the waste incineration installation and is not a shareholder.
De provincie is bevoegd gezag voor de afvalverbrandingsinstallatie en geen aandeelhouder.

to inventory where building quay walls could make freight transport via inland waterways possible

requests the government to tackle the locations with the greatest urgency for bicycle parking, such as Amsterdam, Zwolle and Eindhoven, as quickly as possible

requests the government to map the investment needs of decentralised authorities

Asks the government to work with water boards and municipalities on a plan for faster action in extreme water nuisance cases.
requests the government, separately from the evaluation of the Water Governance Agreement, to consult with water boards and municipalities to draw up a plan
verzoekt de regering om, los van de evaluatie van het Bestuursakkoord Water, met de waterschappen en gemeenten in overleg te treden om een plan te maken
Motie van de leden De Boer en Jacobi over de financieringsmogelijkheden voor een grotere sluis op Kornwerderzand
Asks the government to explore alternative and creative financing options, including EIB, Juncker funds, Waddenfonds and CEF, for a larger lock at Kornwerderzand and to inform the House.
requests the government to think along with the region in the search for alternative and creative financing options for a larger lock at Kornwerderzand

Asks the government, when financial room for rail is found, to give priority to Schiphol station capacity and cross-border links such as Eindhoven-Düsseldorf and Heerlen-Aken, and to report by 1 June 2016.
requests the government, when financial room for rail is found and based on study results, to give priority to
verzoekt de regering, bij gevonden financiële ruimte voor spoor en op basis van de resultaten van de studies in ieder geval voorrang te verlenen aan

Requires operators of service facilities to provide railway undertakings, on request and without delay, with access conditions, service conditions and charge information.

exploitanten van dienstvoorzieningen als bedoeld in bijlage II, punt 2, onderdelen a, f en i, van richtlijn 2012/34/EU onverwijld informatie over de voorwaarden voor toegang

Amendment introduces ex ante approval by the ACM of access conditions and charges set by rail service facility operators in tenders.

Tweede nader gewijzigd amendement van de leden De Boer en Van Helvert ter vervanging van nr. 18 dat beoogt ex ante toezicht door de Autoriteit Consument en Markt in te voeren op tarieven en voorwaarde
Introduces ex ante approval by the Authority for Consumers and Markets of tariffs and conditions that service-facility operators apply in train concession tenders.
This amendment aims to introduce ex ante supervision by the Authority for Consumers and Markets of tariffs and conditions that operators of service facilities apply in a tender.

Dit amendement beoogt ex ante toezicht door de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (hierna: ACM) in te voeren op tarieven en voorwaarden die bij een aanbesteding door exploitanten van dienstvoorzieningen worden gehanteerd.
Motie van het lid De Boer over de impact van de boetesystematiek voor niet ingenomen ruimte op het spoor

to inform the Chamber about this within three months
de Kamer binnen drie maanden hierover te informeren
Motie van het lid De Boer over het betrekken van nieuwe aanbieders bij het spelregelkader
Asks the government to involve new providers of mobility cards and services when drafting the rules framework for public transport payment systems.
requests the government to involve new providers of mobility cards and services in drafting this rules framework

Asks the government to send its promised vision on the public transport payment market to the House within six months, including pros, cons and effects of roaming on existing concessions.
requests the government to send the promised vision on the public transport payment market to the House within six months
verzoekt de regering, de toegezegde visie op de ov-betaalmarkt binnen zes maanden naar de Kamer te sturen
Amendement van het lid De Boer waarmee een evaluatiebepaling in het wetsvoorstel wordt geintroduceerd.

Adds an evaluation clause requiring the minister to report to parliament within five years and every five years on the effectiveness and effects of the public transport law, with a call to repeal delegation articles once problems are solved.
The Minister shall send the States General a report on the effectiveness and effects of this law in practice within five years of entry into force, and every five years thereafter.

Onze Minister zendt binnen vijf jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet, en vervolgens telkens na vijf jaar, aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk.

Amendment introducing ex ante approval by the Autoriteit Consument en Markt of tariffs and conditions set by operators of rail service facilities before they take effect.
This amendment aims to introduce ex ante supervision by the Authority for Consumers and Markets over tariffs and conditions
Dit amendement beoogt ex ante toezicht door de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (hierna: ACM) in te voeren op tarieven en voorwaarden
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van Helvert en De Boer ter vervanging van nr. 12 waarmee een lichte voorhangbepaling in de artikelen 67 en 68 van het wetsvoorstel wordt geïntroduceerd.

Requires a four-week voorhang so the draft AMvB on separate accounting and fair, transparent, non-discriminatory tariffs for service operators on railway lines goes to both chambers before it is submitted.

The proposal for a general administrative order to be adopted under the first or second paragraph may not be submitted until four weeks after the draft has been laid before both chambers of the States General.

De voordracht voor een krachtens het eerste of tweede lid vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.

operators of service facilities as referred to in Annex II, points 2 and 3, of Directive 2012/34/EU provide information without delay
verstrekken exploitanten van dienstvoorzieningen als bedoeld in bijlage II, punten 2 en 3, van richtlijn 2012/34/EU onverwijld informatie
Amendement van de leden Van Helvert en De Boer waarmee een lichte voorhangbepaling in de artikelen 67 en 68 van het wetsvoorstel wordt geïntroduceerd
Adds a light pre-consultation (voorhang) requirement giving both chambers four weeks to see the draft general administrative order on separate accounting and fair tariffs for rail service facilities.
The proposal for a general administrative order to be adopted is not submitted until four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both chambers of the States General.

De voordracht voor een krachtens het eerste en tweede lid vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.

This amendment aims to introduce ex ante supervision by the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) over tariffs and conditions applied by operators of service facilities.

Amendement van de leden De Boer en Van Helvert dat beoogt exploitanten van dienstvoorzieningen verplicht te stellen aan spoorwegondernemingen die daarom verzoeken onverwijld informatie ter beschikking
Requires rail infrastructure operators to promptly provide railway undertakings with access conditions, service information and charges on request.
operators of service facilities must promptly provide information on access conditions to railway undertakings

Amendement van het lid Dik-Faber c.s. waarmee een bijdrage wordt geleverd aan een korte termijn oplossing voor het tekort aan capaciteit op de Valleilijn
Shifts 7.5 million euro within the rail budget from the Beter Benutten programme to fund extra train capacity on the Valleilijn; it moves money between budget lines without changing executive checks.
Specifically, this amendment makes 7.5 million euros available for a short-term solution for the Valleilijn.
Concreet wordt met dit amendement € 7,5 miljoen beschikbaar gesteld voor een korte termijn oplossing voor de Valleilijn.
Motie van de leden De Boer en Jacobi over het op het oude niveau krijgen van de sluisbediening
Asks the government to restore lock operation to its former level, including by remote operation of locks.
requests the government, through cooperation with other authorities and by operating locks remotely, to restore lock operation to the old level
verzoekt de regering om, via de samenwerking met andere overheden, en door middel van het bedienen van sluizen op afstand, de sluisbediening op het oude niveau te krijgen
Motie van de leden Smaling en De Boer over afschaffen van overbodige eisen van de CCR
Asks the government to make abolition of superfluous construction requirements of the Central Commission for Navigation on the Rhine a priority with the sector.
requests the government, in 2015 in consultation with the sector, to make abolishing superfluous requirements by the CCR a priority
verzoekt de regering, in 2015 in overleg met de sector een speerpunt te maken van het afschaffen van overbodige eisen door de CCR
Motie van de leden De Boer en Van Veldhoven
Asks the government to study the costs, procedures and timeline of a possible freight rail line along the N18 alongside monitoring rail freight growth.
this autumn to investigate the final costs of a possible rail line for freight transport along the N18
dit najaar te onderzoeken wat de uiteindelijke kosten zijn van een eventuele spoorlijn voor goederenvervoer langs de N18
Motie van de leden De Boer en Hoogland over het verleggen van het vervoer van gevaarlijke stoffen naar buizenstelsels
Asks the government for a plan to shift the remaining 10% of dangerous goods transport from rail to underground pipelines and water.
requests the government to come up with an action plan by 1 March 2014
verzoekt de regering om, voor 1 maart 2014 met een plan van aanpak te komen
Motie van de leden De Boer en Kuiken over afspraken over het traject Eindhoven-Heerlen-Aken
Asks the government to first agree with the region on covering operating losses of the first phase of the Eindhoven-Heerlen-Aachen intercity link, then on the second phase.
requests the government to first make firm agreements with the region on addressing the operating losses for the first phase
verzoekt de regering, om eerst sluitende afspraken te maken met de regio over de aanpak van de exploitatieverliezen voor de eerste fase
Motie van het lid Albert de Vries c.s. over knelpunten in het grensoverschrijdend spoorvervoer
Asks the government to organise two summits with neighbouring countries to resolve cross-border rail bottlenecks.
requests the government to organise two rail summits with our neighbouring countries
verzoekt de regering, twee spoortoppen te organiseren met onze buurlanden

Removes the sanction provision for the purchase sector from the Housing Act amendment bill.
This amendment deletes the sanction provision for the purchase sector in proposed article 11c, second paragraph, of the Housing Act.
Dit amendement schrapt de sanctiebepaling voor de koopsector, zoals in het voorgestelde artikel 11c, tweede lid, van de Woningwet.

Amendement van de leden De Boer en Van Bochove over de noodzaak voor de eigenaar van een gebouw om te beschikken over een energieprestatiecertificaat berekend aan de hand van het bouwjaar van het gebo

Deems building owners to hold an energy performance certificate based on construction year until a certified certificate is issued, and lets the minister set detailed calculation rules by ministerial regulation.
Detailed rules on calculating energy performance by construction year are given by ministerial regulation
Bij ministeriële regeling worden nadere voorschriften gegeven over het berekenen van de energieprestatie per bouwjaar
Motie van het lid De Boer over huurders met onbekende inkomensgegevens
Asks the government to propose a measure so that tenants whose income data is unavailable cannot be hit by the 5% rent increase for high-income households who are scheduled to pay more.
requests the government to come with a proposal ensuring that the group whose income data is unavailable cannot fall under the rent increase
verzoekt de regering, met een voorstel te komen dat ervoor zorgt dat de groep waarvan de inkomensgegevens niet beschikbaar zijn, niet onder de huurverhoging kan uitkomen
Amendement van het lid De Boer over omkering van de bewijslast
Shifts the burden of proof onto the tenant to show harm when a landlord fails to obtain a tax office statement before an above-inflation rent increase.
the tenant demonstrates that he has been harmed by this omission
de huurder aantoont dat hij door dit verzuim is benadeeld
Motie De Boer/Ortega-Martijn over het tijdelijk verhuren van woningen die te koop staan
Asks the government to greatly simplify or, if possible, abolish the municipal permit required for temporarily renting out homes that are for sale.
requests the government to achieve a strong simplification or, if possible, abolition of the permit
verzoekt de regering te komen tot sterke vereenvoudiging of zo mogelijk afschaffing van de vergunning
Motie Van Bochove/De Boer over het functioneren van verenigingen van eigenaren
Asks the government to examine how the functioning of owners' associations (verenigingen van eigenaren) and the quality of certified administrators can be improved.
requests the government to examine how the functioning of owners' associations can be optimised
verzoekt de regering te bekijken op welke wijze het functioneren van verenigingen van eigenaren geoptimaliseerd kan worden
Motie-Verhoeven/De Boer over de bruikbaarheid van leegstaande kantoorgebouwen
Asks the government to have the Rijksgebouwendienst first examine whether vacant office buildings can be reused before building new offices for government needs.
requests the government to set a good example by instructing the Rijksgebouwendienst to first examine the usability of available vacant office buildings when the government needs new office space

verzoekt de regering het goede voorbeeld te geven door de Rijksgebouwendienst op te dragen om bij overheidsbehoefte aan nieuwe kantoorruimte eerst de bruikbaarheid van beschikbare, leegstaande kantoorgebouwen te onderzoeken
Asks the government to actively encourage temporary student housing rentals for the duration of study, so-called campus contracts, among housing associations and private landlords.
requests the government to actively encourage the temporary rental of student housing for the duration of study, the so-called campus contracts
verzoekt de regering de tijdelijke verhuur van studentenhuisvesting voor de duur van de studie, de zogenaamde «campuscontracten», actief te stimuleren
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over CEF-subsidiegelden

An MP from the VVD asked the government about EU Connecting Europe Facility (CEF) grant rejections for Dutch shipping projects such as exhaust gas scrubbers, and whether this breaches a level playing field. The minister answered that there is no evidence of repeated Dutch-specific rejections, that the same criteria apply to all applicants, and that the budget was oversubscribed two to three times.
I have no indication that CEF subsidies distort competition.
Ik heb geen aanwijzing dat CEF subsidies concurrentieverstorend werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en De Boer over een gesprek met stakeholders uit de spoorsector d.d. 13 maart 2017

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about a stakeholder meeting on rail, the new method for ProRail's user charge (VMT and a planned levy), its effect on freight competitiveness versus Germany, and the costs of rail safety systems. The State Secretary answered at length, explaining the new methodology, the planned multi-year levy differentiated by market segment, efficiency steering of ProRail, and that a diesel tax is not planned, while deferring some figures to later publications.
With this I aim for transparency and stability of the tariffs.
Ik beoog hiermee transparantie en stabiliteit van de tarieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en De Boer over de doorverkoop van de Fyra’s aan een andere vervoerder

MPs Aukje de Vries and De Boer asked whether reported resale of the Fyra trains to Trenitalia was accurate, whether AnsaldoBreda had contacted the minister, and what compensation NS and the state would receive. The minister replied that no sale has yet occurred, that NS is not party to any resale contract, and that NS would receive up to EUR 3.5 million per train if resale succeeds, with the proceeds going to NS profit rather than the state.
If there is an actual sale, NS will be informed of it by AnsaldoBreda/Finmeccanica under this agreement, and NS will inform me of it.
Ingeval er sprake is van een daadwerkelijke verkoop, zal NS hierover conform deze overeenkomst door AnsaldoBreda/Finmeccanica op de hoogte worden gesteld en zal NS mij hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over vervoer van doelgroepen in het openbaar vervoer, naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek aan een vervoerder d.d. 15 maart jl.

An MP asked the state secretary how Translink Systems is owned, whether new carriers can join its cooperative and the OV-chipkaart system, and whether paratransit (doelgroepenvervoer) should be integrated into it. The secretary answered that the cooperative is owned by public transport companies and membership requires a concession, that the OV-chipkaart is not used for contract-based paratransit, and that experiments combining the two will start, with ACM to advise on market regulation by end 2017.
Membership of the cooperative is only possible when holding a valid concession as referred to in the Passenger Transport Act 2000.
Het lidmaatschap van de coöperatie is enkel mogelijk bij het hebben van een geldige concessie als bedoeld in de Wet Personenvervoer 2000.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Remco Dijkstra naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek aan de vereniging RONA in Overijssel en Gelderland op 20 februari jongstleden

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about freight train rerouting over Oost-Nederland lines, transparency on hazardous goods, calamity responsibilities, noise measures and quieter rolling stock. The State Secretary answered that rerouting raises freight trains from about 23 to 32 per day, that hazardous goods data is available to emergency services, that noise dampers and wagon bonuses are in place or planned, and that no extra funding is needed.
I endorse the importance of transparent information provision.
Ik onderschrijf het belang van transparante informatievoorziening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Nijkerken-de Haan en De Boer over het besluit van de Belgische regering om te investeren in het spoortraject Antwerpen-Weert

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretary about Belgium's plans to electrify the Antwerp–Weert rail line, its CEF funding application, cost-benefit analysis, Brabant route relief, and a possible 4 million euro national contribution. The state secretary answered that Belgian federal decision-making is pending, no Dutch financing is involved, no cost-benefit analysis is yet available, the existing line has sufficient capacity, and electrification is not a national priority so no infrastructure fund reservation is appropriate.
I therefore conclude that electrification of the route is not a national priority.
Ik constateer daarmee dat elektrificatie van het tracé geen nationale prioriteit heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer, Van Oosten en Van der Linde over de viersporigheid van het treinverkeer tussen Rotterdam en Schiedam n.a.v. een werkbezoek op 23 januari jl.

Three VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about keeping intercity stops at Schiedam Centrum and the four-track option between Rotterdam and Schiedam after a site visit. The State Secretary answered that the intercity stop may be kept only if four tracks are built and a study is ongoing, with no negotiations started and no Schiedam Kethel study reopened.
The study commissioned by the MRDH and carried out by ProRail shows that with PHS the existing Intercity stop by the Amsterdam-The Hague-Rotterdam-Dordrecht/Vlissingen service cannot be maintained.

Uit het onderzoek, dat in opdracht van de MRDH door ProRail is uitgevoerd, blijkt dat met PHS de bestaande Intercity-stop door de Intercitydienst Amsterdam-Den Haag-Rotterdam-Dordrecht/Vlissingen niet kan worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van ’t Wout en De Boer over de veiligheid en leefbaarheid langs het goederenspoor in de gemeenten Moerdijk, Halderberge en Roosendaal

MPs Van 't Wout and De Boer asked about noise and safety from freight trains in Moerdijk, Halderberge and Roosendaal, and why sleepers and rail dampers are not being installed sooner. The Secretary of State answered that sleeper replacement runs to 2019 but cannot be accelerated within available track-free periods, that noise-reduction measures will be prioritised in 2018 under the MJPG, and that slower train speeds results are expected in autumn.
I expect to be able to share the results of this exploration next autumn.
Ik verwacht komend najaar resultaten van deze verkenning te kunnen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Nijkerken-De Haan en De Boer over een werkbezoek aan de provincie Limburg d.d. 6 februari 2017

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretary about commitments on a rail connection and Carhandling Terminal Swentibold in Limburg, including the status of studies, ProRail's cost validation, provincial guarantees and whether national funding would be provided. The state secretary confirmed the agreements, said the connection now costs about EUR 40 million rather than EUR 20 million, and offered up to EUR 10 million in national funding (EUR 5 million each from the ministries) subject to conditions such as public access, job effects, a one-off contribution and a validated business case.
It has been agreed that the definitive cost estimate for the public connection of this rail terminal will be validated by ProRail according to the standard requirements.
Afgesproken is dat de definitieve kostenraming van de openbare aansluiting van deze railterminal door ProRail zal worden getoetst conform de standaard eisen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de spoorcapaciteitsverdeling ten tijde van de problemen met de Moerdijkbrug

An MP asked the state secretary about the ACM finding that ProRail treated rail freight operators unequally when closing the Moerdijk bridge in April 2016 and whether the minister would act against ProRail and prevent future discrimination. The state secretary regretted the inadequate consultation, said ProRail promised better communication, and declined further action because the ACM as supervisor has already ruled and ProRail is complying.
ProRail has assured me that it will in future involve all rail users with capacity rights in good time in decisions on planning track closures.
ProRail heeft mij verzekerd voortaan alle spoorgebruikers met capaciteitsrechten tijdig te betrekken bij besluitvorming over de planning van buitendienststellingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de bedragen die nog op verlopen OV-chipkaarten staan

An MP asked the state secretary about roughly 5 million euro left on expired OV-chipkaarten and what can be done to make refunds easier. The state secretary said about 5 million euro cannot be traced to holders, committed to scrapping the 1 euro counter fee and proactive refunds, and said the remaining balances are parked in a risk-free bank account.
I agreed this today in the National OV Council (NOVB).
Dit heb ik vandaag in het Nationaal OV Beraad (NOVB) afgesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Nijkerken-de Haan en De Boer over het ongeval bij de stuw bij Grave

MPs of the VVD asked the minister about the causes and consequences of a ship colliding with the Grave weir on the Maas, including damage claims, repair timing, responsibility for coordination, and an evaluation. The minister answered that the cause awaits police findings, damages are unknown and claimable from the ship owner, repairs take at least six months, and an independent evaluation will be delivered by spring 2017.
Pending the results of the police investigation, I cannot make statements about the precise cause of the accident.
In afwachting van de resultaten van het onderzoek door de politie kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de precieze oorzaak van het ongeval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van 't Wout en De Boer over de effecten van de veranderde dienstregeling van NS op West-Brabant

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about the 2017 NS timetable change, which lengthened some West-Brabant to Randstad journeys (e.g. Oudenbosch–Schiphol), and whether NS consulted regional authorities and consumer groups as the concession requires. The State Secretary acknowledged some deteriorations but said the timetable is NS's responsibility, that the concession was respected, and that commercially confidential profitability data cannot be disclosed; she declined to study wider economic effects and offered only to discuss improvements for 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en De Boer over toegankelijkheid van het spoorvervoer en persoonlijke assistentieverlening op NS-stations

MPs Smaling and De Boer asked about NS station assistance for wheelchair users, expansion of assisted stations, costs and punctuality, ProRail's station upgrade timeline, and when all stations will be accessible. The Staatssecretaris answered that NS is extending assistance to 45 more stations, that 90% accessibility is targeted by 2020 and all stations by 2030, and declined to accelerate works for reasons of disruption and contractor capacity.
I want to work with NS and ProRail to examine how independent accessibility is developing in the Netherlands and, on that basis, decide whether there is reason to further expand assistance.

Ik wil samen met NS en ProRail bekijken hoe de zelfstandige toegankelijkheid zich in Nederland ontwikkelt en op grond daarvan besluiten of er aanleiding is om de assistentieverlening nog verder uit te breiden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het succes van de OV-fiets naar aanleiding van het artikel het artikel ‘Succes OV-fiets leidt tot tekort op stations’ in het Nederlands Dagblad van 15 november 2016

An MP asked the state secretary about NS's OV-fiets (public transport bike) expansion, whether it is a core task, who pays for 1,000 new bikes, and whether NS should hand it back to the market. The state secretary replied that NS takes the initiative as part of door-to-door travel, that NS funds the bikes itself, that subscriptions no longer carry bike costs, and that NS will not be asked to reconsider, while noting the questions could not be answered before the MIRT debate.
It has unfortunately not proven possible to answer these questions before the committee debate.
Het is helaas niet mogelijk gebleken deze vragen voor het notaoverleg te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Aukje de Vries over een tweede intercity van en naar Fryslân

MPs De Boer and Aukje de Vries asked why the promised second intercity between Fryslân and the Randstad was not running and whether it can be realised, and what the obstacles are. The State Secretary answers that power supply limitations led ProRail to declare the infrastructure overloaded, that NS, ProRail and Fryslân agreed in November 2016 to start the service around end 2017, and that ProRail is installing an extra substation and other upgrades.
On 16 November 2016, NS, Fryslân and ProRail agreed that the second intercity is expected to run on the Leeuwarden–Zwolle route from the end of 2017.
Op 16 november 2016 hebben NS, Fryslân en ProRail afgesproken dat de tweede intercity naar verwachting eind 2017 gaat rijden op het traject Leeuwarden – Zwolle.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en De Boer over de taxironselaars op Schiphol

MPs Hoogland and De Boer asked the state secretary about aggressive taxi touts at Schiphol, whether the Haarlemmermeer municipal bylaw (APV) leaves too much room for them, and what steps have been taken. The state secretary replied that the bylaw already prohibits intrusive solicitation, that enforcement is being intensified through targeted action against the worst offenders and ILT capacity, and that talks with the municipality and Schiphol are ongoing, with a possible bylaw amendment under consideration.
At present I am examining together with the municipality of Haarlemmermeer whether a further amendment of the APV can make enforcement more effective.
Op dit moment bekijk ik samen met de gemeente Haarlemmermeer of een verdere wijziging van de APV de handhaving effectiever kan maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over twee werkbezoeken aan de taxibranche d.d. 14 en 29 september 2016

MP De Boer asked the state secretary about the long delayed rollout of the mandatory taxi on-board computer (BCT), the reasonableness of charging operators for updates, enforcement and fines, and rest-time rules. The state secretary defended the market-led update approach, enforcement from 1 October 2016, an existing oversight committee, and the current rules, and promised an evaluation by 1 April 2017.
By 1 April 2017 at the latest I want to inform you about the results of this first evaluation.
Uiterlijk 1 april 2017 wil ik u informeren over de uitkomsten van deze eerste evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over “een gesprek met de spoorgoederensector over onder andere de slechte bereikbaarheid van de Rotterdamse haven”

An MP asked about the reliability of rail freight links from the Port of Rotterdam, the causes of poor punctuality, the responsibilities of ProRail, Betuweroute maintenance capacity and Moerdijk bridge repairs. The Secretary of State reported that freight punctuality (75.9% in H1 2016) is below the 80% concession floor, attributed causes to ProRail's operational choices and reduced non-commercial stops, and described existing action programmes while promising a separate letter on the Moerdijk bridge.
At present ProRail scores on this indicator below the minimum value of 80.0 percent agreed in the management concession.
Op dit moment scoort ProRail op deze indicator onder de in de beheerconcessie afgesproken bodemwaarde van 80,0 procent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer, Jacobi, Bosman en over een onderhoud met schippers uit de binnenvaart

MPs asked why commercial shipping was barred from the Krammer recreational lock, whether this and deferred maintenance cause delays and safety concerns, and about weekend closure of the Middensluis. The minister replied that the lock's structures cannot safely bear commercial use, that the maintenance is planned rather than overdue, and that weekend closure reflects low demand pending a new lock.
When commercial shipping uses the Krammer recreational lock, the structural capacity of the scaffolding and fenders is insufficient, so safety cannot always be guaranteed.

Bij gebruik van de Krammerjachtensluis door de beroepsvaart is de constructieve capaciteit van de steigers en remmingwerken niet voldoende, waardoor de veiligheid dan niet te allen tijde kan worden gewaarborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Aukje de Vries over de definitie van staatssteun inzake investeringen in havens in een richtlijn

MPs De Boer and Aukje de Vries (VVD) asked whether the government had raised the port state-aid issue with the European Commission and about the timing of EU guidance on subsidies to seaports. The minister answered that the Netherlands urged the Commission to publish state-aid guidance for seaports and to speed up revision of the block exemption, that the Commission has no current plans for such guidance, and that the Dutch corporate tax exemption for ports was ended while similar exemptions in Belgium and France are under formal investigation.
Together with the EP rapporteur for the new port regulation, Mr Fleckenstein, I sent a letter in June to EU Competition Commissioner Ms Vestager.
Samen met de EP rapporteur voor de nieuwe havenverordening, dhr. Fleckenstein, heb ik in juni jl. een brief gestuurd aan de EU Commissaris voor mededinging, mw. Vestager.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en De Boer over de inzameling van scheepsbedrijfsafval in de binnenvaart

MPs Jacobi and De Boer asked whether the shipping association ASV withdrew from consultations on ship waste collection, how the process will proceed, and whether more containers, cheaper subscriptions and waste separation will be pursued. The minister answered that ASV will present its ideas separately and at the October sector meeting, that all proposed improvements will be discussed together within a cost-recovery framework, and that expanding waste separation is included in those talks.
I want to discuss the sector's ideas with all involved parties at the same time and jointly assess which improvements are feasible
Ik wil graag de ideeën vanuit de sector met alle betrokken partijen tegelijk bespreken en gezamenlijk bezien welke verbeteringen haalbaar zijn

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Visser en De Boer naar aanleiding van de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over de adviesaanvraag dienstregeling 2017 en de diverse nieuwsberichten over de te verwachten cha

Three VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about NS timetable changes on the Kennemerlijn, overcrowding, and complaints about chaos in regional rail from April 2016. The State Secretary answered that NS is responsible for the timetable, reported falling complaint numbers after extra trains were added, stated the concession terms are met, and noted NS will add Intercity and Spitsintercity stops in the 2017 timetable.
Responsibility for designing the timetable for the main rail network and consulting stakeholders such as regional governments, other operators and consumer organisations lies with NS.

De verantwoordelijkheid voor het ontwerpen van de dienstregeling voor het hoofdrailnet en het overleg daarover met belanghebbenden als decentrale overheden, andere vervoerders en consumentenorganisaties ligt bij NS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en De Boer over de certificering van zeegaande zeilschepen

Two MPs asked the minister about outsourcing certification of sailing ships to classification societies, replacing Register Holland, including tender concerns, price rises and transition timing. The minister answered that EU rules require EU-recognised classification societies, that the ILT will oversee the transfer and arbitrate interpretation disputes, that prices will rise without a known amount, and that the transfer is planned between October 2016 and mid-2017.
I have instructed the Human Environment and Transport Inspectorate to closely supervise the transition.
Ik heb de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport de opdracht gegeven de overgang intensief te begeleiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veen, De Boer en Lodders over het artikel ‘Burgemeester Almere heeft geen tijd’

VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report that bus stone-throwing in Almere's Kruidenwijk continued and that no one had been arrested, and what role the mayor should play. The minister said about ten incidents are under investigation, some arrests have been made, the government is working on an integrated public transport safety approach with the municipality and operator, and recovery of damages through criminal proceedings is possible but no concrete statements can yet be made.
As the investigation into these various incidents is still ongoing, I cannot currently provide further substantive information on this.
Nu het onderzoek naar deze diverse incidenten nog loopt, kan ik hier op dit moment geen verdere inhoudelijke mededelingen over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Harbers, Visser, De Boer en Van Veen over het bericht ‘Nederland traag met investeren via Europa’

VVD MPs asked why the Netherlands uses relatively little EFSI investment funding, whether projects were rejected, and whether EFSI should be extended beyond 2018. The minister replied that seven Dutch EFSI transactions worth EUR 287 million have been approved, that rejections are not recorded, that the NIA was set up to help pipeline projects, and that the government will assess any extension constructively, demanding budget clarity and evaluation.
The number of rejections for EFSI is not recorded, because that may contain business-sensitive information.
Het aantal afwijzingen voor EFSI wordt niet geregistreerd, omdat dat bedrijfsgevoelige informatie kan bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Aukje de Vries over de veerdiensten naar de Waddeneilanden

Two MPs (De Boer and Aukje de Vries, VVD) asked the state secretary about price agreements under the Wadden island ferry concessions, the consultation on tariff increases, freight tariffs from Harlingen, and the structure of the concessions. The state secretary answered that tariffs have not risen since the concession became final, that the concessionaire must consult on its ferry timetable plan and that the concession authority approves it, and that freight is a free market outside the concessions.
It is up to the concession authority whether or not to approve (parts of) this transport plan, including the proposed tariffs for the next timetable year.
Het is aan de concessieverlener om al dan niet in te stemmen met (onderdelen van) dit vervoerplan, waaronder de voorgestelde tarieven voor het volgende dienstregelingsjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het rapport “Marktwerking en Samenwerking in de Binnenvaart”

An MP asked the minister about a 2012 report on market competition and cooperation in inland shipping, including whether a freight auction could help and how market transparency is arranged abroad. The minister answered that an auction would not address sector fragmentation, that private platforms exist, and that cooperation within competition law is preferred, while stating no government-run auction exists in neighbouring countries.
In my view, an auction system has no influence on an important characteristic of the inland shipping sector in relation to price formation.
Een veilingsysteem heeft naar mijn oordeel geen invloed op een belangrijk kenmerk van de binnenvaartsector in relatie tot het proces van prijsvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer, Aukje de Vries en Visser over de uitgave van Dagblad van het Noorden 2016

Three VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the navigability of the Westgat channel serving the port of Lauwersoog, whether vessels are diverting, and whether dredging or other action is justified. The minister acknowledged limited depth and possible future deepening, but argued that the situation is not urgent, that the port remains reachable, and that dredging would be costly with a low chance of payback, while offering to discuss the issue with the region.
I do not share your view that there is an urgent situation requiring action in the short term.
Ik deel uw mening niet dat hier sprake is van een urgente situatie welke noopt tot actie op korte termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en De Boer over de CvO-plicht betreffende sleepboten

MPs Jacobi and De Boer asked whether the mandatory inspection certificate (CvO) for tugboats is proportionate for recreational boating, and whether enforcement would be relaxed. The minister acknowledged the problems, said talks with the sector were ongoing and enforcement for small tugs was suspended pending their outcome, but gave no firm commitment to change the rules.
Pending the outcome of these talks, the ILT has for now suspended enforcement of the CvO obligation for small tugboats intended or used to tow small vessels.

In afwachting van de uitkomst van deze gesprekken heeft de ILT de handhaving op de CvO-plicht voor kleine sleepboten die zijn bestemd of worden gebruikt om kleine schepen te slepen vooralsnog opgeschort.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en De Boer inzake een werkbezoek aan een internationaal bedrijf dat zich richt op het ontwikkelen, ontwerpen en bouwen van schepen en materieel voor de bagger- en offshore- industri

MPs Visser and De Boer asked whether the government has policy supporting Dutch firms in international deep-sea mining, and whether a national legal framework is needed for such activities beyond national jurisdiction. The minister answers that deep-sea mining is embedded in the Topsector Water innovation agenda, that a national law is being considered through the Integraal Afwegingskader without commitment, and that Dutch influence in the International Seabed Authority does not depend on national legislation.
The preparatory process for a possible Dutch legislative process has started, in the form of applying the Integral Assessment Framework (IAK).
Het voorbereidingstraject voor het eventuele Nederlandse wetgevingsproces is gestart, in de vorm van het toepassen van het Integraal Afwegingskader (IAK).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het artikel ‘BCT-fabrikanten verwachten update deze maand uit te rollen’

An MP asked the State Secretary about delays in the BCT taxi on-board computer software update and how this affects the evaluation, enforcement and taxi operators. The government confirmed the update is delayed, that evaluation and enforcement start on schedule 1 July 2016 with full enforcement from 1 October 2016, and that the ILT will not fine honest operating mistakes during the transition period.
For the start of the evaluation it is not necessary that all BCTs are fitted with an update in order to record the first effects.
Voor de start van de evaluatie is het niet noodzakelijk dat alle BCT’s zijn voorzien van een update om de eerste effecten te kunnen optekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer, Duisenberg en Aukje de Vries over de uitgave van de Skûtsjekrant 2016

Three VVD MPs asked the minister whether the Binnenvaartbesluit and Binnenvaartregeling apply to historic sailing vessels, the bruine vloot and skûtsjes, what the effects are, whether there was consultation with the sector, and whether any fines have been issued. The minister answered that the rules have existed since 2009 with no known unclarity, that skûtsjes are exempted in key respects after sector consultation, that fines cannot be traced by vessel type, and that only the 31 December 2018 certificate obligation is new.
Fines issued in inland navigation since 2009 cannot be traced back to vessel type.
Boetes die in de binnenvaart sinds 2009 zijn afgegeven zijn niet naar type schip te herleiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Remco Dijkstra naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek aan de Waalhaven in Rotterdam op 25 april 2016

The MPs De Boer and Dijkstra (VVD) asked the state secretary about freight rail compensation for the German Betuweroute works, hazardous-goods transit under the Basisnet, rail capacity, usage charges, permits and information sharing. The state secretary answered in detail, noting State aid approval for compensation, that Basisnet exceedances are being investigated, and that she will inform parliament soon, but declined to commit to a usage-charge evaluation before summer.
