I am consulting the sector to map as quickly as possible the causes of these exceedances and which measures can be taken.
Ik ben in overleg met de sector om zo snel mogelijk in kaart te brengen wat de oorzaken zijn van deze overschrijdingen en welke maatregelen genomen kunnen worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, De Boer en Visser over de adviesaanvraag dienstregeling 2017 en de diverse nieuwsberichten over de te verwachten chaos in het (openbaar) vervoer in Noord-Kennemerland vanaf

Three VVD MPs asked the government about NS's 2017 timetable request for Noord-Kennemerland, the planned Velsertunnel closure and the risk of rail and road disruption and overcrowding in the region. The State Secretary answered that NS will adopt some stopping changes at Heiloo and Castricum, that the timetable is NS's responsibility, that Rijkswaterstaat has a mitigation plan, and that NS is monitoring capacity without having quantified combined economic impacts.
The timetable is the responsibility and expertise of NS.
De dienstregeling is de verantwoordelijkheid en deskundigheid van NS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de punctualiteitscijfers van de IC Direct

MP De Boer (VVD) asked the State Secretary about falling punctuality and rising cancellations of the IC Direct train and who is responsible. The State Secretary acknowledged the poor performance, attributed most cancellations to NS, committed to a joint improvement programme with NS and ProRail, and said new performance indicators will be agreed from 2017.
This is for me a reason to make further agreements with NS and ProRail on improvement and to record these agreements in an improvement programme.
Dit is voor mij een reden om met NS en ProRail nadere afspraken te maken over verbetering en deze afspraken vast te leggen in een verbeterprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Visser en De Boer over het bericht ‘Naar een duurzame energiehuishouding met LNG’ in het NEN magazine van februari 2016

Three VVD MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about an article on building an EU-wide LNG refuelling network, who is responsible for it, who pays, and how the Netherlands can use LNG opportunities. The minister answered that the market should build alternative fuel stations with government setting conditions, that the Netherlands supports the internal energy market, and that various LNG safety, Green Deal and promotion efforts are underway.
In principle the market is responsible for realising the networks of alternative fuel and charging stations.
In principe is de markt aan zet om de netwerken van alternatieve tank- en laadstations te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en De Boer over het artikel: 'Duitse agent gewond na steekincident op station Landgraaf'

MPs Tellegen and De Boer asked about a stabbing of a German conductor/agent at Landgraaf station and the rail-safety measures for cross-border and regional transport. The State Secretary reported on the agreed deployment of 20-22 area police officers and NS double staffing, and said responsibility for tackling aggression on public transport is shared and that a new security approach is being discussed with operators.
I am working on an integrated approach to the problem of aggression in public transport, together with the ministries of Justice and Security and the Interior and the public transport parties.
Ik werk aan een integrale aanpak van de problematiek van agressie in het OV, samen met de departementen van VenJ en BZK en de OV- partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de tarieven van de Kiwa die taxi’s betalen voor een vergunning

An MP asks the state secretary why Kiwa's fees for a taxi entrepreneur's operating permit remain near 1,500 euro after the professional-competence requirement was dropped, and whether Kiwa's tariffs must be cost-covering and why the savings are not passed on. The state secretary confirms the requirement was dropped, says tariffs are being reviewed with the ILT and that the savings will be considered in a separate letter, and states that Kiwa processes applications within the legal 12-week term (target 15 days) with no backlogs.
I will inform you about this in a separate letter to the House.
Ik informeer u daarover in een afzonderlijke kamerbrief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de vernielde spoorbrug bij het Duitse Weener d.d. 3 december 2015

An MP asked the state secretary whether she would contact her German counterpart, raise the destroyed Weener rail bridge with the EU Commissioner for CEF funding, consider a temporary bridge, and put the issue on the agenda of the Dutch EU-presidency rail summit. The state secretary answered that she will consult German partners and await DB Netz's study, will not yet commit to a CEF application, and will discuss the issue at the summit while a Groningen quick scan of a temporary bridge is underway.
I think it is logical that there is also room at this summit to discuss current issues, such as the collision with the bridge at Weener.
Ik vind het logisch dat op deze top ook ruimte is om over actuele issues te spreken, zoals de aanvaring van de brug bij Weener.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het bericht over volle treinen

MP De Boer (VVD) asked the State Secretary about reports of overcrowded trains, the causes and locations of complaints, shortage of rolling stock, reinstating Mat'64 trains, the taskforce on peak spreading and the effect on NS performance indicators. The State Secretary answered that NS's capacity performance is insufficient in places, pointed to concession obligations and fines, and deferred several questions to separate letters while stating the Mat'64 would be kept as an emergency reserve until 1 April 2016.
I will inform you further about this in a separate letter.
Via een separate brief informeer ik u hierover nader.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en De Boer over de voorgenomen proef met een peilverhoging in het Lauwersmeer

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about a planned two-year trial raising the water level at Lauwersmeer, including risks to residents, entrepreneurs and its role as a water storage area, and compensation for damage. The minister answered that the trial follows from the Natura 2000 management plan, stays within existing safety margins and is subordinate to water safety, that the matter is regional competence to be raised with the province, and that damage claims can be made under provincial compensation schemes.
I will forward the concerns and questions you have to the province of Groningen.
Ik zal de zorgen en vragen die u heeft aan de provincie Groningen doorgeleiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en De Boer over het werkbezoek aan Port of Twente en de daar gevestigde bedrijven d.d. 30 november 2015

MPs Jacobi and De Boer asked the minister how she will limit the lengthy closure of Twente Canal locks during renovation, whether business was consulted on alternatives, and whether a long closure fits the policy of stimulating water transport. The minister answered that the tender challenges the market to minimise closure days (maximum 35), that business was consulted on temporary loading points, and that phasing the works is not an option because it would lengthen total closure.
I am preparing the tender for the renovation of the Delden and Hengelo lock complexes in the Twente Canal.
Ik bereid de aanbesteding voor van de renovatie van de sluiscomplexen Delden en Hengelo in het Twentekanaal.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en De Boer over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over de ‘verslechtering van de treinverbinding tussen Alkmaar en Den Haag/Rotterdam’ van 27 maart 2015 en over de nieuwe

MPs Heerema and De Boer ask whether the new NS timetable from 15 December 2015 worsens the Alkmaar–Den Haag/Rotterdam rail link through longer transfer times and whether a three-minute earlier departure from Alkmaar could improve the Haarlem connection. The Staatssecretaris answers that NS achieved a travel-time gain of at least 10 minutes in the morning peak, that a further Haarlem transfer adjustment will follow in early 2016 rather than 15 December, and that the timetable is a complex trade-off among passenger groups.
This adjustment cannot take effect on 13 December 2015 anymore, but will be introduced in early 2016.
Deze aanpassing kan niet meer per 13 december 2015 van kracht worden, maar wordt begin 2016 ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en De Boer over de intercitystatus van station Schiedam Centrum en de mogelijkheden voor realisatie van station Schiedam Kethel

Two MPs asked the state secretary about keeping Intercity stops at Schiedam Centrum under the PHS timetable and about options for a new Schiedam Kethel station. The state secretary said no formal Intercity status exists, that Schiedam Centrum loses Intercity stops without extra measures, and that a variant D upgrade is being studied but no extra funding is currently available, while declining to study the Kethel station options further.
The region is free to expand the research assignment with this question, if desired.
Het staat de regio overigens vrij om, indien gewenst, de onderzoeksopdracht met deze vraagstelling te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het uit de roulatie halen van treinen

The MP asks whether the government knew of the decision to withdraw the Mat'64 train type, why it was taken, how many seats are lost, and whether NS meets its concession obligations. The Secretary of State explains that NS withdrew the Mat'64 after a safety signal from the ILT, that extending service was rejected for safety, maintenance and capacity reasons, and that NS is bound by performance indicators and fines but the choice of rolling stock is NS's own.
I have confronted NS about the expected shortfall and asked it to pull out all the stops to achieve performance improvement.
Ik heb NS aangesproken op het door NS verwachte tekort en gevraagd alles uit de kast te halen om tot prestatieverbetering te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Aukje de Vries over de berichten “Werkgroep: “Haven Lauwersoog is gedoemd te verdwijnen” en “Haven Lauwerseach ferdwynt as polityk neat docht”

MPs De Boer and Aukje de Vries asked the minister about reports that the Lauwersoog harbour is doomed, the state of the Westgat shipping channel and its economic effects, responsibilities for dredging, and an ongoing study. The minister disputes the doom conclusion, describes the silting and Rijkswaterstaat's responsibilities and planned studies, and promises to inform the House when the studies are finished.
I will inform you of the outcomes afterwards.
Ik zal u daarna over de uitkomsten informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en De Boer over het bericht “Krimpbeleid Oost-Groningen zorgwekkend”

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the 2.24 million euro population-decline grant for East Groningen carries conditions, and whether regional rather than Gemeentefonds-based approaches should lead on shrinkage policy. The government answered that the funds are unconditional Gemeentefonds money, favours an integrated cross-municipal approach encouraged by designating one centre municipality per shrinkage region, and says it already works with the province and region on shrinkage policy.
The funds are part of the municipal fund and are therefore not tied to any conditions.
De middelen zijn onderdeel van het gemeentefonds en daarmee niet aan voorwaarden gebonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Veldman over het bericht dat de NS spitstreinen elders in het land schrapt ter bevordering van SAIL in Amsterdam

MPs De Boer and Veldman asked whether NS cutting off-peak local train services to free capacity for Sail Amsterdam was acceptable, how often this happens, its effect on punctuality targets and on reserve rolling stock and maintenance. The State Secretary answered that the local, limited cuts were a considered choice for passengers, that this had not happened before for large events, that cancellations under 48 hours count toward punctuality, and that reserve stock and deferred maintenance were used.
It has not previously happened that NS had to systematically cancel train services during large events.
Het is niet eerder voorgekomen dat NS planmatig treindiensten heeft moeten schrappen tijdens grote evenementen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het bericht dat er een miljoenenstrop dreigt voor de verbouwing van station Utrecht

An MP asked about reports of a multi-million-euro cost overrun for the Utrecht station rebuild, its causes, the ministry's monitoring of ProRail and the reasons for late warning. The state secretary answered in detail, acknowledging a cost increase and delay driven by safety rules and design changes, pointing to an external review due in autumn 2015, but declining to judge ProRail's conduct before that review is complete.
On the outcomes of this review I will inform your House after its completion.
Over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek zal ik uw Kamer na afronding ervan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de langeafstandsbus en de verdere mogelijkheden in Nederland

An MP asked the state secretary about long-distance bus services, EU Regulation 1073/2009, and whether the Dutch market should be opened further, citing Germany and France. The state secretary answered that cross-border bus services are permitted, that domestic long-distance buses fall under provincial concessions unless exempted, and that no further liberalisation study was committed to.
However, deploying operators requires obtaining a concession or an exemption from it, or operating transport without a timetable, whether or not as part of an international bus service.

Wel vergt het inzet van de ondernemers om een concessie of een ontheffing hiervan te verkrijgen, dan wel vervoer zonder dienstregeling te exploiteren al dan niet als onderdeel van een internationale buslijndienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Jacobi over de positie van zeilende zeegaande en binnenvaartpassagiersschepen en motorpassagiersschepen binnen de Woningwet, Omgevingswet en de Erfgoedwet

Two MPs asked whether sailing sea-going and inland passenger ships and motor passenger ships should fall under the building definition in the Woningwet and Omgevingswet, given their minor residential use. The minister agreed they should not be treated as buildings, said this will be clarified in the explanatory memorandum, and promised further information on the heritage vessel position by year end.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Aukje de Vries over het onderzoek naar het reilen en zeilen van de NS

VVD MPs De Boer and Aukje de Vries asked whether law firm De Brauw, which investigated irregularities in the NS Limburg tender while also advising NS on challenging the ACM's findings, has a conflict of interest, and whether an independent body should take over the investigation. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that he sees no reason to doubt De Brauw's integrity, but agreed with the supervisory board that a second opinion on the Limburg investigation will be commissioned and that another firm will investigate the other tenders NS or its subsidiaries bid for.

To avoid any appearance of partiality and to rule out any doubt about the soundness of the investigations, I have agreed with the NS supervisory board that a researcher will be asked to give a second opinion

Om elke schijn van partijdigheid te vermijden en iedere twijfel over de gedegenheid van de onderzoeken uit te sluiten, heb ik met de raad van commissarissen van de NS afgesproken dat een onderzoeker wordt gevraagd een second opinion te geven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Visser en De Boer over het bericht «Ruim miljoen voor schone bussen»

Three VVD MPs asked why the hydrogen bus pilot in Amsterdam would not be repeated, what it contributed, how zero-emission buses fit climate policy, whether returning the buses after three years was a sound use of public money, and whether the project goals were SMART. The Secretary of State answered that the pilot served as an alpha test that led a bus manufacturer to invest in hydrogen buses, that the new subsidy projects continue in five regions, and that selection criteria and reporting obligations apply.
Na afloop wordt de regeling geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en de Boer over loslopende reeën ter hoogte van de Oostvaardersplassen

MPs Heerema and De Boer asked whether roaming deer near the Oostvaardersplassen, which briefly halted some Intercity services, can be prevented from disrupting trains, and whether Staatsbosbeheer should be made to secure the fencing. The state secretary answered that preventive fencing exists, the disruption was limited and brief, and Staatsbosbeheer and ProRail are coordinating on possible extra measures.
It is not possible to give an indication of the costs of a disruption, because this differs strongly per situation.
Het is niet mogelijk een indicatie te geven van de kosten van een verstoring, omdat dit per situatie sterk verschilt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en De Boer over het bericht “Stad is klaar met tunnelmalaise”

MPs Visser and De Boer asked about reports of frequent tunnel closures at the Coentunnel and Schipholtunnel caused by overheight trucks, fire alarms and power failures, and their economic cost. The minister confirms 25 to 30 weekly overheight stoppages at the Coentunnel, lists six Schiphol tunnel disruptions in Q1 2015, says no damage cost estimate exists, and promises intensified monitoring and further study.
For this reason I will intensify the monitoring of the closures at the Coentunnel.
Om deze reden zal ik de monitoring van de stremmingen bij de Coentunnel intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Jacobi over de bruine vloot en de mogelijkheden om in Denemarken te varen

Two MPs asked the minister whether the deadline for certifying Dutch sailing ships (the 'bruine vloot') to sail to Danish ports could be postponed to winter, and whether she would negotiate with Denmark. The minister replied that a formalised solution now lets such ships sail to Denmark on a declaration of compliance plus a certified safety management system due by year-end.
I am pleased to inform you that the solution proposal about which I informed you earlier has been formalised.
Met genoegen kan ik u melden dat het oplossingsvoorstel waarover ik u eerder heb geïnformeerd, is geformaliseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Hoogland over het bericht ‘Geen boete abonnementhouder zwartrijden’

MPs De Boer and Hoogland asked the state secretary about reports that passengers with subscriptions are fined for forgetting to check in when their travel right is already paid for, and about the Rover/Consumentenbond research and the number of disputes. The state secretary defended the mandatory check-in for uniformity and traveller benefits, said he asked carriers for a coulance policy, and that he lacks data on court appeals and on which subscriptions and carriers fine such travellers.
I have asked the carriers to come up with a joint coulance policy for this.
Ik heb de vervoerders gevraagd hiervoor gezamenlijk met een coulancebeleid te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, De Boer en Dik-Faber over mobiliteitskaarten

MPs asked whether NS unilaterally terminated contracts with alternative mobility-card providers, whether this threatens an NS monopoly, and whether ACM is investigating. The state secretary answered that NS did not renew contracts on the same terms, agreed in principle with some providers, and that ACM has found no apparent infringement and is not starting an investigation.
ACM is currently not starting an investigation and for the time being is halting its official interventions.
ACM start op dit moment geen onderzoek en staakt vooralsnog de ambtelijke interventies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Dik-Faber over reizen met de trein door blinden en slechtzienden

Two MPs (De Boer, VVD, and Dik-Faber, ChristenUnie) asked the state secretary about blind and partially sighted train passengers not being clearly told which side of the train to alight on, and about the quality of on-board announcements. The secretary acknowledged the issue, said NS is examining the safety impact and passenger perception before deciding, and reported improvements to announcement equipment and a planned revision of the VIRM intercity announcement systems.
NS wants to first investigate the impact on safety of implementing this measure and how other travellers experience information about the exit side.
NS wil de impact op de veiligheid bij uitvoering van deze maatregel en de hoe andere reizigers informatie over de uitstapzijde ervaren eerst onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de spoorovergangen in Deurne en de noodzaak om in ieder geval de Binderendreef aan te pakken

An MP asked the state secretary whether the level crossing on the Binderendreef in Deurne, which faces longer waiting times from increased freight traffic, is safe and whether it can be added to the national level-crossing improvement list. The state secretary answered that ProRail's analysis shows no safety risk and that the crossing is not on the priority list, but the ministry is willing to consider it with the region through the regional coordinator.
The ministry is willing to think along with the region on this.
Vanuit IenM bestaat de bereidheid om hierbij mee te denken met de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Jacobi over de problemen die de bruine vloot ondervindt in Denemarken

Two MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the status of a deal with Denmark allowing Dutch commercial sailing charter vessels to sail in Danish waters, the BBZ's concerns, and whether ILT inspections would be done in time before 1 April. The minister said the solution is being formalised with Denmark, the BBZ will endorse it, certification will be done by Bureau Veritas with ILT as fallback, and extra time is being sought with Denmark for implementing the safety management system.
I am therefore in consultation with Denmark to allow extra time for this.
Ik ben daarom in overleg met Denemarken om hiervoor extra tijd in te ruimen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en De Boer over de verslechtering van de treinverbinding tussen Alkmaar en Den Haag/Rotterdam

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about the worsened rail connection between Alkmaar and The Hague/Rotterdam, including longer travel times, a Haarlem transfer and missed connections. The state secretary answered that NS prioritises the largest passenger flows, admits the Haarlem transfer is missed too often, and commits to faster Intercity services in the peak from the 2016 timetable.
I share the view that the transfer is too often not made and expect NS and ProRail to work to improve this.
Ik deel de mening dat de overstap te vaak niet wordt gehaald en verwacht dat NS en ProRail zich inzetten om dit te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en De Boer over het winnen van de aanbesteding in Limburg door Abellio

MPs De Vries and De Boer asked whether NS's subsidiary Abellio could bid in the Limburg public transport tender without being cross-subsidised and on a level playing field with commercial rivals, and how its return and finances fit NS's required return. The minister answers that the bid was discussed with the shareholder, meets NS's investment criteria, is market-conform in financing, and that NS does not report subsidiary-level returns publicly.
Providing insight into the return per business unit, subsidiary and participation could lead to a deterioration of NS's competitive and negotiating position.
Inzicht geven in het rendement per bedrijfsonderdeel, dochteronderneming en deelnemingen kan leiden tot een verslechtering van de concurrentie- en onderhandelingspositie van de NS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en De Boer over de Zaanse spoorlijn

MPs Visser and De Boer asked the State Secretary about the high number of complaints (712) on the Zaan railway line, its structural lack of peak capacity, plans for more frequent Randstad services, and the role of the concession in enforcing improvements. The State Secretary answered that NS is under a concession obligation to improve capacity, the Zaandam-Amsterdam line is one of ten focus routes, train extensions and new rolling stock are planned, and the ministry is in ongoing discussion with NS, with sanctions possible if needed.
On the implementation of that programme my department is in discussion with NS and, if necessary, enforcement will follow under the concession.
Over de uitvoering van dat programma is mijn departement in gesprek met NS en zo nodig zal hierop conform de concessie worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het artikel ‘Ongekend amateurisme van treindienstleiding, Reiziger dupe van gestuntel ProRail'

The MP asks whether ProRail's train control mishandled a temporary speed restriction in the Delft tunnel, including wrong speed signs that led to cancelling two trains, and whether ProRail has the problems under control given recent rail incidents. The state secretary explains the speed limit was set to protect against pressure waves, notes the wrong signs were corrected and cancelling trains was an adequate response, and says the incidents are separate and that the Beter en Meer programme with NS addresses reliability.
The correct speed is now shown on the signs.
Inmiddels is de juiste snelheid op de borden aangebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkhoff en De Boer over cyberaanvallen op reisinformatiedienst 9292

Two VVD MPs asked whether the NCSC would assist travel information service 9292 against cyberattacks, arguing it has a statutory duty to inform travellers. The Minister replied that travel information providers are not a vital sector, so NCSC direct support is not provided, that 9292 has no statutory information duty, and that NCSC will consult 9292 on making its public knowledge available.
Incidentally, 9292 has no statutory duty to provide information to the traveller.
9292 heeft overigens geen wettelijke plicht tot informatievoorziening aan de reiziger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het winnen van de openbaarvervoerconcessie in Limburg door Abellio

The MP De Boer asks the government about the return requirements (normrendement) for NS and Abellio, and whether Abellio's winning bid for the Limburg rail concession fits the state's shareholder return policy. The Finance Minister answers that NS uses a 7% normrendement on equity, that the business case for Abellio is confidential, and provides NS's 2010-2014 return figures, but gives no forward-looking statements.
Because of commercial confidentiality, I cannot say anything about the business case underlying the bid.
Ik kan vanwege de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid geen uitspraken doen over de business case die ten grondslag ligt aan de bieding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en De Boer over het bericht 'NS wil af van winkelvastgoed'

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about a report that NS (the state railway) wants to divest property and non-core retail, and about its consequences for the state's role as shareholder and concession grantor. The ministers answered that the divestments are gradual and market-driven, that they favour keeping station management in public hands with a regulatory role, and that the concession is unaffected, leaving much of the shareholder assessment to the shareholder itself.
It is mainly up to the shareholder to assess whether the strategy of the entire NS group is in line with the public interests of the railway.
Het is met name aan de aandeelhouder om te beoordelen of de strategie van het gehele NS-concern in lijn is met de publieke belangen van het spoor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Hoogland over de aanpak van gevaarlijke overwegen

MPs De Boer and Hoogland asked the state secretary about dangerous unguarded level crossings in the Netherlands, including the Voslaan crossing in Winsum, and whether a risk ranking, the Groningen study, LVO or ProRail funding, and innovative solutions could be provided. The state secretary answered that 154 publicly accessible unguarded crossings exist on the passenger network, promised an integrated approach and ranking to the Chamber in May, reserved 10 million euro from the LVO for Winsum with regional co-financing, and said innovative options are being explored.
As promised to your Chamber during the General Consultation on Rail Safety on 27 November, you will receive a proposal this spring for an integrated approach to non-actively secured level crossings.

Zoals aan uw Kamer toegezegd tijdens het Algemeen Overleg Spoorveiligheid op 27 november jongstleden ontvangt u dit voorjaar een voorstel voor de integrale aanpak van niet-actief beveiligde overwegen (nabo's).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het uitbreiden van nachtnet

An MP asked the State Secretary whether NS could be required, under the rail concession, to extend night train services in Brabant and Groningen, or to let regional operators do so cheaper. The State Secretary answered that NS decides how to meet its concession obligations, that regional governments may co-finance night trains, and that agreements have been reached with Groningen and Drenthe while talks with Noord-Brabant continue.
I am awaiting the outcomes of that and will inform you as soon as possible.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten daarvan af en zal u zo spoedig mogelijk informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde en De Boer over het ACM-besluit over de overtreding van de Spoorwegwet door NS

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about an ACM finding that NS breached Article 67 of the Spoorwegwet, whether NS blocked publication and threatened a damages claim over the Limburg tender, and whether ACM would publish its decision and correspondence before the Spoorwegwet debate. The State Secretary confirmed one article was breached, said NS sought interim relief and announced a possible damages claim, and declined to request publication or correspondence, citing ACM's independence and pending legal proceedings, while committing to send the answers to Parliament.
Given the independence of the ACM, it is for the ACM and possibly the court to decide on making this information public.
Gelet op de onafhankelijkheid van de ACM is het aan de ACM en eventueel de rechter om te beslissen over het openbaar maken van deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Visser over de vervanging van de Borgbrug in Groningen

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the lengthy closure of the Borgbrug in Groningen after a ship collision, the delay in reopening, alternatives such as using the ring road, and safety on the Driebondsweg. The minister explained the damage and repair timeline (reopening expected mid-July), said alternative routes and bus transport were arranged, and reported police and municipal measures on safety.
Rijkswaterstaat expects to be able to put the bridge back into use around mid-July.
Rijkswaterstaat verwacht de brug op medio juli weer in gebruik te kunnen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het winnen van de aanbesteding in Limburg door Abellio

An MP asked the state secretary about Abellio winning the Limburg public transport concession, Veolia's disqualification, possible cross-subsidy and guarantees from parent NS, station activities, and dividend and investment arrangements. The government answered that the province is the contracting authority and responsible for the award, that Veolia's bid was invalid for exceeding the permitted extra fee, that the Finance Ministry found no evidence of cross-subsidy, and that it lacks knowledge of bids and internal NS arrangements.
The province of Limburg is the contracting authority and therefore responsible for awarding this concession.
De provincie Limburg is de aanbestedende partij en daarmee verantwoordelijk voor het gunnen van deze concessie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de chaos op het spoor op 2 februari 2015

An MP asked the state secretary why a computer failure at the Utrecht rail control post caused a nationwide disruption on 2 February 2015 and whether ProRail and NS can resolve such problems quickly. The state secretary explained a hardware failure and a staged, safety-driven restart, with ProRail to report by end of March, and noted the winter-weather letter had already been sent.
ProRail is expected to report to the ministry at the end of March on the investigation, the analyses and the measures.
ProRail rapporteert naar verwachting eind maart over het onderzoek, de analyses en maatregelen aan het ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het bericht “Gratis reizen op de NS Jaartrajectkaart

An MP asked the State Secretary whether NS annual rail pass holders could travel free outside their purchased route, how much revenue was lost, and whether the minister would act or raise it with the national transport body. The State Secretary confirmed some holders travel beyond their route without being charged, said NS treats it as a business choice, and declined to intervene since the product is being phased out by 8 July 2015.
Since travellers have suffered no disadvantage, there is no reason for the ministry, as concession grantor, to take action on this.
Aangezien de reizigers geen nadeel hebben ondervonden is er voor het ministerie als concessieverlener geen aanleiding om hier actie op te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en De Boer over het bericht dat de Duitse regering nu ook tol wil op het water

MPs Visser and De Boer asked the minister about reports that Germany wants to introduce tolls on waterways, and about the consequences for Dutch inland shipping, ports, competitiveness and EU internal market goals. The minister replied that the German plans are still in preparation and cannot yet be assessed, that she opposes tolls on other waterways than the Rhine because they could shift cargo to other modes, and that she follows the matter actively and will raise it with her German counterpart when warranted.
There is as yet no clarity whatsoever about the content and publication of a specific regulation for toll charging on waterways.
Over de inhoud en publicatie van een specifieke regeling voor tolheffing op vaarwegen bestaat nu nog geen enkele duidelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het bericht 'Lokale lasten maken onze haven te duur'

MP De Boer (VVD) asked the Minister whether Rotterdam port firms pay double local levies that make the port less competitive, whether small firms are leaving and few new firms settling. Minister Schultz van Haegen replied that the double-payment claim is incorrect since property and advertising levies are general taxes set by Rotterdam municipality, that she has no signals of small firms leaving, and that she will press the European Commission for state aid guidelines for seaports.
The claim about paying levies twice is incorrect.
De stelling omtrent het dubbel betalen van lasten is onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het bericht ‘Gevoel dat het heftiger wordt’ over de vele storingen en treinvertragingen in het noorden van Nederland

An MP asked the state secretary about rail disruptions and delays in northern Netherlands, including ProRail's performance, causes of disruptions on the Roodeschool-Groningen line, regional authorities' influence over maintenance, and the usage fee increase. The state secretary answered that punctuality has been stable or improved, detailed causes of disruptions, pointed to consultation rights and performance indicators for regional authorities, and explained the fee methodology.
In addition, ProRail developed methodological changes at the instigation of the ACM and in line with the EU directive.
Daarnaast heeft ProRail vernieuwingen in de methodiek ontwikkeld op instigatie van de ACM
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Aukje De Vries over het bericht over overboord geslagen containers boven Ameland

MPs De Boer and Aukje de Vries asked about ten containers lost overboard near Ameland, their recovery, liability, follow-up on a 2010 inspection report on container lashing, and the frequency of losses. The minister answered that recovery is the owner's responsibility under Rijkswaterstaat supervision, that lashing enforcement continues within regular inspections, and that IMO work on container mass is nearing completion.
It is not customary to publicize details about the ship widely, so as to avoid negatively affecting the further cooperation of those involved.
Het is niet gebruikelijk gegevens over het schip breed bekend te maken om te voorkomen dat nadere medewerking van betrokkenen negatief kan worden beïnvloed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de Nederlandse chartervaart in Denemarken

An MP asks the minister about the dispute over Dutch sail charter vessels (bruine vloot) in Denmark, which Denmark requires to meet SOLAS safety rules, and about bilateral talks and possible EU court action. The minister acknowledges the problem, reports a rejected Danish compromise, says she is willing to contact her Danish counterpart again, and says the Commission infringement procedure is nearly closed while a bilateral solution is still sought.
I am willing to contact my Danish colleague to reach an agreement acceptable to the majority of the skippers.
Ik ben bereid contact op te nemen met mijn Deense collega, om tot een voor de meerderheid van de schippers acceptabel akkoord te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het ongeluk met fatale afloop op een onbeveiligde overgang bij Winsum

An MP asks the State Secretary about a fatal accident at an unprotected level crossing near Winsum and whether the crossing should be secured urgently under the national crossing improvement programme, and whether a mini-AHOB barrier could be installed quickly. The State Secretary regrets the accidents, says the programme budget is insufficient for this crossing, asks ProRail to evaluate the approach for unprotected crossings, and reports that ProRail and local authorities are assessing concrete options for Winsum.

To that end I will ask ProRail to carry out an evaluation over the coming months of the effectiveness of the approach to non-actively secured crossings in recent years and to submit a proposal for a follow-up approach to me soon.

Daartoe zal ik ProRail vragen de komende maanden een evaluatie te doen op de effectiviteit van de aanpak van de niet-actief beveiligde overwegen in de afgelopen jaren en mij spoedig een voorstel te doen voor een vervolgaanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Remco Dijkstra over Spoorhinder in Den Bosch en Rosmalen

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about rail noise and vibration complaints from residents in Den Bosch and Rosmalen, and about agreements made with them and possible speed limits for freight trains. The state secretary said the two cases differ, that noise and safety rules are met, that vibration is being studied and talks are ongoing, and that a speed-limit pilot in Rosmalen and an investigation for Den Bosch will be carried out.
Together with residents, the municipality and ProRail, my ministry will look into setting up a pilot.
Samen met omwonenden, de gemeente en ProRail zal mijn ministerie kijken naar de inrichting van een proef.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de relingplicht voor binnenvaartschepen

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the temporary railing requirement (relingplicht) for inland vessels, including its scope and whether the inspectorate applies the same rules. The minister explained the transitional rules, that the requirement was extended to 30 November 2017, and that the inspectorate applies CCR rules without deviation.
In working out this, I aim to ensure that existing vessels are left untouched.
Bij de uitwerking hiervan zet ik erop in dat bestaande schepen ongemoeid worden gelaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de nieuwe regels op het Prinses Margrietkanaal en het Van Starkenborghkanaal

MP De Boer asked about new speed limits and restricted bridge operation on the Prinses Margrietkanaal and Van Starkenborghkanaal, including collision risk, accident data, wind and fog rules. The minister answered that speed reductions respond to damaging collisions and bridge constraints, bridges can operate up to wind force 8, and fog restrictions are for safety, with some information not available.
It is not known whether accidents specifically caused by fog have occurred on the main waterway Lemmer-Delfzijl.
Het is niet bekend of op de hoofdvaarweg Lemmer-Delfzijl er specifiek door mist ongevallen zijn gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de de spoorlijn Maastricht-Lanaken

An MP asked why the Maastricht–Lanaken rail line, renovated at great cost, has seen almost no freight traffic and whether it can be revived. The State Secretary said the line remains available, freight demand did not materialise on either side of the border, and he is positive about a light-rail proposal from the province, now under discussion with ProRail and the province.
I am positive about this proposal. ProRail, the Province of Limburg and I are in discussion about it.
Ik sta positief tegenover dit voorstel. ProRail, Provincie Limburg en ik zijn daarover in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over een coördinerend minister voor de maritieme sector

MP De Boer (VVD) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about a proposed coordinating minister for the maritime sector, the level playing field for shipping, and work permit problems facing the owner of the cruise ship Oasis of the Seas. The minister supports better coordination without changing other departments' responsibilities, and says the permit problems stem from late applications and should be resolved through cooperation.
I am in favour of better coordination and alignment of maritime policy and a transparent and accessible government, so that matters for the sector can be resolved quickly.
Ik ben voorstander van een betere coördinatie en afstemming van het maritieme beleid en een transparante en toegankelijke overheid, zodat zaken voor de sector snel opgelost kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over uitstoot op zee

An MP asked the minister whether stricter sulphur rules from January 2015 would sharply raise bunker costs for container shipping and harm Dutch ports' competitiveness, and whether the government would limit the cost increase. The minister answered that shippers can comply via low-sulphur fuel, LNG or scrubbers, that modal shift risk is limited to 1-9% on a few routes, and declined to intervene in fuel price formation.
I will keep an eye on what the practical consequences of the new sulphur oxide emission standards for ships are.
Ik zal in de gaten houden wat in de praktijk de gevolgen zijn van de nieuwe normen voor uitstoot van zwaveloxide door schepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het uitwijken van schepen van de haven van Rotterdam naar Antwerpen

An MP asked whether deep-sea shipping lines are shifting cargo from Rotterdam to Antwerp due to congestion, how much, and whether urgent action is needed. The minister disputes that a substantive shift is occurring, attributes congestion to market fluctuations and terminal adjustments, and points to new terminal capacity opening on Maasvlakte 2.
From information I obtained from the Rotterdam port business community, I gather that the conclusions in the cited article are not shared.
Uit informatie die ik heb ingewonnen bij het Rotterdamse havenbedrijfsleven maak ik op dat de conclusies in het aangehaalde artikel niet worden gedeeld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Visser over het aan te leggen stuk spoor bij Beverwijk en overige werkzaamheden naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek van de leden van de VVD-fractie aan Tata Steel in IJmuiden

Two VVD MPs asked about extending the Beverwijk rail head track to 750 metres, the cost of rail freight, and coordination of overlapping infrastructure works in the North Sea Canal area. The State Secretary answered that ProRail is responsible for the track extension due in 2016, that rail freight measures are in the Long-Term Rail Agenda, and that Rijkswaterstaat coordinates works through annual multi-year planning and regional consultation.
It is of great importance for businesses that infrastructure works are well coordinated with one another.
Het is voor bedrijven van groot belang dat werkzaamheden aan de infrastructuur goed op elkaar worden afgestemd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en De Boer over een bericht in het Eindhovens Dagblad van 28 mei 2014, dat reizen naar Brussel per Thalys goedkoper is met een kaartje naar Parijs

MPs Hoogland and De Boer asked why a Thalys ticket to Brussels can be cheaper when bought as a ticket to Paris, and whether the minister would negotiate with NS to offer the cheapest possible fare. The state secretary explained that Thalys uses yield management pricing set by seat availability and expected demand, that the Thalys is not regulated by national or European rules so operators set their own fares, and that more Thalys services are expected to increase cheaper ticket options.
The Thalys is a train product that is not regulated by national or European rules.
De Thalys is een treinproduct dat niet door nationale of Europese regels wordt gereguleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de situatie bij ProRail

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary about ProRail's performance figures, the departures of its president-director and finance director, the absence of a crisis manager, and a safety/punctuality baseline report. The state secretary explained that the rijdendetreinen.nl figures cover different things than ProRail's data, attributed the departures to the new long-term rail agenda, said the leadership remains complete with interim arrangements, and promised a proposal from the supervisory board and a forthcoming ILT report.
I expect a proposal from the Supervisory Board in the short term on how both the temporary and the definitive arrangement will take shape.
Ik verwacht op korte termijn een voorstel van de Raad van Commissarissen hoe zowel de tijdelijke als de definitieve invulling vorm krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van lid De Boer over uitspraken van de directeur Openbaar Vervoer van het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu

An MP asks whether the Secretary of State agrees with the Ministry's public transport director that NS will keep running the main rail network after 2020, and how that squares with the option to shorten the concession and tender it if NS fails its conditions. The answers say the concession runs 10 years with a midterm review that can lead to changes, and that under the 2000 passenger transport act the concession can be wholly or partly withdrawn for serious negligence, though this would be a proportionate, carefully considered step whose conditions will be set out in the concession itself.
This does not affect the fact that at a midterm review I will assess NS's performance sharply.
Dit laat onverlet dat ik bij een midterm review de prestaties van NS scherp ga beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Remco Dijkstra over de veiligheidssituatie op rangeerterrein Kijfhoek

MPs De Boer and Dijkstra asked about the safety situation at the Kijfhoek rail yard after the Council of State annulled added safety conditions in its environmental permit, and about the risks for nearby municipalities. The Secretary of State answered that the site meets all legal requirements, that the Council of State ruling limits local rules, that a working framework with stakeholders is planned by end April 2014, and that additional measures for the Betuweroute will be sent to parliament after the summer.
Consultations have meanwhile taken place between the municipality of Zwijndrecht and the ministry, in consultation with the parties involved, about the ruling.
Over de uitspraak is inmiddels ook overleg gevoerd tussen de gemeente Zwijndrecht en het ministerie, in samenspraak met betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek van de VVD-fractie aan het station in Hoorn

The VVD MP De Boer asked the State Secretary about timetable changes that skip stops at Hoorn Kersenboogerd, leaving overcrowded trains, and asked whether NS will restore more stops. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems, explained NS measures to reduce Sprinter delays and said NS is considering restoring stops and working with ProRail on a lasting solution.
Without an extensive customer survey, NS cannot determine how these passengers now travel and how many passengers now board at Hoorn instead of Kersenboogerd.
NS kan zonder een uitvoerig klantenonderzoek niet vaststellen hoe deze reizigers nu reizen en hoeveel reizigers nu op station Hoorn instappen in plaats van op Kersenboogerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het bericht dat de verbinding Alkmaar - Haarlem louter zal bestaan uit stoptreinen

An MP asked the State Secretary about NS plans to convert the Alkmaar–Haarlem intercity into stopping trains and whether a fast connection would be kept. The State Secretary answered that NS is responsible for timetable design within concession rules, that a consumer advisory procedure is pending, and that the government will not intervene in the timetable beyond setting broad frameworks.
The role of the government is to set frameworks from the public interest.
De rol van de overheid is kaders stellen vanuit het maatschappelijk belang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het voorstel van ‘Kap op de bak’ in Lansingerland

An MP asks the State Secretary about the 'Kap op de bak' (open cover) proposal from the Stop Geluidshinder HSL foundation for noise reduction in Lansingerland, and whether the Chamber will be informed about the plan and the feasibility of a pilot. The State Secretary welcomes the initiative and states that a letter on the feasibility of a pilot is being sent to the Chamber alongside the answers.
At the same time as this answer, I am sending the Chamber a cover letter informing it about the feasibility of a pilot of this 'Open Kap' plan.
Tegelijkertijd met deze beantwoording stuur ik uw Kamer een aanbiedingsbrief waarmee ik de Kamer informeer over de haalbaarheid van een pilot van dit «Open Kap»-plan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en De Boer over problemen met de wissels op het spoor

MPs Hoogland and De Boer asked the state secretary about railway switch failures and related ProRail maintenance and knowledge gaps, including the lack of spare parts and whether preventive replacement was done. The state secretary answered that no specific repair deadlines are set in the management plan, that spare parts were procured via a Swedish counterpart and urgent order, and that the ILT and Safety Board investigations are ongoing with ILT results expected in Q3 2014.
The ILT investigation focuses on the role of the switch and the rolling stock in the derailment and the operation of the signals.
Het onderzoek van de ILT richt zich op de rol van het wissel en het materieel bij de ontsporing en de werking van de seinen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het artikel ‘Husa stapt uit spoorvervoer’

An MP asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about Husa's exit from rail freight, the continued subsidy to rail freight, the level playing field with neighbouring countries, cost recovery rules and competitiveness versus road transport. The State Secretary answers that Husa made its own business decision, that EU rules govern the playing field, that the subsidy scheme (EUR 42.2 million in 2008-2013) ends after 2013, and that an action plan for rail freight is being prepared.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Boer over het artikel ‘Juridische spaghetti rond de Baltic Ace’

An MP asked the minister whether the state bears the cost of salvaging the Baltic Ace wreck and whether it can recover those costs from owners, and whether the government is pursuing better ways to hold shipowners liable. The minister answered that the state pays the salvage company and recovers costs from the owners, though liability limitation treaties allow only part to be recovered, and promised a letter in spring 2014 plus implementing legislation for the Nairobi Wreck Removal Convention in Q3 2014.
I expect to be able to inform the House in more detail about this in spring 2014.
Ik verwacht de Kamer in het voorjaar van 2014 hierover nader te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en De Boer over het bericht «Uitstel aanleg Seine-Nord-kanaal domper voor havens Zeeland»

MPs Bosman and De Boer asked the Infrastructure minister whether the postponement of the Seine-Nord canal, a TEN-T priority project, harms Zeeland ports, whether France can delay it alone, and whether the Netherlands can recover financial losses or pressure France. The minister answered that France decides on timing, EU coordination is limited, financial consequences are hard to state, and Dutch contacts with France continue without a formal demand.
The Netherlands supports France's subsidy application, but the construction remains a French matter.
Nederland steunt de subsidieaanvraag van Frankrijk, maar de aanleg blijft verder een Franse aangelegenheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bosman en De Boer over het artikel ‘Havenbaronnen kapen onze bedrijven weg’

MPs Bosman and De Boer asked whether Belgian ports receive state subsidies that disadvantage Dutch ports and whether this breaches a level playing field in Europe. The minister acknowledged Flemish funding for Flemish seaports, said Dutch ports are not on a level playing field in harbour-internal costs, and said existing EU rules are insufficient but she supports the proposed EU Port Regulation and state-aid guidelines.
That is why I am in principle positive about the proposed EU Port Regulation.
Daarom sta ik in beginsel positief tegenover de voorgestelde EU Havenverordening.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, De Boer en De Rouwe over het project Zwolle Spoort

MPs asked the state secretary why the Zwolle Spoort rail project was delayed, what extra measures and budget are needed, whether the research report will be shared, and what the preferred variant and timetable consequences are. The government replied that a broader alternatives study is being deepened over the summer, a preferred alternative will be chosen in autumn in consultation with regional authorities, and a final report is expected in October and will be sent to parliament.
I can send this final report to your House.
Dit eindrapport kan ik aan uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en De Boer over de verdeling van verantwoordelijkheden bij het opstellen van de Lange Termijn Spooragenda

MPs Dik-Faber and De Boer asked why the ministry assigns elaboration of the long-term rail agenda (LTSA) to NS and ProRail, and how FMN transport companies can be meaningfully involved. The state secretary answers that the ministry keeps the lead on priorities and concessions, that NS and ProRail are responsible for the operational rail concept under their concessions, and that FMN is being involved through meetings and invitations.
I have the lead in the recalibration and possible reprioritisation of rail programmes and projects based on the goals of the rail agenda.
Ik heb het voortouw bij de herijking en mogelijke herprioritering van de spoorprogramma’s en projecten op basis van de doelen van de Spooragenda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het bericht ‘Duitse sluiswachters houden schippers op’

An MP from the VVD asked the minister whether she knew of reports that German lock keepers were obstructing Dutch barge operators, and whether she would press her German counterpart to end the strikes given the harm to the Dutch economy and EU free movement of goods. The minister confirmed awareness, said she had already raised the issue with her German counterpart in July and again by letter on 27 August, asking Germany to do its utmost to end the strikes.
In the letter I called on my German counterpart to make every effort to have the strikes ended.
In de brief heb ik beroep gedaan op mijn Duitse ambtgenoot om zich maximaal in te spannen om de stakingen te doen beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over uitspraken over certificering van treinen

An MP asked the state secretary about the ILT's role in certifying trains, after an inspector-general said certification does not mean a train is safe. The state secretary explained that ILT grants type approval only when legal requirements are met, that approval does not guarantee production quality, and that an audit of the approval process will be completed by 1 November 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Ziengs over aanbesteding van busvervoer

Two VVD MPs asked whether regional tender requirements such as high turnover and public transport experience exclude new entrants from regional bus concessions, and whether small private bus operators could be considered. The state secretary said tender requirements are public, that regions have wide discretion under EU and national rules, and that the points will be raised with a working group on more flexible tenders.
Therefore I will bring the points you mentioned (turnover and public transport experience requirements) to the attention of the working group
Daarom zal ik de door u genoemde punten (eisen van omzet en ervaring met openbaar vervoer) onder de aandacht brengen van de werkgroep
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en De Boer over de aanpak van illegale taxi’s en aanbieders van illegale taxidiensten op internet

Two MPs asked how the government tackles illegal taxi services offered online, including via Facebook, and how many such operators were contacted, warned or sanctioned. The state secretary agreed these services should be tackled, said the size of the illegal market cannot be measured, and described ILT warning letters (about 60 in 2013) and proceedings, but gave no figures on sanctions or seized cars.
Seizure of cars is generally carried out by the police. The number of cars of unlicensed drivers seized on the order of the Public Prosecutor is not separately registered.
In beslagname van auto’s gebeurt in de regel door de politie. Het aantal op last van de Officier van Justitie in beslag genomen auto’s van snorders wordt niet apart geregistreerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Monasch en Van Dekken en De Boer over het verdwijnen van de unieke collectie typemachines van de schrijver W.F. Hermans naar het buitenland

MPs asked the minister why W.F. Hermans' typewriter collection was allocated to a Belgian bookshop, whether museum rules leave a gap allowing such export, and what tools exist to keep it in the Netherlands. The minister defended the selection process, said the collection stays accessible in the Dutch-language area, stated that museum self-regulation rather than a gap explains the outcome, promised Erfgoedwet rules on state disposal of heritage, and rejected using the Wet tot behoud van cultuurbezit in this case.
I intend to regulate further, in the Heritage Act, the process by which governments, important owners of collections, dispose of cultural objects.
Ik ben voornemens in de Erfgoedwet het proces van afstoten van cultuurvoorwerpen door overheden, belangrijke eigenaars van collecties, nader te regelen
Antwoord vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en De Boer over de inkrimping dienstregeling veerdienst Vlieland en Terschelling

MPs Aukje de Vries and De Boer asked about the planned winter reduction of ferry and fast-ferry sailings to Vlieland and Terschelling, the island councils' protest letter, and the transparency of Doeksen's finances. The state secretary said he is taking the matter seriously, will explore options with the island authorities, and has commissioned an external review whose conclusions are not yet final, while refusing to disclose the review's results and deferring to the independent Commissie Bootdiensten.
We will come back to this later this summer.
Later deze zomer zullen wij hierop terugkomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en De Boer over de veerbotenoorlog

MPs De Vries and De Boer asked about the ferry dispute between EVT and Doeksen on the Wadden islands routes, its long duration, the timing of the CBb court case, effects on service, the winter timetable and Doeksen's compensation request. The state secretary said the concession is not yet final so the ODC applies and competition is allowed, that a request for expedited court handling must come from the CBb, that a winter timetable proposal is under review with municipalities, and that compensation is premature.
That is why I have asked the CBb whether it wishes to submit a request to the European Court for expedited handling of the case.
Daarom heb ik het CBb gevraagd of zij een verzoek willen indienen bij het Europese Hof voor versnelde behandeling van de zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Houwers, Bosman, Litjens, De Boer, Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over ruimtelijke ordening op zee

VVD MPs asked the government for an overview of all plans, visions and directives touching on spatial planning at sea, their relationships, their national or EU origin, and the timing of answers before a committee debate. The minister answered that the National Water Plan and the North Sea policy note with the Integraal Beheerplan Noordzee form the integrated framework, described how EU directives are implemented nationally, and provided a schematic overview and a commitment to update the spatial framework in 2015.
The cabinet intends to adopt spatial protection measures for the seabed of the Friese Front and Centrale Oestergronden, to be reflected in the National Water Plan in 2015.
Het kabinet heeft het voornemen om ruimtelijke beschermingsmaatregelen te nemen voor de bodem van het Friese Front en Centrale Oestergronden, die neerslaan in het Nationaal Waterplan in 2015.
Antwoord vragen De Boer over buitenlandse vervoerders op de HSL-Zuid

MP De Boer (VVD) asked whether Eurostar's plans for an Amsterdam-London high-speed link were known, why foreign operators are admitted to the HSL-Zuid under Dutch rules, and how Dutch high-speed track charges compare with neighbouring countries. The state secretary answered that the link is under study but not before 2018 and that the market should decide, explained that the Dutch cost model differs from other countries so no clean comparison is possible, and declined to disclose the Thalys charge, leaving it to the concessionaire and Thalys.
The amount Thalys pays for its trains is a matter between HSA and Thalys.
De hoogte van het bedrag dat voor Thalys-treinen betaalt wordt, is een zaak tussen HSA en Thalys.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland, De Rouwe, De Boer en Dik-Faber over het geluidsniveau langs de HSL-Zuid

MPs asked when TNO's noise measurements and the pilot along the HSL-Zuid in Lansingerland would be reported and completed, whether the 57 dB(A) limit is exceeded, and about costs, planning, speed reduction and a local residents' plan. The state secretary replied that five of eight measured homes will likely exceed the limit in the end situation by 1 to 6 dB, that the first pilot phase costs about 5.5 million euros with effect measurements planned for autumn, and that speed reduction is undesirable and not legally possible under the Spoorwegwet.

TNO currently concludes that for five of the eight homes (in the municipalities of Hoogmade and Lansingerland) where noise was measured, the calculated noise load in the final situation will be higher than the limit values in the Tracébesluit, namely 57 dB(A).

TNO concludeert op dit moment dat bij vijf van de acht woningen (in de gemeenten Hoogmade en Lansingerland) waar het geluid is gemeten, de berekende geluidbelasting in de eindsituatie hoger zal zijn dan de grenswaarden uit het Tracébesluit, namelijk57 dB(A).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het bericht ‘Europees Parlement stemt voor sloopfonds zeeschepen’

An MP asked the minister whether the European Parliament's proposed ship-scrapping fund, financed by a levy on ships calling at EU ports, would harm the Dutch competitive position and why a one-off levy at registration would not be preferable. The minister agreed the levy could harm the Dutch short sea sector and that a one-off levy would be more logical, and stated the Netherlands opposes the per-call levy in the negotiations.

The Netherlands is in principle open to a financial instrument to encourage compliance with the regulation, but there is insufficient support from industry for the scrapping fund as proposed by the European Parliament.

Nederland staat in principe open voor een financieel instrument om het naleven van de verordening te stimuleren, maar voor het sloopfonds zoals voorgesteld door het Europees Parlement bestaat onvoldoende draagvlak bij het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Boer over de boete opgelegd aan NS

An MP asked the state secretary why NS customer satisfaction on punctuality and seat availability lagged behind objective performance, what action would be taken, and whether the fine was sufficiently incentivising. The state secretary explained NS's analysis of five causes, said no additional action was needed beyond monitoring, and argued the fact of being fined matters more than its size.
I will, however, closely monitor NS's actions and the results thereof.
Wel zal ik de acties van NS en de resultaten daarvan nauwgezet volgen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Boer en Lodders over aanzienlijke prijsstijgingen in het openbaar vervoer, naar aanleiding van prijsstijgingen op het Hanzelijn-traject

Two VVD MPs asked why train fares on the Hanzelijn route are 15-25% higher than on parallel routes, and whether fares were agreed to be based on distance. The state secretary explained NS's tariff-unit system that equalises fares across parallel routes, denied any agreement to base fares on kilometres, declined to change the tariffs, and said regional fares are the responsibility of decentralised authorities.
It is not correct that it was agreed that the fare would be based on the number of kilometres.
Het klopt niet dat was afgesproken dat de ritprijs zou worden gebaseerd op het aantal kilometers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over een incident met een trein met gevaarlijke stoffen

De Boer (VVD) asked the state secretary about an ILT report on a train carrying dangerous goods that ran through a signal in Groningen, asking whether ProRail's error was the cause, whether the fragmented safety process should be unified, whether this was structural, and whether ProRail would be asked to respond. The state secretary confirmed ProRail was responsible, attributed the cause to an incorrect drawing, said procedures had been tightened and a broader ILT audit of drawing management was underway, and committed to sharing ProRail's response.
Yes. As soon as I have received this response, I will share it with your House.
Ja. Zodra ik deze reactie heb ontvangen zal ik die met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het bericht dat treinkaartjes mogelijk duurder worden

MP De Boer asked whether NS's monopoly over travel information lets it set tariffs for regional operators, and whether the cost-allocation method is fair. The state secretary replied that the NMa approved the takeover under strict conditions, with a prescribed tariff method for 2013 and cost-based tariffs from 2014, and that the government will follow the negotiations between operators without commenting on media-reported methods.
I will continue to follow the outcomes of the discussion on tariffs for 2014.
Ik zal de uitkomsten van de discussie over tarieven 2014 blijven volgen.
Antwoord vragen De Boer over het beheer van de Wadden

MP De Boer asked whether the fragmented competent authority for the Wadden Sea causes uncertainty and delays for businesses, and whether a central permit desk or fewer bodies should be created. The minister replied that responsibilities are clear and coordinated through the Regie College Waddengebied, rejected a central desk in favour of the Omgevingswet and Regional Implementation Services, and saw no need for a study into reducing bodies.
The responsibilities of the various competent authorities are, in my view, clear.
De verantwoordelijkheden van de verschillende bevoegde gezagen zijn mijn inziens helder.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en De Boer betreffende de juridisering van het natuurbeschermingsbeleid

Two MPs (Dijkgraaf and De Boer) asked the state secretary whether she agrees that the Natura 2000 legal framework has juridified nature conservation policy and eroded local support, and what she will do with the article's findings, including on the Boetelerveld buffer zone dispute. The state secretary answered that clear legal boundary conditions are unavoidable but that local stakeholders should weigh options within them, and that she trusts the province to conduct a sound process.
Clear boundary conditions with possible legal consequences are unavoidable.
Duidelijke randvoorwaarden met mogelijk juridische consequenties zijn onontkoombaar.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Boer over de situatie in het Nieuwkoopse Plassengebied door Natura 2000

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary whether designating the Nieuwkoopse Plassen as a Natura 2000 area would restrict recreation, housing and business, and whether he would delay definitive designation until the consequences were clear. The state secretary answered that restrictions apply to activities that hinder conservation goals, that the PAS nitrogen programme should restore room for economic development, that he rejects the Panteia/EIM job-loss estimate, and that he will not definitively designate the area until the PAS approach for the area is clear.
As long as it is not clear how the PAS will work out for this area, I will not yet proceed to definitively designate the area.
Zolang niet duidelijk is hoe de PAS uitwerkt voor dit gebied, zal ik nog niet overgaan tot het definitief aanwijzen van het gebied.
Antwoord vragen Lodders en De Boer over de aanslag bij het melden van wildschade

Two VVD MPs asked why farmers must first pay a 300-euro treatment fee before claiming game damage compensation from the Faunafonds, whether it is one-off, whether it is refunded if rejected, and whether the measure should be reversed. The state secretary replied that provinces are now responsible for financing the Faunafonds and lowering administration costs, that the treatment fee is being discussed in the Ganzen consultation, and that no conclusion has been reached so the government awaits the provinces' proposals.
I am awaiting the definitive proposals from the provinces.
Ik wacht de definitieve voorstellen van de provincies af.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Boer en Ziengs over de rijksgebouwen in Veenhuizen

MPs De Boer and Ziengs asked the Minister of Interior about federal buildings in Veenhuizen, including who is responsible for their use and whether a vocational school initiative (Metzelaar PraktijkGilde) could be housed there at comparable rents. The minister answered that responsibility depends on ownership (state assets managed by RVOB and Rijksgebouwendienst), that a market-rate lease offer was made but not agreed, and that the state cannot give targeted incentives without risking unlawful state aid.
There is no need to investigate this, since in April 2012 a lease offer at market-conform terms was made to Metzelaar PraktijkGilde for the building at Hospitaallaan 1.
Het is niet nodig om dit te onderzoeken aangezien er in april 2012 een huuraanbieding is gedaan aan Metzelaar PraktijkGilde tegen marktconforme voorwaarden voor het pand aan de Hospitaallaan 1.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Boer over hoge beloningen van bestuurders van woningcorporaties

An MP asked the minister whether a third of housing corporation directors earned above the Balkenende norm, whether any such excess is acceptable, and whether the minister will get them to cut salaries. The minister said the data cover only 231 of 381 corporations and full 2011 figures are pending, that no statutory cap exists yet but the sector code applies and the forthcoming WNT will give enforcement powers, and that existing contracts will be phased down under transitional rules.
This data is currently being collected. As soon as the data is complete I will inform your House, as happens every year.
Momenteel worden deze gegevens verzameld. Zodra deze gegevens compleet zijn zal ik uw Kamer, zoals dit elk jaar gebeurt, hierover berichten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Boer over het Amsterdamse ‘convenant tegen verhuur aan criminelen’

Rep. De Boer (VVD) asked the Minister of the Interior about the Amsterdam covenant against renting homes and business premises to criminals, asking about its scale, national relevance, enforcement, and whether the government would support it. The minister answered that such misuse occurs, that enforcement is integrated across police, municipality, tax authority and prosecutors, and that the Wwft obligations for estate agents apply, without committing to a new concrete action.
Although it must be assumed that this also occurs outside this region, there is no complete picture of this.
Hoewel moet worden aangenomen dat dit over buiten deze regio voorkomt, bestaat daardaarover geen volledig beeld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Boer over erfpacht in Amsterdam

Mr De Boer (VVD) asked the minister of Interior about municipalities changing their leasehold (erfpacht) policies in Amsterdam and elsewhere, including which municipalities still use leasehold, the number of contracts and revenues, and whether an evaluation would be done. The minister said there is no integral overview, listed changes in several cities, said Amsterdam keeps leasehold, and agreed to commission an inventory of municipal experiences and inform parliament around the new year.
I am willing to have an inventory made of the experiences of municipalities that now offer existing leaseholders the option to acquire full ownership
Ik ben bereid een inventarisatie te laten doen van de ervaringen bij gemeenten die inmiddels de mogelijkheid bieden voor bestaande erfpachters ook de volledige eigendom te verwerven
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Steur en De Boer over drugsdealers in kraakpanden in Rotterdam

MPs Van der Steur and De Boer asked about drug dealers occupying squats in Rotterdam, the number involved, the municipal and police response, and whether other cities see similar activity. The state secretary answered that police raided nine properties on 22 May 2012, arrested six suspects, that the investigation is ongoing, and that the action focused on drug trade rather than evicting squatters, while structural squat-drug activity elsewhere is not established.
The investigation is still ongoing, so I cannot make any further statements about this at this time.
Het opsporingsonderzoek is nog gaande waardoor ik hierover thans geen verdere mededelingen kan doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Boer over het gedwongen duurzaam maken van woningen in Amsterdam-West

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether Amsterdam-West's district council may compel homeowners to make homes more sustainable, and whether this breaches property rights and should be halted through consultation. The minister replied that compulsion is limited to exceptional cases under article 13 of the Woningwet, subject to motivation and court appeal, that no compulsory orders have yet been issued, and that no consultation is planned.

Under article 13 of the Housing Act, the competent authority may oblige an owner (or whoever is otherwise competent) to take measures that exceed the level for existing buildings under the Building Decree 2012

Op grond van artikel 13 van de Woningwet kan het bevoegd gezag een eigenaar (of degene die uit andere hoofde bevoegd is) verplichten voorzieningen te treffen die hoger liggen dan het niveau voor bestaande bouwwerken
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Boer over huursubsidie aan hogere inkomens

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Interior whether a newspaper claim that a few thousand people earning above €54,367 still receive rent allowance is accurate, and what would be done if so. The minister answered that the figures come from preliminary CBS data reflecting provisional allowances, that excess allowances are reclaimed on final assessment, and that timing mismatches in household composition explain the apparent discrepancy, so the figures do not show wrongful receipt.
If at final assessment it turns out that income in 2010 was too high to receive the allowance, the rent allowance received in excess is reclaimed.
Als bij de definitieve toekenning blijkt dat het inkomen in 2010 te hoog was voor het ontvangen van toeslag, wordt de te veel ontvangen huurtoeslag teruggevorderd.
Antwoord vragen De Boer over het bericht ‘Tijdelijk verhuren strop huizenbezitters’

An MP asked the minister of Interior about reports that owners rent out their unsold second homes without the required vacancy permit, and about the cost and necessity of such permits. The minister replied that unpermitted regular rental is not illegal, that no registration exists, that banks show no signs of a rise, defended the permit requirement as protecting tenants and owners, and promised to remove the maximum rent requirement from the permit.
I do not share the view that applying for a permit is time-consuming; indeed, the permit is granted by operation of law if the municipality has not decided within eight weeks of the application.

Ik deel niet de opvatting dat het aanvragen van een vergunning tijdrovend is; het is zelfs zo dat de vergunning van rechtswege wordt verleend indien de gemeente niet binnen acht weken op de aanvraag heeft beslist.
Antwoord vragen De Boer over onderwerp het Nationaal Programma Herbestemming

An MP asked the minister whether she would loosen rules on temporary housing in vacant offices as proposed by the H-team and how this relates to existing temporary-lease rules. The minister is positive about extending temporary lease terms to 10 years but prefers doing so through an amendment to the Leegstandwet, which he plans to submit after the summer recess 2012.
The intention is to submit the bill amending the Leegstandwet to your House as soon as possible after the 2012 summer recess.
Het is de bedoeling het wetsvoorstel ter wijziging van de Leegstandwet zo spoedig mogelijk na het zomerreces 2012 aan uw Kamer voor te leggen.
Antwoord vragen De Boer over het artikel ‘Gemeente publiceert kraakkaart’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about a municipal online map of vacant office buildings in Amsterdam, asking whether it encourages squatting and what role the neighbourhood support point plays.
