The minister replied that the map is public information on structurally vacant offices, that it aims at transparency and pressuring owners, that it does not incite squatting, and that the neighbourhood point is independent and only signals housing issues.
I do not share the view that this encourages squatters to squat.
Ik deel niet de opvatting dat hiermee krakers worden aangezet tot kraken.

Antwoord vragen Van der Burg en De Boer over het bericht van het CBS dat in 2012 de opbrengst uit heffingen van lokale overheden met 3,2 procent stijgt en de Onroerende Zaakbelasting (OZB) de macronorm fors lijkt te over

Two VVD MPs asked whether CBS figures showing a 3.2 percent rise in local levies and a likely overshoot of the 3.75 percent OZB macro-norm for 2012 are reliable, and what the government will do. The minister answered that the figures are preliminary, that final CBS data are due in March, that a joint analysis with the VNG will follow, and that a proportional deduction from the Gemeentefonds is possible if the norm is exceeded.
When the final figures are known in March, we as fund managers, together with the VNG, will make an analysis of the development of the OZB in 2012.
Als de definitieve cijfers in maart bekend zijn zullen wij als fondsbeheerders, samen met de VNG, een analyse maken van de ontwikkeling van de OZB in 2012.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over malafide praktijken onder makelaars

An MP from the VVD asked the minister about reports of fraudulent practices among estate agents, their scale, and whether existing rules should be enforced more strictly rather than new rules added. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, said no data on the scale is available, and stated that the approach should not involve more rules but refers back to earlier answers.
I do not have data on the scale of fraudulent practices and therefore cannot give an estimate.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens over de omvang van malafide praktijken en kan derhalve geen inschatting geven.
Vragen van het lid De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de verhuur van koopwoningen (ingezonden 1 december 2011).

An MP asked the minister about press reports that owners of houses for sale are renting them out temporarily, sometimes through brokers who lack the right permits and contracts, and whether the Leegstandwet functions properly and should be loosened. The minister said the Leegstandwet already allows such temporary rental without tenant protection, that information was published in 2009, that brokers will be informed, and referred the question on loosening the law to a separate letter on Huur op Maat.
I will inform brokers through their associations about the Leegstand Act and the possibility it offers to temporarily rent out a house for sale without tenant protection.
Ik zal de makelaars via hun koepels informeren over de Leegstandwet en de mogelijkheid die deze wet biedt om een te koop staande woning zonder huurbescherming van de huurder tijdelijk te verhuren.
Vragen van het lid De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de werking van de Leegstandsverordening in Amsterdam (ingezonden 6 december 2011).

MP De Boer (VVD) asked the Minister of Interior about implementation problems of Amsterdam's vacancy ordinance (Leegstandsverordening), including how to set fair fines and when rent reduction can be demanded. The minister rejected the claim of implementation problems, noting no experience yet, and explained that fines are set case by case and rent reduction applies only when no commercial tenant is available.
At this moment there is still no experience with the implementation of a vacancy ordinance.
Op dit moment is er nog geen ervaring met de uitvoering van een Leegstandverordening.
Vragen van het lid De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over Ymere-advies (ingezonden 4 november 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the 'Ymere-advies' website, which offered dubious tips to tenants to stay under the social housing income limit, was linked to housing corporation Ymere and what would be done to stop it. The minister answered that there is no link, the site is a hoax protest against cabinet housing policy, and no measures are planned because such actions cannot be prevented.
I therefore do not consider any measures.
Ik overweeg dan ook geen maatregelen.
Vragen van lid De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over huuraftrek (ingezonden 17 juni 2011).

An MP asked the minister for Interior Affairs whether he had noted and what he thought of a proposal from the EIB to introduce a rent deduction as an alternative to the mortgage interest deduction, including its costs and housing-market effects. The minister said he had noted it, argued it would distort housing-price formation without clear benefit to tenants, and estimated costs would be substantially higher than the EIB's 330 million euro, with no financing offered.
In my view a rent deduction would lead to a distortion of price formation in the housing market, and it is not clear in advance whether the benefits would go to tenants or be captured by landlords.

In mijn ogen zal een huuraftrek leiden tot een verstoring in de prijsvorming in de woningmarkt, waarbij niet op voorhand duidelijk is of de voordelen ten goede zullen komen aan de huurder, dan wel door verhuurders zullen worden afgeroomd.
Vragen van lid De Boer aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het weigeren van woningen aan middeninkomens door corporaties (ingezonden 29 juli 2011).

An MP asks whether housing corporations refusing middle-income tenants is linked to the loss of state aid rules, and how large the interest-rate difference from losing WSW guarantees is. The minister explains the 10% rule for renting to middle incomes, the sanction of losing WSW guarantee on new financing, and that the rate effect is about 0.5%, with no change to existing loans.
A 0.5% higher interest rate does not lead to a higher investment amount in social new construction, but on average to an approximately €9,000 higher uneconomic top.
Een 0,5% hogere rente leidt bij sociale nieuwbouw niet tot een hoger investeringsbedrag maar gemiddeld wel tot een ca. € 9 000 hogere «onrendabele top».
Vragen van het lid De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over energieverbruik van warmtepompen (ingezonden 22 juni 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the EPC energy rules fail to ensure heat pumps perform as expected, why residents are not informed about high energy use, who is liable for losses at Zutphen, and how many homes are affected. The minister replied that no regulation yet covers overall heat pump performance, that information duties lie with suppliers and that a certification trajectory, guidance and an AMvB are planned, while liability in Zutphen is under discussion.
There is currently no regulation for heat pumps covering the integral quality of the installation, including energy efficiency.
Er is thans geen regelgeving voor warmtepompen die betrekking heeft op de integrale kwaliteit van de installatie, inclusief energierendement.
Vragen de leden De Boer en Ziengs (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het artikel «Nieuwbouwwoning kost circa 50 000 euro meer» (ingezonden 19 april 2011).

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Interior about a newspaper report that new-build homes cost about 50,000 euros more because of Dutch regulation, and whether he would analyse the price effects of building rules. The minister agreed that construction regulation raises dwelling costs, noted energy-saving benefits, and said he is willing to address building costs, though the study offers limited basis for the requested analysis and he will return to it via the Dekker committee recommendations.
The aforementioned study offers less grounding for the requested analysis because it focuses mainly on the cost effect of regulation and not on its cost-saving effect.
Voornoemde studie biedt minder houvast voor de gevraagde analyse omdat deze vooral op het kosteneffect van regelgeving let en niet op het kostenbesparend effect daarvan.

Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen (SP), Van Bochove (CDA), De Boer (VVD), Voortman (GroenLinks) en Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de kwaliteitsborging van energielabels

MPs asked the minister of Interior about quality assurance of energy labels, including how many were deregistered in 2010, whether spot checks by certifying bodies are legally regulated, whether certifying bodies may check firms they certified, and how many labels failed checks. The minister answered that certifying bodies found 582 deviations among 4,365 checked labels, leading to suspensions or withdrawals, that the market-based system is adequately safeguarded, and that the VROM-Inspectie's findings are not directly comparable.
I will continue to closely monitor the work of the Certifying Institutions and have them report to me regularly on their findings.
Ik zal de werkzaamheden van de Certificerende Instellingen nauwgezet blijven volgen en mij regelmatig laten rapporteren over hun bevindingen.
Vragen van de leden De Boer en Leegte (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over milieusubsidie voor huizenbezitters (ingezonden 8 april 2011).

Two VVD MPs asked the minister of Interior whether a EUR 2 million energy-advice subsidy was channelled to three large parties rather than homeowners, and whether this matched the scheme's criteria. The minister replied that the budget went fully to owner-occupiers, mostly via individual applications processed first-come-first-served, with about a fifth via collective applications from intermediaries.
All subsidy paid out by Agentschap NL has benefited energy-advice measures for owner-occupiers.
Alle door Agentschap NL uitgekeerde subsidie is ten goede gekomen aan maatwerkadviezen voor eigenaar-bewoners.
Vragen van het lid De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over scheefwonen (ingezonden 18 maart 2011).

The MP asks whether the planned extra rent increase for higher-income social housing tenants, due 1 July 2011, still goes ahead and what the financial consequences are if it is delayed. The minister answers that the measure will be delayed to 1 July 2012 because of implementation consequences, promises a bill as soon as possible, and states there are no adverse financial consequences for the state or housing corporations.
The extra rent increase will not take effect on 1 July this year.
De extra huurverhoging zal niet per 1 juli aanstaande ingaan.

Vragen van de leden De Boer (VVD), Van Bochove (CDA) en Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de belangenafwijking van een kraakpand (ingezo

Three MPs asked the ministers of Justice and Interior about a court ruling that refused eviction of a squatted building and whether a balancing of interests must now be made, and how property rights will be protected. The minister answers that the Squatting and Vacancy Act already protects property, cites recent rulings and a pending cassation appeal, and sees no reason yet for additional measures.
Pending the outcome of this cassation procedure, there is for me no reason to take additional measures to protect property rights.
In afwachting van de uitkomsten van deze cassatieprocedure bestaat er voor mij geen aanleiding aanvullende maatregelen te nemen ter bescherming van het eigendomsrecht.
Vragen van het lid De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over verhoging liggeld woonboten op rijkswater (ingezonden 25 januari 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about a sharp rise in mooring fees for houseboat residents on state waters, whether it is true residents pay thousands of euros more a year and why, and whether residents who appeal are charged the full amount immediately without a transition period. The government replied by letter of 1 April 2011, answering the questions in a separate letter (Kamerstuk 32 730, nr. 1).
These questions were answered in a letter of 1 April 2011 (Kamerstuk 32 730, no. 1).
Deze vragen zijn beantwoord bij brief van 1 april 2011 (Kamerstuk 32 730, nr. 1 ).

Vragen van de leden Straus, Hennis-Plasschaert, Bosman en De Boer (allen VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over gevolgen voor de werkgelegenheid door centralisatie overheidsdiensten (inge

MPs of the VVD asked whether preserving administrative employment in shrinking regions is crucial and what measures the government takes so that central government reorganisations strengthen the economic structure and jobs in those regions. Minister Donner answered that regional authorities are responsible for regional economic vitality, that location choices weigh efficiency and service above regional employment, and that earlier analysis showed no disproportionate regional job effects.
The initiative for successful cooperation between these parties lies with governments at the regional level.
Het initiatief voor een succesvolle samenwerking tussen deze partijen ligt bij de overheden op regionale schaal.
Vragen van de leden Huizing en De Boer (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Financiën over particuliere erfpacht en hypotheekverstrekking (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

MPs Huizing and De Boer asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch banks refuse mortgages on privately leased land (particuliere erfpacht) and whether they treat these differently from municipal leasehold. The minister said banks are hesitant due to unclear contract terms and future canon levels, that he has raised concerns with the NVB, and that the AFM will talk with stakeholders about a possible facilitating role.
I have discussed this with the NVB and conveyed my concerns to the NVB.
Ik heb hierover contact gehad met de NVB en heb mijn zorgen bij de NVB neergelegd.
Vragen van het lid De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het splitsen van woningen (ingezonden 2 februari 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether municipalities may block the splitting of houses into smaller units, whether housing corporations should not gain a monopoly over small affordable units, and how many splits occur nationally. The minister answered that municipalities may require a permit for splitting under the Housing Act and set their own policy, that splitting can increase affordable supply, that a varied market with several providers is desirable, and that 1,996 splits occurred in 2009 with no national permit figures available.
No national figures are known regarding the number of splitting permits.
Over het aantal splitsingsvergunningen zijn geen landelijke cijfers bekend.

Vragen van de leden Venrooy-van Ark en De Boer (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de plannen voor het ontwikkelen van zorgvoorzieningen in Hilvarenbeek (ingezonden 13 januari

VVD MPs asked the state secretary about plans for a private care complex (Hilverhoeve) in Hilvarenbeek, whether municipal Wmo budgets are at risk, whether a legal gap exists, and whether municipalities can shape care service contracts. The state secretary supported such initiatives, said no structural Wmo problem is known, saw no need for new rules or guidance, and promised only further research into financial incentives.
Vragen van het lid De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over verhogen huren (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether he agrees that raising the social rent ceiling would be unwise and whether a proposal to harmonise rents of vacated social dwellings up to the liberalisation level deserves study. The minister agrees raising the ceiling would be unwise, notes corporations may house higher incomes within limits, and says he is open to investors in the segment above the ceiling and will examine options with parties.
To that end I am examining the possibilities and preconditions, together with parties.
Ik bezie daartoe, met partijen, de mogelijkheden en randvoorwaarden.

Vragen van het lid De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het aan de laars lappen van de EU-regels inzake staatssteun door woningcorporaties (ingezonden 28 december 2010).

An MP asks the minister whether it is undesirable that housing associations openly disregard EU state aid rules by housing higher-income households, and whether losing guarantees for new loans beyond the 10% threshold is a problem. The minister agrees that disregarding EU rules is undesirable, explains that associations may house higher incomes within the 10% limit without losing state aid, and says that transitional issues are being worked out with the sector and the European Commission.

Vragen van de leden Jansen (SP), Van Bochove (CDA), Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie), Voortman (GroenLinks), Monasch (PvdA) en De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de verliezen va

MPs asked the minister how negative results on subsidiaries (deelnemingen) of housing associations were reflected in the 2010 assessment letters, and how those results break down across core, social and commercial property activities. The minister answered that subsidiary results were not explicitly addressed in the letters, that the CFV will examine more associations in 2011, and that the data do not allow the requested breakdown, while noting that most subsidiary losses likely relate to commercial activities.
The CFV will in 2011 examine more associations where there is an increased risk of unnecessary erosion of the socially bound assets.
Het CFV zal in 2011 meer corporaties onderzoeken waar een verhoogd risico is op onnodige aantasting van het maatschappelijk gebonden vermogen.
Vragen van het lid De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het artikel «Zonder relatie geen woning» (ingezonden 21 oktober 2010).

An MP asks whether Amsterdam's planned housing allocation rule excluding co-habiting persons without a family relationship breaches privacy, and whether the minister will intervene for low-income students. The minister answers that housing allocation criteria are a local matter within the Huisvestingswet, that the regional ordinance has no family-relationship requirement and does not infringe privacy, and that intervention via the VROM-Inspectie is not warranted for a policy discussion.
Where there is a possible infringement, I can instruct the VROM Inspectorate to investigate further and possibly intervene.
Wanneer er sprake is van een mogelijke overtreding kan ik de VROM-Inspectie opdracht geven hier nader onderzoek naar te doen en eventueel in te grijpen.
Vragen van het lid De Boer (VVD) aan de ministers voor Wonen Wijken en Integratie en van Financiën over het niet verhypothekeren van huizen op erfpacht door banken (ingezonden 9 september 2010).

An MP asks ministers whether banks are refusing mortgages on private leasehold (erfpacht) homes, the Amsterdam municipality's solution, how many such cases exist, and whether the competition authority NMa is examining bank coordination on these mortgages. The government says banks are very reluctant due to unclear lease terms, that Amsterdam and the NVB will help owners via buy-out or municipal leasehold, that the Kadaster counts about 8,078 private leasehold parcels, and that the NMa sets its own investigation priorities.
I will continue to closely monitor this process.
Ik zal dit proces nauwlettend blijven volgen.
Vragen van lid De Boer (VVD) aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over het beschikbaar stellen van woningen voor de sociale huurvoorraad (ingezonden 19 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the housing minister about Amsterdam's enforcement against owners of second homes, a 2005 court ruling allowing two main residences, corporations renting social housing to hotels, and the Polish rent-points case. The minister said he would consult Amsterdam and await further information before deciding on next steps, and found no reason to act on the rent-points issue.
I will first await the talks with Amsterdam and further information on this matter before considering next steps.
Ik wacht eerst de gesprekken met Amsterdam en verdere informatie over deze zaak af alvorens vervolgstappen te overwegen.
Vragen van lid De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de hoogte van gemeentelijke bouwleges (ingezonden 18 augustus 2010).

MP De Boer (VVD) asked the minister about large differences in municipal building permit fees and whether they serve purposes beyond covering costs, and whether the government will investigate and supervise. The State Secretary answered that differences stem from municipal choices, that supervision lies with municipal councils, and that tariff-setting is part of municipal autonomy.
Supervision of the fees rests with the municipal council, see also the answer to question 4.
Het toezicht op de leges is aan de gemeenteraad, zie ook het antwoord op vraag 4.

Vragen van het lid De Boer (VVD) aan ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie en van Justitie over de houding van de gemeente Amsterdam inzake het uitvoeren van de kraakwet (ingezonden 24 augustus 2010).

An MP asks the ministers whether the Amsterdam municipality is refusing to enforce the new squatting law, citing a reported internal note deprioritising enforcement, and whether the government will act. The government replies that enforcement is coordinated locally, that a note is being drafted for discussion in late September and its content is not yet settled, and that laws must be implemented.
According to information I recently received from the Amsterdam municipality, a note on this subject will be discussed in the tripartite consultation at the end of September.
Blijkens informatie die ik recentelijk van de gemeente Amsterdam ontving, wordt over dit onderwerp eind september in driehoeksverband een notitie besproken.

m: Motie Jansen c.s. over een binnenvliegregeling als er geen geluidsreductie van 35% is bereikt in 2012
Asks the government to announce a night-flight regime at Geilenkirchen base if a 35% noise reduction is not achieved by 2012, and to prepare conditions on AWACS flights.

requests the government to state at the next NAPMO meeting that the Netherlands, if relocating flights does not lead to a 35% noise reduction in 2012, will invoke the night-flight regime from 1 January 2012

verzoekt de regering om in het eerstvolgende NAPMO-overleg te melden dat Nederland, indien het uitplaatsen van vluchten niet leidt tot een geluidsreductie van 35% in 2012, per 1 januari 2012 zal overgaan tot het inroepen van de binnenvliegregeling
Motie Vendrik over stoppen met het opwerken van Nederlands kernafval
Asks the government to stop reprocessing Dutch nuclear waste as soon as possible and at the latest by early 2016.
reprocessing of Dutch nuclear waste is stopped
wordt gestopt met het opwerken van Nederlands kernafval
Motie Van der Ham en Vendrik over een rangorde binnen niet-duurzame installaties
Asks the government to develop a ranking of non-sustainable installations for grid access during congestion, including environmental costs, to be introduced by general administrative order.
requests the government to develop a ranking within non-sustainable installations for grid admission during congestion
verzoekt de regering een rangorde te ontwikkelen binnen niet-duurzame installaties voor toelating tot het elektriciteitsnet ten tijde van congestie
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van der Ham en Vendrik over de mate van uitstoot van broeikasgasen bij het bepalen van voorrang
Amendment lets the minister, via general administrative rules, weigh greenhouse gas emissions of installations when setting electricity generation priority.
the degree of greenhouse gas emissions by the production installation
de mate van uitstoot van broeikasgassen door de productie-installatie
Amendement van het lid Vendrik over het verduidelijken dat duurzame elektriciteit en elektriciteit uit WKK altijd wordt getransporteerd
Requires grid operators to always transport renewable electricity and high-efficiency CHP electricity, refusing only with reasons given.
unless it concerns the transport of renewable electricity or electricity generated in a high-efficiency combined heat and power installation.
tenzij het transport van duurzame elektriciteit of van elektriciteit opgewekt in een installatie voor hoogrenderende warmtekrachtkoppeling betreft.
Amendement van de leden Van der Ham Vendrik ter vervanging van nr. 14 over het aanbrengen van een rangorde in de toegang van niet duurzame productie installaties tot het net in gevallen van congestie
Van der Ham and Vendrik amend the electricity bill so that, in congestion, non-sustainable generators are ranked by emissions, with the highest emitters last in line for grid transport.
This amendment aims, in addition to the priority for sustainable generation in the bill, to also introduce a ranking in grid access for non-sustainable installations in cases of congestion.

Dit amendement beoogt naast de in het wetsvoorstel geregelde voorrang voor duurzaam tevens een rangorde aan te brengen in de toegang van niet duurzame productie installaties tot het net in gevallen van congestie.
Motie Van Gent en Vendrik over gegevens MER-procedure
Asks the government not to fix the final route choice for the Rijnlandroute until all environmental impact assessment (MER) data are available.
requests the government to make a definitive route choice only when all data from the MER procedure are available
verzoekt de regering pas een definitieve tracékeuze te maken als alle gegevens uit de MER-procedure beschikbaar zijn
Motie Van Gent en Vendrik over aanleg Noord-Zuidlijn
Asks the government to come up with proposals to support Amsterdam in implementing the Veerman advice and building the North-South line.
requests the government to come up with proposals on how to support the municipality of Amsterdam in carrying out the Veerman advice and building the North-South line
verzoekt de regering met voorstellen te komen hoe de gemeente Amsterdam te ondersteunen in het volbrengen van de adviezen van Veerman en de aanleg van de Noord-Zuidlijn
Motie Van Gent en Vendrik over betrekken kilometerheffing in de Nationale Markt- en Capaciteitsanalyse
Asks the government to include the full kilometer charge, both basic and peak charges, in the National Market and Capacity Analysis.
requests the government to include the entire kilometer charge in the calculations of the National Market and Capacity Analysis
verzoekt de regering bij de Nationale Markt- en Capaciteitsanalyse de gehele kilometerheffing in de berekeningen mee te nemen
Motie Linhard c.s. over de mogelijkheid om een kantoor tijdelijk een maatschappelijk gewenste functie te geven
Asks the government to prepare a Spatial Planning Act exception allowing municipalities to grant ten-year temporary use for office conversions to socially desired functions, and to run pilots.
requests the government to prepare an exception possibility in the WRO (Spatial Planning Act)
verzoekt de regering een uitzonderingsmogelijkheid voor te bereiden op de WRO
Motie Van der Ham c.s. over lokale instappakketten voor energiebesparingsprojecten
Asks the government to consult municipalities and housing associations on local starter packages for homeowners joining collective energy-saving projects.
requests the government to consult with the Association of Dutch Municipalities and housing associations to arrive at local starter packages
verzoekt de regering in overleg te treden met de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten en woningcorporaties om tot lokale instappakketten te komen
Motie Vendrik over stimuleren van energiebesparing in woningen
Motion asks the government to propose financial incentives returning a large share of home energy-saving investments to homeowners.
requests the government to come up with proposals by 1 March 2010 to financially stimulate energy saving in homes.
verzoekt de regering voor 1 maart 2010 met voorstellen te komen om energiebesparing in woningen financieel te stimuleren
Motie Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink c.s. over goede sanitaire voorzieningen in ontwikkelingslanden
Asks the government, with water boards and sewerage companies, to develop proposals to make greater use of their expertise for sanitation in developing countries.
requests the government, in consultation with the water boards and sewerage companies, to develop concrete proposals

Amends the Civil Code so the rent commission can no longer move mid-rent dwellings into the social rental sector.
By deleting article 249 of Book 7 of the Civil Code from the list in article 247, mid-rent dwellings can no longer be moved by the rent commission to the social rental sector.

Door artikel 249 van Boek 7 van het Burgerlijk Wetboek uit de opsomming van artikel 247 van die wet te schrappen, kunnen middenhuurwoningen niet meer door de huurcommissie naar de sociale huursector worden getrokken.
Amendement van het lid Koerhuis over het behouden van middenhuurwoningen in de vrije sector
Removes the tenant's right to ask the rent tribunal to lower rent in the free rental sector, so the rent-level review no longer applies to liberalised contracts.
By removing article 249 of Book 7 of the Civil Code from the list in article 247 of that law
Door artikel 249 van Boek 7 van het Burgerlijk Wetboek uit de opsomming van artikel 247 van die wet te schrappen
Motie van het lid Koerhuis over het meewegen van de studielening bij de hypotheekofferte
Asks the government to have Nibud research how study loans weigh on mortgage offers for starters and to propose a solution.
requests the government to have Nibud conduct research on this and send a letter with a proposal to solve it
verzoekt de regering, het Nibud hierover onderzoek te laten doen en een brief te sturen met een voorstel hoe dit op te lossen
Motie van de leden Ronnes en Koerhuis over de bouwopgave
Asks the government to inform the Chamber by 1 April 2018 about agreements with municipalities and provinces on housing plan capacity, and then report on progress every half year.
requests the government to inform the Chamber by 1 April 2018 about the agreements with municipalities and provinces on hard plan capacity
verzoekt de regering, de Kamer voor 1 april 2018 te informeren over de afspraken met gemeenten en provincies over de harde plancapaciteit
Motie van het lid Koerhuis over de verkoop van dure sociale huurwoningen
Asks the government to study how an incentive in the 2019 landlord levy could encourage housing corporations to sell expensive social rental homes in tight housing markets.
requests the government to examine how an incentive can be added to the 2019 landlord levy
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken hoe een prikkel in de verhuurderheffing van 2019 aangebracht kan worden
Motie van de leden Koerhuis en Ronnes over het verzilveren van overwaarde
Asks the government to talk with mortgage lenders, the NHG and the AFM to remove obstacles to homeowners cashing in their home equity, and to report back to the House.
asks the government to talk with mortgage lenders, the National Mortgage Guarantee and the Financial Markets Authority to remove bottlenecks
verzoekt de regering, in gesprek te gaan met hypotheekverstrekkers, de Nationale Hypotheek Garantie en de Autoriteit Financiële Markten om knelpunten weg te nemen
Motie van het lid Van Eijs c.s. over het meefinancieren van de NHG-premie in de hypotheek
Asks the government to investigate how the NHG premium can stay financed within the mortgage and send a letter with a proposal.
to investigate how the NHG premium can continue to be financed within the mortgage
te onderzoeken hoe de NHG-premie meegefinancierd kan blijven worden in de hypotheek
Motie van het lid Koerhuis over een perverse prikkel bij de berekening van bezoldigingsmaxima
Asks the government to remove a perverse incentive so that housing corporation executive pay caps no longer count non-social property holdings.
requests the government to remove this perverse incentive in calculating pay maxima
verzoekt de regering, deze perverse prikkel bij berekening van bezoldigingsmaxima weg te nemen
Motie van het lid Dik-Faber c.s. over een "ouderenwoonakkoord"
Asks the government to remove regulatory obstacles to senior co-housing and to agree an elderly housing accord with municipalities, housing associations and other parties.
remove any regulatory obstacles and reach an elderly housing accord
eventuele belemmeringen in regelgeving weg te nemen en te komen tot een «ouderenwoonakkoord»
Motie van het lid Koerhuis c.s. over de evaluatie van de NHG-regeling
Asks the government to complete the evaluation of the NHG mortgage guarantee scheme before the 2019 budget and consider options for lowering the NHG premium.
requests the government to complete the evaluation of the NHG scheme before submission of the 2019 budget
verzoekt de regering, de evaluatie van de NHG-regeling af te ronden voor de indiening van de begroting voor 2019
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis, Koerhuis, Van der Plas enWesterveld over dreigende huisuitzettingen van weeskinderen

Four MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether she knew of threatened evictions of at least five orphaned young adults from social rental homes before the Orphans' Tenancy Protection Act takes effect, and how to prevent them and hold housing corporations to the law's spirit. The minister agreed such evictions must be prevented, said corporations should already act in the spirit of the law and that she is in close contact with Aedes to find solutions, and targets entry into force on 1 January 2024.
I am in close contact with Aedes to ensure a suitable solution in the spirit of the Orphans' Tenancy Protection Act in the situations mentioned.
Ik heb nauw contact met Aedes om in de genoemde situaties te zorgen voor een passende oplossing in de geest van de Wet huurbescherming weeskinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Koerhuis over het bericht 'Ondernemers desnoods naar rechter om Kooybrug open te houden. 'We voelen ons in de kou staan''

MPs Krul and Koerhuis asked the minister about the planned closure of the Kooybrug, traffic safety, the absence of a temporary bridge, compensation for affected businesses, and coordination with ProRail. The minister answered that the renovation is postponed and will be rescheduled, that detour routes and incident scenarios exist, that compensation under the general regulation applies, and that Rijkswaterstaat will stay in close contact with the region, though many answers give no concrete timeline.
At this moment nothing can yet be said about the expected duration of the closure.
Op dit moment kan er nog niets gezegd worden over de verwachte duur van de afsluiting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat de Gerrit Krolbrug in Groningen tot eind dit jaar dichtblijft

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that the Gerrit Krolbrug in Groningen stays closed until year end, and about a promised working group and an alternative crossing during construction. The minister said temporary ramps will open in early 2024, a working group has been set up, options for a crossing during construction will be studied, and a decision is expected in early 2024.
This connection will in any case remain in place until the moment construction of the new bridge starts.
Deze verbinding blijft in ieder geval in stand tot het moment waarop de bouw van de nieuwe brug start.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden De Kort en Koerhuis over het artikel 'Utrecht wil parkeerkosten voor lage inkomens vergoeden, ook als ze geen auto hebben'

MPs De Kort and Koerhuis asked whether Utrecht's plan to compensate low-income U-pas holders for paid parking, including those without a car, is proportionate, redistributive, or an indirect form of income policy. The minister replied that parking and minima policy fall within municipal competence, that the mobility budget was raised for all U-pas holders because the law does not allow distinguishing car owners, and that no national enforcement is planned.
It falls within the competence of municipalities to make independent considerations and choices regarding parking policy.
Het valt binnen de bevoegdheid van gemeenten om op het gebied van parkeerbeleid eigenstandige afwegingen en keuzes te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de beantwoording over het bericht dat Amsterdam autoroutes dwars door de stad wil afsluiten

MP Koerhuis (VVD) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether Rijkswaterstaat's mandate to intervene in Amsterdam's Weesperstraat pilot is as broad as the minister stated, what triggers intervention, and what the escalation procedure is. The minister confirmed the earlier answers, said intervention depends on A10 traffic jams and that ending the pilot lies with the Amsterdam alderman, and pointed to the earlier answer for the escalation question.
As Minister, I do not have the mandate to end the pilot; that mandate lies with the alderman of Amsterdam.
Als Minister heb ik niet het mandaat om de pilot te beëindigen; dat mandaat ligt bij de wethouder van Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht “Kritiek op gemeente Amsterdam die nieuwe vuilniswagens op diesel koopt vanwege overvol elektriciteitsnet”

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that Amsterdam is buying diesel garbage trucks because the electricity grid is full, and whether this undermines the 2025 zero-emission zone deadline for business vehicles. The secretary acknowledged the report, said he would have preferred otherwise but the choice is Amsterdam's under a transition arrangement, and refused to ask Amsterdam to drop its plan while pointing to grid-capacity measures.
Although I would have preferred to see this differently, the choice is up to the municipality of Amsterdam.
Hoewel ik dit liever anders had gezien, is de keuze aan de gemeente Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Bevers over het bericht dat Terschelling het havengebied met 30 centimeter ophoogt, maar dat Rijkswaterstaat niet meedoet

Two VVD MPs asked why Terschelling municipality can raise its harbour terrain by 30 cm while Rijkswaterstaat will not raise its part, and whether a joint approach is possible. The minister answered that Rijkswaterstaat sees no current need to raise its land, that the municipality has not yet applied for a permit, and that the parties will keep talking and combine works where useful.
Rijkswaterstaat sees no possibility or necessity for a raising at this moment.
Rijkswaterstaat ziet voor een verhoging op dit moment geen mogelijkheid en noodzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht dat de N9 te smal, te saai en te gevaarlijk is

MPs Koerhuis and Heerema asked the minister about road safety at the N9 pedestrian and cycle crossings at the Burgervlotbrug and Sint Maartensvlotbrug, including costs, whether the crossings are too small, and whether funding schemes or the MIRT shift could be used. The minister acknowledged the risks, outlined about EUR 1 million of planned measures funded from the EUR 200 million Rijks-N-wegen package, noted that the bridges and roads on them are the responsibility of the province and municipality, and said MIRT funds cannot finance new investment decisions.
Implementing road safety measures on the bridges is therefore the responsibility of the municipality.
Het realiseren van verkeersveiligheidsmaatregelen op de bruggen is dan ook de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat de verbreding van de snelweg A4 tussen het Knooppunt Burgerveen en de N14 is stilgelegd

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure about the suspended widening of the A4 between Burgerveen and N14, along with traffic safety and congestion near Leiderdorp. The minister confirmed the project was halted over nitrogen priorities and budget shortfalls, promised to restart planning when nitrogen space and capacity allow, and said signage and lane changes are adequate or will be addressed through the project.
The project was not included a year ago in the list of so-called nitrogen priorities.
Het project is een jaar geleden niet opgenomen in de lijst van de zogenoemde stikstofprioriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de beantwoording over het bericht dat Amsterdam autoroutes dwars door de stad wil afsluiten

MP Koerhuis (VVD) asks the infrastructure minister how Amsterdam's plan to close through-routes will affect emergency response times, hospitals, neighbouring municipalities and the A10 ring road, and whether the plan should be halted pending an impact analysis. The minister says the ring road must keep flowing, a pilot with emergency-service override is planned, impact analyses are not yet done, and the ministry will ask Amsterdam to conduct one and agrees to joint review.
This has not yet been analysed by the municipality of Amsterdam.
Dit is nog niet geanalyseerd door de gemeente Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Van den Hil, Van der Plas en Stoffer over het bericht dat Meander opvanglocaties voor schipperskinderen sluit in Maasbracht, Nieuwegein, Lemmer en Terneuzen

MPs asked whether the government will prevent the closure of four boarding houses for bargee children run by Stichting Meander and whether the economic claim right on the buildings blocks relocation. The State Secretary answered that closures are a business decision for the boarding houses, that talks are ongoing and the KPMG study will be shared before summer, and that Meander is not blocked from moving to smaller locations.
The Ministry of VWS is currently in talks with the Meander bargee boarding house, so we cannot agree with the term 'stuck in the Ministry of Health's procedures'.

Het Ministerie van VWS is momenteel in gesprek met schippersinternaat Meander, dus in de term «vastlopen in de procedures van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport » kunnen wij ons niet vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat een noodhulpsleepboot een stuurloos schip weghoudt bij windpark Borssele

An MP asked the minister about reports of a rescue tug holding back a drifting ship near the Borssele wind farm, and about safety measures, tug capacity and maritime traffic management in the North Sea. The minister answered that two rescue tugs are stationed at the wind farms, that existing measures are considered sufficient for the planned capacity, and that further measures and tug expansion are planned, while detailed follow-up on the motion is deferred to a separate letter.
In the collective letter I will send to your House before the Maritime Committee debate of 30 May 2023, I will go into the implementation of the motion in more detail.
10 Antwoord 10 In de verzamelbrief die ik uw Kamer nog voor het Commissiedebat Maritiem van 30 mei 2023 zal doen toekomen ga ik nader op de uitvoering van de motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de beantwoording op de schriftelijke vragen over het bericht dat klimaatactivisten Eindhoven Airport betreden

An MP asked the minister whether airlines and the government can recover damages from climate activists who disrupted Schiphol and Eindhoven Airport, and about the number identified, flight delays, and costs. The minister answered that 62 and 182 people were identified, eight flights were delayed and one cancelled at Eindhoven, that the state suffered no damage warranting a civil suit, and that civil or criminal routes for airlines exist but no decision on prosecution has been taken.
At this moment I therefore see no reason to start a civil procedure, jointly or otherwise, against (certain) climate demonstrators.
Op dit moment zie ik dan ook geen aanleiding om een civiele procedure, al dan niet gezamenlijk, te beginnen tegen (bepaalde) klimaatdemonstranten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Bevers over het bericht dat de diepte van vaargeul Boontjes nog ter discussie staat

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that the depth of the Boontjes fairway is still under discussion, and whether the new Kornwerderzand lock will cause ships to run aground and raise container volumes at Harlingen. The minister rejected the link between the lock and the Boontjes depth, said no decision on maintenance has been taken yet, and declined to commit to extending the main waterway network to Harlingen, citing existing routes and the NWP.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Peter de Groot over het bericht dat in de wijk van de toekomst plek is voor 10.000 mensen, 21.500 fietsen en 0 auto’s

Two VVD MPs asked the Infrastructure and Water Management and Housing ministers about a report on the car-free Merwede neighbourhood in Utrecht, including emergency access, affordable housing share, completion timing and use of national housing-impulse funds. The minister answered that the municipality is responsible for local mobility, that the neighbourhood is not fully car-free (underground parking and car hubs are planned), that emergency access is ensured through consultation, that 55% of homes are affordable, and that construction timelines are monitored under funding agreements.
The choice of transport mode is made by the residents themselves. The municipality is responsible for local mobility policy.
De keuze voor de vervoerwijze maken de bewoners zelf. De gemeente is daarbij verantwoordelijk voor het lokale mobiliteitsbeleid
Antwoord op vragen vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Koerhuis, Rajkowski en Valstar over het bericht ‘‘Verdachte’ Chinese kranen staan ook in Nederlandse havens: zorgen om spionage’

The VVD MPs asked the ministers whether Chinese ZPMC cranes in Dutch ports could enable Chinese digital access, espionage, or disruption of military transports, and about Logink data links and subsidies. The government answered that the risks are being investigated in an interdepartmental review due in autumn 2023, that port facilities are responsible for securing their systems, that no Logink cooperation exists in Rotterdam, and that EU rules and NIS2/CER directives may address the risks.

Whether it is possible for the ZPMC facilities in China to gain digital access to the cranes, or whether they are connected in any way or have access to information in the port of Rotterdam, is being investigated in consultation with the Port of Rotterdam Authority.

Of het mogelijk is om vanuit de ZPMC-faciliteiten in China digitale toegang te krijgen tot de kranen, of dat deze op enigerlei wijze verbonden zijn of toegang hebben tot informatie in de Rotterdamse haven, wordt onderzocht in afstemming met het Havenbedrijf Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de berichtgeving dat de gemeente Amsterdam routes door Amsterdam autoluw wil maken

MP Koerhuis asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Amsterdam's plan to close through-routes for cars and its possible effect on congestion on the Ring A10 and on the Zuidasdok project. The minister answered that the municipality is responsible for local mobility policy, that the effects on the A10 are not yet known, and that IenW is in consultation with Amsterdam about avoiding reduced flow on the A10.
The Ministry of IenW is in consultation with the municipality of Amsterdam on this matter.
Het Ministerie van IenW is met de gemeente Amsterdam hierover in overleg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat klimaatactivisten Eindhoven Airport betreden

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about climate activists entering Eindhoven Airport's non-public area and how such intrusions could be prevented and enforced under the Aviation Act. The minister confirmed that the local authority decided on the response, that no flights were endangered, and described the arrests and enforcement, but did not commit to new measures.
Decisions on whether to act against demonstrations rest with the local authority.
Besluitvorming over het al dan niet optreden tegen demonstraties ligt bij het lokale gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van den Hil over het bericht dat de sluiting van rijtestlocaties definitief is

MPs Koerhuis and Van den Hil asked the minister about the definitive closure of driving-test locations, including Terneuzen, and why only Winschoten was reopened. The minister replied that the 2016 CBR evaluation and 2018 client survey justified concentrating tests in 30 locations, that Goes now takes Terneuzen's tests, and that there is no reason to reconsider the decision.
The CBR does not know how many residents of Zuid- and Noord-Beveland take a driving test in Goes.
Het is bij het CBR niet bekend hoeveel inwoners uit Zuid- en Noord-Beveland een rijtest afnemen in Goes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat er geen snelle oplossing is voor de files op de A2 tussen Weert en Eindhoven

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why there is no quick fix for congestion on the A2 between Weert and Eindhoven, and whether the widening or lane reconfiguration is being considered. The minister replied that widening is not on the MIRT agenda, that no-regret and collective-transport measures are being pursued instead, and that converting hard shoulders to peak lanes is not planned, while acknowledging concerns about rat-running through villages.
Converting hard shoulders into peak-hour lanes is not on the table.
Het aanpassen van vluchtstroken tot spitsstroken is niet aan de orde.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Strolenberg over het bericht dat honderden bagagemedewerkers zich melden voor een claimzaak tegen Schiphol en dat ook de Nederlandse Arbeidsinspectie ingrijpt

Two VVD MPs asked why Schiphol is not automating baggage handling sooner after the Labour Inspectorate found excessive physical strain and Arbo violations, and whether the minister would press Schiphol on timelines, lifting aids, worker surveys and international comparison. The minister answered that the inspectorate set binding deadlines of two years for automation and immediate use of aids, that Schiphol plans a new baggage cellar from 2026, and that the minister will raise timelines at the regular overleg with Schiphol and a bestuurlijk overleg in April, with an international comparison to follow after an outsourced study due before summer.
The Labour Inspectorate imposed these definitive requirements on the baggage handlers at Schiphol on 14 March.
Deze definitieve eisen heeft de Arbeidsinspectie op 14 maart jl. aan de bagage afhandelaars op Schiphol opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat het bijna niet meer rendabel is om als binnenvaartschipper te varen

MP Koerhuis asked the minister whether EU/CCR technical rules on cabin height and other requirements for existing inland vessels threaten their profitability and raise a domestic-right conflict under the ECHR. The minister answers that these are long-standing transitional rules (2035/2049), that a hardship clause exists, that the government will publish research on the effects by spring 2023, and that some questions are answered only by reference to earlier letters.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management advises ship owners to use the hardship clause if they cannot comply with the rules and will cooperate fully with applications for it.

Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat adviseert scheepseigenaren om van de hardheidsclausule gebruik te maken als zij niet aan de regels kunnen voldoen en zal alle medewerking verlenen aan aanvragen hiervoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de tijdelijke beleidsregel inzake elektrische laadpunten op verzorgingsplaatsen

An MP asks whether the temporary policy rule on EV charging points at service areas amounts to a moratorium on new fast chargers until 2028, and whether it conflicts with the 1.8 million charge-point target and with protections for existing tankstation rights. The Minister denies a moratorium, explains that new permits are tied to a minimum five-year term to ease transition to exclusive charging rights, and says he will not lift the rule or extend the permit terms, while answering the questions one by one.
No, the temporary policy rule is an important step in developing new policy, which will give entrepreneurs more clarity and is expected to lead to more charging points being realised.

Nee, de tijdelijke beleidsregel is een belangrijke stap in de totstandkoming van een nieuw beleid, dat ondernemers meer duidelijkheid zal gaan bieden en naar verwachting leidt tot de realisatie van meer laadpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Strolenberg over het bericht dat dagelijkse dronevluchten tussen ziekenhuizen Meppel en Zwolle een stap dichterbij zijn

MPs Koerhuis and Strolenberg asked the minister about drone deliveries of medicines and organs between hospitals and to the Wadden islands, including the Besluit Beperkingen Burgerluchtverkeer Waddenzee restrictions. The minister said the government supports drone testing and experimentation, will amend the Waddenzee decree to replace the blanket ban with a geographic zone under strict conditions, and will facilitate pilots but gave no firm timetable.
The Ministry of IenW wants to replace the total ban on drones with a geographic zone in which drone operations are possible under strict conditions.
Het Ministerie van IenW wil het totale verbod op drones vervangen door een geografische zone waarin drone operaties onder strikte voorwaarden mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Heerema over het bericht dat de N9 te smal, te saai en te gevaarlijk is

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about press reports calling the N9 road too narrow, dull and dangerous, and why only parts of the N9 are being made safer. The minister confirmed planned safety measures (tunnel and roundabout at Kogendijk, removal of risky bus stop and bike path), but declined to fund a physical lane separation across the whole N9 because the €200 million budget is prioritised for other road sections.
From the €200 million this cabinet has made available for road safety on national N-roads, funds are therefore being allocated to improve road safety on the N9.
Vanuit de € 200 miljoen die dit kabinet beschikbaar heeft gesteld voor verkeersveiligheid Rijks-N-wegen worden daarom middelen beschikbaar gesteld om de verkeersveiligheid op de N9 te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Minhas over de motie Koerhuis en Minhas om te onderzoeken hoe het probleem op de spoorwegen van de Maasvlakte voor goederenvervoer kan worden opgelost

MPs Koerhuis and Minhas asked about their motion to study how rail freight bottlenecks on the Maasvlakte can be solved, including costs and possible state funding. The State Secretary says a bottleneck will emerge, that the state lacks the funds for the proposed €400 million infrastructure and is still negotiating reuse of remaining MIRT money, and that funding the remaining €195 million depends on future Mobility Fund space.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de vlootvervanging van de Rijksrederij

An MP asked the minister about the state of the Rijksrederij fleet replacement, whether the investment can pay for itself, which ships are near end of life, and the maintenance costs and emissions effects of replacement. The minister referred to the earlier letter, said the planning is still current, gave age and cost figures, and stated that business cases are still being prepared without yet quantifying maintenance savings or access to climate funds.
Whether, and if so to what extent, the maintenance costs of the ships will fall, I cannot yet say at this moment.
Of, en zo ja in welke mate, de onderhoudskosten van de schepen dalen, kan ik op dit moment nog niet zeggen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Bevers over het bericht dat er onrust is in de industriehaven van Harlingen omdat er miljoenen in de sluis Kornwerderzand worden geïnvesteerd maar dat vaargeul Boontjes mogelij

MPs Koerhuis and Bevers asked about reports that the Harlingen port fears the Boontjes fairway may silt up despite large investment in the Kornwerderzand lock, and about how the Boontjes was scored in the Integrale Mobiliteitsanalyse. The minister answered that the 3.8m NAP depth will be maintained until a decision in 2023 after evaluation with Fryslân and the Omgevingsberaad Wadden, that there is no direct link to the lock, and that the Boontjes is not a main waterway so was not analysed as a capacity bottleneck.
Until that decision has been taken, the depth of NAP-3.8m will in any case be maintained.
Tot dat dit besluit genomen is, zal in ieder geval de diepte van NAP-3,8m worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat Nelis uit De Lutte het verkeerslawaai van de A1 meer dan beu is

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a newspaper report that residents of De Lutte are fed up with traffic noise from the A1 motorway, and whether noise limits are being exceeded and whether Rijkswaterstaat should measure, act or work with the municipality of Losser. The minister replied that the noise production ceilings are not exceeded, that the monitoring reports are sent to parliament, that bronmaatregelen such as quieter asphalt would be considered if a breach threatened, and that joint action with the municipality is not currently needed.
The GPPs are not exceeded on the A1 at De Lutte.
De GPP's worden bij de A1 bij de Lutte niet overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de motie Koerhuis/Van der Molen om de ratificatie van het luchtvaartverdrag Qatar op te schorten

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management what suspending ratification of the EU-Qatar air transport agreement means in practice, given its provisional application, the additional Qatari flights and slot rights, and what legal options Netherlands has to suspend provisional application. The minister answered that the next ratification step is withheld pending the corruption investigation, that provisional application continues because suspension would expose the state to claims from Qatari airlines, and listed current flight frequencies.
In implementing the motion, this step will not be taken pending the corruption investigation.
Als invulling van de motie zal deze stap niet genomen worden in afwachting van het corruptieonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht “vragen over de motie-Koerhuis om de continuïteit van Groningen Airport Eelde te waarborgen’’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the motion to safeguard Groningen Airport Eelde's continuity, and about funding of ancillary costs (NEDAB) for regional airports, including Caribbean airports and Maastricht Aachen Airport. The minister replied that talks with the airport and provinces are ongoing, that the state does not fund airport operations, and that Caribbean airport funding and NEDAB costs fall outside national airport policy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Haverkort over het bericht dat Bouwend Nederland waarschuwt dat er gaten in de weg komen door een dreigende asfaltcrisis

Two VVD MPs asked whether the government would delay scrapping the approved measure for asphalt production, warning of asphalt shortages and effects on roads, circularity and costs. The Staatssecretaris answered that asphalt plants can meet the emission norms, so production will not stop, that the measure was withdrawn because it could not guarantee compliance, and that she will not relax the emission norms.
No, the approved measure has been withdrawn, see the answer to question 4.
Nee, de erkende maatregel is ingetrokken, zie antwoord onder vraag 4.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de beantwoording op de schriftelijke vragen over het bericht dat de vierbaans N18 waar 100 kilometer mag worden gereden blijft staan als piketpaal

An MP asks the minister to explain how the N18 can have low accident density but high monetised casualty risk, why its road-safety costs are low, what causes accidents between Varsseveld and Groenlo, what planned measures will achieve, and whether MIRT funds can be used. The minister answers that the criteria measure different things, identifies unregulated junctions as the main cause, lists planned junction and verge measures and existing funding, and confirms the answers will be provided before the MIRT meeting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat burgemeesters strijd aanbinden tegen extreme hardrijders na dodelijk ongeval Oud Gastel

MPs asked whether mayors have adequate tools against extreme speeding drivers, including ANPR cameras, geotagging, licence withdrawal and vehicle seizure. The minister said existing tools suffice locally, ANPR cannot be used for repeat speeders for lack of legal basis, geotagging is used sparingly under Police Act art. 3, and licence and vehicle measures exist with data not separately recorded.
Figures on licence withdrawal for speeding are not recorded separately.
Cijfers over invordering van het rijbewijs voor te hard rijden worden niet apart geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat een taskforce een einde moet maken aan de Rijnbrug-impasse

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how the widening of the Rijnbrug at Rhenen can be called a provincial project when it is a national bridge, and whether a new administrative agreement or extra national funding is warranted given rising housing targets. The minister answers that the bridge is part of provincial road N233, that a national lump-sum contribution of EUR 40 million (2022 prices) has been agreed with the Foodvalley region, that the region carries the risks, and declines to commit to a new agreement or to shifting housing funds.
The widening can be carried out for EUR 120 million, with the agreement that the risks lie with the region.
De verbreding kan voor € 120 mln worden uitgevoerd, met de afspraak dat de risico’s bij de regio liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chris Simons en Koerhuis over het artikel ‘Inspectie controleerde twaalf jaar niet op zwaar werk Schiphol’

MPs Chris Simons and Koerhuis asked why the Labour Inspectorate conducted no Arbo Act checks on baggage handling at Schiphol after 2010, despite reported occupational illness, and how this fits risk-based supervision. The minister said she was surprised and shocked, that the inspectorate chose not to inspect for lack of triggers, has started an investigation, and will report back on inspections at Schiphol.
I have asked the Labour Inspectorate to examine whether improvements are possible.
Ik heb de Arbeidsinspectie gevraagd te bezien of er verbeteringen mogelijk zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat de verdachte van het drama in Oud Gastel in een huurauto reed en West-Brabantse burgemeesters verontwaardigd zijn over ‘jonge mannen die keihard rijden’

An MP asked the minister whether the fatal Oud Gastel crash involving a driver in a rented car, and mayors' calls to tackle young speeders in rented cars, reflect a growing trend, and what measures exist or are planned. The minister answered that rental status is not recorded in accident or offence data, so no trend can be established, outlined existing risk-based enforcement and planned educational measures, and pointed to the local security triangle for additional local action.
These registrations do not distinguish between rented and non-rented cars.
In deze registraties wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt tussen gehuurde auto's en niet-gehuurde auto's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Haverkort en Koerhuis over het bericht dat chemisch afval massaal wordt gebruikt als scheepsbrandstof

MPs Haverkort and Koerhuis asked the government about reports that chemical waste is being mixed into marine fuel, including questions on enforcement, EU waste definitions and the financial incentive to mix waste. The State Secretary and Minister mostly deferred substantive answers to a promised letter to parliament on ILT enforcement results, while describing existing REACH, MARPOL and Dutch fuel rules.
The further answering of these questions will address existing regulations and efforts, pending the results of the commitments being carried out.
De verdere beantwoording van deze vragen zal ingaan op bestaande regelgeving en inzet, in afwachting van de resultaten van de in uitvoering zijnde toezeggingen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Koerhuis over de Rijnbrug Rhenen taskforce

An MP asked the minister whether the national government would contribute the remaining 80 million euros to widening the Rijnbrug between Rhenen and Kesteren, given its traffic importance and new national funding. The minister replied that the bridge is a provincial project outside the national main road network, the Rijk has no financial role under a 2012 agreement, and it will not contribute.
I have no insight into the updated estimate and budget of the project.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de geactualiseerde raming en het budget van het project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Vierbaans N18 waar 100 km mag worden gereden blijft staan als piketpaal’

MP Koerhuis asked the minister why the N18 remains a single-carriageway road in parts despite a newsreport about four-lane demands, and about the IMA scores and criteria used. Minister Harbers answered that the 2018 N18 upgrade met safety and liveability goals, that a full 2x2 widening lacks priority and regional benefit, and that the IMA shows no major network bottlenecks, so no full widening is currently planned.
At present no area-based or network-based bottlenecks or challenges have been identified that would give cause to widen the entire N18 to a 2x2 road.
Op dit moment zijn er geen gebiedsgerichte of netwerkgerichte knelpunten of opgaven vastgesteld die aanleiding geven om de N18 in het geheel tot een 2x2 weg te verbreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat veteranen niet naar de herdenking van WOII kunnen gaan door Schiphol-chaos en corona

MP Koerhuis (VVD) asked whether twelve WWII veterans were unable to attend a commemoration because of Schiphol chaos and COVID, and what would be done to guarantee their travel next month. Minister Harbers said Schiphol and the KMAR were unaware of the request because it was filed differently than usual, regretted the miscommunication, agreed arrangements to prevent recurrence, and noted the organiser had cancelled the trip, so no further action was taken on that trip.
Schiphol and the KMAR contacted the organiser, explained the situation and made arrangements for the future to prevent a repetition.
Schiphol en de KMAR hebben contact opgenomen met de organisator en de situatie uitgelegd en afspraken gemaakt voor de toekomst om herhaling te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht dat wetgeving doorrijden na een aanrijding aanzienlijk aangescherpt dient te worden

MPs Koerhuis and Michon-Derkzen asked the ministers whether hit-and-run laws should be tightened after a report by a victims' association, including the 12-hour self-reporting rule, drink-driving detection, prosecution and sentencing figures, and comparisons with neighbouring countries. The minister says the 2020 law already raised maximum penalties, that the 12-hour rule is meant to encourage self-reporting, that prosecution remains the burden of the public prosecutor, and that the 12-hour rule and tightening will be examined with police and the prosecution service following an adopted motion, but the questions were not answered one by one in time.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over een brief van de Provincie Noord-Holland over geluidsregels van luchtvaart

MP Koerhuis asked the State Secretary about a Noord-Holland province letter requesting talks on cumulative aviation noise rules and about implementing his adopted motion to transfer noise rules policy-neutrally. The government says talks with the BRS are scheduled for 12 July 2022, that the rule transfer was policy-neutral, and that it expects to inform parliament over the summer.
The Bestuurlijk Overleg with the BRS is scheduled for 12 July 2022.
Het Bestuurlijk Overleg met de BRS is gepland op 12 juli 2022.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Koerhuis een aantal vragen over een artikel van de Telegraaf  over een Europees Plan om vanaf 2027 een verplichting in te voeren voor de elektrificatie van bedrijfswagens

An MP asked the state secretary about a reported EU plan to require electrification of company fleets from 2027 for large firms and 2030 for SMEs, and about its effects. The state secretary said the proposal is only under consideration within the REPowerEU plan, details are unknown, and the Netherlands would share an impact analysis with parliament later.
I will inform the House, in line with the Van Ginneken, De Hoop and Kröger motion, about possibly including fleet standards in this proposal.
Ik zal de Kamer conform de motie Van Ginneken, De Hoop en Kröger 4 informeren over het eventueel meenemen van vlootnormering bij dit voorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chris Simons en Koerhuis over het artikel 'Mee op pad met de arbeidsinspectie: ‘Het deugt niet, maar jij wilt wel je pakketje morgen bezorgd hebben’'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a press report on harsh working conditions and possible exploitation in parcel delivery, and whether principal contractors such as PostNL bear responsibility for subcontractors. The minister answered that client liability for health and safety exists only in construction, that the SER is advising on redistributing responsibility, and that the Arbeidsinspectie targets the parcel sector through risk-based enforcement.
I see that, partly due to a changing labour market, this allocation of responsibility for prevention and for healthy and safe work does not always work (optimally).
Ik zie dat, mede door een veranderende arbeidsmarkt, deze verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling als het gaat om preventie en de zorg voor gezond en veilig werken, niet in alle gevallen (optimaal) werkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht '‘Veilige’ rotondes vaak het onveiligst voor fietsers'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that roundabouts are often the most dangerous for cyclists, the rise in cycling accidents on roundabouts, and whether cyclist priority should be removed. The minister answered that roundabouts are generally safer than other junctions, that the rise in serious cycling injuries is mainly single-vehicle accidents, and that CROW guidelines are advisory, with the final decision left to road managers.
According to SWOV, roundabouts are safer than ordinary junctions because roundabouts have fewer conflict points than other junction types.
Rotondes zijn volgens SWOV veiliger dan gewone kruispunten, doordat rotondes minder conflictpunten hebben dan andere kruispunttypen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat de aanbesteding van laadpalen in Oost-Nederland naar Vattenfall InCharge gaat

An MP asked whether the tender for public charging points in eastern Netherlands awarded to Vattenfall InCharge is sufficient and what the state would do if Vattenfall underdelivers or prices become too high. The State Secretary replied that the regional concession is sound, Vattenfall must place at least 8,000 points in three years, and no national intervention is needed, while promising a broader letter on a nationally covering network before summer.
I trust that the Oost-Nederland region, as the contracting authority, will oversee this so that sufficient charging points are placed each year.
Ik vertrouw er op dat de regio Oost-Nederland hier als opdrachtgever op toeziet, zodat er jaarlijkse voldoende laadpunten worden geplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat EVBox dieper in de problemen zit door ondeugdelijke laadpalen

An MP asked the Secretary of State for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that EVBox faced problems from defective charging poles, covering quality requirements, supervision, and risks to charging infrastructure if the company fails. The government answered that quality tests are the responsibility of contracting authorities, the company's defects were remedied, and it will address continuity and financial safeguards through the national charging infrastructure agenda without committing to new oversight.
The national government does not have this information.
De rijksoverheid beschikt niet over deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht “200 miljoen die kabinet uittrekt voor veilige N-wegen 'druppel op gloeiende plaat'”

An MP asked the Infrastructure Minister whether the EUR 200 million for safer Rijks-N-wegen is enough, and about provincial investments and national investment plans through 2030. The minister answered that the funds will be prioritised, that provinces are primarily responsible for provincial N-roads with support from the Investeringsimpuls, and that a full overview of provincial investments is not available.
Such an overview cannot be provided.
Een dergelijk overzicht is niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Haverkort, Koerhuis en Peter de Groot over de uitzending van EenVandaag over mogelijke tekorten in industriezand en grind

VVD MPs asked the government whether extraction permits for sand and gravel are expiring, whether shortages will arise, and how supply will meet the infrastructure and housing ambitions. The minister answered that a monitoring system and a national demand forecast are being developed, that circularity measures are underway, and that talks with provinces and the sector are ongoing.
At present, the need for sand and gravel is being mapped in cooperation with knowledge institutes and industry organisations. The House will be informed of the results before the end of the year.

Op dit moment wordt – in samenwerking met kennisinstituten en brancheorganisaties – de behoefte aan zand en grind in beeld gebracht. De Kamer zal voor het eind van het jaar over het resultaat worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de wachttijden bij het CBR

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about driving-test waiting times at the CBR, the possible raising of the exam age, and the shortage of examiners. The minister answered in detail on waiting times, examiner recruitment, and the rejection of temporary emergency measures, while stating he would inform parliament before any such measures are used.
Furthermore, my predecessor committed to informing the House before temporary emergency measures are deployed.
Daarnaast heeft mijn voorganger toegezegd de Kamer te informeren voorafgaand aan de inzet van tijdelijke noodmaatregelen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden van de leden Koerhuis en Haverkort over ongelukken met e-bikes en drukte op fietspaden

MPs Koerhuis and Haverkort asked the minister about reports of more accidents with fast e-bikes and crowded cycle paths, including causes, prevention, sales information, speed tuning, and path design. The minister answered that the role of e-bikes is still being studied with results due by end 2022, outlined educational campaigns and infrastructure investments, and said the government will inform parliament before year end.
By the end of 2022 at the latest, your House will be informed of the results.
Uiterlijk eind 2022 wordt uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de resultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat de A1 ter hoogte van afrit Hoevelaken en oprit Hoevelaken wordt afgesloten

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the closure of the A1 parallel carriageway and the Hoevelaken on/off ramps, its expected duration, why no temporary fix was chosen, and how similar failures of road-bridge joints will be prevented. The minister confirmed the six-week closure, explained that a permanent joint replacement was chosen for safety and that prevention depends on maintenance programming and budget choices to be communicated to parliament.
Last December my predecessor informed your House about this matter.
Afgelopen december is uw Kamer hierover door mijn voorganger geïnformeerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat de noodklok wordt geluid door het gevaar op N-wegen

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports of dangerous N-roads, including fatality figures, planned road safety measures, and progress on specific N-roads such as the N36. The minister disputed the figures as not comparable, described the €25m verge-safety programme and €200m investment, and listed the timeline of works and a campaign on driver behaviour.
The precise number and share of fatal traffic accidents and traffic deaths on all N-roads of the various road managers will be included in the research needed to implement the Madlener motion.

Het precieze aantal en aandeel dodelijke verkeersongevallen en verkeersdoden op alle N-wegen van de verschillende wegbeheerders zal worden meegenomen in het benodigde onderzoek voor de uitwerking van de motie-Madlener.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het kredietregister

MP Koerhuis asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about SME financing problems, possible solutions, and whether a credit register is desirable, and asked for an overview of OECD countries with credit registers. The minister outlined existing SME financing instruments, said a credit register exploration plan will be started with external research before any decision, and said a full overview of foreign registers could not be produced in the time available.

It has not proved possible to prepare these overviews in this short timeframe and at the same time show how the credit registers in those countries have contributed to improving SMEs' access to finance.

Het is niet goed mogelijk gebleken om deze overzichten in dit korte tijdsbestek op te stellen en daarbij tevens inzichtelijk te maken op welke wijze de kredietregisters in die landen hebben bijgedragen om de toegang van mkb'ers tot financiering te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het artikel dat de IVBN oproept de nieuwe wet Opkoopbescherming aan te passen

An MP asked the Minister about an IVBN call to amend the new Opkoopbescherming law, which he said blocks new rental housing construction in Amsterdam, and whether Amsterdam's implementation is responsible. The minister answered that the law is aimed at existing housing, that the wording does not clearly exclude new builds so he will consider clarifying it, and that municipalities can avoid the conflict, while promising to monitor implementation and evaluate.
