I will consider whether it is necessary to remove this ambiguity by clarifying in the law that the purchase protection applies only to existing homes.
Ik ga bezien of het nodig is om deze onduidelijkheid weg te nemen door in de wet te verduidelijken dat de opkoopbescherming enkel ziet op bestaande woningen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat de ouders van Gio (4) het stilzwijgen verbreken na een dodelijk ongeluk met voetballer Vloet

An MP asked the minister about a fatal crash involving footballer Vloet, the club's social and road-safety role, and penalties and campaigns against extreme speeding and drink driving. The minister gave a mostly general answer, declining to comment on the specific case, deferring club decisions to the clubs, and describing existing campaigns, penalty levels and an expert group under way.
Furthermore, I will not go into this specific situation as the case is still under investigation.
Verder ga ik niet in op deze specifieke situatie gezien de zaak nog in onderzoek is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Gebiedsverboden en mobiele flitspalen: zo wil Haagse VVD verkeersaso’s aanpakken'

MPs Koerhuis and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked the ministers about enforcement of traffic rules on municipal roads, the number and use of speed cameras, and how the Public Prosecution Service decides where to place them. The government answered that enforcement is set locally by the tripartite consultation (mayor, police, prosecution), that flitspaal placement follows a published policy framework, and that it will inform the House in early 2022 on new enforcement tools for notorious offenders.
Police deployment for traffic enforcement is determined locally in the tripartite consultation (mayor, police and Public Prosecution Service).
De inzet van de politie op verkeershandhaving wordt lokaal in de driehoek (burgemeester, politie en OM) bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat bewoners moeten wijken voor statushouders

An MP asked the Minister about reports that current anti-squat residents of Krabbenbossen in Zundert must make way for refugee-status holders, and about information provided to them, the number of pilot projects, and whether current residents will be rehoused. The minister answered that the municipality is responsible, that residents were informed (though not all in time), that the project is for 95 units for refugee-status holders, and declined to intervene in local responsibilities.
I do not know the local situation and I do not want to intrude on the responsibilities of the municipalities.
Ik ken de lokale situatie niet en ik wil niet in de verantwoordelijkheden van de gemeenten treden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en De Kort over het artikel dat bijstandsgerechtigden in Amsterdam een halfjaar mogen samenwonen zonder gevolgen voor hun uitkering waarin beide partners hun eigen woning mogen aa

MPs Koerhuis and De Kort (VVD) asked the minister whether Amsterdam's policy letting welfare recipients cohabit for six months without benefit consequences, while keeping their own homes, is acceptable given vacancy and social housing waiting lists. The minister answered that the measure stays within the Participatiewet, is not the cost-sharing norm, avoids premature housing loss, falls within the six-month vacancy limit, and that he will be informed of the results of this and the Tilburg trial.
In our view, the municipality of Amsterdam is not conducting income policy with this measure.
De gemeente Amsterdam bedrijft naar ons oordeel met deze maatregel geen inkomenspolitiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat vaste bewoners van Bungalowpark L’Air Pur in Baarle-Nassau hun vaste plek willen behouden

An MP asks whether residents of a bungalow park in Baarle-Nassau who face enforcement and penalty payments should be protected, and whether the minister will intervene via the expert team or reopen rules allowing permanent residence. The minister says enforcement is a municipal matter, the municipality has been informed about the expert team, and a study on permanent residence in recreational homes is ongoing with results expected in spring 2022.
It is up to the municipality and province to make this assessment.
Het is aan de gemeente en provincie om deze afweging te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat Wijk bij Duurstede ruim twee keer zoveel woningen wil bouwen

An MP asked the minister whether Wijk bij Duurstede's request for 530 extra homes was blocked by provincial limits on the built-up area and whether the province should be pressed to remove such obstacles. The minister answered that the province allows expansion under conditions, capped the local site at 280 extra homes over road-network concerns, and promised monitoring and consultation without committing to reversing the restriction.
The province has indicated it will allow a maximum of 280 extra homes on this expansion site, because a higher number is expected to cause bottlenecks on the provincial road network.

De provincie heeft aangegeven op deze uitbreidingslocatie de ontwikkeling van maximaal 280 extra woningen toe te staan, omdat een hoger aantal naar verwachting leidt tot knelpunten op het provinciale wegennet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Koerhuis over het artikel dat de woningbouw naar nul gaat door nieuwe wet

MPs Minhas and Koerhuis (VVD) asked the minister about a newspaper report that a new noise law would bring housing construction near zero, and about the status of the Koerhuis motion on policy-neutral transfer of noise rules. The minister rejects the report's conclusions, says the impact analysis shows up to 60,000-80,000 planned homes may face cumulation assessments, and says a joint working process with the region and an implementation guide for municipalities are underway.
The ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and I are willing to draft, together with the region, a framework or guidance for municipalities that face this issue.
De bewindslieden van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en ik zijn bereid om samen met de regio een handelingskader of handreiking op te stellen voor gemeenten die daarmee te maken krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Van Wijngaarden en Koerhuis over de actuele veiligheidsrisico’s voor Nederlanders in Oekraïne

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Infrastructure about security risks for Dutch nationals in Ukraine, including travel advice, evacuation preparations and airspace safety. The government answered that there is no reason yet to speak of a threatening situation, kept the current travel advice, said evacuation is not being organised, and pointed to existing EU and national airspace risk assessments.
That number need not be representative of the actual number of Dutch nationals in Ukraine, because there is no registration obligation for Dutch nationals abroad (due to privacy).
Dat getal hoeft niet per se representatief te zijn voor het daadwerkelijke aantal Nederlanders in Oekraïne, omdat er geen registratieplicht is voor Nederlanders in het buitenland (vanwege privacy).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat meer tribunes in het Goffertstadion onveilig zijn en herstelmaatregelen nodig zijn voor heropening

An MP asked the minister about reports that more stadium stands at the Goffertstadion were unsafe and needed repairs before reopening, and about structural stadium safety across the Netherlands, including comparisons with Belgium and the UK. The minister answered that repairs were permitted and the municipality will decide on reopening after work is done, and that a legal periodic structural safety assessment for large public buildings is being prepared, while stating no national stadium authority is needed.
I am currently working on the necessary amendment of the Building Decree for the Living Environment, which I expect to submit to your House this spring in the pre-consultation procedure.
Ik werk thans aan de benodigde wijziging van het Besluit Bouwwerken Leefomgeving (Bbl) die ik naar verwachting in dit voorjaar aan uw Kamer zal voorleggen in het kader van de voorhangprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de beantwoording op de schriftelijke vragen over het artikel dat Amsterdam een opkoopbescherming wil invoeren voor de hele stad

MP Koerhuis asked the Minister of Interior whether Amsterdam's plan to apply its purchase protection to the whole city fits the law, which refers to buurten and gebieden, and whether it is well justified. The Minister replied that the law leaves municipalities free to define gebied, that a citywide designation is legally possible but must be justified by scarcity or liveability, and that assessing Amsterdam's justification is for the municipal council and, ultimately, the courts.
It is not for me as Minister to assess Amsterdam's justification.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister om de onderbouwing van Amsterdam te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de beantwoording van de schriftelijke vragen over het maken van landelijke prestatieafspraken met corporaties

An MP asks why national performance agreements were made with Aedes, which does not represent all housing corporations, and how non-member corporations and performance targets will be ensured, and whether regional or provincial agreements or differentiated tax relief will be pursued. The minister says non-members are bound via the priorities and local agreements, defers the regional-agreement question to the next cabinet, and rejects regionally differentiated levy relief.
With Aedes I am working out over the coming weeks how we keep good oversight of achieving the targets in the national performance agreements
Met Aedes werk ik de komende weken uit hoe we goed zicht houden op het realiseren van de doelen uit de landelijke prestatieafspraken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het beleidsneutraal overzetten van beleidsregels

The MP Koerhuis asked the Minister of the Interior about the implementation of the motion on transferring noise rules without policy change, and the status of an impact analysis on cumulation rules for housing. The minister answers that the Aanvullingswet geluid is a policy-neutral transfer of SWUNG-2 but that the revised aircraft noise cumulation rule is a policy change, that an impact analysis was completed in August 2021, and that consultations with administrative partners continue; she commits to sending the impact analyses to parliament as soon as possible.
The State Secretary of IenW, as the responsible minister for noise policy, will send the impact analyses to your House as soon as possible.
De Staatssecretaris van IenW zal, als verantwoordelijk bewindspersoon voor het geluidbeleid, de impactanalyses zo spoedig mogelijk toezenden aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat woningverhuurders met een miljardenclaim dreigen richting de staat

An MP asked whether the minister would release internal advice, Landsadvocaat advice and the Raad van State advice on property rights concerning a planned cap on WOZ points in the rent-valuation system, which landlords threaten to challenge in court for billions. The minister refused to release the internal and Landsadvocaat advice because of an anticipated court case and the advice predates the new policy line, but promised to point the House to the Raad van State advice once published.
In light of that possible procedure, I am not willing to make the internal advice on property rights public.
In het licht van die mogelijke procedure ben ik niet bereid om de interne adviezen met betrekking tot het eigendomsrecht openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het artikel dat Amsterdam een opkoopbescherming wil invoeren voor de hele stad

MP Koerhuis asked the Minister of Interior about Amsterdam's plan to introduce city-wide purchase protection for homes below 512,000 euro, including contacts with the ministry, consistency with the statutory criteria of scarcity and the NHG limit, and property rights. Minister Ollongren answered that the municipality is responsible for its own scope and justification, that the ministry gave general briefings but did not review the Amsterdam proposal, and that the statute allows municipal discretion while a strong justification is required, and that the amendment route bypassed Raad van State advice.
The municipality of Amsterdam is itself responsible for the scope it has chosen in its policy proposal for the purchase protection scheme.
De gemeente Amsterdam is dus zelf verantwoordelijk voor de reikwijdte die zij heeft gekozen in haar beleidsvoorstel voor de regeling Opkoopbescherming.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat Verenigingen van Eigenaren (VvE) zich grote zorgen maken over een nieuwe wet waardoor bewoners laadpunten voor elektrische auto’s in ondergrondse garages kunne

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a planned notification scheme for EV charging points in VvE-managed garages would effectively force associations to install chargers, and whether municipalities block charging on streets citing garages. The minister denied that VvEs are obliged to install chargers, said the owner-initiated notification process involves VvE board review, and declined to meet the VNG, saying municipal parking policy is for municipalities to set.
The VvE board assesses whether the conditions of the notification scheme and any additional VvE conditions are met.
Het VvE-bestuur beoordeelt of is voldaan aan de voorwaarden van de notificatieregeling en de eventuele aanvullende voorwaarden van de VvE.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de beantwoording van de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport tijdens het notaoverleg van 25 oktober 2021 over het maken van landelijke prestatieafspraken met corpora

An MP asked whether the government will make national performance agreements with housing associations via Aedes rather than individually, and how local agreements are made. The minister confirmed national agreements with Aedes on the EUR 500 million levy reduction, citing that individual agreements do not fit the Housing Act and that Aedes represents nearly all associations, and promised monitoring and involvement of non-members.
That is also not necessary, because nearly all housing associations are represented by Aedes.
Dat is ook niet nodig, omdat nagenoeg alle corporaties door Aedes vertegenwoordigd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het artikel dat de Twentse corporatie Domijn met een truc de verhuurdersheffing omzeilt

MP Koerhuis asked the Minister of Interior whether housing corporation Domijn's use of a tax construction to avoid the rental housing levy is acceptable, how many corporations use it, and whether the rules for the new-build tax reduction will be tightened. The Minister declined to comment on individual taxpayers, explained how the investment declaration scheme works, rejected any link between municipal and Authority approvals and the tax reduction, and said corporations are expected to follow the rules, while rule changes cannot be retroactive.
For individual taxpayers and their tax affairs, however, the duty of confidentiality applies and I cannot make any statement.
Voor individuele belastingplichtigen en hun belastingzaken geldt echter de geheimhoudingsplicht 2 en kan ik geen uitspraak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Koerhuis over het bericht 'Asielzoekerscentra bomvol: 'We zitten tegen crisisnoodopvang aan'' en 'Afghanen de druppel'

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security and the Minister of the Interior about the overcrowding of asylum reception centres, the causes of the shortage, and the government's plans to expand capacity and speed up the outflow of status holders. The government answers that all regular reception places are full, attributes this to rising inflow, slow housing of status holders by municipalities and reception capacity pressures, and describes efforts to add temporary places, flexible housing pilots and IND backlog measures.
With this, all regular reception places are occupied and various forms of emergency reception are now being used.
Daarmee zijn alle reguliere opvangplekken bezet en wordt nu verschillende vormen van noodopvang ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Koerhuis over de brandveiligheid van zonnepanelen

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Koerhuis asked about fire safety of solar panels after a roof fire in Hoofddorp and whether building fire-safety rules for new homes are enforced. The minister answered that municipalities supervise compliance, that the Wkb quality-assurance law is planned for 1 July 2022, that NEN is reviewing standards, and that research on particle deposition from solar-panel fires is ongoing with results expected in early 2022.
It is up to the municipality as competent authority to supervise compliance with the fire-safety regulations that apply to new homes.
Het is aan de gemeente als bevoegd gezag toe te zien op de naleving van de brandveiligheidsvoorschriften die gelden voor nieuwbouwwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Koerhuis over de beantwoording van de eerdere schriftelijke vragen over het bericht dat het metropakket MRA een serieuze optie is voor financiering uit Nationaal Groeifonds

MP Koerhuis (VVD) asked the Minister of Interior Affairs follow-up questions on earlier answers about the Amsterdam metropolitan package (MRA) and possible Nationaal Groeifonds financing, covering Haven-Stad housing comparisons, land revenue differences between social and owner-occupied housing, a planned harbour basin in the Houtrakpolder, and the cost of earlier harbour basins. The minister answered that the projects are not fully comparable, that land-price differences cannot be averaged, that a sensitivity analysis on housing mix is underway, that the Houtrakpolder plans are not yet elaborated, and that Havenbedrijf Amsterdam's individual project costs are not public.
The Port of Amsterdam Company N.V. is a company. Therefore information on the costs of individual works is not public and the requested amount cannot be provided.
Het Havenbedrijf Amsterdam N.V. is een bedrijf. Daarom is informatie over de kosten van individuele werken niet openbaar en kan het gevraagde bedrag niet worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat appartementencomplexen elektrische auto’s weigeren in hun garages uit vrees voor brand

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that apartment complexes refuse electric cars in their garages over fire fears, and about the planned notification scheme for charging points in owners' associations' (VvE) car parks. The minister answered that electric cars are not more fire-prone than combustion cars, outlined planned Bbl changes and a subsidy for VvE charging advice, and said VvEs will not be obliged to install charging points.
VvE's are not obliged to install charging points.
VvE's worden niet verplicht tot het plaatsen van oplaadpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van der Woude over het bericht dat de bank voortaan je studieschuld kan opzoeken

Two VVD MPs asked whether a plan letting banks look up students' study debt via DUO for mortgage applications breaks the earlier promise that study debt would not be registered for mortgages. The minister replied that the government is not introducing a BKR registration of study debt, that the data stays with citizens who choose whether to share it, and that no talks with DUO are needed.
The cabinet is not proceeding with a BKR registration of study debts.
Het kabinet gaat niet over tot een BKR-registratie voor studieschulden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het Rebel rapport inzake de business case van 14 de grootschalige woningbouwgebieden

The MP asks the Minister of Interior about the Rebel report on the business case of 14 large-scale housing areas, covering the unfunded public investment, social rent share, land prices, sustainable heating choices, the selection of rail-zone areas and whether other rail zones could be added. The Minister confirms the report, gives consolidated figures and land price ranges, says sensitivity analyses are still underway, and explains the selection criteria, while stating that other rail-zone projects are a municipal choice and may fall under a future WBI tranche.
Once this research is completed, I will inform your House about it.
Zodra dit onderzoek gereed is, zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht 'Radar Checkt! Woonstichting De Key gooit studenten op straat'

An MP asked whether housing association De Key is withholding statutory relocation compensation from students in several Amsterdam and Diemen complexes, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister explained the legal conditions for the minimum relocation allowance, reported De Key's own account of each case, said assessing individual claims is for the courts, and stated she would inform parliament and had no signals about other corporations.
Whether tenants wrongly did not receive the statutory relocation allowance is a matter for the judge.
Het oordeel of huurders ten onrechte niet de wettelijke verhuiskostenvergoeding hebben ontvangen is aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat provincie Noord-Holland een ultimatum stelt aan gemeente Castricum om huisvesting voor statushouders te regelen

An MP asks the Minister of Interior about the province of Noord-Holland's ultimatum to Castricum to arrange housing for refugee status holders, including whether the BPL landscape, grid connection delays and the BAG law hinder building, and whether the ultimatum conflicts with a national pilot. The minister answers that the province's intervention ladder is applied case by case, that sufficient building plan capacity exists, that the province is the supervisor, and that the pilot evaluation is pending.
It is up to the province, in its legal role as supervisor, to assess whether substitution is appropriate when a municipality gives no or insufficient effect to the statutory task.

Het is aan de provincie in haar wettelijke rol als toezichthouder om te beoordelen of indeplaatsstelling aan de orde is, wanneer een gemeente geen of te beperkt invulling geeft aan de wettelijke taakstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat een asielgezin uit het AZC Heerlen mag worden gezet voor het weigeren van een te kleine sociale huurwoning

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that an asylum-seeker family could be evicted from a Heerlen reception centre for refusing a social rental home, and about how often status holders refuse housing. The minister answered that most refusals are accepted after their consequences become clear, that 1,598 of 1,696 refusals since 2013 were found unjustified, and that the outcome for the family is for the municipality and COA to resolve.
It is not possible to break down the above figures by household composition and region, as this is not recorded.
Het is niet mogelijk om bovenstaande cijfers op te splitsen naar gezinssamenstelling en regio, dit wordt niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van den Hil over het bericht dat de derde ronde Woningbouwimpuls opent in september 2021

MPs Koerhuis and Van den Hil asked whether small and medium municipalities face high minimum project sizes (200 and 500 homes) under the Woningbouwimpuls and whether they may pool projects regionally. The minister answered that no such signals reached her beyond Noord- and Midden-Limburg, that joint applications are already possible if one municipality applies, and that the third round's funds are exhausted.
After the third tranche the financial resources for the Woningbouwimpuls are exhausted, so municipalities cannot submit an application for the Woningbouwimpuls after all.
Na de derde tranche zijn de financiële middelen voor de Woningbouwimpuls uitgeput, waardoor gemeenten niet alsnog een aanvraag voor de woningbouwimpuls kunnen indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht “Meer mensen plegen fraude om sociale huurwoning te krijgen”

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether applicants forge documents for social rental housing, whether housing corporations can verify data without access to BRP records, and whether a legal basis for data sharing should be created. The minister acknowledged the forgery problem, pointed to a digital income-check pilot and fraud-detection methods, rejected large-scale data sharing without suspicion as disproportionate, and promised an update on a related study later in the year.
Large-scale information exchange to detect fraud, where there is no suspicion, I do not consider proportionate.
Grootschalige informatie-uitwisseling om fraude op te sporen, waarbij geen sprake is van een verdenking, acht ik niet proportioneel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat provincie Noord-Holland woningbouw in Callantsoog tegenhoudt

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether the Noord-Holland province is blocking a 32-home housing project in Callantsoog, whether housing sites were dropped by the new environmental ordinance, and how the province handles overprogramming and small-scale building in BPL landscape areas. The minister answers that the ordinance does not drop firm municipal plans, that planning capacity is sufficient, that the 32-home project exceeds the 11-home small-scale limit, and that regional coordination and a Noord-Holland-Noord housing deal are ongoing.
No, this is not correct. The adopted environmental ordinance takes existing housing sites into account.
Nee, dit klopt niet. De vastgestelde Omgevingsverordening houdt rekening met de bestaande woningbouwlocaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Koerhuis over brandveiligheid en overbewoning

MPs Beckerman and Koerhuis asked the Minister of the Interior about fire safety and overcrowding after a fatal fire at an overcrowded house in The Hague, including whether the municipality acted adequately and whether enforcement tools against malicious landlords are sufficient. The Minister answered that municipalities hold the enforcement powers, that current instruments are generally adequate, that the repetition requirement is expected to be dropped on 1 January 2022, and that a 'goed verhuurderschap' bill is in consultation, without assessing the municipality's conduct.
It is not for me to judge whether a municipality acted adequately in a case.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen of een gemeente in een geval adequaat handelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Koerhuis over het op straat zetten van meerderjarige weeskinderen (en/of andere medebewoners van overleden familieleden of partners)

MPs Van der Plas and Koerhuis asked the Minister of the Interior about housing corporations evicting adult orphans and other co-residents after a family member's death, including a case in Enschede. The Minister answered that temporary tenancy contracts will be allowed via a regulation change expected around November, a code of conduct is planned by year end, further legal options are being explored, and corporations will be urged via Aedes to act humanely.

The Regulation on Admitted Housing Institutions is currently being amended so that housing corporations can offer these adult children a temporary lease, allowing them to stay longer in a social rental home.

Momenteel wordt daartoe de Regeling Toegelaten Instellingen Volkshuisvesting (RTIV) aangepast, zodat woningcorporaties deze meerderjarige kinderen een tijdelijk huurcontract aan kunnen bieden waardoor zij langer in een sociale huurwoning kunnen wonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over veranderingen op het gebied van woningtaxaties

MP Koerhuis (VVD) asked the Interior Minister about rising costs and changes to mortgage valuations, including the new physical valuation report, a possible maximum price, the EBA guidelines and whether hybrid desktop valuations should be allowed. The minister replied that the sector sets its own prices, rejected a maximum price for now, pointed to cheaper hybrid valuations permitted under EBA rules, and promised to monitor costs and talk with the sector.
I will closely monitor the costs of the new model report after 1 October and where necessary engage in discussion with the sector about this.
Ik zal de kosten van het nieuwe modelrapport na 1 oktober a.s. nauw volgen en waar nodig het gesprek met de sector hierover aangaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Erkens over het bericht inzake overbelasting van elektriciteitsnetten in wijken

MPs Koerhuis and Erkens asked whether electricity grids in neighbourhoods are becoming overloaded, blocking solar connections, new businesses and new homes, and what the government will do. The state secretary confirms growing transport scarcity, points to existing measures and the planned Energy Act, and says new homes may be allowed gas connections where grid capacity is lacking.
Netbeheer Nederland is still working on a national overview of scarce transport capacity for electricity offtake and expects to have it ready this autumn.
Netbeheer Nederland werkt nog aan een landelijk overzicht van schaarse transportcapaciteit voor de afname van elektriciteit en verwacht dat dit najaar gereed te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Koerhuis over de fatale brand in Arnhem en lessen voor brandveiligheid

MPs Beckerman and Koerhuis asked about the fatal Arnhem flat fire, fire-safety supervision of existing buildings, single-escape-route flats, and fire safety of mattresses and upholstered furniture. The minister said she will respond to the Onderzoeksraad recommendations within six months, await an IFV study due in October, and promised further consultation with municipalities and building owners, but did not commit to specific new regulation.
I am going to talk with municipalities and building owners about this supervision.
Ik ga in gesprek met gemeenten en gebouweigenaren over dit toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat woonwagenbewoners, gemeente Haarlem en corporaties een actieplan maken voor woonwagenbewoners

MP Koerhuis (VVD) asked the Minister of the Interior whether other municipalities should be urged to make action plans for caravan dwellers, and raised mortgage and fire insurance access, the shortage of standplaatsen, and the lack of regional and national action. The Minister said she will encourage municipalities through a knowledge programme and a funding scheme rather than require action plans, will talk with lenders and insurers, and will wait for results before considering further instruments.
I do not want to use the data from the repeat measurement now to approach or name individual municipalities.
Ik wil de gegevens uit de Herhaalmeting nu nog niet gebruiken om individuele gemeenten te benaderen of te noemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Ellian over het bericht inzake vertraging woningbouw door tekort aan capaciteit in rechtspraak

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that housing construction in Rotterdam (about 1,310 homes) is stalled because Council of State court cases take too long. The minister acknowledged that durations at the Administrative Jurisdiction Division are longer than desired for some cases, explained the statutory deadlines and causes of delay, noted she cannot say how many projects are stalled, and said no extra funds were given specifically to building cases.
On the basis of the available data I cannot state how many appeal cases concerning housing projects are not decided within statutory deadlines and therefore remain too long before the judge.
Ik kan op basis van de beschikbare gegevens niet aangeven hoeveel beroepszaken over woningbouwprojecten niet binnen wettelijke termijnen worden afgedaan en derhalve te lang bij de rechter liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en De Kort over het bericht inzake vriendjespolitiek in de Eemshaven

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether municipal councils and provincial states could approve land purchase, development and sale frameworks for the Eemshaven port company, how transparent such land deals are, and whether councillors may hold executive posts in joint regulations. The minister answered that the port was corporatised in 2013 with council and states approval, that ministerial supervision is risk-based and no longer requires approval for private law entities since 2016, that council representation in joint regulations is appropriate, and that she will ask the BBV commission to pay attention to transparency.

I will additionally ask the BBV commission whether special attention can be paid to how municipalities, provinces and joint regulations should give shape to this when land policy activities are placed with a private law entity at a distance.
Ik zal de commissie BBV aanvullend vragen of bijzondere aandacht kan worden besteed aan de manier waarop gemeenten, provincies en gemeenschappelijke regelingen hier invulling aan dienen te geven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de brief van Aedes voor Commissiedebat Wonen en Corona

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about housing association Aedes' letter on evicting orphaned children, the implementation of the Koerhuis motion, and whether housing rules or rent allowance should be changed for young adults who lost parents. The Minister said she will amend the Rtiv 2015 to allow temporary leases for adult orphans, draft a code of conduct, and that the age limit issue for rent allowance requires a future cabinet's integral assessment.
To make this possible, I intend to amend the Regulation on admitted housing institutions (Rtiv) 2015 in the short term.
Om dit mogelijk te maken wil ik op korte termijn de Regeling toegelaten instellingen volkshuisvesting (Rtiv) 2015 aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Beckerman over brandveiligheid van gebouwen in Nederland

MPs Koerhuis and Beckerman asked the Minister of the Interior why fire safety of buildings has still not been fully mapped nearly four years after Grenfell, and questioned provinces' and municipalities' handling of the inventory, including municipalities that have not reported. The Minister answers that provinces and municipalities have policy discretion, that an inventory is being completed with a follow-up survey of 80 municipalities this year, and that she will inform the House at year end.
Provinces have policy discretion over how interadministrative supervision is given shape.
Provincies hebben beleidsvrijheid hoe aan het interbestuurlijke toezicht vorm wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het feit dat de provincie Noord-Holland woningbouw in Landsmeer tegenhoudt

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of the Interior why the province of Noord-Holland is blocking housing in Landsmeer, and whether the Minister has spoken only with the province and not with the municipality. The Minister answers that contact with both parties has taken place, that housing is a provincial competence in the region, that eight discussion locations were dropped in BPL landscape areas affecting only soft plans, and that a maatwerk approach for linear settlements is being developed.
Therefore this topic will soon be discussed in consultation between my ministry and the deputy minister for spatial planning and housing of Noord-Holland.
Daarom komt dit onderwerp binnenkort aan de orde tijdens overleg tussen mijn ministerie en de gedeputeerde Ruimtelijke ordening en wonen van Noord-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de beantwoording van de vragen over het feit dat mevrouw Bunschoten met drie kinderen door corporatie Dudok feitelijk op straat wordt gezet

An MP asked whether a divorced mother of three being effectively evicted by housing corporation Dudok fits the human-scale approach, and whether Article 1.7 of the local housing ordinance allows corporations to help such tenants. The minister said individual assessment at local level is appropriate, that Article 1.7 is for existing tenants rather than applicants, and that she will inform parliament after the summer on the problem of divorced parents.
I will inform the House about this after the summer, involving the various stakeholders.
Ik zal de Kamer hierover na de zomer informeren, waarbij ik tevens de verschillende stakeholders zal betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat bouwen in het oosten goedkoper is

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Interior about reports that building in eastern Netherlands is cheaper, whether further research into building more homes there is needed, how housing plans there are being accelerated, and the status of the Arnhem–Nijmegen housing deal, a motion on a Zwolle–Deventer–Apeldoorn deal, and a stikstof-related motion. The minister answered that planning capacity in Overijssel and Gelderland is sufficient to 2030 so additional research is unnecessary, listed acceleration programmes and agreements, reported progress on the Arnhem–Nijmegen deal, and said talks on the Zwolle–Deventer–Apeldoorn deal are ongoing with the decision left to the next cabinet.
It is up to the new cabinet to ultimately make a decision on this.
Het is aan het nieuwe kabinet om hier uiteindelijk een besluit over te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Koerhuis over het artikel ‘Plannen voor daklozenwoningen belanden te vaak in ijskast’

MPs Van den Hil and Koerhuis asked whether homelessness housing plans are stalling, how many of the 10,000 supported housing places have been realised, and whether temporary housing, prioritisation and municipal data are adequate. The State Secretary answered that municipalities report about 2,200 places realised by end 2020 (on track by their own measure), with overlapping figures from housing associations and the BZK fund, acknowledged delays due to COVID, and deferred further prioritisation and additional measures to a future cabinet.
It is up to a future cabinet to determine how the follow-up is shaped.
Het is aan een volgend kabinet om te bepalen hoe het vervolg vorm wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Beckerman over brandveiligheid

MPs Koerhuis and Beckerman asked the Minister of the Interior about fire safety of buildings after the Grenfell fire, including the lack of an inventory of risky buildings, the status of municipal inventories and provincial oversight, and whether municipalities can be compelled to act. The Minister answered that most provinces and municipalities are progressing, that municipalities have policy discretion but are expected to complete the inventory, and that results will be sent to parliament by end 2021.
I asked the provinces to indicate what actions they have taken following my request.
Ik heb de provincies verzocht om aan te geven welke acties zij hebben ondernomen naar aanleiding van mijn verzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat rijksambtenaren maar weinig weten van wat zich in Twente en de Achterhoek afspeelt

An MP asked the Interior Minister about a report that national civil servants know little about Twente and the Achterhoek and take those regions' concerns less seriously, and asked for a response to the advisory council's findings and for steps to improve rijk-regio cooperation. The minister declined to comment on substance for all questions, deferring to a formal response to the advisory council's report, expected before the summer recess.
Pursuant to article 24 of the Framework Act on Advisory Bodies, I will respond within 3 months of receiving the advice.
Op grond van artikel 24 van de Kaderwet adviescolleges, zal ik binnen 3 maanden na ontvangst van het advies een reactie geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Koerhuis over het NRC-bericht ‘Nieuwe bouwcrisis dreigt door ‘onwerkbare’ megawet’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the Environmental and Planning Act (Omgevingswet) could delay building projects if introduced on 1 January 2022, and whether the digital system is ready. The Minister answered that the start date moves to 1 July 2022, admitted the digital system is not yet fully in order with ongoing delays, and described temporary alternative measures and transitional law.
With a view to meeting the minimum criteria for entry into force, together with the other governments it has been decided to move the entry-into-force date from 1 January 2022 to 1 July 2022.

Antwoord 2 Met het oog op het voldoen aan de minimumcriteria voor inwerkingtreding is samen met de andere overheden besloten de inwerkingtredingsdatum van 1 januari 2022 naar 1 juli 2022 te verplaatsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat Amsterdam een bouwstop doorvoert in belangrijke groeigebieden

MP Koerhuis asked the Minister of Interior whether Amsterdam's reported building stop in growth areas would worsen the housing shortage, its effect on metropolitan planning capacity, land prices and Woningbouwimpuls-funded projects. The minister answered that no ongoing projects are affected, that planning capacity is ample, that land prices are set per location, and that no call with the municipality is needed.
The level of land prices is not public.
De hoogte van de grondprijzen is niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat provincie Noord-Holland woningbouw in Landsmeer tegen houdt

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether a Noord-Holland provincial landscape designation (BPL) and restrictions on small-scale housing in Landsmeer had removed housing locations and undermined housing targets. The minister answered that only a limited number (about 1,200 homes across eight locations) is affected, that planning capacity is sufficient, and that cooperation with the province on housing is ongoing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Minhas over het bericht 'Vertraging woningbouw dreigt na uitspraak Raad van State'

MPs Koerhuis and Minhas (VVD) asked the Minister of the Interior about a Council of State ruling that may lengthen housing project delays by letting non-objectors appeal, and about the risk of further delays and of people selling off objections. The minister answers that the ruling is not a crisis but may lengthen procedures, that a bill to amend the General Administrative Law Act is being prepared, and that a draft will go to internet consultation this summer.
The intention is to put a draft bill out for (internet) consultation this summer.
Het voornemen is om deze zomer een conceptwetsvoorstel in (internet)consultatie te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Remco Dijkstra en Wiersma over het bericht dat het metropakket MRA een serieuze optie is voor financiering uit Nationaal Groeifonds

VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that the Amsterdam metropolitan package (extending the North/South line and closing the ring line) was a serious option for Nationaal Groeifonds funding, including housing numbers, port land use, social housing shares and land revenues. The government answered in detail on the proposal, its costs, housing figures and port policy, reserving 1.5 billion euros for the North/South line extension but declining to calculate some counterfactuals and leaving the exact land-revenue effects undetermined.
For the reason given above, this calculation cannot be made.
Om de reden die hiervoor werd gegeven is deze berekening niet te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht Alkmaarse raad rebelleert tegen provinciaal verbod op woningbouw in Stompetoren

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the province of Noord-Holland's protection of the Stompetoren countryside as a Bijzonder Provinciaal Landschap blocks housing construction, and whether the province should reverse lost housing sites given the national housing shortage. The minister replied that the province has sufficient plan capacity, that the Stompetoren site no longer fits the province's urbanisation strategy, and that a Masterplan Wonen and talks with the region are under way.
For me it is important that the provinces, in consultation with municipalities, offer sufficient room for the regional need for construction.
Voor mij is het van belang dat de provincies in overleg met gemeenten voldoende ruimte bieden voor de regionale behoefte van de bouwopgave.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het feit dat mevrouw Bunschoten met drie kinderen door corporatie Dudok feitelijk op straat wordt gezet

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior about a divorced mother of three who was reportedly left without housing by housing corporation Dudok, and whether separated parents should get urgency status for social housing. The minister replies that urgency rules are set by municipal housing ordinances, that the corporation has no discretion, that the applicant can already apply for regular social housing, and that the municipality is responsible for further categories.
It is up to the municipalities themselves which further categories are added, depending on the local situation.
Het is aan gemeenten zelf welke verdere categorieën hieraan toegevoegd worden afhankelijk van de plaatselijke situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het niet uit huis zetten van weeskinderen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior for an update on implementing the Koerhuis motion on not evicting orphaned minor children, the age limits involved, and whether housing corporations could be forced to keep such young adults housed. The minister said the work is in its final phase with results to be sent before summer, that maatwerk and a possible code of conduct are preferred over compulsion, and gave limited direct answers on the legal options.
As previously indicated, I will inform your House of the outcomes before the summer.
Zoals eerder aangegeven zal ik uw Kamer voor de zomer over de uitkomsten informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat Faith het huis uit moet na het overlijden van haar moeder

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a housing corporation may evict 20-year-old Faith after her mother's death, given the COVID-era agreement against evictions. The minister answered that a court ruled for non-rent reasons, the corporation has repeatedly offered alternative housing, and she sees no reason to intervene with the corporation.

On 25 May 2021 the court, weighing the interests of Faith and of the housing corporation, decided that Faith will not continue the lease of the social rental home and must leave the home by 1 September.

Op 25 mei 2021 heeft de rechter, onder afweging van de belangen van Faith en die van de woningcorporatie besloten dat Faith de huur van de sociale huurwoning niet voortzet en de woning per 1 september moet verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat een windmolenvoorstel bouwplannen in gevaar brengt

MP Koerhuis asked whether the provincial executive of Noord-Holland's proposal to drop the 600-metre minimum distance for wind turbines endangers housing plans and health of residents. The minister answers that the provincial rule is a supplementary requirement, national noise and shadow rules still apply, the housing targets are not considered at risk, and that setting distances is primarily a municipal task.
The provincial executive has indeed decided to drop the minimum distance requirement.
Het college van gedeputeerde staten heeft inderdaad besloten de minimale afstandsgrens los te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boulakjar en Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Doelstellingen flexwoningen lang niet gehaald

MPs Boulakjar and Koerhuis asked the minister whether municipalities and housing corporations are missing flexible housing targets, what obstacles exist (locations, business case, image) and what is being done. The minister answered that it is too early to conclude targets will be missed, outlined support measures and funding, and said most woondeals already include flexible housing targets.
I therefore think it is too early to conclude that the target for placing flexible housing will not be met.
Ik vind het daarom te vroeg om te concluderen dat de doelstelling voor het plaatsen van flexwoningen niet wordt behaald.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de berichten dat bewoners uit het zogenaamde ´smurfendorp´ in het Groningse Kropswolde niet permanent in hun recreatiewoningen mogen wonen en dat permanent wonen op bungalowpa

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that residents of the Kropswolde holiday park De Leine may not live there permanently, including whether the municipality is acting with due regard for the human factor during the COVID crisis and whether the rapid-reuse task force could assess the park. The minister answered that the municipality has a phased enforcement policy with a six-month grace period, that the decision on the park's future rests with the municipality, and that she has already conveyed her call for the human factor to the municipality.
It is up to the municipality to weigh the future prospects of a specific park.
Het is aan de gemeente om een afweging te maken aangaande het toekomstperspectief van een specifiek park.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van der Woude over het opnemen van studieschulden in het BKR-register

MPs Koerhuis and Van der Woude asked whether student debts would be registered with the BKR credit register, as the AFM proposed, and whether the government would keep its promise not to do so. The minister answered that the government will not move to BKR registration of student loans, noting that lenders can already verify loans via Mijn DUO and that student loans have different social repayment terms.
Yes, the cabinet will not proceed with BKR registration for student debts.
Ja, het kabinet gaat niet over tot een BKR-registratie voor studieschulden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘ICT-adviseur corporaties had financiële banden met ICT-leveranciers waarover het adviseert’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that an ICT adviser to housing corporations had financial ties to ICT suppliers it advised on, and about conflict-of-interest safeguards, procurement rules and governance codes. The Minister acknowledged the risk of conflicting roles, placed primary responsibility on the ICT firms and corporations' own procurement policies, and argued that European procurement rules would not prevent such conflicts.
Possible mixing of roles is primarily the responsibility of the entrepreneur, not of the client.
Mogelijke vermenging van rollen is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de ondernemer, en niet in die van de afnemer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat bewoners van Park de Braassem de wanhoop nabij zijn door de onheilstijding van hun gemeente in de toch al moeilijke coronatijd

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the municipality of Kaag en Braassem is enforcing permanent-residence bans on people living in recreational homes during the COVID crisis, and whether the minister will urge the municipality to apply a humane approach. The minister confirmed the enforcement procedure, said she contacted the municipality which claims to apply a humane approach, and promised a quality and assessment framework around summer.
It is correct that the procedure has been started.
Het klopt dat de procedure is gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Koerhuis over het bericht dat arbeidsmigranten onterechte kosten betalen voor huisvesting

MPs Wiersma and Koerhuis asked why the Roemer advisory team did not examine reports that migrant workers pay unlawful extra housing costs via intermediaries, and how supervision works. The minister answered that a landlord permit scheme is being prepared, that information initiatives exist, that the Inspectorate SZW and municipalities supervise within their own remits, and that no complete data on such practices is held.
At present I am preparing a law that would allow municipalities, if they wish, to impose nationally uniform rules on landlords.
Op dit moment ben ik bezig een wet voor te bereiden waarmee gemeenten desgewenst landelijk geüniformeerde voorschriften kunnen instellen voor verhuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat mensen op bungalowpark Eper Sprengen de telkens loerende toezichthouders zat zijn

MP Koerhuis asked the Minister of the Interior whether Epe municipality's enforcement against permanent residence in holiday bungalows, including questions about residents' beliefs, was proportionate, and how this fits a motion on the human touch. The minister answered that such questioning unrelated to zoning enforcement is undesirable under the General Administrative Law Act, that the municipality denies asking about religion, and that she has re-raised her earlier call for the human touch with Epe.
I therefore consider it undesirable that questions are asked about matters that are not necessary for supervising the zoning plan.
Ik acht het daarmee onwenselijk dat vragen gesteld worden naar zaken die niet noodzakelijk zijn voor het toezicht op het bestemmingplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de problemen met het nieuwe energielabel

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of the Interior about problems with the new energy label, including shortages of certified advisers, rising prices, the 190 euro cost estimate, measurement quality and the consumer-facing criticism raised by Radar. The Minister rejects claims of a rushed introduction, acknowledges shortages and price rises, and says extra measures and a market consultation on digital labels are underway, with an update to parliament promised before the summer.
I therefore do not share the view of Vereniging Eigen Huis that the introduction was careless and too hasty.
Ik deel dan ook niet de mening van Vereniging Eigen Huis dat de invoering onzorgvuldig en te snel is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Linda's zoon (13) is over een paar maanden wees: 'Ik wil hem goed achterlaten'

MPs Lodders and Koerhuis asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of the Interior about a 13-year-old orphan who may have to sell the family home to pay inheritance tax. The State Secretary answered that the existing rules offer no sufficient relief, that the Tax Authority can grant only limited instalment payment, and that he intends to legislate an interest-free long-term payment arrangement for such hardship cases, to be included in the Fiscale verzamelwet 2023.
I therefore intend to prepare an amendment to laws and regulations so that a general solution can be offered for this and other comparable hardship situations.
Ik ben daarom voornemens om een wijziging van wet- en regelgeving voor te bereiden zodat een algemene oplossing kan worden geboden voor deze en andere vergelijkbare schrijnende situaties.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Regterschot en Koerhuis over het artikel ‘Woningbouwimpuls zorgt voor bijna 45.000 nieuwbouwwoningen’ en de uitvoering van de aangenomen motie Koerhuis c.s. over de ondergrens verlagen naa

MPs Regterschot and Koerhuis asked the Minister of Interior about the number of woningbouwimpuls projects per province, why 48 applications were rejected (mostly for unvalidated financial shortfalls), how the Koerhuis motion on lowering the 500-home threshold was implemented, why the second-tranche budget was exceeded, and how the third tranche (about 250 million euro) will be allocated and spread. The minister answered that rejections mainly concerned the 'necessity of the contribution' criterion, that the motion could not be applied to the already-open second tranche, that the overrun was to fund all positively assessed projects, and that the spread and ranking will be addressed in an interim evaluation letter to parliament.
Question 3: How has the adopted Koerhuis et al. motion been implemented within the second tranche?
Vraag 3 Hoe is de aangenomen motie-Koerhuis c.s. 2 uitgevoerd binnen de tweede tranche?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de digitale inkomenstoets

An MP asked why the digital income-check pilot for social housing allocation had not started, and why a legal basis for sharing BRP data had only surfaced late. The minister attributed the delay to greater technical complexity and to legal uncertainty over the BRP data basis, which has since been resolved, and expects the pilot to start in spring 2021.
This uncertainty has since been resolved and the expectation is that the pilot can start this spring.
Deze onduidelijkheid is inmiddels opgelost en de verwachting is dat de pilot dit voorjaar kan starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van der Linde over het bericht 'De computer mag de taxateur straks niet meer vervangen bij bepalen waarde woning'

Two MPs from the VVD asked about reports that the EBA guidelines will bar purely computer-generated valuations for mortgages, raising concerns about higher costs and longer waiting times. The Minister of Finance answered that a hybrid valuation (model checked by a valuer) will remain permitted, that cost and duration effects are expected to be limited, and that DNB and the ECB will decide how to apply the guidelines in supervision.
It is for DNB and the ECB, as independent and autonomous authorities, to determine how they will apply the guidelines in supervision.
Het is aan DNB en de ECB als zelfstandige en onafhankelijke autoriteiten om te bepalen hoe zij de richtsnoeren zullen toepassen in het toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Lodders, Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over de funderingsproblematiek

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers about foundation damage in cities and rural areas, including costs to homeowners, the Fonds Duurzaam Funderingsherstel, the role of KCAF and RVO, and innovation for bacterial decay of wooden piles. The government answered that the problem is poorly quantified and complex, that the loan fund has issued only 34 loans, that KCAF declined cooperation, and that the Rijksprogramma Aanpak Funderingsproblematiek will be developed further in 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht 'Kosten nieuwbouw stijgen met 16 procent door BENG-eisen'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about a report that new-build costs rise 16% due to BENG energy requirements, and about cost increases in construction generally. The minister rejected the 16% figure, citing estimates of 4-8% for BENG-related cost increases, and said cost increases are largely driven by market conditions and that the government is working with the sector on cost reduction.
There is no 16 percent cost increase for new construction due to BENG requirements.
Er is bij nieuwbouw geen sprake van 16 procent kostenstijging door BENG-eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat gemeente Midden-Groningen er een potje van maakt met recreatiepark De Leine

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that Midden-Groningen municipality is enforcing against permanent residence in holiday bungalows at De Leine, and whether this fits with earlier motions on proportionate enforcement and a transformation task force. The minister said the municipality is aware of the human-scale principle, residents get time to find housing, the task force is to be operational around summer 2021, and she has contacted the municipality and will deliver an assessment framework around summer.
Following your questions, I contacted the municipality of Midden-Groningen and brought my call to apply the human scale in enforcement on permanent residence to its attention.

Naar aanleiding van uw vragen heb ik contact opgenomen met de gemeente Midden-Groningen en mijn oproep om de menselijke maat te hanteren in de handhaving op permanente bewoning onder de aandacht gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Terpstra over het bericht ‘Huren van de corporatie terwijl je 59 panden bezit’

MPs Koerhuis and Terpstra asked the minister about reports that some social rental tenants also own one or more homes, including owners of many properties. The minister answered that such occupancy is undesirable, cited Kadaster data showing 1,055 tenants with two or more owned homes, and promised further research and talks with Aedes and the VNG on remedies.
It is undesirable if a tenant 'occupies' a social rental home from the housing corporation when he is not entitled to it to meet his housing needs because he owns one or more owner-occupied homes.

Het is ongewenst als een huurder een sociale huurwoning van de woningcorporatie «bezet houdt», als hij niet op die woning is aangewezen om te voorzien in zijn woonbehoefte vanwege het bezit van één of meer koopwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Aartsen over het bericht 'gemeente als huurbaas geen pretje'

MPs Koerhuis and Aartsen (VVD) asked whether it is true that businesses cannot negotiate lower rent with the municipality of Amsterdam, whether other large municipalities have similar policies, and whether municipalities should be urged to give tenants tailored relief during COVID. The state secretary replied that Amsterdam offers rent deferral, interest-free repayment and cancellation for bankrupt tenants, and announced a 10 million euro fund for rent discounts, but gave no overview of other municipalities and said municipalities must decide their own role.
No overview is available of the rent discount policy for businesses during the coronavirus period of all municipalities with more than 100,000 inhabitants.
Er is geen overzicht beschikbaar van het beleid inzake huurkorting voor ondernemers in coronatijd van alle gemeenten met meer dan 100.000 inwoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Particuliere woningverhuur groeit ondanks alles gestaag door’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about reports that private landlords and investors account for around 40% of home purchases, and about definitions, transaction shares, buy-to-let trends and comparisons with other countries. The minister explained the broad investor definition used by the Kadaster, provided tables on transactions, buy-to-let shares, first-time buyer shares and ownership shares, and argued that investors are needed for a stable housing market while outlining measures on transfer tax and rent caps.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Harbers over het bericht dat bewoners in Transvaal al dagen in de kou zitten

MPs Koerhuis and Harbers asked about residents of Transvaal in The Hague left without heating for days, a shortfall on the Energiek 2 district heating network owned by housing corporation Staedion, and whether corporations may run heat networks and why they are exempt from the Warmtewet licensing requirement. The minister answered that outages affected about 50 then about 20 homes, that tenants' protection lies with tenancy law and courts or the Huurcommissie, that ACM may enforce for non-tenants, and that no revision of the exemption is planned.
For tenants, disputes can be brought before the court or the Huurcommissie.
Bij geschillen ligt voor huurders de weg naar de rechter of Huurcommissie open.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht 'Vestia wil jaren na derivatendrama opnieuw hulp van andere corporaties'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about press reports that Vestia, a housing corporation, again wants help from other corporations, questioning its financial results, planned sanering requests, settlements with banks, repayment of the 675 million euro rescue loan and a tax exemption. The Minister largely answered that the sanering period runs to 2022, that any new request will be judged then, that no new state support is given, and that structural solutions and tax measures are as described.
Assessment of a possible application will take place in due course, based on the application and the situation at that time.
Beoordeling van een eventuele aanvraag geschiedt te zijner tijd op basis van aanvraag en de situatie op dat moment.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van Eijs over het bericht ´Hoogleraren: stop de strijd tegen permanente bewoning van vakantiehuizen´

MPs Van Eijs and Koerhuis asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities are still enforcing against permanent residence in holiday homes and how this fits with the adopted motion on applying the human touch. The minister answered that municipalities should apply the human touch, that a quality and weighing framework is coming, and that municipalities should be cautious with enforcement and penalty payments during the second COVID wave.
Later this year I will come with a quality and weighing framework for municipalities.
Later dit jaar kom ik met een kwaliteits- en afwegingskader voor gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht 'Over dingen die blijven'

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether Noord-Holland's new environmental regulation, which designates 32 protected provincial landscapes, removed housing sites in Alkmaar and the BUCH municipalities, and whether this is due to provincial or national/EU rules. The Minister answers that some soft housing plans are constrained but mostly were already blocked, that the designations rest on existing protection regimes, that sufficient housing capacity exists, and promises to inform parliament in early 2021 on a regional follow-up.
The Environmental Regulation offers room to reach sufficient housing sites in line with this.
De Omgevingsverordening biedt ruimte om in lijn hiermee tot voldoende woningbouwlocaties te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht 'Over dingen die blijven'

MP Koerhuis (VVD) asked whether the new provincial environmental regulation designates all of Wijdemeren as protected landscape, removing housing sites, barn conversions and marina renovations, and asked the minister to pressure the province to reverse this. The minister confirmed a large part of the municipality is designated BPL, that only two housing locations fall away, that barn conversion rules were restored, and that the province will run a review of BPL boundaries, while declining to commit to a direct intervention.
I consider it important that sufficient housing is built that matches the need.
Ik vind het van belang dat voldoende woningen worden gerealiseerd die aansluiten bij de behoefte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van der Linde over de beperkte dekking van asbestdaken

MPs Koerhuis and Van der Linde asked whether insurers such as Centraal Beheer and Achmea are limiting coverage of asbestos roof damage, leaving homeowners uninsured or underpaid, and whether the government will press insurers to reverse this. The minister (Finance) answered that he has no overview of insurers' conditions, that Achmea phases out coverage of asbestos roofing by 5% a year, that policy terms govern payouts, and that the government is asking the asbestos programme office to talk with insurers.
I have no insight into insurers' conditions.
Ik heb geen zicht op voorwaarden van verzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Terpstra en Koerhuis over de bouwopgave in Noord-Holland in relatie tot het bericht ‘Nieuwe omgevingsverordening beschermt 32 bijzondere landschappen’

MPs Terpstra and Koerhuis asked whether the new Noord-Holland environmental regulation, including Bijzonder Provinciaal Landschap designations and extra sustainability requirements, makes outer-urban building nearly impossible and undermines the national housing target. The minister answered that the province still has ample housing plan capacity (127% outside the MRA, above 130% in the MRA), that the legal basis exists, and that she sees no evidence that plans will be blocked, while the enquiry was answered late due to consultation with the province.
For me it is paramount that provinces provide ample space for the realisation of building plans to meet the regional housing task.
Voor mij staat voorop dat provincies ruim voldoende ruimte bieden aan de realisatie van bouwplannen om invulling te geven aan de regionale bouwopgave.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Koerhuis over het bericht 'Steen door de ruit en dreigbrief Molukse wijk in Elst'

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers about reports of a stone through a window and a threatening letter in a Moluccan neighbourhood in Elst, and about the allocation policy giving Moluccans priority for housing in such neighbourhoods. The government explained the historical basis of the arrangements, said they exist in about 45 municipalities, denied that tensions are a recurring pattern, and said it sees no reason to revisit the agreement.
Apart from the incidents reported by the Gelderlander and the NOS, I am not aware of any signals so far that give cause to revisit this agreement.
Buiten de incidenten waarvan de Gelderlander en de NOS melding hebben gemaakt, zijn mij vooralsnog geen signalen bekend die aanleiding geven tot een herijking van deze afspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de berichten ‘Microwoning: een ‘echt’ huis voor minder dan 2 ton’ en ‘Flexwoningen, wel te huur niet te koop’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of the Interior about micro and flexible housing: how many projects exist, whether they can be financed with mortgages (including on leased land and for 15-year permits), infrastructure costs, and whether to meet with banks. The minister answered that no national monitor exists yet, explained mortgage conditions and NHG limits, and declined to meet lenders since some already offer such mortgages.
Although Statistics Netherlands is working on it, there is as yet no national registration or monitor of micro or flexible homes.
Hoewel het CBS daaraan werkt, is er nog geen landelijke registratie of monitor van micro- of flexwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de huisuitzetting van mantelzorger meneer Zilverentant

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether housing corporation WoonOpMaat was evicting a carer after his partner entered care, and whether this breached the COVID-era agreement against evictions. The minister answered that this was a voluntary termination co-signed by the tenant, not an eviction, and that the corporation agreed to extend his stay until 4 January 2021.
Following your questions, the housing corporation concerned has informed me upon request that in this case there is no question of an eviction or forced vacation of the dwelling.
Naar aanleiding van uw vragen laat de betreffende woningcorporatie mij desgevraagd weten dat er in het geval van de betrokkene geen sprake is van een huisuitzetting of ontruiming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘27.000 statushouders moeten volgend jaar huis krijgen’

MPs Koerhuis asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that 27,000 refugee status holders must be housed next year, the impact on social rental waiting lists, temporary housing pilots, and faster permit procedures. The minister acknowledged the heavy burden on municipalities, announced an extra 3 million euros for flexible housing pilots and a planning-procedure change via the Crisis- en herstelwet, but did not answer all questions due to time constraints.
Given the limited time span, that has not been possible.
Gegeven de beperkte tijdspanne is dat niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Koerhuis over het artikel ‘Krotbeleggen: ‘triest’ spel van een beursfonds drijft gemeentes tot wanhoop’

MPs Van der Linde and Koerhuis asked whether the government would act against a listed fund that lets listed monuments decay to gain land positions, and whether exchange listings could be refused. The minister answered that municipalities already have enforcement powers under the Wabo and Woningwet, that Wassenaar has taken action, and that exchange exclusion and new general coercive measures are too far-reaching, so no further steps are planned.
For that reason we see no reason for follow-up steps.
Om die reden zien wij geen aanleiding voor vervolgstappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het ‘Hoe bewoners van het Wijnhaveneiland zich voor veel geld laten afkopen door projectontwikkelaars’

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether residents of Rotterdam's Wijnhaveneiland are obstructing construction projects by holding out for payments from developers, and asks for data on objection and appeal procedures for zoning plans. The minister says compensation settlements are legitimate, that the government has no statistics on objections or settlements, that existing law already addresses abuse of procedure, and that the Council of State has sped up appeal rulings.
No statistics are kept on objections or appeal procedures against zoning plans or on how these procedures unfold.
Er worden geen statistieken bijgehouden van bezwaren of beroepsprocedures tegen bestemmingsplannen en/of hoe het verloop is van deze bezwaar- en beroepsprocedures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht 'Proefproject 'van gas af' stilgelegd'

An MP asks the Minister of Interior about reports that the Purmerend gas-free neighbourhood pilot in Overwhere-Zuid was halted, probing communication, the causes of problems, and ministry responsibility. The minister answers that the project was not stopped but slowed for evaluation, that the municipality is responsible for execution with the ministry overseeing the national programme, and that no specific new measures are planned.
The conclusion that the pilot project has been halted is therefore not correct, but the pilot will be delayed compared to the original planning.
De conclusie dat de proeftuin is stilgelegd is dus niet correct, wel zal de proeftuin vertraging oplopen ten opzichte van de oorspronkelijke planning.
Antwoord op vragen van het vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Ook radiatoren onder toezicht’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether homeowners are obliged to hydraulically balance radiators and install per-room temperature control when replacing their boiler, and whether this unduly burdens them with high costs. The minister answered that these obligations follow from EPBD III, with exemptions, a 3-4 year payback for balancing and about seven years for thermostatic valves, and that municipalities enforce them; the answer to the final question on the AO was not provided.
I assume that through the FAQ, the knowledge base and the customer contact centre, any unclarities can be removed.
Ik ga ervanuit dat door de FAQ, de kennisbank en het klantcontactcentrum eventuele onduidelijkheden kunnen worden weggenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat een lezer de ‘dakloze’ Annica (19) aan een huis helpt na overlijden van haar ouders

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether housing corporation De Alliantie intends to evict a 19-year-old woman, Annica (Sammy-Jo), within thirty days after being publicly reported as homeless, and asked for a prompt answer. The minister confirmed the report, said the corporation has been involved in seeking a solution, and that the young woman can move into a home in Hilversum from 1 October for a year while using the Woningnet emergency scheme.
I acknowledge the urgency of Sammy-Jo's situation and therefore answered your earlier questions on 24 September.
Ik onderken de urgentie van de situatie van Sammy-Jo en heb uw eerdere vragen daarom op 24 september jl. beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de korting op de verhuurderheffing voor extra nieuwbouwwoningen

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of the Interior whether the rent-tax (verhuurderheffing) reduction for new social housing really adds new homes, whether the total cost may exceed 1 billion euros, and how eligibility is assessed. The minister answers that applications cover about 150,000 homes, that realisation cannot be precisely measured, that the scheme is now closed, and that a joint taskforce with housing associations and municipalities will monitor construction.
This cannot be established. Applications are not checked on whether the building plans are existing or new.
Dit is niet vast te stellen. Aanvragen worden niet getoetst op het feit of het bestaande of nieuwe nieuwbouwplannen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat woningcorporatie De Alliantie Sammy-Jo uit huis zet na het overlijden van haar vader

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether housing corporation De Alliantie acted improperly by ending the tenancy of a young woman after her father died, despite the agreement not to evict during the COVID-19 crisis. The minister answered that the contract ended automatically on death, that the corporation looked for a solution with her and she has been offered alternative housing, and that she may stay in the parental home until then.
I have understood from De Alliantie that it has searched together with Sammy-Jo for a suitable solution and that replacement housing has now been found with housing corporation Dudok Wonen.
Van De Alliantie heb ik begrepen dat zij samen met Sammy-Jo naar een passende oplossing heeft gezocht en dat er inmiddels vervangende woonruimte is gevonden bij woningcorporatie Dudok Wonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van der Linde over het bericht dat huizenbezitters honderden euro’s extra kwijt zijn aan taxaties

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance and Interior ministers about reports that homeowners pay hundreds of euros more for valuations, and whether an EBA guideline banning computer-generated valuations was legally binding. The minister answered that the guidelines follow a comply-or-explain principle, that DNB and the ECB will apply them from 30 June 2021, and that a working group is exploring hybrid valuations and reforms to the appraisal process.
For the guidelines the comply-or-explain principle applies, whereby national authorities have room to deviate from the guidelines with reasons.
Voor de richtsnoeren geldt het «pas toe of leg uit» principe, waarbij nationale autoriteiten de ruimte hebben om gemotiveerd af te wijken van de richtsnoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over berichtgeving van mogelijke fraude bij Vestia

The MP asks about reports of alleged multi-million fraud at housing corporation Vestia, how it went undetected by the board, supervisory board, accountant and the Autoriteit Woningcorporaties, and whether fraud is structural. The minister replies that the case dates from 2018, a criminal and forensic investigation is ongoing so the amount cannot be disclosed, the Aw does not supervise individual transactions, fraud is not considered structural, and the saneringsproces will not be postponed.
Because this is an ongoing criminal investigation, I cannot inform you about the scale of the alleged fraud.
Omdat het een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek betreft kan ik u niet informeren over de omvang van de vermeende fraude.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de Woondeal regio Arnhem-Nijmegen
