MP Koerhuis asked whether a theoretical 50% social rental share would satisfy the Woondeal Arnhem-Nijmegen agreement, whether the government would clarify this to the region, and how it would ensure free-market homes are built. Minister Ollongren answered no, said she is willing to raise a clarifying letter at the next consultation, and pointed to a regional monitoring system and the Versnellingstafel.
I am in principle certainly willing to do so, but according to my information there appear to be no misunderstandings about this agreement in the region.
Daartoe ben ik in principe zeker bereid, maar naar mijn informatie blijken er over deze afspraak geen misverstanden te bestaan in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘woningbouwrel met Ouderkerk’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether Amsterdam, as landowner, may impose its housing policy on Ouder-Amstel's 'De Nieuwe Kern' project and whether this undermines local democracy, and raised state aid and competition concerns. The Minister answered that Amsterdam acts only as a private-style landowner bound by the zoning plan set by Ouder-Amstel's council, sees no undue encroachment, gives no data on other municipalities, and sees no reason to act.
There is no question of Amsterdam imposing its own housing policy on the municipality of Ouder-Amstel.
Er is geen sprake van het opdringen van eigen woningbouwbeleid aan de gemeente Ouder-Amstel door de gemeente Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Krakers bij Lunetten hebben vrij spel’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that squatters occupying a municipal site in Utrecht were free to act, asking who bears damage costs, whether squatting is a crime, and whether the minister would press the Utrecht council to evict. The minister confirmed squatting is the crime of trespass, that victims must sue for damages, and that eviction decisions rest with the Public Prosecution Service and the municipality, so he would not intervene.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide whether eviction takes place under the given circumstances. It is not for me to judge this.
Het is aan het OM om te besluiten of in de gegeven omstandigheden ontruimd wordt. Het is niet aan mij om hierover te oordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Terpstra over het bericht 'Nieuwe geluidsregels zetten streep door bouw 380.000 huizen'

MPs Koerhuis and Terpstra asked whether new noise rules for aviation and rail would block construction of 380,000 homes around Amsterdam, whether WHO noise guidelines are legally binding and how they factor in, and whether the province and municipalities were involved. The minister answered that the rules leave room for development, that WHO advice is not legally binding and its impact will be reported to parliament by end 2020, and that consultations with the province and municipalities are ongoing with possible regulatory adjustment.
The WHO advice on noise was not taken into account in shaping the noise rules as they will apply after the Environment and Planning Act enters into force (Supplementary noise track).
Het advies van de WHO over geluid is niet betrokken bij het vormgeven van de geluidregels, zoals die na inwerkingtreding van de Omgevingswet gaan luiden (Aanvullingsspoor geluid).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Ollongren wekte te hoge verwachtingen met aardgasvrije wijken’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Interior about the Algemene Rekenkamer's criticism of the Aardgasvrije Wijken programme: few homes made gas-free, unclear goals and monitoring, and no evaluation until 2022. The Minister replied that the goal is learning rather than a home count, that monitoring and evaluation plans are being finalised, that the funding and business-case weaknesses are being addressed, and that the evaluation will go ahead in 2022 without delaying the second tranche.
I will inform the House of Representatives about this through the second progress report at the start of 2021.
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer hierover informeren middels de tweede voortgangsrapportage begin 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Te hoge belasting omdat gemeente VvE- reserve meerekent in WOZ bepaling’

MPs Lodders and Koerhuis asked whether municipalities wrongly include a homeowners' association (VvE) reserve when valuing apartments for WOZ property tax, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary answered that municipalities use uniform methods, that significant VvE reserves are taken into account in sales analysis, that the Waarderingskamer found no shortcomings, and that no further measures are considered necessary.
No problem is experienced with the way municipalities take into account the share in the VvE reserve when determining WOZ values.
Er wordt geen probleem ervaren met de wijze waarop gemeenten rekening houden met het aandeel in de VvE-reserve bij het vaststellen van WOZ-waarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Koerhuis over het bollenvloerdossier

MPs Ronnes and Koerhuis asked whether TNO's follow-up research on the bollenvloer (bulb floor) dossier would be finished before summer, and whether the inspection obligation for the highest consequence class could be postponed pending those results. The minister said the TNO research may narrow the obligation for lower classes, that the obligation for CC3 buildings is not postponed, and that she will share the proposal and results with the House later.
I will share the research proposal with you after I have received it and commissioned TNO to carry out the work.
Ik zal het onderzoeksvoorstel met u delen nadat ik het heb ontvangen en opdracht aan TNO heb verstrekt voor de uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Harbers over de uitspraken van netbeheerders over de energietransitie

MPs Koerhuis and Harbers asked ministers about grid operators' statements on the energy transition, including whether older homes can be heated without gas, reuse of gas infrastructure for green gas and hydrogen, and costs of replacing the gas network. The minister answered that the transition follows the 'feasible and affordable' principle, that municipalities will decide per neighbourhood with local analysis, and that cost estimates depend on future hydrogen availability, so no firm numbers on connections remaining are given yet.

Because there is still uncertainty about the availability of sustainable gas for now, and because a first picture of the future heat supply will only emerge from the Heat Transition Visions at the end of 2021, I cannot in this phase say how many homes will remain connected to the gas network.

Doordat er voorlopig nog onzekerheid bestaat over de beschikbaarheid van duurzaam gas en omdat pas eind 2021 uit de Transitievisies Warmte een eerste beeld ontstaat van hoe de toekomstige warmtevoorziening is samengesteld kan ik in deze fase geen uitspraken doen over het aantal woningen dat aangesloten blijft op het gasnet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Provincie Noord-Holland trapt op de rem’ in het Noordhollands Dagblad

An MP asked the minister whether the province of Noord-Holland is again slowing housing construction by restricting overprogramming, rural building and inner-city focus, and whether the minister will re-engage the province. The minister replied that agreements exist with the region, that 130% plan capacity is expected from all provinces, that Noord-Holland already has more than 130% capacity, and that further talks on volume and speed will take place, with specific location choices left to the provinces.
I will periodically talk with the provinces, including the province of Noord-Holland, about building plans and the realisation of housing construction.
Ik zal periodiek met de provincies, waaronder provincie Nood-Holland, spreken over bouwplannen en de realisatie van woningbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de Woondeal regio Arnhem-Nijmegen

An MP asked the minister about the Arnhem-Nijmegen housing deal, including whether a 50% affordable-housing target was appropriate and whether enough owner-occupied homes would be built. The minister answered that the target concerns the type of new homes needed, not the stock as a whole, and that the deal's aims reflect the commitment to sufficient owner-occupied housing.
As described above, the agreement concerns the type of homes the parties in the region want to add.
Zoals hierboven beschreven gaat de afspraak over het type woningen dat partijen in de regio willen bijbouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Bizarre wending in bollenvloeren-dossier: inspectie en versterking onnodig’

MPs Ronnes and Koerhuis asked whether buildings with suspect hollow-core slabs would escape inspection and whether a Cobouw report on a reversal in policy was accurate. Minister Knops answered that an inspection duty for the highest-consequence buildings takes effect in April 2020, that the report was incorrect and there is no change of course, and that TNO will study a possible narrowing of later phases.
That is not correct. I refer to my answers to question 2 and question 4.
Dit klopt niet. Ik verwijs daarbij naar mijn antwoord op vraag 2 en vraag 4.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat er extra huurwoningen nodig zijn voor asielzoekers in Westland

An MP asked the Minister about press reports that Westland needs extra rental housing for asylum seekers and whether temporary housing could ease pressure on reception centres and the housing market. The minister agreed flexible temporary solutions can help, said municipalities are primarily responsible, and pointed to existing flex-housing measures and a planned accelerator programme for Westland.
Municipalities are primarily responsible for taking the necessary measures to counter pressure on the housing market as far as possible.
Gemeenten zijn namelijk primair verantwoordelijk om de nodige maatregelen te treffen om de druk op de woningmarkt zoveel mogelijk tegen te gaan
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Ronnes over het bericht ‘Minister vertraagt woningbouw’

MPs Koerhuis and Ronnes asked the minister whether the Schone Lucht Akkoord (clean air agreement) would slow housing construction and whether it would impose new procurement requirements on construction equipment amid the housing shortage. The minister answered that the agreement's measures support source-based nitrogen policy, that no new binding standards are set yet, and that concrete procurement criteria will be developed with the construction sector over the coming year.

The Schone Lucht Akkoord does not yet set concrete requirements, but states the following agreement: the central government will investigate with partners how a roadmap for clean and zero-emission construction equipment can look and will publish the results in 2020.

In het Schone Lucht Akkoord zijn nog geen concrete eisen vastgelegd, maar staat de volgende afspraak: «De rijksoverheid onderzoekt daarvoor in samenwerking met partijen hoe een ingroeipad («routekaart») voor schoon en 0-emissie bouwmaterieel eruit kan zien en publiceert de resultaten in 2020» .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat KPMG en Deloitte schikken met Vestia

An MP asked whether KPMG and Deloitte were settling with housing corporation Vestia for 84 million euro against a 2.7 billion euro loss, what the status of open claims against banks was, and whether Vestia must repay the 675 million euro of public support. The minister declined to share settlement status, said 2019 accounts are not yet available, and pointed to a 2022 review of whether the support converts to a gift or must be repaid.
Since this would not benefit the course of negotiations between these parties, the Authority for Housing Corporations (Aw) states that no statements can be made about this.
Aangezien dit het verloop van de onderhandelingen tussen deze partijen niet ten goede komt, geeft de Autoriteit woningcorporaties (Aw) aan dat hier geen mededelingen over gedaan kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp, Lodders en Koerhuis over het inschrijven in de BRP.

MPs Middendorp, Lodders and Koerhuis asked the government about registration in the Basisregistratie Personen (BRP), including cases where new residents are registered without the main tenant's consent and suffer consequences. Minister Knops answered that he opposes mandatory prior verification and mandatory consent from existing residents, points to municipal responsibility and ongoing work on a BRP change and complaints point, and promises a progress letter in spring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht in de Telegraaf van 8 januari 2020 ‘Miljoenenroof bij Corporatie’

An MP asked the Minister for Environment and Housing about an alleged multi-million euro embezzlement at housing corporation Stadgenoot, including why internal controls, the board, supervisory board, auditor and regulator Aw did not detect it, and about screening for gambling addiction. The minister said a criminal investigation and an external forensic audit are ongoing, deferred questions on controls to those findings, said the Aw does not supervise individual transactions and will take the follow-up into its judgment letter, and said corporations themselves are responsible for staff screening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Lage overdrachtsbelasting voor kluspand’

An MP asked the housing minister about a Supreme Court ruling on the transfer tax rate for office buildings converted into homes, the number of conversions, the availability of convertible offices and the Transformatiefaciliteit. The minister answered that the rulings apply to all conversions, that conversions added about 10,000 homes a year, that a study of future conversion potential will start, and that the rulings are not expected to have a large effect on output.
Therefore I will start a study into the future availability of buildings for housing conversion.
Daarom zal ik een onderzoek starten naar de toekomstige beschikbaarheid van panden voor woningtransformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van der Linde over het bericht dat een dubieuze afbouwverzekeraar het project in Brielle niet af bouwt

MPs Koerhuis and Van der Linde asked whether a dubious completion insurer leaving a Brielle housing project unfinished leaves buyers unprotected, how often the AFM receives signals about such insurance, how many providers operate, when providers must account, and what specific rules apply. The minister says the insurer lacked a licence and used unusual terms, that buyers may be unable to claim, that the AFM has received very few signals which led to no follow-up, that DNB regulates prudential supervision of 18 insurers offering the branch, and that no specific rules for completion insurance are known beyond general insurance law.
The Minister for Environment and Housing will therefore work with the supervisor to map how the risk of such situations can be further limited in the future.
De Minister voor Milieu en Wonen gaat daarom met de toezichthouder in kaart brengen hoe het risico op dergelijke situaties in de toekomst verder kan beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat Laurens Wonen in opspraak is

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Environment and Housing about the scandal at housing corporation Laurens Wonen, including inadequate oversight of prohibited dual positions, withholding of the Aw's correspondence, and whether misappropriated funds would be reclaimed. The minister answered that the Aw has tightened checks on dual positions, found no other violations, and that the Aw will address the case in its regular public letter, while reclaiming funds is for the corporation's board.
It is up to the Aw, within the legal framework, to decide which documents are or are not made public.
Het is aan de Aw om, binnen het wettelijk kader, te bepalen welke documenten al dan niet openbaar worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis en Ronnes over het bericht dat Utrecht versneld ruim 9.000 woningen en nieuwe OV-verbindingen krijgt

MPs Koerhuis and Ronnes asked why the minister reserved 60 million euros from the housing impulse for Utrecht before the allocation rules (AMvB) were published, and on what legal basis. The minister answered that the reservation is conditional on the yet-to-be-set rules and procedure, gives no guarantee of payment, is not an allocation that can be appealed, and that other regions will be assessed on the same conditions.
There is therefore no allocation of funds from the impulse yet, and so there is no possibility of objection or appeal against the intended reservation.
Er is dus nog geen sprake van een toekenning van middelen uit de impuls en daarmee is er geen bezwaar- of beroepsmogelijkheid tegen de voorgenomen reservering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Koerhuis over gevaarlijke AGPO Ferroli CV-ketels

MPs Beckerman and Koerhuis asked about dangerous AGPO Ferroli central heating boilers, including NVWA findings on poor maintenance, disagreement among maintenance firms, housing corporations' replacement decisions, and whether a 0800 helpline should be opened. The Minister answered that maintenance is the owner's responsibility, the NVWA has imposed corrective actions on the manufacturer under its supervision, corporations decide replacement themselves, and the NVWA's existing number suffices, while promising a progress update before summer 2020.
I will inform you before summer 2020 about the progress of the corrective actions the NVWA imposed on Ferroli.
Ik zal u voor de zomer van 2020 informeren over de voortgang van de door de NVWA aan Ferroli opgelegde corrigerende acties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Actiegroep Niet Te Koop een sociale huurwoning bezet in Oud-West’

An MP asked whether squatting a social rental home is a crime, whether housing corporation Stadgenoot delayed filing a complaint against squatters, and whether corporations should always file immediately. The minister confirmed squatting is punishable, said Stadgenoot delayed its complaint by two days, and declined to require corporations to file immediately, leaving it to the owner's discretion.
It is up to the owner (Stadgenoot) to decide what it does with its property.
Het is aan de eigenaar (Stadgenoot) om te bepalen wat deze met zijn pand doet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat Actiegroep Niet Te Koop een sociale huurwoning bezet in West

An MP asked the minister whether housing corporation Stadgenoot reported the occupation of a social rental home in West Amsterdam by activist group Niet Te Koop to police, whether it delayed as before, and whether corporations should always report such occupations. The answer, given partly on behalf of the Justice minister, is only partly responsive, referring to earlier answers and noting the corporation's own responsibility.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de beantwoording van het verzoek van de vaste commissie voor Binnenlandse Zaken om een reactie op de twee rondetafelgesprekken over woonfraude

An MP asks the Minister of BZK about the timing of the digital income check pilot against housing fraud, which depends on Logius prioritising it through a vote among government organisations, and how to secure capacity and a national rollout. The minister answers that the pilot started this autumn, that a new voting round produced enough votes to start the pilot, that it will run with a limited number of housing corporations, and that a national rollout will be decided later based on the pilot results.
De pilot is dit najaar gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat Laurens Wonen in opspraak is

An MP asks the minister about reports that housing corporation Laurens Wonen is in trouble, including recovery of damages from its former supervisory board chair, a dual personal union that the regulator should have caught, and an inaccurate oordeelsbrief. The minister answers that the corporation's board decides on recovery, that the regulator Aw is monitoring the case and will publish findings, and that the regulator has admitted missing the dual union and not updating the letter, with procedures tightened.
The Aw has informed me that following this case it will provide an overview of personal unions before the end of the year.
De Aw heeft mij laten weten dat zij naar aanleiding van deze casus voor het einde van het jaar een beeld zal geven inzake personele unies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp, Ldders en Koerhuis over het inschrijven in de Basisregistratie Persoon (BRP)

MPs Middendorp, Lodders and Koerhuis asked whether residents can register at any address in the BRP without the consent of existing occupants, and about the checks municipalities must perform, in cases where people are registered without the main resident knowing and suffer financial harm. The state secretary answered that registration depends on actual residence rather than consent, that municipalities control registrations under the BRP law and the adres onderzoek circular, that consent-based registration would undermine the BRP, and that the ministry is discussing solutions with municipal and implementing bodies.
Registration in the BRP at an address in the municipality is therefore not dependent on the consent of the resident already registered at that address.
Inschrijving in de BRP op een adres in de gemeente is derhalve niet afhankelijk van de instemming van de reeds op dat adres ingeschreven bewoner.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het energielabel voor woningen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the reliability of the home energy label and the research behind a proposed change to a kWh/m2 indicator, including whether a simplified self-assessment version can be as accurate as the current one. The minister answered that a simplified version would be less accurate due to home geometry and required inputs, that the EU directive requires a numeric kWh/m2 indicator, and that work on affordability and a digital home file is ongoing.
The energy label gives homeowners insight into the energy performance and also informs them about measures they can take to improve energy performance.
Het energielabel geeft woningeigenaren inzicht in de energieprestatie en informeert hen bovendien over maatregelen die zij kunnen nemen om de energieprestatie te verbeteren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra en Koerhuis over de berichten ‘Havengebied dreigt een warzone te worden’, ‘Wordt ruimte straks de grote uitdaging voor Amsterdam?’ en ‘Kock wil verzelfstandiging havenbedrijf

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about press reports on tensions between the Amsterdam port and housing plans, and about the municipality's 100% ownership of the port company. The minister answered that the port is of national importance, that the municipality as sole shareholder is responsible for its ownership, and that Rijk and region coordinate on infrastructure and housing without committing to a concrete new step.
It is up to the municipality of Amsterdam, as 100% shareholder, to give proper form to its ownership of Havenbedrijf Amsterdam N.V.
Het is aan de gemeente Amsterdam als 100% aandeelhouder om op een goede manier invulling te geven aan haar eigenaarschap van het Havenbedrijf Amsterdam N.V.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat Vestia schikt met Deutsche Bank voor € 175 miljoen

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior about Vestia's settlement of 175 million euros with Deutsche Bank over toxic derivatives, the status of claims against other banks, the 675 million euros in rescue aid from other housing corporations and its repayment, and Vestia's 2017 and 2018 results. The minister answers that the Aw found Vestia made sufficient efforts to recover damages, declines to report on pending claims against other banks, explains that repayment of the aid is assessed by 2022 under the rescue decision, and notes that the large results were mainly unrealised revaluations.
Since this would not benefit the course of proceedings with these parties, the Aw cannot provide any information about this.
Aangezien dit het verloop met deze partijen niet ten goede komt, kan de Aw hier geen mededelingen over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over beantwoording van het verzoek van de vaste commissie voor Binnenlandse Zaken om een reactie op de twee rondetafelgesprekken over woonfraude

An MP asks whether a digital income check for social housing allocation, and direct access by landlords to income data without consent, are sound ways to prevent housing fraud. The minister supports a pilot of a digital income check with consent, rejects landlord access without consent as contrary to the GDPR, and describes the pilot's data sources and timeline.
No, because consulting income data (a processing under the GDPR) without the consent of the prospective tenant is contrary to the GDPR.
Nee, want het raadplegen van de inkomensgegevens (een verwerking onder de AVG) zonder toestemming van de potentiële huurder is in strijd met de AVG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht dat AZ aan een ramp is ontsnapt

MPs Koerhuis and Rudmer Heerema asked the Minister of Interior about the roof collapse at the AZ stadium, including inspection of stadium roofs, expertise support for municipalities and the sequencing of the Wet kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen. The minister answered that the cause is still unknown pending investigations, that building owners and municipalities bear inspection duties, and that pilot projects for higher consequence classes are being explored.
At this moment it is still unclear what caused the roof of the AZ stadium to collapse.
Op dit moment is nog onduidelijk wat de oorzaak is geweest van het instorten van het dak van het AZ-stadion.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat Laurens Wonen in opspraak is

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that housing corporation Laurens Wonen was in trouble, including whether its supervisory board chair was unlawfully reappointed and paid, and whether a joint management arrangement with care provider Laurens Zorg creates financial risks like those at Humanitas. The Minister, relaying the Aw's findings, confirmed the unlawful reappointment, said the Aw has agreed supervisory arrangements with the corporation, and said the joint arrangement is being ended and the financial ties unwound.
The Aw, as supervisor of housing corporations, cannot rule on the remuneration for work for Laurens Zorg.
De Aw kan als toezichthouder op woningcorporaties geen uitspraak doen over de vergoeding voor werkzaamheden voor Laurens Zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Koerhuis over het bericht dat er fors minder vergunningen voor nieuwbouwwoningen zijn afgegeven

MPs Ronnes and Koerhuis asked the Minister of Interior Affairs why building permits for new homes fell 27 percent in early 2019 and whether the ban on gas connections in new construction, the rising costs and scarce building locations are to blame. The minister acknowledged concern, linked the drop plausibly but not certainly to the gas-free new build rule and lagged application declines, said permits have since recovered, and committed only to continued monitoring.
I will continue to closely monitor the development.
Ik blijf de ontwikkeling nauwlettend monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat bouwers moeten bijdragen aan de toekomst van de stad Eindhoven

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of the Interior whether the Eindhoven municipality's plan to recover costs for supra-local facilities from developers (a 'new-build levy') was known beforehand, whether it complies with the law, and whether it threatens the housing deal targets, and asked the minister to intervene. The minister answered that the municipality uses a lawful cost-recovery option under the Wro, that it does not affect the 3,000 homes per year target, and that she sees no reason to intervene for now, promising to talk to Eindhoven if monitoring data give cause.
I see no reason at this moment to intervene.
Ik zie dan op dit moment geen aanleiding om te interveniëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan, Koerhuis en Lodders over het  bericht ‘Leidse  steuntrekker mag  kamer verhuren aan student om bij te verdienen’

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretaries whether a Leiden plan to let welfare recipients sublet rooms and keep part of the income was lawful, and what the government would do. The government answered that the plan contravened the Participatiewet, that it was a serious shortcoming in lawful implementation, and that Leiden withdrew the pilot after contact with the ministry, so no formal sanction was needed.

Given its scale (both the target group and the monthly amount to be exempted) and its possible spillover effect, implementing the plan would in my view lead to a serious shortcoming in the lawful implementation of the law.

Gelet op de omvang daarvan (zowel qua doelgroep als het vrij te laten maandbedrag) en het mogelijke uitstralingseffect, zou de uitvoering van het plan naar mijn mening leiden tot een ernstige tekortkoming in de rechtmatige uitvoering van de wet
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Ronnes over aardgasvrij bouwen na 1 juli 2018

MPs Koerhuis and Ronnes asked the Minister of the Interior about homes built after 1 July 2018 that are exempted from the gas-free building rule, including how many were connected to gas, the grounds used, alternatives, and future heating options. The minister answered that no precise registration exists, about 1,200 homes in 24 municipalities received exemptions, the choice of exemption rests with municipal councils, and municipalities must present heat transition plans by end 2021.
It is up to the municipal council concerned to exercise control over this.
Het is aan de betreffende gemeenteraad om hier controle op uit te oefenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht 'Domper voor wethouder Kurvers: corporaties zien niets in plan voor duurdere huurhuizen'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Rotterdam's plan for more middle-income rental housing, which housing corporations rejected, was a setback, and whether corporations and municipalities can be compelled to implement local housing agreements. The minister replied that a binding ruling was issued in the dispute, that corporations can still contribute to district renewal within the Housing Act, and that existing instruments, including court action and the minister's binding ruling power, are sufficient.
There is no hierarchical relationship between a municipality and a housing corporation when making performance agreements.
Er geldt bij het maken van prestatieafspraken geen hiërarchische relatie tussen een gemeente en een woningcorporatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Verplicht sparen voor onderhoud appartement’

MPs Lodders and Koerhuis asked whether VvE mandatory maintenance savings held in reserve funds should be taxed in box 3 and whether this creates unequal treatment and double taxation. The minister answered that the reserve is a taxable property right under Supreme Court case law, that there is no unequal treatment, and that no additional exemption or new measures are planned beyond reviewing the eigenwoningrente ruling.
The cabinet sees no injustice in this.
Het kabinet ziet hier geen onrechtvaardigheid in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over misbruik van de landelijke regeling huisvesting statushouders om uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers te huisvesten

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether a subsidised social housing experiment in Almere for refugee status holders was misused to house rejected asylum seekers, and how many were housed and how the subsidy was checked. The minister answers that the subsidy was checked against the BRP registration criteria, that four undocumented persons were found temporarily staying there and referred to Ter Apel, and that no subsidy went to housing rejected asylum seekers, while verification of the five-year requirement occurs at the end of the period.
Every subsidy application is assessed by RVO against the criteria set out in the scheme.
Iedere subsidieaanvraag wordt door RVO getoetst aan de in de regeling gestelde criteria.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Koerhuis over het bericht 'ABN-AMRO-economen: bouw is miljarden kwijt door fouten'

MPs Van Eijs and Koerhuis asked the minister how the government will reduce the high failure costs in Dutch construction, citing an ABN-AMRO report. The minister answers that the Kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen bill, along with stricter contractor liability and the Bouwagenda, is the main route, and commits to answering the questions within the time frame.
The bill on quality assurance for construction aims at such a system, which may also contribute to the necessary cultural change in the sector.
Het wetsvoorstel Kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen beoogt zo'n stelsel, dat tevens kan bijdragen aan de noodzakelijke cultuuromslag in de sector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Koerhuis over het bericht dat Amstelveen vasthoudt aan 2500 nieuwe studentenwoningen

MPs Dijkstra and Koerhuis asked whether Amstelveen's plan for 2,500 student dwellings under Schiphol flight paths risks residents' safety and health and circumvents Schiphol airspace rules. The minister answered that the plan is only a non-binding area vision, that the LIB rules restrict housing near flight paths and that consultation with the province and ministries will follow, but declined to judge the plan before a binding zoning plan exists.

In the short term, consultation will take place between representatives of the municipality, the province of Noord-Holland and the ministries of BZK and IenW to discuss how the area vision and the zoning plan still to be drawn up relate to the LIB rules.

Op korte termijn vindt nader overleg plaats tussen vertegenwoordigers van de gemeente, de provincie Noord-Holland en de ministeries van BZK en IenW om te bespreken hoe de Gebiedsvisie en het nog op te stellen bestemmingsplan zich verhouden tot de regels van het LIB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Ronnes over het bericht dat er vraagtekens zijn bij de fundering van de parkeergarage in Eindhoven

MPs Koerhuis and Ronnes asked whether the foundation of the Eindhoven parking garage played a role in its collapse, citing doubts raised by Terken and Plass, and asked about the independence of the Hageman report and the OvV findings. Minister Ollongren answered that the foundation is not considered a cause, citing Hageman, the Safety Board (OvV) and TNO, and that the municipality found no material deviations in its inspections, but did not claim absolute certainty.

In carrying out its investigations, the Safety Board is bound by a duty of confidentiality and therefore does not state with whom it spoke, what information it collected and how it handled it, except as set out in its report.

Bij het uitvoeren van haar onderzoeken is de Onderzoeksraad gehouden aan een geheimhoudingsplicht en doet daarom geen uitspraken met wie er gesproken is, welke informatie verzameld is en hoe daarmee is omgegaan, behoudens wat in het rapport is weergegeven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Van der Linde en Koerhuis over de brief van de Ombudsman aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het opnieuw aandacht vragen voor de korte aanvraagtermi

VVD MPs asked why the Dutch Ombudsman's concerns about low awareness of the 'special situations' rent/benefit scheme and its six-week application deadline were not addressed, and what the government would change. The State Secretary answered that the Belastingdienst had expanded website information and would raise awareness via intermediaries, that the six-week term is set in regulation and sufficient in practice, and that changes await an IBO review due end 2019, while declining a coulance scheme.
From an implementation perspective, the six-week term is sufficient.
Vanuit de uitvoering gezien is de zeswekentermijn voldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat de gemeente Utrecht zonnevelden en windmolens in Rijnenburg en Reijerscop wil plaatsen

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether Rijnenburg, a large Utrecht development area, should be kept for housing rather than solar and wind, given the regional housing shortage and province-wide shortfall of firm plans. The Minister replies that Rijnenburg is not a location for large-scale housing in the short term, that the choice of specific sites lies with the province and municipalities, and that she will press regions to secure enough building locations.
Rijnenburg is not a location where large-scale housing construction is possible in the short term.
Rijnenburg is geen locatie waar grootschalige woningbouw op korte termijn mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Ronnes over het bericht 'Corporaties laten vergoeding NOM-woning links liggen'

MPs Koerhuis and Ronnes asked why the government sent the Energy Performance Allowance evaluation to parliament without a policy response, why only about 6,000 zero-on-the-meter homes were built against a target of 100,000, and whether the costs and rules can be reduced. The minister said the evaluation was sent on 5 April 2019, that she will consult stakeholders and expects to report to parliament by year-end, and that she sees no reason to doubt CE Delft's cost findings but has not yet sketched alternatives.
I expect to be able to inform your House of the outcome at the end of this year.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer eind dit jaar over de uitkomst te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Koerhuis over het bericht 'Negen jaar Crisis- en Herstelwet: de (dis)balans'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether lengthy objection and appeal procedures, allegedly abused by querulous stakeholders, delay housing projects and whether settlement payments to objectors should be curbed, and whether legal rules could be changed to speed up procedures. The Minister answered that existing law already allows abuse to be countered, that settlements are private and not monitored, and that further restriction of appeal rights is not desirable, though further acceleration measures in the Crisis- and Herstelwet are being pursued.
I am aware that project developers and other clients sometimes reach a settlement with a party that has lodged an objection or appeal. These settlements are not made public.

Ik ben er van op de hoogte dat projectontwikkelaars en andere opdrachtgevers soms een schikking treffen met een partij die in bezwaar of beroep is gegaan. Deze schikkingen worden niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Koerhuis over het bericht 'Corporaties laten vele miljoenen euro’s voor nieuwbouw ongebruikt liggen'

MPs Van Eijs and Koerhuis asked whether housing corporations leave large unused investment capacity for new social rental homes and sustainability, and whether they should be pressed to use it. The minister confirmed the indicative investment capacity figures, said local parties decide how it is deployed, and promised to report on the sector in the annual Staat van de Volkshuisvesting.
It is therefore up to tenant organisations, housing corporations and municipalities to make local agreements on the deployment of the available housing resources.
Het is dan ook aan huurdersorganisaties, corporaties en gemeenten om lokaal afspraken te maken over de inzet van de beschikbare volkshuisvestelijke middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Laan-Geselschap over illegale bewoning op vakantieparken

MPs Koerhuis and Laan-Geselschap asked the government about illegal residence on holiday parks, including ZKA findings that a third of parks lack a tourist future and about ten percent face serious safety problems. Minister Ollongren answered that an action agenda 2018-2020 is being implemented, pilots will report by end 2020, an information base with the Kadaster will help municipalities, and conversion to housing is possible locally.
I will inform you about the results after the pilots are completed.
Ik zal u na afronding van de pilots over de resultaten informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Aartsen en Laan-Geselschap over het kraken van het Fort bij Velsen in de gemeente Beverwijk door oud-ADM-krakers

VVD MPs asked whether the government will act against squatters who occupied the listed Fort bij Velsen, whether the owner filed a complaint, and whether monumental buildings should get priority for eviction and damage recovery. Minister Grapperhaus said squatting is illegal, the owner filed a report, a court allowed eviction, and no change to prosecutorial priorities for monuments is planned, while withholding details on individual cases.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele zaken doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Koerhuis over een item in het programma Kanniewaarzijn

MPs Van der Linde and Koerhuis asked whether the government shares concern that older people and people on benefits struggle to get small mortgages, and whether lenders' duty of care and a 'no-fuss' rule for mortgages under 20-30% of WOZ value should be added. Minister Hoekstra answered that lenders choose their target groups, that a bagatelle rule is not responsible because home value does not reveal income, and that the government will raise remaining bottlenecks at the next Platform hypotheken meeting.
From the Platform hypotheken I currently have no signals that people with modest incomes lack mortgage options while this would be responsible.
Vanuit het Platform hypotheken heb ik op dit moment geen signalen dat mensen met een bescheiden inkomen geen hypotheekmogelijkheden hebben terwijl dit wel verantwoord is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat 1400 huizen in Amsterdam verhuurd worden op Airbnb door mensen die buiten Amsterdam staan ingeschreven

MP Koerhuis (VVD) asked the Minister of Interior whether about 1,400 Amsterdam homes rented on Airbnb by people registered outside Amsterdam create vacancy and housing fraud, and about progress on the Koerhuis/Beckerman motion to make housing fraud an economic offence. The minister said she does not know these figures, pointed to a planned registration duty for hosts and a permit/notification regime for tourist rental, and noted that illegal room rental can already be enforced under the Housing Act and the Spatial Planning Act.
Precisely to gain insight into these numbers, the bill proposes a registration duty for hosts.
Juist om inzicht te krijgen in deze aantallen wordt in het wetsvoorstel een registratieplicht voor verhuurders ( hosts ) voorgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over illegale verhuur op Airbnb

MP Koerhuis (VVD) asked the Minister of Interior whether Spain's registration approach to holiday rentals could be applied in the Netherlands, whether Airbnb could be designated a tourist intermediary and required to show KvK numbers, and whether this could be included in the forthcoming holiday rental law. The Minister replied that a mandatory single registration with a number to be displayed on each listing will be introduced via a Huisvestingswet amendment, but declined to classify rental providers as entrepreneurs under the Housing Act, citing the housing-market link and proportionality, and noted KvK registration would not reveal property addresses.
In this context, the Housing Act will be amended.
In dit verband zal de Huisvestingswet worden gewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Fraudeverdachte verdient aan villa' en het bericht 'Beslag gelegd op huizen Erik Staal om miljoenenfraude'

An MP asked whether renting out real estate under attachment (beslag) by fraud suspect Erik Staal on Bonaire is lawful, whether this situation is undesirable, and whether the villa's rental requires a permit or enforcement. The Minister answered that renting attached property is in principle allowed, that the attachment creditor's rights remain protected, that no permit is required for rental and thus no enforcement is possible, and that the villa is no longer listed.
Renting out a property under attachment is in principle permitted.
De verhuur van een in beslag genomen onroerende zaak is in beginsel toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht dat duizenden mensen illegaal op een vakantiepark wonen

Two VVD MPs asked the Interior and Justice ministers about reports that thousands of people live illegally on Veluwe holiday parks, including whether the government will prevent criminal groups from exploiting them and whether it will publish quantitative and per-park overviews. The minister answered that no national data exists on permanent occupancy and deferred enforcement to municipalities, while promising support, a learning network, pilots and better data.
No quantitative overview is available at national level of holiday parks where permanent residence takes place.
Op landelijk niveau is geen kwantitatief overzicht beschikbaar van vakantieparken waar permanente bewoning plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over misstanden bij woningcorporatie Mijande

An MP asked the minister about misconduct at housing corporation Mijande, including whether the buyer will cooperate in reversing below-value sales, whether the corporation's assets are at risk, whether the former board member should contribute financially, and whether the interim director's pay will be disclosed. The minister answered that the Autoriteit woningcorporaties is handling the buyer's objection, that the corporation must limit and recover damage, that the regulator will act if needed, and that pay details will appear in the 2018 annual accounts.
If the House wishes, I can send information about the interim board member's remuneration to the House.
Antwoord 4 Indien de Kamer daar prijs op stelt, kan ik informatie over de bezoldiging van de interim--bestuurder naar de Kamer zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Bouwen in het groen? Wel doen’

MPs Koerhuis and Laan-Geselschap (VVD) asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about the Chief Government Architect's public stance against building in green areas and its implications for housing policy and decentralised housing responsibility. The minister answered that the advisory views are non-binding, that the government must prioritise accelerating housing construction, that regions should first use inner-city space but some may need greenfield sites, and that the National Environmental Vision will set the direction for a national vision.
The advice of the College of State Advisers and the Chief Government Architect is not binding and aims to promote spatial, and therefore integrated, thinking.
De adviezen van het College van Rijksadviseurs c.q. de Rijksbouwmeester hebben geen bindend karakter en hebben als doel het denken vanuit een ruimtelijke, dus integrale, invalshoek te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis relaties over gestuntel bij bouw parkeergarage Wormerveer

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about building-safety lapses in the Wormerveer car park and in Eindhoven, including whether municipalities can structurally provide adequate construction supervision and whether the Kwaliteitsborging bill would help. The minister answered that municipalities supervise under their own policy and that the bill adds an independent quality assurer, while stating she has no power to intervene in individual municipalities and that a motion is being implemented.
I have no authority to intervene in the municipality of Zaanstad.
Ik heb geen bevoegdheid om bij de gemeente Zaanstad in te grijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht dat de provincie Noord-Holland woningbouw in Alkmaar tegenhoudt

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the province of Noord-Holland is blocking housing construction in the Alkmaar region, and whether the Metropoolregio Amsterdam should be extended to include those municipalities and others such as Hoorn. The Minister answered that the national target is on track to be discussed further, that the Alkmaar region can build without joining the MRA, that she has not yet talked with the province but will do so and report by the end of Q1 2019, and that delays stem mainly from implementation capacity and the province has earmarked EUR 15 million for bottlenecks.
I have committed to your chamber to enter into talks with the province of Noord-Holland soon and to inform you of the outcomes.
Ik heb uw kamer toegezegd spoedig met de provincie Noord-Holland in gesprek te gaan en u over de uitkomsten te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over onderzoek naar fraude bij Vestia

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior when the forensic investigation into fraud at housing corporation Vestia started and when it will finish, and whether its outcome will be sent to parliament. The minister replied that the Autoriteit woningcorporaties reports a start on 19 November 2018 with an uncertain duration, and that the report will not be published given its confidential content, though the main findings will be shared with parliament in time.
Given its confidential nature, it is not customary for the Aw to make public the reports arising from forensic investigations it receives.
Vanwege het vertrouwelijk karakter daarvan is het niet gebruikelijk dat de Aw rapportages naar aanleiding van forensisch onderzoek waarover zij komt te beschikken openbaar maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over vluchtelingen die eigen woonunits bouwen

An MP asks about a reported plan by refugees to build their own housing units and whether the province can take over housing of status holders from municipalities that miss their quota, and how that process works. The minister explains a six-step intervention ladder ending in substitute placement at municipal cost, says temporary housing can help ease pressure, and announces pilots for flexible housing.
When the quota is not met, an intervention ladder is applied, in which substitute placement can be reached in six steps.
Bij het niet halen van de taakstelling wordt een interventieladder gehanteerd, waarbij in 6 stappen tot indeplaatsstelling gekomen kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over onderzoek naar fraude bij Vestia

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reported fraud by Vestia staff, whether the new Housing Act prevents it, the FIOD's and Aw's oversight of such cases, and whether the problem is structural. The Minister declined substantive comment while the case is with the Public Prosecution Service, described the Aw's integrity reporting point and interventions, and said Vestia has launched an independent forensic investigation and remains under intensified supervision.
I cannot respond substantively to the report at this time, because the case is still with the Public Prosecution Service.
Ik kan op dit moment niet inhoudelijk op het bericht reageren, omdat de zaak nog bij het Openbaar Ministerie ligt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over misstanden bij woningcorporatie Mijande

MP Koerhuis asked the minister about misconduct at housing corporation Mijande, including whether the new Woningwet can prevent it, how the Autoriteit Woningcorporaties (Aw) handles integrity reports, whether whistleblowers are protected, whether the former director must pay damages, and whether the interim director's pay complies with the rules. The minister answered that the Aw intervened, the sales were voided, the former director was dismissed without severance, the Aw has sufficient instruments, and pay will be verified via the 2018 annual accounts audit.
The Aw therefore cannot yet provide insight into the remuneration of directors for 2018.
De Aw kan daarom nu nog geen inzage geven over bezoldiging van bestuurders over 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Beckerman over de brandveiligheid van gebouwen

MPs Koerhuis and Beckerman asked about fire-safety of buildings, including combustible facade panels, the reported Nijmegen plan to loosen fire-safety enforcement, and what the minister can do to intervene in municipalities. The minister said an inventory of risky buildings is being prepared with the VBWTN and fire service, with a letter expected end of November, that municipalities have policy freedom in enforcement and are accountable to their councils, and that she has no power to intervene since interbestuurlijk toezicht lies with the provinces.
Although it is therefore not for me to have an opinion on this, I made inquiries with the municipality as part of the right of reply.
Hoewel het dus niet aan mij is om hierover een mening te hebben, heb ik in het kader van wederhoor navraag gedaan bij de gemeente.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de conclusie van EenVandaag dat de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid de huidige landelijke inventarisatie van breedplaat- ofwel bubblevloeren in twijfel trekt

MP Koerhuis asked the Minister of the Interior whether the national inventory of hollow-core (bubble) floors is doubted by the Dutch Safety Board, whether a new inventory will be started, and whether municipalities are informed quickly. The Minister said she is having Prof. Wijte examine the consequences of the Safety Board's findings for the inventory and will report by end of November, but did not know whether complete building files lie with municipalities.
I have asked Prof. Wijte to examine this and to consult with the OvV and all other experts he considers relevant.
Ik heb prof. Wijte gevraagd om dit te onderzoeken en hiervoor in overleg te treden met de OvV en met alle andere deskundigen die hij van belang acht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Koerhuis over de tekortkoming bij de aansluitingsplicht van nutsbedrijf Liander bij het nieuwbouwproject 'Oostweide' in Heiloo

MPs Rudmer Heerema and Koerhuis asked the minister about grid operator Liander's failure to connect the Oostweide new-build project in Heiloo on time, including household hardship, financial liability, compensation, and whether such cases occur elsewhere. The minister answered that financial consequences are private-law matters outside his involvement, that Liander and the builders reached constructive agreement to finish work quickly, and that he is consulting network operators and the regulator ACM on the wider problem of missed 18-week connection deadlines.
Any financial consequences result from private-law relationships between the parties, in which I am not involved.
Eventuele financiële consequenties zijn het gevolg van privaatrechtelijke verhoudingen tussen de partijen, waarbij ik niet ben betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het instorten van een parkeergarage in Wormerveer

MP Koerhuis asked the Minister of the Interior about the partial collapse of a parking garage in Wormerveer, whether prefab floors were implicated, and what is being done about similar garages and building supervision. The minister answered that the collapse was caused by a failed steel beam connection rather than the floors, that other garages are being reviewed, and that the forthcoming Wet Kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen is intended to tighten supervision, while the investigation is still ongoing.

The investigation into the partial collapse of the parking garage in Wormerveer is not yet complete. Once this investigation is finished, I will consider whether national measures are needed for similar parking garages or buildings.

Het onderzoek naar de gedeeltelijke instorting van de parkeergarage in Wormerveer is nog niet afgerond. Als dit onderzoek is afgerond, bezie ik of landelijke maatregelen nodig zijn bij soortgelijke parkeergarages of gebouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over scheuren in pilaren in een parkeergarage in Almere

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether cracked pillars closing an Almere parking garage pose collapse risk, whether they are linked to the 2017 Eindhoven collapse, and whether municipal building supervision and the planned quality-assurance law address the failure. The minister answered that the municipal investigation into the cause is not finished, that there is no link to Eindhoven, and that the municipality holds the permit file while the planned Wkb would supervise building quality through private quality assurers.
The investigation into the cause has not yet been completed.
Het onderzoek naar de oorzaak is nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Koerhuis over de inventarisatie van brandgevaarlijke gevelplaten

MPs Beckerman and Koerhuis asked whether more information exists on the extent of fire-hazardous facade panels in the Netherlands, whether suppliers were approached, whether municipalities are asked to inventory affected buildings, and whether Nijmegen's self-inspection by housing corporations is problematic. The Minister says all municipalities will be asked to inventory the most risky buildings and check Bouwbesluit compliance, with the approach still being discussed with VBWTN and the fire service, and that building owners bear primary responsibility while municipalities have policy freedom in building supervision.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Veldman over het bericht 'Veel bewoners van sociale huurwoningen verdienen te veel'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about a newspaper report on high-income social housing tenants in the Rivierenland and Maasland regions, and about the effects of monitoring data, rent rules, selling dear social rentals and possible action. The Minister answered in detail with regional statistics, explained the income-based rent rules, and said she will assess the expected rent agreement and report to parliament, if it is not reached she will consider whether current policy suffices.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en De Lange over het bericht ‘het overmaken van de huurtoeslag aan woningcorporaties’

Two MPs (VVD) asked the Minister of the Interior about whether moving debt-burdened tenants to the cheapest social rental housing could reduce housing costs and debt, and what other countries and corporations do. The minister gave rent-burden data, said debt cases require customised municipal solutions with no national data on relocations, and rejected extra consultation as unnecessary since corporations already work to prevent evictions.
The information you requested is not available because debt handling is customised work for which no national figures are kept.
De door u gevraagde informatie is niet beschikbaar omdat de aanpak van de schulden maatwerk is waarvan landelijk geen cijfers worden bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Nieuwbouw gebrekkig opgeleverd’

Rep. Koerhuis (VVD) asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that new-build homes are delivered with defects, the causes, and how buyers and the housing market are protected. The Minister acknowledges rising defects, points to the Kwaliteitsborging bill strengthening buyer protection and contractor liability, and says a letter to the Eerste Kamer on resuming that bill is coming before the summer recess.
With the Kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen bill I want to give a boost to improving construction quality by strengthening the position of construction consumers.
Met het wetsvoorstel Kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen wil ik een impuls geven aan de verbetering van de bouwkwaliteit door de positie van bouwconsumenten te versterken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Koerhuis over crimineel geld in de Amsterdamse huizenmarkt

MPs Beckerman and Koerhuis asked whether criminal money is entering the Amsterdam housing market, how large it is, what measures exist to keep it out, and whether police have enough capacity. The Minister replied that the reports describe risks rather than established facts, pointed to an upcoming WODC study, and listed existing anti-money-laundering and RIEC cooperation measures while acknowledging police capacity is scarce.
The article, like the police unit's 'Trends and developments' report, speaks of risks rather than established facts.
Het artikel spreekt, net als het rapport «Trends en ontwikkelingen» van de politie-eenheid Amsterdam over risico’s, niet over vastgestelde feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Huizenkoper bij bank duizenden euro’s duurder uit dan bij onafhankelijk adviseur’

MPs Van der Linde and Koerhuis asked whether a report showing bank-channel mortgage buyers pay more than those using independent advisers reflects reality, and what the government will do about competition and transparency. The minister said he cannot confirm the survey's findings, sees no signals of insufficient competition or transparency, and will examine how the advisory-cost disclosure document (dienstverleningsdocument) can be improved, with a follow-up letter to Parliament.
I cannot confirm the results of this study.
Ik kan de resultaten van dit onderzoek niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en De Lange over het overmaken van de huurtoeslag aan woningcorporaties

MPs Koerhuis and De Lange asked about the proposal to pay housing benefit (huurtoeslag) directly to housing corporations, its effect on debt-restructuring tenants, and the size and cost of social rental housing. The minister answered that talks with Aedes and the Tax Administration are ongoing, that direct payment is currently not used, and that outcomes cannot yet be anticipated.
I do not want to anticipate the outcome of those talks.
Op de uitkomst van die gesprekken wil ik niet vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht 'Amsterdam: laat krakende asielzoekers zitten'

MP Koerhuis (VVD) asks about reports that Amsterdam is leaving squatting asylum seekers in social housing alone, and whether the government will intervene. The minister agrees squatting is illegal, says the case is left to Amsterdam authorities and the public prosecutor, and states he has no direct means to order eviction.

I take the position that the further course of the procedure toward eviction should be left to the authorities in Amsterdam, and I see no reason to enter into discussion with those authorities about it.

Ik stel mij op het standpunt het verdere verloop van de procedure tot ontruiming aan de autoriteiten in Amsterdam over te laten en zie dan ook geen aanleiding om hierover met deze autoriteiten in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het kraken van sociale huurwoningen in Amsterdam

An MP asked the Minister about squatting of social rental homes in Amsterdam, including its costs, the number and outcomes of squatting cases, state accommodation of squatters, and owners' options. The Minister gave substantive figures on Ymere's costs and prosecution statistics, rejected the idea that squatters are accommodated, and declined to collect some data or comment on foreign law.
I do not have the other requested data from the above questions.
Over de overige gevraagde gegevens van bovenstaande vragen heb ik geen beschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Hypotheekkeurslijf nekt starters en senioren’

MP Koerhuis (VVD) asked the minister about a report that the mortgage rules leave starters and seniors without loans and about a Vereniging Eigen Huis study finding lenders underuse the room for tailored mortgages (maatwerk). The minister acknowledged the differences between lenders, said the platform on maatwerk found clarity had improved after the AFM's clarification, and that evaluation results will be sent to parliament before summer.
The outcomes of the platform are currently being evaluated. The House will be informed about the outcomes before the summer.
De uitkomsten van het platform worden momenteel geëvalueerd. De Kamer zal voor de zomer over de uitkomsten worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het wantrouwen van gemeenten in beleggers van middenhuurwoningen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about municipalities' distrust of investors in mid-rent housing, the 40% fear of quick resale, use of land allocation and zoning tools, liveability and debt-relief goals, and what the government would do. The minister acknowledged the housing shortage, pointed to private agreements, the Expertteam Woningbouw and local round tables, and said the policy is a local responsibility with support offered.
Housing and land policy is a local matter.
Het woon- en grondbeleid is een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het artikel ‘3,7 ton voor krakers’

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior about reports that Amsterdam spends about 370,000 euros preparing a temporary site for ADM squatters, questioning the duration, scale, and secrecy of the decision. The minister confirms squatting is illegal, explains the civil and administrative proceedings and the Raad van State injunction, notes no comparable cases are known, and attributes the secrecy to the Amsterdam municipality.
The Amsterdam municipal executive imposed secrecy until residents near the sludge fields in North had been informed about the possible arrival of the current ADM site residents.
Het college van de gemeente Amsterdam heeft geheimhouding opgelegd tot het moment dat omwonenden van de slibvelden in Noord geïnformeerd waren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over gebouwen met brandgevaarlijke gevelpanelen in Nederland

MP Koerhuis (VVD) asked the Interior Minister about buildings with fire-hazardous facade panels across the Netherlands and the government's role in addressing it, including whether municipal building files and the Quality Assurance Act would fix oversight gaps. Minister Ollongren said primary responsibility lies with builders and owners, municipalities enforce, and she will await the Grenfell inquiry before considering measures, while pointing to the pending Quality Assurance Act and promising to send a separate letter on its status.
Because the problem is national in scope, there is also a role for me as systems-responsible minister for building regulation.
Omdat er sprake is van een landelijke problematiek, ligt er ook een rol voor mij als stelselverantwoordelijke voor de bouwregelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Wiersma en El Yassini over het bericht 'Ernstig tekort aan bouwvakkers dreigt nu de economie weer bloeit'

MPs Koerhuis, Wiersma and El Yassini asked the ministers whether the projected shortage of 70,000 construction workers threatens the housing target and quality, and what the government will do about training, innovation and secure building pipelines. The minister answered that employers bear primary responsibility, pointed to existing measures (tax cuts on labour, Matchen op Werk, Techniekpact, UWV retraining budget, BBL subsidies), and said she would talk with stakeholders and regional parties without giving firm commitments.
The responsibility to attract sufficient qualified personnel lies primarily with the employers themselves.
De verantwoordelijkheid om voldoende gekwalificeerd personeel aan te trekken ligt primair bij de werkgevers zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Ronnes over verlagen van administratieve lasten en overhead bij woningcorporaties

MPs Koerhuis and Ronnes asked the Minister of Interior Affairs whether housing corporation administrative costs, overhead, personnel, maintenance and IT costs exceed those of private landlords and how they could be reduced. The minister answered that comparison data are lacking, that corporations have statutory tasks justifying certain costs, that costs have been falling since 2013, and that the sector and the Autoriteit woningcorporaties will be monitored, with a commitment to work with the sector on reducing administrative burdens.
Due to the lack of figures from private landlords and property managers, such a comparison is not possible.
Door het ontbreken van cijfers van private verhuurders en vastgoedbeheerders is een dergelijke vergelijking niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de kosten van een lege buizen- en laadpaalnorm

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the number of parking spaces covered by the empty-conduit rule for EV charging, the estimated costs per space, the definition of major renovation, and whether the norms should apply to owner-occupied renovations. The minister said the EU trilogue deal was not yet detailed enough to answer the first question, gave cost estimates and the renovation definition, and argued the norm should apply only where parking or electrical infrastructure is part of the renovation.
Because the provisional agreement is still being worked out, I unfortunately cannot yet provide clarity on the provisions for EV charging infrastructure.
Omdat het voorlopige akkoord nog nader uitgewerkt wordt, kan ik op dit moment helaas nog geen duidelijkheid verschaffen over de bepalingen voor laadinfrastructuur voor elektrisch vervoer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘32 woonunits voor vluchtelingen in Veldhoven geplaatst’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports of 32 housing units for refugees in Veldhoven, the typical wait for status holders to move from COA shelter to regular housing, and whether status holders should lose automatic priority for social housing. The minister answered that status holders wait on average five to six months, that the automatic urgency status was abolished in July 2017 leaving municipalities to decide, and that she would inform parliament on the effect if data become available.
It is currently not known to me in how many municipalities status holders are still considered a priority category.
Het is mij op dit moment nog niet bekend in hoeveel gemeenten statushouders nog als een voorrangscategorie worden beschouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Rijk in stenen, arm in geld’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether seniors should be able to unlock home equity and whether the mortgage-access issue blocks housing mobility, and why a motion on senior mortgages had not yet produced action. The minister responded that a platform on tailored mortgage lending identified constraints from the income-based annuity test in the RHK, that the AFM clarified when exceptions are permissible, and that a yearly mortgage platform will revisit equity release, possibly involving the NHG if warranted.
I have decided to give substance to this by organising a mortgage platform every year.
Ik heb besloten hier invulling aan te geven door jaarlijks een platform hypotheken te organiseren.
Antwoord op van het lid Koerhuis over het huurbeleid van woningcorporaties

Rep. Koerhuis (VVD) asked the Minister of Interior about a CPB report finding that housing corporations give larger rent discounts on luxury homes, and about options to align rents with quality, including a norm rent in rent allowance, selling and liberalising high-point homes, and stimulating such sales. The Minister replied that rent policy is constrained by existing rules, that a norm rent would be a major change with income effects, that sales rules were loosened and that the middle-rent table's findings will be sent in early 2018.
Early in 2018, following the outcomes and recommendations of the middle-rent working table chaired by Mr van Gijzel, I will inform you further on this point.
Begin 2018 zal ik naar aanleiding van de uitkomsten en aanbevelingen van de samenwerkingstafel middenhuur o.l.v. de heer van Gijzel u op dit punt nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat de woningbouwproductie steeds verder achteroploopt door onderbezetting bij gemeenten

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether municipal understaffing delays housing construction, how many projects the Crisis and Recovery Act and expert teams had helped, and whether those teams should proactively visit municipalities. The minister acknowledged delays and capacity problems but said exact figures are lacking, pointed to ongoing regional talks and continued use of the expert teams, but did not commit to proactive outreach.
At this moment I do not have exact figures that could give more insight into this.
Op dit moment beschik ik niet over exacte cijfers die hier meer inzicht in kunnen geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Koerhuis over het onderzoek naar de oorzaken van het instorten van een parkeergarage in Eindhoven

MPs Ronnes and Koerhuis asked the Minister of Interior about the causes of a parking garage collapse at Eindhoven Airport, the division of building-quality responsibilities, the status of related buildings, and the scope of inspections on breedplaatvloeren. The minister answered that builders remain responsible under current rules, that the planned Wet kwaliteitsborging shifts checks to a private quality assurer, that NEN finds the norm clear but may clarify it, and that inspections were started at government buildings and gemeenten with buildings from 1999 onward.
I do not know which buildings these are.
Ik weet niet welke gebouwen dit zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht 'Erfpachtkorting 'groene' woning'

An MP asks the Minister of Interior Affairs whether housing corporations receive ground-price discounts or special erfpacht conversion terms from municipalities, how this fits EU state-aid rules, and how any benefit is recovered when homes are sold on the free market. The minister confirms the discounts can apply to DAEB social housing, says conversion to perpetual erfpacht is open to private buyers so no corporation advantage arises, knows of no other municipalities with such exceptions, and states that proceeds from DAEB sales stay within the DAEB arm, with Amsterdam having specific erfpacht payment arrangements.
Because the private owner is given the opportunity to convert to perpetual erfpacht, there is no advantage for corporations in the European legal sense.
Omdat de particuliere eigenaar in de gelegenheid wordt gesteld om over te stappen naar eeuwigdurende erfpacht, is geen sprake van een voordeel voor corporaties in Europeesrechterlijke zin.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Koerhuis over hypotheken, echtscheiding en maatwerk

Two VVD MPs asked whether mortgage lenders can and do provide case-by-case flexibility (maatwerk) after divorce or relationship breakdown, and how NHG, AFM rules and debt release work in such cases. The minister answers that the Platform Maatwerk has found no new bottlenecks, that the rules already allow justified deviations, that lenders vary in practice, and promises to inform the House before summer.
I will inform you before the summer about the outcomes of this.
Ik zal u voor de zomer informeren over de uitkomsten hiervan.

m: Motie van de leden Nanninga en Van der Burg over nagaan of de Kustwacht Caribisch Gebied beschikt over voldoende capaciteit en middelen om, in het licht van een mogelijke vluchtelingencrisis, haar tak
Asks the government to examine whether the Coast Guard in the Caribbean has enough capacity and resources for a possible refugee crisis and act if needed.
requests the government to examine whether the Coast Guard Caribbean has sufficient capacity and resources
verzoekt de regering na te gaan of de Kustwacht Caribisch Gebied beschikt over voldoende capaciteit en middelen
Motie van de leden Ceder en Van der Burg over voor 1 juli 2026 een gedragen (financieel) plan voor een structurele oplossing van Selibon Lagun
Asks the government to deliver by 1 July 2026 a financially backed plan for a structural solution to the Selibon Lagun landfill on Bonaire, clarifying each ministry's responsibility.
requests the government to deliver by 1 July 2026 a broadly supported (financial) plan
verzoekt de regering voor 1 juli 2026 een gedragen (financieel) plan aan te leveren
Motie van het lid Paternotte c.s. over streven naar een bemiddelende rol bij het leveren van Taurusraketten en andere langeafstandsraketten aan Oekraïne
Asks the government to seek a mediating role in supplying Taurus and other long-range missiles to Ukraine.
requests the government to seek a mediating role in supplying Taurus missiles
verzoekt de regering te streven naar een bemiddelende rol bij het leveren van Taurusraketten
Motie van de leden Piri en Van der Burg over blijven pleiten voor de invoering van stemmen met gekwalificeerde meerderheid in het GBVB
Asks the cabinet to keep advocating for qualified majority voting in the EU's common foreign and security policy.
requests the cabinet to keep advocating for introducing qualified majority voting in the CFSP
verzoekt het kabinet om te blijven pleiten voor de invoering van stemmen met gekwalificeerde meerderheid in het GBVB

Motie van het lid Van der Burg c.s. over personen die zich zonder gegronde reden in een rood reisgebied bevinden een financiële bijdrage laten betalen voor een door de regering georganiseerde evacuati
Asks the government to charge financial contributions to people without good reason who were in a red-advice travel area and evacuated, and to explore a black travel advice.
requests the cabinet to have persons using a government-organised evacuation and repatriation flight pay a financial contribution
verzoekt het kabinet om personen die gebruikmaken van een door de regering georganiseerde evacuatie en repatriëringsvlucht een financiële bijdrage te laten betalen
Amendement van het lid Kahraman c.s. over middelen ten behoeve van de totstandkoming van een IS-tribunaal
Amendment reserves 250,000 euro from the human rights fund for setting up an international tribunal on ISIS crimes.
With this amendment, 250,000 euro is reserved in 2025 from the Human Rights Fund (article 1.2) for setting up an ISIS tribunal.
Met dit amendement wordt in 2025 € 250.000 gereserveerd uit het Mensenrechtenfonds (artikel 1.2) ten behoeve van de totstandkoming van een IS-tribunaal.
Motie van de leden Koekkoek en Van der Burg over mogelijkheden onderzoeken om een data-ambassade te creëren voor Nederland
Asks the government to consult Estonia and investigate whether a data embassy can be created in the Netherlands to keep core government services running during cyberattacks.
requests the government to consult with colleagues in Estonia and investigate the options for creating a similar data embassy for the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering met collega's in Estland in overleg te gaan en te onderzoeken welke mogelijkheden er zijn om een soortgelijke data-ambassade te creëren voor Nederland
Motie van het lid Van der Burg c.s. over in Europees verband de mogelijkheden voor een Europese veiligheidsraad onderzoeken
Asks the government to explore, at European level, options for a European security council and report progress to the House in Q3 2025.
