requests the government to explore, at European level, the possibilities for a European security council, make concrete proposals, and report progress to the House in Q3 2025

verzoekt de regering om in Europees verband de mogelijkheden voor een Europese veiligheidsraad te onderzoeken, hiervoor concrete voorstellen te doen, en de Kamer in Q3, kwartaal drie, van 2025 over de voortgang te rapporteren
Motie van het lid Boswijk c.s. over in het onderzoek naar elektrische auto’s de economische risico’s van alle mobiliteitsproducten uit China onderzoeken
Asks the government to also examine the economic risks of other Chinese mobility products within its existing study on electric cars and report to the House by spring 2025.
requests the government to also examine the economic risks of other mobility products from China in the research on electric cars
verzoekt de regering in het onderzoek naar elektrische auto's ook de economische risico's van overige mobiliteitsproducten uit China te onderzoeken
Motie van het lid Van der Burg c.s. over onderzoeken of een rechtsbijstandovereenkomst met Taiwan naar Duits model wenselijk is voor Nederland
Asks the government to examine whether a Germany-style legal assistance agreement with Taiwan would be desirable for the Netherlands.
requests the government to examine whether a legal assistance agreement with Taiwan along German lines would also be desirable for the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering om te onderzoeken of een rechtsbijstandovereenkomst met Taiwan naar Duits model ook wenselijk zou zijn voor Nederland
Motie van het lid Boswijk c.s. over de Kamer uiterlijk voor de Voorjaarsnota informeren over de consequenties van beleidskeuzes en bezuinigingen voor de actieagenda van de Afrikastrategie
Asks government to inform the House before the Spring Memorandum about consequences of budget cuts for the Africa strategy action agenda.
requests the government to inform the House before the Spring Memorandum about what consequences there will be for the action agenda
verzoekt de regering de Kamer uiterlijk voor de Voorjaarsnota te informeren over welke consequenties er zullen zijn voor de actieagenda
Motie van het lid Van der Burg c.s. over een structureel samenwerkingsplatform oprichten om best practices en praktische oplossingen voor de naleving van sancties te delen
Asks the government to set up a structural platform with ministries and businesses to share best practices on complying with sanctions.
requests the government to set up a structural cooperation platform
verzoekt de regering een structureel samenwerkingsplatform op te richten
Motie van het lid Van der Burg c.s. over onderzoeken op welke wijze inlichtingen van veiligheidsdiensten kunnen worden ingezet om sancties sneller en nauwkeuriger op te leggen aan individuen
Asks the government to investigate how intelligence from security services could be used to impose sanctions on individuals faster and more precisely.
requests the government to investigate how intelligence from security services can be used to impose sanctions on individuals faster and more accurately
verzoekt de regering om te onderzoeken op welke wijze inlichtingen van veiligheidsdiensten kunnen worden ingezet om sancties sneller en nauwkeuriger op te leggen aan individuen
Motie van de leden Paternotte en Van der Burg over er in EU-verband voor pleiten alle diensten te sanctioneren die bijdragen aan gesanctioneerde economische activiteiten van Rusland
Motion asks the government to push at EU level for sanctions on services supporting Russian sanctioned economic activity and discourage such services in the Netherlands.
requests the government to advocate at European level sanctioning all services
verzoekt de regering er in Europees verband voor te pleiten alle diensten te sanctioneren
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van Lanschot, Piri, Van der Werf, Belhirch, Van der Burg, Ceder en Dassen  over een gat in de steun aan Oekraïne

MPs from several parties asked whether part of the 2026 military support budget for Ukraine was brought forward into 2025, leaving a gap in 2026, and how the government will prevent unwanted gaps. The Minister confirms that €3.1 billion for 2026 was partly accelerated into 2025, that planned 2026 cash outlays now stand at about €2.1 billion, and that support will continue with further burden-sharing efforts, without committing to a specific new safeguard.
Part of this support has been accelerated into cash expenditure in 2025.
Een deel van deze steun is versneld in 2025 tot kasuitgaven gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Van der Burg over de aankondiging van Netanyahu dat migratiestromen uit Gaza zullen ontstaan

MPs Rajkowski and Van der Burg asked the government whether Netanyahu's announcement of Palestinian departures from Gaza would cause migration flows to the EU, how screening would catch Hamas members among asylum seekers, and how the Netherlands would press Israel and support the region. The minister answered that the Netherlands opposes forced displacement, screens asylum seekers for war-crime indicators, works on regional reception and EU migration measures, and continues diplomatic pressure for a ceasefire.
For Dutch policy it is beyond question: Gaza belongs to the Palestinians.
Voor het Nederlands beleid staat buiten kijf: Gaza is van de Palestijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Van der Burg en Ellian over oproepen tot geweld tijdens het concert van Bob Vylan in Paradiso Amsterdam

VVD MPs asked the Justice and Culture ministers whether Bob Vylan's concert calls for violence (including cheering the killing of Charlie Kirk and calling for hunting Zionists) should be treated as criminal, how the concert was permitted, whether the UK prosecution affects visas or entry bans, and whether local authorities can prevent further calls to violence. The government answered that police and the Public Prosecution Service must establish what was said, that bans on performances require concrete serious disorder, that entry refusal is possible under the Schengen Borders Code on public order grounds, and that local mayors make their own assessments without commenting on individual cases.
Which statements Bob Vylan made will have to emerge from the police and Public Prosecution Service investigation.
Welke uitingen zijn gedaan door Bob Vylan zal uit het onderzoek van politie en het Openbaar Ministerie moeten blijken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Van der Burg en Diederik van Dijk over de uitvoering van de motie-Sjoerdsma c.s. ten aanzien van erkenning en schadevergoeding voor Indische slachtoffers van Nederlandse

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister why the promised local disclosure of the NIMH victims list and claims handling for Indonesian victims of Dutch abuses has not yet happened two years after the Sjoerdsma motion. The minister answers that privacy assessments under the GDPR are slow, that a foundation has been funded to promote the scheme locally, and that the list is expected to be shared this autumn.
It is expected that the data overview can be shared with the Indonesian foundation this autumn.
Naar verwachting kan het gegevensoverzicht dit najaar worden gedeeld met de Indonesische stichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Burg over het bericht ‘Gaza krijgt voedsel uit de lucht’

Van der Burg (VVD) asked the Foreign Minister whether the EU should press Israel to admit far more aid into Gaza, and what Dutch and EU steps follow, including the Dutch role in airdrops of food. Minister Veldkamp answered that the government backs suspending trade parts of the EU-Israel Association Agreement, joins a multinational airdrop operation from 8 August, and keeps pressing for ground access, while stating that airdrops cannot replace land aid and that Nederland does not work with the GHF.
At EU level the Netherlands is working for suspension of the trade part of the Association Agreement with Israel.
Op EU-niveau zet Nederland zich in voor opschorting van het handelsdeel van het Associatieakkoord met Israël
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Burg over kabinet wil extra maatregelen tegen Israël en roept ambassadeur op matje

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Dutch government plans for additional measures against Israel, the ambassador summons, humanitarian access in Gaza, Hamas's role, and EU-US coordination. The minister answered at length, reaffirming the goal of a ceasefire and hostage release, pointing to Hamas responsibility, outlining an EU review of Israel's compliance with the Association Agreement, and declining to share the Commission's list of potential measures.
Sharing parts of it would undermine trust in the Netherlands and thereby Dutch diplomatic leverage.
Delen daarvan zou het vertrouwen in Nederland en daarmee de Nederlandse diplomatieke slagkracht ondermijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijk en Van der Burg over het bericht ‘Remco S. loopt nog altijd vrij rond in India na de moord op José

Two MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that a suspect in the murder of a Dutch woman remains free in India, and about extradition, diplomatic contact, victim information and compensation. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, stated that India has primary jurisdiction and extradition depends on facts and procedures, said Nederland's influence over foreign procedures is very limited, and noted victims of crimes abroad are not eligible for Schadefonds compensation, though the law may be revised.
On individual criminal cases, contact about them with a foreign authority, and how a foreign authority acts, I cannot provide information.
Over individuele strafzaken, het contact daarover met een buitenlandse autoriteit en de wijze waarop door een buitenlandse autoriteit wordt gehandeld, kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Diederik van Dijk, Eerdmans, Van der Burg en Ceder over de brief van omstreden VN-rapporteur Albanese aan Christenen voor Israël

MPs from SGP, JA21, VVD and ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about a letter from UN Special Rapporteur Albanese to Christians for Israel, its mandate limits, and threats of criminal consequences. The minister answered that communicating with non-state actors falls within the mandate, that the government disagrees with her content, that vandalism and intimidation are condemned, and that the mandate is adequately defined and the letter was confidential practice.
The letter itself has not been made public.
De brief zelf is niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Burg over het bericht ‘Russisch oorlogsschip escorteert olietankers van schaduwvloot door Noordzee.’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that a Russian warship escorted two sanctioned shadow-fleet tankers through the North Sea, why one tanker is sanctioned only by the UK, and what legal and practical options Netherlands has to block such passages and enforce sanctions. The minister answered that Defence does not normally comment on specific incidents, that freedom of navigation applies in the EEZ, that enforcement is possible when sanctioned ships fall under Dutch jurisdiction such as entering a Dutch port, and that a technical briefing on the legal framework is planned for 11 September.
In principle, the cabinet does not make public statements about specific incidents, the related level of knowledge, the methods or the sources of the intelligence services and/or the armed forces.

In principe doet het kabinet over specifieke voorvallen en het daaraan gerelateerde kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van de inlichtingendiensten en/of de Krijgsmacht in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Van der Burg over de reportage ‘Voelbare kunst, hoorbare grafieken en dobbelstenen met braille op een bijeenkomst in Amsterdam over visueel beperkten’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how accessible museums and the cultural sector are for people with visual impairments, following a newspaper report on a conference about tactile reading methods. The minister acknowledged the report, agreed culture should be accessible to all, described existing museum initiatives and subsidies, and said a subsidy scheme and a knowledge point on accessible culture are being developed, without a count of museums with tactile art.
The exact number of museums that already offer tactile art and other initiatives to make museums more accessible for people with disabilities is not known.
Het exacte aantal musea waarin al sprake is van voelbare kunst en andere initiatieven om musea toegankelijker te maken voor mensen met een beperking is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Boswijk, Van der Lee, Van der Burg en Dassen over Chinese spionage via diplomatieke posten

MPs from several parties asked whether US concerns about Chinese espionage linked to the large Chinese embassy in London also affect the Netherlands, including via financial infrastructure, internet hubs and diplomatic expansion, and whether the EU should adopt joint risk-analysis guidelines for diplomatic buildings. The government answered that it shares the concerns, points to existing measures such as DORA, the Wbni and the forthcoming Cbw, says no Chinese embassy expansion request is pending in the Netherlands and no increase in Chinese diplomats has occurred, and states it will raise China-related issues within the EU.
The cabinet makes no public statements about the investigations or working methods of the services.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de onderzoeken of werkwijze van de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van der Burg over ‘anti-emancipatoire beïnvloeding’

MPs Becker and Van der Burg asked about foreign lobby and funding aimed at influencing Dutch public and political debate on anti-emancipatory themes, including US, Russian and Islamic-linked funding, and what the government will do. The government answered that lobbying is legitimate but that incitement and discrimination are not, pointed to the Nationale Extremismestrategie, said it has no legal basis to map funding flows from most countries, noted the pending Wtmo law as a possible tool, and said it is willing to raise the issue in the EU.
The ministries have no legal basis for processing personal data in addressing problematic conduct and unwanted foreign financing.
De ministeries hebben geen juridische grondslag voor het verwerken van persoonsgegevens in het kader van de aanpak van problematisch gedrag en ongewenste buitenlandse financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Burg over hulpverlening aan Nederlanders die vastzitten in Israël

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Dutch nationals stranded in Israel after airspace closed, including how many there are, what help is provided, and when they can return. The minister answered that about 200 stranded persons registered, over 100 were repatriated by bus to Egypt and charter flight, and a second organised departure was planned.
A second departure organised by the ministry is therefore planned later this week so that the remaining repatriates who have registered can leave Israel.
Later deze week wordt daarom een tweede door het ministerie georganiseerde uitreis gepland waarmee de overige repatrianten die zich hebben aangemeld
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Dassen, Van der Burg, Paternotte en Piri over het bericht dat Nederland de Russische oorlogskas spekt en mogelijk spionnen binnenlaat

MPs asked the government whether it would press the EU for a full ban on Russian LNG and condensate imports, and act against vessels with Russian crews or ties that may carry Russian intelligence officers into Dutch ports. The minister answered that the EU lacks unanimity for an import ban, that the Commission's RePowerEU roadmap phases out Russian LNG by end-2027, that a national ban is opposed, and that Russian-flagged ships are already barred while sanctioned ships are refused and inspected, but declined to comment on intelligence use of crews.
The cabinet cannot make statements on whether Russia uses the crews of LNG and condensate tankers as cover for Russian intelligence officers.
Het kabinet kan geen uitspraken doen over of Rusland gebruik maakt van bemanning van LNG- en aardgascondensaattankers als dekmantel voor Russische inlichtingenofficieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Paternotte en Van der Burg over een Nederlands monument ter nagedachtenis aan de Holodomor

MPs asked whether the government would support a Dutch memorial to the Holodomor and attend the annual commemoration, citing Russian denial and the Kremlin's historical revisionism. The minister answered that Russian historical revisionism is opposed where it arises in international fora, that a memorial is not a core task of the ministry and would more likely be an initiative of the Ukrainian community via municipal decision, and that the ambassador in Kyiv represents the Netherlands at the commemoration.
Realising a memorial is not a core task of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Het realiseren van een monument is geen kerntaak van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg, Van Campen en Boswijk over het gevaar van Russische inmenging bij de aanstaande verkiezingen in Moldavië

MPs Van der Burg, Van Campen and Boswijk asked the Foreign Minister about Russian interference risks ahead of Moldova's September 2025 elections, including support measures, EU/NATO security cooperation, observation missions and sanctions. The minister answered that Russia's gas cut-off and broader interference are being countered through cyber, anti-corruption and media resilience aid, bilateral security cooperation and EU sanctions, and committed to keep Parliament informed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Burg over het bericht “AIVD beschuldigt Iran van liquidatiepogingen Haarlem en Madrid”

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the AIVD's attribution of two attempted assassinations in the Netherlands and Spain to Iran, and about the reception of the Iranian foreign minister, protection of the diaspora, and the ambassador summons. The minister called the findings very worrying, said intelligence matters are not discussed publicly, referred protection to the NCTV-coordinated approach, and said the consequences were shared confidentially.
Your question concerns the knowledge level and functioning of the intelligence and security services. No public statements are made about that.
Uw vraag betreft het kennisniveau en het functioneren van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten. Daarover worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Becker over het bericht ‘Hoe Nederlands geld naar radicale kolonisten gaat. De Palestijnen hebben geen macht’

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch donations via the foundation Christenen voor Israël reach radical settlers in the West Bank, and what the government will do about it, including whether the foundation's ANBI tax status and the settlement discouragement policy apply. The minister answered that the government does not supervise financing flows abroad and cannot confirm the claims, that investigation of possible criminal offences is for the Public Prosecution Service, and that the Tax Administration is bound by confidentiality on individual ANBI cases, while restating the policy that contributions to settlements are undesirable.
The cabinet does not have the necessary information to confirm this claim.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over de benodigde informatie om deze bewering te bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Paternotte over het overleg tussen de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken met de Indiase Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken

MPs Van der Burg and Paternotte asked whether the Foreign Minister's social media post about the meeting with India's foreign minister omitted discussion of critical minerals cooperation, and how India could help limit Chinese influence on critical raw material supply chains. The minister answered that the post was only a fragment, that cooperation on economic security and diversifying dependencies was discussed, that details are confidential, and that the topic will continue to be raised with India.
The confidential nature of such conversations does not sit well with full public disclosure.
Het vertrouwelijke karakter van dergelijke gesprekken verdraagt zich niet goed met een volledige publieke weergave.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Burg over de arrestatie van burgemeester van Istanbul Imamoglu

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether the arrest of Istanbul mayor Imamoglu, a rival of President Erdogan, and the related diploma revocation and protest restrictions are unlawful, politically motivated and restrictions on free speech, and what the Netherlands will do bilaterally and in the EU. The minister expresses serious concern, conveys it to Turkish officials, notes the EU postponed thematic consultations, and points to MATRA rule-of-law support, without committing to specific new measures.
I have serious concerns about the arrest of mayor İmamoğlu and others, including mayors of Istanbul district municipalities and journalists.
Ik heb grote zorgen over de arrestatie van burgemeester İmamoğlu en anderen, waaronder burgemeesters uit deelgemeenten van Istanbul en journalisten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Boswijk, Van der Burg en Van der Lee over de geheime deportatie van 48 Oeigoeren naar China door de regering van Thailand

MPs from D66, CDA, VVD and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Foreign Minister about the reported secret deportation of Uyghurs from Thailand to China and what the Dutch government had done to prevent it. The minister confirmed the deportation, said Thailand breached non-refoulement, described diplomatic outreach to Thai and Chinese authorities and EU and UN statements, and said the Dutch embassy in Beijing would monitor the situation.

From the Dutch embassy in Bangkok, the Dutch Permanent Representation to the UN in Geneva and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in The Hague, active outreach was made to the Thai authorities up to the day of deportation.

Vanuit de Nederlandse ambassade in Bangkok, de Nederlandse Permanente Vertegenwoordiging bij de VN in Genève en vanuit het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken in Den Haag is actief outreach gedaan naar de Thaise autoriteiten tot op de dag van uitzetting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Ceder, Van der Burg, Kahraman, Vermeer, Boswijk en Eerdmans over christenvervolging in de Democratische Republiek Congo

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the killing of 70 people in a church in the DR Congo, the role of the Special Envoy for Religion, EU terrorist listing of the ADF, foreign support for the ADF, and UN action. The minister condemned the attack, said the Envoy's involvement is not currently of added value, agreed to explore listing the ADF, and described Dutch and EU support for peace and UN human rights mechanisms.
I am willing to examine the possibilities of placing this group on the European terrorism sanctions list or the European ISIS/Al-Qaida sanctions list.
Ik ben bereid te onderzoeken wat de mogelijkheden zijn om deze groep op de Europese terrorisme-sanctielijst of de Europese ISIS/Al-Qaida sanctielijst te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Meulenkamp over het bericht ‘Ondanks weren vissersschepen: ‘Nederlandse vishandel spekt Russische oorlogskas’

Two VVD MPs asked whether Dutch fish trade, including transit of Russian whitefish, funds Russia's war economy and why Russian fish is not under EU sanctions. The government answered that Russian fish is a small share of Russian exports, that EU sanctions exclude food for food-security reasons, that the government supports exploring an EU import ban on Russian whitefish, and that consumers cannot reliably tell whether fish is Russian-caught.
The central government does not have hard figures on the value or earnings for Russia of Russian-origin whitefish transshipped in Dutch ports in transit by trading parties in the global food chain.

Over de waarde en/of de verdiensten van Rusland van uit Rusland afkomstige witvis die in Nederlandse havens «in transit» wordt overgeslagen door handelspartijen in de wereldvoedselketen beschikt de Rijksoverheid niet over harde cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van den Burg, Teunissen, Ceder, Boswijk, Van der Lee en Kahraman over de acuut dreigende uitzetting van Oeigoeren in Thailand

Seven MPs asked the ministers about the imminent deportation of 48 Uyghurs held in Thailand to China and what the Netherlands was doing to prevent it. The Foreign Minister answered that the Netherlands has urged Thailand, bilaterally and within the EU, to respect non-refoulement and not deport the group, and is monitoring third-country resettlement options.
The Netherlands has made the urgent appeal to the Thai authorities, orally and in writing, both bilaterally and within the EU, not to extradite the 48 Uyghurs.

Nederland heeft op verschillende manieren, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk en zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband de dringende oproep aan de Thaise autoriteiten gedaan om de 48 Oeigoeren niet uit te leveren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Van Campen over het bericht 'Moldavië kondigt noodtoestand af vanwege wegvallen Russisch gas'

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister how she views Moldova's declared state of emergency over the loss of Russian gas, Russia's role, and what the Netherlands can do to support Moldova's energy security and reduce dependence on Russia. The minister answered that Russia's gas cut-off is destabilising, that the Netherlands is considering short-term EU support, and cited past and ongoing Dutch and EU energy and resilience assistance, without committing to new specific measures.
The Netherlands is currently considering, within the EU, how it can provide additional short-term support to Moldova.
Nederland beziet momenteel in EU verband op welke manier het Moldavië extra kan ondersteunen op korte termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van der Burg, Van der Lee en Boswijk over de situatie van Oeigoeren in Thailand

MPs from D66, VVD, GroenLinks-PvdA and CDA asked the Foreign Minister about the detention in Thailand of over 48 Uyghurs fleeing China, and whether Thailand's threatened deportation breaches non-refoulement. The minister replied that the Netherlands urges third countries to respect non-refoulement, raises the case with UNHCR and Thai authorities privately rather than publicly, and answered every question on substance.
For now, the considered approach is not to publicly address UNHCR and to continue regular contacts with UNHCR on this matter.
Vooralsnog is de afweging om UNHCR niet publiekelijk aan te spreken en in te blijven zetten op de regelmatige contacten met UNHCR hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Van der Burg over het bericht ‘China intimideert Nederlandse media en correspondenten’

MPs Martens-America and Van der Burg asked the Ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Foreign Affairs about reports of Chinese intimidation of Dutch media and correspondents, and what the government will do about it. The minister answers that the government will evaluate its intensified foreign interference approach in 2025, supports PersVeilig, raises concerns with Chinese authorities, and will study the China Knowledge Network report's recommendations, without committing to specific new measures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Burg over het bezoek van de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken uit Iran aan Nederland

An MP from the VVD asks the Foreign Minister why he met the Iranian Foreign Minister in the Netherlands, whether Iran was confronted on repression, its regional role, support for Russia and nuclear ambitions, and what concrete outcomes resulted. The minister defends the meeting as necessary diplomacy for regional de-escalation and says the government's concerns on these issues are consistent, but declines to give details of the conversation or outcomes, citing diplomatic effectiveness.
However, for the sake of the effectiveness of the Netherlands' diplomatic efforts, no details can be given about the conversation itself.
Omwille van de effectiviteit van de Nederlandse diplomatieke inzet kunnen echter geen details worden gegeven over het gesprek zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Burg over het bericht 'Tankervloot die Iran miljarden opleverde via Suriname beheerd'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that a Dutch-based law firm helped Iran's oil industry evade US sanctions, asking about Dutch/EU sanctions breaches, measures against shadow fleets, and cooperation with the US and Suriname. The minister answered that it is not Nederland's role to enforce US sanctions, that suspected breaches of Dutch/EU sanctions are investigated without commenting on individual cases, and that the Netherlands cooperates closely with the US on sanctions.
When there are signals of possible sanctions violations, investigation is always carried out and further (criminal) follow-up is given where necessary.
Bij signalen van mogelijke overtreding van sancties wordt altijd onderzoek gedaan en hier wordt waar nodig verdere (strafrechtelijke) opvolging aan gegeven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Paternotte en Van der Burg over het bericht dat Nederlandse landbouwbedrijven die subsidie ontvangen om Oekraïne te helpen met de wederopbouw tegelijkertijd zakendoenin Rusland

MPs Boswijk, Paternotte and Van der Burg asked whether Dutch farm firms receiving Ukraine reconstruction subsidies also trade with Russia, and whether RVO checks this and should exclude such firms. The government says it does not comment on individual firms, that unsanctioned trade with Russia is not currently grounds for exclusion, and that it is studying adding such an exclusion to the Ukraine Partnership Facility subsidy scheme and considering further EU sanctions on agricultural goods.
In addition, the cabinet is examining whether unsanctioned trade with Russia can be added as a ground for exclusion from the subsidy scheme for the Ukraine Partnership Facility (UPF).
Daarnaast onderzoekt het kabinet of ongesanctioneerde handel met Rusland als uitsluitingsgrond toegevoegd kan worden aan de subsidieregeling voor de Ukraine Partnership Facility (UPF)

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Brug en Van Campen over bericht ‘Georgië neemt omstreden wet aan tegen lhbtqia+-rechten’ en het bericht ‘Beroemde trans vrouw vermoord in Georgië na invoering wet tegen lhbtqia+-re

MPs Van der Burg and Van Campen asked the Foreign Minister about Georgia's new anti-LGBTQ+ law and the reported murder of a trans woman after its adoption. The minister condemned the law as undermining fundamental rights and EU values, said EU accession has effectively stalled, and said the government would await the murder investigation and keep pressing Georgian authorities.
Regarding the horrific murder of Kesaria Abramidze, the cabinet is awaiting the investigation into it.
Met betrekking tot de gruwelijke moord op Kesaria Abramidze wacht het kabinet het onderzoek hiernaar af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Kamminga over het bericht ‘Russen maken microchips met oude ASML-machines voor wapens’

MPs Van der Burg and Kamminga asked the ministers whether Russia is obtaining ASML spare parts and machines despite sanctions and what can be done about intermediaries. The government said it cannot confirm the reported shipment numbers or the number of machines in Russia, cites confidentiality, and says it works with the EU sanctions envoy and other partners to counter circumvention, while acknowledging that listing intermediaries takes time.
The cabinet cannot provide insight into the number and type of ASML machines in Russia.
Het kabinet kan geen inzicht geven in het aantal en het soort ASML-machines in Rusland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Van der Burg over het bericht "Doodsbedreigingen en anonieme berichten: hoe Chinese studenten in Nederland worden geïntimideerd"

Two VVD MPs asked the Education minister and Foreign Affairs minister about reports that Chinese students in the Netherlands are threatened and intimidated, and what is being done. The minister agreed such intimidation is unacceptable, pointed to a broad approach against unwanted foreign interference, university responsibility for safety, a raised issue with the Chinese embassy, and ongoing work on academic freedom and self-censorship.
The cabinet considers every form of unwanted foreign interference completely unacceptable.
Het kabinet vindt elke vorm van ongewenste buitenlandse inmenging volstrekt onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Kamminga over vrouwenrechten in Afghanistan

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about Taliban restrictions on women's rights in Afghanistan, EU and UN engagement, sanctions and visas for Taliban members, and whether aid can be misused. The minister answered that the Netherlands condemns the restrictions, co-holds Afghanistan liable under CEDAW, keeps conditional aid and monitoring, and sees no case for a full aid stop.

The Netherlands, bilaterally and within the EU, strongly condemned this law and called on the Taliban to respect human rights and especially women's and girls' rights in line with international treaty obligations.

Nederland heeft bilateraal en in EU verband deze wet ten sterkste veroordeeld en de Taliban opgeroepen mensenrechten en vrouwen- en meisjesrechten in het bijzonder in lijn met internationale verdragsverplichtingen te respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van der Burg, Boswijk, Dobbe, Teunissen en Dassen over het bericht “Rusland zet onafhankelijke krant The Moscow Times op zwarte lijst”

MPs from several parties asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Asylum and Migration about Russia placing the independent Moscow Times on a blacklist and the risks to Russian journalists working for it. The minister confirmed awareness of the report and said that emergency visas are possible in exceptional cases within existing policy frameworks, reaffirming support for press freedom.
This entails that within existing policy frameworks, and carefully tested against the Visa Code, visas can in exceptional cases be issued where there are compelling or humanitarian reasons.

Daar hoort bij dat binnen de bestaande beleidskaders, en daarbij zorgvuldig getoetst aan de Visumcode, het in uitzonderlijke gevallen mogelijk is visa te verstrekken als daar zwaarwegende of humanitaire redenen voor zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van der Burg en Van der Lee over het proces tegen Jimmy Lai, hoofdredacteur van de voorheen grootste vrije krant in Hongkong

MPs Paternotte, Van der Burg and Van der Lee asked the Foreign Minister about delays in the trial of Jimmy Lai, the erosion of rights in Hong Kong under the 1984 Sino-British Declaration and the ICCPR, and whether the Netherlands would join calls for his release, the Council of the EU agenda, and the matter being raised. The minister answered that Netherlands shares concern and speaks out with the EU and like-minded states, attends the trials, but will not issue a separate statement or put the case on the Foreign Affairs Council agenda for now.
At this moment I therefore do not intend to put this case on the agenda of the Foreign Affairs Council.
Op dit moment ben ik daarom niet van plan deze zaak op de agenda van de Raad Buitenlandse Zaken te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brekelmans over het landenbeleid Ethiopië

An MP asked the State Secretary about asylum policy for Ethiopia, including whether Fano members accused of human rights abuses can be excluded under Article 1F of the Refugee Convention and whether Dutch companies harmed by Fano-linked crimes warrant policy changes. The Minister explained the 1F framework and IND procedures, said the ministry sees no need to change country policy now, but will ask about crimes against Dutch companies in the next Terms of Reference.

However, in the next Terms of Reference that form the basis for a new general country report on Ethiopia, I will ask questions about signals of crimes against Dutch companies in Fano-controlled parts of Ethiopia.

Wel zal ik in de eerstvolgende Terms of Reference die de basis vormen voor een nieuw algemeen ambtsbericht inzake Ethiopië vragen stellen ten aanzien van signalen van misdrijven tegen Nederlandse bedrijven in Fano-gecontroleerde delen van Ethiopië.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Kamminga en Van der Burg over het bericht 'Burkina Faso volgende Afrikaanse land dat homoseksualiteit strafbaar wil maken'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that Burkina Faso plans to criminalise homosexuality and what the Netherlands is doing in response, including aid, contacts with the regime and Sahel policy. The ministers answered at length, saying the legal consequences are still unclear, that the embassy raised the issue and supports civil society indirectly, and that public statements are currently judged counterproductive, while committing to raise the issue at EU-AU level.
The cabinet will work to achieve this.
Het kabinet zal zich daarvoor inzetten.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over opvang en werk voor asielzoekers en statushouders die nog in een asielzoekerscentrum (azc) verblijven

An MP asked about barriers to employing asylum seekers and status holders still in reception centres, including the 24-week rule, relocations, permit timing and commuting. The government answered that the Raad van State ruling removed the 24-week rule, that permit processing delays were largely resolved, and that it is pursuing pilots, a support structure, and a subsidy scheme, while declining to commit to a two-week transition period for relocations.
It is not desirable to introduce a transition period of at least two weeks, because a bed may then have to be reserved for too long.
Het is niet wenselijk om een overgangsperiode van minimaal twee weken in te voeren, omdat een bed dan mogelijk te lang moet worden gereserveerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Boswijk over de dreigende sluiting van het Walaardt Sacré Kamp in Huis ter Heide

MPs Piri and Boswijk asked whether the Walaardt Sacré Kamp asylum reception site in Huis ter Heide would close, where Afghan refugees and family members were housed, and about alternative housing, medical care and schooling. The minister answered that the site is being returned to Defence from September 2024, that residents were moved to other locations, and that Defence has repeatedly weighed extensions but needs the site for its own growing organisation.
Defence needs the barracks for its own growing organisation.
Defensie heeft de kazerne nodig voor de eigen groeiende organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Nispen over fraude met hotelkamers voor asielopvang

An MP asked about alleged fraud and corruption involving a commercial intermediary (LCHD) that billed COA for hotel rooms for asylum reception, including Van der Valk hotels, and why no tender was held. The minister confirmed an OM/FIOD criminal investigation, defended the reliance on hotels and private intermediaries amid the reception crisis, said no tender was needed for leasing existing property, and promised an October letter on emergency reception costs.
I can confirm that the Public Prosecution Service and the FIOD are conducting a criminal investigation. Pending that, I will make no further statements on this matter.
Ik kan u bevestigen dat het OM en FIOD een strafrechtelijk onderzoek uitvoeren. Vooruitlopend daarop zal ik geen verdere uitspraken doen over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de zorgelijke mensenrechtensituatie in Tunesië

Piri (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the government about the deteriorating human rights situation in Tunisia, including arrests of lawyers, NGO workers and journalists, and about Dutch and EU funding and oversight. Minister Veldkamp answered that concerns were raised at senior official level, that trial monitoring and rights support continue, and that the EU Ombudsman inquiry into the EU-Tunisia MoU is ongoing, while giving limited detail on programmes and funding.
Given the confidential nature of these activities, the cabinet cannot go into further detail on this.
In verband met het vertrouwelijke karakter van deze activiteiten kan het kabinet hier niet verder op in gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over het inburgeringsexamen in het buitenland

An MP asks the State Secretary about the pre-departure civic integration exam abroad, including its effectiveness, its compatibility with international anti-discrimination treaties, and plans if courts rule against it. The government reports exam volumes, evaluation findings, that it appealed the Haarlem court ruling to the Council of State, and that it will decide on consequences only after that ruling.
I do not want to anticipate the ruling of the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op de uitspraak van de Afdeling Bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek en Teunissen over het gebruik van dwangmiddelen bij begeleide terugkeer

MPs Koekkoek and Teunissen asked about the use of restraints (body cuffs, tie wraps) and force during forced returns, including a May 2024 Dublin transfer to Bulgaria, medical incidents, oversight and whether an independent inquiry is needed. The minister answered that restraints were justified by a prior risk assessment, that oversight by the Public Prosecution Service and the Inspectorate exists, and that no independent investigation is warranted.
The Public Prosecution Service supervises the use of restraint aids for removal and the use of force.
Het Openbaar Ministerie houdt toezicht op de inzet van hulpmiddelen ten behoeve van uitzetting en op het gebruik van geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het NOS artikel 'Vluchtelingen moeten vijf weken weg vanwege studentenfeest, mogen daarna weer terug'

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the forced relocation of 120 asylum seekers from the Octoberhal in Leiden for a student party was considered, and whether their vulnerability and mental health were weighed. The minister answered that the location was a temporary emergency shelter, the municipality required it for student activities, no alternative site was available, and the residents were moved to other COA locations.
Naturally, alternative locations for the student associations were discussed, but in the various talks with the municipality this proved not feasible.
Vanzelfsprekend is gesproken over eventuele alternatieve locaties voor de studentenverenigingen, maar dat is in de verschillende gesprekken met de gemeente niet haalbaar gebleken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het Lighthouse Reports rapport “Desert Dumps”

An MP asked the State Secretary whether EU and Dutch funding or operational involvement contributed to abuses of migrants dumped in the desert, as reported by Lighthouse Reports, and what steps would prevent recurrence. The government answered that the Commission and EEAS found no evidence of direct or indirect EU support, that the Netherlands has no indication of its funds contributing to abuses, and that it will press for monitoring and do-no-harm standards, while saying the Commission had not yet answered the Parliament's request for a review.
The Netherlands has asked the European Commission for clarification.
Nederland heeft bij de Europese Commissie om opheldering gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘De kapper pochte in de salon dat hij de IND had bedonderd met een schijnhuwelijk, maar de immigratiedienst trof geen maatregelen’

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that the IND was given information about a suspected sham marriage but took no action, and how fraud signals are reported and investigated. The State Secretary said the IND investigated an integrity report internally and via the Integriteitscommissie, that new information led to a follow-up investigation, and that an independent investigation has been commissioned, though he would not anticipate its findings.
An independent investigation is being carried out under the commissioning of the acting Secretary-General of the Ministry of Justice and Security.
Er wordt een onafhankelijk onderzoek uitgevoerd onder opdrachtgeverschap van de waarnemend secretaris-generaal van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de uitvoering van de Spreidingwet

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the implementation of the Dispersal Act: full funding of municipal support, clarity on funds and quality frameworks for municipal exploitation of reception, COA realisation timelines, use of Rijksvastgoed buildings, provincial and ministerial intervention powers, and funding timing for newcomer education. The State Secretary answered that funding arrangements follow the Intergovernmental Relations Code, that a quality framework is ready with a handbook to follow, that realisation of reception takes weeks to three years, that the ministry will escalate interventions via a stepwise ladder ending in replacement of municipalities, and that education funding is being changed to start from first enrolment.

The steps in interadministrative supervision for neglect of duties are signalling, requesting and validating information, active supervision, pre-announcement of legal intervention, a decision on replacement, and execution ("escalation ladder").

De stappen in het interbestuurlijk toezicht bij taakverwaarlozing zijn signaleren, informatie opvragen en valideren, actief toezicht, vooraankondiging juridische interventie, besluit tot indeplaatsstelling en uitvoeren («escalatieladder»).
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht 'Van der Burg: 1500 asielplekken minder sinds hoofdlijnenakkoord'

MP Podt (D66) asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the coalition's plan to repeal the dispersal law is already causing 1,500 fewer asylum places, and what can be done to keep reception capacity available. The State Secretary says some municipalities are withdrawing or freezing commitments while many remain willing, that he cannot guarantee no asylum seekers will sleep outside this summer, and points to short-term reception plans.
Answer 9: No, unfortunately I cannot guarantee that.
Antwoord 9 Nee, dat kan ik helaas niet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Dijk over signalen dat een grote groep mensen ten onrechte een brief heeft ontvangen van de IND waarin wordt aangegeven dat zij geen rechtmatig verblijf zouden hebben in Nede

MPs Van Nispen and Dijk asked why Dienst Toeslagen sent letters stopping allowances based on IND residence codes, causing distress and wrongful loss of benefits for some EU citizens, and asked about compensation, legal aid and prevention. The government admits a system design error, says about 800 letters were sent with 180 later reinstated, and defends the approach while promising to reinstate and not claw back benefits where residence is confirmed.
The cabinet finds it highly undesirable that persons who are not lawfully residing in the Netherlands and therefore have no entitlement to allowances receive them.
Het kabinet vindt het zeer onwenselijk dat personen niet rechtmatig in Nederland verblijven en dus geen recht hebben op toeslagen deze ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de behandeling van asielverzoeken van Palestijnse asielzoekers

An MP asked the State Secretary why processing of asylum applications from Palestinian asylum seekers had not started after the Council of State lifted the decision moratorium, and whether the return moratorium would be ended. The State Secretary confirmed processing had not started in general, said the Gaza situation justified recognising refugee status and treating Gaza-based applicants as facing generic danger, and said the return moratorium was to be ended because sufficient information now existed.
I agree that a ruling of the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State must be implemented as quickly and correctly as possible.
Ik ben het er mee eens dat een uitspraak van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State zo spoedig en correct mogelijk moet worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de problemen voor nareizigers bij de IND in Zevenaar

The MP asks about long waiting times at the IND in Zevenaar for family reunification migrants, whether they can be registered, housed by COA and obtain a citizen service number, and what action is taken. The state secretary denies that they lack registration, COA shelter or social security cover, states the backlog has been cleared, rejects giving municipalities power to issue citizen service numbers before IND registration, and describes capacity and efficiency measures.
Municipalities must be certain that the person they register has lawful residence and must also know who they are registering.
Gemeenten moeten zeker weten dat de persoon die zij inschrijven rechtmatig verblijf heeft en dienen ook te weten wie zij inschrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldkamp, Olger van Dijk en Van Hijum over de toegenomen onveiligheid op de treindienst Zwolle-Emmen

Three NSC MPs asked why incidents of fare evasion and violence against rail staff on the Zwolle-Emmen line rose in early 2024, and what measures, cameras, travel bans and COA-related steps are being taken. The government answered that the rise largely reflects more systematic checks by the service team, that Arriva is reinstating two stewards per train, that camera discussions will continue, and that a national travel ban was ruled out on proportionality grounds while operators explore faster temporary bans.
No figures are available on the nationalities of the persons causing the incidents.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over de nationaliteiten van de personen die de incidenten veroorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht dat de IND in de zomer al beschikte over cijfers inzake gestapelde nareis

MP Piri asked the Justice Minister and State Secretary about reports that the IND had preliminary figures on stacked family reunification in summer 2023, probing who knew what and when, and why the August 2023 draft note was only sent to parliament after the European elections. The government largely refers to an attached process sketch, declines to name officials, says the former secretary-general was not informed of the draft, and states the draft was only found to fall within the request scope after the February 2024 request.
Sharing the names of officials and their functions is not compatible with ministerial responsibility.
Het delen van namen van ambtenaren en functies van ambtenaren past niet bij de ministeriële verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldkamp over het artikel 'IND hield lage ‘nareis op nareis’-cijfers maandenlang achter'

Veldkamp (NSC) asks whether the IND withheld low 'nareis op nareis' figures for months and whether a draft memo on the matter reached the Minister or State Secretary of Justice and Security between July and October 2023. The government answers that the draft note did not reach either of them, based on the process sketch, and confirms the earlier letter.
Based on the information presented in the process sketch, we conclude that this is not the case.
Op basis van de in de processchets weergeven informatie komen wij tot de conclusie dat dat niet het geval is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘Nieuw beeld van daders seksuele uitbuiting: bijna 90 procent heeft migratieachtergrond en ze vallen na straf terug in oud gedrag’

MPs Tielen and Brekelmans asked about a report on perpetrators of sexual exploitation (predominantly with migration background, reoffending after sentence), including attention to people with mild intellectual disability, the effects of the LVB policy study, attachment problems in youth care, and further research. The state secretary points to the LVB-proof criminal justice agenda, existing youth care guidelines, planned research and the forthcoming reinforced anti-trafficking action plan, without committing to a new specific measure.
Your House was informed by letter of 23 April about, among other things, the recent research of the National Rapporteur
Uw Kamer is per brief van 23 april jl. geïnformeerd over onder meer het recentelijk onderzoek van de Nationaal Rapporteur
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Veldkamp over het informatieverzoek inzake de coördinator nationale aanpak overlast

MPs Podt and Veldkamp asked why the ministry bypassed tendering for Snel Beveiliging Nodig's mobile supervision teams, why the Chamber was not informed, and about the coordinator's project plan, budget and evaluations. The government admits tendering was skipped due to urgent need, says the Chamber was informed later, and defends the pilot evaluation and monitoring arrangements.
The Chamber was not informed promptly about deviating from the tendering rules, because it is customary to inform the Chamber of this in the financial accountability.
Over het afwijken van de aanbestedingsregels is uw Kamer niet terstond geïnformeerd, omdat het gebruikelijk is uw Kamer daarover te informeren bij de financiële verantwoording.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paternotte over de berichten 'EU biedt Egypte miljardensteun om stabiliteit in de regio te waarborgen' en 'Egypte ontvangt 7,4 mrd van EU voor bestrijden-migratie’

Two D66 MPs asked about the EU's EUR 7.4 billion package for Egypt, including whether the spending was approved before parliamentary consent, concerns about migration routes and detention, legal migration options, and human rights and civil society space. The government answered that the EU's urgent procedure bypasses the European Parliament for EUR 1 billion, that the rest follows the regular procedure, and that human rights conditions will be monitored, while the Commission holds the disbursement decision and member states have no formal role.
Authority to disburse tranches lies with the Commission. Member states have no formal role in this process.
Bevoegdheid tot uitbetaling van tranches ligt bij de Commissie. Er is voor lidstaten geen formele rol weggelegd in dit proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over de kamerbrief Uitplaatsing vreemdelingen naar hotels van 1 maart 2024

An MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the 1 March 2024 letter on placing migrants in hotels, which asks mayors for consent, was shaped by the Spreidingswet, why statushouders were placed in a Castricum hotel without consent, and how that policy was adopted and communicated. The State Secretary confirms the mayor-consent approach was chosen for speed, that statushouders can be placed without consent while asylum seekers need it, that no compensation is given to local businesses, and that the measures were previously communicated to parliament and municipalities.

Given the acute need for additional reception places at the time the parliamentary letter was sent on 1 March, it was chosen to place asylum seekers only with the consent of the mayor in order to act quickly.

Gelet op de acute noodzaak voor aanvullende opvangplekken ten tijde van het versturen van de Kamerbrief op 1 maart jl. is gekozen om asielzoekers enkel te plaatsen met instemming van het bestuursorgaan burgemeester om zo snelheid te betrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Koekkoek over het bericht ‘Rechtbanken wijzen voorlopige voorzieningen ‘derdelanders’ toe’

MPs Podt and Koekkoek asked why courts granted interim relief to third-country nationals with Ukrainian temporary protection and how the policy to end that protection was made and implemented. The Secretary of State defended ending the protection, said the status was frozen pending CJEU rulings, and described municipal and private-sector obligations and reception arrangements.
As a result, I have been obliged to again freeze the consequences of ending temporary protection for these third-country nationals until the CJEU answers the preliminary questions.

Als gevolg hiervan ben ik genoodzaakt geweest om opnieuw de gevolgen van de beëindiging van de tijdelijke bescherming voor deze derdelanders te bevriezen tot de beantwoording van de prejudiciële vragen door het HvJEU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek en Teunissen over het rapport 'Death, Despair and Destitution: The Human Costs of the EU’s Migration Policies' van Artsen zonder Grenzen

MPs Koekkoek and Teunissen asked the government to react to a Médecins Sans Frontières report on the human costs of EU migration policy, including externalisation, violence at borders, Libya and Tunisia cooperation, Malta and Italy sea rescue, and legal routes. The State Secretary answered at length, mostly by restating EU and Dutch frameworks, citing monitoring mechanisms, and declining to commit to suspending cooperation or launching new investigations.
On this subject, questions were asked on 21 February by MP Piri (GroenLinks-PvdA). The cabinet refers to the answers to those questions for a comprehensive response on detention centres in Libya.

Over dit onderwerp zijn op 21 februari jl. vragen gesteld door het lid Piri (GroenLinks-PvdA). Graag verwijst het kabinet naar de beantwoording op deze vragen voor een uitgebreide reactie over detentiecentra in Libië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en White over het bericht dat honderd oudere Surinamers een verblijfsstatus aanvragen

MPs Piri and White asked the Interior and Justice ministers about reports that about a hundred elderly former Dutch-Surinamese residents were applying for residence status, and about a possible scheme for this group. The state secretary said a targeted one-off scheme was examined but not developed, that the caretaker cabinet would leave new policy to its successor, and that individual cases cannot be discussed.
Given the caretaker status of the current Cabinet, I am of the view that it is no longer for me to develop policy.
Gelet op de demissionaire status van het huidige Kabinet ben ik van oordeel dat het niet meer aan mij is beleid te ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht 'Ruimere asielmogelijkheden voor Eritreeërs metciviele dienstplicht'

An MP from BBB asks the State Secretary of Justice and Security about reports that Eritreans facing civil conscription may now obtain asylum, questioning the temporary permits, the rationale for the policy change, reception capacity and dispersal. The State Secretary confirms the reports, explains that temporary permits follow from the Aliens Act, and defends the policy change as a reflection of country information and European and human rights law, while declining to forecast future numbers or record refusal motivations.
The reasoning for rejecting an asylum application is not recorded, so no answer can be given to this question.
De motivering van het afwijzen van een asielaanvraag wordt niet geregistreerd hierdoor kan er geen antwoord worden gegeven op deze vraag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Brekelmans en Michon-Derkzen over de rellen in Den Haag tussen groepen Eritreers

MPs Becker, Brekelmans and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked the Justice Minister about violent clashes in The Hague between Eritrean groups, the handling of perpetrators, residence-permit consequences, and foreign interference by the Eritrean regime. The minister answered that the matter is under criminal investigation, outlined existing legal grounds for revoking permits, and said the government has taken diplomatic steps and is developing a complaints point for victims of foreign interference.
Since this is still an ongoing investigation, no further substantive information can be provided.
Nu het nog een lopend onderzoek betreft kunnen geen nadere inhoudelijke mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Veldkamp over gewelddadigheden binnen de Eritrese gemeenschap in Nederland

MPs Kahraman and Veldkamp asked the Justice Minister about violence within the Eritrean community in the Netherlands, including whether the government knows the groups involved, whether they are linked to the Eritrean regime, whether violent organisations can be banned, and whether involvement should affect residence status. The minister answered that investigations are ongoing and details of suspects and group membership cannot be disclosed, that the government has no signals of regime direction, that the Public Prosecution Service could petition for a ban under civil law, and that existing residence rules are already strict.
I cannot make substantive statements about an ongoing criminal investigation.
Ik kan geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doen over een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht ‘IND handelt in hoger tempo asielaanvragen af, maar de wachttijd blijft oplopen’

MP Piri asks why the IND cannot keep pace with asylum intake, why no contingency plan for peaks has been adopted despite EY advice from 2021, and how backlogs, staff turnover, sickness absence and hearing dropout will be addressed. The State Secretary answers that intake exceeded IND capacity, lists structural measures and the BAA project, but acknowledges processing times will keep rising in 2024.
No reliable figures can be generated from the IND systems on the percentage of hearings that fall through.
Er zijn geen betrouwbare cijfers uit de systemen van de IND te genereren over het percentage gehoren dat uitvalt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de uitgelekte asielplannen van de formerende partijen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether an 'asylum crisis' could lawfully be declared to allow stricter measures, including suspending reception, and about EU and Dutch law limits, consequences for dispersal, and court risk. The State Secretary answered that emergency derogation under article 111 Vreemdelingenwet is limited to situations like war, that access to the asylum procedure and reception cannot be denied under EU directives, and that legal views have not changed, while declining to speculate on hypothetical outcomes.
This means that foreigners cannot be denied access to the asylum procedure and asylum reception.
Dat betekent dat vreemdelingen niet de toegang tot de asielprocedure en de asielopvang kan worden ontzegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht dat honderd oudere Surinamers een verblijfsstatus aanvragen

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the government would grant legal status to undocumented older Surinamese born before 1975 via the former-Dutch-national route, and how the criteria for such a scheme would work. The State Secretary explained the strict legal conditions for re-admission of former Dutch nationals, said a scheme had been explored with Amsterdam and NGOs but was not pursued after the cabinet fell, and declined to reopen it while the cabinet is caretaker.
Given the caretaker status of the cabinet, I see no possibilities for this.
Gelet op de demissionaire status van het kabinet zie ik hiertoe geen mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht 'Mostafa is ongedocumenteerd, op leeftijd en nergens welkom – behalve in de Pauluskerk in Rotterdam'

An MP asked about homeless elderly people without residence permits, their eligibility for care under the coupling rules, and whether gemeenten should provide care. The government said homelessness monitoring does not capture this group, that medically necessary care is guaranteed under the regeling onverzekerbare vreemdelingen, and that it sees no need for new talks with municipalities.
Existing methods for monitoring the number of homeless people in the Netherlands do not specifically capture the group of homeless elderly people without a residence permit.
Bestaande methoden die het aantal dakloze mensen in Nederland monitoren, brengen niet specifiek de groep dakloze ouderen zonder verblijfsvergunning in beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai over uitbuiting van sekswerkers

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports of agencies recruiting Eastern European sex workers through misleading advertisements, and about trafficking, controls, cross-border measures, a national police trafficking team and the criminal law revision. The government answered that trafficking is punishable, that municipalities oversee the sex industry with police involvement, that tackling intermediaries is hard, that a national coordination point and EU cooperation exist, and that the revised trafficking article is pending with a bill expected this spring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de samenwerking van Frontex met de Libische kustwacht.

An MP asks the government about Frontex sharing migrant boat coordinates with the Libyan coast guard, including links to militias, Libya's unsafe status, EU funding and whether the EU does enough to prevent abuses. The government answers that Frontex must alert the responsible rescue centre, that no formal cooperation with Libya exists, that it finds such coordinate sharing undesirable, and that it will raise human rights and due diligence issues in EU forums.
The cabinet considers it important that Frontex's internal procedures and rules for assessing maritime emergencies it detects through surveillance are examined.
Het kabinet hecht eraan dat gekeken wordt naar de interne procedures en regels bij Frontex aan de hand waarvan het maritieme noodsituaties beoordeelt die het via zijn bewaking detecteert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht over het bij het grofvuil zetten van (gloednieuwe) huisraad van vakantiepark De Lindenberg

An MP asked the State Secretary whether COA discarded usable furniture from a former holiday park and why it was not reused or donated. The State Secretary acknowledged that about one third of the furnishings was sent to waste processing after the Domeinen Roerende Zaken pickup was delayed, and said COA will seek closer local cooperation in future.
COA can imagine that this approach gave a wrong impression to the outside world.
Het COA kan zich voorstellen dat deze aanpak naar buiten toe een verkeerd beeld gaf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht 'Schadevergoeding voor asielzoeker die apart geplaatst werd in overlast-azc'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a court ruling awarding damages to an asylum seeker placed in a separate handhaving- en toezichtlocatie (htl) at an overlast-azc, and whether it undermines the approach to nuisance-causing asylum seekers. The government defended the htl as a permissible measure, said it will appeal the ruling, and gave no commitment to amend legislation until the appeal outcome is known.
After studying the court's judgment, COA has decided to appeal the ruling.
Na bestudering van het oordeel van de rechter heeft het COA besloten in hoger beroep te gaan tegen de uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over maatregelen in het kader van het asiel en migratiebeleid

An FVD MP asked the State Secretary for a list of migration measures the cabinet would favour but cannot implement because of the Refugee Convention, and for a list of the Convention's benefits to the Netherlands. The State Secretary declined both lists, stating the Convention is the cabinet's starting point and pointing to a 2020 review by Donner and Den Heijer on the Convention's limits.
For that reason, there are no such measures outside the Refugee Convention, and no overview of them can be provided.
Om die reden is van maatregelen die niet binnen het Vluchtelingenverdrag geen sprake en kan daarvan geen overzicht worden geboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Samidoun-kopstuk naar Amsterdam: club riep op ’Europa te verslaan met kalasjnikovs, raketten en kogels’’

An SGP MP asked the Justice Minister whether a PFLP-linked Samidoun speaker, reportedly calling to defeat Europe with weapons, could be barred from entry or from operating in Amsterdam, and whether the Samidoun organisation could be banned. The government answered that the IND found insufficient grounds to exclude him under current criteria, that local authorities saw no basis for a area ban, and that a Dutch ban would be a matter for the Public Prosecution Service, not the cabinet.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service, not the cabinet, to decide whether there is cause in this case to make such a request.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie, niet aan het kabinet, om zich uit te spreken over de vraag of er in casu aanleiding bestaat om een dergelijk verzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht: ‘Oekraïners gelokt: vanuit heel Europa komen mensen nu af op gratis woning en zorg.’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security and the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that Ukrainians are arriving from across Europe for free housing and care, asking about arrival numbers, motives, medical care, work rights and long-term planning. The government answered that arrivals are mostly under temporary protection rules, that a monitoring study will be launched, and that it will prepare a uniform co-payment scheme and information on self-employment rules before the summer recess.
In light of these signals, a formal (qualitatively reliable) monitoring study will be launched in the short term at the HUB in Utrecht.
Mede naar aanleiding van deze signalen zal er op korte termijn een formeel (kwalitatief betrouwbaar) monitoringsonderzoek worden opgestart bij de HUB in Utrecht
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Temmink over de lobby-activiteiten van oud-bewindspersonen bij de IND

MPs Marijnissen and Temmink asked about IND lobbying meetings with former ministers Verdonk and Teeven on Indonesian nurse visas, whether procedures changed, the ministry's whistleblower cases, ministers' agenda transparency, and a lobby register. The government answered that the IND's decision was based on rules and not affected by the meetings, that no procedures were changed, and that agenda publication will be improved while a lobby register is deferred pending research.
The cabinet recognises the importance of transparent representation of interests.
Het kabinet onderkent het belang van transparante belangenvertegenwoordiging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de straf- en verblijfsrechtelijke consequenties van misdrijven door asielzoekers

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked how many crimes by asylum seekers in COA locations led to forced return, the type of offences, the revocation of asylum permits on public-order grounds, and the legal limits on such revocation, plus a specific case of repeated sexual assault. The State Secretary answered that departures are not registered by offence, gave return figures (about 1,130 VRIS departures from DT&V's caseload in 2023), said a bill on public-order grounds concerns regular residence permits rather than asylum permits, and declined to comment on individual cases while promising further information on public-order policy.
The data on departures cannot be automatically linked in the system to the number of offences of which foreigners are suspected.
De gegevens over vertrek kunnen in het systeem niet automatisch worden gekoppeld aan het aantal misdrijven waarvan vreemdelingen worden verdacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Hoe een schaduwteam van Yeşilgöz een omstreden asielaanpak doorvoerde’

An SP MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about an NRC report on a 'shadow team' that shaped the asylum approach to nuisance-causing asylum seekers, raising concerns about ethnic profiling, unclear definitions of nuisance, pressure on the Public Prosecution Service, and procurement rules. The Minister denies ethnic profiling is permitted or occurred, says the Public Prosecution Service acts independently, defends the approach as operating within existing law, and declines to publish the internal documents directly, referring to a separate information request response.
By letter of 1 March, the request for information from MP Podt on this matter has been carried out.
Bij brief van 1 maart jl. is er uitvoering gegeven aan het Informatieverzoek van lid Podt hieromtrent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het persbericht ‘Oekraïense school in Breda moet sluiten, onbegrip is groot’

MP Bontenbal (CDA) asked why the Ukrainian school in Breda, a temporary education facility, must close on 14 July 2024, and whether Ukrainian language instruction can be preserved for displaced children. The minister explained the temporary legal exemption expires by statute, that Ukrainian-language education is not a task of publicly funded schooling, and that talks with the school and municipality on alternatives are ongoing.

I understand the importance for Ukrainian children of maintaining their connection to their own language and culture. However, this is not a task of formal publicly funded education, as it is not for other newcomers either.

Ik begrijp het belang voor Oekraïense kinderen om de verbinding te houden met de eigen taal en cultuur. Dit is echter geen taak van het formele bekostigde onderwijs, zoals het dat ook voor andere nieuwkomers niet is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de dreigende sluiting vanhet Walaardt Sacré Kamp in Huis ter Heide

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security and the Minister of Defence why the Walaardt Sacré Kamp refugee reception site in Huis ter Heide is being closed despite a shortage of reception places. The government answered that Defence's support was always temporary, that a parliamentary motion led to a gradual wind-down agreed for July 2024 with the municipality, and that most residents now have refugee status and are awaiting housing.
With this, I am honouring your motion.
Hiermee doe ik uw motie gestand.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden de leden Veldkamp, Kahraman en Van Hijum over de voorgenomen sluiting van het Walaardt Sacré Kamp dat sinds de zomer 2021 fungeert als opvanglocatie voor Afghaanse vluchtelingen

Three NSC MPs asked why the Walaardt Sacré Kamp, a Defence-owned Afghan refugee reception site, is being closed and whether closure will be reconsidered. The government answered that, following a motion, the site will wind down gradually to July 2024 in agreement with COA, the municipality and Defence, and that Defence will keep looking for temporary reception support while the site is needed for its own units.
In agreement with COA and in consultation with the municipality of Zeist, Defence has decided to make the site available for longer.
In overeenstemming met het COA en in samenspraak met de gemeente Zeist heeft Defensie besloten om de locatie langer beschikbaar te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Podt over de tekortkomingen in de geboortezorg voor asielzoekers

MPs Paulusma and Podt asked the government about a study showing higher perinatal loss among pregnant asylum seekers, interpreter use, relocation of pregnant women, and communication problems between care providers. The State Secretary replied that the data are already known and regretted, that existing measures and the care chain working group address them, that access to care is adequately arranged, and that relocation of pregnant women is restricted but not fully avoidable.
Yes. Access to maternity care is also well arranged for asylum seekers in the Netherlands.
Ja. De toegang tot de geboortezorg is ook voor asielzoeksters in Nederland goed geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht 'Nieuwe regels na uitspraak Raad van State: asielzoeker mag meer dan 24 weken werken'

MP Podt asked whether the government will remove other barriers, identified by Regioplan, to asylum seekers entering the labour market beyond the 24-week rule, and asked about BRP registration backlogs, guidance to work, meedoenbalies, VOG and diploma recognition. The minister says the 24-week rule will be removed from regulations, other options are being explored for a next cabinet, BSN waiting times will be cleared by end 2024, and the government is examining support for asylum seekers while avoiding commitments beyond that.
In this amendment the 24-week requirement will no longer be included in the Decree implementing the Foreign Nationals Employment Act 2022 and the ministerial regulation.
Bij deze aanpassing zal de 24-weken-eis niet meer in het Besluit uitvoering Wet arbeid vreemdelingen 2022 en de ministeriële regeling worden opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pool en Markuszower over het nieuws dat het demissionaire kabinet onderzoekt of er asielzoekers kunnen worden opgevangen op locaties van Defensie

PVV MPs asked whether the caretaker cabinet's plans to house asylum seekers on Defence sites should be abandoned, citing security risks, incidents and the military's primary purpose. The Defence Minister answered that such requests are weighed case by case for humanitarian reasons and legal feasibility, that security measures are added after consent, and that incidents are recorded by COA.
For the number of reported incidents, I refer you to the 'COA incident registration per location' on www.coa.nl.
Voor het aantal gemelde incidenten verwijs ik u naar de «COA incidentenregistratie per locatie» op www.coa.nl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over hulp aan mannelijke sekswerkers

MP Mutluer asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about support for young male sex workers, including minors, after a Eindhoven drop-in centre faced closure, and whether the House of Inner Strength can be funded. The government answered that exit programmes (DUUP, 6 million euro per year) are open to all sex workers, that municipalities are responsible for youth and victim care, and that a follow-up meeting with VNG and VWS would take place in March 2024.
I have no insight into the numbers of boys and men who use this drop-in centre or which region they come from.
Ik heb geen inzage in de aantallen jongens en mannen die gebruik maken van dit inloophuis en uit welke regio zij komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de antwoorden op schriftelijke vragen over de voornemens van het kabinet tot asielopvang in Albergen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security to clarify how Tubbergen municipality was informed about the government's plan to use spatial planning powers for the Albergen asylum shelter, the impact on residents and trust, the end date and future of the site, the financial arrangement, and the possibility of a binding third-party clause. The State Secretary answered that contacts with the municipality took place from April 2022, that the coercive instrument was ultimately not used after agreement was reached on 150 residents, that the agreement ends on 1 November 2032 with later decisions left to the then-current bodies, and that a third-party clause was not considered desirable.
