It has been agreed with the Tubbergen board that the administrative agreement ends after 10 years.
Met het college van Tubbergen is afgesproken dat de bestuursovereenkomst na 10 jaar eindigt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vondeling en Markuszower over ‘overvolle gevangenissen en Tbs-klinieken’

PVV MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection how many convicted offenders are free because prisons and tbs clinics are full, whether convicted criminals should never escape their sentences, and what will be done to ensure all sentenced criminals are imprisoned. The Minister answered that 636 adult male self-reporters are temporarily not being called up, that about 150 tbs-passanten are held in prisons, and that the measure is a temporary emergency to be lifted as soon as staffing allows, with further measures being examined.
Not admitting self-reporters is a temporary emergency measure due to staff shortages at DJI, so that not all cells can be used.
Het niet opnemen van zelfmelders is een tijdelijke noodmaatregel als gevolg van persoonstekort bij DJI waardoor niet alle cellen inzetbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht 'Mijn kinderen voelen zich door mij in de steek gelaten, mijn dochter gelooft niet dat een asielaanvraag zo lang kan duren'

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the asylum moratorium for Palestinians should be revised given the situation in Gaza, and whether urgent cases can be prioritised. The State Secretary replied that the moratorium stays because the situation is too uncertain for lasting policy, with limited exceptions, and that the situation will be monitored and Parliament informed within six months.
Naturally, the situation in the Palestinian territories is being monitored in the meantime.
Uiteraard wordt de situatie in de Palestijnse Gebieden tussentijds gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veltman over het artikel ‘Enorme groei van illegale seksbranche: tot duizenden advertenties per dag erbij’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about press reports of rapid growth in illegal sex work, the fall in licensed workplaces, and enforcement difficulties due to privacy rules. The State Secretary said hard figures are unavailable, licensed businesses have declined while flexible and unlicensed work has grown, and a bill on municipal supervision of sex businesses (Wgts) has been sent to the Council of State, with timing still uncertain.
That is why I have started work on the bill on municipal supervision of sex businesses (Wgts).
Daarom ben ik aan de slag gegaan met het wetsvoorstel gemeentelijk toezicht op seksbedrijven (Wgts).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Diederik van Dijk, Helder en Bontenbal over het bericht 'Australische haatprediker ongemoeid naar Utrecht: terreurdaden Hamas ’een opsteker’'

MPs asked whether the government will prevent extremist preacher Mohamed Hoblos from spreading his message online after being denied physical entry to a Utrecht event, and why the venue and mayor could not stop it. The government answered that an online approach is being developed, that terrorist content can be removed, and that under existing law a mayor can only ban a speaker in concrete and serious threat cases, while the organiser and Jaarbeurs assured the speaker would not speak.

Through various pillars, such as dialogue with the internet sector, the local approach and an ambitious international effort, the Minister of Justice and Security is making every possible effort in this regard, nationally and internationally.

Via diverse pijlers, zoals een dialoog met de internetsector, de lokale aanpak en een ambitieuze internationale inzet spant de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid zich hier, nationaal en internationaal, zo maximaal mogelijk voor in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Diederik van Dijk, Helder, Michon-Derkzen, Bontenbal over het bericht ‘Australische haatprediker ongemoeid naar Utrecht: terreurdaden Hamas ’een opsteker’’

MPs asked the Justice Minister whether an Australian extremist preacher planning to speak in Utrecht could be barred from entry, and what would stop him operating elsewhere in the Netherlands. The government answered that it acts against speakers who incite hatred or violence, that the preacher is flagged in the Schengen SIS system for refusal of entry, and that the municipality and services cooperated to prevent him getting a platform.
This refusal of entry applies, in line with the Schengen Borders Code, to all other Schengen member states as well.
Deze toegangsweigering geldt, in lijn met de Schengengrenscode, ook voor alle andere Schengen lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Duitse regeringspartij: Antisemieten mogen geen Duitser worden’

An SGP MP asked the Justice Minister whether the Netherlands should adopt a German proposal to bar antisemitic migrants from naturalisation and revoke citizenship for antisemitic offences. The State Secretary answered that existing rules already allow refusal of naturalisation and revocation on public-order grounds, that revocation grounds are limited by law, and saw no reason to contact Germany or explore a similar proposal further.
I see no reason to do so.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over de brief van 19 december 2023 aan de Provinciale Regietafel (PRT) Noord-Holland

Keijzer (BBB) asks whether a December 2023 letter to the Noord-Holland Provincial Regietafel, supporting an Amsterdam offer to house 1,200 extra asylum seekers in exchange for other municipalities taking statushouders, amounts to steering under the not-yet-enacted Spreidingswet, and questions the legal basis, transparency, consultation of councils and residents, and related funding. The government answers that the arrangement is voluntary under the existing Huisvestingswet, denies pre-empting Parliament, promises to send the communication and the meeting report later, and gives partial or deferred answers on several points.
We will inventory the communication between the municipality and the central government and send it to you.
Wij zullen de communicatie tussen de gemeente en het rijk inventariseren en u doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over OV-geweld

An MP asks the government about violence on public transport, including tougher penalties, a lifetime transport ban, conductors on risk lines, the migration background of perpetrators, and expulsion or loss of Dutch nationality for offenders. The State Secretary replies that action is underway through a joint action programme, that penalties and transport bans are already governed by existing rules, that ethnicity of suspects cannot be registered so the requested overview is not provided, and that asylum and nationality measures are limited by law.

It is not possible to retrieve from police systems an overview of violent incidents on public transport with the background of the suspects, because the police are not allowed to register the ethnicity of the suspect.

Het is niet mogelijk om een overzicht van geweldsincidenten in het OV met daarbij de achtergrond van de verdachten uit de politiesystemen op te halen, omdat Politie de etniciteit van de verdachte niet mag registreren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over een nieuw azc in Alphen

The MP asks why up to 400 asylum seekers are to be placed beside an existing shelter and a prison, how residents were excluded from the decision, and why the State does not halt asylum intake or act on safe-country returns and border controls. The State Secretary answers that the municipality is responsible for shelter arrangements, that residents' participation is a municipal matter, that nuisance will be addressed through national and local measures, and that Netherlands cannot impose an asylum stop due to international obligations.
It is up to the municipal government itself to decide how it involves its citizens and how their input is processed and taken into account in the final decision-making.
Het is aan het gemeentebestuur zelf om te bepalen op welke wijze ze haar burgers daarbij betrekt en hoe inbreng van haar burgers wordt verwerkt en betrokken bij definitieve besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brekelmans over het alleen schriftelijk beoordelen van asielaanvragen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the IND's use of written hearings for asylum applications from Syrians and Yemenis, which Nederland appears to be the only EU state to use, and about the reliability, risks and approval rates of the procedure. The State Secretary answered that written hearing was a temporary measure to reduce backlogs, with safeguards, and that the IND has since stopped written hearings following a motion adopted by the House.
The House of Representatives adopted on 10 October a motion by MPs Brekelmans and van den Brink asking the government to abolish written hearings for promising asylum seekers.

Inmiddels heeft de Tweede Kamer op 10 oktober jl. een motie van de leden Brekelmans (VVD) en van den Brink (CDA) aangenomen waarin de regering wordt verzocht om schriftelijk horen voor kansrijke asielzoekers af te schaffen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het optreden van de Libische kustwacht tegen bootvluchtelingen

MP Ceder asked the ministers about the Libyan coast guard's ramming of a migrant rubber boat, EU support to that coast guard, monitoring, and accountability for abuses against migrants. The government answered that no deaths were registered, that it sees limited Commission tools to mitigate human rights risks, and that it keeps pressing for transparency and monitoring reports, though it has not stopped the EU support.
Due to the safety of the actors carrying out the monitoring, the Commission does not share written reports.
Vanwege de veiligheid van de actoren die de monitoring uitvoeren deelt de Commissie geen schriftelijke rapportages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het per direct invoeren van een asielstop en stoppen met de voorrang van statushouders op woningen

Mr Van Haga asks whether, since all asylum reception locations are full, a immediate asylum stop should be introduced and priority housing for status holders ended. The government answers that international and EU law prevent an asylum stop, that it will keep asking municipalities for reception places, and that municipalities legally must house status holders in time and may decide on urgency status themselves.
In addition, international treaties and European law prevent an asylum stop from being introduced.
Daarnaast beletten internationale verdragen en Europees recht om een asielstop in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over doorduwen van opvang vluchtelingen in Midden-Delfland

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why residents' concerns and petition about a planned 225-person asylum reception location in Midden-Delfland were not addressed, and whether national asylum policy is to blame. The State Secretary answered that the municipality decides how to involve residents and make its choice, that the municipality is already involving residents early, and that an asylum stop is not possible because of international and EU obligations.

The municipal executive and the municipal council of Midden-Delfland decide whether they wish to comply with my explicit call to make asylum reception possible and how the choice of a location comes about.

Het gemeentebestuur en de Raad van de gemeente Midden-Delfland bepalen of zij gehoor wensen te geven aan mijn uitdrukkelijke oproep asielopvang mogelijk te maken en hoe de keuze voor een locatie tot stand komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over ngo’s diede oversteek van illegale immigranten over de Middellandse Zee faciliteren

Baudet (FVD) asked whether NGOs conducting sea rescues in the Mediterranean are subsidised by the Dutch government, where rescued migrants are landed, and whether rescues encourage irregular crossings. The government replied that it funds no such NGOs, that SAR rules place landing responsibility with the coordinating rescue centre, that it values rescue work while seeking clearer EU landing arrangements, and it did not provide the total number rescued.
The cabinet does not have the total number of persons rescued by vessels operated by NGOs.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over het totaal aantal personen dat gered is door schepen in beheer van ngo's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het verblijfsrecht van derdelanders onder de Tijdelijkebeschermingsrichtlijn

MP Podt asked whether third-country nationals under the Temporary Protection Directive still have residence rights while appeal proceedings run, whether the IND portal showing no residence right should be corrected, and how affected people are being informed. The State Secretary replied that termination of temporary protection was suspended pending a Council of State ruling, so the group is still treated as protected, that the IND is examining portal changes, and that affected people were informed by letter.

After this decision, on 2 September it was decided not to implement the consequences of this decision until the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State (hereinafter: Division) issues a guiding ruling on appeal.

Na dit besluit is op 2 september besloten aan de gevolgen van dit besluit geen uitvoering te geven totdat de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State (hierna: Afdeling) een richtinggevende uitspraak doet in hoger beroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht 'Pakistaans homostel met geregistreerd partnerschap volgens IND geen koppel: 'Geen toekomst zonder Ali''

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about an IND decision not to accept the homosexuality of an asylum-seeking same-sex registered partner and how marriages and partnerships are weighed, including the verification role of civil registrars and the separate placement of the two partners. The State Secretary answered that partnership evidence is weighed on the whole file without decisive weight to formal status, that the IND does not aggregate such decisions, and that COA will try to keep family members together within legal limits.
Such information is not stored in a way that allows it to be made available in aggregated form.
Dergelijke informatie wordt niet opgeslagen op een manier dat dit geaggregeerd inzichtelijk gemaakt kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over koppeling statushouders aan gemeenten

An MP asks how statushouders (recognised refugees) are matched to municipalities, including family, work and study ties, the reliance on regional advice, the treatment of unaccompanied minors, early integration courses, and the handover of case files. The State Secretary answers that COA matches on hard and soft criteria with 79% of advice followed in 2022, that early contact is encouraged but hindered by reception shortages, and that short-term measures on early start and COA-municipality cooperation are being developed.
The main obstacle to early contact with the municipality and starting integration is the distance between COA reception and the matched municipality.
Het belangrijkste knelpunt bij vroegtijdige kennismaking met de gemeente en het starten met de inburgering is de afstand tussen de COA-opvang en de gekoppelde gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de voornemens van het kabinet tot asielopvang in Albergen

An MP from JA21 asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security why the cabinet used spatial planning powers in August 2022 to force asylum reception in Albergen, why the hotel is still empty nine months later, and whether the decision was inappropriate and harmed local trust. The State Secretary answered that the powers were ultimately not used because agreement was reached with Tubbergen, that the cabinet will not withdraw the plan, and that agreed limits (150 places, end date 2032, no additional construction) will be written into a future administrative agreement.
To prevent use of the spatial planning instruments in the future, I submitted to the House of Representatives the bill 'Wet gemeentelijke taak mogelijk maken asielopvangvoorzieningen'.

Om in de toekomst inzet van het Ruimtelijk Ordening instrumentarium te voorkomen heb ik bij de Tweede Kamer het wetsvoorstel «Wet gemeentelijke taak mogelijk maken asielopvangvoorzieningen» ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het artikel 'Beëindiging opvang 'derdelander' uit Oekraïne mag van de rechtbank'

An MP asked why information to municipalities and third-country nationals about ending temporary protection for Ukrainian third-country nationals came late, whether the process was legally tested, and what happens to shelter, work and returns given pending court proceedings. The State Secretary answered that the end date was frozen pending a Council of State ruling, that communication was broadly consistent though some letters caused confusion, and described legal checks, shelter transitions and remigration support.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Draagvlak minder door incidenten opvang’

An MP from JA21 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a series of incidents at a reception centre for unaccompanied minor asylum seekers in Papendrecht, including incident counts, whether the situation was untenable, and how the municipal council was informed. The State Secretary acknowledged the incidents, said the COA took measures and that calm had returned, gave no current incident figures (pointing to the annual 2022 overview), and declined to view the situation as untenable.
The COA publishes an annual incident overview at location level.
Het COA publiceert jaarlijks een incidentenoverzicht op locatieniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de gelekte migratiebrief

An MP from Volt asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security 29 questions about a leaked cabinet migration letter, covering planned policies, EU negotiations, asylum, border controls and detention. The government declined to address the substance, stating that political negotiation documents are not disclosed and that as a caretaker cabinet it exercises restraint, promising only to keep Parliament informed through usual channels.
The same applies to the information requested in this set of questions in relation to this document.
Dat geldt eveneens voor de informatie die, in het kader van dit document, in deze vragenset wordt opgevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het bericht ‘Ukrainian refugees in the Netherlands face uncertain future: report’ en het bericht Tijdelijke karakter opvang Oekraïners blijft knellen

MP Koekkoek asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about reports on the uncertain future and temporary status of Ukrainian refugees, including financing of housing, exploitation risks, healthcare and education, opvang standards, and EU-wide extension of temporary protection. The government answered each question, largely by describing existing measures, extending investment periods, and promising further reports, without committing to an EU-wide extension beyond pursuing one.
In the autumn I will inform you of the outcomes.
In het najaar zal ik u over de uitkomsten informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kroger en Piri over de berichtgeving rondom de Tunesië-deal

MPs Kroger and Piri asked about the formal status, accountability and human rights safeguards of the EU-Tunisia memorandum of understanding on migration and partnership. The government answered that the MoU is a non-binding political commitment agreed by the European Commission, with no formal role for the European Parliament, and that existing human rights obligations are unchanged, while committing to press Tunisia on rights and to keep the House informed on implementation and funding.
There is no formal role for the European Parliament in the drafting of MoUs.
Er is geen formele rol van het Europees parlement bij de totstandkoming van MoU’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het artikel 'Tunesië-deal zit vol ‘juridische bochten’, zeggen experts'

An MP from D66 asked the government about the EU-Tunisia migration deal, including the EUR 105 million for border management, human rights safeguards, monitoring, asylum capacity and legal basis. The government answered that the MoU is non-binding, references respect for human rights and international law, and that details will follow once the Commission specifies the EU support.
Your House will be informed further once more detailed information can be provided on the design and conditions of EU support and any budgetary consequences for the Dutch budget.
Uw Kamer zal, zodra nadere informatie kan worden gegeven over vormgeving en voorwaarden van de EU-steun en eventuele budgettaire gevolgen voor de Nederlandse begroting, nader worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het artikel 'Ik dacht: ze gaan ons vermoorden. Ze gaan alle zwarte mensen in Tunesië vermoorden'

An MP asks the ministers whether they are aware of reports that Tunisian authorities expelled Black migrants without food, water or phones into the desert near the Libyan border, whether this breaches the EU-Tunisia MoU and human rights law, and what steps will be taken. The government says it is aware of worrying reports but that it is unclear what exactly happened, notes the MoU is not legally binding, and says it will keep raising migration management and human rights with Tunisia through EU and bilateral channels.
Based on the information known to the cabinet, it is unclear exactly what happened.
Op basis van de bij het kabinet bekende informatie is onduidelijk wat er precies is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over alleenstaande minderjarige asielzoekers in de noodopvang en crisisnoodopvang

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security, in 23 numbered questions, about unaccompanied minor asylum seekers in emergency reception, including quality of care against the Opvangrichtlijn, disappearances, safety, healthcare, education and complaint handling. The State Secretary largely answered by pointing to the shortage of locations and staff, the Spreidingswet, ongoing measures and the inspections' findings, while declining a broad survey of staff and a large-scale discrimination investigation.
I see no reason to commission an additional survey on this.
Ik zie geen reden om daar een aanvullend onderzoek op te (laten) organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de komst van azc op vakantiepark De Lindenberg in Holten

MP Van Haga asks the State Secretary how residents of De Lindenberg holiday park in Holten were informed about a planned asylum reception centre and whether the government will abandon the plan if the municipal council rejects it. The State Secretary says the urgency for reception places remains high, describes the municipality's information sessions and council meeting, and states the council's position is positive towards the purchase.
I remain committed to preventing any nuisance and ensuring the safety of residents, staff and local residents.
Ik blijf mij onverminderd inzetten om eventuele overlast te voorkomen en de veiligheid van bewoners, medewerkers en omwonenden te garanderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het bericht «E.U. Border Agency Considers Pulling Out of Greece Over Migrant Abuses»

An MP from Volt asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security, on behalf of the Foreign Minister too, whether Frontex might withdraw from Greece over migrant rights abuses, what the Council and Netherlands would do, and what tools Frontex and the Commission have. The government answered that the decision to suspend or end Frontex operations lies with the Frontex executive director after consulting the fundamental rights officer, that Commission enforcement tools exist, and that it supports continued dialogue and the Commission's role without committing to a new Dutch initiative.
The decision to temporarily suspend or end Frontex activities in a Member State is reserved, under the European Border and Coast Guard Regulation, to the Frontex executive director.

Het besluit om activiteiten van Frontex in een lidstaat (tijdelijk) op te schorten of te beëindigen is op grond van de Europese Grens- en Kustwachtverordening (hierna: EGKW-Vo) voorbehouden aan de uitvoerend directeur van Frontex.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het bericht «Bulgaria will invite Dutch and Austrian customs experts to help secure Schengen entry»

An MP asked whether the Netherlands joins the Bulgarian border-management pilot, what support it will give Bulgaria's border control with Turkey, what concrete conditions apply to Bulgaria's Schengen accession, and how it will prevent Dutch funds supporting rights-violating border control. The government answered that the Netherlands supports the pilots and provides Frontex staff via existing channels, that accession requires full compliance with the Schengen acquis, and that it will monitor that fundamental rights are respected.
The cabinet has also informed the House of the Netherlands' wish for an additional fact-finding mission to Bulgaria to ensure correct and current application of the Schengen acquis.

Het kabinet heeft uw Kamer ook ingelicht over de wens van Nederland voor een aanvullende fact finding -missie in Bulgarije die de correcte en actuele toepassing van het Schengenacquis moet verzekeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de toepassing van artikel 1F in het vreemdelingenbeleid

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security how many residence permits refused under Article 1F of the Refugee Convention involved a finding that return would breach Article 3 ECHR, how many also carried an entry ban, what happens if courts lift such bans, whether prosecution is possible, and whether these persons should get a permit if no prosecution follows. The government answered with figures (321 cases, 88 with entry bans), explained the limited role of courts and the IND's revised procedure after the CJEU K and H.F. ruling, stated that criminal and immigration law are separate and that dismissal does not automatically entitle someone to a permit, and pointed to a narrow temporary-permit policy.
In principle it is not for the court to lift an entry ban.
Het is in principe niet aan de rechter om een inreisverbod op te heffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het artikel 'Buitenlandse investeerders krijgen straks geen visum meer: ‘Doodzonde voor het ecosysteem’'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the planned abolition of the residence permit scheme for foreign investors, questioning its economic value, implementation costs, alleged criminal misuse and the decision to end it. The State Secretary answered that the scheme had minimal use, that abolition was not due to criminal money concerns, and that the government will not reconsider the decision.
The answer to question 2 is not affirmative.
Het antwoord op vraag 2 is niet bevestigend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over religie en buitenlands beleid

Lawmaker Ceder asked the Foreign and Justice ministers how the 2018 recommendations on religion and foreign policy were implemented, what role religion plays in peacebuilding in six countries, whether freedom of religion will be raised in bilateral dialogue, and how IND staff religious literacy is ensured. The minister replied that implementation is progressing (strategy days, training, a special envoy), outlined a JISRA programme in the named countries, committed to raising freedom of religion in bilateral contacts, and described IND training improvements.
Yes. Freedom of religion and belief is one of the priorities of the Netherlands' foreign human rights policy and is always raised where necessary
Ja. Vrijheid van religie en levensovertuiging is een van de prioriteiten in het buitenlands mensenrechtenbeleid van Nederland en wordt waar nodig altijd te berde gebracht
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht 'Asielkinderen verwaarloosd in luxe hotel: ‘Criminelen staan gewoon voor de deur’'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports of neglect, misconduct and exploitation risks for unaccompanied minors housed in a Oosterhout hotel emergency shelter, including staff behaviour and the risk of criminal exploitation. The government acknowledges quality concerns and says incidents are investigated via Nidos and the IGJ, but describes the situation as not representative of normlessness, says internal COA findings cannot be fully shared due to privacy, and points to shelter shortages and the Spreidingswet.
That there would be a state of «normlessness» I do not recognise.
Maar dat sprake zou zijn van «normloosheid» herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het ombouwen van ziekenhuizen tot asielwalhalla’s

Van Haga asked the state secretary and health minister whether it is undesirable to close hospitals while care demand grows, and whether asylum seekers should be kept out of the empty Tergooi hospital in Blaricum. The government replied that the hospital operator decides on its own organisation within legal limits, that national government is responsible for asylum reception, and that a bill giving municipalities a reception task is pending but its timing cannot be stated.
It is the responsibility of the care provider, in this case Tergooi MC, to decide on the organisation of the care organisation
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de zorgaanbieder, in dit geval het Tergooi MC, om te beslissen over de inrichting van de zorgorganisatie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over de brief van de staatssecretaris over Italiaanse Dublinzaken van 23 mei 2023

An MP from Volt asked the State Secretary why Dublin transfers to Italy are being held for the full six-month transfer period despite court findings that Italy's reception shortcomings cannot be resolved on a known timeline, and why applicants are not yet placed in the national procedure. The State Secretary answered that the full transfer period will be awaited because Italy describes the suspension as temporary, that cases will be moved to the national procedure only after the deadline expires, and that Nederland may rely on mutual trust in other member states.
I still intend to await the final transfer deadline in these cases, because information from the Italian authorities shows that the situation is temporary.
Ik ben vooralsnog van plan de uiterste overdrachtstermijn in deze zaken af te wachten, omdat uit informatie van de Italiaanse autoriteiten blijkt dat sprake is van een tijdelijke situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het migratiepakket

An MP asks the state secretary of Justice and Security for a list of migration measures considered during failed coalition talks, of measures the four parties could agree on, and of measures the demissionary cabinet plans to implement, and whether a package can still be agreed. The government answers that no list of agreed measures exists, that the demissionary cabinet is exercising restraint so no list can be given, and that agreement on a package is not expected, while pointing to earlier letters containing internal documents.
Anticipating that, it is not possible to provide a list of measures or to give a precise date.
Vooruitlopend daarop is het niet mogelijk een lijst van maatregelen te bieden of een precieze datum aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht ‘ Bijna elke dag verdwijnt er een kind uit de asielopvang’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that children disappear from asylum reception almost daily, including how disappearances occur, whether they relate to recent measures for unaccompanied minors, and how they are monitored and prevented. The government answered that absolute numbers of disappearances have fallen since 2018, that most cases involve unaccompanied minors, that it sees no evidence linking them to recent measures, and described existing monitoring, police notification and prevention procedures while committing to no new steps.
I am not aware of signals indicating a possible link between minors leaving asylum reception and the current measures to address the reception shortage
Ik ben niet bekend met signalen die duiden op een mogelijk verband tussen het vertrek van minderjarigen uit de asielopvang en de huidige maatregelen om het opvangtekort tegen te gaan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Brink over het bericht ‘Jumbo-echtpaar is overlast asielzoekers zat en stopt met winkel in Maarheeze’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a supermarket closing due to nuisance from asylum seekers, including incident registration, action at the station, police capacity, and residence rules for offenders. The State Secretary said nuisance is unacceptable, described COA measures, supervisory teams, HTL placement, and noted that residence decisions follow European and national rules, while committing to continued consultation and cooperation.
I am of the opinion that our hospitality must never come at the expense of our safety.
Ik ben van mening dat onze gastvrijheid nooit ten koste mag gaan van onze veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de overlast van asielzoekers in Maarheeze

An MP asks the State Secretaries about nuisance caused by asylum seekers in Maarheeze, including a shop closure and train drivers wanting to bypass the station, and why nothing was done earlier and whether offenders are punished and returned. The State Secretary answers that nuisance is unacceptable, lists measures taken with COA and the municipality (fencing, supervision, sports field, mobile shop, camera plans, a supervision team, possible COA hosts at the station), and explains that asylum status can be refused or revoked on public order grounds only after a conviction for a serious or particularly serious offence, with return proceedings following.
Any form of nuisance caused by asylum seekers is unacceptable, including in Maarheeze.
Iedere vorm van overlast veroorzaakt door asielzoekers is onacceptabel, zo ook in Maarheeze.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Peters over het alleen schriftelijk beoordelen van asielaanvragen

MPs Brekelmans and Peters asked whether written-only asylum hearings for Syrian, Yemeni and Turkish applicants risk carelessness, wrongful grants and missed security risks, and whether they are reconsidered. The State Secretary defends written hearings as a careful, voluntary IND procedure needed to raise output, notes no evidence they attract more applicants, and states Turkish applicants are dropped from the procedure because it proved less suitable.
For that reason, written hearings are no longer applied to Turkish asylum seekers and are limited to asylum seekers from Syria and Yemen.
Om die reden wordt schriftelijk horen niet langer toegepast op Turkse asielzoekers en beperkt tot asielzoekers uit Syrië en Jemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Piri over de dood van een drie maanden oude baby in het aanmeldcentrum Ter Apel

MPs Kröger and Piri asked about the death of a three-month-old baby at the Ter Apel asylum centre, including unhygienic conditions, why the mother had to travel to Ter Apel despite holding a residence permit, and steps to prevent recurrence. The State Secretary acknowledged the poor conditions, said no causal link to the death could be established, and listed measures such as ending use of the sports hall for vulnerable residents and expanding capacity, though several answers were delayed or deferred to later policy responses.
Unfortunately I have not managed to answer your questions within the usual timeframe, as not all necessary information has yet been received.
Helaas is het mij niet gelukt om binnen de gebruikelijke termijn uw vragen te beantwoorden, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Podt over financiering van grensbewakingsprojecten in Soedan

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers whether EU border-control funding in Sudan indirectly benefited the RSF militia, why projects ended only in 2019-2020, and what lessons apply to future projects. The minister denied that EU funds or equipment went to the RSF or army, said safeguards and monitoring existed, and committed to no new action beyond raising risks in Brussels.
The EU, however, provided no financial support for that security training either in 2017 or in the years after.
De EU heeft echter noch in 2017 noch in de jaren daarna financiële steun gegeven aan genoemde veiligheidstraining.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Kröger over het gebrek aan opvangplekken

MPs Piri and Kröger asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a looming shortage of asylum reception places, including whether 8,000 places would be missing by April and what concrete steps are being taken. The State Secretary answered that a shortage has been averted for now through coordinated measures, that many places are still needed, that ongoing monitoring and talks with municipalities and COA continue, and that the Spreidingswet is pending in parliament.
I have therefore asked the provincial coordination tables to coordinate the reception and housing needs.
Ik heb daarom aan de provinciale regietafels gevraagd om de opvang- en huisvestingsbehoefte te coördineren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Brekelmans over het bericht 'Statushouders niet tevreden met flexwoning: weigeren contract te tekenen'

MPs De Groot and Brekelmans asked about refugees in Rijswijk refusing flex housing contracts, how many are in reception, and what measures the government will take. The minister says refusal is unacceptable, that under 3% of refusals led to eviction, that no ultimatum can be set since municipalities decide, and that a handreiking for municipalities is being prepared.
The cabinet is not in a position to set such an ultimatum in situations such as in Rijswijk.
Het kabinet is niet in de positie om een dergelijk ultimatum te stellen in situaties zoals in Rijswijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Piri over het aantal minderjarigen in (crisis)noodopvangvoorzieningen

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why the promised overview of minors in crisis emergency shelters, showing locations and access to education and care, had not been sent, and for the latest figures before a debate. The State Secretary apologised for the delay, citing logistical issues from the 1 July closure of crisis shelters, gave a headcount of about 980 children across 89 locations, and declined to provide a location-by-location breakdown because it could be traced to individuals, promising a separate letter on conditions and access to education and care.
A concrete overview broken down by which locations children stay at would contain information that can be traced back to the individual, and for that reason I cannot provide it to you.
Een concreet overzicht waarbij is uitgesplitst op welke locaties kinderen verblijven zou informatie bevatten welke tot de persoon te herleiden is en kan ik u om die reden niet verstrekken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het rapport van de onafhankelijke Fact Finding Mission (FFM) van de Hoge Commissaris Voor de Rechten van de Mens van de Verenigde Naties, over de mensenrechtensituatie in Libië

An MP asked the government about the UN Fact-Finding Mission's findings on abuses against migrants in Libyan detention centres and about Dutch and EU support to the Libyan coast guard, including whether that support contributes to abuses and whether independent monitoring exists. The government answered that EU support (training, vehicles, equipment) aims to strengthen interception capacity, acknowledged the risks and limited instruments, pointed to third-party monitoring whose reports are not shared, and said IOM's registration system is not in use.
For the safety of the actors carrying out the monitoring and for the continuity of the monitoring, the EU does not share reports.
Omwille van de veiligheid van de actoren die de monitoring verrichten alsook voor de continuïteit van de monitoring deelt de EU geen rapportages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het geweld bij het AZC in Heemserveen.

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a renewed brawl at the Heemserveen asylum centre, how repeated violence can occur, what measures are planned, whether closure is an option, and whether violent asylum seekers will be expelled. The government answered that incidents appear unconnected, outlined a coordinated person-focused approach with the municipality and COA including extra security, a 'lik-op-stuk' prosecution approach, and that closure is undesirable given capacity needs while the asylum procedure of offenders is being accelerated.
The cabinet is therefore very keen to restore peace and security in the municipality of Hardenberg.
Het kabinet is er daarom alles aan gelegen om de rust en veiligheid in de gemeente Hardenberg te herstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht 'Afgevinkt en uitgezet'

MP Piri asks about a report that outsourced medical examinations (MediFirst) for asylum seekers rely on nurses without relevant expertise, do not record scars, and fall under no dedicated oversight. The State Secretary defends the medical advice procedure as sound, notes the IND may ask MediFirst follow-up questions, and says BIG registration and healthcare inspectorate/disciplinary oversight suffice, so no new oversight body is needed.
I do not consider it necessary to establish further supervision in addition to this.
Ik acht het niet nodig aanvullend hierop verder toezicht in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over politiegeweld jegens een vreedzame demonstratie in de crisisopvang

An MP asked the state secretary about reported police violence against a peaceful demonstration at the Zuidbroek crisis shelter, including reports that residents' allowances were withheld, a transfer to Ter Apel followed filming, and staff confiscated phones. The government confirms awareness of the footage, says house rules allow sanctions for breaches but that demonstrating is permitted, declines to discuss the individual transfer for privacy reasons, denies phones were taken, and says the police and COA aimed to restore safety rather than curb the right to demonstrate.
For the privacy of our residents, I will not go into this specific case.
Vanwege de privacy van onze bewoners ga ik niet op dit specifieke geval in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het criminele karakter van het asielzoekerscentrum in Gilze en het onder druk zetten van burgers die hier verslag van doen op sociale media

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a separate housing unit for troublesome asylum seekers at the Gilze reception centre, stolen property not being recovered, police pressure on residents who posted about it online, and staff safety. The State Secretary confirmed the unit houses 20 people, said police cannot search rooms without grounds under the Code of Criminal Procedure, rejected changing the law, and said cooperation between partners is being strengthened.
Everyone may tell their story in the Netherlands, including on social media.
Iedereen mag zijn verhaal doen in Nederland, ook op sociale media.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over minderjarige inklimmers in de Rotterdamse haven

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about unaccompanied minors climbing onto lorries in the Rotterdam port to reach the UK, including numbers, registration, recidivism and prevention. The government answered with figures for 2021 and 2022, described a joint Nidos-police-Raad voor de Kinderbescherming approach and border measures, while stating that some data (such as KMar recidivism and whether attempts succeed) are unavailable.
There is no central overview recording whether persons had previously stayed in the Netherlands when they attempted irregular departure.
Er bestaat geen centraal overzicht waarin wordt bijgehouden of personen al eerder verblijf hadden in Nederland toen zij een poging deden irregulier uit te reizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het vervolg van de financiële impuls huisvesting grote gezinnen

An MP asked about the results of the earlier pilot grant for housing large refugee families, its distribution across municipalities, and why the new subsidy is run by RVO and open first-come first-served rather than via a specific grant. The minister answered that 24 municipalities were selected, 17 large families were housed by January 2022 with no measurable acceleration, the new scheme opens in July 2023, and it deliberately avoids a fixed application window while monitoring regional spread.
That is why it is logical for municipalities to submit the application.
Daarom ligt het voor de hand dat gemeenten de aanvraag indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de aanhoudende asielcrisis

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the ongoing asylum crisis, including whether an emergency should be declared, the Refugee Convention, a Rwanda deal, and a five-point plan. The State Secretary answered that short-term measures are in place for Ter Apel, that the legal conditions for an emergency regime are not met, and that the other proposals are either ongoing EU work, already addressed, or under review.
Yes, I am aware of the reports and inventory mentioned.
Ja, ik ben bekend met de genoemde berichtgeving en inventarisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de te realiseren opvangplekken voor asielzoekers

MP Podt asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reception places for asylum seekers, including whether people would again have to sleep outside at Ter Apel, the status of measures to speed up status holders' exit from reception, whether the hotel and accommodation scheme and use of large vacant sites would be expanded, and whether the spreading law's transitional arrangement would be activated early. The State Secretary answered that measures were taken, that the scheme would be extended to 1 January 2025, that talks with municipalities would continue, and that the questions could not be answered before the debate date.
I will expand and extend the hotel and accommodation scheme until 1 January 2025.
Ik zal de hotel- en accommodatieregeling uitbreiden en verlengen tot 1 januari 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Boswijk en Krul over het bericht 'Nieuw probleem bij zoeken opvangplekken: ‘Dassen blokkeren opvang 800 asielzoekers’'

CDA MPs asked whether the government will act urgently to grant general exemptions under the Nature Protection Act so badgers blocking reception locations for 800 asylum seekers can be removed. The minister answered that exemptions are case-specific, the province is the competent authority, a general exemption is being explored with care, and ProRail has a code since January 2023.
As indicated, the province is the competent authority under the Nature Protection Act and it is up to the province to make that assessment.
Zoals aangegeven is de provincie bevoegd gezag op grond van de Wnb en is het het aan de provincie om die afweging te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brekelmans over overlast en criminaliteit op het AZC in Gilze

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about crime, nuisance and safety problems at the Gilze asylum reception centre, including whether illegal residents are kept out and whether residents are punished for harbouring them. The State Secretary answered that nuisance has declined thanks to cooperation between COA, municipality, police and security, that staff feel safe, and that measures such as expedited procedures, removal and sanctions are applied, while largely not addressing the specific question on punishing residents or the reason for not transferring offenders to the HTL.
The picture that there is serious, structural nuisance is not recognised by the municipality of Gilze and Rijen and the COA.
Het beeld dat er sprake is van ernstige, structurele overlast, wordt door de gemeente Gilze en Rijen en het COA niet herkend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het nieuwe Zweedse asiel- en terugkeerbeleid

An MP from JA21 asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about Sweden's new asylum and return policy, including expanded immigration detention capacity and a claimed 50% rise in removals, and whether the Netherlands should follow suit. The State Secretary said he could not confirm the 50% figure, that Sweden's plans are still being worked out, that the Netherlands is monitoring them, and promised a list of Dutch EU-asylum transpositions before the summer recess.
This overview is still being worked on. I expect to be able to send it to your House before the summer recess.
Aan dit overzicht wordt thans nog gewerkt. Ik verwacht dit zeker nog voor het zomerreces aan uw Kamer te kunnen doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Smolders over het azc in Budel

Two Groep Van Haga MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the government will close the Budel asylum centre given local residents' complaints about nuisance and insecurity. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, pointed to existing measures such as street patrols and a neighbourhood connection plan, and said he remains in talks with the municipality, province and COA about the centre's future and further measures, without committing to closure.
I am and remain in discussion with the municipality of Cranendonck, the province, the COA and other key partners about the future of the reception centre.
Ik ben en blijf met de gemeente Cranendonck, de provincie, het COA en andere belangrijke partners in gesprek over de toekomst van het aanmeldcentrum.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Van der Staaij 'De komst van Marokkaanse staatsimams naar Nederland'

MPs Stoffer and Van der Staaij asked whether the Moroccan state-funded Fondation Hassan II sends state imams to the Netherlands, what messages they spread, whether the government was informed in advance, and whether entry could be refused. The government answered that the imams provide religious support to the Moroccan diaspora during Ramadan within permitted diaspora policy and freedom of religion, that visas are assessed individually, that there is no current reason to refuse them, and that it will report on the revamped Taskforce later.
There is currently no reason to take action or to refuse the visa applications of the imams.
Er is op dit moment geen aanleiding om op te treden of de visumaanvraag van de imams te weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de crisis in de asielopvang

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the reception crisis for asylum seekers, including municipalities unwilling to extend reception places, the risk of a new shortage, ad hoc policy, and the Spreidingswet financial incentives. The State Secretary answered that a 19,000-place package is underway, a Wet gemeentelijke taak is being prepared and submitted, and additional measures are being monitored, though no full structural solution or timeline was given.
I agree that a lot of work still needs to be done to ensure that everyone with a legal entitlement is and remains assured of a reception place.
Ik onderschrijf dat nog veel werk verzet moet worden om ervoor te zorgen dat iedereen met een daartoe strekkend recht verzekerd is en blijft van een opvangplek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over woningweigering door statushouders

MPs Kops and Wilders asked how often refugee status holders refused housing, why, how many evictions followed, and who handles refusals under the hotel and accommodation scheme. The government answered that initial refusals were about 140 to 300 a year, mostly reversed, with COA and municipalities handling procedures and a guidance document in preparation.
Because status holders have left COA, it is not centrally recorded how many status holders under the hotel and accommodation scheme refuse a home.
Omdat statushouders zijn uitgestroomd bij het COA, wordt niet centraal bijgehouden hoeveel statushouders onder de Hotel- en accommodatieregeling een woning weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek en Sylvana Simons over de geweldincidenten op HTL Hoogeveen

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about violent incidents at the HTL Hoogeveen asylum enforcement facility, including who decides on placement, whether courts are involved, use of force by staff, reporting of incidents to Nidos and the Inspectorate, and compliance with EU and UN child rights rules. The State Secretary answered that placement is an administrative measure open to judicial review, that minors can only be placed in exceptional cases with Nidos consent, that force is used only in exceptional situations and reported, and that the COA is working on an independent complaints procedure and updated policy, though the answers were often descriptive and deferred some steps.
So a judge is indeed involved here.
Hier komt dus wel een rechter aan te pas.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over seksueel geweld onder asielzoekers en vluchtelingen naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Slachtoffers zijn belangrijker dan bewijzen, ook na verkrachting in de oorlog’

An MP asked the State Secretary whether sexual violence against asylum seekers is overlooked in the asylum procedure and whether support is adequate, citing an Amnesty report. The government answered that forensic medical examinations are ordered only when needed for credibility assessment, that individual assessment and training are in place, that medical data falls under confidentiality so numbers are unknown, and that it aims to pay more attention to the issue.
The aim is to pay more attention to this subject in the future.
Het streven is om in de toekomst meer aandacht te besteden aan dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de opvang van asielzoekers in Hotel aan de Linge

An MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the emergency accommodation of asylum seekers in a hotel in Kedichem, whose owner objected and whose rights were allegedly overridden. The State Secretary answers that a summary-proceedings court ruled on lawfulness, that the municipality contracted with the hotel operators (not the state or COA), that no expropriation or seizure occurred, and that municipalities decide how to shelter homeless people.
In no case was there any seizure or requisition of the hotel property in question when the hotel was rented in the municipality of Vijfheerenlanden.
In geen geval is er bij de huur van het genoemde hotel in de gemeente Vijfheerenlanden sprake geweest van inbeslagname dan wel vordering van het pand in kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over asielopvang in Zwaagdijk West

An MP asks whether a provincial plan to build temporary housing for refugee status holders in Zwaagdijk-West, against the municipality's wishes, risks a repeat of the Tubbergen conflict and how the provincial decision and public participation are handled. The minister answers that the province is only conducting a feasibility study, that the municipality is primarily responsible, that a participation process will follow if the project is feasible, and that he sees no reason yet to discuss it with the provincial executive.
Should it turn out that the project is not feasible, the provincial executive does not consider a participation process necessary either.
Mocht blijken dat het project niet haalbaar is, dan acht het provinciale bestuur een participatietraject ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over strengere regels voor schepen die migranten redden op de Middellandse Zee

An MP asked whether Italy's new rules and fines on NGO rescue ships in the Mediterranean, and the Dutch absence of a humanitarian exemption in people-smuggling law, are compatible with international law and should be challenged. The State Secretary answered that Italian law is a matter for Italy and the courts and the Commission, that NGO rescue is valued but private ships should not aid smugglers, and that existing criminal-law defences suffice without an explicit humanitarian exemption.
It is not for the cabinet to judge whether this Italian law is compatible with European and international treaties; that is reserved for a judge.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om een oordeel te geven over de verenigbaarheid van deze Italiaanse wet met Europese en internationaalrechtelijke verdragen.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Ceder en Podt over de uitspraken van de minister-president inzake NGO's

MPs Ceder and Podt asked the Prime Minister and the State Secretary of Justice and Security to explain and justify the Prime Minister's remarks distinguishing 'good and bad' NGOs at sea, and whether those remarks were unfounded. The State Secretary answered that the government values NGO rescue work, that national authorities (the Public Prosecution Service in the Netherlands) decide on criminal investigation, and that humanitarian motives can already be weighed under necessity defences, while giving no evidence that specific NGOs are involved in smuggling.
It is up to the national (investigative) authorities, if there is cause, to investigate this and, where necessary, to proceed to criminal prosecution.
Het is aan de nationale (opsporings)autoriteiten – als daartoe aanleiding is – hiernaar onderzoek te doen en zo nodig over te gaan tot strafrechtelijke vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Westerveld over het voortduren van het gebrekkige onderwijsaanbod voor kinderen in asielopvangvoorzieningen

MPs Kröger, Westerveld and Piri asked about the continuing shortfall in education for children in asylum reception facilities, including delays, placement policy and whether gaps are structurally addressed. The State Secretary answered that data on children missing schooling is not yet available, that placement of families in crisis emergency shelters is undesirable but cannot always be refused, and that a bill and evaluations are in preparation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over dreigende onteigening van panden als gevolg van de asieldwangwet

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the asylum reception obligation bill opens the door to compulsory expropriation of buildings by municipalities, and whether it should be withdrawn given claimed lack of support and legal problems. The State Secretary said the bill contains no expropriation provisions, so expropriation is not an option under it, and maintained that the government intends to submit the bill to the House soon.
The bill contains no provisions that make expropriation possible.
Het wetsvoorstel bevat geen bepalingen die onteigening mogelijk maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht 'Dordts asielzoekerscentrum komt waarschijnlijk op bedrijventerrein Distripark langs de A16'

MP Podt (D66) asked whether Dordrecht's plan for an asylum centre of at least 500 places, with full-time work for residents, is a good example and what the government will do about work rights. The State Secretary welcomed Dordrecht's initiative but declined to commit to full-time work rights, pointing to a pending study by the Minister of Social Affairs and no timetable for pilots.
The cabinet considers it undesirable to anticipate the results of the study.
Het kabinet acht het niet wenselijk om vooruit te lopen op de resultaten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het realiseren van een tweede aanmeldcentrum voor asielzoekers

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security how many municipalities have been approached about a second asylum registration centre, why some refuse, what incentives exist, and when spatial planning instruments would be used. The State Secretary answered that talks are ongoing with two municipalities, that the Bant plan changed form, that incentives such as shared agreements on capacity and local economic benefits are offered, and that spatial planning instruments are not currently being used since voluntary cooperation is still being pursued.
At this moment, therefore, there is no question of deploying spatial planning instruments.
Op dit moment is daarom geen sprake van de inzet van het ruimtelijk ordeningsinstrumentarium.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over overlastgevende asielzoekers in het Budel

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about asylum seekers at a Budel reception centre causing nuisance (shouting, threats, spitting) on a bus line, and asked for their deportation and a detailed enforcement plan. The State Secretary condemned the conduct, said prosecution and residence decisions rest with the Public Prosecution Service, IND and DT&V, and listed a joint action plan with preventive measures and a supervision team in Cranendonck.

It is for the Public Prosecution Service and the courts to assess whether causing nuisance such as shouting, threatening and spitting in individual cases leads to criminal prosecution and/or conviction.

Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie en de rechtspraak om te beoordelen of het veroorzaken van overlast zoals schelden, dreigen en spugen in individuele gevallen leidt tot strafrechtelijke vervolging en/of veroordeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht 'Vorig jaar 3,4 miljoen euro uitgekeerd aan dwangsommen' op de website van de IND

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary about IND payouts of 3.4 million euro in penalty payments for late asylum and residence decisions, the rise in default notices (ingebrekestellingen) in 2022, the reasons behind the missing 2022 figures, and plans to limit the penalty scheme. The State Secretary gave detailed answers on figures and scenarios but declined several requests for breakdowns, pointed to pending court rulings and a bill being revised, and promised to inform parliament once alternatives are examined.
That cannot be provided, because the IND works with a case management system.
Dat kan niet gegeven worden, omdat de IND met een zaaksysteem werkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Peters over het bericht ‘Mensenhandelaren actief bij azc, asielzoekers stappen in geblindeerde busjes: ‘Moderne slavernij’

MPs Kuik and Peters asked the State Secretary about press reports of human trafficking, exploitation and sexual approaches to minors around asylum reception centres, and what is being done to detect and prevent it. The State Secretary answered that COA, police and municipalities cooperate, that the police prioritise trafficking, that COA trains contact persons and visitor controls exist, and that he takes the signals seriously while disputing some reported facts.
I find it serious if concerned residents were no longer reporting because of a lack of action and fear of retaliation.
Ik vind het ernstig als bezorgde omwonenden geen aangifte meer zouden doen wegens een gebrek aan actie en de angst voor vergelding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht 'Niemand op de boot in Genemuiden weet waar de 85 vluchtelingen aan toe zijn' en de bereikbaarheid van de IND.

MP Podt (D66) asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about reports that asylum seekers in Genemuiden and elsewhere have waited months without a first IND interview, with no information on timing, and about the IND's poor telephone and email accessibility. The State Secretary acknowledges rising inflow and waiting times of about 12 weeks, explains information sessions and staff expansion, but gives no firm timeline for reducing waits and declines to commit to a visit within a month to all locations.
It is unfortunately not possible to indicate for each asylum seeker when the hearing will take place.
Het is helaas niet mogelijk om per asielzoeker aan te geven wanneer het gehoor plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de mobilisatie in Rusland

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security and the Foreign Minister about reports of a new Russian mobilisation and whether Russians fearing mobilisation should receive asylum protection or a suspension of decisions. The State Secretary answered that mobilisation was declared finished in October 2022 but incidental recruitment continues, that individual asylum assessments will proceed without a new moratorium, and that a new country report is due in spring.
This concerns a confidential source. It will not be made public.
Het betreft hier een vertrouwelijke bron. Deze wordt niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het vervoeren van asielzoekers per taxi

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about taxis used to transport asylum seekers, how often this happens, the costs, and why they do not use public transport. The State Secretary replied that taxis are used only in specific cases, such as transporting unaccompanied minors or vulnerable persons to the Ter Apel registration centre, that costs are paid from the state budget, that COA is responsible for its own cost records, and referred to earlier answers on the remaining questions.
COA is an independent administrative body and itself bears responsibility for the costs of orders related to transporting asylum seekers.
COA is een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan en draagt zelf verantwoordelijkheid voor de kosten die betrekking hebben op opdrachten die verbandhouden met het vervoeren van asielzoekers.

Antwoord  op vragen van de leden Kröger en Piri over het bericht ‘Asieldeal wéér onder vuur van rechter: uitspraak hekelt nu ook ander onderdeel van het akkoord’ en de uitspraak van rechtbank Den Haag

MPs Kröger and Piri asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the Den Haag court ruling that the generic six-month extension of asylum decision deadlines was not lawfully adopted, and about why IND backlogs persist despite staff growth. The State Secretary attributed high intake to multiple factors, explained that training takes about a year, said the extension will continue while an appeal is filed, and promised a further update on financial risks of penalty payments.
I am in continuous discussion with the IND about the measures needed to clear the backlogs.
Ik ben continu met de IND in gesprek over de benodigde maatregelen om de voorraden weg te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over eten klagende asielzoekers

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about asylum seekers on hunger strike over food at a The Hague hotel, and whether complaints about meals warrant leaving the country. The State Secretary answered that asylum seekers have the same right to complain as everyone in Nederland, and that a conversation with the location's staff has led to agreements.
Asylum seekers have the right to complain just as much as all other persons present in the Netherlands.
Het recht om te klagen hebben asielzoekers evenzeer als alle andere personen die zich in Nederland bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over de overname van de tijdelijke opvanglocatie voor asielzoekers door het COA

MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why COA took over a municipal emergency reception site in Groningen without consent, whether residents were consulted, and whether more sites will be taken over. The State Secretary replied that takeovers happen in consultation with municipalities, that the Groningen site remains temporary emergency shelter with no plan to make it permanent, that informing residents is the municipality's responsibility, and that more suitable sites are being discussed with municipalities before 1 April 2023.
It is primarily the responsibility of the municipality to inform residents about the emergency shelter remaining open longer.
Het is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente om de omwonenden te informeren over het langer open blijven van een (crisis)noodopvanglocatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht ‘Asielzoekers Almere wachten een half jaar op gesprek over verblijf: wanhoop slaat toe’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about asylum seekers in emergency crisis shelters waiting over six months for their first IND interview, asking about numbers, the need for faster transfer to regular centres, communication failures, and capacity. The State Secretary answered that about 60 people had waited over six months, that the shelters are still needed, that a bill is in preparation to expand regular reception, and that the IND has hired staff and is adding capacity.
On 31 December 2022, about 60 asylum seekers in a crisis emergency shelter had been waiting longer than half a year for their first interview (aanmeldgehoor).
Op 31 december 2022 zaten circa 60 asielzoekers in een crisisnoodopvanglocatie die langer dan een half jaar wachten op hun eerste gesprek (aanmeldgehoor).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Kröger, Sylvana Simons en Akerboom over ongedocumenteerde mensen in Nederland

MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the size and composition of the undocumented population in the Netherlands, and whether Dutch policy could adopt German, Irish or city-level measures such as regularisation or city ID cards. The State Secretary answered that return remains the central policy, that existing support (LVV, minors' rights, medical care) suffices, and that he is reluctant to add broader facilities or a new education convention.
I am therefore, unlike the initiatives mentioned in question 3, reluctant to provide additional facilities such as a city pass.
Derhalve ben ik, in tegenstelling tot de in vraag 3 genoemde initiatieven, terughoudend in het faciliteren van aanvullende voorzieningen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een digitaal reisdocument en digitale gezichtsherkenning

An MP asked whether the new EU digital travel credential pilot with facial recognition is a continuation of the earlier KTDI pilot involving the World Economic Forum, KLM and the Canadian government, and about the WEF's role. The Secretary of State answered that the DTC pilot is not a continuation of KTDI, differs in technology and partners, and that the WEF is not involved.
The DTC pilot now announced is not a continuation of the KTDI pilot.
De nu aangekondigde DTC-pilot is geen voortzetting van de KTDI-pilot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat bijna alle slachtoffers van het Essex-drama in Nederland zijn geweest

SP MPs asked whether the Essex lorry deaths victims had mostly been in the Netherlands, after a Myria report implied 38 of 39 victims were previously known there, and asked about Dutch handling of Vietnamese human trafficking and smuggling. The State Secretary answered that the passage was a misreading: fingerprint comparison found only two prior Dutch presences, the report was amended, the observation was not subject to the transit-prohibition given no concrete knowledge of smuggling, and no new investigation is planned.
This research showed that two of the 39 victims had been in the Netherlands before the tragedy.
Uit dit onderzoek is gebleken dat twee van de 39 slachtoffers voorafgaand aan het drama in Nederland zijn geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de sluiting van een noodopvanglocatie in Horst aan de Maas

An SP MP asked the state secretary about the closure of an emergency asylum reception site in Horst aan de Maas, protests against it, the need for stable longer-term shelter and children's schooling, and whether he would intervene with the mayor. The state secretary confirmed awareness of protests, said closure is a municipal decision in consultation with the safety region, noted the COA is talking with the municipality about a transition, and announced a bill to encourage longer-term shelter, without committing to halt the closure.
Closing and opening crisis emergency shelter is a decision that falls to the local government, in consultation with the safety region.
Het sluiten en openen van crisisnoodopvang is een besluit dat de lokale overheid toekomt, in samenspraak met de veiligheidsregio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Piri en Sylvana Simons over geheime gevangenissen langs de EU-buitengrenzen

MPs Kröger, Piri and Simons asked the state secretary whether reports of secret detention facilities at the EU external border in Bulgaria, funded with EU money and involving beatings and pushbacks, are true, what Frontex's role is, and what the Netherlands will do. The government said it cannot verify the reports, expects the Commission and national monitoring mechanisms to investigate, stated Frontex's role is limited to surveillance support, and said no signals of abuse came from Dutch Frontex staff.
The cabinet is of the view that reports of abuses at the external borders should be investigated by the Member States concerned.
Het kabinet is van mening dat berichtgeving over misstanden aan de buitengrenzen onderzocht moeten worden door de betrokken lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over gratis zwemles voor asielzoekers

An MP asked why asylum seekers up to age 35 get free swimming lessons funded by COA while Dutch children and adults do not, calling it discriminatory. The government answered that asylum seekers and residents drown relatively more often, that COA covers swimming lessons as a targeted risk-reduction measure, and that other municipal and national financial schemes exist for Dutch residents.
COA reimburses the cost of swimming lessons for residents up to and including age 35.
Het COA vergoedt de kosten voor zwemlessen voor bewoners tot en met 35 jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het feit dat babysterftecijfers bij asielzoekers zeven keer hoger liggen dan het landelijk gemiddelde

Kuzu (DENK) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that infant mortality among asylum seekers is seven times the national average, and whether discrimination in care or the reception system explains it. The State Secretary acknowledged the concern, noted several possible causes including late pregnancy care, relocations and reception conditions, and pointed to existing care arrangements and planned discrimination research without committing to new specific measures.
The starting point is that asylum seekers are moved as little as possible, especially vulnerable groups such as children and pregnant women.
Het uitgangspunt is dat asielzoekers zo min mogelijk verhuizen, zeker waar het gaat om kwetsbare groepen, zoals kinderen en zwangere vrouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht ‘En weer schat het ministerie het aantal asielzoekers te laag in: locaties 'te laat, te krap en te kort' beschikbaar’

MP Podt asked whether asylum forecasts in the Meerjaren Productie Prognose (MPP) are again too low, why forecasts on family reunification miss, how the MPP is made and whether it should be drawn up outside the asylum chain. The State Secretary acknowledges asylum inflow is above the medium scenario, explains the probabilistic methodology and protocol, and declines to outsource the MPP, citing safeguards already in place.
Following the Regioplan study commissioned by WODC on the governance of the MPP, a policy response was sent to your House last year.
Naar aanleiding van het onderzoek van Regioplan (in opdracht van het WODC) naar de governance van de MPP is vorig jaar een beleidsreactie naar uw Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het opstarten van een mediation traject met het COA, rijk en gemeente Westerwolde

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a council motion in Westerwolde calling for mediation with the COA, the national government and the municipality, and about the COA's alleged failure to honour agreed reception capacity limits at Ter Apel. The State Secretary acknowledged the motion, admitted the 2,000-person cap was not always respected due to pressure on the asylum chain, supported mediation as the preferred route, and said the Ombudsman had been asked to take a role.
The aim of a mediation process is precisely to (re)build trust between the parties on a voluntary basis.
Het streven van een mediation traject is immers gericht op het (her)opbouwen van vertrouwen tussen de partijen op vrijwillige basis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over verschillende kwesties in de gemeentelijke opvang van Oekraïners.

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about friction in municipal reception of Ukrainian displaced persons, including how complaints are handled, rules on nuisance behaviour, and whether shelters can be denied to people. The State Secretary acknowledged friction in some municipalities, said complaints are handled by municipalities with no central complaint figures, and said a joint approach to nuisance is being developed with the VNG and safety regions.
No figures on complaints are kept centrally.
Er worden centraal geen cijfers over klachten bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over problemen voor Oekraïners die zonder verblijfsstickers in Nederland zijn

An MP asked the State Secretary about Ukrainians without residence stickers, including those who were in other EU countries or had expired visas when the war began, and who are being turned away by municipal shelters. The State Secretary answered that such persons fall outside the Temporary Protection Directive, that they can apply for asylum, that objections have no suspensive effect, and that the IND is adjusting BRP registration codes.
Objection to not receiving a residence sticker has no suspensive effect.
Bezwaar tegen het niet ontvangen van een verblijfssticker heeft geen schorsende werking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Van Wijngaarden over de migratieroute via Servië

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about the rise in irregular migration via the Western Balkan route through Serbia, including EU pressure on Serbia's visa regime and possible consequences for its visa-free arrangement. The government shares concern, reports Serbia's recent visa changes after EU diplomatic pressure, says it will monitor progress, and supports EU steps such as Frontex status negotiations and an action plan for the route.
The cabinet will closely monitor progress on this commitment and continue to press for progress.
Het kabinet zal de voortgang op deze toezegging nauwlettend monitoren en op voortgang blijven aandringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het inzetten van Rijksvastgoed en provinciaal vastgoed voor asielopvang

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about using national and provincial real estate for asylum reception, including plans in Zwaagdijk-West (Medemblik) and whether the municipality was informed.
