The government said the spatial planning instrument is not currently being deployed, that a feasibility study is underway with the municipality cooperating, and that the Provincial Executive's compliance with Provinciewet article 167 is for the provincial states to judge.
We would prefer to leave the assessment of that to them.
Oordeelsvorming daarover laten wij graag aan hen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Bikker en Verkuijlen over het bericht 'Centrum tegen Kinderhandel slaat alarm: 'Pa of ma soms pooier eigen kind''

MPs Kuik, Bikker and Verkuijlen asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a report by the Centre against Child Trafficking (CKM) showing rising, younger victims of exploitation, some exploited by their own parents, and whether official data and support reach them. The State Secretary acknowledges the concern, notes that registered figures underestimate true victim numbers, and promises further talks with partners, a 2023 follow-up on the Samen tegen Mensenhandel programme and a research and reporting process.

I will discuss the research results with the CKM/Fier and other relevant chain partners, such as other victim organisations, the police and the Public Prosecution Service, to interpret each other's information further and reach appropriate follow-up steps together.

Ik zal met het CKM/Fier en andere betrokken ketenpartners, zoals andere slachtofferpartijen, politie en OM, in gesprek gaan over de onderzoeksresultaten om elkaars informatie nader te duiden en samen tot passende vervolgstappen te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het dalend aantal opvangplekken in asielzoekerscentra

Ceder (ChristenUnie) asks whether reception places for asylum seekers are falling by 1,250 despite the August asylum agreement, why, what is being done about expiring contracts and the agreement, whether the dispersal law can take effect on 1 January 2023, and for a breakdown per safety region. The Secretary of State answers that about 8,200 to 8,470 emergency crisis places exist, fluctuating as temporary locations open and close, that the Rijk reimburses costs, that a shortfall would be offset by COA capacity, that the dispersal bill is in consultation and depends on the Raad van State and parliament, and that each region targeted 450 places with about 8,400 available.

The municipalities within a safety region decide among themselves, in consultation with e.g. municipal councils, residents and location owners, where crisis emergency reception locations are realised and how long they remain open.

De gemeenten die in een veiligheidsregio liggen bepalen onderling en in afstemming met o.a. gemeenteraden, inwoners en locatie-eigenaren waar crisisnoodopvanglocaties worden gerealiseerd en hoelang deze open zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat er weer asielzoekers op het terrein voor Ter Apel hebben overnacht

An SP MP asks why asylum seekers again slept outside the Ter Apel reception centre, why shelter was not provided, and when emergency reception locations can close, and asks about Westerwolde municipality's agreements and inadequate medical care. The Staatssecretaris answers that about 30 people spent one night outside because no shelter was available at that late hour, that the government is working on alternatives and new municipal reception powers, and that it is willing to talk with Westerwolde, but does not foresee ending emergency reception soon.
I am willing to talk with the municipality of Westerwolde about the future of asylum reception.
Ik ben bereid om met de gemeente Westerwolde te spreken over de toekomst van de asielopvang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Piri over het gebrekkige onderwijsaanbod voor kinderen in asielopvangvoorzieningen

MPs Kröger and Piri asked about children in asylum reception being moved to a cruise ferry without education in place, and why this happens, how often, and what measures will prevent repetition. The government admits the move should not have happened, acknowledges pressure on newcomer education, and points to planned legislation and a flexibilisation agenda to reduce relocations.
Since not all necessary facilities in Velsen were ready for the group, this group should not yet have been moved.
Aangezien voor de groep nog niet alle noodzakelijke voorzieningen in Velsen gereed waren, had deze groep echter nog niet verhuisd moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder en Kuzu over de modernisering van de Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap

MPs from D66, VVD, CDA and DENK asked about the coalition agreement's plans for a private register of unwanted nationality and for revising the automatic loss of Dutch nationality after thirteen years abroad. The government answered that the register is a societal initiative the state would only support if taken up, and that it will draft a bill in the first quarter of 2023 amending the Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap to revise the loss rule and add a recovery option.
I am preparing a bill that amends the Netherlands Nationality Act on these two points.
Ik bereid een wetsvoorstel voor dat de Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap op deze twee onderdelen wijzigt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Piri over ongedocumenteerde studenten die eigenlijk niks kunnen met hun diploma als ze hun opleiding hebben afgerond

MPs De Hoop and Piri asked whether undocumented youths who finish vocational training cannot use their diplomas, whether they were overlooked in labour-shortage measures, and how the government views their exclusion from work, including the German 'Duldung' approach. The State Secretary answered that undocumented migrants are not part of the labour-shortage plan, that admitting them to the labour market is undesirable for migration and welfare reasons, and that this changes no existing policy.
The answers have no consequences for the existing policy.
De antwoorden hebben geen consequenties voor het geldende beleid.
Antwoord op schriftelijke vragen van de leden Piri en Kröger over ‘Nederland kan weer migranten uitzetten naar Marokko - maar mag geen kritiek meer geven op het land’

MPs Piri and Kröger asked whether the Netherlands has stopped publicly criticising human rights abuses in Morocco in exchange for renewed cooperation on migrant returns, and about a possible extradition treaty. The minister replied that the relationship is constructive, denied any agreement to refrain from public criticism, said human rights are discussed case by case and that exploring an extradition treaty is at official level, while committing only to keep the Chamber informed.
No agreements have been made that the Netherlands will no longer publicly voice criticism regarding human rights.
Er zijn geen afspraken gemaakt dat Nederland niet langer openbaar kritiek uit ten aanzien van mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de mobilisatie in Rusland

Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers about Russian mobilisation, refugees fleeing it, Baltic border closures, and whether the departure and decision moratorium should be extended. Minister Hoekstra answered that IND assesses each asylum claim individually, the Netherlands backs a coordinated EU approach, and extending the moratorium is not ruled out while the situation is examined.
In the meantime, we are not taking irreversible steps in asylum and return procedures where a genuine appeal is made on grounds related to the mobilisation.
In de tussentijd nemen we geen onomkeerbare stappen in asiel- en terugkeerprocedures waarin een reëel beroep wordt gedaan op gronden gerelateerd aan de mobilisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de aantallen asielzoekers die gemeenten moeten opvangen als gevolg van de dwangwet

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked whether municipalities had already been told, possibly via the commissaris van de Koning, how many asylum seekers they would have to house under the proposed dwangwet, and asked for per-municipality figures. The State Secretary denied that any such figures had been communicated, said talks on the bill's content were still ongoing, and therefore declined to share numbers.
No, this is not correct. At the time of writing this answer, discussions are still taking place on the content of the bill.
Nee, dit klopt niet. Op het moment van schrijven van deze beantwoording vinden er nog gesprekken plaats over de inhoud van het wetsvoorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het artikel 'Vannacht sliepen toch mensen buiten in Ter Apel'

The Dutch Member of Parliament Podt (D66) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that people slept outside at Ter Apel, the waiting times and shelter, ticketing, responsibility for the forecourt, reception capacity, and AVIM registration backlogs. The State Secretary answered that about 30 people slept outside on one night, that a ticketing system has been in use since 10 September, that shelter and covering are being arranged, and that responsibility for the forecourt is shared by the municipality and the safety region.
It is true that in the night of Tuesday 27 to Wednesday 28 September about 30 people slept outside.
Het klopt dat er in de nacht van dinsdag 27 op woensdag 28 september circa 30 mensen buiten hebben geslapen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de verder verslechterde situatie van minderjarige asielzoekers in het opvangcentrum in Ter Apel

MP Ceder asks the State Secretary why conditions for unaccompanied minor asylum seekers at Ter Apel have worsened since the Children's Ombudsman's April visit, including missing toothbrushes, blankets and beds, and whether hotel accommodation was considered. The State Secretary answers that inflow remains high with little outflow, that minors sometimes slept at the IND registration centre lacking facilities, that other emergency options were exhausted, and promises periodic progress reports but not within three weeks.
I cannot commit to this being within three weeks.
Ik kan u niet toezeggen dat dit binnen drie weken zal zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het luxe Walhalla op de zogeheten asielboot

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a TikTok video showing luxury conditions aboard a ferry used for asylum reception, arguing it attracts asylum seekers and is unaffordable for taxpayers. The State Secretary acknowledged the video, explained that the ferries offer only basic provisions due to a shortage of regular reception places, and said the ministry cannot exclude some pull effect but does not recognise the luxury depicted.
Provisions necessary to meet basic needs are of course available, including shelter and meals.
Voorzieningen die nodig zijn om te voorzien in basisbehoeften zijn uiteraard beschikbaar, waaronder onderdak en maaltijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht ‘Britse regering kondigt hardere koers tegen illegale immigranten aan’

MP Van Haga asked whether the Netherlands would follow the UK in barring illegal entrants from claiming asylum, capping arrivals, and pursuing migration partnerships and tighter border controls. The Secretary of State answered that such bans and caps conflict with EU and international law, pointed to ongoing EU migration measures and partnership work, and referred to letters already sent to parliament.
Setting a maximum on the number of asylum seekers who may lodge an asylum application in the Netherlands would conflict with international treaties and EU law to which the Netherlands is bound.
Het zetten van een maximum op het aantal asielzoekers dat in Nederland een asielverzoek mag indienen, zou in strijd zijn met internationale verdragen en EU-recht waaraan Nederland gebonden is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de voortdurend slechte situatie in het aanmeldcentrum Ter Apel en het weigeren en afslaan van hulp bij de opvangcrisis

An ChristenUnie MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the persistently poor conditions at the Ter Apel registration centre and why offers of help from INLIA and volunteers were refused. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems, listed concrete measures such as cleaning the sports hall, phased transfers and extended medical hours, and said cooperation with INLIA and other organisations is ongoing, while stating that coordination of volunteer aid is needed.
Immediately it will be examined whether asylum seekers transferred from Marnewaard to Ter Apel for identification and registration can be brought in phases.
Per direct zal worden onderzocht of asielzoekers die vanuit Marnewaard naar Ter Apel worden gebracht om het identificatie en registratie proces te doorlopen, gefaseerd kunnen worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het realiseren van een aanmeldcentrum voor asielzoekers in Bant

MP Podt asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the collapse of a planned asylum registration centre in Bant, Noordoostpolder, what the next steps are, and why the alternative is housing family reunifiers. The State Secretary says COA withdrew the request after local opposition, the municipality now offers a 300-place alternative mainly for family reunifiers, and no timeline for a new location can yet be given because it depends on municipal cooperation.
I am in discussions at various locations in the Netherlands about realising an additional registration centre.
Ik ben op diverse plaatsen in Nederland in gesprek voor de realisatie van een additioneel aanmeldcentrum.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de opvangcrisis

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the reception crisis at Ter Apel, the causes, the sudden designation of a reception centre in Albergen, and fair distribution of asylum seekers. The State Secretary acknowledges a severe shortage of reception places, describes the Albergen agreement with Tubbergen and the COA, and promises a bill on municipal reception duties, while not fully answering questions on causes and the process.
To respond to changing inflow, the national government, provinces, COA and VNG have made agreements in the Implementation Agenda for Flexibilising the Asylum Chain.
Om in te kunnen spelen op veranderende instroom hebben het rijk, de provincies, het COA en de VNG afspraken gemaakt in de Uitvoeringsagenda Flexibilisering Asielketen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de nieuwsberichten 'Veiligheid en gezondheid van kinderen zonder ouders in de asielopvang onder de maat' en 'Minderjarige alleenstaande asielzoekers geëvacueerd uit Ter Apel, omda

The MP asks about inspectorate findings on unsafe and unhealthy conditions for unaccompanied minor asylum seekers in Ter Apel, and what has been done since April. The state secretary acknowledges severe overcrowding and understaffing, lists interim measures (extra security, cleaning, early transfers, emergency shelters) and structural plans for more reception places, while admitting the measures are insufficient and that staffing shortages persist.
The main means to improve the situation in Ter Apel for amv immediately and structurally, however, is to reduce the occupancy and length of stay.
Het voornaamste middel om de situatie in Ter Apel voor amv per direct en structureel te verbeteren is echter het terugschroeven van de bezetting en de verblijfsduur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de verdringing van legaal sekswerk door illegaal sekswerk

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about legal sex work being displaced by illegal sex work, citing a newspaper report that the legal sector is struggling partly because of government policy. The government answered that local regulation varies, that unlicensed work carries risks, that it is working on financial access, the opting-in scheme, COVID support gaps and stigma, and that it is engaging the sector and municipalities, though it made no firm commitment to new legislation beyond the planned regulation bill.
Together with the relevant ministries and partners in the local domain, I continue to engage with the sex industry as a full discussion partner.
Ik blijf, samen met de betrokken ministeries en met partners uit het lokale domein, in gesprek met de seksbranche als een volwaardige gesprekspartner.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Eerdmans over het bericht dat honderden verdwijnstudenten uit het buitenland misbruik maken van studentenvisa

Opposition MPs Pouw-Verweij and Eerdmans asked whether international students using study visas who then disappear from view, and whether a quota and higher fees would help. The minister answered that such misuse is undesirable, that the IND is investigating Bangladeshi student cases, that a quota has no legal basis, and that more monitoring and sector measures will follow.
This gave the IND cause to examine this further.
Dit was voor de IND aanleiding om dit nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de aangekondigde aanwijzing van een locatie in Albergen als asielzoekerscentrum

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about communication with Tubbergen municipality, the procedure for siting an asylum centre in Albergen via the national-interest route, and the consultation and objection rights of residents and the council. The government answered in detail on the procedure, the absence of required council consent, and the ex-post objection route, but declined to deliver the requested full documents now (pending a Woo request) and said it could not answer within two weeks.
There is no legally prescribed prior consultation round.
Er is geen wettelijk voorgeschreven voorafgaande inspraakronde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over criminele asielzoekers uit veilige landen

Eerdmans (JA21) asked the State Secretary and Minister of Justice and Security about criminal asylum seekers from safe countries causing nuisance and crime in Amsterdam, and about measures such as detention, returns, and cooperation with countries of origin. The government answered at length, giving incident statistics, stating that police do not register specifically on this group, describing new nuisance-coordination and return measures, and saying detention during the asylum procedure is being explored more broadly while detention is limited by legal conditions.
This cannot be provided. The police do not register specifically on safe-country nationals.
Deze is niet te geven. De politie registreert niet specifiek op veiligelanders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over vluchtende alleenreizende kinderen uit Oekraïne

MP Koekkoek asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security whether the registration of unaccompanied Ukrainian refugee children is adequate compared with other EU states, including whether age and gender are recorded and what action is taken. The State Secretary acknowledged early confusion over referral routes, described new procedures routing all unaccompanied minors to Nidos, reported growing registration numbers and EU coordination, but gave only partial answers on some points and largely restated existing procedures.
These arrangements at the time led to confusion, as a result of which registration and monitoring of this group did not always take place.
Deze afspraken hebben toentertijd tot verwarring geleid, waardoor registratie en monitoring van deze groep niet altijd plaatsvond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Piri over de aanpak van de inhumane situatie bij Aanmeldcentrum Ter Apel

MPs Kröger and Piri asked about the government's plans to address the inhumane situation at the Ter Apel reception centre, including the 20,000 status-holder housing target, 225 extra crisis shelter places per safety region, the limited supervision of unaccompanied minors, basic facilities, and whether the armed forces should be deployed. The State Secretary answered that the housing and shelter measures are additional, that shelter places are being created in the short and medium term, that a temporary forecourt facility opened on 10 September, and that the armed forces already support reception and will prepare further aid, while not addressing the minors' supervision directly.
Thanks to the Ministry of Defence and the municipality of Hogeland, the forecourt facility on the Marnewaard site was brought into use on 10 September 2022.
Met dank aan het Ministerie van Defensie en de gemeente Hogeland is op 10 september 2022 het voorportaal op het terrein van de Marnewaard in gebruik genomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over het rapport 'In Europa uitgebuit nergens beschermd', het bericht 'Nederland stuurt slachtoffers mensenhandel terug naar Italië ondanks risico op herhaalde uitbuiting'

MPs Bikker and Ceder asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about a Salvation Army report on Nigerian trafficking victims, a report on returns of trafficking victims to Italy, and implementation of the Segers/Buitenweg motion. The State Secretary answered that the government relies on mutual trust among member states, that the B8/3 residence scheme was amended in 2019 with an evaluation due in 2023, and that the IND's multidisciplinary pilot had limited reach, while committing to further study and possible follow-up.
It is then up to the receiving member state to organise appropriate care.
Het is dan aan de ontvangende lidstaat om gepaste zorg te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de verplichte asielopvang in Tubbergen

MP Kuik (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security why the Albergen hotel was chosen for mandatory asylum reception in Tubbergen, how municipal consultation was handled, and how trust with the municipality can be restored. The State Secretary answered that the hotel was offered to the COA, that talks with Tubbergen took place from April to June without agreement on asylum seekers, and that the government intends to use the RO-instrument if needed while pledging continued dialogue.
Granting a permit by the government through the so-called RO-instrument is a measure that is far from ideal in many respects.
Het verlenen van een vergunning door de overheid door middel van het zogenaamde RO-instrumentarium is een maatregel die in vele opzichten verre van ideaal is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de opvang van Oekraïense vluchtelingen

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the reception of Ukrainian refugees, covering residence stickers, travel documents, IND waiting times, particular-housing shifts, student access, and bank accounts. The government answered that the IND has issued about 45,000 stickers with a temporary pause, that the work-permit transition was extended to 31 October 2022, and that roughly a quarter of adult displaced persons may lack a bank account, with solutions still being explored.
The aim is for displaced persons from Ukraine already registered in the BRP before 1 November 2022 to be able to collect their residence document (sticker or O-document).
Het streven is dat ontheemden uit Oekraïne die reeds zijn ingeschreven in de BRP voor 1 november 2022 in de gelegenheid zijn om hun verblijfsbewijs (sticker of O-document) op te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht dat fors meer kinderen zich in Nederland in hun eentje voor asiel melden

An MP asked the State Secretary whether unaccompanied minors are sent ahead to benefit from family reunification and whether the rules can be changed, and asked about Council of State and European case law. The government answered that the family reunification rules do not disadvantage minors, that Dublin rules for minors are distinct, that changing policy to deter sending children ahead would be undesirable, and cited court rulings on Greece, Malta, Croatia and Hungary.
Together with other member states, the cabinet therefore urges the European Commission to present a concrete plan to fully resume Dublin transfers to Greece.
Samen met andere lidstaten spoort het kabinet de Europese Commissie dan ook aan om een concreet plan te presenteren om Dublintransfers naar Griekenland weer volledig te hervatten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over het bericht 'Advies: stop met de crisisaanpak van asielzoekers, creëer meer buffercapaciteit aan opvangplekken'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about advice to stop the crisis approach to asylum reception and build buffer capacity, and about the government's asylum reception policy, funding, municipal role, staffing and crisis organisation. The State Secretary answered at length, acknowledging strain on reception quality, outlining plans for a stable and flexible reception system and a planned legal municipal task, but giving only general answers on several points and deferring details to later letters.
The government's efforts to realise a stable and flexible reception landscape bear this out.
De inzet van het kabinet om een stabiel en flexibel opvanglandschap te realiseren, getuigt hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht 'Dorpen samen in het geweer tegen komst aanmeldcentrum: 'Toezegging geschonden''

MP Bisschop asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the purchase of a site in Bant for a new asylum registration centre, the alleged broken promise to villages, the role of the Commissioner of the King as state organ, and the lack of municipal support. The State Secretary answered that the COA bought the site after provincial talks, that municipal and village consultation is ongoing, and that binding legal instruments may be needed in the long term.
In the further elaboration, cooperation with the municipality, residents and stakeholders will be explicitly sought.
Bij de verdere uitwerking zal nadrukkelijk de samenwerking met gemeente, omwonenden en belanghebbenden worden gezocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Piri over de intentie om het recht van statushouders op gezinshereniging te beperken

MPs Kröger and Piri asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the planned restriction of family reunification rights for refugees with status, and whether it complies with the Children's Rights Convention and EU law. The State Secretary answered that the best interests of the child remain central, that reunification is only postponed by up to six months, and that the measure was chosen as necessary to address the reception crisis, while the courts would ultimately judge its legal tenability.
In every situation it is ultimately up to the judiciary to rule on the legal tenability.
In elke situatie is het uiteindelijk aan de rechtspraak om te oordelen over de juridische houdbaarheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de aankopen en transacties in het kader van het nieuwe aanmeldcentrum in Bant

An MP asked the State Secretary for a detailed reconstruction of how the COA acquired a plot in Bant for a new reception centre, including total costs, who paid each component, and how values were set. The government described the April-July 2022 sequence of contacts via the Commissaris van de Koning, declined to disclose the purchase price citing private-law confidentiality, and said values were set by an official appraisal.
In general I do not make substantive statements about the content of a private-law agreement with a private owner.
Ik doe in het algemeen geen inhoudelijke mededelingen over de inhoud van een privaatrechtelijke overeenkomst met een particuliere eigenaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het optreden van een CdK als Rijksheer ten behoeve van asielopvang

An MP asked whether the Flevoland commissaris van de Koning acted as a Rijksheer (state officer) rather than as a Rijksorgaan when facilitating asylum reception, and what legal basis applied. The Minister answers that the commissaris acted as Rijksorgaan under article 182 Provinciewet and Ambtsinstructie, without decision-making power, and that terminology has been used loosely but has no consequences for legal validity.
We will bring this to the attention of all those involved, to prevent future confusion.
Wij zullen dit bij alle betrokkenen onder de aandacht brengen, om toekomstige verwarring te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht 'Oneigenlijk gebruik van opvang'

Slootweg asked whether arbitrage workers from Ukraine who are not war refugees lack a legal basis to be refused temporary protection shelter, benefits and housing, and how many there are nationally. The State Secretary answered that such workers are also displaced and may use the ROOO scheme unless they have work income or housing elsewhere, that no national figures exist, that the IND will not actively pursue return, and that post-expiry policy is still being worked out.
No integrated figures are available on the number of Ukrainian labour migrants already in the Netherlands who fall under the Temporary Protection Directive.
Er zijn geen integrale cijfers beschikbaar van het aantal arbeidsmigranten uit Oekraïne die al in Nederland verbleven en onder de Richtlijn Tijdelijke Bescherming (RTB) vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de toestroom van asielzoekers naar Nederland via EU-lidstaten

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about asylum seekers arriving via other EU member states, including modes of arrival, Dublin responsibility, returns, border monitoring, and whether a border control or asylum stop should be introduced. The government answered that most arrivals are secondary migration with unknown entry routes, that Dublin transfers are constrained, that most cases are still pending, and that an asylum stop has no legal basis under Article 111 of the Aliens Act, with a legal exploration promised.
The precise number of asylum seekers arriving by land is therefore not known.
Het precieze aantal asielzoekers dat via land aankomt, is dan ook niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paulusma over het toenemende aantal covid-besmettingen in relatie tot de asielopvang

MPs Podt and Paulusma asked about rising COVID-19 infections in asylum reception centres, including monitoring, prevention measures, vaccination rates, quarantine capacity and staffing contingency planning. The State Secretary answered that COA relies on self-tests with no registration of positives due to GDPR, that measures and vaccination information are in place, that vaccination uptake cannot be measured, and that scenarios are being prepared by COA and IND.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Verkuijlen over het rapport ‘Jonge Nederlandse slachtoffers criminele uitbuiting witte vlek in aanpak ondermijning van Centrum kinderhandel en mensenhandel’

MPs Bikker and Verkuijlen asked the ministers about the CKM report on young Dutch victims of criminal exploitation, its link to organised crime, recognition of victims and the Dutch versus UK definitions. The government acknowledges the report, commits to a broader prevention approach, to working with the UK, and to a follow-up letter on the second report and the modernisation of article 273f Sr.
We endorse the findings of the report and the recommendation to anchor the approach to criminal exploitation and make it part of the approach to organised and undermining crime.

Wij onderschrijven de bevindingen uit het rapport en de aanbeveling om de aanpak van criminele uitbuiting te verankeren en deze onderdeel te maken van de aanpak georganiseerde en ondermijnende criminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het rapport Death in Slow Motion: Women and girls under Taliban rule van Amnesty International van 27 juli 2022

An MP asked the Foreign and Justice ministers about Amnesty International's report on women and girls under Taliban rule, including the lifting of the asylum decision and departure moratorium for Afghans, the treatment of Afghan women asylum seekers, and sanctions and humanitarian aid. The government said it is pursuing diplomatic and financial support focused on women's and girls' rights, will give the benefit of the doubt in individual asylum cases involving (imputed) Westernised women, and that the UN sanctions regime does not block health care or food supplies.
The Cabinet has great concerns about the increasing repressive measures against women and girls in Afghanistan.
Het Kabinet heeft grote zorgen over de toenemende repressieve maatregelen tegen vrouwen en meisjes in Afghanistan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht Moeder van mishandelde jongen (5) uit azc Katwijk: 'Hij reageert anders'

An MP asked the State Secretary about a report that a five-year-old boy was beaten at the Katwijk asylum centre, the slow police investigation, safety and mental health measures, and the mother's criticism of the COA. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, pointed to the ongoing investigation and to 24-hour security and COA supervision, and said COA can refer residents and transfer them if needed.
It is important that this investigation is carried out carefully. In the interest of proper procedure, I am awaiting the outcome.
Het is van belang dat dit onderzoek zorgvuldig plaatsvindt. In het belang van een goede procesorde wacht ik de uitkomst af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht ‘Nederland koploper naturalisatie: ruim 45.000 asielzoekers kregen paspoort‘

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a report that the Netherlands led the world in naturalising asylum seekers in 2021, and about related questions on comparisons with other EU states, immigration policy, naturalisation conditions, and Dublin transfers to Greece. The State Secretary declined to compare the figures without knowing their definitions, pointed to Eurostat data, referred to EU migration pact initiatives, said naturalisation conditions were stated but not reconsidered, and promised a separate letter on Greek beneficiaries of protection.
I cannot substantively address the comparison named, as it is not known which definitions were used for the figures cited in the report.
Op de genoemde vergelijking kan ik niet inhoudelijk ingaan, aangezien niet bekend is welke definities gehanteerd zijn bij de in het bericht genoemde cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Piri en Ceder over de toezeggingen die zijn gedaan aan de veiligheidsregio’s t.a.v. (extra) crisisnoodopvanglocaties voor asielzoekers

MPs Piri and Ceder asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the government's commitments to safety regions on medical care, staffing and registration at emergency reception locations for asylum seekers. The answers say medical care at some locations is not yet adequate, around 80 civil servants are assigned to specific locations with about 30 active, and registration is being intensified.
The cabinet is currently examining whether it is possible to organise care with other parties in the regions where this has not yet succeeded.
Momenteel onderzoekt het kabinet of het mogelijk is met andere partijen alsnog de zorg te organiseren in de regio's waar dat tot nu toe nog niet gelukt is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de aanhoudende chaos bij asielzoekerscentrum Ter Apel en de bevindingen van het Rode Kruis

The MP asks the State Secretary how he will address the chaos at the Ter Apel asylum centre, the Red Cross's warnings about an inhumane situation, safety in the area, and whether immigration-restricting measures are needed. The State Secretary responds that a crisis structure with three phases is being activated, that further measures including emergency shelter expansion and use of spatial-planning instruments are planned, that he does not agree with closing the tap, and that a legal exploration of an asylum admission stop will follow after the summer recess.
During the committee debate of 30 June I promised your House a legal exploration of, among other things, a temporary asylum processing stop.
Tijdens het commissiedebat van 30 juni jl. heb ik uw Kamer een juridische verkenning toegezegd naar o.a. een tijdelijke asielbehandelstop
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over derde- en veiligelanders die bij bosjes Nederland in komen

Van Haga asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about third-country and safe-country nationals entering the Netherlands among asylum seekers, whether border controls should be strengthened, a second and third reception centre, IND staff vacancies, and the impact on social cohesion. The State Secretary answered that asylum claims are assessed individually, that internal border controls can only be reinstated on serious threats to public order, that a second reception centre is needed and more may follow, that IND vacancies reflect a tight labour market, and that migration policy depends on public support.
At the same time, I do not rule out that more reception centres will be established in the future.
Daarbij sluit ik niet uit dat er in de toekomst nog meer aanmeldcentra zullen komen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over noodkreet burgemeester Hardenberg over overlastgevende asielzoekers

An MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a mayor's call over nuisance from asylum seekers, including whether those from Morocco and Algeria should be excluded and whether applications should be destroyed, and about the government's plan to help Hardenberg. The State Secretary rejects the exclusionary positions, points to the procedural rights of asylum seekers and existing measures, and outlines contact with the mayor, a funding scheme and a planned process location.
During the asylum procedure, asylum seekers have the right to reception, regardless of where they come from.
Tijdens de asielprocedure hebben asielzoekers recht op opvang, ongeacht waar ze vandaan komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de situatie in Ter Apel

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the crisis at the Ter Apel asylum reception centre and the municipality of Westerwolde's ten-point plan, including whether he agrees with it and what he will do, and whether the Red Cross withdrew because refugees had gone 12 hours without food or drink. The State Secretary acknowledged the situation is unacceptable, said it has been escalated to national crisis management, and answered each measure with reference to planned or existing steps, several of which are referred to earlier letters.

I can assure you that all efforts are aimed at achieving rapid results, first and foremost to resolve the acute shortages in asylum reception and remedy the pressing situation at the Ter Apel location.

Ik kan u verzekeren dat alle inzet erop is gericht om snelle resultaten te boeken, in de eerste plaats om de acute tekorten in de asielopvang op te lossen en de nijpende situatie op de locatie Ter Apel te verhelpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht 'Onrust in azc Katwijk na mishandeling Adam (5)'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the reported assault on a five-year-old boy at the Katwijk asylum centre, including oversight, registration of incidents, and whether the centre's safety policy is adequate. The State Secretary declined to comment on the case because a criminal investigation is ongoing, pointed to a WODC report with incident statistics, and said no additional safety measures were needed for now.
In the interest of a careful legal process I cannot make statements about what happened, partly because the investigation has not yet been completed.
In het belang van een zorgvuldige procesgang kan ik geen mededelingen doen over wat er is gebeurd, mede omdat het onderzoek nog niet is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht 'Uitspraak Europees Hof zet Nederlands asielbeleid op losse schroeven; staat mag documenten asielzoeker niet meer zomaar opzijschuiven'

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a Volkskrant report that a European Court ruling and a Council of State ruling require the Netherlands to stop setting aside documents submitted by asylum seekers, and asked what concrete steps will ensure a realistic burden of proof, equality of arms, the benefit of the doubt, and safeguards in the return process. The State Secretary answered that the current IND practice is compliant with EU law, that documents of unverified authenticity may be weighed, that the benefit of the doubt is applied where appropriate, and that the return process contains several opportunities for the individual to raise risks.
I consider the current working method of the IND to be in line with the relevant case law of the EU Court of Justice and the Council of State.
Ik acht de huidige werkwijze van de IND in overeenstemming met de hier bedoelde jurisprudentie van het EU-Hof van Justitie en de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht ‘De IND komt vaak niet opdagen bij rechtszaken’

MP Podt asked why the IND (immigration service) often fails to appear at court hearings in asylum cases and whether this harms asylum seekers, and the state secretary replied that about 11% of cases had no IND representation due to staffing shortages, planning problems and sick leave, while stating that the IND screens cases and that absence is unwanted but usually does not harm applicants; he also described measures to improve planning with the courts.
Yes, the IND cannot retrieve from its system in how many cases it was absent from court hearings, but manual registration shows that in about 11% of cases no IND representation was present.

Antwoord 2 Ja, de IND kan niet uit het systeem halen in hoeveel zaken zij niet aanwezig was bij de rechtszaken, maar uit een handmatige registratie blijkt dat bij ongeveer 11% van de zaken (alle gerechtelijke procedures) geen vertegenwoordiging van de IND aanwezig was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht ‘Kabinet overweegt asielopvang op zee, huidige situatie kan nog weken duren’

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether asylum seekers would be housed on cruise ships moored offshore, and whether this is humane and compatible with EU and international law. The State Secretary replied that offshore reception was examined but rejected because of too many disadvantages, including weather-dependent transport and restricted freedom of movement, which would be unlawful.
This initial inventory showed that there are too many disadvantages attached to offshore reception.
Uit deze eerste inventarisatie is gebleken dat er te veel nadelen aan opvang op open zee kleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over asielopvang op cruiseschepen op zee

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether housing asylum seekers on cruise ships at sea is being seriously pursued, and about its legal feasibility, humane conditions and the failure of talks with safety regions. The State Secretary replied that the option was examined but dropped due to disadvantages, that humane treatment is a criterion, and that the national asylum-capacity plan will be accelerated.
This option is therefore currently not being investigated further, as reported to your House on 28 July 2022.
Deze optie wordt daarom momenteel dan ook niet verder onderzocht, zoals aan uw Kamer gemeld dd. 28 juli 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over aanhoudende diefstal, intimidatie en agressie veroorzaakt door asielzoekers

An MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about asylum-seeker nuisance, theft and intimidation in Ter Apel, including the status of a promise on expelling offenders, figures on removals, compensation for residents and businesses, and when the borders will close. The State Secretary answers that the open-order policy is existing practice, provides figures on revoked asylum permits and removals, points to support schemes and an intended separate facility for weak asylum cases, and rejects closing the borders as unrealistic.
This is not a promise, but existing policy that is being implemented.
Dit is geen belofte, maar staand beleid dat wordt uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Oekraïense vluchtelingen met een beperking zijn blinde vlek voor Nederland’

MPs Bisschop and Van der Staaij asked how care and reception for Ukrainian refugees with disabilities is organised, given reports that a support organisation lacks government funding and coordination, and whether a national coordinator is needed. The minister answered that the EU distribution procedure applies, that care is available via the RMA/Wlz and municipal Wmo, that the ministry is exploring a contribution to the organisation's costs, and that a separate coordination point is not necessary given limited uptake.
On the basis of a request from Soft Tulip, the Ministry of Justice and Security is exploring the possibilities to contribute to the organisation's costs.
Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid verkent op basis van een verzoek van Soft Tulip de mogelijkheden om bij te dragen aan de kosten van de organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Brekelmans, Ceder en Slootweg over actuele problemen van Oekraïense ontheemden

MPs asked the state secretary and ministers about problems faced by Ukrainian displaced persons, including education, income, childcare, information and housing. The government answered that municipal education choices are acceptable, rejected a fully Ukrainian curriculum for children in the Netherlands, and described existing benefit, childcare and housing measures.
It is essential that children receive a full educational offer that suits their development.
Het is namelijk essentieel dat kinderen een volwaardig onderwijsaanbod krijgen dat past bij hun ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de situatie met betrekking tot de Oeigoeren

MP Sjoerdsma asked the government about the Xinjiang Police Files, whether the Uyghur situation should be called genocide, UN and ICC follow-up, business complicity, protection of Uyghurs in the Netherlands and family reunification. The minister condemned the abuses, joined a 47-country UN statement, said genocide recognition is under EU-level review, and outlined existing measures while noting limits on information and responsibility lying elsewhere.
The cabinet has noted the visit of UN High Commissioner Bachelet to Xinjiang and the fact that the visit was not an investigative mission.
Het kabinet heeft nota genomen van het bezoek van de VN Hoge Commissaris van de Mensenrechten Bachelet aan Xinjiang en het feit dat het bezoek geen onderzoeksmissie was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de schrijnende situatie van een Iraniër die met de dood wordt bedreigd

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the case of an Iranian asylum seeker threatened with death, including proof requirements for refugees, conversion claims, and whether his case should be reviewed as a hardship case. The State Secretary declines to discuss individual cases, explains the evidentiary and credibility rules and the conversion assessment framework, and refuses to refer the case to the IND for a hardship review.
As you know, I cannot go into individual cases.
Zoals u weet kan ik niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over oneigenlijk gebruik leefgeld

An MP asked the ministers about reports that Ukrainian arbeidsmigranten who were already in the Netherlands before the war are claiming leefgeld, and how misuse of refugee facilities and exploitation of Ukrainians will be tackled. The government answered that such workers can fall within the temporary protection group and so be eligible, that municipalities get support and verification via the IND, and that the Arbeidsinspectie is investigating possible labour-law violations and the Aanjaagteam recommendations are being implemented.

Persons who were already in the Netherlands as labour migrants before the Russian attack can therefore fall within the target group and in that case are also eligible for reception and the associated leefgeld.

Personen die voor de Russische aanval al in Nederland waren als arbeidsmigrant kunnen derhalve onder de doelgroep vallen en komen in dat geval ook in aanmerking voor opvang en het bijbehorende leefgeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de bescherming van Russische vluchtelingen

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether the government should be more generous toward Russian asylum seekers, including conscientious objectors and deserters, given Russia's repression and the 2022 invasion of Ukraine, and whether it would impose a moratorium or designate them as a risk group. The State Secretary answered that Russian asylum policy is adequate and not strict: the existing country-specific policy covers activists, journalists, LHBT people and others, a six-month decision and departure moratorium was introduced for Russian male conscripts aged 18-27 who refuse or desert, and a new general country report is expected in early 2023.
For this reason it was decided to introduce a decision and departure moratorium for a period of six months after entry into force for Russian conscripts who refuse military service or desert.

Om deze reden is er besloten om een besluit- en vertrekmoratorium in te stellen voor een periode van zes maanden na inwerkingtreding voor Russische dienstplichtigen die dienstweigeren of die deserteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht 'Frontex left 'traumatised' says caretaking leadership'

MP Slootweg (CDA) asks the State Secretary about reports that Frontex staff refuse to work amid poor rights records, the impact of the executive director's departure, the Greek operation, returns figures and risk analyses. The State Secretary says operations continue, the director's exit does not affect returns or risk analysis, Frontex retains powers to suspend operations, and the government condemns rights violations at the border while leaving primary responsibility to member states.
The cabinet takes a position against all forms of human rights violations at the external border.
Het kabinet neemt stelling tegen alle vormen van het schenden van mensenrechten aan de buitengrens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Kröger over het bericht ‘Verdriet en onbegrip over starre aanmeldprocedure in Ter Apel: 'Niemand kan dit uitleggen''

MPs Piri and Kröger asked why newly arriving family members (nareizigers) of asylum status holders must still register at the Ter Apel reception centre despite the shortage of places, and whether the obligation could be dropped. The Secretary of State answered that registration is needed for BRP enrolment, TB screening and identity checks, that a separate Zevenaar route exists for some groups, and that COA and IND are working towards a change by end 2022 without yet committing to scrapping the obligation.
I agree that it would be good if the process for family members whose sponsor takes part in the guest arrangement or hotel arrangement no longer burdened the reception in Ter Apel.

Ik deel dan ook dat het goed zou zijn als het proces voor nareizigers van wie de referent deelneemt aan de logeerregeling of de hotelregeling en de verblijfplaats van de vreemdeling ook opvangmogelijkheden biedt voor de nagereisde familieleden, niet meer de opvang in Ter Apel zou belasten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Verkuijlen over het bericht dat mogelijk ook een Nederlandse moskee een rol speelt in constructies voor mensenhandel en prostitutie

MPs Becker and Verkuijlen asked the government about reports that Dutch mosques may be involved in sham 'pleasure marriages' linked to sex work and trafficking, and about possible investigation, prosecution and sanctions. The minister answered that no signals of such marriages in the Netherlands have been received, that no investigation is planned, that the OM sees no current signs of crimes, and that the Taskforce cannot investigate individuals, while pointing to the pending Wtmo amendment and other planned instruments.
The OM has indicated that there are currently no signals of criminal offences.
Het OM heeft laten weten dat er op dit moment geen signalen zijn van strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de zorgelijke situatie rondom de aanmeldprocedure van nareizigers

An MP asked the State Secretary about the situation at Ter Apel, where family reunification migrants (nareizigers) must register there even when they could stay with a sponsor, occupying scarce reception beds. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, said COA and IND are exploring alternatives such as a separate location and streamlined procedures, but gave no firm timeline and noted that a thorough registration process remains necessary.
COA and IND are currently exploring the possibilities for this.
Het COA en de IND zijn momenteel de mogelijkheden daartoe aan het verkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht ‘Vlissingen en Velsen eerste mega-opvanglocaties voor vluchtelingen

MP Van Haga asks the State Secretary about reports of cruise ships and a land site being used as mass refugee reception locations in Vlissingen, Velsen and The Hague, including how the sites were chosen, costs, rationale, and impacts on local communities. The State Secretary answers that no formal decisions have been taken, that municipalities decide and talks are ongoing, that cruise ships are a short-term buffer during a reception crisis costing per-day charter fees plus extra costs, and that COA will prepare plans for liveability, safety and local impacts.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het ethisch profileren bij de IND bij 'erkend referenten'

MPs Leijten and Jasper van Dijk asked why the IND's risk model for recognised sponsors (erkend referenten), which registered company board composition and reportedly profiled by origin, was stopped without public notice, whether other ministries were informed, and whether risk profiling by government should be halted. The government replied that the model had no consequences for decisions, that the board-composition indicator was never used in scoring but was wrongly registered, that it acknowledged an unheeded 2017 legal warning, and that it will inform the House before the summer recess on the results of the Motion#21 investigation into discriminatory risk models.
I regret that an internal memo from the IND's Legal Affairs department, which in 2017 advised stopping the risk model, was not acted on more quickly.
Ik betreur dat er niet sneller opvolging is gegeven aan een interne notitie van de afdeling Juridische Zaken van de IND, die in 2017 adviseerde met het risicomodel te stoppen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over risicoprofilering door de Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst (IND)

MP Mutluer asked the government about the IND's risk model for recognised sponsors, which since 2014 recorded the ethnic background of company boards and continued until May 2021 despite internal warnings. The State Secretary admitted the registration should not have happened, said it had no effect on decisions, and announced a new risk model under review by TNO.
I want to state at the outset that registering the origin of the company board should not have happened.
Ik wil voorop stellen dat het registreren van de afkomst van het bedrijfsbestuur niet had mogen gebeuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de opvang van 1.000 Oekraïense vluchtelingen in Vlaardingen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the planned temporary reception village for up to 1,000 Ukrainian refugees in Vlaardingen, including whether the government would sign the financial guarantee the municipality needed by 23 June 2022. The State Secretary confirmed the talks and shared interest, but said the revised financial proposal requires significant national guarantees and needs careful assessment before a decision.
The consultation will be continued aimed at giving a decision on Thursday.
Het overleg wordt voortgezet gericht op uitsluitsel op donderdag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over lange wachttijden bij de IND

An MP asked the State Secretary about long IND waiting times for biometrics and residence documents, the requirement to re-submit biometrics at each renewal, and the closure of the Rotterdam counter. The State Secretary explained the EU and ICAO rules behind the requirement, attributed waiting times to rising applications and labour shortages, listed measures such as extended opening hours and recruitment, and promised a letter before the summer recess on the asylum chain.
From early July the IND will have part of the residence documents delivered by the IPKD.
De IND zal per begin juli een deel van de verblijfsdocumenten laten bezorgen door de IKPD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over aanranding door asielzoekers

Van Haga asks whether the State Secretary agrees that asylum seekers who break the law should forfeit their asylum prospects and be deported, whether he will deport three suspects in an assault case, and whether Nederland is too lenient toward misbehaving asylum seekers. The State Secretary answers that offenders are prosecuted in the Netherlands, that residence can be refused or withdrawn only after serious criminal convictions under EU rules, that individual cases cannot be discussed, that a shuttle bus was introduced to curb nuisance, and that the House will be informed annually through incident reports.
Without a criminal conviction there is no legal basis to proceed with termination of residence and deportation.
Zonder strafrechtelijke veroordeling bestaat er geen juridische grondslag om over te gaan tot verblijfsbeëindiging en uitzetting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de situatie van Jezidi’s

An SP MP asked the government about conditions for Yazidis in Sinjar and Iraqi camps, including psychological care, reconstruction spending, and a dedicated resettlement programme for Yazidis like France, Germany and Canada. The minister acknowledged the gravity of the situation, described funding for psychosocial aid and UNDP reconstruction, but declined a special asylum programme since Dutch policy has no framework for such transfers, and explained UNHCR resettlement criteria.
The Netherlands has no policy framework for transferring people from their country of origin for asylum in the Netherlands, and therefore has no policy for transferring Yazidis.
Nederland kent geen beleidskader voor de overbrenging van mensen uit hun land van herkomst voor asiel in Nederland en heeft dus ook geen beleid voor de overbrenging van Jezidi’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Bikker over het bericht 'Gevaar loert voor Oekraïense vluchtelingen: 'Prostitutie, gedwongen adoptie en uitbuiting''

MPs Kuik (CDA) and Bikker (ChristenUnie) asked how Ukrainian refugees are protected against exploitation, trafficking, and unclear coordination of private reception, and whether a reception ambassador is needed. The State Secretary answered that the government works with partners on awareness, flyers, EMPACT information sharing, and a new reception organisation, while noting dozens of registered incidents and one investigation, with no trafficking found in controls.

The cabinet works with various chain partners, such as civil society organisations (including the Red Cross and the Salvation Army) and churches, to make displaced persons from Ukraine aware of the risks of exploitation when staying with private individuals.

Het kabinet zet zich met de verschillende ketenpartners, zoals maatschappelijke organisaties (zoals het Rode Kruis en het Leger des Heils) en kerken in om ontheemden uit Oekraïne bewust te maken van de risico's op uitbuiting als ze bij particulieren gaan verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over berichten over wangedrag in azc’s

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about reports of violence and drug-related incidents at asylum reception centres, including whether an asylum seeker who attacked staff would be deported and what measures protect staff. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual cases, stated that deportation follows detention and that staff safety is under review, and promised further information before the summer recess.
As your House is aware, I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, kan ik over individuele zaken geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht dat gemeenten die Oekraïners particulier opvangen niet worden gesteund

An MP asked whether the government excludes refugees housed privately from its reception targets and whether municipalities doing private placements deserve support. The Secretary of State answered that private hosting is voluntary, that targets apply only to municipal reception, and that municipalities receive reimbursement and compensation for private-host costs.
Providing shelter to a displaced person from Ukraine in a private home is a voluntary choice of a host household.
Het onderdak bieden aan een ontheemde uit Oekraïne in een particuliere woning is een vrijwillige keuze van een gasthuishouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Podt over het bericht ‘Surinaamse leerkrachten kunnen ons lerarentekort opvangen, maar ze mogen niet komen’ en de uitzending van Kassa van 5 maart 2022

MPs Van Meenen and Podt asked why Surinamese teachers were refused residence and work permits in the Netherlands despite a teacher shortage, and whether Suriname has a teacher surplus. The minister answered that permits are refused when Wav conditions, including qualifications and priority supply, are not met, that there is no evidence of a surplus in Suriname, and that the Netherlands will focus mainly on domestic recruitment and retention.
The reason for refusal was that the conditions set in the Foreign Workers Employment Act (Wav) were not met, including possessing the correct qualifications.
Reden voor afwijzing was dat niet voldaan werd aan de voorwaarden die in de Wet arbeid vreemdelingen (hierna: Wav) worden gesteld, waaronder het beschikken over de juiste kwalificaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de onveilige omstandigheden voor kinderen in noodopvanglocaties zoals in Leeuwarden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about unsafe conditions for children in emergency asylum reception locations such as Leeuwarden, citing UNICEF and school staff warnings on stress, privacy, lack of support and suicidal thoughts. The State Secretary acknowledged the situation is undesirable, pointed to a shortage of reception capacity and listed child-support measures, privacy limits and planned structural solutions with municipalities.
It is undesirable that asylum seekers, and certainly children, stay in emergency reception locations.
Het is onwenselijk dat asielzoekers, en zeker kinderen, in noodopvanglocaties verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de naturalisatie van pardonners en andere personen met een verblijfsvergunning

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the naturalisation of Ranov-permit holders (pardoned asylum seekers), including doubts about identity based on old language analyses, the handling of the motion on removing legal obstacles, the situation of the 2,097 asylum seekers under the 2003 one-off regulation, municipal advisory capacity, support for less self-reliant applicants, and naturalisation fees. The State Secretary reports about 3,250 Ranov applications with roughly 2,200 granted and about 50 refused, explains that 'gerede twijfel' requires an objective source, declines to map the 2,097-group, and defends the fee structure.
I believe the policy offers sufficient room to address this situation and I therefore do not intend to map what you requested.
Ik vind dat het beleid voldoende ruimte biedt om deze situatie te ondervangen en ben daarom niet voornemens het door u gevraagde in kaart te laten brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de gevolgen van een uitspraak van de Raad van State over de overdracht van vreemdelingen aan Kroatië

Rep. Kröger (GroenLinks) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the consequences of Council of State rulings that Dublin transfers to Croatia cannot proceed without further investigation, and about Frontex involvement in pushbacks and its leadership resignation. The government answered that it will gather additional information on Croatia, suspends Dublin transfers there, admits asylum applications where deadlines lapse, and says it actively opposes pushbacks while noting member states are primarily responsible for border control.
Until then, no asylum seekers will be transferred from the Netherlands to Croatia under the Dublin Regulation.
Tot die tijd worden vanuit Nederland geen asielzoekers op grond van de Dublinverordening overgedragen aan Kroatië.
Antwoord op vragen van Jasper van Dijk over het vervallen recht op toeslagen vanwege gegevens in de basisregistratie personen (BRP)

An MP asks why childcare and housing allowances are withdrawn and recovered when the IND registers code 98 (no lawful residence) in the BRP, even when people may not be definitively rejected, and whether affected people can contest this before recovery. The State Secretary replies that code 98 reflects current status not final rejection, that Toeslagen relies on IND's code and only checks doubtful cases, that the code is not a contestable decision but the underlying IND decision is, and that the government will report on hardship options in the summer.
Code 98 means that at the time of determination a citizen does not (or no longer) lawfully reside in the Netherlands; it does not mean the person has been finally rejected.
Code 98 betekent dat een burger op het moment van vaststelling niet (meer) rechtmatig in Nederland verblijft, dit betekent niet dat iemand uitgeprocedeerd is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de opvang van Oekraïense ontheemden, asielzoekers en vergunninghouders

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the number of unused reception places for Ukrainian displaced persons, whether municipalities were asked to make them available for asylum seekers and status holders, and whether talks would be reopened given conditions at Ter Apel. The State Secretary replied that about 6,500 places were free, that the choice of locations rests with municipalities and that there is no overview of talks held, and that a further 150 places per safety region were agreed for asylum seekers, with no commitment to new talks beyond ongoing efforts.
The final choice to make a location available for displaced persons or asylum seekers/permit holders lies with the municipalities and not with me.
De uiteindelijke keuze om een locatie beschikbaar te stellen voor ontheemden of asielzoekers/vergunninghouders ligt bij de gemeenten en niet bij mij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over dwang richting gemeenten om asielzoekers op te vangen

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the government whether there is an asylum crisis, why it previously denied one, and what legal basis exists to force municipalities to provide asylum reception, including the role of safety-region chairs and the Rotterdam letter. The state secretary answered that a crisis exists only for Ukrainian displaced persons, that no binding legal instrument currently compels municipalities on asylum reception, and that the government will explore one and avoid the term 'aanwijzing' in future.
A study is currently underway into the possibilities of arriving at a binding legal instrument to realise asylum reception.
Momenteel vindt een verkenning plaats naar de mogelijkheden om tot een dwingend juridisch instrumentarium te komen om asielopvang te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Bikker, Van der Graaf en Piri over de situatie aan de grens met Oekraïne

MPs asked the government about human trafficking risks for Ukrainian refugees at the border, including unaccompanied children, and whether it would press for EU coordination and raise the issue in Council meetings. The government answered that it shares the concerns, has raised them in EU and UN contacts, and describes registration, monitoring and awareness measures in the Netherlands.
The cabinet generally shares UNHCR's concerns about signals of human traffickers in Europe exploiting vulnerable people, including unaccompanied children fleeing Ukraine.

Het kabinet deelt in algemene zin de zorgen van UNHCR over signalen van mensenhandelaren in Europa die misbruik maken van kwetsbare personen, inclusief alleenstaande kinderen die uit Oekraïne vluchten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over opvang en asiel van derdelanders uit Oekraïne in Nederland

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about third-country nationals from Ukraine who were allegedly refused the right to apply for asylum in Ter Apel, the status of those whose Ukrainian residence permits expire, Rotterdam's information to them, municipal duties, and whether a humanitarian residence permit should be granted to all. The State Secretary answered that these persons must formally apply for asylum to access temporary protection, that status is determined by a valid Ukrainian permit on 23 February 2022, that existing procedures are maintained, and that study options are for higher education institutions to decide.
They are therefore given the opportunity to apply for asylum, without the associated procedural steps being carried out at this time.
Zij worden derhalve in de gelegenheid gebracht om asiel aan te vragen, zonder dat de bijbehorende procedurestappen op dit moment al worden doorlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het gedrag van zogenaamde 'vluchtelingen'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reported misconduct by asylum seekers at the emergency shelter at Soesterberg, and whether those responsible should be expelled immediately. The State Secretary condemned threats and vandalism, acknowledged frustration over shelter conditions, and said expulsion for crimes is governed by rules referred to in earlier answers.
In general terms, aggressive or nuisance-causing behaviour is unacceptable and undermines public support for sheltering people fleeing war, violence or persecution.
In algemene zin geldt dat agressief of overlastgevend gedrag onacceptabel is en het draagvlak aantast voor de opvang van personen die vluchten voor oorlog, geweld of vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Bisschop, Van der Plas, Bikker, Ceder, Van den Berg, Tielen, Brekelmans en Podt over de toegang tot basiszorg voor Oekraïense vluchtelingen

MPs from several parties asked about access to basic healthcare for Ukrainian refugees, including GP, mental health, pharmacy, dental and maternity care, and about coordination with the LHV, InEen and GGD GHOR, medical evacuations, administrative burden, and interpreters. The government answered that Ukrainian displaced persons fall outside the asylum medical scheme, that JenV leads the organisation of access with insurers, that existing systems are being copied, and that it could not answer all questions before the plenary debate but sent a broader letter.
It has not been possible to answer the questions before the plenary debate.
Het is niet gelukt om de vragen voor het plenaire debat te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en van Ginneken over automobiliteit van vluchtelingen uit Oekraïne in Nederland

MPs Podt and Van Ginneken asked whether Ukrainian refugees can renew Ukrainian car insurance or obtain Dutch insurance, and whether their Ukrainian driving licences lapse after 185 days, with consequences for work and life in the Netherlands. The government answered that Ukrainian insurers still issue green cards so policies can be extended, the Vereende offers short-term cover as a fallback, and the European Commission is preparing an EU-wide extension of the licence validity.
That insurance provides cover for three months and can be extended for a maximum of three months.
Die verzekering biedt voor drie maanden dekking en kan voor maximaal drie maanden worden verlengd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de criminaliteit en geweldsdelicten door asielzoekers in Budel

An MP from JA21 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about crime by asylum seekers at the Budel reception centre, including whether convicted residents faced residence-permit withdrawal and transfer under the VRIS protocol, and about asylum rates for Algerians and the closure of the Cranendonck centre. The State Secretary largely referred to forthcoming WODC reports, said the data are not routinely kept and would require manual file review, declined to change the detention rules, and committed to a security package and continued talks with the municipality.
To answer these questions, the files at the various chain partners would have to be reviewed manually and multiple file comparisons made.
Om antwoord te kunnen geven op deze vragen zullen derhalve handmatig de dossiers bij de verschillende ketenpartners moeten worden doorgenomen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over stelende asielzoekers

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about asylum seekers in Ter Apel who commit shoplifting and public disorder, and whether their asylum applications should be stopped and they should be sent back. The State Secretary acknowledged the overcrowding, announced a broader nuisance-reduction approach and a review of a binding legal instrument, but said shoplifting usually does not meet the threshold for revoking asylum status and that no figures on removals after theft are recorded.
It is not registered how many foreigners who commit theft are subsequently also deported.
Er wordt niet geregistreerd hoeveel vreemdelingen die een diefstal plegen vervolgens ook uitgezet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het International Migration Review Forum (IMRF) van 17 t/m 20 mei 2022 te New York

An MP asked the State Secretary about Dutch consultations with civil society on the Global Compact on Migration, the Netherlands' stance at the International Migration Review Forum, the return of rejected asylum seekers and cooperation with countries of origin. The government answered that consultations with NGOs took place, that return cooperation is a stated priority, but gave no concrete numbers or specific targets for agreements on rejected asylum seekers.
The cabinet cannot give precise figures or information with certainty about the composition of this group.
Het kabinet kan geen precieze aantallen geven of met zekerheid informatie geven over de samenstelling van deze groep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Van Weyenberg over problemen bij het inschrijven van vluchtelingen uit Oekraïne in Nederland

MPs Podt and Van Weyenberg asked about problems registering Ukrainian refugees in the Netherlands, including slow municipal registration, identity documents, financial access, and bank accounts. The government answered that it is working with municipalities, banks and the Ukrainian embassy, describes temporary flexibilities and a planned Hryvnia exchange scheme, but gives little detail on definitive fixes.
It is good that we also gain insight into this group.
Het is goed dat we ook zicht krijgen op deze groep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de onaanvaardbare toestanden op Aanmeldcentrum Ter Apel

An MP asks why structural solutions for the asylum reception shortage at Ter Apel have not been found, whether vacant Ukrainian reception places can be used, and whether people can be spared sleeping outside. The State Secretary acknowledges the night outside as unacceptable, points to a flexibilisation agenda, crisis emergency shelter and new locations, but gives no guarantee it will not recur.
I therefore consider it undesirable and inappropriate that we were unable for several hours to provide these people with a roof over their heads, and I regret this.
Ik vind het dan ook ongewenst en ongepast dat wij deze mensen een aantal uren geen dak boven het hoofd hebben kunnen bieden en dat betreur ik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de chaos bij asielzoekerscentrum Ter Apel

An MP asks the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the overnight crisis at the Ter Apel asylum centre, where asylum seekers spent hours outside the gate, how such situations will be prevented, which nationalities make up recent arrivals, and how many asylum seekers the Netherlands can absorb. The State Secretary regrets the situation, says no guarantee can be given, commits to preparing emergency shelter and new locations, but answers the questions on nationalities and absorption capacity only by reference to other answers or general statements.
I find it undesirable and inappropriate that we were unable for several hours to provide these people with a roof over their heads, and I regret this.
Ik vind het ongewenst en ongepast dat we deze mensen een aantal uren geen dak boven het hoofd hebben kunnen bieden en dat betreur ik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over noodvisa voor journalisten door de situatie in Oekraïne

An MP asks the government whether Russian and Belarusian journalists fleeing to Ukraine can receive emergency visas or temporary protection, citing risks of arrest and Kosovo's precedent, and asks about EU border treatment and relocation. The minister answers that the EU Temporary Protection Directive covers certain third-country nationals, that Russian-speaking journalists are supported through Shelter City and a EUR 2 million fund, that specific cases are considered individually, and that the Netherlands will not commit to mandatory relocation or extra border staff.
Due to the safety of these persons, the cabinet cannot make further statements about this.
Vanwege de veiligheid van deze personen kan het kabinet hierover geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower over het afdwingen van opvangplaatsen van vreemdelingen

PVV MPs asked whether the government would requisition property such as sports halls, offices, hotels and homes to house asylum seekers, and whether ministers would house migrants in their own property. The state secretary answered that requisitioning property is not currently under consideration and referred to earlier letters on ministers' property holdings, adding that housing migrants in one's own home is a private matter and not an obligation.
