For completeness, I refer you regarding ownership of immovable property to letters from the Prime Minister dated 14 January 2022 on the interests of ministers.
Volledigheidshalve verwijs ik u ten aanzien van het bezit van onroerend goed naar brieven van de Minister-President d.d. 14 januari 2022 inzake de belangen van bewindspersonen

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de beantwoording van de schriftelijke vragen over het rapport van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State over de Wijziging van het Vreemdelingenbesluit 2000, in verband met

An MP from D66 asks the State Secretary how the merged asylum intake hearing works for unaccompanied minors, whether minors get enough rest and preparation time and legal support, and whether the evaluation will cover their rights. The State Secretary replies that safeguards such as Nidos involvement, a child-specific hearing, and a three-week rest period are sufficient, and commits to an evaluation in Q3 2022 that includes Nidos, the asylum bar and Vluchtelingenwerk.
Following the brief outline of asylum motives, the IND does not ask further, in-depth questions during the intake hearing.
Naar aanleiding van de korte uiteenzetting van de asielmotieven stelt de IND tijdens het aanmeldgehoor verder geen nadere, verdiepende vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Bikker, Van der Graaf en Piri over de situatie aan de grens met Oekraïne

MPs from ChristenUnie and PvdA asked the government about long border waits for Ukrainian refugees, humanitarian funding, reported discrimination against Roma at the Hungarian border and trafficking risks. The government answered that it finds long waits undesirable, is supporting neighbouring states via Frontex, EUAA and EU civil protection, increased humanitarian funding, and found no evidence of discrimination on the EU side while stating it monitors the situation closely.
The Netherlands intends to respond positively to this.
Nederland is voornemens hier positief op te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Brekelmans over medische zorg en vaccinatie t.b.v. vluchtelingen uit Oekraïne

MPs Tielen and Brekelmans asked the Health Minister and Justice State Secretary how medical care and vaccination for Ukrainian refugees is arranged in other European countries and in the Netherlands, including access for those arriving independently. The minister replied that many EU states link care to existing asylum schemes or adopt special rules, that the ministry coordinates with GGD, GHOR, COA and others, and referred to earlier correspondence on vaccination; care is available via the local GP and COVID vaccination without registration, while costs for non-working, non-asylum Ukrainians are covered by an SOV subsidy limited to basic-package care.
Anyone in the Netherlands who needs acute medical care can go to the local GP, including Ukrainians who arrive on their own.
Iedere persoon in Nederland die acute medische zorg nodig heeft kan zich melden bij de plaatselijke dokter, dus ook Oekraïners die op eigen gelegenheid naar Nederland komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht 'Migranten door kou gestorven aan de Turks-Griekse grens'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about reports that twelve (later nineteen) migrants died of cold after alleged pushbacks at the Greek-Turkish border, and about Greek denials, UNHCR warnings, Frontex's role and EU funding. The government condemned alleged pushbacks, said it lacks independent information, pointed to the Commission's responsibility as guardian of the treaties and to an independent monitoring mechanism, and promised no concrete new step.
The cabinet refers gladly to the answers to questions 4 and 5.
Het kabinet verwijst graag naar de beantwoording van vragen 4 en 5.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Kuiken, Nijboer en De Hoop over 50.000 opvangplekken voor vluchtelingen uit Oekraïne

Opposition PvdA MPs asked how the government will support municipalities in securing and managing about 50,000 reception places for Ukrainian refugees, and about preparations for education, healthcare, housing, language lessons and work. The government answered that safety regions coordinate place creation with municipalities, a national reception programme is being prepared, and that housing, education and healthcare measures are being worked out, with further letters promised.
The cabinet considers it important that displaced persons from Ukraine residing in our country have the opportunity to learn the Dutch language
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk dat ontheemden uit Oekraïne die in ons land verblijven de mogelijkheid hebben om de Nederlandse taal te leren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Kroger over capaciteit en bereidheid van Nederland voor de opvang van eventuele vluchtelingen uit Oekraïne

MPs Ellemeet and Kroger asked about Dutch capacity and willingness to receive refugees from Ukraine, including EU solidarity, reception numbers at COA, and activation of the Temporary Protection Directive. The government answered that Afghan evacuees are being transferred despite capacity concerns, that municipalities and safety regions are preparing thousands of reception places, and that the Temporary Protection Directive was activated at the JBZ Council.
The cabinet is receiving the first reports that surrounding countries are reaching the limits of their reception capacity.
Het kabinet ontvangt de eerste berichten dat omringende landen aan de grenzen van de opvangcapaciteit zitten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de Argos-uitzending 'Drama bij evacuatie Kabul'

An SP MP asked the foreign and justice ministers about an Argos broadcast on chaotic evacuations from Kabul, including whether two sisters were on the evacuation list, why about a hundred people were removed from the list, and whether the ministry obstructs court access and appeal decisions. The government declined to discuss individual cases citing privacy, explained the removals as post-evacuation verification, and denied that appeals and court access are obstructed.
In line with the objectives of the GDPR, I will not address questions relating to specific individual cases.
In lijn met de doelstellingen van de AVG ga ik niet in op vragen die betrekking hebben op specifieke casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Van der Laan en Sjoerdsma over de zorgelijke toestand van etnisch-Russische studenten, docenten en onderzoekers

MPs Podt, Van der Laan and Sjoerdsma asked about the difficult situation of ethnic-Russian and Belarusian students, teachers and researchers in the Netherlands after sanctions, including financial hardship, work-hour limits, unclear visa prospects and knowledge-leakage risks. The minister acknowledged the problems, said work-hour limits will not be changed, urged institutions to support these students, and said residence rights are kept while study conditions are met.
Adjusting the number of hours students may work is not seen as a solution.
Het aanpassen van het aantal uren dat studenten mogen werken wordt niet als oplossing gezien
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de berichten ‘Miljoenen Oekrainers op de vlucht’ en ‘Noodopvang zonder plan’

The CDA MP Kuik asked about the refugee flow from Ukraine, available reception capacity, emergency planning, coordination of private initiatives, and residence rights for Ukrainians. The State Secretary answered almost every question by referring to earlier letters of 8 and 17 March, while noting that EU emergency plans exist and that a national coordination point for private initiatives is desirable.

For an overview of the latest situation regarding all efforts being made in response to the refugee flow from Ukraine, including the creation of 50,000 reception places coordinated by the safety regions, I refer you to the letters to the House of 8 March and 17 March.

Voor een overzicht van de laatste stand van zaken omtrent alle inspanningen die verricht worden naar aanleiding van de vluchtelingenstroom uit Oekraïne, waaronder de realisatie van 50.000 opvangplekken onder coördinatie van de veiligheidsregio’s, verwijs ik u naar de Kamerbrieven van 8 maart en 17 maart jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Piri over de voorbereidingen voor de opvang van Oekraïners die hun land moeten ontvluchten vanwege de Russische invasie

MPs Ploumen and Piri asked about preparations for receiving Ukrainians fleeing the Russian invasion, including EU coordination, capacity, asylum procedures and whether Ukraine should remain a safe country of origin. The government answered that it is preparing for large-scale reception with municipalities and safety regions, has imposed a half-year decision and departure moratorium, and has suspended Ukraine's safe-country designation, but gave mostly general answers and referred to earlier letters.
The designation of Ukraine as a safe country of origin has also been suspended for at least the same period, until a new reassessment has taken place.
Ook is de aanwijzing van Oekraïne als veilig land van herkomst opgeschort voor in ieder geval dezelfde periode, totdat een nieuwe herbeoordeling zal hebben plaatsgevonden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline. The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de verblijfsprocedure van de Haarlemse Amine

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why a Dutch-born young adult, Amine, still lacked residence rights and whether the IND should decide or refer the case to a judge. The State Secretary said the application had already been granted, declined to discuss individual cases, and pointed to the general assessment criteria in the published work instruction.
As agreed with your House, I will not go into individual cases in substance.
Zoals met uw Kamer is afgesproken ga ik niet inhoudelijk in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over luxe vervoer voor asielzoekers

The PVV MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked why asylum-seeker children in Utrecht were taken to school by touring coach despite having free bicycles, and asked for an overview of everything asylum seekers receive for free. State Secretary Van der Burg answered that the coach was temporary because the Afghan evacuees initially lacked bicycles and cycling skills and had no means for public transport, that the service has ended since the spring holiday, and that asylum seekers are entitled to reception under law, with the COA's provisions set out in a regulation rather than a single overview.
A touring coach was temporarily deployed for about 75 school-age children of Afghan evacuees.
Er is tijdelijk een touringcar voor ongeveer 75 leerplichtige kinderen van Afghaanse evacuées ingezet

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Jasper van Dijk en Kuik over naturalisatieverzoeken RANOV-vergunninghouders en de Kamerbrief over diverse onderwerpen migratiebeleid van 7 juli 2021 en het WODC rapport “(N)ooit Nede

MPs Podt, Jasper van Dijk and Kuik asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why RANOV permit holders may still be asked for identity and nationality documents, how many naturalisation applications were filed and refused since the July 2021 policy change, and whether the Van Dijk/Van Toorenburg motion was properly implemented. The State Secretary answered that about 2,070 RANOV holders filed applications, around 690 were granted and fewer than 10 refused, that the documentary requirement is waived for RANOV holders with the possibility of submitting documents voluntarily, and that the motion is considered implemented.
Do you think you are implementing the adopted Van Dijk/Van Toorenburg motion in a way consistent with its spirit and intent?
Vraag 5 Vindt u dat u de aangenomen Kamermotie Van Dijk/Van Toorenburg 5 uitvoert op een manier die in lijn is met de geest en de bedoeling van de motie?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht ‘Vluchtelingenstroom op gang vanuit Oekraïne, buurlanden bereiden opvang voor’

MP Podt (D66) asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security whether the ministry's view that no extra measures are needed for Ukrainian refugees is wise, given full asylum reception and COA/IND backlogs, and whether extra preparatory measures will be taken and reported to parliament. The State Secretary answered that the Netherlands is preparing for possible large-scale reception with municipalities, COA, IND, police and Defence, and that Ukrainians already present will be assessed for residence-status issues such as expiring visas.
The Netherlands is preparing for the arrival of refugees from Ukraine.
Nederland bereidt zich voor op de komst van vluchtelingen uit de Oekraïne.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de opvang van alleenstaande minderjarige vreemdelingen

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the reception of unaccompanied minor asylum seekers, including whether small-scale housing is still feasible, placement waiting lists, school access, guardian caseloads and youth participation. The State Secretary answered at length, acknowledging that capacity pressure forces longer stays and transfers and that guardian caseloads are too high, while committing to evaluate extended care only later.
Question 1: What is the most recent state of affairs regarding the reception of unaccompanied minor asylum seekers in small-scale facilities?
Vraag 1 Wat is de meest recente stand van zaken met betrekking tot de opvang van alleenstaande minderjarige vreemdelingen (amv's) in kleinschalige voorzieningen?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de geweldsgolf rond het azc in Budel

An MP from JA21 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the wave of violence around the Budel asylum centre, including the mayor's emergency ordinance, sanctions imposed, the low number of residence permits refused or revoked on public-order grounds, nationality of offenders, and the Algeria safe-country decision. The State Secretary acknowledged the seriousness, reported court and COA sanctions, explained legal limits on revoking protection and ongoing work on public-order options, and agreed joint short- and medium-term safety measures with the municipality and COA while declining to terminate the COA contract.
I am investigating with these parties which options could strengthen the nuisance approach, and will inform the House of the outcomes.
Ik onderzoek samen met deze partijen welke handelingsperspectieven de overlastaanpak meer kracht bij zouden kunnen zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Inge van Dijk en Peters over noodverordening op en rond azc Budel na steekpartijen

MPs Kuik, Inge van Dijk and Peters (CDA) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about violence and stabbings at the Budel asylum centre and the emergency ordinance that followed, including causes, short- and long-term actions and consequences for perpetrators' asylum claims. The State Secretary acknowledged serious incidents, listed security measures agreed with the mayor, the Commissioner of the King, and COA, and explained the legal grounds for refusing protection to offenders.
Of course I will inform your House of the outcomes of the research into options for action.
Uiteraard zal ik uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek naar handelingsperspectieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Ceder, Koekkoek, Jasper van Dijk, Simons, Piri  en Kuzu over afwijzingen kort verblijf familieleden Syrische Nederlanders

MPs asked why Syrian visitors for family visits, even when they appear to meet the Visa Code conditions, are refused at a high rate (55% for Syrians overall, about 75% for family visits), and whether the Syrian war is treated as breaking ties to the home country. The Minister of Foreign Affairs answered that each application is assessed on its merits under the Visa Code, that refusals mostly reflect insufficient ties to the country of origin and doubts about timely return, and that Syrian nationals can only obtain a family visit visa if these concerns are resolved.
Every visa application is assessed on its own merits in accordance with the provisions of the Visa Code.
Alle visumaanvragen worden echter op hun eigen merites beoordeeld overeenkomstig de bepalingen van de Visumcode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Valstar over het bericht 'Riesen- Zoff um Asyl-Plan von Innenministerin Faeser'

An MP asked the government about a German plan to admit more asylum seekers and whether the Netherlands would join a coalition of receptive member states. The state secretary declined to comment on the German idea, confirmed regional reception and GEAS reform remain policy, and said joining such a coalition is not on the agenda.
Joining a 'coalition of receptive member states' aimed at admitting more asylum seekers is not under consideration.
Het aansluiten bij een «coalitie van ontvankelijke lidstaten» dat tot doel heeft meer asielzoekers op te vangen, is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Jasper van Dijk over het feit dat de regering brieven met aanwijzingen aan gemeentes stuurde zonder wettelijke grondslag

MPs Omtzigt and Van Dijk asked whether letters the government sent to municipalities instructing them to create emergency asylum reception places, called 'aanwijzingen', had any legal basis, and whether they amounted to mere requests. The government answered that the letters had no basis in Dutch law, were not legally binding, were intended as urgent requests, and that it will no longer use the term 'aanwijzing' in this way, while refusing to share some correspondence yet and not answering the criminal-law questions.
The cabinet regrets this. Therefore the cabinet no longer wishes to use the term 'aanwijzing' in a situation like this in this way.
Het kabinet betreurt dat. Daarom wil het kabinet de term «aanwijzing» in een situatie zoals deze niet meer op deze wijze gebruiken.

m: Amendement van de leden Verkuijlen en Dral over het spreekrecht bij de delicten van ernstige benadeling, voordeeltrekking en strafbaarheid prostituanten
Adds victims of serious harm, benefiting from exploitation and prosecution of clients under articles 273fa, 273fb and 273g of the Criminal Code to those who may exercise a right to speak at trial.
Therefore the submitters propose to make the right to speak available to victims of the offences in articles 273fa, 273fb and 273g of the Criminal Code.
Daarom stellen de indieners voor het spreekrecht mogelijk te maken voor slachtoffers van de misdrijven in artikelen 273fa, 273fb en 273g Sr.
Motie van de leden Dral en Kathmann over onderzoeken wanneer gegevensdeling noodzakelijk is maar nu niet kan plaatsvinden
Asks the State Secretary for Legal Protection to investigate where data sharing is necessary but blocked by insufficient sectoral legal bases, and to propose how to prioritise fixing these gaps.
requests the State Secretary for Legal Protection, as system authority for personal data protection, to investigate when data sharing is necessary

verzoekt de Staatssecretaris Rechtsbescherming als stelselverantwoordelijke voor bescherming van persoonsgegevens, in samenspraak met de AP en onafhankelijke privacyjuristen, te onderzoeken wanneer gegevensdeling noodzakelijk is
Motie van het lid Dral over de AP verzoeken de Kamer tweemaal per jaar te informeren over het verbeterplan
Asks the government to have the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens report to parliament twice a year on its improvement plan and its effects on supervised parties.
requests the government to ask the AP to inform the House twice a year about the progress of the improvement plan
verzoekt de regering om de AP te verzoeken de Kamer tweemaal per jaar te informeren over de voortgang van het verbeterplan
Motie van de leden Dral en Michon-Derkzen over een snellere notice-and-take-downprocedure bij zeer ernstige privacyinbreuken door deepfakes
Asks the State Secretary to investigate a faster notice-and-takedown procedure for deepfake privacy violations and whether a legal basis and which enforcer should handle it.
asks the State Secretary to investigate how a faster notice-and-takedown procedure can be set up as quickly as possible, within an hour where technically feasible
verzoekt de Staatssecretaris onderzoek te doen naar hoe een snellere notice- and-take-downprocedure zo snel mogelijk en waar technisch mogelijk binnen een uur kan worden ingericht
Motie van het lid Ceder c.s. over de Nationaal Rapporteur Verslavingen toegang verlenen tot dezelfde data als de Kansspelautoriteit zodat deze onderzoek kan doen naar gokgedrag en gokverslaving
Asks the government to give the National Rapporteur on Addiction access to the same gambling data the Gambling Authority holds, to enable research on gambling behaviour.
requests the government to grant the National Rapporteur on Addiction access to the same data as the Gambling Authority
verzoekt de regering de Nationaal Rapporteur Verslavingen toegang te verlenen tot dezelfde data als de Kansspelautoriteit
Motie van het lid Michon-Derkzen c.s. over in de halfjaarraportage ondermijning in 2025 rapporteren over de resultaten van de Taskforce gegevensdeling
Asks the government to report in the 2025 half-year undermining report on results of the Taskforce gegevensdeling for information sharing among partners in neighbourhoods.
requests the government to report in the 2025 half-year undermining report on the results achieved so far by the Taskforce data sharing
verzoekt de regering om in de halfjaarraportage ondermijning in 2025 te rapporteren over de tot dan toe behaalde resultaten van de Taskforce gegevensdeling
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dral, Van den Hil en Tielen over het artikel '‘Ik heb zelfs een huis opgeblazen’; Malafide medewerkers in de jeugdzorg maken misbruik van de positie van kwetsbare jongeren’

MPs Dral, Van den Hil and Tielen (VVD) asked the State Secretaries about a Telegraaf report that malicious youth-care workers exploit vulnerable youths for crime, and about fraud with EVC certificates and training points in the youth-care register. The government answered that it does not know the numbers, is sampling 274 of about 3,500 EVC-based registrations, has suspended 490 pending applications, and is pursuing wider anti-fraud measures.
Therefore the SKJ started with a sample of 274 files to determine the content and pace of the follow-up on that basis.
Daarom is de SKJ gestart met een steekproef van 274 dossiers om op basis daarvan de inhoud en het tempo van het vervolg te kunnen bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kisteman, Dral en Bikkers over het bericht 'Gokken, alcohol, drugs: verslavingsproblemen nemen toe bij noodlijdende ondernemers'

MPs Kisteman, Dral and Bikkers asked the ministers whether the government is aware of rising addiction among distressed entrepreneurs, whether there are regional or sectoral differences, and what measures and municipal support are planned. Minister Karremans answered that addiction among entrepreneurs is not registered separately and no national figures exist, pointed to existing debt-support programmes and municipal efforts, and committed to exploring with municipalities and other partners how support for entrepreneurs with multiple problems can be structurally strengthened.
Yes. I will explore with municipalities, trade organisations and care partners whether, and if so how, support for entrepreneurs with multiple problems can be structurally strengthened.
Ja. Ik ga samen met gemeenten, brancheorganisaties en zorgpartijen verkennen of, en zo ja, hoe de ondersteuning van ondernemers met meervoudige problematiek structureel versterkt kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dral en Rajkowski over het artikel ‘Mensensmokkel via zee goudmijn’

MPs Dral and Rajkowski asked the government about reports that criminal networks use the Netherlands as a hub for preparing people-smuggling crossings to the UK, including monitoring of networks, reporting by the maritime sector, social media recruitment and protection of unaccompanied minor Vietnamese girls. Minister Van Weel answered that preparatory acts occur in the Netherlands, that international cooperation (Europol OTF Wave, Calais Group) is ongoing, that reports are not centrally recorded so no comparative figures exist, and that current protection measures for unaccompanied minors are considered sufficient.
However, figures on these reports are not centrally recorded and therefore cannot be compared with previous years.
Cijfers over deze meldingen worden echter niet centraal bijgehouden, en zijn dus ook niet te vergelijken met voorgaande jaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Dral over het bericht 'Jeugdzorginstellingen onder verscherpt toezicht: 'Jongeren opgesloten in kamer''

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretaries about reports that youth care institutions under stricter supervision confine youths to their rooms, and how the transition away from closed youth care will be supported and monitored. The state secretary answered that EUR 176 million is available for the transformation, that a supplementary implementation programme is being discussed with providers, that the IGJ can escalate to instructions if needed, and that a national project organisation monitors the transformation toward near-zero closed placements by 2030.
Improving the legal position of young people in closed youth care and reducing the use of restrictive measures are two important objectives for me.
Het verbeteren van de rechtspositie van jeugdigen in de gesloten jeugdhulp en het terugdringen van het gebruik van vrijheidsbeperkende maatregelen vind ik twee belangrijke doelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dral over het artikel ‘Voor welk type speler zijn offshore casino’s perfect?’

An MP asked the State Secretary about an article on dagblad010.nl that promoted offshore casinos as suitable for various players, asking about its reach to youth, the KSA's enforcement powers and warnings, the unequal position of licensed operators, and European cooperation. The State Secretary condemned the article as disguised illegal gambling advertising, reported that the KSA had it removed informally and launched a project sending about forty letters, and said a policy response would follow in March 2025 along with European cooperation efforts.
I find it alarming that a seemingly factual article appears on a local newspaper's webpage that is in reality disguised advertising for illegal gambling.
Ik vind het alarmerend dat op een webpagina van een lokaal dagblad een ogenschijnlijk feitelijk artikel lijkt te staan, dat in werkelijkheid verkapte reclame voor illegaal gokken is.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Dral over het artikel ‘Duizenden jongeren zijn geldezel’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that thousands of young people are lured via social media to act as money mules for criminals, asking how this is criminalised, whether it falls under the modernised human trafficking article 273f, and what prevention is done. The minister answers that recruiting youths is punishable under several offences, cites recent convictions, explains that criminal exploitation under 273f depends on case circumstances, and describes prevention programmes in pilot municipalities plus school and parental outreach.
There are no figures on the number of suspects who approached young people to make their bank account available, because no separate registration is kept of this.

Er zijn geen cijfers bekend met betrekking tot het aantal verdachten dat jongeren heeft benaderd om hun bankrekening ter beschikking te stellen, omdat hiervan geen aparte registratie wordt bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dral ver de oproep van Doarpswurk m.b.t. de wet- en regelgeving omtrent bingo in Nederland

An MP asked the ministers whether the planned exemption allowing small games of chance like bingo in licensed hospitality venues would address municipalities threatening to ban bingo where alcohol is served, and what they would tell affected elderly people. The state secretary answered that bingo is not banned in general, that the Alcohol Act ban on hospitality venues will be lifted through a bill, and that the VNG will be asked to show restraint in enforcement meanwhile.
I have asked about this and the VNG indicates that it does not have these figures and that it is not possible to obtain the relevant data.
Ik heb dit nagevraagd en de VNG geeft aan dat zij niet over deze cijfers beschikken en dat het niet mogelijk is om de betreffende gegevens te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dral over het artikel ‘Kindsoldaten uit de polder’

MP Dral asked the Justice Minister and State Secretary about a newspaper report on youths recruited into criminal exploitation, including prevention measures, police and conviction statistics, progress on an initiative note, municipal enforcement capacity, a planned tougher youth criminal law, and the 'patseraanpak'. The government said prevention is being funded and expanded, could not provide the requested police and court figures because they are not recorded, and promised further information on the youth sentencing and Halt pilot proposals later.
It is therefore not possible to provide the requested figures.
Het is daarom niet mogelijk om de gevraagde cijfers aan te leveren.

m: Motie van het lid Koerhuis c.s. over een overzicht van versnellingsopties voor verkeersveiligheid en vervanging van bruggen, viaducten en tunnels naar de Kamer sturen
Asks the government to send parliament an overview of options to accelerate road safety measures and replacement of bridges, viaducts and tunnels before the autumn MIRT.
requests the government to send the Chamber an overview of acceleration options for road safety and replacement of bridges, viaducts and tunnels before the autumn MIRT
verzoekt de regering om een overzicht van versnellingsopties voor verkeersveiligheid en vervanging van bruggen, viaducten en tunnels voor het najaars-MIRT naar de Kamer te sturen
Motie van het lid Van Ginneken over een richtinggevend kader ontwikkelen ter stimulering van de beschikbaarheid en het gebruik van deelauto's bij nieuwbouwprojecten
Asks the government to develop a guiding framework to encourage car-sharing availability and use in new housing developments.
Requests the government to develop a guiding framework to stimulate the availability and use of shared cars in new construction projects.
verzoekt de regering een richtinggevend kader te ontwikkelen ter stimulering van de beschikbaarheid en het gebruik van deelauto’s bij nieuwbouwprojecten
Motie van het lid Van der Graaf c.s. over een vergunningsplicht voor deelscooters en meer eenduidigheid in de desbetreffende maatregelen
Asks the government, with municipalities, to draw up an action framework on e-scooter nuisance and consider a licensing requirement in the model municipal bye-law.
requests the government, together with municipalities, to draw up an action framework
verzoekt de regering samen met gemeenten een handelingskader op te stellen
Motie van de leden Van Ginneken en Van der Molen over onderzoeken hoe deelmobiliteit gestimuleerd kan worden onder minima
Asks the government to investigate how shared mobility can be encouraged for low-income people, for example through a reduced fare via a city pass, with attention to rural-urban differences.
requests the government to investigate how shared mobility can be encouraged among people on low incomes
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken hoe deelmobiliteit gestimuleerd kan worden onder minima
Motie van het lid Van Ginneken over een permanent afwegingskader met criteria voor een rijksbijdrage aan infrastructuur in bezit van decentrale overheden
Asks the government to draw up a permanent framework with criteria for when national funding of infrastructure owned by local governments is appropriate.
requests the government to draw up a permanent assessment framework with criteria for when a national contribution to infrastructure owned by decentralised governments is appropriate
verzoekt de regering een permanent afwegingskader op te stellen met criteria waar een rijksbijdrage aan infrastructuur in bezit van decentrale overheden gepast is
Motie van het lid Van der Molen c.s. over op basis van de PBL-analyse een proeve van normering van gewenste minimumbereikbaarheidsniveaus uitwerken
Asks the cabinet to develop a draft of minimum accessibility standards based on the PBL analysis and submit it to the House for consideration.
requests the cabinet, based on the PBL analysis, to develop a draft standard of desired minimum accessibility levels
verzoekt het kabinet op basis van de PBL-analyse een proeve van normering van gewenste minimumbereikbaarheidsniveaus uit te werken
Motie van het lid Minhas c.s. over versterking van de concurrentiepositie van het spoorgoederenvervoer
Asks the government to explore additional funds and EU state-aid flexibility to strengthen the competitiveness of rail freight.
requests the government to explore whether additional funds can be made available to strengthen the competitiveness of rail freight
verzoekt de regering te verkennen of er aanvullende middelen vrij te maken zijn om de concurrentiepositie van het spoorgoederenvervoer te versterken
Motie van het lid Koerhuis c.s. over het op provincieniveau in kaart brengen van de gemeentelijke plankaarten met locaties van laadpalen
Asks the government to map municipal charging-point plans per province for the next two years and to report to the House in Q1 2023 and every half year thereafter.
requests the government to inform the House about this in the first quarter of 2023 and then every half year
verzoekt de regering de Kamer hierover in het eerste kwartaal van 2023 en vervolgens halfjaarlijks te informeren
Motie van de leden Minhas en Van Ginneken over tot een implementatieplan komen voor de 740 metertrein
Asks the government, with ProRail, to draft an implementation plan for the 740-metre freight train, including a social cost-benefit analysis, and to inform the House by autumn 2023.
requests the government, in cooperation with ProRail, to draw up an implementation plan for the 740-metre train
verzoekt de regering in samenwerking met ProRail te komen tot een implementatieplan van de 740 metertrein
Motie van het lid Van der Graaf c.s. over wet- en regelgeving in lijn brengen met het Bestuursakkoord Toegankelijkheid OV
Asks the government to align laws and regulations with the public transport accessibility agreement as soon as possible and inform the House before summer 2023.
requests the government to bring current laws and regulations in line with the agreements as soon as possible
verzoekt de regering de huidige wet- en regelgeving op de kortst mogelijke termijn in lijn te brengen met de afspraken
Motie van het lid Van der Graaf c.s. over in gesprek gaan met de provincie Gelderland over een (rolstoel)toegankelijk toilet in elke trein
Asks the government to discuss with the province of Gelderland how to achieve wheelchair-accessible toilets in every train by the next concession tender.
requests the government to enter into discussion with the province of Gelderland
verzoekt de regering met de provincie Gelderland in gesprek te gaan
Motie van het lid Van Ginneken over een snelle inwerkingtreding van de regeling CO2-reductie werkgebonden personenmobiliteit en deze voorzien van meer ambitie
Asks the government to bring forward and strengthen the CO2 reduction scheme for work-related passenger mobility.
requests the government to make the CO2 reduction scheme for work-related passenger mobility more ambitious as soon as possible
verzoekt de regering de regeling voor CO 2 -reductie werkgebonden personenmobiliteit op de kortst mogelijke termijn
Amendement van de leden Van Ginneken en Van der Graaf over een MIRT-onderzoek naar het volledige traject van de Nedersaksenlijn
Shifts funds from the road network budget to rail to finance a standalone MIRT study of the full Nedersaksenlijn rail route.
With this amendment a standalone MIRT study into the full planned Nedersaksenlijn route is funded.
Met dit amendement wordt een zelfstandig MIRT-onderzoek naar het volledige traject van de beoogde Nedersaksenlijn gefinancierd.
Amendement van de leden Van Ginneken en Van der Molen over een pilot over toegankelijkheid van deelmobiliteit
Moves 3 million euro from the regional infrastructure article to the rail article for a pilot on access to shared mobility for low-income groups.
This amendment aims to make 3 million euro available within the Mobility Fund for a pilot
Dit amendement strekt ertoe om binnen het Mobiliteitsfonds € 3 miljoen euro beschikbaar te stellen voor een pilot
Amendement van de leden Van der Graaf en Van Ginneken over een beter openbaar vervoer voor mensen met een handicap
Shifts 20 million euro within the transport budget to improve public transport accessibility for people with disabilities.
This amendment aims to make 20 million euro available within the Mobility Fund to improve public transport accessibility
Dit amendement strekt ertoe om binnen het Mobiliteitsfonds € 20 miljoen euro beschikbaar te stellen voor het verbeteren van de toegankelijkheid van het openbaar vervoer
Amendement van de leden Minhas en Van Ginneken over pilots voor het vervoerssysteem Bus Rapid Transit
Moves 2 million euro within the Mobility Fund from regional infrastructure to railways to fund BRT bus pilots; a budget reallocation with no bearing on executive checks.
This amendment aims to make 2 million euros available within the Mobility Fund to start pilots for the Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) transport system.
Dit amendement strekt ertoe om binnen het Mobiliteitsfonds € 2 miljoen euro beschikbaar te stellen om pilots op te starten voor het vervoerssysteem Bus Rapid Transit (BRT).
Amendement van de leden Minhas en Van Ginneken over het verbeteren van de spoor- en perroncapaciteit van Meppel
Moves €35 million within the Mobility Fund from the main road network item to rail to improve track and platform capacity at Meppel.
