However, the Afsluitdijk will be largely accessible from 2024 as I described in my answer to question 4.
Wel zal de afsluitdijk grotendeels toegankelijk zijn vanaf 2024 zoals ik heb beschreven in mijn antwoord op vraag 4.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over de petitie 'Een voldoende gebleken uiterste wil moet, ook zonder testament, worden gevolgd'

A D66 MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether an unsigned draft will should be valid when it clearly reflects the deceased's wishes, following a petition. The minister rejected a general rule, arguing signature and notarial formalities are needed for legal certainty, leaving exceptions to judicial assessment, and promised no legislative change.
I consider it of great importance that the last will is carried out in accordance with what the testator actually wanted.
Ik vind het van groot belang dat de uiterste wil wordt uitgevoerd overeenkomstig hetgeen de erflater werkelijk heeft gewild.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Tjeerd de Groot over het gebruik van chemische middelen zoals glyfosaat door ProRail

D66 MPs asked the state secretary about ProRail's slower-than-expected move away from glyphosate and other chemical weed control, and whether the 2025 phase-out target still stands. The government answered that the 2025 aim remains, that alternatives are still being tested, that no extra agreements with ProRail are needed, and that a ban on avoidable use will follow once adequate alternatives exist.
The aim is to end use before 2025, but the exact timing is ultimately determined by meeting the condition from the 25 October 2019 letter that usable and feasible alternatives must be available.
Inzet is beëindiging vóór 2025, maar het exacte moment van beëindiging wordt uiteindelijk bepaald door de vervulling van de randvoorwaarde uit de brief van 25 oktober 2019
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht 'Populariteit van SUV’s drukt gewicht Nederlandse auto omhoog (en vertraagt daling uitstoot)'

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the growing popularity of SUVs is raising the weight of the average Dutch car and slowing the fall in CO2 emissions, and what tools government has to steer car size and weight. The State Secretary acknowledged that heavier cars raise CO2 emissions but argued the trend is not solely SUV-driven, described existing tax levers (BPM, MRB, fuel excise) as sufficient, and offered no new steering measures.
Because there is no statutory definition of an SUV, we can only give estimates on whether SUVs have slowed CO2 emissions from the Dutch car fleet and, if so, by how much.

Omdat er geen bij wet vastgestelde definitie van een SUV is (zie mijn antwoorden op vraag 4 en 5) kunnen we alleen schattingen geven op de vraag of SUV’s de CO 2 -uitstoot van het Nederlandse wagenpark hebben afgeremd en zo ja, hoeveel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot, Boulakjar en Van Ginneken over de Kaderrichtlijn Water (hierna: KRW) en het rapport ‘Een KRW-risicoanalyse voor de vergunningverlening voor de bouw- en infrasector’

MPs from D66 asked the government whether the Water Framework Directive (KRW) targets will be met, and about the construction-sector risk analysis claiming large losses if permits are restricted by missed targets. The minister answered that no guarantee can be given, disputes the report's conclusions and scale of risk, and says the government will consult the European Commission on possible exceptions.
However, guarantees that all KRW targets will be met cannot be given.
Garanties dat alle KRW-doelen gehaald worden kunnen echter niet gegeven worden.
Antwoord  op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht “NS trapt op de rem vanwege drukte in buitenlandse treinen, reizigers woedend

An MP asked the state secretary about NS's reservation requirement and capacity limits on international trains to Germany and Belgium after reports of overcrowding. The government answered that temporary measures are in place, capacity expansion is planned for 2024, and that the wider cross-border capacity issues are a broader matter.
I am therefore pleased that NS and Deutsche Bahn (DB) intend to increase ICE capacity from 2024
Ik ben daarom blij dat NS en Deutsche Bahn (DB) voornemens zijn om de capaciteit van de ICE te verhogen per 2024
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Van Ginneken over aangezichtsoperaties bij transgenderzorg

D66 MPs asked the health minister about gender-affirming facial surgery: whether it is reimbursed, why insurers use prior authorisation, how passability assessments avoid arbitrariness, and whether rejections are checked. The minister said no data exist on volumes or rejections, defended the authorisation system and the 2021 assessment framework, and stated that not every request is approved.
No data are available on this.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Van der Graaf over het bericht van het College voor de Rechten van de Mens: 'NS discrimineert reiziger met handicap'

MPs Van Ginneken and Van der Graaf asked the state secretary to respond to a College voor de Rechten van de Mens ruling that NS discriminates against passengers with disabilities through a one-hour pre-booking time for assistance and transfer norms, and asked about steps, data, and options to shorten booking times. The state secretary disagreed in part, citing NS research and improvements, Dutch and EU norms, and committed to continued dialogue and to including regional operators in assistance by 2025, while rejecting further shortening of pre-booking time for reliability reasons.
The College notes that NS has not conducted any new research into the wishes of its customers in this area since the last study seven years ago.
Het College stelt vast dat NS sinds het laatste onderzoek zeven jaar geleden geen nieuw onderzoek meer heeft verricht naar de wensen van haar klanten op dit gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht 'Krakkemikkige boogbrug over het Julianakanaal wordt ineens niet meer vervangen: Itteren houdt zijn hart vast'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the 85-year-old Itteren bridge will now be renovated rather than replaced, and what this means for safety, the inland shipping modal shift, nearby businesses and residents. The minister confirmed that rising costs drove the change, said the bridge is structurally safe for now with interim measures until mid-2024, and gave only partial detail on renovation scope and timing.
Until mid-2024, Rijkswaterstaat will first work out the scope of the renovation.
Tot medio 2024 gaat Rijkswaterstaat eerst de scope van de renovatie uitwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht in het Algemeen Dagblad/De Dordtenaar “Gevaarlijke treinen door steden verbieden kan wel”

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the ministry can and must intervene via a routing decision to reduce risks of hazardous goods rail transport through cities, citing a Zuid-Holland study. The State Secretary answered that a routing decision is legally possible but not preferred as a last resort because of the waterbed effect, and promised a study on the Basisnet and a rail freight vision.
No, as I indicated in answer to question 2, I do not intend to do that.
Nee, zoals ik bij vraag 2 heb aangegeven ben ik dat niet van plan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht «Rover verrast door mogelijke weigering van Interrail op de ICE»

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary whether Interrail holders would be refused access to ICE trains to Germany and about related rail access and capacity matters. The state secretary replied that NS says the reporting was incorrect, that temporary crowd-management measures are being developed, and that the ministry lacks ridership data for Interrail passes.
Such figures are not known at my ministry or at NS.
Dergelijke cijfers zijn bij mijn ministerie en bij NS niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het artikel 'Achternaam minderjarige wijzigen'

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether foster children's surnames can be changed to a biological parent's name, and related questions on consent and hardship clauses. The minister answered that changes are restricted to cases meeting care-period conditions, that consent depends on custody rather than biological parenthood, and that article 7 of the decree functions as a hardship clause.
In my view, a change in the law is not necessary for the situation described in question 5.
Mijns inziens is een wetswijziging voor de situatie zoals beschreven in vraag 5 niet nodig
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Sjoerdsma over een kadaster voor journalisten

Two D66 MPs asked why journalists cannot shield their home addresses in the Kadaster as threatened persons can, and why the Verhoeven motion on withholding private addresses has not been implemented. The minister answered that the Kadaster must keep object addresses public for a transparent property market, that searching by name is now limited to professional users, and that doxing should be criminalised instead, so no change to the Kadasterbesluit is planned.
I am aware that with this I depart from the line being taken for the Trade Register.
Ik ben mij bewust van het feit dat ik daarmee afwijk van de lijn die wordt ingezet bij het Handelsregister.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht ‘Kritiek op niet naleven securityregels overheidswebsites: ‘geen rocketscience’’’

An MP asks the Justice and Security and Interior ministers why half of central government domain names fail mandatory security standards that should have been implemented by 2019 and 2021, and how lower governments are being held to account. The state secretary answers that only 50% of Rijksoverheid domains comply with web standards and 55% with email standards, attributes delays partly to external vendors such as Microsoft, and promises a letter to all governments urging compliance and a later update to parliament on the Justice ministry's own implementation.
I find it unacceptable that governments do not have this in order and will, by letter via the umbrella organisations, call on all governments to implement the standards as quickly as possible.
Ik vind het onacceptabel dat overheden dit niet op orde hebben en zal per brief, via de koepelorganisaties 2 , alle overheden oproepen zo snel mogelijk de standaarden te implementeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht 'reizigersorganisaties keren zich tegen beperkte dienstregeling NS'

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reduced NS train timetables due to staff shortages, including whether the reduction is acceptable, what steps are being taken, and what recruitment and other measures NS is pursuing. The State Secretary acknowledged the reduction is undesirable, said NS should scale up as soon as possible, reported recruitment and staffing figures, and stated NS is examining longer trains with one conductor, while giving no concrete new national intervention.
I therefore expect NS to do absolutely everything to limit the inconvenience for travellers.
Ik verwacht dan ook van NS dat zij er écht alles aan doet om de hinder voor reizigers te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Van Ginneken over het aanbieden van petities door de gemeente Bergen en de Nederlandse Federatie Omgevingslawaai Motorvoertuigen (NEFOM)

MPs Hagen and Van Ginneken asked the State Secretary about petitions from NEFOM and the municipality of Bergen on motor vehicle noise nuisance, the RIVM advice on environmental noise, and steps taken per noise source. The State Secretary answered that concrete follow-up will be reported to parliament around the end of the year, noted that noise norms are generally met, and said an inventory of motor vehicle noise nuisance and a study are underway.
I expect to be able to inform your House about this around the end of this year.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer rond het eind van dit jaar hierover te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht 'Alles op alles voor verbreding A27'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether serious alternatives to widening the A27 that would spare the Amelisweerd nature area were ignored, including a 12-lane variant, and about the status of a regional alternative. The Minister replied that the 12-lane variants were studied but rejected for not giving a road-safety outcome, that the Schoof Commission reviewed the decision process, and that the region is preparing its own alternative in consultation with the ministry.
When the region has an alternative ready, we would gladly consult with the region, and we will continue to keep the House informed about the state of affairs.
Als de regio een alternatief gereed heeft, treden wij graag met hen in overleg en we zullen de Kamer blijven informeren over de stand van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken, Minhas, Bouchallikh en De Hoop over het bericht 'Inspectie: NS heeft onvoldoende zicht op gevaarlijke situaties'

MPs asked the State Secretary about a NRC report that the Inspectorate found NS had insufficient oversight of dangerous situations in trains, following a whistleblower complaint, including questions on maintenance, a possible concealed technical defect, and sanctions. The State Secretary answered that the ILT found no acute risk or violation, is monitoring NS's improvement measures, will share the ILT letters, and found no concealment, though many answers defer to NS's own information.
Such letters are currently not actively made public, but an exception is possible in consultation with those involved.
Dergelijke brieven worden op dit moment niet actief openbaar gemaakt, maar in overleg met betrokkenen is een uitzondering mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over de aantrekkelijkheid en betaalbaarheid van duurzame vormen van vervoer

An MP asked the state secretary about the affordability and attractiveness of rail travel and electric driving after energy contracts, tax reductions and fuel costs change. The state secretary confirmed the timing of expiring contracts and tax cuts, said the effects are not yet clear, and committed to scenarios for stimulating electric driving in spring 2023 and to ongoing price information to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het arbeidsconflict bij NS

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management and the Finance Minister why NS cancelled trains nationwide on 9 September 2022 due to a regional strike, how the affected area was expanded, and what criteria NS applied. The State Secretary answered that the nationwide cancellation was undesirable, that the strike area was larger than before, and that NS judged it could not guarantee a safe and reliable timetable, promising to ask NS for an explanation to be shared with parliament.

As I promised in the committee debate on Public Transport and Taxis of Wednesday 14 September, I will ask NS to reflect on the strikes and to set out again the reasons for the nationwide impact of the strike on 9 September, which I will share with your House.

Zoals ik heb toegezegd in het commissiedebat Openbaar Vervoer en Taxi van woensdag 14 september jl., zal ik NS vragen te reflecteren op de stakingen en om de redenen voor de landelijke uitstraling van de staking op 9 september nog eens op een rij te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Van Ginneken over het bericht 'Toezichthouder verzamelt ongevraagd info over 800.000 ggz-patiënten'

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport whether the NZa (healthcare regulator) may collect patients' mental health data without explicit consent, on what legal basis, and whether privacy principles and the Data Protection Authority were properly addressed. The minister answered that the NZa acts under its statutory powers in the Wmg, that data are pseudonymised and will be destroyed after use, that the reporting obligation was postponed to 1 January 2023, and that no further investigation will be ordered because the NZa decides itself how to gather information.

I will not instruct further research as described in questions 8 and 9, because, as stated in my answer to question 1, the NZa as an independent administrative body makes its own considerations about how it generates information.

Ik zal geen opdracht geven tot nader onderzoek zoals omschreven in vraag 8 en 9, omdat zoals gesteld in mijn antwoord op vraag 1 de NZa als ZBO haar eigen afwegingen maakt over de wijze waarop zij informatie genereert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Ginneken over de hoorplicht bij beroepen tegen verkeersboetes

MPs Sneller and Van Ginneken asked whether the Public Prosecution Service (OM) has failed for years to inform traffic-fine objectors of their right to be heard, whether it wrongly dismissed appeals as manifestly unfounded, and how the appeal threshold increase affects citizens' protection. The minister acknowledged the OM did not actively communicate the hearing right, said talks are underway to restore it, disputed the 90% manifestly-unfounded figure (1.9% actually), and defended the appeal-threshold rise as restoring the legislator's original intent.
The OM reports that persons who themselves indicated they wish to be heard are in fact heard.
Het OM meldt dat betrokkenen die zelf hebben aangegeven gehoord te willen worden, ook daadwerkelijk zijn gehoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Van der Laan over een geweldsincident tijdens de Amsterdam Pride

MPs Van Ginneken and Van der Laan asked the government about a violent incident involving an Uber driver during Amsterdam Pride, whether data exist on LHBTIQ+-related violence and refusals in taxis, and about the effectiveness of Uber's discrimination button and the Actieplan Veiligheid LHBTI. The state secretary answered that no specific figures are kept for taxi-sector incidents, that the investigation is ongoing, and pointed to existing general reports, a pending study and future policy letters.
No specific figures are kept on violent incidents in the taxi sector against LHBTIQ+ persons.
Er worden geen specifieke cijfers bijgehouden over geweld gerelateerde incidenten in de taxisector tegen LHBTIQ+-personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht 'Minder treinen door personeelstekort'

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of reduced train services due to staff shortages, the threat to public transport after BVOV funding ends, and wage conditions in rail. The government answered that NS will keep reducing some services through at least week 33, that a one-off 2023 transition safety net is in place, and that personnel policy is NS's own responsibility, so it has no role on wages.
My ministry has no role in the matter of wages and working conditions in the rail sector.
Mijn ministerie heeft geen rol bij het vraagstuk rondom de loonsituatie en arbeidsvoorwaarden in de spoorsector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Ginneken over het bericht dat de clouddienst van Microsoft niet gebruikt kan worden voor de uitwisseling of opslag van gevoelige of bijzondere persoonsgegevens

An MP from D66 asked ministers how they assess reports that Microsoft cloud services cannot be used for sensitive personal data given possible US intelligence access, and what measures will limit such use. The government answered that the DPIA does not rule out Microsoft services, that mitigation such as customer-managed encryption keys and standard contractual clauses apply, and that a national cloud strategy and EU enforcement work are pending.
Risks are identified that affect access to government services, but solutions are also identified to mitigate this risk.
Er worden risico’s gesignaleerd die raken aan de toegang tot overheidsdiensten, maar ook oplossingen geïdentificeerd om dit risico te mitigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over de brief 'Actualisatie prognose reizigersaantallen OV'

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management why KiM's public transport passenger forecasts are more optimistic than those of operators and regional authorities, and about model updates, uncertainty, uniform modelling and update frequency. The State Secretary answered at length, explaining sources and assumptions, that the KiM model was not changed, that operator forecasts are confidential, and that updates occur twice yearly.
Operators use confidential business information for their scenarios that is not publicly available.
Vervoerders gebruiken voor hun scenario's bedrijfsvertrouwelijke info die niet openbaar beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Van Ginneken over het gebruik van omstreden Chinese bewakingscamera’s door de Nederlandse overheid en politie

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Van Ginneken asked the ministers whether the Dutch government and police use Chinese surveillance cameras (Hikvision, Dahua), what security risks this poses, and what will be done. The government confirmed use of Chinese cameras, stated that national security is weighed in procurement case by case, announced a study into camera risks within central government, but said the police will keep using Dahua cameras and no central overview exists.
For this reason there is no central overview available of Chinese cameras in use by the government, the risks associated with them, or the considerations behind their purchase.

Daarom is er geen centraal overzicht beschikbaar van Chinese camera’s in gebruik bij de overheid en eventuele risico’s die daarmee verbonden zijn en ook niet van de afwegingen die ten grondslag lagen bij de aankoop.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Van Ginneken over het artikel 'Zo werd Myrthe Reuver de dupe van haar data: ‘Ze geloven in eerste instantie het systeem’'

MPs Kat and Van Ginneken asked the ministers about a newspaper report on credit assessments by credit-information bureaus based on general data, possibly including incorrect data from former residents, and about notification, objection, retention periods and BKR registrations. The government answered that such assessments on general data are undesirable, that incorrect data processing is unlawful, that GDPR rights apply, that the Dutch industry code sets an 8-year retention, and that the BKR retention period of five years is retained while a draft law on credit registration is prepared.
Processing incorrect personal data to arrive at the score is therefore unlawful.
Het verwerken van foutieve persoonsgegevens om tot de score te komen is dan ook onrechtmatig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Tjeerd de Groot over MIRT-projecten

D66 MPs asked the government to reconcile its 2019 pledge to reserve nitrogen room in the SSRS for seven MIRT infrastructure projects, funded partly by a national speed reduction, with its 2021 decision not to use that speed reduction for MIRT projects, and asked about the nitrogen mitigation for the A27 and the consequences of a April 2022 court ruling. The minister answered that the 2021 decision merely nuanced the 2019 pledge because the speed-reduction yield could not be guaranteed, that no SSRS nitrogen room from the speed reduction is used for these projects, that the A27/A12 amendment is still being prepared, and that the court ruling and the decision have no consequences for the pending plans.

With the second statement, your House was informed that the national speed reduction will not be used, because there is a risk that after each annual update and due to the effects of COVID-19 on mobility, the precise yield of the national speed reduction is not certain at the required level of detail.

Met de tweede uitspraak is uw Kamer geïnformeerd dat geen gebruik wordt gemaakt van de landelijke snelheidsverlaging, omdat het risico bestaat dat na elke jaarlijkse actualisatie en vanwege de effecten van COVID-19 op de mobiliteit de precieze opbrengst van de landelijke snelheidsverlaging niet op het vereiste detailniveau zeker is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en van Ginneken over automobiliteit van vluchtelingen uit Oekraïne in Nederland

MPs Podt and Van Ginneken asked whether Ukrainian refugees can renew Ukrainian car insurance or obtain Dutch insurance, and whether their Ukrainian driving licences lapse after 185 days, with consequences for work and life in the Netherlands. The government answered that Ukrainian insurers still issue green cards so policies can be extended, the Vereende offers short-term cover as a fallback, and the European Commission is preparing an EU-wide extension of the licence validity.
That insurance provides cover for three months and can be extended for a maximum of three months.
Die verzekering biedt voor drie maanden dekking en kan voor maximaal drie maanden worden verlengd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht 'ProRail moet schadevergoeding betalen voor trillend huis door passerende treinen'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about a court ruling ordering ProRail to pay damages for train vibrations, and about measures in Goes and possible norms for rail vibrations. The State Secretary said ProRail is appealing, measures have been taken in Goes with a monitoring study pending, and a norm-setting decision on vibrations will be prepared after research results expected this year.
After the legal procedure has concluded, I will assess the possible consequences of this.
Na afloop van de juridische procedure beoordeel ik de mogelijke gevolgen hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Ginneken over dwingend recht en het toepassen van de menselijke maat door het CBR

MPs Sneller and Van Ginneken asked whether the CBR (driving licence authority) and the courts can take personal circumstances into account, given that the Wegenverkeerswet and RMRG leave little room for balancing interests, and how this fits with proportionality and the Raad van State's reflection report. Minister Harbers answered that the legal framework is strict by design, the CBR uses passend contact and mitigating measures within it, the government is considering an Awb provision allowing administrative bodies to depart from mandatory rules, and a CBR knelpuntenbrief is expected in Q2 2022.

The cabinet is considering various amendments to better safeguard the general principles of proper administration, increase room for tailored decisions, and put the citizen's perspective at the forefront of service delivery.

Het kabinet overweegt diverse wijzigingen om de algemene beginselen van behoorlijk bestuur beter te borgen, ruimte voor maatwerk te vergroten en het burgerperspectief in de dienstverlening voorop te stellen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken, Dekker-Abdulaziz en Rajkowski over de beantwoording van de schriftelijke vragen inzake de vacature 'Senior beleidsmedewerker interceptie en digitale opsporing' bij het Minist

Three MPs asked the Justice Minister about a senior policy vacancy on interception and digital investigation, and whether intelligence services could intercept encrypted OTT communications, and how quantum threats to encryption should be handled. The minister said intelligence services fall under other ministers, that an inventory of lawful access to encrypted evidence is underway with EU work pending, that OTT providers are currently not subject to decryption obligations, and that quantum effects on encryption fall outside the inventory's scope.
I cannot speak for the intelligence and security services (IenV services), as these services fall under the portfolios of the Ministers of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and of Defence.

Ik kan niet voor de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten (IenV-diensten) spreken, deze diensten vallen onder de portefeuille van de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en Defensie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Van der Graaf over de kwartaalrapportage OV Ombudsman van het vierde kwartaal van 2021 en het bericht 'Gps-proef moet eind maken aan meervoudig in- en uitchecken in ov'

Two MPs asked the state secretary about station lift and escalator outages, bus ramps, and dual-card (subscription plus pay-as-you-go) problems raised by the OV Ombudsman. The secretary acknowledged the priority of repairs, described existing ProRail-NS arrangements and monitoring, and said the dual-card issue will be solved by the OVpay programme, while declining to take further immediate steps on the current card system.
I share the view of the OV Ombudsman that the repair of lifts and escalators should be given priority in keeping stations accessible.
Ik deel de mening van de OV Ombudsman dat de reparatie van liften en roltrappen prioriteit moet hebben in het toegankelijk houden van stations.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht 'Op bezoek bij omstreden fietskoeriers: 'We zullen nooit pushen om harder te rijden''

An MP asked the ministers whether the rapid rise of quick-delivery couriers causes traffic danger, nuisance and streetscape decline, what tools municipalities have, and about research, consultations and youth-courier initiatives. The minister answered that municipalities hold the main instruments, that research results are due later in 2022 and that consultations with the G4 will be shared after the summer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Van Ginneken, Van der Molen, De Hoop en Bouchallikh over toegankelijkheid in het openbaar vervoer

Five MPs asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about accessibility of public transport, including the delayed Bestuursakkoord toegankelijkheid OV, assistance and toilets on regional trains, station counter closures, and the replacement of accessible buses by buurtbus and taxi concepts. The state secretary confirmed the accord was not concluded due to the outgoing cabinet, promised to aim for completion before summer without committing to specifics, and said a study on buurtbus accessibility is underway with results expected in November 2022.
I also consider it desirable that the measures are developed through a careful process.
Ik vind het daarnaast wenselijk dat de maatregelen tot stand komen via een zorgvuldig proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Van Ginneken over het niet dragen van mondkapjes in de taxi.

Two D66 MPs asked why the mask requirement in taxis lapses when only one passenger is present, whether this differs from public transport, and about risks and the use of partitions. The state secretary answered that the exemption follows from the 1.5-metre distance norm, that taxis are not public transport, and that no signals of enforcement problems have been received.
The Ministry of I&W regularly has contact with the transport operators about the corona measures.
Het Ministerie van IenW heeft regelmatig contact met de vervoerders over de coronamaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht 'Rijbewijs halen? Dan moet je bij deze rijschool minstens één keer in een elektrische auto lessen?'

An MP asked the minister whether driving schools offer lessons in electric cars, whether the curriculum and CBR exams cover EV-specific skills, and how government encourages EV lessons. The minister answered that reliable data are lacking, that schools choose their own curriculum, and that the government will pursue pilots, national working groups and EU action on the automatic-transmission code, but made no binding commitment on a driving-school EV plan beyond exploring options.
Inquiries with the driving school sector show that reliable figures are not available.
Uit navraag bij de rijscholenbranche komt naar voren dat betrouwbare cijfers niet voorhanden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ginneken, Van der Laan en Simons over de moorden op, geweld tegen en zelfdodingen door trans-personen in Nederland

MPs Simons, Van der Laan and Van Ginneken asked about murders of, violence against, and suicides among trans people in the Netherlands, including official statistics, a registration system, anti-violence and reporting policy, and suicide prevention. The Minister answered that no separate registration system is planned, cited police and prosecution data, and described existing LHBTI safety, reporting and suicide-prevention measures and waiting-list efforts in trans care.
In light of the available material, I see no reason to set up an additional registration system.
In het licht van het beschikbare materiaal, zie ik geen aanleiding om een aanvullend registratiesysteem in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Van Ginneken over kindermisbruik

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about child sexual abuse networks, police capacity and psychological support, the removal of abuse imagery online, and legal options under the Digital Services Act. The minister declined to discuss individual prosecutions and operational methods, pointed to existing takedown practices, the planned ATKM oversight authority and EU proposals, and did not commit to new capacity.
Because of operational interests, no further detail is given on specific investigative methods or investigations.
Vanwege het operationeel belang wordt niet nader ingegaan op specifieke opsporingsmethoden of -onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over waarom Nederland het Dataprotectieverdrag nog niet geratificeerd heeft

An MP asked why the Netherlands has not yet ratified the modernised data protection convention (Convention 108+), whether the caretaker cabinet plans to ratify it and when, and how the minister views the TIB and CTIVD call for prompt ratification. The minister replied that the approval procedure was paused pending an external analysis of recent ECtHR case law on bulk interception, which is now ready and will be shared, and that the procedure will now be resumed in line with the TIB and CTIVD wish.
The approval procedure will now be resumed, in line with the wish of the TIB and the CTIVD.
De goedkeuringsprocedure zal nu, in lijn met de wens van de TIB en de CTIVD, hervat worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht in de Gelderlander van 23 januari: 'Heisa in de Achterhoek over nieuwe tak van de Betuweroute: ‘Het brengt ons helemaal niets’

An MP asked the state secretary about residents' concerns over a study of the economic and social value of a northern branch of the Betuweroute rail freight line, and about involving local parties and German alternatives. The state secretary answered that no decision has been taken, the preliminary study (due spring 2022) will be reported to parliament, and stakeholders and livability will be considered, with scenarios to be examined only if a route study is decided.
When the study is completed, I will inform your House.
Wanneer het onderzoek is afgerond, zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht “FNV Spoor is er klaar mee: personeel op IC Brussel belaagd door ‘tuig van de trein’’

MP Van Ginneken asked about intimidation and violence on the IC Brussel line, the lack of enforcement powers across the Belgian border, and union demands for action. The Staatssecretaris answered that incident numbers did not specifically rise during lockdowns, described extra NS and police measures, and said cross-border enforcement has no legal basis, with ongoing cooperation with Belgian counterparts.
On the basis of these agreements I will remain in close contact with NS and the Belgian government to be able to respond quickly to comparable situations.
Op basis van deze afspraken zal ik met de NS en de Belgische overheid in nauw contact blijven om snel op vergelijkbare situaties te kunnen reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Podt over het bericht dat de politie onschuldige asielzoekers aan strafrechtelijke informatie koppelde

MPs Van Ginneken and Podt asked whether police wrongly matched asylum seekers' phone data against criminal intelligence, whether the data still exists and whether it was used in criminal cases. The government admits the Athene project lacked a legal basis after the 2019 privacy law change, says the project was stopped and the data destroyed, and says the Raad van State advice on statutory safeguards is taken to heart, while several questions get only partial or general answers.
That realisation came through a Data Protection Impact Assessment carried out within AVIM in November 2021 as part of a force-wide programme.
Dat besef kwam dankzij de uitvoering van een Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) 2 die in november 2021 binnen AVIM als onderdeel van een korpsbreed programma is gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Sneller over het bericht ‘Jongen (17) krijgt allereerste ‘online gebiedsverbod’ in Nederland, maar wat betekent dat eigenlijk?’

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a Utrecht mayor's order (last onder dwangsom) barring a 17-year-old from online incitement to riot, and whether it is lawful and what powers mayors have online. The minister said the measure is a local matter for the mayor and courts, that it cannot assess the decision, and that the government will provide guidance on online public-order monitoring for municipalities.
It is not for me to judge the mayor's conduct. That concerns a local matter.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over het optreden van de burgemeester. Dat betreft een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het gebruik van gezichtsherkenningssoftware door de politie van het omstreden bedrijf Clearview AI

MP Van Ginneken asks the Justice Minister to explain why an earlier answer denying any biometric real-time face recognition by police was reformulated, and whether police use of Clearview AI has occurred without authorization. The Minister says the reformulation clarifies that police do not currently authorize real-time face recognition for surveillance, that Clearview use is incompatible with law and fundamental rights, and that police internal procedures and impact assessments govern any future use.
For the use of biometric surveillance in public space by the police, in the sense of real-time facial recognition, no permission is currently given within the police organisation.
Voor het gebruik van biometrische surveillance in de publieke ruimte door de politie, in de zin van real time gezichtsherkenning, wordt op dit moment in de politieorganisatie geen toestemming gegeven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Van Ginneken over het onderzoek 'Transcript from the Margins'

MPs Podt and Van Ginneken asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the 'Transcript from the Margins' report on how the asylum procedure treats transgender applicants, including IND reliance on country information, the sourcing of ambtsberichten, misgendering in communication, and complaints. The State Secretary replied that individual assessments take the applicant's position into account, that the small sample limits representativeness, that IND will meet Transgender Netwerk Nederland, and that complaints about transgender applicants cannot be traced because asylum motive is not registered.
Following the report, the IND has therefore extended an invitation to Transgender Netwerk Nederland to meet with the IND's LHBTI coordinators.
De IND heeft naar aanleiding van het rapport daarom een uitnodiging verstrekt aan Transgender Netwerk Nederland om in gesprek te treden met de LHBTI-coördinatoren van de IND.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over de voortgang op interlandelijke adoptie

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about progress on a new intercountry adoption system, the impact of the adoption suspension on licence holders, the reopening of adoption routes, and the expert centre. The minister replied that findings on the future of intercountry adoption will be sent to parliament by end 2021, that 40 children were approved for admission, that talks with licence holders on continuity are ongoing, and that the expert centre is not yet operational, targeted for the first half of 2022.
I will inform the House before the end of 2021 about the outcomes of the exploration into the future of intercountry adoption.
Ik informeer uw Kamer voor het einde van 2021 over de uitkomsten van de verkenning naar de toekomst van interlandelijke adoptie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Van Ginneken, Kuiken, Ellemeet en Simons over het faillissement van de ggz-instelling voor transgenderzorg 'Stepwork'

The State Secretary answered that continuity of care is secured through takeover by Genderhealthcare, that the government had intervened repeatedly since 2019, and that a review of the psychological assessment requirement is being prepared via ZonMw.
The policy of the Ministry of VWS is aimed at continuity of care for patients and clients, not at continuity of individual institutions.
Het beleid van VWS is gericht op continuïteit van zorg voor patiënten en cliënten, en niet op continuïteit van individuele instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Ginneken over het bericht dat de politie zonder wettelijke basis automobilisten en bijrijders heeft gefotografeerd voor opsporing

MPs Sneller and Van Ginneken asked the Justice Minister about reports that police photographed drivers and passengers' faces without a legal basis for investigations, and how oversight, retention and evidence use are handled. Minister Grapperhaus disputes that faces were photographed without basis, explains the ANPR legal grounds and the decision to blur all personal images, notes three cases of unblurred photos being shared, and says the evaluation and oversight by the AP and internal bodies apply.
With regard to the question, I want to emphasise that there is by no means any unlawful surveillance.
Ten aanzien van de vraagstelling wil ik benadrukken dat geenszins sprake is van onrechtmatige surveillance.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Bouchallikh over het bericht dat de Nederlandse politie toch gebruik heeft gemaakt van gezichtsherkenningssoftware van het omstreden bedrijf Clearview AI

MPs Van Ginneken and Bouchallikh asked whether Dutch police used Clearview AI facial recognition software despite earlier denials, and how this fits with privacy law. The minister answered that logs predate February 2020, police deny operational use and have no contract, the authorities cannot verify the claims, and no further legislative steps are planned because no legal gap was found.
Upon inquiry, it has not emerged that Dutch police employees used a test account on or following this event.
Op navraag is niet gebleken dat door medewerkers van de Nederlandse politie op of naar aanleiding hiervan gebruik is gemaakt van een testaccount.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Ginneken over het bericht dat het ROC Mondriaan in Den Haag is gehackt

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education about the hack of ROC Mondriaan in The Hague, its effects on students and staff, timing of recovery and data breach, and whether other ROCs and the sector are protected. The minister answered that systems were shut down as a precaution, teaching largely continued, recovery will take weeks, data including class lists and financial details has been published, and sector-wide security initiatives and a dialogue with the MBO Raad are underway.
That cannot be said at this moment.
Dat is op dit moment niet te zeggen.

De KVK heeft naar aanleiding van de onbevoegde opvraging aangifte gedaan tegen de advocaat.

The State Secretary answered that home addresses will be shielded by default via a planned amendment, but shielding registered business addresses that are also home addresses conflicts with EU law and is only done in exceptional cases on request, with a further letter promised.
I have further made a proposal to lay down in the Trade Register Decree 2008 that the Chamber of Commerce will from now on shield registered home addresses by default.
Ik heb voorts een voorstel gedaan om in het Handelsregisterbesluit 2008 vast te leggen dat de Kamer van Koophandel als zodanig ingeschreven woonadressen voortaan standaard afschermt.

MPs asked why the compensation scheme for the former transgender sterilisation requirement was not published by 1 July, how the Transgender and Intersex Collective was involved, and why the amount is EUR 5,000. Vanwege staatsveiligheid kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de specifieke maatregelen die de onder mij ressorterende diensten treffen.

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a Palantir pilot for pandemic response in southern Dutch safety regions, covering who signed, contract disclosure, the absence of a DPIA, data access, Palantir's reputation and future agreements. The minister answered that six southern safety regions signed a pilot contract with Palantir, the contracts are marked confidential but could be disclosed, no DPIA was done because only public data was used, and no future agreements exist.

Hoewel deze overeenkomsten om concurrentieredenen de status «vertrouwelijk» hebben gekregen, heeft de directeur van de Veiligheidsregio Limburg-Noord mij gemeld dat ze indien nodig openbaar gemaakt kunnen worden.

It does not matter whether work takes place at home or at the workplace. The rules for monitoring employees are the same in both cases.
Het maakt niet uit of het werk thuis of op de werkplek plaatsvindt. De regels voor controle van werknemers zijn in beide gevallen gelijk.

Het is nu aan de ILT om in het kader van het verscherpt toezicht de uitvoering van het verbeterplan actief te bewaken.

requests the Minister to make possible a reconsideration of the ban on pulse fishing in Europe
verzoekt de Minister een heroverweging van het verbod op de pulsvisserij in Europa mogelijk te maken
Motie van het lid Vedder c.s. over het hanteren van bufferstroken van maximaal 100 meter
Asks the government to use buffer strips of at most 100 metres around nature areas instead of the 250-metre zone, citing RIVM data on emission decline.
requests the government to use buffer strips of at most 100 metres
verzoekt de regering bufferstroken van maximaal 100 meter te hanteren
Motie van het lid Van der Plas c.s. over alsnog de aangenomen motie-Van Campen c.s. over innovatieve technologieën uitvoeren
Asks the government to implement the previously adopted motion on innovative technologies to reduce nitrogen emissions in agriculture.
Amendement van het lid Vedder c.s. over middelen voor de regeling Vestigingssteun jonge landbouwers
Moves 19.9 million euro within the agriculture budget to the new young farmers establishment scheme, funded from a guarantee facility reserve.
In article 21 Agriculture and horticulture, the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by € 19,900 (x € 1,000).
In artikel 21 Land- en tuinbouw worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 19.900 (x € 1.000).
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over de PwC speelveldtoets die de afval- en recyclingsector heeft laten uitvoeren op het invoeren van €567 miljoen extra heffingen op afval

An MP asked the government about a PwC level-playing-field study showing the proposed €567 million waste levies could harm recycling competitiveness, push waste export and endanger the Aramis CCS project. The government acknowledged these risks, pointed to ongoing work with the waste sector on alternative measures and a decision planned for spring 2026, but gave no firm commitment to change the levy design now.
That is precisely why the cabinet, together with the sector in the Waste Sector Working Group, is exploring alternative arrangements that better support the circular economy.
Juist daarom is het kabinet, samen met de sector in de Werkgroep Afvalsector, bezig met het verkennen van alternatieve invullingen die de circulaire economie beter ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas, Vermeer, Pierik, Van Zanten, Rikkers-Oosterkamp, Wijen-Nass, Oostenbrink en Joseph over optredens van de haatprediker Bob Vylan in Nederland

MPs from BBB asked whether a Bob Vylan concert in Paradiso calling for violence against Zionists and whether such performances should be allowed, and asked about criminal liability, entry bans and municipal responsibility. The minister said prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, declined to comment on individual cases, and noted that municipal mayors decide on events and that entry refusal is possible under Schengen rules but depends on available information.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to investigate exactly what was said. The police investigation into this is still ongoing.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te onderzoeken wat er precies is gezegd. Het politieonderzoek hiernaar loopt nog.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pierik en Verkuijlen vragen gesteld over de nachtelijke bereikbaarheid van de Waddeneilanden

Two MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about night-time access to the Wadden islands, including the stalled night watertaxi service to Ameland, the status of a motion, the planned MARIN study and a pilot. The minister answered that an independent MARIN study on safe night speeds is due at year-end, the pilot depends on operators and an environmental permit, and night watertaxis remain legally possible at 20 km/h.
That is why an independent study into a safe night-time sailing speed is being carried out by the maritime research bureau MARIN.
Daarom wordt een onafhankelijk onderzoek uitgevoerd naar een veilige vaarsnelheid in de nacht door maritiem onderzoeksbureau MARIN.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over het nieuwsbericht 'Den Helder Airport ziet status ‘nationaal belang’ als enige reddingsboei' van 11 maart 2025 in Regio Noordkop

MP Pierik asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Den Helder Airport's threatened survival, including a claimed 300% rent increase, lack of 'national importance' status, CBS statistics, and whether the government will decide on that status by end 2025. The Minister answered that Den Helder Airport is a civil company rather than a national-importance civil airport, that rent rises follow the integral cost model and indexation, that the national government is not responsible for its operations, and that no decision on that status is planned.
Den Helder Airport (DHA) is not a civil airport but a civil company.
Den Helder Airport (DHA) is geen civiele luchthaven, maar een civiel bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over het bericht ‘Vergoedingen voor faunaschade explosief gestegen’

The MP Pierik (BBB) asks whether rising goose-damage compensation reflects failing fauna management, whether the 20% standard own-risk and leges deter claims so the damage picture is incomplete, and whether provinces should abolish leges and lower own-risk. The State Secretary answers that provinces are responsible for this policy, that the true damage is not fully measured, that a study is underway with results expected in Q4 2025, and that she declines to intervene in provincial competences.
Provinces are responsible for policy on geese and for financing the damage compensation schemes.
Provincies zijn verantwoordelijk voor beleid met betrekking tot ganzen en voor de financiering van de schadetegemoetkomingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pierik en Stoffer over onnodige trainingseisen voor vissers Wet bemanning zeeschepen

MPs Pierik and Stoffer asked whether mandatory additional safety training for fishers under the new Wet bemanning zeeschepen is disproportionate and not aligned with practice on fishing vessels, and asked the government to pause implementation. The minister answered that the only change is a five-yearly refresher for basic safety training required by STCW-F, agreed with sector bodies, with a transition period to 2030, and declined to pause the law, which enters into force on 1 July 2025.
The only substantive change in the new Wet bemanning zeeschepen, which enters into force on 1 July 2025, is a five-yearly refresher obligation for this training.
De enige inhoudelijke aanpassing in de nieuwe Wet bemanning zeeschepen, die per 1 juli 2025 in werking treedt, is een 5-jaarlijkse herhalingsverplichting voor deze training.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over de Technische Briefing over de Contouren landelijk aanvalsplan invasieve exoten

An MP asks the State Secretary about the evidence base on invasive alien species: which native species are harmed, how much biodiversity loss and damage is attributable to them, who is responsible for control, and what funding exists. The State Secretary answers that no national overview of harm or costs exists, describes responsibilities split between the national government, provinces and water boards, and states that a national action plan will follow around summer 2025 along with funding decisions still pending.
There is no overall picture of native species that suffer damage from invasive alien species.
Er is geen totaalbeeld van inheemse soorten die schade ondervinden door invasieve exoten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over de Aziatische hoornaar

An MP asks the State Secretary about the spread of the Asian hornet in the Netherlands, its impact on biodiversity, beekeeping, fruit and agriculture, responsibility for control across ministries, and whether control can continue year-round and be funded. The State Secretary acknowledges the spread, says full eradication is no longer feasible so the species is shifting to control, notes limited known economic damage, and points to ongoing provincial funding talks.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over de beperkte bereikbaarheid van Zeeland bij stremmingen van de Vlaketunnel (A58)

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the closure of the Vlaketunnel on the A58, the delayed partial reopening, risks to schoolchildren cycling, economic losses, and the adequacy of Zeeland's emergency routes. The minister replied that the closure followed a technical fault, partial reopening came after the morning rush hour due to a more complex fault, an evaluation is pending, and no structural tracking of losses exists for unplanned closures, while committing to ongoing regional cooperation and a future Rijkswaterstaat-led traffic management arrangement.
The evaluation by Rijkswaterstaat and others should reveal why the tunnel tube could not be partially reopened earlier.
Uit de evaluatie van onder andere Rijkswaterstaat moet blijken waarom de tunnelbuis niet eerder gedeeltelijk kon worden opengesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pierik en Stoffer naar aanleiding van het artikel in de Telegraaf ‘Recyclingsector in actie tegen extra plasticheffing: ’Kabinet zoekt geld, afvalsector wordt gepakt’’

MPs Pierik and Stoffer asked the government whether a planned plastic levy would fall on the waste and recycling sector, why recycling is struggling, and what the cost burden is. The State Secretary answered that the levy's design is still under review in spring budget decisions, that recyclers face high energy prices and EU rules, and gave tax-rate tables and Belgian and German comparisons, without committing to a final design.
The design of this is part of the spring budget decision-making. One cannot anticipate this.
De vormgeving hiervan is onderdeel van de voorjaarsbesluitvorming. Hier kan niet op worden vooruitgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Pierik over de onafhankelijkheid en transparantie van de review op het VGO-III-onderzoek

MPs Van der Plas and Pierik asked whether the peer review of the VGO-III goat-farm health study was independent and transparent, and whether a new independent review will be commissioned. The minister answers that the study was peer reviewed in journals, two independent epidemiologists reviewed it in 2020, the Gezondheidsraad is advising on its evidence, and no new independent review is planned.

As indicated in the letter to Parliament accompanying the VGO-III final report, the Health Council has been asked to provide further interpretation of the evidence on health effects for residents near goat farms.

Zoals in de Kamerbrief bij het eindrapport VGO-III is aangegeven, is de Gezondheidsraad gevraagd om een nadere duiding te geven van de bewijslast met betrekking tot gezondheidseffecten voor omwonenden van geitenhouderijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Aukje de Vries, Soepboer en Pierik over de gesloten brug bij Uitwellingerga

Four MPs asked the minister why temporary solutions for the closed Uitwellingerga bridge are not feasible, what the impact is on residents and businesses, and whether bridge inspections were adequate. The minister explains that only a temporary fixed bridge deck option is being pursued for August 2025, that the bridge cannot be repaired, that about 1,500 people in surrounding villages are affected, and that inspection procedures are being evaluated.
Rijkswaterstaat regularly evaluates the inspection procedures; the experiences at Uitwellingerga are also being taken into account.
Rijkswaterstaat evalueert de inspectieprocedures regelmatig; ook de ervaringen van Uitwellingerga worden hierin meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over het artikel ‘Brug Uitwellingerga kan niet worden gerepareerd: nieuwe brug pas in 2029 klaar’

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the prolonged closure of the Uitwellingerga bridge, the temporary bridge timeline, the 2029 permanent replacement, the vaarseizoen 2026 options and ferry, and the risk to nearby bridges. The minister answered in detail on timelines and options but with several deferrals to decisions still pending.
The aim is to take a decision on this by May 2025 at the latest.
Beoogd is om hierover uiterlijk in mei 2025 een besluit te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over uitzonderingsgronden op basis van het Verdrag van Aarhus

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about exceptions to public access to environmental and emissions information under the Aarhus Convention, Directive 2003/4/EC, the GDPR and the Dutch Woo, including case law and whether Dutch disclosure rules are broader than in neighbouring countries. The minister answered question by question, explaining that emissions data cannot be withheld under several exceptions, that the Woo is applied in line with EU law, and that a study on comparable regimes in other countries is underway.
Under the Woo, emissions data must always be made public (Article 5.1, seventh paragraph, of the Woo).
Op grond van de Woo moet emissiegegevens altijd openbaar worden gemaakt (artikel 5.1, zevende lid, van de Woo).
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Pierik over de import van Russische kunstmest en de mogelijkheden om alternatieven zoals RENURE sneller toe te laten

Pierik (BBB) asked the minister about EU plans to cut imports of Russian fertiliser and how to speed up alternatives such as RENURE, and whether to press for it at the EU Foreign Affairs Council. Minister Wiersma answered that the Netherlands supports tariffs on Russian fertiliser and is actively lobbying the Commission and member states for fast RENURE approval, but declined to answer the Council question in time and did not commit to changing the Aa-list policy.
I am currently working hard to get RENURE approved and am also raising this point with my European colleagues and the European Commission.
Ik zet mij momenteel vol in voor de toelating van RENURE en breng hierbij ook dit punt onder de aandacht van mijn Europese collega's en de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Flach, Van Campen, Graus en Pierik over de dure importcontroles bij groente en fruit

MPs from SGP, VVD, PVV and BBB asked why residue controls on imported fruit and vegetables at the national reference lab WFSR are so expensive compared with private labs in Belgium, and whether private labs could be allowed to do them. The government answered that the NVWA cost-recovery tariffs cover sampling, transport and lab analysis, that WFSR is non-profit and independence rules rule out private labs for now, and that a study and consultation with industry are underway with results promised before summer.
I will also commission a research bureau to look into this further. Your House will be informed about this before the summer.
Ook zal ik een onderzoeksbureau opdracht geven om dit nader uit te zoeken. Uw Kamer zal hier voor de zomer over worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over het artikel 'Derogatiebedrijven helpen kabinet een handje: 'Nitraatconcentratie daalt naar, op of onder de norm''

An MP asks ministers whether the reported fall in nitrate levels on derogation farms, and the claim that ending the manure derogation will help water quality, are supported by RIVM and Wageningen research and by the European Commission. The ministers answer that the reports were shared with the Commission, that ending the derogation may reduce grassland and shift fertiliser use, and that additional measures such as the 7th and 8th Nitrate Action Programmes are needed.
Yes, these reports have been shared with the European Commission by the Minister of LVVN.
Ja, deze rapporten zijn door de Minister van LVVN met de Europese Commissie gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rikkers-Oosterkamp en Pierik over overheidssubsidie voor het Taboer-platform

Two MPs from BBB asked the government about its funding for Taboer, a platform breaking taboos on mental health in agriculture, including whether the subsidy is being phased out and why it sits under Agriculture rather than Health. The minister confirmed the current programme ends in April 2025, said he wants to continue funding and is in talks with the sector on terms, and stated that the sector and government share responsibility for the costs.
I am willing to make a financial contribution in the coming years as well to cover Taboer's costs.
Ik ben bereid om ook de komende jaren een financiële bijdrage te leveren om kosten van Taboer te dekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over Praalwagens

Mp Pierik (BBB) asked the minister whether stricter APK, registration and plating rules for float vehicles at carnival parades are unduly costly for traditional carnival associations, and what alternatives and communication took place. The minister answered that floats fall under existing vehicle categories, that the rules stem from an EU directive, that existing exemptions apply, that no data exists on affected associations, and that communication went through industry bodies rather than directly to all carnival associations.
No data is available on which carnival associations use which type of vehicle in carnival parades.
Er is geen data beschikbaar omtrent welke carnavalsverenigingen welk type voertuig inzetten bij carnavalsoptochten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Olger van Dijk en Pierik over het bericht 'Rijksadviseur Wouter Veldhuis is om: Lelylijn zonder Duitse connectie wél van belang.'

MPs Olger van Dijk and Pierik asked the State Secretary about a news report on the Lelylijn and Nedersaksenlijn rail projects, including whether further study should be done and how the projects can be financed. The State Secretary answered that both lines are priorities, that MIRT start conditions require about 75% financing not yet secured (roughly 7 billion euro for Lelylijn and 1.3 billion for Nedersaksenlijn), that financing options are still being studied, and that a final decision on next steps will be taken by the spring memorandum.
By the spring memorandum (April 2025) at the latest, the cabinet will take the definitive decision on the next steps for the Lelylijn.
Uiterlijk bij voorjaarsnota (april 2025) zal door het kabinet het definitieve besluit over de vervolgstappen voor de Lelylijn worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over de situatie in Sluiskil.

An MP asks the minister whether Rijkswaterstaat is liable for groundwater flooding in Sluiskil, whether the damage is really due to homes rather than the state, whether residents can be compensated, and whether the damwanden were deep enough. The minister answers that Rijkswaterstaat is not legally liable, that causes are mixed including housing age, that a joint drainage programme with the municipality is planned, and that no new legal basis for compensation is needed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis, De Hoop, Pierik, Postma, Stoffer en Vedder over de voortgang van de verruiming van het sluizencomplex bij Kornwerderzand

MPs asked about the delayed and costlier widening of the Kornwerderzand lock complex, including whether cost increases stem from tighter Rijk standards, the salinity problem, the bridges, and whether the Rijk should bear costs. The minister answered that the cost rise reflects a more realistic estimate rather than new norms, that the regional province must make a substantial contribution, and that talks with the region are being restarted, without firm commitments on financing.

In the consultation with the deputy it was indicated that if the region chooses to realise the project, IenW first expects a substantial contribution from the regional governments towards the identified cost increase.

In het overleg met de gedeputeerde is aangegeven dat als de regio ervoor kiest het project te willen realiseren, IenW eerst een substantiële bijdrage van de regionale overheden verwacht voor de geconstateerde kostenstijging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over het onteigenen van grond om een betere waterkwaliteit te bereiken

Pierik (BBB) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about expropriating land to improve water quality, including whether land can be expropriated when the pollution source lies abroad or has no proven link to the land, and about Belgian sewer overflows affecting the Mark. The minister answered that expropriation is legally possible under the Omgevingswet only with a justified reason and urgency, that the government is not a proponent of compulsory expropriation except in extreme necessity, and that transboundary pollution is raised bilaterally and via river commissions.
Expropriation can only take place if there is a justified reason for it.
Onteigenen kan alleen plaatsvinden als hier een gegronde reden voor is.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Pierik en Van der Plas over de handhaving op de huis- en hobbydierenlijst

MPs Van der Plas and Pierik asked whether the Minister is aware of a commitment made in court to suspend enforcement of the breeding ban for animals on the pet list and whether enforcement could be paused for all non-listed species until six weeks after the ruling. The Minister confirmed awareness but declined to suspend enforcement broadly, citing risk-based supervision and animal welfare, while pointing to reversible contraception and a practical solution pending the objection phase.
So I cannot commit to temporarily refraining from enforcement altogether.
Dus ik kan niet toezeggen om voorlopig helemaal af te zien van handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over organische stofrijke meststoffen binnen de fosfaatgebruiksnorm

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether straw-rich manure from non-organic pigs is excluded from the differentiated phosphate standard and grant scheme, while manure from other animals and organic pigs qualifies, and questioned inconsistent manure definitions and humification data. The minister answered that such manure qualifies only when applied on organic arable farms, acknowledged an erroneous explanatory note, denied any uneven playing field, and could not answer by the requested date.
The straw-rich solid manure of non-organic pigs is also designated, but only on the condition that it is applied on an organic farm for plant production.
Ook de strorijke vaste mest van niet-biologisch gehouden varkens is aangewezen, maar wel op de voorwaarde dat deze wordt toegepast op een biologisch bedrijf voor plantaardige productie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over het AD artikel ‘Groenten verrotten onder de grond door extreme regenval: ‘Dat gaat onherroepelijk tot tekorten leiden’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about crop losses and farm planning difficulties caused by extreme wet weather and whether eco-scheme requirements could be relaxed or extended. The minister sympathised, postponed some eco-activity start dates, but refused to allow adding new eco-activities after the Gecombineerde opgave deadline and declined further changes to the weidegang requirements for now.
I will closely monitor the situation during the year and, if necessary, seek renewed advice from Stichting Weidegang on adjusting the conditions.
Ik zal de situatie gedurende het jaar goed in de gaten houden en, indien nodig, opnieuw advies vragen aan Stichting Weidegang over aanpassing van de voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Pierik over het incident waarbij een hond aangevallen is door een wolf

Two MPs from BBB asked the State Secretary for Agriculture, Fisheries, Food Security and Nature about a dog killed by a wolf in Leusden, including whether a 'problem wolf' label applies, whether interventions are possible, and how to protect people and pets. The State Secretary answered that the province of Utrecht could not yet license action against the parent pair because the individual wolf was not identified, that the Interprovincial Wolf Plan and possible changes to the wolf's protection status are being pursued, and that he will raise the issue with European counterparts.
I want to work with the provinces to create more possibilities to act more quickly against wolves showing problematic behaviour.
Ik wil me samen met provincies inzetten voor meer mogelijkheden om sneller op te treden bij wolven met problematisch gedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over champost

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether spent mushroom substrate (champost) should be treated like GFT compost rather than under manure law, citing a 2006 WUR report and claims about nutrient and water retention benefits. The minister accepts that champost can be seen as compost agronomically but notes it still counts as manure under the Meststoffenwet, and offers to ask the expert commission whether its efficiency coefficient could be aligned with compost, while the answers to the questions were delivered late.
I will ask the Commission of Experts on the Fertilisers Act whether such an adjustment can be justified.
Ik zal de Commissie Deskundigen Meststoffenwet vragen of een dergelijke aanpassing te verantwoorden is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over de huis- en hobbydierlijst

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the pet list (huis- en hobbydierenlijst), including transitional rules, the legal basis after a 2017 court ruling on transparency, a pending objection by Our-EARTH, and whether enforcement can be paused during appeal. The minister answered that transitional rules allow existing animals to be kept until death, that the list rests on independent scientific advice, that objections have no suspensive effect so enforcement continues, and gave short answers to the remaining questions.
Objection and appeal procedures have no suspensive effect (see article 6:16 of the General Administrative Law Act) on the entry into force of the pet list on 1 July 2024.
Bezwaar- en beroepsprocedures hebben geen schorsende werking (zie artikel 6:16 van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht) ten aanzien van de inwerkingtreding van de huis- en hobbydierenlijst op 1 juli 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Flach, Vedder, Postma, Grinwis en Pierik over de visserij en ETS-2

Five MPs asked whether fisheries should be brought under the EU ETS-2 carbon market and what the consequences would be for the sector. The minister answers that the cabinet has decided not to opt fisheries in, citing lack of a viable path for the sector, EU state-aid limits and unequal competition, and that a WECR impact study will be sent to Parliament.
The cabinet has now decided not to bring fisheries under ETS2 through the opt-in.
Inmiddels heeft het kabinet besloten om visserij niet onder het ETS2 te brengen middels de opt-in
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pierik en Van der Plas over het rapport “Hinweise zum Einsatz autogener BTV-3 Impfstoffe”

Two MPs from BBB asked the Minister of Agriculture about a German expert report on autogenous BTV-3 vaccines, including whether Dutch vets may prescribe them, whether NVWA enforcement threats harm farmers, and liability for damage. The Minister confirmed conditional authorisation of three regular BTV-3 vaccines, said autogenous vaccines are restricted to specific herds and recalled by the German manufacturer for safety issues, refused liability, and declined to individually answer all questions by the deadline.
I am not going to ensure that.
Ik ga daar niet voor zorgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over uitbetaling GLB-gelden ecoregelingen

MP Pierik (BBB) asked the minister why many farmers had still not received their CAP eco-scheme payments, why the expected payment share was delayed, and whether compensation was possible. Minister Adema attributed the delay to late approval of national funding, a complex and late-finalised 2023 CAP strategic plan, and set 30 June 2024 as the deadline for all payments, while declining compensation.
I do not provide for compensation because the statutory deadline for the payments is 30 June following the year in which the application was submitted.
Ik voorzie niet in compensatie want de wettelijke termijn van de betalingen is 30 juni 3 volgend op het jaar dat de aanvraag is ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pierik en Van der Plas over het artikel 'Toekomst van Gorsselse melkveehouders onzeker, want in het bos staan eiken in plaats van iepen'

MPs Pierik and Van der Plas asked the minister about a Trouw article on Gorssel dairy farmers facing uncertainty because the Eester Loo forest was reclassified as beech-oak rather than elm-ash, and about the wijzigingsbesluit that added protected habitat types. The minister answered at length on the process, the reclassification, its effects on nitrogen permits, legal certainty and support measures, while stating that existing permits are not affected and that little room exists to ease the rules.
I do not see those possibilities, because the Netherlands is already sailing very close to the wind in this area.
Die mogelijkheden zie ik niet, omdat Nederland op dit vlak al scherp aan de wind zeilt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Pierik over de Nationale Databank Flora en Fauna

MPs Van der Plas and Pierik asked the minister about access to the Nationale Databank Flora en Fauna (NDFF), its costs, data control, and alleged overstatement of nitrogen-sensitive habitat on the Veluwe. The minister answered that open access is being prepared but legal anchoring means full opening is delayed to 2025, while disputing the claimed mapping discrepancies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Pierik over de onlangs openbaar gemaakte Woo-documenten “stikstofadvies Remkes” deel I-II-III

Two MPs from BBB asked the Minister of Nature and Nitrogen, on behalf of the Minister of Agriculture, about the released Woo documents on the Remkes nitrogen advice, covering the MOB letter, bank and supply-chain steering, buffer strips, socio-economic impact methodology, and permit revocation. The government answered that the MOB letter is public, that the Remkes report took its own line, that the Landbouwakkoord failed so the concept commitments are not binding and no instruments to secure supply-chain contributions have yet been developed, and that provinces are not obliged to use the socio-economic impact method or specific instruments.
The agreement did not come about and therefore the draft agreements are not binding.
Het akkoord is er niet gekomen 7 en daarmee zijn de conceptafspraken niet bindend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Pierik over het bericht 'Thom kwam met z’n rolstoel wel de Domtoren op, maar station Maarssen is 'onmogelijke horde''

MPs Van der Plas and Pierik asked about repeated elevator and escalator failures at Maarssen station and whether ProRail and the state meet their accessibility duties. The state secretary said real-time elevator data is being rolled out gradually, that ProRail provides alternative travel advice when elevators fail, and that the Maarssen elevator was repaired on 1 March with the escalator expected back around 22 March.

Following your earlier written questions of 25 August 2023, it was stated that general information will be added to the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management website on accessibility facilities in station buildings

Naar aanleiding van uw eerdere schriftelijke vragen d.d. 25 augustus 2023 is meegedeeld dat algemene informatie zal worden toegevoegd op de website van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat over toegankelijkheidsvoorzieningen in stationsgebouwen
Antwoord op antwoorden op de vragen van het lid Pierik over de relatie tussen stikstofemissie en stikstofdepositie

An MP asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen how nitrogen emissions from wild animals relate to deposition in Natura 2000 areas, and whether their impact is included in calculations and nature-target analyses. The minister answered that wild animal emissions are estimated at about 1.5% of Dutch ammonia emissions and under 1% of deposition, so no specific policy measures are planned, while acknowledging data gaps and noting that dog-related effects are a local management matter.
The contribution of wild animals is thus about 1.5% of total emissions at 1.9 kilotons.
De bijdrage van wilde dieren is met 1,9 kiloton dus ongeveer 1,5% op het totaal aan emissies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Pierik over amfetamine in mestvergisters

MPs Van der Plas and Pierik asked the government about amphetamine found in digestate from manure digesters, the applicability of the Opiumwet and Meststoffenwet, and compensation for affected operators. The minister answered that the Opiumwet is not directly applicable given the mixed-in residues, that digestate may be traded as fertiliser only if it poses no health or environmental risk, that responsibility for waste enforcement lies with provinces and municipalities, and that she declines to offer compensation.
The Ministry of LNV was not involved in this action, but only afterwards provided a view at the request of the provinces on the interpretation of the Meststoffenwet.
Het Ministerie van LNV is in dit handelen niet betrokken, maar heeft op verzoek van de provincies pas naderhand een zienswijze verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over het artikel 'Foei, edelherten en wilde zwijnen piesen stikstof'

An MP asks the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about claims that wild animals such as deer and wild boar produce significant nitrogen emissions, and whether waterfowl undermine water quality and Natura 2000 goals. The minister answers that wild animal ammonia is about 1.5 percent of Dutch emissions, with limited impact on nitrogen policy, water quality designations and habitat goals, and promises no change to the vulnerable-area designations for now.
