It therefore has a very limited impact on the objectives of nitrogen policy and the conservation of Natura 2000 areas.
Het heeft daarmee een zeer beperkte impact op de doelstellingen van het stikstofbeleid en het behoud van Natura 2000-gebieden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over veehouders die nog niet voldoen aan antibioticaregels

An MP asked the state secretary whether he would ensure all cattle farmers comply with the new antibiotic registration and inspection rules by year end, and whether he would inform parliament before year end. The government acknowledged 7,000 of about 32,000 dairy and beef farmers were non-compliant, said they were given until 1 December 2012 with disciplinary measures to follow, and promised an updated progress overview in spring 2013.
If a cattle farmer is still in violation after 1 December 2012, the PVV will take disciplinary measures.
Als blijkt dat een rundveehouder na 1 december 2012 nog steeds in overtreding is, zal het PVV tuchtrechtelijke maatregelen nemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over campylobacterbesmettingen in slachthuizen

MP Thieme asked the ministers whether unequal Campylobacter contamination between slaughterhouses, the lack of progress since 1997 commitments, and the non-public identification of high-risk slaughterhouses were acceptable, and whether sanctions would be strengthened. The minister replied that Campylobacter is hard to control, that Dutch slaughterhouses perform better than foreign ones, that the industry-run Convenant will provide data, and that RIVM cannot identify individual slaughterhouses while the NVWA enforces against violators.
The RIVM does not have this data.
Het RIVM beschikt niet over deze gegevens.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over nieuwe besmettingen Q-koorts

An MP asks how a goat dairy farm whose goats were all vaccinated against Q fever became infected again, whether faulty bulk-milk testing was to blame, and what will be done about public health risks. The state secretary answers that vaccination reduces but does not eliminate infection, that bulk-milk monitoring is adequately supervised by the national reference institute, and that visitor bans, transport restrictions and hygiene measures are in place.
Control of bulk milk is therefore adequately secured by the national reference institute.
De controle van tankmelk is dus adequaat geborgd door het nationale referentie-instituut.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over insecten als eiwitbron voor varkens- en kippenvoer

MP Thieme asks why a Wageningen study into insects as feed protein was subsidised before the rules allow it, and whether ethical and public-support assessments were done before funding insect farming that would kill many more animals. The state secretary replies that the EUR 40,000 study tests feasibility, that the ethical framework and next steps will be considered after the results, that no public-support research was done, and that no law change is planned for now, as insects already appear on the GWWD list.

Now that the results of this study are known, and this animal husbandry appears to have sufficient future prospects, the next steps, including going through the ethical assessment framework, will be further considered.

Nu de resultaten van dit onderzoek bekend zijn, en deze dierhouderij voldoende toekomstperspectieven lijkt te hebben, zullen de vervolgstappen, waaronder het doorlopen van het ethisch afwegingskader, verder worden bezien.
qn: Antwoord vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht dat emissiearme vloeren van de RAV-lijst verdwijnen

An MP asked about reports that low-emission cattle floors risk being removed from the RAV list and whether this affects the PAS, and about privatising RAV assessment. The minister says the floors will be dropped in 2014 unless measured, that PAS targets should still be met, and that metering subsidies and emission-factor updates are being pursued.
Early this year I will inform manufacturers of the consequences of not measuring their system.
Begin dit jaar zal ik fabrikanten wijzen op de gevolgen van het niet bemeten van hun systeem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de teelt van gansaanlokkende gewassen rondom Schiphol

The SP MP Van Gerven asks why the state, through BBL, owns farmland near Schiphol where goose-attracting crops such as sugar beet, potatoes and maize are grown, and whether lease and sale conditions, a convenant and hunting oversight can reduce bird strike risk. The state secretary answers that these crops are not clearly goose-attracting, that a lease condition on grain stubble ploughing has been introduced, and that no binding ban on crops or hunting-safety monitoring is planned beyond existing arrangements.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de afslachting van zwijnen voor decoratie tijdens het Halloween-feest

An MP asked whether wild boar shot for Halloween decoration were killed illegally, whether the ammunition was investigated, and whether a forester who trusted hunters' word should have pursued further inquiry. The government answered that police found the killings were legal, the Public Prosecution Service decided not to prosecute, the forester has no investigative powers, and it disapproves of how the carcasses were handled.
Police investigation showed that the wild boars were shot dead in a legal manner.
Uit politieonderzoek is gebleken dat de zwijnen op legale wijze zijn doodgeschoten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Thieme en Van Dekken over financiering van megastallen in het buitenland

MPs Thieme and Van Dekken asked why Dutch public money still indirectly supports megastables abroad, such as Myronivsky Hliboproduct in Ukraine, despite the Ouwehand motion, and demanded an exclusion list for Atradius DSB. The minister replied that export credit insurance is available case by case under IFC performance standards, that a megastable-specific exclusion would not be imposed, and that the government will discuss the link between stable size and animal welfare with colleagues and inform the House.
I will discuss the relationship between stable size and animal welfare with my colleagues at Economic Affairs and will inform the House of this as soon as possible.
Ik zal in overleg met mijn collega’s van Economische Zaken de relatie stalomvang en dierenwelzijn bespreken en zal de Tweede Kamer daar zo spoedig mogelijk over informeren.
Antwoord vragen De Boer over het beheer van de Wadden

MP De Boer asked whether the fragmented competent authority for the Wadden Sea causes uncertainty and delays for businesses, and whether a central permit desk or fewer bodies should be created. The minister replied that responsibilities are clear and coordinated through the Regie College Waddengebied, rejected a central desk in favour of the Omgevingswet and Regional Implementation Services, and saw no need for a study into reducing bodies.
The responsibilities of the various competent authorities are, in my view, clear.
De verantwoordelijkheden van de verschillende bevoegde gezagen zijn mijn inziens helder.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de onafhankelijkheid van visserijonderzoek

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries whether commercial fishing vessels and crews are used for government-commissioned fisheries research, when this is done, and how the independence of such research is safeguarded. The government answered that commercial vessels are mainly used for contract research and discard studies, that independent observers and cross-checks are used, and that Rijksrederij vessels are preferred where possible.
Independence and reliability of the research outcomes have the highest priority.
Onafhankelijkheid en betrouwbaarheid van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek hebben de hoogste prioriteit.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Thieme, Gesthuizen, Krol, Maij, Mulder en Van Ojik over kinderarbeid bij de productie van schoenen door grote ketens

MPs asked the government whether shoe companies using child labour in their supply chains should be held to account, excluded from state support and trade missions, and whether embassies and public procurement could be used to address it. The minister answered that due diligence duties under the OECD guidelines apply, that no shoe companies receive state support or joined trade missions, and that embassies raise labour standards where possible, while procurement social conditions already apply.
No, there are no shoe companies currently receiving government support or having previously joined trade missions.
Nee, er zijn geen schoenenbedrijven die momenteel overheidssteun ontvangen of in het verleden mee zijn geweest met handelsmissies.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Boer over de situatie in het Nieuwkoopse Plassengebied door Natura 2000

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary whether designating the Nieuwkoopse Plassen as a Natura 2000 area would restrict recreation, housing and business, and whether he would delay definitive designation until the consequences were clear. The state secretary answered that restrictions apply to activities that hinder conservation goals, that the PAS nitrogen programme should restore room for economic development, that he rejects the Panteia/EIM job-loss estimate, and that he will not definitively designate the area until the PAS approach for the area is clear.
As long as it is not clear how the PAS will work out for this area, I will not yet proceed to definitively designate the area.
Zolang niet duidelijk is hoe de PAS uitwerkt voor dit gebied, zal ik nog niet overgaan tot het definitief aanwijzen van het gebied.
Antwoord vragen Lodders en De Boer over de aanslag bij het melden van wildschade

Two VVD MPs asked why farmers must first pay a 300-euro treatment fee before claiming game damage compensation from the Faunafonds, whether it is one-off, whether it is refunded if rejected, and whether the measure should be reversed. The state secretary replied that provinces are now responsible for financing the Faunafonds and lowering administration costs, that the treatment fee is being discussed in the Ganzen consultation, and that no conclusion has been reached so the government awaits the provinces' proposals.
I am awaiting the definitive proposals from the provinces.
Ik wacht de definitieve voorstellen van de provincies af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Jan Vos en Schouw over geweld in de Braziliaanse sojateelt

MPs Van Gerven, Jan Vos and Schouw asked the government about violence against indigenous peoples and smallholders linked to Brazilian soy farming, and what Dutch action, embassy contact, bank financing and investigation follow-up exists. The minister answered that the Dutch embassy raises indigenous rights with Brazil and supports CIMI, that the Dutch soy sustainability initiatives are supported, that the embassy has no knowledge of a river-dredging study, and that one Dutch bank has a code of conduct and it will report on prosecutor investigations involving Dutch financiers.
Yes, insofar as this concerns Dutch banks and financiers.
Ja, voor zover dit Nederlandse banken en financiers betreft.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over nestgedrag zeugen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the state secretary about sows' nest-building behaviour, the availability of nesting material and whether a legal obligation should be introduced. The state secretary answered that EU rules already require nesting material in the last week before farrowing, that the government is funding innovation in farrowing systems, and that economic considerations are a matter for farmers.
If it turns out that the results are as promising as this research indicates, I expect large-scale application in practice in the short term.
Als hieruit blijkt dat de resultaten net zo perspectiefvol zijn als uit dit onderzoek blijkt dan verwacht ik op korte termijn een grootschalige toepassing hiervan in de praktijk.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over een toename van locomotieproblemen bij vleeskuikens

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation about the rise in locomotion problems in broiler chickens, their other causes, and whether the GD's research would cover wider causes and welfare issues. The State Secretary answered that Enterococcus cecorum is the main identified driver, that the GD's research focuses on it for now, that the government will inform parliament of results in due course, and that welfare research is ongoing with a decision on further research in 2013.
I am willing to inform the House in due course about the results of the research.
Ik ben bereid de Kamer te zijner tijd te informeren over de resultaten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosman over het fuikenverbod in de recreatieve visserij

An MP asks the State Secretary why a 2011 ban on recreational fishing with fyke nets along the coast was imposed, whether fishers were informed, and whether the ban will be lifted given its cultural and limited scale. The State Secretary answers that the ban implements the EU-mandated Dutch eel management plan, was widely communicated, and will not be reversed, as the alternative proposal conflicted with the plan.
I see no reason to reconsider this position.
Ik zie geen reden om op dit standpunt terug te komen.
Antwoord vragen Van Veldhoven met betrekking tot de voortgang van Natura 2000

An MP asked the state secretary about the progress of Natura 2000 designations, management plans, the removal of complementary objectives, nitrogen and hydrological problems. The government answered that 58 sites are definitively designated, management plans are in various stages, complementary objectives are being removed after consultation, and nitrogen and drainage measures are being addressed through the PAS.
I am therefore currently mapping what the policy task is in this regard, what agricultural nature management could contribute, and whether additional effort is necessary.
Ik breng momenteel dan ook in kaart wat de beleidsopgave hierin is, wat agrarisch natuurbeheer daar bijvoorbeeld aan bij kan dragen en of eventueel extra inzet noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over een dodelijk jachtongeluk in Zwiggelte

An MP asked the government about a fatal hunting accident in Zwiggelte, the legality of night hunting with lights, and whether such hunts should be banned. The minister said the victim was a bystander, an investigation is ongoing, foxes fall outside the statutory night-hunting ban, provinces can grant exemptions, and no change to the framework is planned while the case and court proceedings are pending.
The answer from the Benelux Court on those questions is awaited.
Gewacht wordt op het antwoord van het Beneluxgerechtshof op die vragen.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Kooiman over handhaving van de Visserijwet 1963

MPs Van Gerven and Kooiman asked whether police and green BOAs can check compliance with the Fisheries Act 1963 and whether the designation decree should be changed, and about staffing for fisheries poaching enforcement. The state secretary answered that existing powers under the Code of Criminal Procedure and Article 55 of the Act are sufficient, so no new designation is needed, and gave staffing figures.
I therefore am of the view that enforcement officers, including BOAs and police officers, have sufficient powers to carry out checks on compliance with the Fisheries Act 1963.
Ik ben derhalve van mening dat opsporingsambtenaren, waaronder BOA's en politieagenten, voldoende bevoegdheden hebben om controle uit te voeren op naleving van de Visserijwet 1963.
Antwoord vragen Jacobi en Van Dekken over “het feit dat ruim de helft van de Brabantse veeboeren teveel ammoniak uitstoten”

MPs Jacobi and Van Dekken asked why over half of Brabant livestock farms exceed ammonia limits and what this means for Natura 2000 goals, air quality and enforcement. The state secretary says enforcement is the province's responsibility, promises electronic monitoring of scrubbers from 2013, and deems the province's planned enforcement measures sufficient for now while refusing to halt new livestock farms.
As a result, the verifiability and enforceability of scrubbers will improve considerably.
Hierdoor zal de controleerbaarheid en handhaafbaarheid van luchtwassers aanzienlijk verbeteren.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over het doden van kikkers voor consumptie

An MP asks the ministers whether a broadcast promoting frog's legs for consumption is acceptable for public broadcasting, whether a ban on importing and selling frog legs should be introduced, and whether research into how frogs are caught and killed in Europe will be done. The minister says the broadcaster is responsible for its own content, the state secretary sees no need for a national import ban, and no research is planned.
The State Secretary for EL&I does not intend to carry out research into the scale and methods by which frogs are caught and killed in Europe for human consumption.
De Staatssecretaris van EL&I is niet voornemens onderzoek te doen naar de schaal en de wijzen waarop kikkers in Europa worden gevangen en gedood ten behoeve van de humane consumptie.
Antwoord vragen Jacobi en Fokke over “het bericht dat Brabant duizenden boeren niet gaat controleren op vergunning”

MPs Jacobi and Fokke asked the State Secretary whether Noord-Brabant can refuse to enforce the Nature Conservation Act against thousands of farmers lacking permits, and whether the province should be held to its enforcement duty. The State Secretary said he is aware of the long-running 'interimmers' problem, that the PAS can help, and that he is working with the provinces on a solution, without committing to a specific enforcement action.
Within the framework of the PAS, I am working with the provinces on a solution.
Ik werk in het kader van de PAS samen met de provincies aan een oplossing.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over aanhoudende problemen met de opslag en opvang van (in beslag genomen) dieren

An MP asks the state secretary of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation about the Dutch Papegaaienpark (NOP) bird shelter, which may be unable to feed about 2,100 seized birds, and why the ministry contracted it despite past misconduct and financial doubts. The state secretary answers that the ministry ended its contracts with NOP in summer 2012 over administrative and animal welfare shortcomings, that no federal funds are paid for animals not placed by the ministry, and that the ministry will act via administrative measures if welfare is harmed.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation (EL&I) terminated all contracts with the NOP this summer.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie (EL&I) heeft deze zomer alle contracten met de NOP beëindigd.
Antwoord vragen Lodders over het bericht dat de staatssecretaris niet ambitieus is voor jonge ondernemers

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation whether he was unambitious on young farmers' succession and why he would not place the support measure in the First Pillar of the CAP. The state secretary denied lack of ambition, said he backed extra support for young farmers, accepted First Pillar support as one option, and argued that targeted Second Pillar investment is more effective.
During the Council I in fact strongly advocated extra support for young farmers.
Tijdens de Raad heb ik mij juist sterk gemaakt voor extra ondersteuning voor jonge boeren.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken over het bericht “Nederland is onvoldoende voorbereid op nieuwe uitbraak dier op mens overdraagbare ziektes”

An MP asked whether the Netherlands is unprepared for new zoonotic outbreaks, citing survey findings that doctors and vets cooperate poorly, and asked how cooperation and a One Health approach will be strengthened. The state secretary replied that preparedness has been improved since the Q-fever outbreak through the EmZoo report and a new human-veterinary risk-analysis structure, disputed that the report notes limited doctor knowledge, accepted that the risk of a new zoonosis is real, and pointed to conferences, training and information-sharing as the way to improve cooperation.
I share the view of the majority of the surveyed veterinarians that the chance of an outbreak of a new zoonosis in the Netherlands is real.
Ik deel de opvatting van de meerderheid van de geënquêteerde dierenartsen dat de kans op een uitbraak van een nieuwe zoönose in Nederland reëel is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen aangaande de falende postbezorging van PostNL

An SP MP asked the state secretary about persistent postal delivery failures at PostNL, including complaints about held-back mail, whether PostNL still meets the Universal Postal Service delivery norm, and whether staffing problems explain the decline. The state secretary replied that OPTA found no evidence of deliberate withholding on Mondays, that OPTA will assess compliance with the 95% next-day norm for 2012 by mid-2013, and that PostNL suspended its reorganisation until at least 2013 and is preparing an improvement plan.
OPTA assesses annually whether PostNL meets the norm.
OPTA beoordeelt jaarlijks of PostNL aan de norm voldoet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over antibioticaresistentie bij kalveren door melk

Party for the Animals MP Thieme asked whether feeding calves antibiotic-contaminated milk from treated cows poses resistance and health risks and what the government will do. The state secretary acknowledges the practice is common and risks promoting resistance, says it is contrary to EU feed rules but hard to enforce, and promises sector engagement, possible enforcement, and raising the issue at EU level.
Because of the risk of promoting resistance, milk from cows that have received antibiotics should not be fed to calves within the withdrawal period.
Vanwege het risico dat resistentie bevorderd wordt, dient melk van koeien die antibiotica hebben gekregen, binnen de wachttijd niet aan kalveren gevoederd te worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het doodschieten van een stier die is gevallen uit een omgeslagen aanhangwagen op de A2

Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) asked why a bull fell from an overturned trailer on the A2 and was shot by police, whether transport rules were breached, whether the NVWA checks small transports, and what protocol applies. The state secretary answered that the transport fell under the lighter rules for trips under 50 km, no breach was found, NVWA samples such transports, police guidelines allowed shooting when the vet lacked sedative, and a joint protocol is being drafted.
It is not known whether, and if so why, the animals in the trailer were restless.
Het is niet bekend of, en zo ja waarom, de dieren in de aanhangwagen onrustig waren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Geurts over het bericht dat Vlaanderen binnenkort de arbitrageprocedure over de ontpoldering van de Hedwigepolder wil starten

Two MPs asked the state secretary about Flanders starting arbitration over the Hedwige polder de-polderisation, the expected timeline, whether the government will reuse its earlier alternative plan, and whether positive dredging results could prevent de-polderisation. The state secretary answered that the arbitration timeline runs from 22 May 2012, that the earlier alternative was not accepted by the Commission, that a demissionary cabinet leaves the decision to its successor, and that the dredging results are preliminary.
The current demissionary cabinet is not taking any action on this matter and has left the decision to the next cabinet.
Het huidige demissionaire kabinet neemt geen actie in dezen en heeft besluitvorming aan het volgende kabinet overgelaten.
Antwoord vraag van het lid Servaes over het handelsakkoord van de Europese Unie met Colombia en Peru

The MP Servaes asks whether the EU-Colombia-Peru trade agreement contains binding human and trade union rights obligations and enforceable monitoring and sanction mechanisms, and whether the minister will discuss these with the EU trade commissioner. The state secretary replies that the agreement includes a human rights clause and a sustainability chapter with binding ILO-based obligations, a monitoring and dispute settlement mechanism, and suspension possibility as a last resort, and that the agreement has been signed and will be sent to parliament for ratification.
The trade agreement, and therefore every individual provision, is legally binding on the parties that ratify the treaty.
Het handelsakkoord en dus ook iedere individuele bepaling is juridisch bindend voor de partijen die het verdrag ratificeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht ‘RWE wil vier olieproefboringen in Waddenzee

An MP asks whether the government will press German authorities against RWE's planned oil test drillings in the Wadden Sea and whether drilling should stop altogether there. The minister answers that the drillings fall within agreed Dutch-German-Danish rules under the Wadden Sea Plan 2010, that drilling is prohibited only in the World Heritage area, and that no further action toward RWE is planned.
No, because the test drillings in question fall within the agreements we jointly made during the World Heritage nomination process.
Nee, want de proefboringen waarover het hier gaat vallen binnen de afspraken die wij gezamenlijk hierover hebben gemaakt tijdens het werelderfgoednominatieproces.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over besmette zalm

An MP asked the government about salmonella-contaminated Greek salmon sold via a Harderwijk supplier, covering distribution, NVWA inspection frequency, consumer awareness, bacteria stickers, pre-export inspection and EU food-safety cooperation. The minister answered that the contaminated salmon reached various retail and food outlets, that the NVWA's sampling found no salmonella, and that EU rules and FVO oversight apply, offering no new oversight measures.
All samples examined for Salmonella were negative.
Alle op Salmonella onderzochte monsters waren daarbij negatief.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over aanhoudend geweld bij mijnen in Zuid-Afrika

An MP asked the government about ongoing violence at Lonmin mines in South Africa, whether the IFC should pressure Lonmin, whether transparency of payments should be mandated, and whether conflict minerals should be restricted. The minister answered that the South African investigation should not be prejudged, pointed to existing OECD guidelines, EITI and Voluntary Principles, said Lonmin cannot be obliged to disclose payments, and noted that EU negotiations on payment reporting are ongoing.
It is better not to anticipate the outcomes of this investigation.
Het is beter niet vooruit te lopen op de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Geurts over het artikel “vegabal inzet strijd vleessector”

An MP from the CDA asked the government whether the food safety authority NVWA deprioritises enforcement against misleading names such as 'chicken skewer' made of soy, and whether it could intervene more. The ministers answered that enforcement is risk-based, that names are assessed case by case for misleading content, and that the NVWA asked the producer to adjust its labelling.
The NVWA sets priorities in the cases it addresses within the capacity available to it for supervision.
De NVWA stelt prioriteiten in de zaken die ze aanpakt binnen de capaciteit die zij voor het toezicht beschikbaar heeft.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over een geitenbedrijf zonder vergunning

An MP asked why a goat farm with about 1,000 goats operates without a permit, is tolerated by the municipality, and plans to expand to 5,650 goats, and whether the state will prevent this. The state secretary answered that the municipality is competent authority, that enforcement was judged disproportionate given expected legalisation, that vaccination limits health risk, and that no new permit request exists under the motion, deferring the scale decision to the next cabinet.
The municipality of Hof van Twente is the competent authority for the environmental permit.
De gemeente Hof van Twente is het bevoegd gezag voor de milieuvergunning.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over een stalvergassing na brand

An MP asked whether a poultry farm in Groesbeek gassed about 30,000 hens after a fire, whether TCC-group carried out the gassing despite its contract being terminated, whether the NVWA was present, and how animal welfare was ensured. The state secretary answered that the farmer decided on gassing for animals weakened by smoke, that the contract was terminated for a different context, that the NVWA attended, and that the same indicators as in official culling were checked, with a reference to a separate letter on fire safety in stables.
The government supervises compliance with these provisions.
De overheid ziet toe op de naleving van deze bepalingen.
Antwoord vragen Koopmans betreffende het TKI onderzoek naar grondontsmetting

An MP asked the state secretary about the TKI research agenda on soil disinfection, import phytosanitary barriers, and nitrate manure rules hindering wet soil disinfection for export bulbs and lilies. The government answered that phytosanitary requirements are not generally rising, that it has strengthened market-access capacity, that the manure rules create timing barriers, and that EL&I cannot reallocate TKI budgets but can request attention to the research.
EL&I cannot release budgets from TKIs.
EL&I kan geen budgetten van TKI's vrijmaken.
Antwoord vragen Houwers over de verplichting van het aan boord hebben van een werkend elektronisch logboek

An MP asks the state secretary about the NVWA's plan to enforce the electronic logbook requirement for fishing vessels from 15 September, whether fishers were informed in time, and whether more time should be granted. The state secretary rejects the complaints, stating the legal obligation applies since 2010/2012, fishers were contacted from April 2012, and no extension is planned.
No. The electronic logbook obligation has been legally mandatory since 1 January 2012 for fishing vessels larger than 12 metres and since 1 January 2010 for vessels larger than 24 metres.
Nee. De verplichting van het E-logboek is wettelijk al vanaf 1 januari 2012 verplicht voor vissersvaartuigen groter dan 12 meter en vanaf 1 januari 2010 voor vissersvaartuigen groter dan 24 meter.
Antwoord vragen Dijkgraaf over de opstelling van de NMa inzake de MSC-certificering van de garnalenvisserij in de Noordzee

An MP asks why the competition authority NMa has not approved the garnalen sector's MSC management plan, especially the Catch Control Rule, and whether the government will intervene or issue policy rules. The state secretary answers that the NMa has independent supervisory status, that it is up to the sector to adapt its plans to competition rules, and that he will not intervene or issue policy rules on sustainability.
Given the independent position of the NMa as supervisor of the competition rules, it is not fitting for me to intervene in this.
Gezien de onafhankelijke positie van de NMa als toezichthouder van de mededingingsregels past het mij niet om hier in te treden.
Antwoord vragen Lodders over “Het bericht Bleker en Ciolos zijn het eens over vergroening Europees Landbouwbeleid”

An MP asked the state secretary whether he agreed with the Commissioner's plan to make CAP direct payments conditional on greening measures, and what alternative measures he would take. The state secretary said he opposes fully decoupling the greening premium, prefers alternatives via agri-environment schemes and farm certification, and referred several questions to earlier written reports.
I am not in favour of farmers setting the goals themselves, but I do want them to have more freedom in deciding which measures they use to reach these goals.
Ik ben er geen voorstander van dat boeren zelf de doelen bepalen, maar wel dat zij meer vrijheid krijgen bij het bepalen met welke maatregelen zij deze doelen willen bereiken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over miljoenensubsidie voor de megastal in Grubbenvorst

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Grubbenvorst megastable received hidden government subsidies, whether that fits a planned ban on megastables, and whether subsidies to such farms should be ended. The state secretary replied that the subsidies were open to all entrepreneurs under standing schemes, were innovation grants rather than construction funding, cannot lawfully be reclaimed, and that the next cabinet will decide on size limits and subsidy exclusion.
Deploying subsidies by other authorities I regard as primarily their own responsibility, in which I do not wish to interfere.
Het inzetten van subsidies door andere overheden acht ik bij uitstek hun eigen verantwoordelijkheid waarin ik niet wil treden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over miljoenen subsidies voor een gigastal in Horst aan de Maas en het informeren van de Kamer daarover

An MP asks the state secretary why public innovation subsidies went to the Nieuw Gemengd Bedrijf livestock complex in Horst aan de Maas despite plans to limit farm size, and why the Chamber was not informed earlier. The secretary answers that the subsidies were general schemes open to all entrepreneurs, that they date from before a motion on farm size, that the Chamber was informed through the budget and published subsidy lists, and that municipal and provincial matters fall to those authorities.
I indicated in the broadcast that the Chamber is informed in general terms, through the budget cycle in the budget and annual report of the ministry, about subsidy schemes.
Ik heb in de uitzending aangegeven dat de Kamer in algemene zin via de begrotingscyclus in de begroting en het jaarverslag van het ministerie van EL&I geïnformeerd wordt over subsidieregelingen
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de subsidiëring van de ontwikkeling van een gigastal in Horst aan de Maas

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation how the ministry can claim it informed parliament about innovation subsidies for a gigastable in Horst aan de Maas, and how many such subsidies were granted for mega- and gigastables at home and abroad. The State Secretary points to general budget and annual report channels and the public subsidy database, gives counts of innovation subsidies by province, and reports subsidies abroad without a dedicated mega-stable policy.
I indicated in the broadcast that the House of Representatives is informed in general terms, via the budget and the annual report of the ministry, about subsidy schemes.
Ik heb in de uitzending aangegeven dat de Tweede Kamer in algemene zin via de begroting en het jaarverslag van het ministerie van EL&I wordt geïnformeerd over subsidieregelingen
Antwoord vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers over het bericht dat energiebedrijven nog steeds niet openbaar maken of ze bloedkolen gebruiken

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked whether Dutch energy companies disclose whether they use coal linked to human rights abuses, including coal from Drummond mines in Colombia, and what the coal dialogue has achieved. The state secretary answered that self-regulation via the coal dialogue is preferred, that energy companies proposed only aggregated disclosure of mines citing commercial sensitivity, and listed interim dialogue results with the dialogue expected to run to end 2012.
Information on the specific suppliers of coal to energy companies is, according to the latter, commercially sensitive.
Informatie over de specifieke leveranciers van steenkolen aan energiebedrijven is, volgens laatstgenoemden, commercieel gevoelig.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Lodders en Houwers inzake een verbod op chemische onkruidbestrijdingsmethoden

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretaries whether the IVAM LCA quickscan showing no environmental gain from banning chemical weed control on paved surfaces is accepted, whether environmental standards should apply to non-chemical methods, and whether the government will revisit the Grashoff motion on glyphosate for non-commercial use. The government acknowledged the study's mixed findings, announced an independent inventory to resolve confusion, saw no current need for standards on non-chemical methods, and pointed to the Dutch sustainable crop protection action plan for implementing the motion.
Therefore an independent inventory will be carried out to remove this lack of clarity.
Daarom zal een onafhankelijke inventarisatie uitgevoerd worden, om deze onduidelijkheid weg te nemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ormel over vernieling van proefvelden met aardappelen in Valthermond en Lelystad

An MP asked ministers about the vandalism of potato trial fields in Valthermond and Lelystad, including its importance for food security, progress on investigations, and whether the attacks were linked. The state secretary condemned the vandalism, stressed the research's value and the public consultation on the permit, said the Valthermond case is under investigation and police are monitoring Lelystad, and that the two attacks differed and no group has claimed responsibility.
I cannot anticipate the results of the investigation.
Ik kan niet op de resultaten van het onderzoek vooruit lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Snijder-Hazelhoff over het bericht "Brabantse boer klem door vele procedures"

Two VVD MPs asked whether lengthy permit procedures will prevent Brabant pig farmers from meeting animal welfare and manure processing rules, and whether postponement would be granted. The state secretary rejected postponement of the 1 January 2013 EU welfare deadline and said manure processing targets were set with available capacity in mind, while promising to press provinces and municipalities to speed permits and to report on further measures.
I therefore see no reason for postponement.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding voor uitstel.
Antwoord vragen van de leden El Fassed en Braakhuis, Voordewind en Gesthuizen over ketentransparantie, kinderarbeid en uitbuiting in de kledingindustrie

MPs from GroenLinks, ChristenUnie and SP asked the government about implementing a motion on full supply-chain transparency and ending child labour in the garment sector, including IMVO policy, EU action and India/Bangladesh cases. The government answered that talks with textile industry associations continue, that a national action plan on business and human rights will come around the new year, and that it is primarily up to the industry to set feasible transparency commitments.
The cabinet expects internationally active companies to comply with the OECD Guidelines.
Het kabinet verwacht van bedrijven die internationaal actief zijn dat zij de OESO Richtlijnen naleven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers over financiering van Nigeriaanse veiligheidstroepen door Shell

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked whether the government will hold Shell to account for funding Nigerian security forces linked to alleged human rights abuses and whether this conflicts with the Voluntary Principles, which the Netherlands chairs. The minister answered that the government raises these issues with Shell regularly, that Shell says it applies the Voluntary Principles, and that the government presses Nigeria to endorse them, while transparency reporting is left to participants themselves.
For the implementation of the VPs and communication about it with stakeholders, the participants in the VPs, including Shell, are themselves responsible.
Voor de invulling van de VP’s en de communicatie daarover met belanghebbenden zijn de deelnemers aan de VP’s, waaronder Shell, zelf verantwoordelijk.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme inzake aanpak van brandveiligheid in stallen

An MP asked the state secretary and the interior minister about fire safety in livestock barns after pig deaths, and why a parliamentary motion requiring fire-safety rules by 1 January 2013 had not been implemented. The government answered that an Action Plan on barn fires has been drawn up, that research on current requirements is underway, and that advice on possible regulatory changes will follow by end 2012, without committing to new rules by the deadline.
The Action Plan provides for research into the adequacy of the current requirements and into how animals in practice can be better protected against fire through more effective regulation.

Het Actieplan voorziet in de uitvoering van een onderzoek naar de toereikendheid van de huidige eisen alsmede naar de wijze waarop dieren in de praktijk door effectievere regelgeving beter tegen brand beschermd kunnen worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Lodders met betrekking op de begrenzing van het Natura 2000-gebied Westerschelde

An MP asks whether the Westerschelde Natura 2000 boundary near Rammekensschor was moved despite industrial zoning and lost nature values, and about economic consequences and the WCT container terminal. The minister answers that a Council of State ruling required a better-reasoned boundary, the sand depot stays outside the area, and the change has no added economic or WCT impact.
In doing so, the Council of State ruled in favour of Vogelbescherming that the boundary at Rammekensschor was insufficiently reasoned and instructed me to take a new decision on this point.

Hierbij heeft de Raad van State de Vogelbescherming in het gelijk gesteld dat de begrenzing bij Rammekensschor onvoldoende is gemotiveerd en heeft mij opgedragen een nieuw besluit te nemen op dit punt.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over Nederlandse hulp bij tankdeal met Saoedi-Arabië

An MP asked whether the government granted an export licence for a Leopard 2 tank used in Saudi Arabian trials, whether it was a lease, whether parliament was informed, and whether arms-export criteria were applied. The Defence Minister answered that the tank remains Defence property on loan to KMW, that no sale or export occurred so no licence or criteria test was needed, and that parliament was not separately informed.
There is no agreement with Saudi Arabia that would have to be tested in any way.
Er is geen sprake van een overeenkomst met Saoedi-Arabië die op enigerlei wijze zou moeten worden getoetst.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Lodders over natuurherstel Westerschelde

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary about the European Commission's objection to the Province of Zeeland's measures for nature restoration in the Westerschelde, including whether four polders should be flooded in future. The state secretary answered only by referring to a letter sent by the Minister of Foreign Affairs to the Commission and a copy sent to parliament, without addressing the substance of the questions.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de sterke achteruitgang van het aantal vuursalamanders in Nederland

An MP asked the state secretary about the sharp decline of fire salamanders in the Netherlands, whether the species faces extinction, whether it has disappeared elsewhere, and whether legal protection should be tightened. The state secretary called recent developments worrying, said the species is extinct in the Voerstreek in Belgium, is discussing research with nature organisations, and noted that existing Flora- and faunawet protections already cover the issues raised.
I am in consultation with the nature organisations concerned about possibilities for research into the cause of the decline.
Ik ben met de betrokken natuurorganisaties in overleg over mogelijkheden van onderzoek naar de oorzaak van de achteruitgang.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Lodders met betrekking tot te hoge eisen aan Natura 2000 in Overijssel

An MP asked the state secretary whether the differences between Natura 2000 conservation targets in the designation decrees and the Standard Data Forms in Overijssel are unacceptable, and whether complementary targets should be removed before designation. The state secretary answered that complementary targets were being removed from final designation decrees, that remaining differences arise from newer knowledge and will be resolved when the standard forms are updated, and that the IQuatro report uses an overly broad definition of complementary targets.
When Natura 2000 areas are definitively designated, complementary targets, as named in the Natura 2000 Targets Document, are removed.
Bij het definitief aanwijzen van Natura 2000-gebieden worden complementaire doelen, zoals benoemd in het Doelendocument Natura 2000, geschrapt
Antwoord vragen Koppejan over het nieuwe protocol dat de Europese Commissie namens de Europese Unie heeft gesloten met Mauritanië

Koppejan (CDA) asked the state secretary about the new EU fisheries protocol with Mauritania, its cost relative to the old one, the fleet's competitiveness, sustainability provisions, and the risk of third-country fleets taking over. The state secretary answered that the protocol is a compromise with sustainability improvements, that the EU pays less on average and EU vessels get priority, that the Netherlands has not yet decided its position, and that third-country fleets face the same conditions.
I want to use the coming period, after consultation with all parties and other member states, to form a judgment on the protocol.
Ik wil de komende periode benutten om, na overleg met alle partijen en andere lidstaten een oordeel te vellen over het protocol.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over kippen die zijn gestikt door de warmte

An MP asks the state secretary about broiler chickens that suffocated in heat in Schuinesloot and other farms, whether the deaths relate to large-scale housing, and whether publicly funded fire brigade assistance should be charged to the farmer. The secretary confirms about 200 birds died there, says housing scale is not the issue, states the fire brigade's assistance was a legal duty and not charged, and commits to working with the poultry sector on heat preparedness.
I am willing, together with the poultry sector, to look at the risks that a heat period poses to poultry in relation to housing.
Ik ben bereid samen met de pluimveesector te kijken naar de risico's die een hitteperiode met zich meebrengt voor het pluimvee in relatie tot de huisvesting.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de uitbraak van vogelgriep

An MP asked the state secretary about the August 2012 bird flu outbreak in Hagestein, its cause, the risk of spread or mutation, and measures to prevent further outbreaks. The state secretary said the exact cause is rarely known, the Hagestein farm was detected through the monitoring system and is unrelated to the Mexico outbreak, and a working group is assessing measures to reduce risks from free-range access.
Once the working group has completed this analysis, I will inform you of the results.
Zodra de werkgroep deze analyse heeft afgerond, zal ik u op de hoogte stellen van de resultaten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de regio-indeling in het Pachtprijzenbesluit

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation about the region classification in the lease price decree, including analysis of Grondkamer decisions on lease price review requests, room for lower prices for low-yielding land, and whether the Grondkamer route will be clarified or the rules changed. The secretary answered that the analysis shows most reviews raised prices, that the Grondkamer route offers adequate tools without changing the law, and that a different region classification is only considered if all stakeholders unanimously ask for it.

However, I am of the view that amending article 333 of Book 7 of the Civil Code or article 21 of the 2007 Lease Price Decree is not warranted, because these articles provide good tools for an objective valuation of the land concerned.

Ik ben echter van mening dat aanpassing van artikel 333 van Boek 7 van het Burgerlijk Wetboek of artikel 21 van het Pachtprijzenbesluit 2007 niet in de rede ligt, omdat deze artikelen goede handvatten bieden voor een objectieve waardebepaling van de betreffende grond.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Koopmans, Wolbert en Snijder-Hazelhoff inzake sierkolen

MPs Koopmans, Wolbert and Snijder-Hazelhoff asked why pesticides approved for food cabbage cannot be used on ornamental cabbage, whether the small-use definition excludes such crops, and how other EU states treat them. The state secretary explained the separate authorisation procedure, said the small-use area limits will be widened to 5,000 ha open and 1,000 ha covered, and that the Ctgb will be asked to apply this.
I will ask the Ctgb to act in accordance with the above.
Ik zal het Ctgb verzoeken conform het bovenstaande te handelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over een uitbraak van vogelgriep

An MP asked the state secretary about the duration, method and monitoring of the August 2012 culling of 32,870 laying hens at Hagestein during an avian flu outbreak, including whether the culling ran until Sunday and whether the NVWA monitored it properly. The government answered that the process was correct, indicators were met, the NVWA monitored continuously, and the contractor followed an approved work plan.
The entire process proceeded correctly and the prescribed indicators were achieved.
Het hele proces is correct verlopen en de voorgeschreven indicatoren zijn behaald.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hazekamp over aangespoelde zeehonden en verminkte bruinvissen

An MP asked the state secretary about many dead seals and mutilated porpoises washed ashore in the Grevelingen and Ouddorp, asking about protection, nets, causes of injury, prosecution and research. The state secretary said protection is adequate, bycatch research is planned, a pathology study from Utrecht will be published in 2013, and a progress report on the porpoise protection plan will follow by end 2012.
Last year I received the Porpoise Protection Plan.
Ik heb vorig jaar het Bruinvisbeschermingsplan in ontvangst genomen.
Antwoord vragen Koppejan en Holtackers over de stand van zaken op het gebied van meting van actuele grondwaterstanden

MPs Koppejan and Holtackers asked the state secretaries about recent developments in measuring groundwater levels, the independence of DLO research, the reliability of piezometer data and the NHI model. The government answered that the Alterra report on groundwater measurement is attached, that it sees no societal damage from possible measurement errors, and that screening of piezometers for soil structure is not centrally available and is the responsibility of provinces and water boards.
This detailed information is not centrally registered, and collecting it across a large variety of projects is very labour-intensive.
Deze detailinformatie wordt niet centraal geregistreerd en het verzamelen daarvan bij een grote verscheidenheid aan projecten is zeer arbeidsintensief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over verwaarlozing van paarden in Weert

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary about neglected horses in Weert, including whether a horse was moved to an unknown location to evade inspection and whether that should be made a criminal offence. The State Secretary answered that inspections continued, the owner complied with orders and that moving animals is not in itself criminal, but that refusing cooperation with inspectors is punishable.
No, there are sufficient legal possibilities to obtain information or take action if cooperation is not provided.
Nee, er zijn voldoende wettelijke mogelijkheden om informatie te verkrijgen of op te treden als geen medewerking wordt verleend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jacobi over door mijn ministerie verleende vergunning voor het uitzetten van otters in zwaar verontreinigd water in de grote rivieren in Nederland

An MP asked the state secretary about a permit allowing the otter reintroduction in heavily polluted large rivers, and whether this conflicts with dioxin/PCB risks and IUCN guidelines. The state secretary confirmed the permit, said current water quality and removed causes of extinction justify it, and referred to an expert report commissioned by regional authorities.
I adhere to the Policy line on reintroduction of animals, which was also discussed with the House of Representatives at the time.
Antwoord 4 Ik houd mij aan de Beleidslijn herintroductie van dieren 9 , die indertijd ook met de Tweede Kamer is besproken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het niet voldoen aan de vaccinatieplicht tegen Q-koorts (sts ELI)

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked why 18% of professional goat and sheep farms had not vaccinated against Q fever by the deadline, whether this poses a public health risk, and whether sanctions and breeding bans should be tightened. The state secretary replied that all farms eventually complied after orders under administrative coercion, that current sanctions are adequate with criminal reports filed, and that a breeding ban already applies to unvaccinated animals.
I therefore see no reason to increase the sanctions for failing to vaccinate on time.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding voor verhoging van de sancties voor het niet tijdig vaccineren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over het aanleggen van graanvoorraden in Nederland

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about grain stockpiling in the Netherlands, the grain market situation, Germany's reserve, US and EU biofuel effects on prices, and whether EU biofuel blending should be raised. The government answered that the EU grain market is stable with no shortage, that member-state crisis reserves are for the member states and subject to Commission oversight, and that a biofuel report is due by the end of 2012.
Both the European Commission and the FAO are closely monitoring developments on the grain market.
Zowel de Europese Commissie als de FAO volgen de ontwikkelingen op de graanmarkt nauwlettend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over melkveehouders die in de problemen komen door de lage melkprijs

MP Wiegman-Van Meppelen Scheppink asked whether low milk prices are pushing half of Dutch dairy farmers deeper into debt, whether the 2011 price rise was a one-off, and whether the government will request early payment of EU area subsidies. The state secretary replied that the margin is above the 2006-2011 average though below 2011, that prices are expected to recover and not fall structurally, and that the Netherlands will not request early subsidy payment.
The Netherlands has therefore not submitted a request.
Nederland heeft dan ook geen verzoek ingediend.
Antwoord vragen Hamer over de aanbesteding van de postbezorging van de overheid

An MP asks why the State's postal delivery tenders for the Tax Authority set per-item rates below the range SEO advised, which would prevent 80% of postal workers from having sector-CAO employment contracts by 2014, and whether the government will set decent prices. The state secretary replies that the tendered rates are substantially higher than before, leave room for the planned phase-in, were not fixed in advance, and were protected by quality weighting and conditions requiring realistic prices.
The final rates are not public.
De uiteindelijke tarieven zijn niet openbaar.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over Bonaire die wilde ezels als lastdier naar Haïti wil sturen

An MP asked whether Bonaire's plan to capture wild donkeys and ship them to Haiti as pack animals is supported by the Dutch government, and asked for humane alternatives. The state secretary replied that the Dutch government has no role in the plan, that Bonaire's public body is primarily responsible for stock management and is still studying options, and that the government will await the proposal and is willing to discuss it if Bonaire asks.
The primary responsibility for initiating, shaping and implementing stock management of these donkeys lies with the public body of Bonaire.
Het is de primaire verantwoordelijkheid van het openbaar lichaam Bonaire bestandsbeheer t.a.v. deze ezels te initiëren, dit vorm en inhoud te geven en vervolgens te implementeren.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over het beperken van het beschermingsregime in enkele Natura 2000-gebieden

An MP from the Partij voor de Dieren asked why the government limited the protection regime in some Natura 2000 areas during the summer recess while the cabinet was caretaker, and whether that was compatible with its demissionary status. The state secretary replied that the measure implements a 2011 policy decision already discussed with parliament, that the Natura 2000 file is not controversial, and that the draft amending decree was open for public consultation until 13 September 2012.
This concerns implementing the decision to remove complementary objectives.
Het gaat hier om het effectueren van het besluit tot het schrappen van complementaire doelen.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over de stijgende graanprijzen

MP Thieme asked the State Secretary about record-low EU grain stocks, Dutch grain reserves, promoting protein crops, meat consumption and the shift to plant proteins. The State Secretary answered that the Netherlands holds no strategic grain stocks, that cultivation should be market-driven, that no active government role in reducing meat consumption is foreseen, and referred to earlier letters on protein.
No, the Netherlands does not hold strategic grain reserves.
Nee, Nederland houdt geen strategische voorraden graan aan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over een zeer lage straf voor ernstige dierenmishandeling

An MP asked why a very light sentence was imposed for serious animal cruelty to 115 birds of prey, whether supervisors failed, and whether bans on keeping animals or hunting licences should follow. The state secretary answered that individual criminal cases are not communicated, that inspections found no welfare problems, that the company went bankrupt, and that existing law already allows refusing hunting licences, while withholding details on privacy grounds.
It is not for me to communicate about individual criminal cases.
Het is niet aan mij om te communiceren over individuele strafzaken.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over sancties voor een jager in overtreding

An MP asked about the delayed prosecution of hunters for Flora and Fauna Act violations, sanctions, membership of the hunting association, and withdrawal of hunting licences. The government answered that the case is before the economic police court, that hunting licences were revoked by the police chief and upheld by the Council of State, and that some statistics are not centrally recorded.
The requested data are not kept by the Public Prosecution Service in a centralised system.
De gevraagde gegevens worden door het Openbaar Ministerie niet in een gecentraliseerd systeem bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de investeringsregeling jonge landbouwers

An SGP MP asked the state secretary why the budget ceiling and maximum investment amount of the young farmers investment scheme were lowered, and how this relates to EU co-financing and earlier motions. The state secretary said the scheme's future will be considered within the new CAP's young-farmer support, that the 2012 budget was raised by 2.5 million euro from national reserves to 5.3 million, and that the lower maximum investment amount lets more applications be honoured.
For the year 2011 I did not apply a budget ceiling for young farmers' support applications, in line with the Dijkgraaf/Koopmans motion.
Voor het jaar 2011 heb ik conform de motie Dijkgraaf/Koopmans geen budgettair plafond gehanteerd voor steunaanvragen van jonge boeren.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over het bericht “Dode apen op Schiphol”

An MP asked the State Secretary about 13 monkeys found dead at Schiphol, their cause of death, whether the transport was checked for animal welfare, and how many monkeys transit Schiphol yearly. The government said an NVWA investigation is ongoing, the surviving monkeys met health and CITES requirements for onward transport, and it will not speculate on further measures until the investigation concludes.
Once the investigation is concluded I will inform the House of the results.
Zodra het onderzoek is afgerond zal ik de kamer informeren over de resultaten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de effectiviteit van ecoducten

An MP asked whether the Alterra report's recommended 40 to 60 metre ecoduct width is a binding minimum, which existing Dutch ecoducts fall below it, how far the report's recreation-related recommendations guide design, and whether the narrow De Borkeld ecoduct will still be used by wildlife. The state secretary answered that 40 to 60 metres is a recommendation rather than a prescribed minimum, that six existing ecoducts are narrower, that recreational use is allowed unless the primary wildlife function is impaired, and that De Borkeld is a two-year trial that can be ended if wildlife use is hindered.
Policy aims to allow recreational shared use of ecoducts, unless the primary function of the wildlife passage is impaired.
Het beleid is er op gericht recreatief medegebruik van ecoducten mogelijk te maken, tenzij de primaire functie van de faunapassage wordt aangetast.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven inzake een conflict op het eiland Texel tussen een erfpachter en Staatsbosbeheer

An SP MP asks whether the state forest manager Staatsbosbeheer could have prevented the eviction of the W. family from their Texel farm and whether mediation, as in an earlier Baarn case, could be used. The state secretary answers that a long-running commercial dispute was handled through repeated negotiations and eight court cases that ruled largely in Staatsbosbeheer's favour, so mediation is not appropriate, and that the case stands alone.
In a total of 8 proceedings the court has issued clear rulings in which Staatsbosbeheer's claims were almost entirely upheld.
In inmiddels 8 procedures heeft de rechter duidelijke uitspraken gedaan waarin de Staatsbosbeheer-claims nagenoeg voor 100% zijn gehonoreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand heeft mij vragen gesteld over “de ehs die moet wijken voor kipgigant”.

MP Ouwehand asked whether the province of Flevoland may remove part of the Ecological Main Structure (EHS) to make way for a Kentucky Fried Chicken outlet, and whether the state secretary would urge the province to refuse. The state secretary acknowledged the press report but said the provinces are responsible for delineating the EHS and referred the MP to Flevoland.
The provinces are responsible for redrawing and recalibrating the Ecological Main Structure.
De provincies zijn verantwoordelijk voor het herbegrenzen en herijken van de Ecologische Hoofdstructuur.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dikkers, De Lange en Smeets over Shell’s gebrekkige rapportage over olielekkages in Nigeria en compensatie daarvan

MPs Dikkers, De Lange and Smeets asked the government about Shell's inaccurate reporting of oil spills in Nigeria, independent investigation, cleanup and compensation. The minister answered that the Bodo spill is under litigation and a NCP complaint is pending, that Nigerian law assigns spill investigations to joint teams, and that the Netherlands supports dialogue and oversight initiatives while Shell has accepted responsibility for the Bodo cleanup.
The extent of the pollution and the amount of compensation are the subject of a civil case.
De omvang van de vervuiling en de hoogte van de schadeloosstelling zijn onderwerp van een civiel proces.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Mos over het artikel  “CO2-opslag helpt klimaat niet”

An MP asks whether the government reserved 81.2 million euros for CCS in 2011, how much was spent and what can be recovered, and whether scientific warnings about CO2 storage should be taken seriously. The minister explains that 2011 spending was delayed and shifted to 2012-2013, the 81.2 million is committed and not recoverable, and that the warnings were reviewed by CATO-2 and found to be nuanced for the Dutch context of depleted gas fields.
The amount mentioned in the question, 81.2 million euros, concerns the estimated expenditure for 2012.
Het in de vraag genoemde bedrag ad. € 81,2 mln betreft de geraamde uitgaven voor 2012.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over Export van censuur technologie

MP El Fassed asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers whether Western firms still export censorship technology to countries that violate human rights, whether a list of such firms exists, and what the government is doing on free news gathering, a list of repressive states, and arms trade treaty regulation of dual-use items. Minister Rosenthal replied that it cannot be established whether such exports occur, no company list exists or is desirable, the EU dual-use regulation proposal is expected late 2012, and Dutch efforts to include such goods in the arms trade treaty have found no support.
It is not possible to establish whether companies from European countries and the United States export censorship technology to countries where human rights are violated.
Het is niet mogelijk vast te stellen of bedrijven uit Europese landen en de Verenigde Staten censuurtechnologie exporteren naar landen waar mensenrechten worden geschonden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Koopmans over het onderzoek van de Wageningen Universiteit “Storen broedvogels zich aan het geluid van race-evenementen?”

An MP from the CDA asked ministers whether a Wageningen University study finding no significant negative effect of race events on breeding birds in Witterveld undermines the noise rules for Natura 2000 areas, and whether those rules could be relaxed. The state secretary replied that the study is useful for Witterveld only, cannot be generalised to other Natura 2000 sites, notes that increased bird song after events indicates some disturbance, and will make the report available online.
Because the circumstances in Witterveld (closed to the public) are specific to this area, the results of this study cannot simply be translated to other Natura 2000 areas.

Omdat de omstandigheden in het (voor publiek afgesloten) Witterveld specifiek zijn voor dit gebied kunnen de resultaten van dit onderzoek niet zondermeer worden doorvertaald naar andere Natura 2000-gebieden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dikkers, De Lange en Smeets over de vernieuwing van de licentie van Shell in Nigeria

Three PvdA MPs asked the ministers whether they accept the renewal of Shell's Nigerian licence despite pollution from oil spills, what the Dutch government thinks of Shell Netherlands' remarks on polluted water, and whether they have discussed compensation for local residents with Shell. The government answered that licence renewals are a matter between Nigeria and the companies, that it has intensive contact with Shell on MVO and the Niger Delta, and that it facilitates a dialogue on pollution there.
Renewal of licences is a matter between the Nigerian government and companies with which the Nigerian government wishes to do business.
Verlenging van licenties is een zaak tussen de Nigeriaanse overheid en bedrijven waar de Nigeriaanse overheid zaken mee wenst te doen.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over een sloopwerf voor zeeschepen in Harlingen op 11 april 2012

An MP asked whether the Harlingen port's plan for a ship-breaking yard in the protected Wadden Sea would be assessed, its effects on the World Heritage and Natura 2000 area, dredging, pollution and transport of old ships. The state secretary answered that the plan is a local initiative still without detail, that the municipal council is first responsible, that existing rules will apply, and that the Rijk does not develop such sites itself.
It is primarily up to the Harlingen municipal council to assess the proposal and decide whether to support it.
Het is in eerste plaats aan de gemeenteraad van Harlingen om het voorstel te beoordelen en al dan niet te ondersteunen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Hachchi over de aanhoudende problemen met de postvoorziening op de openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Hachchi asked about persistent postal failures on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, including residents receiving reminders and fines for bills they never received, and whether postcodes, UPU country codes and enforcement would fix the problems. The state secretary admitted the service still falls short of concession terms, said enforcement via an instruction or fine is being considered, and noted liability for losses is a matter for the courts while a review of alternatives to the concessionaire is underway.
I have now commissioned an external agency to explore whether, and under what conditions, parties are willing to take on (parts of) the postal service for the Caribbean Netherlands.

Ik heb inmiddels een extern bureau opdracht gegeven om een verkenning uit te voeren of, en zo ja onder welke voorwaarden partijen bereid zijn om (delen van) de postvoorziening ten behoeve van Caribisch Nederland op zich te nemen.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Hazekamp, Van Gerven, Grashoff en Graus over de voortgang van de bouw van megastallen ondanks het nadrukkelijk verzoek van de Tweede Kamer voor een moratorium op de bouw van deze

Five MPs asked the state secretary why construction of mega-stables continues despite a Chamber request for a moratorium, including a municipality's decision to proceed with a Horst aan de Maas project after a health risk assessment. The state secretary confirmed awareness, said the Witveldweg zoning procedure started before the motion so it is not a new application, reiterated restrictive policy, and said a legislative cap on animal numbers would be left to a next cabinet.
There is therefore no question of new applications as referred to in the motion by the members Grashoff and Van Veldhoven.
Er is derhalve geen sprake van nieuwe aanvragen als bedoeld in de motie van de leden Grashoff en Van Veldhoven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hazekamp over beschietingen van roofvogelnesten

An MP asked the state secretary whether proceedings had been brought for destroying raptor nests, how often offenders were traced, whether supervision would be tightened, and whether convictions should lead to permanent revocation of hunting licences. The state secretary said detection is very difficult, that nest destruction should be punished severely under the Economic Offences Act, and that prevention and enforcement policy will be pursued, but declined to subsidise more field supervision.
The government does not have databases that allow distinctions at the level of modus operandi and/or threatened species for violations of the Flora and Fauna Act.
De overheid beschikt niet over databases waarmee tot op het niveau van modus operandi en/of bedreigde soorten onderscheid gemaakt kan worden bij overtredingen van de Flora- en faunawet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Peters en El Fassed over het opnemen van verzekeringen voor wapentransporten in de sancties tegen Syrië

MPs Peters and El Fassed asked whether insurance for arms shipments to Syria is covered by EU sanctions, whether this should be tightened like the Iran oil-insurance ban, how enforcement works, and whether financial sectors are aware of the rules. The minister answered that EU sanctions ban insuring arms cargo bound for Syria, that Dutch customs (POSS) enforces this and will remind businesses, that at least one ship apparently turned back after insurance was withdrawn, but that many insurers still cover arms cargo and enforcement by insurers is limited.
Given the importance of this matter, these services will again actively bring the information on the sanctions against Syria to the attention of Dutch business.
Gezien het belang van deze materie zullen genoemde diensten de informatie over de sancties tegen Syrië nogmaals actief onder de aandacht van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven brengen.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over de Nederlandse toestemming voor het massaal doden van ganzen met behulp van CO2

An MP asks why the minister granted an exemption allowing mass gassing of geese with CO2 near Schiphol despite the EU biocides directive, and questions the necessity, animal welfare basis, costs, and preventive measures. The minister answers that the exemption rests on a convenant and motion, that the Commission was informed, that the welfare basis is a Wageningen study, and that the risk increase was not foreseeable.
I refer to the explanatory note accompanying the exemption (No. IenMbsk-201269716) of 10 May 2012, published in the Staatscourant on 15 May 2012.
Ik verwijs naar de toelichting bij de vrijstelling (Nr. IenMbsk-201269716) van 10 mei 2012 welke op 15 mei 2012 in de Staatscourant gepubliceerd is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Jacobi over plofkippen en het Beter Leven Keurmerk

MPs Van Dekken and Jacobi asked the state secretary about the 'plofkip' (fast-growing broiler), antibiotic use, welfare problems, and whether government canteens could switch to Beter Leven chicken. The state secretary largely deferred to retail and industry initiatives, cited pending research on antibiotic use, and said canteen criteria were being updated to encourage more animal-friendly products.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over legbatterijeieren die ondanks verbod nog steeds in Nederland verkocht worden (sts ELI)

An SP MP asked the state secretary about battery-cage eggs still sold in the Netherlands despite the EU ban, including EU and Italian figures, import controls, use in processed foods, a sales ban and labelling. The state secretary confirmed roughly 45 million hens remain in battery cages in the EU, said import restrictions conflict with WTO rules, ruled out a national sales ban and mandatory discouraging labels, and pointed to retailer purchasing rules requiring free-range eggs.
As previously stated, under WTO rules it is not permitted to distinguish between 'like' products based on production method.
Zoals eerder aangegeven is het volgens de regels van de WTO niet toegestaan onderscheid te maken tussen «soortgelijke» producten op basis van de productiemethode.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hazekamp over het rapen van kievitseieren op de Werelderfgoedlijst van Unesco

An MP asked whether the Chamber's April 2012 approval of the UNESCO Intangible Heritage convention changes the government's earlier answers that listing egg-collecting was not on the agenda. The state secretary replied that ratification does not change earlier answers, because the Kingdom only becomes party three months after deposit and inventorying will come first.
The fact that the House of Representatives approved ratification of the UNESCO Convention for Intangible Cultural Heritage changes nothing about the earlier answers.
Het feit dat de Tweede Kamer heeft ingestemd met de ratificatie van het UNESCO-verdrag voor Immaterieel Erfgoed verander niets aan de eerdere antwoorden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het houden van wallaby’s

An MP asks the state secretary about escaped wallabies, the lack of rules on keeping and selling exotic animals, the costs and ownership of recaptured animals, and trade data. The state secretary answers that the animal was recaptured and rehomed, that no sale conditions currently apply apart from a planned information duty, that a positive list for mammals is being prepared with WUR research, and that trade data for non-protected kangaroo species is not collected.
Currently no conditions are imposed on the sale of wallabies.
Momenteel worden geen voorwaarden gesteld aan de verkoop van wallaby's.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het toesturen van de lijst van diersoorten, waarin handel verboden is (sts ELI)

An MP asked the state secretary why the list of animal species banned from online trade, promised to journalists as ready by the end of the week, had not been sent to Marktplaats. The secretary confirmed the timing and stated that the list is now published on Marktplaats' information page.
The list is on the information page of the Marktplaats website.
De lijst staat op de informatiepagina van de website Marktplaats.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over haringpromotiecampagnes op basisscholen

MP Ouwehand asks the education and economic affairs ministers whether the commercial Dutch Fisheries Bureau's 'haringsmaaklessen' campaign in primary schools, which promotes herring to children, is acceptable given overfishing and marine harm, and whether the government subsidised it. The minister replies that schools are free to use such materials, that the campaign is not an official government product, that the Fisheries Bureau received two EU fisheries fund subsidies of 7 million each for sustainability promotion, and that herring stocks are within safe limits, while declining to commit to new measures.
Schools are completely free to use the 'haringsmaaklessen'.
Scholen zijn volledig vrij om gebruik te maken van de «haringsmaaklessen».
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de internethandel in (wilde) dieren (sts ELI)

An MP asks the state secretary about internet trade in wild animals on Marktplaats, the legality of keeping captive-bred wild animals, enforcement capacity, the role of the Tor network, and a positive list for animals. The state secretary answers that legal keeping requires proof of legal origin, that NVWA enforcement is limited to a few specialised investigators, and that a positive list for mammals will take effect on 1 January 2013, with other animal groups to be considered later.
I do not have recent figures on the volume of internet trade in (wild) animals on sales sites.
Ik beschik niet over recente cijfers over de omvang van de internethandel in (wilde) dieren op verkoopsites.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Houwers over het artikel 'Ministerie straft mosselvissers' in de Provinciale Zeeuwse Courant van 7 april jl. (sts ELI)

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary about reports that mussel fishers from Zeeland were penalised for fishing outside agreed coordinates, asking about notification timing, the inspection's conduct, the rules for participation, and whether Dutch enforcement is stricter than in neighbouring countries. The state secretary defended the timing and care of the inspection, said fishers were informed of the rules through their producer organisation, and noted the transports were required under EU habitat law with a temporary permit running to 19 April 2012.
No, the ministry's inspectors, together with staff of the P.O. Mosselcultuur, analysed the black box data with extreme care and precision before contacting the fishers.
Nee, de toezichthouders van het ministerie hebben, in samenspraak met medewerkers van de P.O. Mosselcultuur, uiterst zorgvuldig en nauwkeurig de black box-data geanalyseerd
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hazekamp over het uitsterven van de witte kievitsbloem (sts ELI)

An MP asked the state secretary whether the white meadow lady's-smock (kievitsbloem) is at risk of extinction because groundwater is kept low for farmers in a Haren nature area, and whether measures will be taken with nature organisations, water boards and provinces. The state secretary answered that the species is protected, that existing Natura 2000 and provincial measures are sufficient, and that the claim about the last 15 plants in Haren is incorrect since the largest population is in the Uiterwaarden Zwarte Water en Vecht area.
It is incorrect that the last 15 wild kievitsbloemen (or white variants thereof) in Haren would be found anywhere in the world or even in the Netherlands.
