Het is onjuist dat in Haren de laatste 15 wilde kievitsbloemen (of witte varianten daarvan) ter wereld of zelfs maar van Nederland zouden voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Houwers en Ten Broeke over het bericht dat de gemeente Almelo circussen weert met wilde dieren

MPs Houwers and Ten Broeke asked the state secretary whether municipalities such as Almelo may ban circuses with wild animals without a public order threat, and whether the law should be changed so municipalities cannot refuse circuses that meet the animal welfare law. The state secretary answered that municipalities may regulate circuses only for public order or safety purposes, not for animal welfare, and declined to change the legislation.
Municipalities do have the power to make rules concerning animals for a different purpose, provided these rules do not conflict with the standards of the Animal Health and Welfare Act.
Gemeenten hebben wel de bevoegdheid om met een ander oogmerk regels te stellen inzake dieren, mits deze regels niet in strijd zijn met de normen in de Gezondheids- en welzijnswet voor dieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het mogelijk geven van foutieve informatie door Shell inzake de olielekkages in de Nigerdelta

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that Shell may have given inaccurate and incomplete information on the size of Niger Delta oil spills and the extent of sabotage, and whether he would discuss the Accufacts findings with Amnesty International and Shell. The State Secretary answered that the matter is handled through the OECD Guidelines National Contact Point, which has held talks with the parties, and that a separate discussion on the report was not considered appropriate beyond regular contacts.
The NCP has held several talks with the parties involved over the past year and hopes to reach positive, forward-looking steps with them.
Het NCP heeft in het afgelopen jaar meerdere gesprekken gevoerd met de betrokken partijen en hoopt met hen te kunnen komen tot positieve, toekomstgerichte stappen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hazekamp over CO2-opslag onder de zeebodem

An MP asked the minister about reported plans by RWE/Essent to store CO2 under the seabed in depleted gas fields, the government's role, EU or government funding, Wadden Sea environmental risks, and coal-plant policy. The minister denied knowledge of a concrete plan, said environmental assessments would be required for any project near Natura 2000 areas, and defended coal plants as supply-secure while pointing to a coal tax in the coalition agreement.
I am not aware of any concrete plan for storing CO2 from the RWE/Essent coal plant under the seabed.
Er is mij geen concreet voornemen voor de opslag van CO 2 uit de kolencentrale van RWE/Essent onder de zeebodem bekend.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over nazorg bij ruiming in de veehouderij om dierziekte

An MP asked whether aftercare exists for human victims of animal disease crises such as Q fever, and what lessons were drawn from the earlier Q fever outbreak. The minister answered that patients use regular care, GGD informed medical professionals, the Q-uestion patient association was subsidised, and a multidisciplinary guideline and research were funded.
Patients needing aftercare following such an infectious disease can, like patients with other serious illnesses, rely on regular healthcare provision.
Patiënten die nazorg nodig hebben ten gevolge van een dergelijke infectieziekte, kunnen net als patiënten met een andere ernstige ziekte een beroep doen op het reguliere zorgaanbod.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over een jager die een auto op de A15 raakt met een kogel

An MP asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers about a hunter who hit a car on the A15 motorway with a bullet, including whether a report was filed, whether his hunting permit was revoked, and whether lead ammunition and hunting near public roads should be banned. The minister answered that a criminal investigation is ongoing, the permit may be revoked after review, no general ban on lead ammunition or hunting near roads is planned, and details cannot be given while the case is pending.
In the interest of the investigation, no statements can be made about that.
In het belang van het onderzoek kunnen daarover geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over de aanwezigheid van pathogenen in kippenvlees

An MP asked the health and agriculture ministers about pathogens in chicken meat, citing a US study on E. coli, and asked how many Dutch products are contaminated, whether products should be pathogen-free, who bears liability, whether consumers' burden of proof should be eased, and the government's role in tracing infection sources. The minister replied that the US situation is not comparable, that Salmonella is declining, that Campylobacter is found on 20% of chicken, that producers bear primary responsibility, that no special burden-of-proof rules are planned, and described the GGD/NVWA reporting and investigation routes.
I am currently considering additional measures regarding Campylobacter on poultry meat.
Momenteel beraad ik mij op aanvullende maatregelen ten aanzien van Campylobacter op pluimveevlees
Antwoord vragen Ormel over het bericht “Omstreden walvisvaart weer begonnen”

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation whether Japan, Norway and Iceland may catch whales for scientific purposes under IWC rules, and whether scientific necessity has been independently reviewed. The State Secretary answered that only Japan hunts for scientific purposes under its own quota, that Iceland and Norway hunt commercially, and that the treaty requires no prior approval or peer review, while the Netherlands seeks to end such hunting through IWC treaty revision.
The Whaling Convention permits countries to kill whales for scientific purposes. This requires no prior approval or peer review.
Het Walvisvaartverdrag staat toe dat landen walvissen doden voor wetenschappelijke doeleinden. Dit vereist geen voorafgaande toestemming of peer review.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het stimuleren van duurzame eiwitconsumptie

An MP asked the state secretaries whether the price gap between meat and plant-based meat substitutes should be closed through taxes or subsidies and whether the external costs of meat should be included in its price. The government answered that it sees no short-term options, is awaiting a LEI study on external costs, uses voluntary sustainability initiatives and does not plan stimulation schemes for meat substitutes.
At the request of my ministry, the LEI will publish a study on this subject this summer.
Op verzoek van mijn ministerie brengt het LEI deze zomer nog een studie uit over dit onderwerp
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over wapentransport naar Egypte met een Nederlands schip

MP El Fassed asked the ministers whether a Dutch-flagged ship was carrying a military cargo from the US to Egypt, and about Egypt's human rights record, arms export risks, and whether the carrier can be held to account. The government answered that the cargo's destination was not confirmed and not Egypt, that transporting military goods requires no licence, that no action against the shipowner is planned, and that the Wet Strategische Diensten deliberately excludes mere transport services.
No steps against the owner of the chartered ship are being considered because the facts give no cause for them and there is no legal basis on which steps could be taken.

Antwoord 6 Er worden geen stappen tegen de eigenaar van het gecharterde schip overwogen omdat de feiten hier geen aanleiding toe geven (zie antwoord op vraag 2) en omdat er geen juridische grond is op basis waarvan stappen gezet kunnen worden.
Antwoord vragen De Mos over Nederlandse telers die de USDA Organic teeltmethode toepassen

An MP asked the state secretary about Dutch growers using USDA organic methods (including substrate growing) following the EU-US organic equivalence agreement, and whether those methods could continue for the North American market. The government answered that the rules remain distinct, that a study of growing methods is planned with results expected in autumn, that the topic may return to the EU organic committee in 2013, and that continued US-market production is possible as long as the rules are unchanged, though no guarantee is given.
I intend to have a number of cultivation methods investigated.
Ik heb het voornemen een aantal teeltwijzen te laten onderzoeken.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het naderen van een post-antibioticatijdperk

An MP asked the health and agriculture ministers about the WHO warning of a post-antibiotic era, whether voluntary reduction targets in livestock farming are adequate, and whether binding measures will follow. The minister answered that existing policy is serious and based on self-regulation combined with strict state supervision, that the 50% reduction target is not the end goal, and that a transition to sustainable farming is needed, without committing to new legislation.
I do not share your view that only non-binding agreements have been made with the livestock sectors, without a stick behind the door.
Ik deel uw mening niet dat er daarbij slechts vrijblijvende afspraken zijn gemaakt met de betreffende veehouderijsectoren, zonder stok achter de deur.
Antwoord vragen Ormel over suggestieve uitspraken van de directeur GGD Nederland over risico’s van overdracht van dierziekten naar mensen

CDA MP Ormel asked the minister about remarks by the GGD Nederland director suggesting worry about zoonotic virus spread, and about the transparency of communication on animal disease outbreaks. The minister said the RIVM found no evidence of Schmallenberg transmission to humans, declined to answer for GGD Nederland, and pointed to existing communication arrangements between EL&I and VWS.
GGD Nederland is not part of VWS.
GGD Nederland is geen onderdeel van VWS.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over reeën die zich dood lopen tegen de afrastering van de Betuwelijn

An MP asked how high the Betuwe railway fencing is, why deer died against it, and whether a fine mesh top edge should be mandatory for wildlife fencing. The state secretary confirmed the fence is about 1.80 m with no barbed wire, but said the technical design of the fence is not his responsibility.
The (technical) implementation of the fencing along the Betuwe line does not fall within my responsibilities.
De (technische) uitvoering van de afrastering langs de Betuwelijn hoort niet tot mijn verantwoordelijkheden.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Hazekamp over het conflict tussen de Nederlandse dierenbeschermer Edwin Wiek en de Thaise overheid over de handel in uit het wild gevangen babyolifanten voor de toeristenindustrie

Hazekamp (PvdD) asked the ministers whether the Thai government and its park officials were complicit in poaching baby elephants for tourism and in harassing Dutch animal welfare activist Edwin Wiek's shelter, and whether the Netherlands would raise these concerns. The minister answered that the matter is under investigation by Traffic, that Thailand is responsible for CITES enforcement, and that the Netherlands would raise concerns with Thailand if official involvement is established, but could not rule out that seized animals fall prey to traders.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het subsidiëren van de promotie van geitenzuivel en geitenvlees

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation and the minister of Health about government subsidies for promoting goat dairy and goat meat, linked to surplus male kids, antibiotic use and intensification in goat farming. The state secretary denied that the ministry funded goat-dairy promotion, explained that a small EU- and ministry-co-funded practice-network website covered goat-kid meat, acknowledged antibiotic use in goat kid fattening is a concern, and said the sector must take responsibility and provide insight into antibiotic use.
At present there is no central overview of antibiotic use in the goat sector, and there is no insight into the quantities and categories of antibiotics used.
Op dit moment is er nog geen centraal zicht op het gebruik van antibiotica in de geitensector en is er geen inzicht in het gebruik van hoeveelheden en categorieën antibiotica.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over gekleurde duiven in pasteltinten die te verkrijgen zijn via duivenverhuurservice.nl

An MP asked the state secretary whether dyed pastel pigeons rented for parties, and pigeons with whistles fitted to their tails, are legally restricted and whether their welfare is harmed. The state secretary answered that no specific law regulates dyeing animals, that the general animal-cruelty ban applies, that the whistle option has been removed due to low demand, and that no clear welfare harm has been identified so no action is planned.
At this moment I have no indications that the welfare or health of the animal is affected to such an extent that action should be taken against it.
Ik heb op dit moment geen aanwijzingen dat sprake is van een dusdanige aantasting van het welzijn of de gezondheid van het dier dat hiertegen opgetreden zou moeten worden.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over de kap van twee bomen in Schinnen

An MP asked the state secretary whether trees in Schinnen were felled without a permit and without public consultation to make way for beer tanks, and whether this was acceptable, given earlier NATO tree felling. The state secretary answered that the municipality's own tree policy applies, that the municipality said no environmental permit was needed, and that he does not judge the municipality's application of its autonomous policy.
I do not pass judgment on the application of the autonomous policy of the municipality of Schinnen.
Ik spreek geen oordeel uit over de toepassing van het autonome beleid van de gemeente Schinnen.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over de geconstateerde overtredingen met betrekking tot de productie van filet americain

An MP asked the state secretary and minister about food safety violations in filet americain following a television investigation, including bacteria levels and undisclosed pork. The minister answered that no legal bacteria norm exists for this product, TNO found no pathogens, and she sees no reason to tighten nVWA oversight or add sanctions.
In my view the nVWA oversight is sufficiently adequate on this point, and the television programme has provided no new insights regarding the effectiveness of the oversight.
Naar mijn mening is het nVWA-toezicht voldoende adequaat op dit punt en heeft het televisieprogramma geen nieuwe inzichten opgeleverd ten aanzien van de effectiviteit van het toezicht.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over EHEC-besmetting bij herten

An MP asked the government whether venison from wild deer, found in a German study to be largely carrying EHEC-type bacteria, is adequately controlled and who is liable for food safety in the wild game chain. State Secretary Bleker answered that the bacteria found are mostly harmless STEC, that existing EU and national inspection rules adequately control the risks, and that no new measures or ban are warranted.
I therefore see no reason to ban the consumption of meat from wild animals.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om de consumptie van vlees van in het wild levende dieren te verbieden.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het rapen van kievitseieren op de Werelderfgoedlijst van Unesco

MP Hazekamp asked whether the traditional collecting of lapwing eggs (Aaisykjen) belongs on the UNESCO heritage list and whether its declining lapwing population justifies restricting it. The minister replied that the list concerned is the intangible heritage list, to which the Netherlands is not yet a party, so listing is not at issue, and that falling lapwing numbers are taken into account in exemption decisions.
The decline is taken into account in the assessment for future exemption grants.
De daling wordt meegenomen bij de beoordeling voor toekomstige ontheffingverlening.
Antwoord vragen Snijder-Hazelhoff over het bericht dat Duitsland de achtergronddepositie van ammoniak anders dan in Nederland bepaalt

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that Germany calculates background ammonia deposition differently from the Netherlands, and whether this affects the level playing field and Dutch nature targets. The state secretary answered that no single prescribed method exists in Europe, that differences stem from methods and emissions, that the Netherlands uses the latest scientific insights, and that German regulation affects Dutch nature targets only to a limited extent.
To date there is no fixed or prescribed method for determining deposition in Europe.
Er bestaat tot op heden geen vastgelegde of voorgeschreven methode waarmee de depositie bepaald moet worden in Europa.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over nazorg bij ruiming in de veehouderij om dierziekte

An MP asked the State Secretary whether aftercare is needed for farming families and owners facing culling due to animal disease, whether aftercare existed during the 2001 foot-and-mouth crisis, and what aftercare is available now and what lessons were drawn. The State Secretary answered that aftercare is needed, that during foot-and-mouth support came mainly from sector organisations, social networks and churches, and that the GGD now organises psychosocial aid with improvements from past evaluations, with (Z)LTO offering aftercare to its members.
Evaluations of various animal disease crises show that affected livestock farmers have a need for aftercare.
Uit de evaluaties van verschillende dierziektecrises komt naar voren dat er bij de getroffen veehouder behoefte is aan nazorg.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het voorkomen van mastitis en klauwproblemen bij melkkoeien in Nederland

An MP asked the state secretary about rising painkiller use in dairy cows, the prevalence of mastitis and hoof problems, milk yield and pasture access, and what policy is planned to reduce these problems. The secretary said painkiller monitoring is a task for the vets' and farmers' sector rather than government, cited prevalence figures from research, and pointed to sector-led projects and an integrated sustainability agenda without committing to new binding measures.
Monitoring the use of painkillers in animals is not primarily a task for the government but rather for the professional association of veterinarians and the livestock sector itself.
Het volgen van het gebruik van pijnstilling bij dieren is niet in de eerste plaats de taak voor de overheid maar eerder voor de beroepsvereniging van de dierenartsen en de veehouderijsector zelf.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over koeien die dansend de wei in gaan

An MP asked whether the excitement of cows entering pasture shows that year-round housing is harmful, and whether pasture grazing should be made mandatory given reduced grazing from farm scale-up. The minister welcomed sector initiatives promoting grazing but rejected mandatory grazing, leaving it to chain partners.
I consider making grazing mandatory undesirable; it is up to the partners in the chain to give substance to grazing, as is also happening.
Verplichten van weidegang acht ik ongewenst, het is aan de partners in de keten om aan weidegang invulling te geven, zoals ook gebeurt.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp en Ouwehand over het ontduiken van de m.e.r.-plicht voor vergunningverlening van intensieve veehouderij

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether municipalities are evading the EIA (MER) obligation for intensive livestock permits by approving stepwise expansions just below the threshold, and what consequences, oversight and enforcement follow. The minister answered that the matter rests with competent authorities (municipalities), that only incidental signals were received, that a mandatory EIA screening applies below the threshold, that inspection can act against structural negligence, and that supervision will shift to provinces under the pending Revitalisering Generiek Toezicht bill.
However, these are incidental reports, which gives me no reason to launch broader research into this.
Het gaat echter om incidentele berichten, hetgeen mij geen aanleiding geeft om hier een breder onderzoek naar in te stellen.
Antwoord vragen Van Veldhoven over de waterbouwkundige gevolgen van de kabinetsplannen ten aanzien van natuurcompensatie in de Westerschelde

Ms. Van Veldhoven (D66) asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation about the water-engineering effects of the cabinet's Westerschelde nature-compensation plans: erosion at Saeftinghe, dike maintenance costs, the Hedwigepolder dike length and water levels, and consultation with Flanders. The state secretary answered that the buitendijkse measures are not part of the cabinet decision, that the Hedwigepolder dike length will be about 3.9 km instead of 1.5 km under full depoldering, that a 1-2 cm upstream water-level effect is expected without yet having been discussed in the Flemish-Dutch Scheldt Commission, and that no contribution has been offered to Flanders.
Those buitendijkse measures you refer to are not part of that.
Daarvan maken de door u bedoelde buitendijkse maatregelen geen onderdeel uit.
Antwoord vragen Van Tongeren over de kosten van een alternatief voor het ontpolderen van de Hedwigepolder

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Deltares alternative IIa for the Hedwige polder costs 300 million euro, whether it meets the ministry's criteria, how many hectares of nature restoration it yields, and whether spending that much on a few farmers is justified. The secretary answered that Deltares priced IIa at 270 million, that the cabinet decision of 17 June 2011 uses a maximum of 190 million, and referred to that letter for the details of the measures and hectares.
Antwoord vragen de Mos, van Vliet en van Bemmel over het bericht “Hedwige mogelijk deels onder water”

PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether the risks of flooding caused by the Hedwige polder de-embankment, including for the Doel nuclear plant across the border, warranted independent research or invoking treaty clausula rebus sic stantibus. The secretary answered that flood safety was already a key condition in planning, so the de-embankment does not compromise safety and further independent research is not needed.
No, in the planning for the de-embankment of the Hedwige polder flood safety has been taken into account as an important condition.
Nee, in de planvorming voor de ontpoldering van de Hedwigepolder is de veiligheid tegen overstroming als een belangrijke voorwaarde meegenomen.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over natuursubsidies Reiderwolde

Opposition MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the state secretary why land at Reiderwolde was sold below its appraised value, why its price rose about 4% in five months, whether 9% annual land appreciation is normal, how the subsidy application price was set, and why nature management went to a private operator rather than Staatsbosbeheer. The state secretary answered that the price was negotiated from the appraisal, no instructions were given to the land agency, the subsidy procedure ran through the province and Dienst Regelingen, and the natural function is secured notarially and under the EHS framework.
No instructions were given to the land agency BBL.
Er zijn geen aanwijzingen gegeven richting BBL.
Antwoord vragen Ormel en Houwers over het voornemen van de gemeente Capelle aan den IJssel om circussen met tijgers en olifanten te weren

MPs Ormel and Houwers asked whether municipalities may ban circuses with tigers and elephants on animal-welfare grounds when national law governs animal welfare, and what enforcement applies to the sector's own guidelines. The state secretary answered that municipalities may only regulate animals for other purposes such as public order, that the national Animal Health and Welfare Act is exhaustive on welfare, and that the sector will improve its guidelines and EU action is being pursued.
Municipalities do have the power to make rules on animals for other purposes, provided those rules do not conflict with the norms of the national Animal Health and Welfare Act.
Gemeenten hebben wel de bevoegdheid om met andere oogmerken regels te stellen inzake dieren, mits deze regels niet in strijd zijn met de normen in de Gezondheids- en welzijnswet voor dieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het besluit van supermarktketen Plus om alleen nog biologische en vrije-uitloop eieren te verkopen

An MP from the PvdD asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation whether he welcomes supermarket chain Plus's decision to sell only organic and free-range eggs, and why the pluimveehouders' union and LTO criticised it. The state secretary answered that supermarkets decide their own product range, that the sector should manage the market transition itself, and that he sees no need for a letter of praise or reprimand.
It is primarily up to supermarkets and other parties to decide, within their market and consumer strategy, which products they offer to consumers.
Het is primair aan de supermarkten en andere partijen om binnen hun markt- en consumentenstrategie te besluiten welke producten zij aanbieden aan de consument.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Irrgang over de terugbetaling van geïnde omstreden Amerikaanse invoerheffingen aan het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven

Two SP MPs asked whether the EU-US deal ending zeroing duties, which does not require refunds of wrongly collected duties to Dutch firms, is acceptable, and what can be done about collective recovery. The minister called the refund outcome disappointing but acceptable, said the EU lacks legal means to force US refunds, and said firms themselves must decide on collective action in US courts.
The agreement reached was the highest achievable and is therefore disappointing on refunds but wholly acceptable to me.
Het bereikte akkoord was het hoogst haalbare en is voor mij dan ook op het punt van terugbetaling teleurstellend maar in zijn geheel acceptabel.

Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het afwijzen door het ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid van een vergoeding voor deeltijd WW bij een paardenhouder die ter voorkoming van besmetting van andere paarden met de

MP Van Gerven asked why the Ministry of Social Affairs rejected a request for short-time work benefit for a horse-riding business that closed to prevent spread of the EHV1 virus, and whether this was not an exceptional circumstance. The minister answered that the risk of animal disease is a normal business risk, that the rejection followed the policy criteria, and that the business acted well but does not qualify for the exemption.
There are no exceptional circumstances that cannot reasonably be attributed to the normal business risk.
Er is geen sprake van buitengewone omstandigheden die in redelijkheid niet tot het normale bedrijfsrisico kunnen worden gerekend.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het bericht dat er veel meer q-koortsslachtoffers zijn

An SP MP asked the minister whether the Q-fever outbreak was far larger than previously stated, why past estimates were wrong, and whether a Q-fever compensation fund should be set up. The minister answered that earlier figures were not wrong because notified cases differ from infections, that no national estimate of medical or economic costs exists, and that about 250 chronic patients are being treated, with the Visie op schadefondsen letter setting out the position on a fund.
No national estimate has been made of the medical costs and economic damage resulting from Q-fever.
Er is geen landelijke inschatting gemaakt van medische kosten en de economische schade als gevolg van Q-koorts.
Antwoord vragen Dijkgraaf over het scheuren van grasland

An MP asked the state secretary whether he would press Brussels to move the grassland ploughing deadline on sandy soil from 31 May to 30 June 2012, citing reports on nitrate leaching. The state secretary replied that he will raise revising the grassland rules with the Commission, but will not seek a change within the current action programme, since the rules are a condition of the derogation, and sees no new facts warranting priority treatment.
These reports give me reason to advocate, with the European Commission, an adjustment of the applicable rules for destroying the grass sod of grassland.
Deze rapporten geven mij aanleiding een aanpassing van de geldende regels voor het vernietigen van de graszode van grasland bij de Europese Commissie te bepleiten.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over afschot van zogende wilde zwijnen

An MP asks whether the wild boar shooting period is being extended into the gestation and nursing period, risking starvation of piglets, and whether a national ban or enforcement of animal welfare duties is planned. The state secretary confirms the extension and piglet sightings, says shooting is necessary for road safety and delegates the decision to the province, rejects a national ban and leaves enforcement to case-by-case assessment.
Killing wild boar is necessary, among other things, for the safety of road users on the North Veluwe. The province is authorised to make decisions on this.
Het doden van zwijnen is noodzakelijk voor onder meer de veiligheid van verkeersdeelnemers op de Noord-Veluwe. De provincie is bevoegd om hier besluiten over te nemen.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over Aanvallen Japanse walvisvaarders op bemanning Sea Sheperd

An MP asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers about Japanese whalers' alleged violent attacks on Sea Shepherd crew near Antarctica, including water cannons, grappling hooks and bamboo poles, and asked why no prosecution had been launched. The minister said the Netherlands is in contact with both sides and will assess whether independent investigation is needed, but declined to judge the specific incidents, pointing to the absence of a judicial procedure and to the lack of complaints filed.
On the basis of the available information I am not in a position to make a substantive judgment on this specific situation.
Op basis van de beschikbare informatie ben ik niet in staat om een inhoudelijk oordeel te vellen over deze specifieke situatie.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over de nieuwe ophef die is ontstaan rond het Nederlands Opvangcentrum Papegaaien (N.O.P.)

An MP asked the state secretary about an alleged link between a bird shelter (N.O.P.) employee and illegal import of exotic birds, seizures during searches, whether the shelter's contract should be ended, and its fees and the reliability of shelters. The government answered that an investigation is ongoing, that the contract will be reviewed if the outcome warrants it, and that it cannot disclose contract fees as commercially sensitive.
When the outcome of the investigation is known, I will, if there is cause, review the agreements with the N.O.P. again.
Wanneer de uitkomsten van het onderzoek bekend zijn zal ik, wanneer hier aanleiding toe is, de overeenkomsten met de N.O.P. opnieuw bekijken.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over schokkende beelden van dierenmishandeling op een Brits veebedrijf

An MP asked the state secretary whether Dutch meat from a UK factory-farm abuse case could be stopped at the border, whether Dutch consumers can be protected, and what enforcement safeguards exist. The state secretary replied that closing borders on welfare grounds is not possible under EU law, that enforcement is shared with member states and the NVWA does risk-based inspections, and promised to push for better EU enforcement without committing to a specific step.
No, I cannot rule that out.
Nee, dat kan ik niet uitsluiten.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp en Van Dekken over gesjoemel met tellen van reeën

MPs Hazekamp and Van Dekken asked the state secretary about reports that Drenthe hunting units inflated or manipulated deer counts to obtain larger culling quotas, and whether the state would investigate, ban the mixing of roles, or fund independent research. The state secretary said deliberately overstating counts is unacceptable but that provincial Gedeputeerde Staten are responsible for oversight and enforcement, declined to investigate population dynamics, and said the Faunabeheereenheid's multi-party composition sufficiently guarantees independence.
However, it is the responsibility of the Provincial Executives of the provinces to investigate this and take measures where necessary.
Het is echter de verantwoordelijkheid van de Gedeputeerde Staten van de provincies om dit te onderzoeken en in voorkomende gevallen maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over een zoekgeraakte brief van een dierenasiel

MP Van Gerven asked whether an exemption request from Dierenbescherming Limburg for housing rules for an animal shelter in Maastricht had been lost, whether this left municipalities in breach of their duties, and whether a private animal welfare body could file such a request on behalf of a public authority. The state secretary answered that the request was registered on 27 January 2012 and decided within the reasonable eight-week period, that no statutory deadline applies, and that the duty to meet the rules lies with the shelter operator rather than the municipality.
This request was registered with the ministry on 27 January 2012.
Dit verzoek is op 27 januari 2012 geregistreerd bij het ministerie.
Antwoord vragen Ormel over een meldplicht voor de nerveuze vorm van Rhinopneumonie bij paarden

An MP asked the state secretary for a mandatory reporting duty for the neurological form of Rhinopneumonia in horses, plus information on deaths and transmission. The state secretary gave case counts, said the virus spreads by direct contact, but declined a statutory reporting duty, preferring a sector-run helpdesk and sector-led investigation.
A heavy instrument such as a statutory reporting and/or control duty is reserved for diseases where
Een zwaar instrument als een wettelijke meld- en of bestrijdingsplicht is gereserveerd voor ziekten waarbij
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over de uitbraak van het Rhinopneumonievirus onder paarden

Ouwehand asked the state secretary about the Rhinopneumonia outbreak among horses, including how owners are warned, whether a notification duty should exist, and how transport to markets and events should be judged. The state secretary said owners are informed through vets, the Sectorraad Paarden and a planned helpdesk, but saw no government role in a mandatory notification duty since the sector can manage the disease itself.
I see no role for the national government in this.
Hierbij zie ik geen rol voor de rijksoverheid weggelegd.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over een bij strenge vorst buiten vastgeketende hond in Breskens

An MP asked why police did not act on repeated reports of a labrador kept chained outside without adequate shelter or water in Breskens during severe frost, and whether current rules and enforcement are adequate. The minister answered that police found no criminal offence, that existing rules offer sufficient grounds for enforcement, that a forthcoming decree will clarify animal cruelty, and that no data exist on how many dogs are chained 24 hours a day.
The police have been unable to establish a criminal offence concerning the dog in this case.
De politie heeft geen strafbaar feit met betrekking tot de hond in deze casus kunnen aantonen.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over een transport van 38 Heckrunderen, in eigendom van Staatsbosbeheer, waarvan 16 runderen het niet hebben overleefd

An MP asked the state secretary about a transport of 38 Heck cattle owned by Staatsbosbeheer in which 16 died, asking how it happened, whether the animals stabbed each other, the condition of the survivors, why a distant slaughterhouse was chosen, and whether extra transport rules apply. The government answered that a criminal investigation by the NVWA and Public Prosecution Service is ongoing, the deaths cannot be fully explained yet, the choice of slaughterhouse is left to the parties, EU rules contain no special Heck cattle requirements, and it will inform parliament once the investigation results are known.
Following the incident mentioned above, the NVWA has launched a criminal investigation under the direction of the Functional Prosecution Service of the Public Prosecution Service.
Naar aanleiding van bovengenoemd voorval is door de NVWA een strafrechtelijk onderzoek ingesteld onder leiding van het Functioneel Parket van het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord vragen Ormel over de uitbraak van mond-en-klauwzeer (MKZ) in Egypte

An MP asked the state secretary about the foot-and-mouth disease outbreak in Egypt, including spread to neighbouring countries, EU measures, vaccine availability, aid to Egypt and traveller advice. The secretary reported new outbreaks, explained EU import bans and vaccine stocks, and said he is consulting on specific traveller communication while customs has raised checks by 10%.
I am still consulting on options to communicate about this specifically to travellers to and from Egypt, in addition to general communication.
Ik overleg nog over mogelijkheden om, in aanvulling op algemene communicatie, hierover specifiek te communiceren naar reizigers van en naar Egypte.
Antwoord vragen Slob over een voorlopige voorziening aangaande de spieringvisserij

An MP asked whether the Council of State's suspension of the spiering fishing permit, and the timing of the permit and opening decree, could be remedied so fishers get the full three weeks. The state secretary confirmed the facts, explained the permit timing was aligned with publication, and said the rules do not allow extending the period.
Article 65 of the Fisheries Implementation Regulation does not offer this possibility.
Artikel 65 van de Uitvoeringsregeling visserij biedt deze mogelijkheid niet.
Antwoord vragen Jacobi, Smeets en Timmermans over het salaris van de Floriadedirectie en de vergoedingen van de commissarissen bij de Floriade

Three PvdA MPs asked whether the Floriade directorate's pay exceeds the Balkenende norm, how much public subsidy funds it, and whether commissioners' fees (reportedly 4000 euro per meeting) are excessive and publicly financed. The minister answered that the Wopt does not apply to the Floriade company, that the directorate's pay is reportedly below the norm, that no state subsidy is used for directorate salaries, that commissioner fees average 750 euro net per month and are not state-financed, and that the exhibition commissioner's fee is split 50/50 between the ministry and the company.
At my request, the chair of the Supervisory Board informed me that the Floriade directorate's remuneration does not exceed the norm amount.
Op mijn verzoek heeft de voorzitter van de Raad van Commissarissen mij medegedeeld dat de vergoeding van de Floriadedirectie niet boven het normbedrag ligt.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind over kinderarbeid en de positie van Dalits in India

Voordewind (ChristenUnie) asked the Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs ministers about whether the EU-India trade agreement's sustainability chapter had been agreed, child labour and Dalit rights in India, an ITUC report on labour rights, and human rights follow-up such as torture reports. Minister Rosenthal answered that the trade negotiations were not concluded before the February summit, that India has relevant laws but implementation is weak, and that Dalit rights and torture are on the EU-India human rights dialogue agenda, though most answers restate existing policy.
It has not proven possible to conclude the negotiations on the EU-India free trade agreement before the EU-India Summit of 10 February.
Het is niet mogelijk gebleken om de onderhandelingen over het EU-India vrijhandelsverdrag voor de EU-India Top van afgelopen 10 februari af te ronden.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het via een website tegen betaling aanbieden van jachtuitjes aan jagers

An MP asked whether the government shares concern that a website offering paid hunting trips to any location encourages hunting tourism and recreational killing, and whether it will restrict such trips or stop new hunting licences. The state secretary answered that hunters are responsible for hunting within the Flora and Fauna Act and sustainable management, pointed to a forthcoming nature conservation bill, and said hunter training is not subsidised and that cross-regional kill data is not available.
There is a WBE database that records culling of various animal species. However, it is not possible to extract data from this database on culling outside one's own hunting grounds.
Er is een WBE-databank die afschot van diverse dierensoorten registreert. Echter het is niet mogelijk om uit deze databank gegevens op te dissen over het afschot buiten de eigen jachtvelden.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over 2578 onderschepte dode zeepaardjes op Schiphol

MP Hazekamp asked why a Peruvian woman caught with 2,578 dead seahorses at Schiphol paid only a fine, and questioned enforcement against wildlife trafficking and its deterrent effect. The minister answered that a €3,500 transaction was accepted per Openbaar Ministerie policy, that prison sentences are reserved for complex organised cases, and that a CITES-related pilot against organised wildlife crime will start in 2012.
The Public Prosecution Service informed me that in this case a settlement of €3,500 was offered, which the suspect accepted.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij meegedeeld dat in dit geval een transactie is aangeboden van € 3500, die door verdachte is geaccepteerd.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het gebruik van chemische toevoegingen in dierlijke producten

MP Hazekamp asked the ministers whether ammonium hydroxide (E527) and meat glue (trombine/fibrinogen) are permitted in Dutch meat products, whether they are safe, and how labelling and an EU ban would be handled. Minister Schippers answered that E527 is considered safe and remains permitted under EU rules until a 2013 change, that the Commission is still deciding on enzyme measures, that labelling of meat glue is required on packaged meat but not on unpackaged meat, and that the matter should be settled at EU level.
No, I believe this discussion should be resolved at European level.
Nee, Ik vind dat deze discussie op Europees niveau moet worden beslecht.
Antwoord vragen Snijder-Hazelhoff inzake het nietig verklaren van het besluit Eilandpolder

MP Snijder-Hazelhoff asks the state secretary what the Council of State's annulment of the Eilandpolder decision (non-enforcement against unpermitted manure spreading in a Natura 2000 area) means in practice for other Natura 2000 areas. The state secretary answers that consequences may remain limited, since manure spreading often falls under existing use and the court did not rule that spreading is a significant-effect project.

In my view the consequences of the ruling may remain limited, especially since the Council of State did not say that spreading manure as such is a project with possibly significant effects within the meaning of the Habitats Directive.

Naar mijn oordeel kunnen de gevolgen van de uitspraak beperkt blijven, zeker nu de RvS niet heeft gezegd dat mest uitrijden als zodanig een project met mogelijk significante gevolgen in de zin van de Habitatrichtlijn is.
Antwoord vragen Van Veldhoven over natuurcompensatie in de Westerschelde

An MP asked whether the Raad van State ruling on the Rammekensschor sand depot, which found the Natura 2000 boundary inadequately justified, means estuarine habitat was lost unlawfully, and how and when it would be restored and compensated. The State Secretary acknowledged habitat loss and a flawed boundary but declined to quantify losses or set out compensation until a pending ecological study is complete.
Currently it is being carefully investigated exactly where the boundary of the Natura 2000 area should lie.
Momenteel wordt zorgvuldig onderzocht hoe de grens van het Natura 2000-gebied precies moet komen te liggen.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over de bevalling van een koe op Schiphol

An MP asked the state secretary about a pregnant cow that gave birth during export transport at Schiphol, whether pregnant animals should be exported given Schmallenberg virus, export and inspection statistics, and whether the NVWA investigation results will be shared. The state secretary answered that the transport met the rules, that a ban on pregnant animal exports would be disproportionate, that inspection statistics are provided, and that the Chamber will be informed of the investigation results depending on whether criminal steps follow.
Depending on whether the investigation leads to criminal steps, I will inform the Chamber of the results of the investigation.
Afhankelijk van het antwoord op de vraag of het onderzoek leidt tot strafrechtelijke stappen zal ik de Kamer informeren over de resultaten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grashoff en Van Dekken over de bouw van een megastal bij Vlagtwedde

MPs Grashoff and Van Dekken asked the state secretary about a planned 1,000-cow dairy farm with 800 young cattle near Vlagtwedde, the size relative to a 300 livestock-unit ceiling, whether cows should be kept outdoors, and whether a special law would be needed to prevent such mega-farms. The secretary confirmed the plan, said spatial planning lies mainly with provinces and municipalities, and promised to set a size limit through a forthcoming bill and urge no irreversible steps before the Health Council advice.
Given this trend of large-scale development, I will intervene on the basis of the bill in preparation and set a limit.
Bij deze trend van grootschalige ontwikkeling zal ik op basis van het in voorbereiding zijnde wetsvoorstel ingrijpen en een grens stellen.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over een afschotverbod voor in het wild levende dieren in verband met de aanhoudende vorst

An MP asked the State Secretary to ban hunting of wild animals during the prolonged frost, arguing they are weakened and cannot find food, and questioned whether beheer and schadebestrijding shooting is covered by the winter hunting bans. The State Secretary answered that most animals have sufficient reserves, that the Flora- en faunawet hunting bans apply to hunting rather than management and pest control, and that provinces are better placed to decide on suspending management culls.
Incidentally, I would not have imposed a temporary general shooting ban during persistent frost.
Overigens zou ik bij aanhoudende vorst geen tijdelijk algeheel afschotverbod hebben ingesteld.
Antwoord vragen Dijkgraaf over de regio-indeling in het Pachtprijzenbesluit

An MP asked the state secretary about regional rent-price boundaries in the Pachtprijzenbesluit, which may disadvantage low-yield areas such as the Wieringermeer, and about follow-up on the Grondkamer route and boundary review. The secretary says the Grondkamer practice gives no reason for measures yet, boundary changes will only be considered if representativeness is seriously compromised, and any change requires broad support and a LEI study.
My officials hold periodic consultations with the secretariat of the (central) Grondkamer and take note of decisions concerning the application of article 7:333 of the Civil Code.

Mijn ambtenaren hebben periodiek overleg met het secretariaat van de (centrale) grondkamer en nemen kennis van beschikkingen die betrekking hebben op de toepassing van artikel 7:333 Burgerlijk Wetboek.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over de subsidiëring van onderzoek naar het eten van insecten

An MP asked the state secretary whether the government funds research and promotion of insect eating, how much it spends on this compared with plant-based protein alternatives, and whether it favours plant-based over animal protein. The state secretary answered that roughly 950,000 euros goes to insect production research and several small pilots, that protein sustainability is left largely to industry and consumers, and that he will not push the EU to shift funds away from insects.
There are no specific amounts reserved for 2012 and beyond.
Er zijn geen specifieke bedragen voor 2012 en verder gereserveerd.
Antwoord vragen Smeets en Plasterk over de berichtgeving dat MVO-beleid bij grootbanken te wensen overlaat

Two Labour MPs asked the government whether banks' corporate social responsibility reporting and investment transparency, including of state-supported banks, should be strengthened after reports of slowing progress. The state secretary answered that banks are expected to be transparent, pointed to existing benchmarks and a forthcoming EU transparency proposal, and saw no need to change current transparency requirements.
I will inform your House about the implications for Dutch CSR policy.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de implicaties voor het Nederlandse MVO-beleid.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over de onbeheersbaarheid van de populatie wilde zwijnen bij het Leenderbos door toedoen van jagers

An MP asked the state secretary whether hunters have made the wild boar population near Leenderbos uncontrollable, whether night hunting with artificial light breaches Benelux rules, and whether rivalry between hunters and farmers poses security risks, and asked about a provincial official's remark against joint hunting. The state secretary answered that the Benelux light-hunting ban does not apply to damage control for non-huntable species, that the province is responsible for management, that no armed conflict or threat exists, and that regional hunters are capable of contributing.
The province of Noord-Brabant is responsible for managing damage-causing species in the province.
Provincie Noord-Brabant is verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van schadeveroorzakende soorten in de provincie.
Antwoord vragen Smeets en Jacobi over over de berichtgeving dat het Loodswezen een miljoenenstrop lijdt vanwege de aanhoudende discussie over de ontpoldering van de Hedwigepolder

Two PvdA MPs asked whether Vlaanderen's refusal to pay the Loodswezen is linked to the Netherlands not honouring its commitment to de-embank the Hedwigepolder, and whether other projects are affected. The state secretary said the dispute is between the Loodswezen and Flanders under binding arbitration, that the minister will raise it with her Flemish counterpart, and that de-embanking the Hedwigepolder is not on the table.
It should be noted that the Dutch government is not a party to the dispute over the payments.
Daarbij zij aangetekend dat de Nederlandse overheid geen partij is in het geschil over de betalingen.
Antwoord vragen Snijder-Hazelhoff met betrekking tot de extra korting op de bedrijfstoeslag

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of an extra 2.5% cut on farm area payment rights (bedrijfstoeslag) in 2012, the total cut, planned future cuts, and how the funds for sustainable stables, precision farming and risk funds are covered. The state secretary referred to earlier letters, said the agreed 2012 cut is at most 3.2%, that the 2.5% is an advance generic cut with a later top-up cut on payments above €5,000, and that funds from discontinued welfare measures were redirected.
For answering questions 2 through 6, I refer briefly to my letter of 30 May 2011
Voor de beantwoording van de vragen 2 tot en met 6 verwijs ik kortheidshalve naar mijn brief van 30 mei 2011
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over het naleven van de afspraken over het welzijn van de grote grazers in de Oostvaardersplassen

An MP asked the state secretary whether ICMO2 recommendations on shelter, opening the Hollandse Hout forest, early-reactive culling, staffing amid budget cuts and visitor safety were being implemented for the large herbivores in the Oostvaardersplassen. The secretary said shelter walls were built and forests opened, declined to open Hollandse Hout because Lelystad council refused, denied a 20 million euro cut to Staatsbosbeheer's budget for 2012 while citing ongoing provincial financing talks, and pointed to protocols for culling and safety.
On the state of affairs of the application of early-reactive management of the large herbivores in the Oostvaardersplassen you receive a separate letter.
Over de stand van zaken van de toepassing van het vroeg-reactief beheer van de grote grazers in de Oostvaardersplassen ontvangt u separaat een brief
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het thuis ontvangen van jachtlobbyisten

An MP asked whether the minister received hunting lobby representatives at home, whether officials attend such meetings, and whether this creates an appearance of conflict of interest. The minister says he meets many civil society organisations in various settings, including sometimes at home, and that all stakeholders could comment on the nature conservation bill.
These meetings take place at the ministry, in the country, at the organisations, and sometimes also at my home.
Deze gesprekken vinden plaats op het departement, in het land, bij de organisaties en soms ook bij mij thuis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Mos en De Jong over de artikelen ‘Regeringsstad zonder internationale trein’ en ‘Hedwige-conflict kwelt Loodswezen’

PVV MPs De Mos and De Jong asked about a Telegraaf report that Belgium had not ordered the rolling stock needed for the Den Haag-Brussel HSL-Zuid agreement, about a Hedwige polder alternative, and about roughly EUR 9 million in unpaid pilotage deficits owed by Flemish authorities to the Dutch pilotage service. The minister said Belgium had pledged to implement the agreements but NMBS had not ordered the trains, that the Hedwige polder de-polderisation is no longer on the table under the June 2011 decision, and that the pilotage dispute is under binding arbitration, which she will raise with her Flemish counterpart.
In the short term I have a meeting with my Belgian colleague minister Magnette in which the implementation of these agreements will be discussed.
Op korte termijn heb ik een overleg met mijn Belgische collega minister Magnette, waarin de uitvoering van deze afspraken zal worden besproken.
Antwoord vragen Koopmans over ganzen in de motoren van een Boeing op de polderbaan

An MP asked the state secretaries about a January 2012 goose strike on a Boeing 767 approaching Schiphol's Polderbaan, the number and costs of bird strikes, prevention measures, and urgency of action. The government confirmed the incidents, listed prevention and population-control measures, and committed to pilots, a 2012 inventory and an AMvB, though CO2 use depends on pending procedures.
Furthermore, in 2012 an inventory will be made of spatial developments in the zone between 6 and 13 km.
Verder zal in 2012 een inventarisatie worden gemaakt van de ruimtelijke ontwikkelingen in de zone tussen de 6 en 13 km.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over het bericht dat een vermeende stroper die een vergoeding heeft ontvangen van de gemeente Putten

An MP asked whether a suspected poacher acquitted over a bait trap with a dead deer and bird was truly cleared on legal grounds, whether the prosecution will appeal, and whether the municipal compensation sends a wrong signal. The minister answered that the case was dismissed on a prosecution drafting error (wrong statutory basis), not a substantive finding, that no appeal will be lodged, and that the compensation covered legal costs rather than the bait use.
An error was made when drafting the summons.
Bij het opstellen van de dagvaarding is een fout gemaakt.
Antwoord vragen Slob over de Natuurbeschermingswet-vergunning en de spieringvisserij op het IJsselmeer

An MP asked the state secretary about permits for the smelt (spiering) fishery on the IJsselmeer and Markermeer, including the split between Rijk and province, the handling of the catch threshold, and pending appeals. The answers state that the smelt fishery was licensed under the Visserijwet rather than the Nb-wet, that the Markermeer permit prohibits smelt fishing because the threshold of 2100 per hectare was not met, and that the minister will revise the 2007 protocol without planning a single integrated permit.
I foresee no process to adjust the permit procedure so that there will be a single integrated permit.
Ik voorzie geen traject om de vergunningsprocedure zodanig aan te passen dat sprake zal zijn van één integrale vergunning.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand en Hazekamp over de Natuurbeschermingswet-vergunning voor de staand want visserij op het Markermeer

Two MPs asked the state secretary to respond to the province of Flevoland's permit allowing staand want fishing in the Markermeer, which kills large numbers of protected waterbirds, and whether this breaches nature protection law. The secretary answered that the province is the competent authority and judged that no significant negative effects were shown, that he sees no reason to issue a direction against the permit, and that objections can be lodged through the usual channels.
However, I see no reason to use my power to issue a direction regarding the permit granted by Flevoland.
Ik zie echter geen aanleiding gebruik te maken van mijn bevoegdheid een aanwijzing te geven ter zake van de door Flevoland verleende vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de voedseltekorten bij voedselbanken

MP Karabulut asks whether rising food shortages and waiting lists at food banks are acceptable, whether a national poverty plan is needed, and about the EU minimum-benefit scheme's status and Dutch contribution. The state secretary answers that food banks are a private initiative, that the benefits system is the proper remedy, that the Netherlands will not participate in the EU scheme, and that the Dutch share cannot be precisely determined.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Ulenbelt over de contracten van subcontractors die werken voor Post NL

Two SP MPs asked the state secretaries about a Zembla broadcast on subcontracted parcel couriers working for PostNL, including whether their contracts amount to disguised employment and whether the tax authority agreed special arrangements. The government answered that the contracts are free commercial arrangements, that employment status depends on the facts and can be tested by the Tax Authority or courts, and that it cannot disclose any Tax Authority agreements with specific taxpayers due to confidentiality rules.
However, no information can be provided about any agreements with specific taxpayers.
Over eventuele afspraken met specifieke belastingplichtigen kan echter geen informatie worden verstrekt.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers, Gesthuizen en Voordewind over kinderarbeid in de cacaoketen

MPs Dikkers, Gesthuizen and Voordewind asked the government about child labour in the cocoa chain, including the Child Labour Platform, IDH's programme links, the Harkin-Engel Protocol targets and the reliability of industry commitments. The State Secretary answered that the CLP was set up independently of IDH programmes, that child labour is integrated in certification standards, and that guarantees cannot be given, especially in Ivory Coast.
Guarantees can certainly not be given in Ivory Coast.
Zekerheden zijn zeker in Ivoorkust niet te geven.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over Europese wapenexport naar ontwikkelingslanden

An MP asked about incomplete EU arms export reporting for 2010, late submission by some member states, and whether licence refusals under criteria 2, 3 and 8 are adequately documented. The minister answered that several states do not register or pass on actual export values, the deadline was exceeded by some states, the common position sets no reporting deadline, and the Netherlands favours greater transparency in the EU.
The government cannot verify whether the value of actual exports to the Middle East and North Africa in 2010 was greater or smaller than 8.3 billion euro.
De regering kan niet nagaan of de waarde van de daadwerkelijke export naar het Midden-Oosten en Noord-Afrika in 2010 groter of kleiner dan 8,3 miljard euro was.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed, Verhoeven, Voordewind, Eijsink, Jasper van Dijk en Koppejan over het schip de Chariot dat naar verluidt munitie vervoerde met bestemming Syrië

MPs from six parties asked the foreign minister whether Cyprus, Russia and EU partners would be pressed over the ship Chariot, reportedly carrying munitions to Syria in breach of the EU arms embargo, and whether prosecution or Europol/Interpol involvement was possible. The minister confirmed the transit violates the embargo, said Nederland raised it with Cyprus in the EU, would press Russia through the EU, and said primary responsibility for action lies with the flag state and Cyprus.
Primarily it is up to the flag state (Saint Vincent and the Grenadines) or the port state (Cyprus) to take action where possible.
Het is primair aan de vlaggenstaat (Saint Vincent and the Grenadines) of de havenstaat (Cyprus) om waar mogelijk actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord vragen Van Tongeren over de uitvoering van afspraken uit het Scheldeverdrag

Rep. Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation whether he had received a letter from Flemish minister-president Peeters on implementing the Scheldt Treaty and asked him to send it to the House immediately. The state secretary confirmed receipt and said the letter was sent to the House on 20 January 2012.
Yes. I sent the letter from minister-president Peeters to your House on 20 January 2012.
Ja. De brief van minister-president Peeters heb ik op 20 januari 2012 aan uw Kamer gezonden.
Antwoord vragen Ormel over een Russische importstop vanwege het Schmallenbergvirus

An MP asks the state secretary for agriculture about Russia's import ban on goats and sheep over Schmallenberg virus, the risk of further bans, the cost to Dutch exporters, and whether other states would stop reporting outbreaks. The answers say the minister protested, wrote to Russian authorities, arranged expert talks, reports that Mexico and others acted or asked questions, and argues that countries will keep reporting because non-reporting would harm trade.
I regret the measures Russia has taken and am working to get the border reopened as quickly as possible.
Ik betreur de maatregelen die Rusland heeft genomen en zet mij er voor in om de grens zo snel mogelijk weer open te krijgen.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de ongekende droogte en de rol van de landbouw

An MP asks the minister about irreversible drought damage to nature, water allocation priorities, irrigation bans, groundwater abstraction by farms, and fire risk in dune areas. The minister answers that the water allocation order is applied by water boards and provinces, that regional bans are a decentralised decision, and that groundwater measures are being prepared in regional programmes due in 2023.
Provinces can, through a provincial regulation, establish a priority order for groundwater (article 2.9 Water Act). No province has done so yet.
De provincies kunnen, via een provinciale verordening, een verdringingsreeks voor grondwater instellen (artikel 2.9 Waterwet). Dit heeft nog geen enkele provincie gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het verbod op vleesreclames in Haarlem

An MP asked the Minister whether a Haarlem ban on meat advertising in public space is censorship and an unacceptable restriction on entrepreneurship, and whether it threatens pig farmers and shifts production abroad. The Minister replied that the ban follows a council motion, that it does not stigmatise meat eaters or restrict purchasing, that whether it is unacceptable is a matter for the courts, and that the sector would not disappear.
Whether the ban on meat advertising in Haarlem is an unacceptable infringement is not for me to answer, but possibly for the court to judge.
Vraag of het verbod op vleesreclames in Haarlem een onaanvaardbare aantasting is, is niet aan mij om te beantwoorden, maar eventueel aan de rechter om een oordeel over te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het boek 'De Melkveerevolutie, Lessen van de landbouwtransitie op Schiermonnikoog'

An MP (Boswijk, CDA) asked whether environmental and nature permits can be adjusted when farmers voluntarily shrink their herds, whether government distrust and legal risks obstruct the transition, and about exit schemes and tax barriers for farmers without successors. The minister answered that voluntary reductions can be recorded via partial withdrawal of permits, that the government is examining reintroducing a permit requirement for internal netting, and that a separate letter on fiscal obstacles will follow.
I am also examining the possibility of bringing so-called 'internal netting' back under the permit requirement.
Ik onderzoek overigens ook de mogelijkheid om het zogenoemde «intern salderen» weer onder de vergunningplicht te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Alkaya over het bericht ‘Het uitkopen van boeren is wéér een bail-out voor banken’

MPs Beckerman and Alkaya asked whether banks such as Rabobank, which hold large food and agri loans, share responsibility for the nitrogen crisis and whether buy-out schemes for farmers amount to a bail-out for banks. The minister answered that banks share a joint responsibility, that the buy-out schemes are financed from state funds and may be used to repay bank loans, and that the government will inform parliament further on expecting a non-voluntary contribution from banks.
It is not for the government to intervene in the settlement of these financial obligations between private parties.
Het is niet aan de overheid om in de afhandeling van deze financiële verplichtingen tussen private partijen te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over de schuldbekentenis van de Rabobank

MPs Thijssen and Bromet asked the ministers about the Rabobank's opposition to the nitrogen policy and whether banks and other supply-chain parties should contribute financially to the agricultural transition. The minister answered that all chain parties, including banks, have a shared responsibility, that a non-voluntary contribution is expected, that existing funds of 24 billion euro suffice, and that questions were answered separately but not before the debate.
The cabinet expects a non-voluntary contribution from supply-chain parties (banks, suppliers, processing industry and retail), as included in the coalition agreement.
Het kabinet verwacht een niet-vrijblijvende bijdrage van ketenpartijen (banken, toeleveranciers, de verwerkende industrie en de retail), zoals is opgenomen in het coalitiekakkoord.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het falen van het Nederlands aalbeheerplan

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the failure of the Dutch eel management plan, citing polls, rising adult eel catches, weak EU results and ICES advice for a full fishing stop. The minister answers that eel protection is a government task pursued mainly through strengthened EU rules, defends the current three-month closure and glass eel policy as subject to further research, and refuses a full fishing ban for now.
That is why my aim is to achieve a further strengthening of the approach at European level through amendment of the European Eel Regulation.
Om die reden is mijn inzet erop gericht om in Europees verband tot een verdere versterking van de aanpak te komen middels wijziging van de Europese Aalverordening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over de brandbrief 'saneringsregeling visserij'

An MP asks whether the fishing decommissioning scheme's condition that quotas lapse without compensation was never discussed beforehand, calls it unjust, and asks why the Dutch government supports fishers less than France or Belgium. The minister confirms the condition was not discussed to avoid insider trading in quotas, defends the scheme as necessary after Brexit, offers temporary free quota management for remaining fishers, and promises a letter on a bridging scheme.
This was chosen because a preliminary consultation on this component could lead to trading quotas with inside knowledge, which is undesirable.
Hiervoor is gekozen omdat een vooroverleg over dit onderdeel kon leiden tot handel in contingenten met voorkennis, wat ongewenst is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de ‘Geleverde streek aan vissers’

An MP asked the agriculture minister whether she knew fishers were angry about the decommissioning scheme's requirement that fishing quotas lapse, and why she was shrinking the fleet, including whether she would abandon this and honour earlier promises. The minister replied that the quota lapse is a condition of the voluntary scheme, needed because of reduced EU quotas after Brexit, that consultation with the sector took place except on this point to avoid insider trading, and that two further compensation schemes will open in 2023.
This was done because prior consultation on this part of the decommissioning scheme could lead to insider trading, which is undesirable.
Dit is gedaan omdat vooroverleg over dit onderdeel van de saneringsregeling zou kunnen leiden tot handel met voorkennis, wat ongewenst is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over ‘Het openstellen van de saneringsregeling voor de visserij’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why the fishing vessel decommissioning scheme compensates by vessel size rather than fishing rights, whether this is unfair, and why the sector was misled about the quota management system. The minister defended the size-based design as necessary given the lack of reliable quota market values and EU state-aid rules, said quota management will be developed with the sector by 2025, and gave timelines for the liquidity and standstill schemes.
I can imagine certain conditions were not foreseen. However, to prevent trading on insider knowledge, I could not share all details of the scheme in advance.
Ik kan mij voorstellen dat bepaalde voorwaarden niet waren voorzien. Om handelen met voorkennis te voorkomen, kon ik echter niet alle details van de regeling vooraf delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de Kamerbrief 'Openstelling saneringsregeling visserij'

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the fisheries decommissioning scheme, including how payments are calculated, whether it follows earlier advice, the treatment of fishing quotas and tax measures, and the need to reform the quota allocation system under the CFP. The minister answers in detail, explaining that payments are based on gross tonnage and average income loss, that the scheme responds to Brexit quota cuts, and that the quota allocation system will be revised by 2025 in consultation with the sector.
In developing this change I will exercise all necessary care and make room for consultation with the sector, experts and other stakeholders.
Ik zal bij het uitwerken van deze wijziging alle noodzakelijke zorgvuldigheid betrachten en ruimte nemen voor afstemming met de sector, deskundigen en andere belanghebbenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de uitspoeling van nitraat bij drijfmest

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about preliminary research showing lower nitrate leaching from high slurry application on drought-sensitive grassland, and why this was not used in derogation negotiations. The minister said the final report is due in autumn 2022, refused to share preliminary results with the European Commission, and noted derogation negotiations had concluded.
The interim results of the mentioned practical research were not published and had not yet gone through a scientific review process.
De tussenresultaten van het genoemde praktijkonderzoek waren niet gepubliceerd en ook nog niet door een wetenschappelijk reviewproces gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Van Esch over de vondst van plastic in veevoer, melk en vlees

MPs Vestering and Van Esch asked the ministers about microplastics found in feed, milk, meat and blood, the health risks, the 0.15% action limit for packaging residues in feed, and enforcement. The minister answered that health risks are not expected but cannot be fully excluded, that research funding is provided, and that the Dutch policy already complies with EU rules.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de voorgenomen verkoop van dolfijnen aan een Chinees pretpark, waar doflijnenshows plaatsvinden, die verboden zijn volgens de Nederlandse wet

An MP asked the minister whether dolphin shows at a Chinese park, which would be banned under Dutch rules, should stop the planned transfer of Dolfinarium animals and whether the zoo's commitments are enforceable. The minister said the transfer can only proceed if the zoo complies with welfare rules, that RVO's welfare assessment is still pending, and that dolphin presentations fall outside the legal scope, so she has no power to intervene there.

Dolphin presentations do not fall within the scope of Article 4.11. I therefore do not have the authority to intervene when animal presentations in China are not carried out in accordance with Dutch standards.

Dierpresentaties vallen niet binnen de scope van artikel 4.11. Ik heb daarom niet de bevoegdheid om in te grijpen wanneer dierpresentaties in China niet overeenkomstig de Nederlandse normen worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over dreigende stalbezettingen door extremisten

The MP asked whether the government will protect farms against extremist stable occupations, whether it will consider harsher penalties like Australia's, and whether it would follow that model. The minister answered that police contact points, a factsheet and a police operational framework exist, that current criminal provisions for trespass are adequate, and that the penalty maxima already exceed the Australian ones.
I consider the current legal possibilities to prosecute illegal stable occupations and punish them appropriately to be adequate.
De huidige juridische mogelijkheden om illegale stalbezettingen te vervolgen en passend te bestraffen acht ik toereikend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het scheurverbod in Natura 2000

An MP asked the minister about the ploughing ban in Natura 2000 areas, including agricultural parcels on the Veluwe that became subject to the ban after a Council of State ruling, and about the effect on grassland and wildlife damage. The minister acknowledged the Habitat Directive status of these parcels, noted research showing reseeding options, and committed to adjusting the approach in the national strategic plan and in consultation with the sector.
I am willing to work towards an adjustment in the implementation of GLMC9.
Ik ben bereid om met de invulling van GLMC9 tot een aanpassing te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het nieuws dat 700 varkens zijn omgekomen nadat een Nederlandse vrachtwagen met 900 varkens is gekanteld op een Duitse snelweg

An MP asked the minister about a Dutch truck carrying 900 piglets that overturned on a German motorway, killing about 700, and about the legality and welfare of such loads in extreme heat. The minister said the transport complied with EU rules, that NVWA supervised loading, and committed to pushing for stricter EU transport rules with other member states, with a Commission proposal expected next year.
Currently this transport complied with the applicable laws and regulations, and the NVWA supervised it prior to departure.
Momenteel geldt dat dit transport voldeed aan de geldende wet- en regelgeving, daar heeft de NVWA voorafgaand aan het vertrek toezicht op gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de toename van de export van varkens over lange afstanden en de dreiging van Afrikaanse varkenspest

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture about the sharp rise in long-distance exports of piglets and fattening pigs to Spain, Italy, Poland and Slovenia, and the risk of African swine fever. The Minister describes the transport conditions, attributes the increase to temporary slaughter capacity problems, and says that stopping such transports requires an EU-wide amendment of the transport regulation rather than unilateral Dutch action.
The Dutch government cannot unilaterally take measures to stop this.
De Nederlandse overheid kan niet eenzijdig maatregelen treffen om dit te stoppen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de brief ‘Stand van zaken derogatie van de Nitraatrichtlijn’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, in 24 questions, about the effects of ending the nitrate derogation on water quality, farm finances, fertiliser supply, the feasibility of the plan and the handling of the motion on the negotiations. The minister answered that the effects are uncertain and partly depend on other factors, referred to a forthcoming transition allowance and a later letter on agriculture, and promised to share correspondence with the European Commission on the negotiations once confidentiality allows.
I have not yet informed the House about this due to the confidentiality of negotiations, and will do so as soon as possible.
Ik heb de Tweede Kamer hierover in verband met de vertrouwelijkheid van onderhandelingen tot op heden nog niet geïnformeerd en zal dit zo spoedig mogelijk doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over ‘bronnen waaruit blijkt dat mogelijk ook in Nederland bloed wordt afgenomen van drachtige paarden voor de productie van Pregnant mare serum gonadotrophin (PMSG)’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether blood is taken from pregnant mares in the Netherlands for PMSG production, after Polish and Romanian authorities named the Netherlands as a supplier, and whether an investigation would follow. The minister answered that no mares are kept for PMSG in the Netherlands, the cited Dutch production site has been out of use since 2015, the NVWA has no signals of illegal practices, no investigation is planned absent signals, and the EU is being pressed to tighten animal welfare rules.
However, should signals come in, I will immediately have an investigation carried out.
Wanneer er echter wel signalen binnenkomen, zal ik daartoe onmiddellijk een onderzoek in laten stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Plas over stikstof

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Plas asked the government about internal Finance Ministry calculations showing that a 39-kton ammonia reduction target for the national rural area programme exceeds what is needed, and about the number of farms affected, withheld or unpublished modelling, and whether the targets could change. The minister answered that the calculations are unvalidated internal advice not equal to government policy, promised to share them with RIVM and to inform parliament on final figures, but declined to publish the figures now.
These are internal calculations by the Ministry of Finance with an indicative character that have not yet been scientifically validated.
Het betreffen ambtelijke berekeningen van het Ministerie van Financiën met een indicatief karakter en die nog niet wetenschappelijk zijn gevalideerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over een hitteplan voor dieren

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality what she would do to protect livestock from extreme heat, including transport limits, stocking density, outdoor shelter and waiting times at slaughterhouses.
