The minister answered that existing rules and NVWA enforcement already apply, that a generic 30-degree transport limit and a 15-minute slaughterhouse waiting limit are not legally feasible yet, and that she will await EFSA advice and facilitate talks with municipalities on shelter.
I will await this advice before making any adjustments to the policy rule.
Ik wacht dit advies af alvorens ik eventuele aanpassingen doorvoer in de beleidsregel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Boze boeren kappen uit frustratie 100 oude bomen én hangen houten koe op aan trekker'

An MP asked the Minister of Nature and Nitrogen about farmers felling about 100 old willows in protest against nitrogen policy, asking whether damage to nature should be restored and whether protest-related felling is penalised. The minister regretted the felling but said the willows were exempt from replanting duties under the Nature Conservation Act, no regional rules applied, the province saw no grounds to act, and EU subsidy recipients face cross-compliance checks with possible clawback.
I do not have that data. Apart from a few exceptions, that competence lies with the provinces.
Over die gegevens beschik ik niet. Op enkele uitzonderingen na ligt die bevoegdheid bij de provincies.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het plan van de Europese Commissie om gelijke productiestandaarden te eisen van niet EU-landen en de onmogelijkheid om dat in bestaande handelsverdragen, zoals CETA, te regele

MP Ouwehand asked whether the European Commission plans to require equal sustainability standards for food imports from non-EU countries, whether CETA prevents raising import duties or sustainability requirements, and whether farmers face unfair competition. The minister answered that the Commission's study allows autonomous measures only within WTO rules, that CETA preserves the EU's right to regulate for environmental protection but binds import tariffs, and declined to answer the question on the upcoming agricultural debate letter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie bereid is derogaties toe te staan van milieuvereisten uit het Gemeenschappelijk Landbouwbeleid (GLB)

An MP from D66 asked the agriculture minister whether the Netherlands will use EU derogations from Common Agricultural Policy environmental conditions (GLMC 7 and 8a) to protect food security, and what the expected effects on water, soil, nitrogen and nature are. The minister answered that the Netherlands will apply the derogation to ensure a level playing field and give farmers more time, that environmental ambitions remain unchanged over the full CAP period, and that no new environmental impact assessment was made.
I have decided that the Netherlands will use this derogation option to ensure a level playing field within the EU
Ik heb besloten als Nederland gebruik te maken van deze mogelijkheid tot derogatieverlening uit hoofde van het waarborgen van een gelijk speelveld binnen de EU
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het toezicht tijdens het Offerfeest

An MP asked the minister whether the government would call for vigilance against illegal unstunned animal slaughter during the Eid al-Adha festival, and about the inspection capacity and staffing for supervision at slaughterhouses. The minister confirmed the NVWA's call, supported reporting illegal slaughter, and gave detailed figures on inspectors and staff deployed across 43 slaughterhouses and the mobile teams.
Because the NVWA does not publicly disclose by name the slaughterhouses that slaughter for the Eid al-Adha festival, the requested figures were not specified further.
Omdat de NVWA de slachthuizen die ten behoeve van het Offerfeest slachten niet met naam naar buiten brengt, zijn de gevraagde cijfers niet nader gespecificeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de uitblijvende maatregelen om dieren te beschermen tegen stalbranden

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the minister why measures to protect animals from barn fires have stalled after several fires killed large numbers of animals, and whether a cap on animals per fire compartment and compartmentalisation of technical rooms will be pursued. The minister responds that a fire-compartment cap is to be worked out with other considerations, that compartmentalisation is under study by WUR with a possible shift to tailored measures, and that new rules on compartmentalisation, inspections and electrical checks are being prepared.
I do not believe that with the announced measures the barn fire dossier would be back at square one.
Ik ben niet van mening dat met de aangekondigde maatregelen het stalbrandendossier terug bij af zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Boswijk en Van Campen over ‘werkbezoeken aan de grensregio in het kader van stikstof en de aangenomen motie over verschillen aan de grens’

Omtzigt, Boswijk and Van Campen ask about nitrogen-related management and differing rules at the German border, including Natura 2000 areas, cross-border cooperation, monitoring, and planned visits to border farms. The minister answers that cooperation with Germany works well, that the KDW is exceeded in some habitats due to foreign deposition, that cross-border management is being coordinated, and that she will visit three border locations on 22 August while withholding exact locations for security reasons.
In light of all the unrest, during the preparation of working visits, on the advice of the security services (police and the ministry's security service), we do not make the exact locations public.

In het licht van alle onrust maken we tijdens de voorbereiding van werkbezoeken, op advies van de veiligheidsdiensten (politie en beveiligingsdienst binnen het ministerie), de exacte locaties niet openbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Plas over berekeningen over stikstof van het Ministerie van Financiën, die een totaal ander beeld op de stikstofproblematiek werpen en over de bemiddelingspoging van dhr

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Plas asked the government about unpublished Ministry of Finance nitrogen calculations showing smaller agricultural reductions needed if climate targets are met, and why these were not shared with parliament, plus the role of mediator Remkes and the basis of the NPLG targets. The government answered that the calculations are unvalidated, indicative internal advice, that they were shared with LNV and interdepartmentally and later published, and that targets will be adjusted as new projections (KEV 2022) come in.
The cabinet considers publishing unvalidated calculations that are still part of policy preparation not in the interest of good and democratic governance.
Het kabinet acht het openbaar maken van niet-gevalideerde berekeningen die nog onderdeel zijn van de beleidsvoorbereiding niet in het belang van goede en democratische bestuursvoering.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het Toeslagenschandaal op het gebied van hardhe

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked which measures the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality has taken following the childcare benefits scandal regarding harsh consequences of laws and the handling of information. The minister responded that departments are conducting inventories of harsh regulations under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, that research reports and timelines were or will be shared, and described the chat-message retention policy and pending Wob/Woo request figures.
To implement the Ploumen/Jetten motion, every department is carrying out an inventory of laws and regulations that have harsh effects on people.
1 , 2 , 3 Antwoord 1 Ter uitvoering van de motie Ploumen/Jetten 4 verricht elk departement een inventarisatie naar wet- en regelgeving die hardvochtig uitpakt voor mensen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over de Afrikaanse varkenspest naar aanleiding van het bericht 'Zorgen over uitbraak varkenspest pal over de grens in Duitsland'

MPs Thijssen and Bromet asked the minister about African swine fever near the German border, including risk assessment, transport restrictions, prevention measures, preventive culling, a breeding ban, a 1 km farm distance rule and NVWA capacity. The minister said the risk is real, that the expert group reassessed the risk, that transport risk is small but measures are in place, and that a breeding ban is disproportionate for now, while answering most questions substantively and committing to updates.
I expect to provide an update in the short term on the results of the actions carried out over the past two years within this framework, and I will inform the House of Representatives about this.
Ik verwacht op korte termijn een update te geven van de resultaten van de acties die de afgelopen twee jaar in het kader hiervan zijn uitgevoerd en ik zal de Tweede Kamer hierover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Bromet en Kröger over het bericht dat Nederland geen gezonde leefomgeving biedt aan kinderen

MPs Bouchallikh, Bromet and Kröger asked the government about a UNICEF report finding that the Netherlands does not offer children a healthy living environment, covering air pollution, energy poverty, breakfast, noise, lead, pesticides and damp/mould. The government replied that the situation is not 'very worrying' but that there are attention points, pointed to the forthcoming National Environmental Programme, the Clean Air Agreement, energy allowances, lead-pipe measures and a broad mould-prevention approach, and promised to answer each question individually.
For that reason I would not call the situation in the Netherlands very worrying, although there are certainly points of attention that the Netherlands wants to address.
Om die reden zou ik de situatie in Nederland niet zeer zorgelijk willen noemen, al zijn er zeker aandachtspunten waar Nederland een been bij wil trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Wassenberg inzake het gebruik van dieren als actiemiddel bij boerendemonstraties

An MP asked whether farmers bringing cows to a demonstration caused animal stress, whether it is permitted to use animals as protest tools, and what powers exist to prevent this. The ministers acknowledged possible stress but said animal welfare rules were met after a police check, found no general ban on using animals in demonstrations, called it undesirable, and pointed to existing legal powers of mayors.
There is no prohibition on using animals as a protest tool at a demonstration.
Er is geen verbod op het inzetten van dieren als actiemiddel bij een demonstratie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de opvang van honden uit Oekraïne

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why Ukrainian dogs without owners face a four-month quarantine at an external site, why Poland applies different rules, and why NVWA charges high costs to owners. The Minister answers that these dogs fall under EU rabies import rules for a high-risk country, that the rules apply uniformly and Poland applies the same rules, that costs follow EU and Dutch law with limited exceptions, and that NVWA prioritises the rabies risk.
Naturally the NVWA has implemented this ruling, and these animals have been returned to their owner to stay in home quarantine there.
Vanzelfsprekend heeft de NVWA uitvoering gegeven aan deze uitspraak, en deze dieren zijn terug bij de eigenaar om daar in thuisquarantaine te verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht dat er wetenschappelijke tekortkomingen zitten aan de beoordeling dat glyfosaat niet potentieel kankerverwekkend is

MP Tjeerd de Groot asked the minister whether EU regulators wrongly dismissed animal-study evidence linking glyphosate to cancer, whether the Dutch AGG member should explain this, and whether the 2015 IARC conclusion is supported by newer studies, and asked how the precautionary principle applies. The minister replied that the AGG and ECHA's RAC kept the existing hazard classification, did not classify glyphosate as carcinogenic, will publish a detailed RAC opinion in August 2022 explaining the animal-study assessment, and will send it to parliament.
I will send this to your House.
Ik zal uw Kamer deze doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de bemiddelaar in het stikstofdossier en de juridische status van de stikstofplannen

Omtzigt asked the government about the nitrogen (stikstof) targets, whether the 74% reduction by 2030 in the coalition agreement is in law (current law sets 50% by 2030), the legal status of provincial measures, and whether the mediator Remkes is independent, asking for advice and consultation before the process starts. Minister Staghouwer replied that the 50% legal target stands until a bill to move the 74% target to 2030 passes, that provinces have discretion but the national target is a result obligation, and that the planned bill will go through the standard consultation, Council of State advice and financial checks.
The bill is expected to be submitted to the House of Representatives in the first half of 2023.
Het benodigde wetsvoorstel zal naar verwachting in de eerste helft van 2023 bij de Tweede Kamer worden ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over fijnstof en stankoverlast

MPs Thijssen and Bromet asked about odour and particulate nuisance from livestock farms, including enforcement gaps, combi-scrubber performance, permit practice and recovery of subsidies. The Staatssecretaris acknowledged the problem and pointed to area-based approaches, WUR research on chemical odour measurement and an e-learning module, but largely deferred permit and enforcement questions to municipalities and provinces and declined to give farm-level data citing GDPR.
Due to the General Data Protection Regulation, the data on agricultural businesses from the top 100 ammonia sources were supplied anonymised by the RIVM.
In verband met de Algemene verordening persoonsgegevens zijn de gegevens van de agrarische bedrijven uit de top100 ammoniakbronnen geanonimiseerd aangeleverd door het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'De Urker vloot 'verdrinkt en niemand helpt ons''

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality how fishing is faring under high fuel prices, what support is given, and why state aid schemes and a fuel supplement have been delayed. The minister acknowledged the situation, said no specific support measures exist beyond general measures, and explained that the decommissioning scheme awaits European Commission approval while a bridging scheme is being prepared.
I am making every effort to be able to open the decommissioning scheme shortly after the summer.
Ik span mij ervoor in om de saneringsregeling kort na de zomer te kunnen openstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het massaal vergassen van kippen, eenden en kalkoenen vanwege uitbraken van het vogelgriepvirus

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture about mass gassing of poultry during avian flu outbreaks, including welfare, supervision, compensation and whether gassing should be a last resort. The Minister defends CO2 gassing as the best available method, describes NVWA and welfare commission oversight, gives cost and compensation figures, and says a vaccination pilot and biosecurity are being pursued.
The Animal Diseases Welfare Committee oversees the entire process and can intervene and advise on-site where there is reason to do so.
De Welzijnscommissie Dierziekten ziet toe op het hele proces en kan ter plekke interveniëren en adviseren als daar aanleiding voor is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de juridische status van het Nationaal Programma Landelijk Gebied (NPLG), het feit dat de reductiedoelen daarin nu hoger zijn dan de reductiedoelen in de wetgeving en de juridi

Mr. Omtzigt asked the ministers whether the NPLG nitrogen reduction targets are binding, why they exceed the Wet natuurbescherming target of 50% by 2030, and whether a 74% target by 2030 has a legal basis. The minister replied that the regional targets are indicative until the area programmes are set on 1 July 2023, that the Wsn-based outcome obligation is being accelerated from 2035 to 2030 via a bill expected in the first half of 2023, and that Parliament will assess feasibility through that bill.
It is for the House of Representatives and the Senate to assess whether the acceleration of the reduction targets must be laid down in law.
Het is aan de Tweede en Eerste Kamer om te beoordelen of de versnelling van de reductiedoelen bij wet moet worden vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de nieuwe vogelgriepuitbraak in de Gelderse Vallei en het feit dat dit ‘seizoen’ een vijfde van alle eenden in de eendenhouderij is vergast

An MP asks the Ministers of Agriculture and of Health about repeated avian influenza outbreaks in the Gelderse Vallei, the culling of about a fifth of duck flocks this season, and lack of vaccination and density reduction. The government answers that outbreaks are being controlled through culling, vaccine trials and biosecurity, that it cannot yet give a percentage and no sector ban is planned, and that it apologises for missing the deadline.
Recently I have instructed that a trial be started with various bird flu vaccines to examine their effectiveness.
Onlangs heb ik opdracht gegeven een proef te starten met verschillende vogelgriepvaccins om hun werking te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bromet over het bericht 'Is de vezelhennepteelt ten dode opgeschreven?'

MPs Boswijk and Bromet asked whether the greening subsidy of 150 euro per hectare would end in 2023, what this means for farmers, and what the new nitrate rules mean for hemp and sustainable crops. The minister answers that the greening payment lapses at EU level and is replaced by the eco-scheme, with hemp cultivation counting as one of 21 eco-activities, and that the ecoregeling and the autumn cover-crop rules are still being developed.
The greening premium will lapse at European level in the new CAP period from January 2023.
De vergroeningspremie komt op Europees niveau te vervallen in de nieuwe GLB-periode vanaf januari 2023
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het feit dat boeren bang zijn dat koeien niet meer buiten mogen zonder vergunning

Van Haga asked whether the government will prevent a permit requirement for grazing cows and fertilising land, which farmers fear under nitrogen policy. The minister replied that by agreement with provinces most grazing and manuring need no permit, that a Council of State appeal on this is pending, and that if the ruling goes against the government it will seek ways to keep grazing permit-free.

If the Council of State's Administrative Jurisdiction Division agrees with the district courts' judgment, we will work with the provinces to find ways to ensure farmers can graze their animals without an additional permit.

Indien de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State meegaat in het oordeel van de rechtbanken, zullen wij samen met provincies zoeken naar mogelijkheden om te borgen dat agrariërs hun dieren zonder aanvullende vergunning kunnen laten weiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Van der Molen over het bericht 'Droogte: natuur voortaan belangrijker dan landbouw'

MPs Boswijk and Van der Molen asked whether farmers in the Peel area must now apply for permits to irrigate fields, after a court annulled the irrigation exemption in the Natura 2000 buffer zone, and about consequences for food security, costs and transition periods. The minister confirmed the exemption was removed, that individual permit applications remain possible, a two-year transition period is planned with an intention agreement, and that responsibility for crop choices and risk lies with farmers.

The court annulled the exemption from the permit requirement for irrigating open crops in the buffer zone around these Natura 2000 areas, included in the management plan because of periodically occurring extremely dry conditions.

De rechter heeft de in het Natura 2000-beheerplan Groote Peel, Deurnsche Peel en Mariapeel opgenomen vrijstelling van vergunningsplicht voor het beregenen van open teelten in de bufferzone rondom deze Natura 2000 gebieden i.v.m. periodiek optredende extreem droge omstandigheden vernietigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Ministerie negeerde ‘desa-streus' stikstofadvies zodat bouwprojecten gewoon door konden gaan'

An MP asked whether the Infrastructure Ministry overrode an advisory committee's recommendations on nitrogen calculation so that infrastructure permits could proceed, and whether the sectors were disadvantaged. The minister denies this, saying the committee's recommendations were taken up, including a uniform 25 km calculation radius for all emission sources, and that AERIUS remains the best available tool.

That is not correct. In cooperation with the departments concerned, other competent bodies and knowledge institutions, under the coordination of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, it was examined how the advice of the Advisory Committee could be followed up.

Dat klopt niet. In samenwerking met de betrokken departementen, andere bevoegde instanties en kennisinstellingen is onder coördinatie van het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit onderzocht hoe opvolging gegeven kon worden aan de adviezen van het Adviescollege.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over de VN-conferentie over de VN-conferentie over het wereldzeeënverdrag

MPs Wassenberg and Teunissen asked whether slow BBNJ treaty negotiations threaten the 30% ocean protection target, and about Dutch positions on MPAs, RFMOs, EIA thresholds, and genetic resources. The minister answered that negotiations are complex and ongoing, that the Netherlands seeks an ambitious outcome coordinated within the EU, and that no final decisions have been taken, while declining to commit to specific positions beyond general ambitions.
The process must ultimately lead to adoption of the treaty text by the UN General Assembly.
Het proces moet uiteindelijk leiden tot vaststelling van de verdragstekst door de AVVN.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Vestering over de ‘ongekende droogte’

MPs Van Esch and Vestering asked the government about the 2022 drought, groundwater abstraction, illegal wells, enforcement, the water tax and compensation claims. The minister answered most questions substantively, pointing to existing measures, a ongoing review of the water tax, and declining to judge a pending collective claim.
I therefore refrain from giving a judgment on that.
Ik onthoud mij daarom van een oordeel daarover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Minister: 'Rode diesel keert niet terug'

Two MPs asked whether the government will reinstate red diesel for farmers, given that Belgium and Germany offer farmers cheaper fuel and that Dutch farmers face heavy regulation. The minister refused to reinstate red diesel, pointing to the temporary fuel excise cut and EU crisis reserve funds, and gave no separate scheme for farmers.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Nee, daartoe ben ik niet bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het openbaar maken van boetes

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why the NVWA publishes fines for animal transport without distinguishing cases that are still under appeal, overturned by a court, or dropped, and whether such cases count toward stricter supervision and cumulative fines. The Minister answered that the documents are published as they exist under the Wet open overheid, that disputed fines stay in the file but are refunded if overturned, and that contested or annulled violations do not count toward recidivism or enhanced supervision.
If a judge upholds an appeal against a previously imposed fine, that fine is not removed from the file.
Als een rechter het beroep tegen een eerder opgelegde boete gegrond verklaart, wordt deze boete niet uit het dossier geschrapt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over besmettelijke dierziekten naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Varkens in Nood slaat alarm: Nederland niet klaar voor Afrikaanse varkenspest’

MPs Thijssen and Bromet asked the Minister of Agriculture about Dutch preparedness for African swine fever, including animal transports, the contingency plan dating from 2013, the NVWA's capacity, minimum distances and areas between pig farms, and vaccine funding. The minister acknowledged the risk, pointed to existing preventive measures, the roadmap and EU rules, and rejected a breeding ban and a 1 km minimum distance as disproportionate for now, promising further action within the area-based approach.
I share the author's concern that an outbreak of African swine fever (ASF) could occur in the Netherlands.
Ik deel de zorgen van de auteur dat zich een uitbraak van Afrikaanse varkenspest (AVP) kan voordoen in Nederland.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over 'Wijziging van de Wet verbod pelsdierhouderij in verband met een vervroegde beëindiging van de pelsdierhouderij' van 22 november 2021 en eerdere toezeggingen aan de sector

An MP asked the Minister why pension compensation for older fur farmers under the Fur Farming Ban has not yet been clarified, and when applications can be submitted. The Minister confirmed the compensation framework, said the complex individual assessment and an external adviser delay matters, and expected information from summer with applications possible from Q4.
Fur farmers are expected to be informed about the further arrangement of the pension provision from the summer.
Naar verwachting zullen pelsdierhouders vanaf de zomer geïnformeerd worden over de verdere invulling van de pensioenvoorziening.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over 'emissies naar lucht uit de landbouw berekend met NEMA voor 1990-2019' van Van Bruggen e.a. en de uitspraak van de rechtbank Oost-Brabant inzake emissiearme stallen van 8

An MP asked about the NEMA agricultural emissions model used for reporting, emission-low stall effectiveness, the ruling of the Oost-Brabant court, and the RAV list. The ministers replied that the NEMA model is used for reporting and deposition inputs, that low-emission floors are treated as equal to conventional ones due to lower practical performance, and that innovation and real-time measurement are being pursued.
I am aware of the ruling of the Oost-Brabant court.
Ik ben bekend met de uitspraak van de rechtbank Oost-Brabant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over 'de noodzaak om de vraag naar veevoer terug te dringen nu hongersnood dreigt'

MP Ouwehand asked the minister of Agriculture about reducing feed demand from livestock farming amid famine risk from the war in Ukraine, including feed hoarding, slaughter of animals, and food versus feed land use. The minister answered that there is no current food security problem, urged farmers not to hoard feed, rejected a breeding ban as lacking legal basis, and only referred to existing protein and biofuel policies.
The legislation provides no power to impose a breeding ban in the interest of food security.
De wetgeving biedt geen bevoegdheid om in het belang van voedselzekerheid een fokverbod in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het nieuwe onderzoek naar gezondheidsrisico’s van landbouwgif

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about a new study on health risks of pesticides for farmers and residents, including RIVM findings on respiratory disease, Parkinson's, eye irritation, leukaemia, pesticide residues in homes and urine, and the Health Council's advice on the precautionary principle and stricter approval. The minister confirms the coalition agreement commits to health research, says the RIVM advice is delayed so the research agenda will follow after the summer recess, and says a pesticide phase-out target will be pursued but full phase-out is not foreseen.
This advice has unfortunately been delayed, so I will send this agenda to your House after the summer recess.
Dit advies is helaas vertraagd, waardoor ik uw Kamer deze agenda na het zomerreces zal doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het uitkopen van boeren in Gelderland

An MP asked the ministers whether the buyout of farmers for the A15 road project in Gelderland went against the province's wishes, and questioned the informal style and 'surprise' tactics used by the minister and deputy. The government answered that the buyouts were voluntary, agreed within existing province-state policy frameworks, and that the minister acknowledged the 'overvallen' wording was sharp but had not informed officials in advance of a commitment made in talks with provincial deputies.
The Minister had not informed her officials in advance that she wanted to make this commitment, and the officials only heard of it after the administrative agreement had been made.
De Minister had van tevoren niet gemeld aan haar ambtenaren dat ze deze toezegging wilde doen en de ambtenaren hoorden dit nadat deze bestuurlijke afspraak was gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bisschop over het bericht 'Geen staatssteun voor bedrijven die worstelen met hoge energieprijzen'

MPs Boswijk and Bisschop asked the agriculture minister whether the cutter fishing sector is hit hard by high energy prices, why the Netherlands does not use the EU temporary state-aid option for firms hit by Russia sanctions, and whether a COVID-style idle-vessel scheme can be reinstated. The minister confirmed the problem, declined the broader EU state-aid framework and the idle scheme (citing EMFAF rules and innovation priorities), pointed to existing support instruments, and promised an impact study and structural innovation and decommissioning measures.
At my request, Wageningen Economic Research is mapping the short-term economic effects of the war in Ukraine on the fishing sector.
Wageningen Economic Research brengt op mijn verzoek de economische effecten op korte termijn in beeld van de gevolgen van de oorlog in Oekraïne voor de visserij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over dreigende olietekorten en compensatie voor visserij

An MP asks the ministers whether a diesel and oil shortage linked to Russian oil sanctions threatens sectors such as fishing, and whether compensation for fishers should be paid and the pulse-fishing ban reconsidered. The government answers that it has released diesel from strategic stocks, will not compensate businesses for high energy prices, and sees no reason to revisit the decision.
The cabinet's position is that compensation of businesses for high energy and fuel prices resulting from the war in Ukraine is not on the table.
Het kabinetsstandpunt is dat compensatie van bedrijven vanwege hoge energie- en brandstofprijzen als gevolg van de oorlog in Oekraïne niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de hongersnood in Sri Lanka

MP Van der Plas asks the government about Sri Lanka's forced shift to organic farming, Dutch knowledge-sharing, possible lessons for Dutch policy, and lobby influence on fertiliser and pesticide policy. The minister answers that the Netherlands raised concerns with Sri Lanka, offered knowledge exchange and webinars, sees no lessons warranting a study, and states the government's own pesticide transition strategy.
To begin with, it is of course up to a country itself to make its own policy choices.
Vooropgesteld is het uiteraard aan een land zelf om de eigen beleidskeuzes te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de bescherming van wilde bijen in het bijenrichtsnoer

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether wild bees and bumblebees are protected under pesticide authorisation rules, and questions the 10% bee mortality threshold, the field studies behind it, and the use of control fields. The Minister replies that wild bees are protected under the existing EFSA-based framework, that a new bee guidance with a 7% mortality standard will be pursued, and that the requested study details are in the EFSA background document previously sent to parliament.
I have asked the Ctgb for advice on this as usual and informed your House of my position on 16 May 2022.
Ik heb het Ctgb zoals gebruikelijk hierop om advies gevraagd en heb uw Kamer over mijn positie geïnformeerd op 16 mei 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Vestering over het nieuws dat kalverhouders in de afgelopen maanden veel meer kalfjes hebben geïmporteerd uit Ierland

Two MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture whether the sharp rise in Irish calf imports, involving long transports of very young animals, was acceptable and what steps were being taken. The minister said the transports are concerning, the sector has targets to reduce long transports, and the minister supports a ban on long-distance transport of unweaned calves in the EU transport regulation review while awaiting an EFSA opinion.
My position for the upcoming revision of the European transport regulation is a ban on long-distance transport of unweaned animals, such as young calves but also goat and sheep lambs.

Mijn inzet voor de aanstaande herziening van de Europese transportverordening is een verbod op langeafstandtransporten van ongespeende dieren, zoals jonge kalveren maar ook geiten- en schapenlammeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over het bericht 'Levend koken van varkens in slachthuizen gaat nog altijd door'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about a report that pigs are still alive when entering scalding tanks in Dutch slaughterhouses, and about enforcement failures, the coalition agreement, camera supervision and independent investigation. The Minister called such cases unacceptable, said slaughterhouses must take more responsibility, and promised a camera-monitoring bill, though it is delayed to spring 2023 and no external investigation will be commissioned.
I see no added value in commissioning a new external investigation in response to the inspection results.
Ik zie geen meerwaarde om naar aanleiding van de inspectieresultaten een nieuw extern onderzoek te laten uitvoeren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de zoveelste berichtgeving over ernstig onnodig en vermijdbaar lijden van dieren in Nederlandse slachthuizen en het nog altijd uitblijven van maatregelen

An MP from the Partij voor de Dieren asked the Minister of Agriculture about repeated reports of severe, avoidable animal suffering in slaughterhouses, NVWA inspection shortcomings, camera surveillance evidence, and the delayed slaughter-speed study. The Minister called the situations unacceptable, acknowledged that misconduct also occurs under permanent NVWA supervision, pointed to strengthened oversight and a delayed study, and gave the results in an earlier letter.
Looking back, an additional measure such as shutting down the line would have been appropriate.
Terugkijkend zou een aanvullende maatregel zoals de stillegging van de band passend zijn geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Van Campen over het bericht 'Levend koken van varkens in slachthuizen gaat nog altijd door'

MPs De Groot and Van Campen asked the minister about reports that pigs were still being scalded alive in slaughterhouses, repeat violations, sanctions, late reporting, camera surveillance and the Beter Leven label. The minister answered that repeat cases were handled with maatwerk interventions and fines, promised a verscherpt toezicht procedure and a camera-surveillance bill, but declined to lower slaughter speeds generically and left the label question to private bodies.
The report the questioners refer to concerns information the NVWA made public following a Wob request.
Het bericht waarop de vragenstellers doelen, ziet op informatie die de NVWA heeft openbaargemaakt op grond van een Wob-verzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over het bericht 'Voedselmakers zoeken met spoed alternatief voor zonnebloemolie'

MP Thijssen asked the Minister of Agriculture about reports of a sunflower oil shortage, the sustainability of substitute oils such as palm and rapeseed oil, certification reliability, and price effects. The minister said substitution is possible but prices will rise, the NVWA will temporarily not enforce label accuracy, and the government supports the EU deforestation-free products regulation while relying on industry to supply sustainable oils.
I therefore support the Commission's proposal that only deforestation-free products may be placed on the EU market.
Ik steun daarom het voorstel van de Commissie dat uitsluitend Ontbossingsvrije producten op de EU-markt mogen worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de overlast die wordt veroorzaakt door de aanwezigheid van de Amerikaanse rivierkreeft

An MP from the CDA asked the minister about damage caused by the American crayfish, its spread, the Water Framework Directive, a possible dike failure at Reeuwijk, and why only professional fishers may catch crayfish. The minister acknowledged the problems, said the financial damage cannot yet be quantified, noted the Reeuwijk investigation is ongoing, and explained that professional fishing gear is restricted for conservation reasons while a new crayfish-specific trap is being explored.
At present the investigation into the possible cause of the dike slide is still ongoing.
Op dit moment is het onderzoek naar de mogelijke oorzaak van de dijkafschuiving nog in uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar, Grinwis en Boswijk over het bericht 'Hoge gasprijzen dwingen vier van de tien glastuinders definitief of tijdelijk te stoppen'

MPs Valstar, Grinwis and Boswijk asked the ministers for Climate and Energy and for Agriculture about reports that high gas prices may force many greenhouse growers to stop, and about job losses, timelines for switching to sustainable heat, and support. The ministers acknowledge the sector's serious concerns and possible bankruptcies, say sustainability transitions take time, but refuse to compensate high gas prices and promise a letter at the end of April.
We cannot rule out that companies will go bankrupt.
Tegelijk kunnen wij niet uitsluiten dat er bedrijven failliet zullen gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bevers over “kleinschalig historisch medegebruik op Ameland”

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about restrictions on small-scale historical use (recreational stake-net fishing, bait and shellfish gathering) on Ameland and other Wadden islands, including the 2016 Natura 2000 management plan exception. The minister answered that recreational stake-net fishing remains permitted under existing rules with prior municipal notification, that EU rules banning retention of bycaught sea bass cannot be exempted nationally, and that the Natura 2000 plan's wording still applies.
As regards the Natura 2000 management plan, no further restrictions have come into effect.
Wat betreft het Natura 2000-beheerplan zijn er niet meer beperkingen gaan gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Van Campen over het bericht 'waanzinnige regels dreigen garnalenvisser Eddy Sinke de nek om te draaien'

MPs Valstar and Van Campen (VVD) asked the ministers of Agriculture and of Nature and Nitrogen about shrimp fishers facing new Nature Conservation Act permit requirements by 1 January 2023, including nitrogen rules, unclear assessment methods, monitoring of engine hours, and the absence of a phased path to compliance. The ministers answered that the sector must apply for permits itself with LNV support, that the 1 January 2023 date will not be moved, that provinces are not parties, and that a subsidy scheme and a fisheries vision are being developed.
I am therefore not willing to make an exception for the fishers regarding the date of the new nature permit.
Ik ben dan ook niet bereid een uitzondering te maken voor de vissers als het gaat om de datum van de nieuwe natuurvergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de verdeling van de marges in de zuivelsector

An MP asked the minister whether dairy price noteringen rising sharply (butter, skimmed milk powder) are passed on only partly to farmers' raw milk prices, and what should be done about margin distribution. The minister replied that the two are not directly comparable, the raw milk price follows the market with a lag and is set by private firms, and that existing measures (Agro-Nutri Monitor, ban on unfair trading practices, Geschillencommissie) apply, with agreements with chain parties planned.
Nevertheless, it is of great importance that there are no structural problems with price formation, and that unfair trading practices in the chain are countered.
Niettemin vind het wel van groot belang dat er geen structurele problemen zijn met de prijsvorming, en dat oneerlijke handelspraktijken in de keten worden tegengaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het vernietigen van de exportvergunning van een dolfijn aan een Chinees pretpark

An MP asked the minister, after a court ruling annulled the export permit for an American dolphin sold to a Chinese amusement park, whether the remaining dolphins may still be sold there and whether dolphinariums are commercial. The minister answered that the ruling does not block new CITES permits for the other nine animals, which are under review, that welfare checks under the Animal Keepers Decree are ongoing, and that zoos can be non-commercial without being defined as such.
The court ruling gives no reason not to issue a new CITES export permit for the other nine animals, since the previous ones have expired.
De uitspraak van de rechtbank geeft geen aanleiding om ten aanzien van de andere negen dieren niet opnieuw een CITES-exportvergunning te verlenen, nu de vorige verlopen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Van Campen over het bericht 'Schoon water is in Nederland nog ver weg'

MPs Minhas and Van Campen (VVD) asked the ministers about a news report that clean water is far off in the Netherlands, including the EU Water Framework Directive risks for 2027. Minister Harbers answered that the water quality picture is complex, that most chemical norms are met but biological and nutrient norms lag, and that further measures and possible use of exemptions are planned.
I do not share the view that water quality is not good in all respects.
Het beeld dat de waterkwaliteit op alle onderdelen niet goed is, deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over misbruik van coronasteun door Berts Animal Verhuur

Two MPs asked whether the government would reclaim NOW wage subsidy paid to an animal rental company that used it for building work, and how enforcement by the NVWA and municipalities failed despite repeated complaints since 1998. The minister said NOW subsidy is adjusted only if wage sums fell, that building and dog-keeping limits are municipal matters, and that the NVWA has acted regularly and the company is now under intensified supervision.
For information on building works that may conflict with the zoning plan or other building permits, I refer you to the municipality of West Maas en Waal.
Voor informatie over bouwwerken die eventueel strijdig zijn met het bestemmingsplan of andere bouwvergunningen verwijs ik u naar gemeente West Maas en Waal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht 'Olie, gas, graan en geld - Oekraïne laat zien hoe de wereld werkt'

An MP from BBB asked ministers in 19 numbered questions about the effects of the war in Ukraine on food supply, input prices, farm viability and the EU's dependence on imports, and whether the Green Deal transition should be postponed. The minister answered mostly on substance, noting no structural food shortage is expected in the EU, commitments to monitor and share a Wageningen study, and rejected postponing the sustainability transition.
I monitor the situation closely and am also in close contact with the European Commission and the agriculture ministers of the EU member states on this.
Ik monitor de situatie nauwlettend en heb hieromtrent ook nauw contact met de Europese Commissie en de landbouwministers van de EU-lidstaten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht “de overeenkomst van het ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit met de Stichting Duurzame Palingsector Nederland (DUPAN) voor het uitzetten van jong

An MP asks the minister why the ministry contracted DUPAN to release glass eels caught elsewhere in Europe, despite ICES advice that stocking is harmful, and whether it helps the eel population. The minister answers that the net benefit of stocking is unknown, more research is needed, stocking is a permitted EU management measure, and it is meant to support long-term eel recovery.
At European level I also press for more research.
In Europees verband dring ik ook aan op meer onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de verkoop van voormalige circusolifant Buba aan een circuspark in Hongarije

An MP asked the minister whether elephant Buba was being transferred to Kimba Elefant Park in Hungary and about related permits, animal treatment and the French sanctuary option. The minister said the transfer was reported in the media but unverified, that CITES and health certificates are needed, that Buba should not be used for performances, and that the government regrets the outcome, which followed parliamentary motions to keep Buba with her owner.
I am not happy with this turn of events, as it has gone differently than my predecessor and I had envisioned for elephant Buba.
Ik ben niet gelukkig met deze gang van zaken, aangezien het anders is gelopen dan mijn voorganger en ik voor ogen hadden voor olifant Buba.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Graus over het artikel 'Luxemburgers kijken naar Delfzijl voor industriële houtzagerij: investering van meer dan 1 miljoen'

PVV MPs Graus and Mulder asked whether Staatsbosbeheer's planned supply of roundwood to a new large Delfzijl sawmill (linked to Wood Trading & Technologies/IBV) would distort competition and squeeze smaller Dutch sawmills, contrary to a motion they had passed. The minister replied that Staatsbosbeheer operates within the Market and Government Act, that only a limited volume is reserved and smaller mills keep access, and that she will talk with Staatsbosbeheer about additional measures but sees no reason for a large-scale investigation.
I am therefore of the view that the current regulations provide sufficient frameworks.
Ik ben derhalve van mening dat met de huidige regelgeving voldoende kaders zijn meegegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over problemen in de glastuinbouwsector als gevolg van de aanhoudend hoge energieprijzen

Two CDA MPs asked ministers about financial distress in greenhouse horticulture caused by high energy prices, including SDE++ subsidies falling with gas prices and possible project shutdowns. The ministers acknowledged the problems, said they are in talks with the sector and banks, explained the SDE++ design, declined to intervene in the subsidy scheme, and promised a letter to parliament in April.
We have no information that would allow us to assess how many projects this concerns.
Wij hebben geen informatie waardoor wij kunnen beoordelen om hoeveel projecten dit gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over de zogenaamde “vleespropaganda” van de Europese Unie (EU)

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture whether EU-cofinanced meat promotion campaigns, criticised in a TV segment, conflict with climate and healthy-diet goals and whether national taxpayer money funds them. The minister replies that the campaigns are EU-financed (80%, with the rest paid by producer organisations), that no national money is involved, and that the Netherlands is lobbying in the EU review to exclude meat from promotion funding.
It is up to the organiser of the relevant subsidised EU promotion programme to decide whether to buy airtime for the product.
Het is aan de organisator van het betreffende gesubsidieerde EU-promotieprogramma om voor het product al dan niet zendtijd in te kopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over het toekennen van een groot bedrag aan NOW-steun aan een meermaals veroordeeld bedrijf, dat weigert dwangsommen te betalen

Two MPs asked why a company that rents out animals, has repeated court-imposed penalties and enforcement history, received about 170,000 euro in NOW wage subsidy and remains an approved training company. The ministers answered that the NOW scheme does not test animal welfare, that subsidy amounts are advances pending final settlement, and that SBB and the NVWA are monitoring the company.
Animal welfare is not part of these conditions.
Dierenwelzijn is geen onderdeel van deze voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de toename van landbouwgifcocktails op voedsel en op insecten, waaronder bijen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about rising pesticide residue cocktails on Dutch food and insects, including bees. The minister disputed the PAN-Nederland findings as based on an unrepresentative sample, stated that cumulative exposure poses no health risk for now, and said a safety factor for pesticide approval is being pursued at EU level without committing to a national maximum on the number of residues.
I cannot confirm that. The NVWA supervises the maximum permitted residue levels (MRLs) on food; the average number of pesticide residues is not part of that.
Dat kan ik niet bevestigen. De NVWA houdt toezicht op de maximaal toegestane residuen (MRL's) op voedsel, het gemiddeld aantal residuen van bestrijdingsmiddelen is daar geen onderdeel van.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Michon-Derksen over activiteiten van radicaal extremistische dierenactivisten

MPs Van Campen and Michon-Derkzen asked about criminal activities by radical animal-rights extremists (stable occupations, break-ins, arson, smear campaigns, online intimidation), overview of cases and sentences, enforcement roles, legal basis and disclosure of farm data. The minister said no overview is available since there is no specific classification for animal-rights extremism, police remain primarily responsible with an agreed contact point and factsheet, and existing legal grounds suffice, while committing to examine stronger penalties and to send a letter to farm organisations before summer.
It is not possible for the police and the Public Prosecution Service to provide an overview of the past 10 years of such criminal activities on and around agricultural businesses.
Het is voor de politie en het OM niet mogelijk om een overzicht te geven van de afgelopen 10 jaar betreffende dergelijke strafbare activiteiten op en rond een agrarisch bedrijf
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Sjoerdsma over VN Intergovernmental Conference on Marine Biodiversity of areas Beyond National Jurisdiction (BBNJ)

Two MPs (D66) asked the ministers about marine biodiversity in areas beyond national jurisdiction (BBNJ), including protection gaps, Dutch participation and ambition at the UN conference, and environmental impact assessment standards. The government answered that the BBNJ treaty process is ongoing, that Dutch ministerial participation is not yet appropriate at this stage, that it supports the High Ambition Coalition statement and 30% protection goals, and that it favours strategic and project environmental impact assessment in the treaty.
Participation at political level is not yet on the table at this stage of the negotiations.
Deelname op politiek niveau is in deze fase van de onderhandelingen nog niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline. The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over het exporteren van hamsters naar Hongkong

MPs Wassenberg and Teunissen asked whether the government would share its exchanges with Hong Kong authorities after hamsters exported from the Netherlands tested positive for the Delta variant, and whether it would halt live rodent exports. The minister said the correspondence was shared with parliament via the health minister, that existing EU and OIE rules were followed without a SARS-CoV-2 requirement, and that no direct reason for a ban exists while exports stay within those rules, with a national zoonosis action plan to follow.
As long as the trade in live rodents to other member states or export to third countries takes place within the framework of this regulation, I see no direct reason to ban the trade.
Zolang de handel van levende knaagdieren naar andere lidstaten of export naar derde landen binnen de kaders van deze regelgeving plaatsvindt, zie ik geen directe aanleiding de handel te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over onderzoek naar en compensatie van faunaschade landbouw

Van der Plas (BBB) asked about the number and reasons of rejected wildlife damage claims for agriculture, whether protected status and cross-border migration of wolves and other species hinder deterrence, whether responsibility should shift away from livestock keepers, whether the Netherlands should seek an EU exemption for wolves, and whether there is cross-border communication on fauna. The minister gave detailed figures on rejected claims, stated the legal framework, said no exemption push is warranted, and described cooperation with Germany, Belgium, Poland and international management platforms, promising a provincial wolf plan after summer.
I expect to be able to send this to your House after the summer.
Ik verwacht dit na de zomer aan uw Kamer te kunnen toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klink, Kamminga en Van Campen over de nadelige gevolgen van het sluiten van de grenzen in Groot-Brittannië met betrekking tot de invoer van aardappelpootgoed uit de EU

MPs asked whether Brexit trade barriers harming the Dutch seed potato sector, including SMEs, would be eased by a derogation or by Brexit Adjustment Reserve support. The minister acknowledged the sector's difficulties, rejected a special derogation for seed potatoes, said export options to the UK are being explored but are complex, and pointed to an internationalisation programme and individual support.
However, this is extremely complex and time-consuming.
Dit is echter uiterst complex en tijdrovend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de wanpraktijken aan boord van vissersschepen op de Noordzee

An MP asked the minister about fish being killed without stunning on Dutch fishing vessels and about enforcement of the landing obligation, including camera monitoring and inspection numbers. The minister answered that no rules govern killing fish at sea, that research on stunning methods is underway, and that inspections of around 300 per year are carried out with plans for a camera monitoring pilot.
In the RVO fisheries information bulletin of December 2021, fishers were once again reminded of the need for complete and correct registration of bycatch.

In het door de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO) uitgegeven informatiebulletin Visserij van december 2021 zijn de vissers nogmaals gewezen op de noodzaak van een volledige en correcte registratie van bijvangsten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Haverkort en Van Campen over de fok en verkoop van kortsnuitige honden

MPs Haverkort and Van Campen asked about a Kassa broadcast showing online sales of short-snouted puppies below the legal skull-nose ratio, the NVWA's enforcement, and the Raad van Beheer's use of the Cambridge test and pedigree papers. The minister said the NVWA inspects breeders against six criteria (15 controls in 2021, 6 violations), that the Raad van Beheer should be held to account, and that the stock of imported and bred pets is still under study with a letter promised this spring.
I am looking into this. I will inform the House about it this spring.
Ik ben dit aan het onderzoeken. Ik informeer uw Kamer dit voorjaar hierover.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het meedoen van het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit aan de Nationale Week Zonder Vlees & Zuivel en het invoeren van het principe ‘Carnivoor?

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture whether the ministry will join the national meat-free week, adopt a plant-based catering default, and endorse plant-based diets for climate and health. The minister answers that the ministry's catering participates in the week, that plant-based protein is supported via the Schijf van Vijf and circular catering policy, but declines to commit to a plant-based default and answers were late.
I tried to send the answers for my department to your House by 7 March. Unfortunately, this did not succeed.
Ik heb getracht de antwoorden voor mijn departement voor 7 maart toe te sturen aan uw Kamer. Dit is helaas niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg naar aanleiding van de aflevering ‘Buitensporige dierenartsrekeningen’ van Meldpunt van 7 januari 2022

An MP asked the ministers about very high emergency veterinary costs for pets, pre-payment demands, advice to borrow money or rehome animals, VAT, market concentration and vet training numbers. The minister replied that veterinary pricing is a free market, that the ACM oversees competition, that vets must disclose prices, and that a study of the veterinary sector and labour market is underway.
The Netherlands Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) is the independent regulator for competition, a number of specific sectors and consumer protection.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) is de onafhankelijke toezichthouder voor mededinging, een aantal specifieke sectoren en de bescherming van consumenten.
Antwoord op van het lid Van Campen over het bericht ‘Explosie in stal in Maarsbergen, brandweer redt twintig koeien uit de mestput’

MP Van Campen asked the ministers about a 2021 barn explosion in Maarsbergen and whether emission-reducing floor systems raise explosion risks, and about research, sector measures, safety requirements and RVO permitting. The minister answered that the studies do not show explosions caused by emission-reducing floors, that several safety measures and innovation requirements are being pursued, and that RVO will consider safety in permit applications.
The studies do not show that stable explosions have occurred as a result of an emission-reducing floor system.
Uit de onderzoeken volgt niet dat er stalexplosies zich hebben voorgedaan als gevolg van een emissiearm vloersysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het artikel 'Landbouwminister in de clinch met Brussel over teruggave fraudemiljoenen'

An MP from Volt asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why parliament was not informed in time about a disputed EU agricultural subsidy fraud case (FresQ, around 52 million euros), whether audits will be shared, and why the minister has not recovered the funds or acted earlier. The minister replies that the case is still in civil and criminal proceedings, that audits are shared with the national audit service and summarized in departmental reports, that a request has been made to charge the unrecovered amount to the EU fund after the company's bankruptcy, and that the Commission has yet to decide.
These audits by the European Commission are aimed at lawfulness errors and can be fairly detailed and technical in nature.
Deze audits van de Europese Commissie zijn gericht op rechtmatigheidsfouten en kunnen vrij gedetailleerd en technisch van aard zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over fraudemiljoenen

Van Haga asked the agriculture minister why parliament was not informed about the FresQ fraud millions, why LTO's chairman was involved, how the NVWA criminal complaint relates to the refusal to repay Brussels, whether this affects the nitrogen derogation, and about EU state aid recovery for nature organisations. The minister answered that ongoing bankruptcy, criminal and EU procedures prevent full disclosure, that a request was made to the Commission to charge the amount to the EU agricultural fund, and that the derogation question is separate.
In this matter several ongoing matters play a role, such as the bankruptcy settlement by the curator and a criminal case.
In deze kwestie spelen nog diverse lopende zaken een rol, zoals de faillissementsafwikkeling door de curator en een strafzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over de uitzending van de Keuringsdienst van Waarde over 'Bij-vriendelijke planten'

MPs Bromet and Kröger asked whether the Keuringsdienst van Waarde broadcast showing pesticide residues on plants sold as bee-friendly was true, whether this misleads consumers and harms insects, and whether labelling warnings should be required. The minister answered that pesticides are approved only after risk assessment including insects, that misleading claims are for the ACM and Reclame Code Commissie to judge, and that warning labels are not needed.

Pesticides are only authorised in the Netherlands if a scientific risk assessment by the College for the Authorisation of Plant Protection Products and Biocides shows that they are safe for humans, animals and the environment when used according to the rules.

Gewasbeschermingsmiddelen worden in Nederland alleen toegelaten als uit een wetenschappelijke risicobeoordeling van het College voor de Toelating van Gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en Biociden blijkt dat ze volgens de voorschriften veilig zijn voor mens, dier en milieu.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de effecten van de Europese Green Deal op de landbouwopbrengst

MP Boswijk (CDA) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a WUR study predicting that EU Green Deal cuts in pesticide and fertiliser use would lower crop yields, raise prices and increase imports and land use abroad. The minister found the study useful but limited in scope, said he would assess each Commission proposal on its merits and inform parliament via BNC-fiches, and pointed to Commission work on new breeding techniques, carbon farming and carbon border adjustment as ways to address farm incomes and leakage.

I will work towards an integrated implementation of the Green Deal, including the Farm to Fork Strategy, and will assess each individual proposal the Commission puts forward under the Green Deal on its merits, including its possible consequences.

Ik ga mij inzetten voor een integrale implementatie van de Green Deal, waaronder de BtB, en zal elk individueel voorstel dat de Commissie onder de vlag van de Green Deal uitbrengt op zijn merites beoordelen, inclusief de mogelijke consequenties ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het bericht dat er mogelijk wolven uitgezet zijn in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister whether wolves may have been released illegally in the Netherlands, how they arrived, what risks they pose to people and animals, the penalties for release, and how citizens can protect themselves and what the costs are. The Minister answered that release is considered very unlikely, that release is a punishable offence under the Nature Conservation Act with penalties up to two years' imprisonment or a fine, that no exemption was granted, and gave cost figures and prevention advice.
No exemption has been granted for releasing wolves in the Netherlands.
Er is geen ontheffing afgegeven voor het uitzetten van wolven in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de weigering van het Erasmus Medisch Centrum om gegevens over proefdierengebruik te delen met de toezichthouder

MP Wassenberg asked whether Erasmus MC refused to supply animal experiment data to the NVWA, whether this breaches the Dierproevenregeling, and what sanctions would follow. The minister answered that Erasmus MC met its legal registration obligations, that the missing institution-level table is not legally required, that reminders were sent without reply, and that the national overview remains complete.
Erasmus Medical Centre (MC) complied with the legally required registration requirements for animal experiments and laboratory animals in 2020.
Het Erasmus Medisch Centrum (MC) heeft aan de wettelijk verplichte eisen over de registratie van uitgevoerde dierproeven en proefdieren 2020 voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de samenstellingsvoorschriften voor babyvoeding

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the composition rules for baby food, including whether the old Directive 2006/125/EC still applies, how spreadable sandwich fillings fall under the rules, and whether the rules will be tightened. The Minister for Health answered that the directive remains in force until EU delegated acts are adopted, that enforcement follows the Warenwetbesluit, that the EU work has stalled, and that the Netherlands will push for stricter composition requirements.
The Netherlands will, in developing the delegated act for cereal-based foods and baby food, ensure that the composition requirements are strictly delimited.
Nederland zal bij de ontwikkeling van de gedelegeerd handeling voor op granen gebaseerde levensmiddelen en babyvoeding zorgen dat de samenstellingseisen strikt worden afgebakend
